comments: Arnaldo's place is good for party travelers — the bars of Barrio Bellavista are right outside your doorstep. Of course, this means it can get a little noisy during the weekends. Still, if you're looking for a place in a good location (near a metro station and in close proximity to Santiago landmarks), this is a comfortable, decent place to stay in.

It has been a really great experience staying in America's house. She's a wonderful host, very responsive and helpful. There are other interesting people staying in the house and it is a great way not to feel lonely when traveling abroad. I would definitely stay there again!

Arnaldo was a great host. The place was very clean with a nice doorman at the entrance with our key. Bella Vista is a great neighborhood with a close proximity to several nice restaurants, bars and the metra rail! Arnaldo stopped by the last night to help us arrange a taxi for a 4am Pick for our flight! I would highly recommend using him in the future.

Thank you

Excellent apartment, it is all that you may need if you visit santiago, very good neighborhood and close to everything. Great view of the mountains.

I would totally recommend it. Consuelo is always helping you to find things to do, very concern about you have a good experience in the city

Camilla at Santiago Backpackers took great care of us. The apartment was perfectly located and provided exactly what we needed for a night. Camilla gave us great recommendations of places to eat/drink. Great overall.

We had a very nice stay in this confortable apartment in the very centre of Siantago. It is very modern and completely furnished, and Emelina gave us a phone to get in touch with her or Miguel for any question. We enjoyed the proximity of downtown, just at 5 minutes walking. A very good adress!

I was one of the first guests of Emelina and Michael - I never got to see them because of organizational reasons but it was not even necessary.

Everything was planned so nicely and I felt very welcomed in the apartment.

They even left a phone for me in order to contact them if I would have needed anything.

But it was not necessary at all.
The portier of the building and some other persons in the house helped me around the building - also with the laundry.

Everything was perfectly clean and well equipped!

I am in Santiago from time to time and I will come back to this place for sure as soon as I will be back in Santiago!


Saludos desde Viena!
Excellent apartment.  Consuelo was always contactable.  Near the road but peaceful and we got a very good night's sleep.  We would definitely stay here again.

Nice place within walking distance of the San Miguel metro. I shared the apartment with only one roommate because we each wanted our own room (and our own bathroom since the apartment has two), but there's plenty of space to accommodate a couple with one or two children as well. The host (Cecilia) was helpful and responsive, and her English is very good.

Miguel's apartment has an excellent location! Is neat, clean and beautiful. Thank you Miguel and Emelina for your hospitality! I definitely look forward in coming back to Santiago and stay in your apt again. Best Wishes, Gabe

.
The apartment is small and compact but has everything you need. Clean, bed comfortable, good wifi, helful hosts (although we didnt meet them). The location is awesome as is Emelina y Miguel's help and communication. We had a hiccup with their arranged taxi (friend) pick-up for our very early departure flight not arriving on time so we had to grab an alternate taxi. That of course was not within their control.

Consuelo and Francisco's apartment is perfect for a Santiago staying. The bed is really comfortable, the shower works well, the building is new and we were able to use the laundry to get our clothes clean (good for backpackers). In addition, is very well located - a few blocks from Bellavista nightlife and also close to the downtown tourist attractions (we did everything on foot, but you can also take a cab or the subway - there is a station two blocks away). Consuelo and Francisco are very friendly and made we feel at home (like all Chileans we met, great people). It's a good value for money to stay in this apartment. We would definitely stay there again.
Saludos! :)

Comfortable and clean apartment suitable for us (2 adults/2children). The location/area was fun and convenient especially for dining and sightseeing. Arnaldo was very helpful and attentive, filling every request and checking-in throughout our stay. Everything worked, complete kitchen, comfortable beds, hot/warm showers, clean bathrooms, heat throughout, amazing views! Thank you Arnaldo!

Our host Cecilia was just fantastic and could not have been more helpful. Cecilia is the perfect host. The apartment is effectively new with everything and more you would expect in your own home. So convenient to the awesome metro and the supermarket both just minutes away by foot with an Italian restaurant just round the corner. The view from the apartment looked over the downtown area and with the Andes mountains in the background. The whole experience was wonderful and we would not hesitate in going back to book again with Cecilia. Thank you Cecilia we were so fortunate to meet you.

Consuelo and Francisco are very kind hosts.  The apartment had everything we needed - free parking, easy walk to the train station, great views, comfy bed, etc.  The wifi stopped working and they were able to have it fixed promptly and they offered us a free night stay given the outage.  We'd happily stay with Consuelo and Francisco again.

Great place, great location, we enjoyed our stay very much. We got to know Emeline and Miguel on our final day and they were absolutely great.
The place was clean and exactly what we needed. Walking distance from everything. My wife and I highly recommend it.
Overall great! It's a very small apartment but it has everything you will need and close to the metro. They even left a phone so I can use it. Nice touch!

Emelina and Miguel were very friendly and helpful and did everything to make our stay comfortable.
The apartment is located very central we could reach all interesting sites by walking, anyway a subway is also nearby. It is very clean and situated in a nice elegant building.
When we arrived from the airport, Emelina welcomed us and provided us with a lot of useful information. We definitely recommend this place!

We spent over a month af the beautiful apartment. The location was perfect and extremely convenient with all amenities within walking distance. Graziela is an outstanding host. So far the best we have come across. We loved our stay at Graziela's place.

Arnaldo is a great host. He communicates well both in email and during your stay. He is easy going, laid back and an all around fun person.  We travel with two small dogs and he cheerfully welcomed them as well! The apartment was clean, cozy, inexpensive and we would stay there again without hesitation!
Fracisco was a very accommodating host who made us feel welcome after a long trans-Pacific flight with two young children. The apartment is great and well located in a quiet neighborhood.

Gerardo was very sharp at communicating in advance of our stay and a prepared host. His Santiago Bellavista apartment is well equipped in the kitchen and the were beds very comfortable. Lovely neighborhood, very centrally located, would definitely book again!
A perfectly situated flat from where you could reach everything without using the tube. A very nice view from high above.

This was the second time we stayed with Francisco, and again we thoroughly enjoyed his hospitality as well as his fantastic apartment, which is conveniently located to shops and public transport, well-resourced, and in a very nice neighborhood. I would highly recommend staying with Francisco.

Excellent value apartment located close to the Bellavista neighborhood which has the best restaurants and nightlife in Santiago. You are also just a bridge away from Centro and all the touristic and cultural attractions of the city. Consuelo and Francisco were very responsive from the moment I inquired about the property to the time I checked in and checked out.

Has been a great time at Dantes home. he´s a very kind guy giving you the space to feel really at home. And he´s as helpful as someone can be. He gave me a lot of advices where to go, how to go etc. He´s really easy going and has letting me be so as well.

The place is just amazing. It´s on a upper level of a tower though you´ve got a amazing view upon the city – and a seldom seen sunset. You´re pretty central to everything. a super market is beside the house as well as the cultural center gabriela mistral - an very vivid and charming place.

in short: I recommend Dante as well as his place warmly to everyone!

The neighborhood was close to patio bella vista right across the street which is very convenient and there is a mini mart close too. It was about a 15 to 20 min walk to xerro st lucia. Taxis were cheap. The accomdations was clean and bed comfortable. In the weekends it ca be a littlw loud from patio bella vista across street
Arnoldo was accomodating when our travel plans chgd several times. The wifi was great. The only down side was the water was cold which in the morning is not too pleasant. He came by to check on us after i messaged him to help with wifi. Didnt see him much after that but The concierge is very friendly n helpful. The view at night is amazing. The other down side is we had no wherw to chrge phone because the plugs were small circular holes. We had to buy adaptera or use the usb on the tv

Thank you very much for hosting us during our stay in Santiago!
The appartement is really nice and clean and in a perfect location for sightseeing, nightlife etc.
I can absolutely recommend it!

Miguel was very welcoming and very good with communication. He began messaging us 3 months prior to our trip to make sure everything was in line. And during our stay we were in contact through message as well. He answered all our questions. adequately.  The place is just as listed. It is super close to everything, great location. Never once did we get on public transit to visit the major attractions. Excellent stay.

The apartment is perfect, Cecilia is very friendly and helpful, had an excellent reception, including transfer, explained the apartment and nearby places besides leaving a guide with city tips. About the apartment, it is just like in the pictures; is complete and nothing is missing. Close to subway, the two great markets and pharmacies. Recommend and come back no doubt.

Francisco was very friendly and welcoming, and was very flexible in terms of our arrival time, even though we checked in on Christmas day!  The apartment is in a beautiful, quiet residential neighborhood with running/biking paths and parks nearby.  The apartment was great, and was even stocked with everything we needed for breakfast, including eggs, bread/butter, fruit and coffee!  I had a great stay and would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Santiago.

Emelina and Michel are great hosts: they answerd all our questions and helped us alot. The apartment is in a very central location, close to all important sights. Also it is cozy, tidy and very clean. Thank you very much! :)

Arnaldo was an excellent host. He was extremely responsive, helpful, and courteous. If we had any issues, he quickly resolved them. The apartment is exactly how it appears in the photos/description: safe, great location to San Cristobal, metro stations, Patio Bellavista and tons of bars and restaurants. I would say, since we were very light sleepers, you definitely need to bring ear plugs because you can hear the club music and drums well into the early morning.

Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend this place to people who are looking to be close to the Bellavista nightlife.

Well located compact studio apartment, allowing us to easily visit the heart of Santiago on foot. Clean and tidy, with all that we needed for our visit. Friendly and secure building. Good recommendation for area restaurant from Emelina and Miguel. We would gladly return.
The apartment is well situated, perfect to visit Santiago for a few days. It's clean and well equiped. Emelina and Miguel are very helpful and kind ! Muchas gracias.

Dante was awesome. When I arrived he had a big bottle of water and a six pack of beer waiting for me. He was always considerate about my needs, and gave me great suggestions for things to do and see in Chile. I would definitely stay again. Muchas gracias Dante!

Roberto kept a great communication and was quick with replying. The apartment was as described and it really is perfect for 1 person or a couple. The area is safe and public transportation easy to reach. Totally recommend it. Quiet street and nice area but still in the middle of the city. Would take it again. Thanks for everything!

The apartment was as described. It was a far walk from the metro station. There are however plently of buses on the main road. Close to shops and supermarkets. Wifi was fast and reliable. Both owners were great to deal with and we had no problems.

We stayed for two nights in that cosy Santiago apartment and really enjoyed it! The location is absolutely great, you get a real good value for money here. Communication with the hosts was fast, nice and charming, as they even allowed us to check in the very early morning around 6 AM. A big Thanks for organizing that! Overall we can highly recommend that apartment for a stay in Santiago and would always come back.

Graziela was a great host.  The apartment was beautiful, exactly as described and pictured in the photos.  Doormen were very nice.  Bed was very comfortable and dual AC units are both cold.  Great view of the park from the balcony, and a quick walk to restaurants and shops at Parque Arauco.  Everything went off without a hitch; I would definitely stay here again.

The hosts made us feel very welcome. We had no trouble finding the apartment and it is in an excellent location. The door men were very helpful and the apartment was clean and well equipped. The only con would be the heat. Because it is on an interior court yard there is zero air circulation and it was very hot at night.
Nice cozy apartment. Good location, walking distance from everything. Check in and out very smooth and easy. The hosts were very responsive and helpful.

This was great house to stay in - a quiet, beautiful street in a great neighborhood. I´m impressed with how modern and clean my flat was, and also with the kindness of the host. Absolutely recommend staying here.

I had a very good time in the apartement in Satiago! Sergio was very nice and helped me whenever I needed help. The appartement was what I expected - joining the community of students in Santiago. Nothing to complain about - Thanks for everything!

My husband and I spent four nights in Emelina and Miguel's studio apartment in central Santiago.  Very clean, comfortable, and welcoming.  No problems getting the key from the concierge when we arrived. It was great to have a small kitchen for making coffee and having breakfast before our day adventures.  There's a grocery store two blocks away.  The bed is very comfortable. The location is fantastic for exploring central Santiago by foot.  In a charming neighborhood: Paris-Londres.  Wifi is great.  Cellphone coverage inside the apartment is very poor.  We really enjoyed our stay.  Emelina and Miguel were very accommodating with our exit time and leaving for the airport.  Emelina and Miguel, thanks for everything!

We really liked the appartment. It is small but so cozy and with everything you need for a good stay. The location is great, really close to the city center, a great supermarket is close as well as the subway.
i could not think of a reason not to stay there another time.

The apartment as well as communicating with Eduardo were fantastic. I could not have hoped for a better experience. The apartment is clean and has everything needed to live comfortably. The location is convenient with access to the metro. Highly recommended!

We stayed a week in Emelina's and Miguel's apartment. Although we found the apartment a little small, we were comfortable and it was impeccable. Location is excellent! Within walking distance of everything. Our hosts were nice, they responded to our messages right away and allowed us to check out late because we had a later flight. I would recommend their apartment!

We stayed in Francisco's house for one night. It has several self contained apartments which are comfortable, very well equipped and spotlessly clean. Francisco lives on the bottom floor and was readily available to help with any questions we had. Highly recommended.

It was a very nice stay. Emilina and Miguel are a very friendly couple, though we did not had the chance to meet them in person. Very well organized and communication was perfect. The flat is top and perfect for a stay in santiago!

The room of Sergio is really convenient for a short stay in Santiago. It very well located and having your own bathroom is a plus. Just the noise from the street can bother you at night.
Sergio is really a nice guy and open-minded. He will not hesitate to help you if you need.

Christian is a friendly person and communication was perfect. Flat is pretty good for some nights to stay, maybe at night some loud neighbours, but that is something you can't evoid sometimes. We liked it! Thanks again @ christian.

This cozy apartment is perfect for a stay in Santiago! In fact, we love it so much, this is the second time we have stayed here! The hosts are terrific and the apartment has everything you need! It's close to everything and is very secure. It even has a doorman who can help too.

We will stay here every time we are in Santiago if we can get a reservation with Emelina and Miguel! It is now a very popular spot to stay!

Highly recommended!

Sergio is a very kind host. Having moved to Santiago for work, he helped me with pretty much everything and was hence a very welcome help. He cooked every night for me, lent me clothes when my suitcases went missing, and kept me for some nights for free when I still hadn't found an appartment, like a friend would do. If you lost faith in humanity, stay at his place!  Very much recommended host.

Our stay at Cecilia's apartment was awesome. It is close to the San Miguel metro line. The apartment is just like the pictures; very clean and modern. Cecilia was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Highly recommend!

The studio is really cute, quite functional and quiet. It is clean, the shower is warm and has a great pressure. There are two doormen all day and night. We checked out pretty late and someone was waiting for us at the apartment. We did not get a chance to meet Cristian but he was so helpful giving us information on which bus to take from/to the airport. Overall a great transit in Santiago at a great price and a center location, will definitely go back next time in town!

Great location, great place. 24 hr security bldg. You're on the 15th floor in the middle of Santiago. Got a bit cold in the evening, so used the stove on medium and it was nice.

420 friendly with a outdoor deck w/sofa.

Eduardo even invited me with his girlfriend and the party was worth the whole Santiago trip. The people, the food and conversation with my broken spanish was definitely the highlight of this trip.

We had a fantastic time at Cristián's home! The flat is in a great location, there are supermarkets and metro stations nearby. The flat is fully equipped with towels,soap etc. Everything is very clean and tidy.
Thanks for having us! :)

Gerardo was very helpful, organized a baby Chair for us, when the fridge broke down he got a new one the Day After, gave advice on Hospitals. Thank you so much! The Apartment is in the Arty and Night Life area, on the tenth floor it was Not too Loud for our baby. Restaurants and Bars are very close. The Apartment was as shown on the pictures, everything you Need, cool view from the balcony. We stayed six Weeks and enjoyed the Place. Thanks again!

Excellent! I couldn’t have asked for a better host. Phillip is attentive and very responsive, he made sure I was comfortable throughout my stay at his loft. The location is incredible, the neighborhood is great with many restaurants at walking distance. The apartment is fantastic and I was allowed to use the parking structure. I truly recommend this location. I enjoyed every minute of it.

Everything was just perfect. The place is very central, you can get to the subway very easily.
When we got there the place was ready for us, so clean and cosy. If you are going with your partner or with a friend, this apartment is perfect! The kitchen is also good, you can cook anything there.
I really recommend this place, our experience is Santiago was much more enjoyable because of this apartment. :)

The location for this apartment is absolutely fantastic. In addition to being so close to the metro stop, it is also next a lot of great places to eat as well as what became by favourite coffee shop called 'wonderful'. Angelo is one of the best hosts I've had. He was very respectful and chilled out, socialised with me when I wanted and truly made me feel like I was at home. I feel that made my experience in Santiago even better and I also feel like I made a new friend. You can come to London and stay with me anytime you want! Thanks again for hanging out with me and all the tips! I miss Santiago already!

Francisco was the perfect host, he help us with anything we need to know and the apartment is super cozy and we all you need, even fresh bread! The studio is situated in a quiet and nice neighborhood, easy to get in the city with public transport. I will definitely recommend it!
Excellent apartment and very warm welcome. Graziela thinks of everything! The family had a lovely time in this very centrally located Las Condes apartment.

The apartment is as pictured. It is clean and there is plenty of room for at least 3 or more people. It is in a well located area close to plenty of amenities such as clubs, bars and places to eat. Downtown is only 5-10 minute walk away. Gerardo is a great host and ready and willing to answer any of your questions.

Staying at Araucaria was a great experience!  The house was stylish & very well heated for the cold winter.  Everyone there were so welcoming and made us feel right at home.  Even our friends who came over to visit loved the house.  The location was superb.  Walking distance to many shopping and restaurant choices and close to everything.  We have enjoyed ourselves at this house and we highly recommend it to everyone!  Thank you Mabel & all everyone at Casas del Cerro!

I was in Angelo home for about 9 nights, the experience was great! Angelo is very respectful, and very gentle; he is also committed to make your stay at his beautiful apartment an awesome experience. As a host he try his best to accommodate to your needs and provided you with key information about Santiago, where to go and what to do. The apartment is in the 21-22 floor and it has beautiful views.... Close to everything the metro, restaurants, and Santiago centro. Very conveniente! Thanks angelo!
One mire thing! If you are planning to go to Valparaiso and vina del mar, ask angelo for his hostel , he has one in Valparaiso, a very well looked After place, where you will be have a great experience in the heart of Valparaiso and a great view.

This is a great little place within walking distance of a lot of Santiago's hip neighborhoods. It's also right across the street from a Metro station if you need it for any reason.
The building is modern, clean and secure. It also has good heating, which according to many locals, is uncommon in Santiago.
On clear days you have a great view of the Andes from the balcony.

I had a really good time at Nestors place - the room is small, but fine to stay for some nights. Nestor is a nice guy and was always willing to help me, when I had some questions or needed advice concerning live in Santiago. The location of Nestors home is perfect to explore Santiago; its very central and offers opportunities to go out and see cultural places like museums or to just go out and have some drinks. I  enjoyed my stay - i can only recommend it!
Excellent accommodation. This clean and conveniently located studio is fully equipped: they even provide a mobile phone with local sim and netflix on the smartTV!

Patricia made us very welcome, with fruit and other basic foods waiting for us when we arrived after a long journey. The description was accurate, and the area nice, having lots of shops and interesting restaurants. Patricia also helped us out with good local info, from sites to a laundrette.
I had a good stay in Santiago, the apartment has a very well location in the city and a great view. Thank you so much Eduardo.
I stay Nestor's house only two nights. Nestor is nice and help. The location is good.

Angelo is fantastic, the best host I've ever met and a friend now, he made me feel at home from the first moment. The house is at the top floor of a tower with a great view of the all neighbourhood, it is in downtown and at walkable distance from any interesting points in Santiago.
The apartment is perfect, wonderful location, amazing view to the montains sta Lucia and San cristobal hills and the whole city.

Francisco has a great place. His apartments are in an easy to get to neighbourhood. They are particularly good because they are near pocuro and it has a great bike path to get around. The kitchen is duly equipped and overall the space is very comfortable. I will be back!
Great apartment, the overall experience was excellent. The apartment has everything you may need and its location is great. Would recommend it 100%.

Patricia was an excellent host, her mother took the effort to stay at the apartment and waited for us till we arrived. The location of the apartment just cannot get any better, being located on the 21st floor with sweeping views of Santiago it just cannot get any better. The apartment was very comfortable, with a nice built in kitchen. I definitely recommend everyone to visit the 25th floor where you have 360 degree sweeping views of entire Santiago. The place is very easy to get to, if you are coming from airport just take the Centro Puerto shuttle it will drop you at the Los Heroes station, from there take the metro to the Presidential place, which is just a one stop away. From the metro station its just couple of blocks. Will definitely stay at this place on our next visit.

Great apartment.  It was exactly as described.  It was really nice to have two bedrooms and two bathrooms.  The building is secure and safe.  The location was great, but it did get a little loud because it's so close to the action in Bellavista.

Thank you, Nestor, for your hospitality.  I appreciated you showing me how to use the gated entrance and following up with me regarding my airport transfer.  Your location is super! It's so close to metro Bellas Artes. Hope to visit you again soon!

Santiago was amazing ! And the apartment couldn't have been better ! Everything was perfect ! Alejandro also was an awesome houseowner ! He helps you with everything you want and is very open minded so can get along with everybody !

Great location of apartment with great views. The apartment was as described in the website, though the pool in the pics is only open for a few summer months (being English, we found some of the winter sun lovely and would have happily sat by the pool!)
The owners were really great, replied to any queries we had while we were there promptly. We were there during the recent earthquake and they also got in touch to make sure we were ok and offered advice, which was lovely.

We had a great time, the apartment is located in a very nice, and full of live environment. The university quarter brings you all the nice people (and then the great story's which are the spice of each travel) in front of your door. The apartment itself is clean and have all the things you need (maybe instead of a hairdryer, we had rain). Shower has great pressure and temperature (for my the minimum requirement to start in a joyful day). Jean was very helpful and supports us with all information we needed (how to come to the place, people who will help us (hi marcelo), and when the WiFi is bad he organized a new access in minutes).
Really can recommend this place!

Francisco was a good host and very accomodating. Though it was listed as an instant booking, and we made the reservation, Francisco informed us that the apartment was not available for all of the days. Fortunately he was able to accomodate us in other apartment he had, which was also very good. Advice: make sure you check with Francisco of the availability of the rooms.
Apart from that, the location is pretty good, there is normally parking available in front of the house, and there is a supermarket less than 2 blocks away. Services are very good with a good speed internet connection. We wanted to stay again when we returned to Santiago but the rooms wanted were not available.

Everything was great! From my arrival day to the end. Excellent service and a very cosy room with a beautiful view over a part of the capital if Santiago De Chile. I recommend this place highly and I hope you will enjoy.

Great location, clean and comfy place, rooftop balcony with both washers and dryers and all for an excellent price. Jean was great with quick communication and was very helpful. His mother also lives in the building which makes checking in and out quick and easy. Highly recommended.

Francisco is the sort of bloke that after meeting him you feel like you've been friends for a long time. He went out of his way to make us feel welcome.

Thanks Francisco.
Graziela was a fantastic host; I will stay in her place again. Best neighborhood, a block away from Starbucks, a huge supermarket and one of the finest shopping malls. It was a good find.

Everything was ok, flat was nice and tidy, we slept well though there was a halloween party in the block:) were too tired to bother:)
Quite easy to find, good choice, thanks!

Great place in a very nice a safe neighbourhood. The place is an small apartment really close to the metro. Nothing fancy but perfectly functional. Perfect for up to 4 people.

Patricia was really friendly and helpful. She even arrange for some small food and transport cards.

We booked this apartment specifically because of its location - knowing that it wasn't central, but a short walk from the airport shuttle to catch it for our return flight. When we arrived, the owner greeted us at the reception, brought us to the apartment and showed us everything we needed to know: wifi password, where all the bedding was, how to get a hold of her if needed. There was a complimentary bottle of wine and a bottle of water for us, which we happily enjoyed :)

We booked the apartment for four people - two of use slept in the bed and two took the futon. It's not the most convenient setup having the washroom accessed through the main bedroom, but not a big deal if you're staying with friends or family. If there were any issues, the owner addressed them right away, which was a nice change from other places we've stayed at in Santiago.
Néstor was very kind and most helpful. The accommodation, although very basic, was very well located. The Price was most reasonable

The apartment was clean and as pictured, checking  in was easy and convenient. We enjoyed our stay and the roof top view. Public transportation was easy to get to, walking around the area at night was not a big deal. I would recommend staying here.

We stayed for two nights over the weekend. Claudia showed us in and was really helpful with everything we needed. The kitchen  was small and doesn't have a full cooker but was fine for our few days stay. It was close to the metro and around 20/25 minutes walk to Plaza des Armes, so easy to get around and explore the city. We found a great coffee place on Av Ricardo Cummings called Forastero,  which is close and well worth a visit.

As I arrived when Nestor was at work he arranged to have his mother meet me. A charming lady who showed me the apartment. The apartment is ideally located close to the subway, parks, museums and plazas. I recommend staying at Nestors
This apartment is in the good location and it's very safe and comfortable . Nice and friendly house owner.
Cecilia was very quick to respond and answered all the questions we had to make our stay as easy as possible. Lovely room with gorgeous view of the mountains. Easy enough to get a taxi into the city.

Nestor was very welcoming, friendly and helpful. The apartment, bedroom and bathroom were very clean. Nestor helped me arrange some bus tickets for a trip in the south which was great! Plus, the apartment is very well located in a fun, bustling part of Santiago close to good restaurants, parks and museums!
Thank you Nestor!

Was received by Jean's wonderful mother with a bottle of while and sweets, so kind.. The flat was super clean and ready for us.  Good location for anyone trying to get to the metro or to the bus station.  Very light space as well.

Jean did a great job of coordinating my arrival, especially since I booked last minute. The space is just as you see in the pictures—very clean and comfortable! I was only here one night, resting up before the next leg of my trip to Brazil, and this was the perfect place to relax. Safe neighborhood, quiet and comfortable apartment. Thank you!

Mabel was so accommodating, the house was amazing and the location was ideal to explore the city. She had delicious wine, chocolates and some breakfast staples waiting for us upon arrival which were totally unexpected and was always available. The house could comfortably sleep at least 8 people, if not more. I would highly recommend staying here.

Nice flat, in a good location close to the underground (metro) and in a nice street.  Jean's mother was very helpful giving advices how to commute and move around.  A very nice thing it was a bottle of red wine waiting for me in the room.  Many thanks.

Nester's place was great! Everything was clean and he really made me feel like a guest at his apartment, not just someone renting a room. The place is in a great location and is very close to the subway. I can't imagine finding a place with a better location and price.

When we arrived at the apartment we were happy to see that Jean was ready to meet us! She lives on the floor below so it's very easy to ask for her help. The apartment itself is cosy and was what we needed for a one night layover.

Mabel and Antonio were excellent hosts. Their attention to detail is great. They picked us up from the airport and provided us with enough food to have a good first breakfast. They were also quite accommodating in helping us rent a car and organize some sight seeing. The apartment was as advertised - stylishly decorated in a very nice neighborhood convenient to restaurants and shopping. I highly recommend booking your next stay in santiago at one of Mabel's apartments.

Patricia was so helpful with our stay in Santiago.  The apartment was clean with a good view and pretty close to the major attractions of Santiago. Our flight was late and she was great about it. Would definitely stay here again.
Francisco is a great host. He is amicable and sociable. The place is quiet and very private. The neighborhood is quite nice. It has some quaint stores for ice cream or for groceries.

Such a terrific apartment in a wonderful and safe neighbourhood of Santiago. Francisco was a terrific host meeting us upon our arrival. The kitchen was stocked with some supplies for breakfast our first morning - such a nice treat! The apartment remained cool despite the heat outside, and was quite quiet. Check out was great, and we were allowed to leave our bags until we needed a taxi, which Francisco kindly arranged for us. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again if we make it back to Santiago.

My parents absolutely enjoyed their stay at Philip's apartment. They were so comfortable here that I nearly had to drag them away just to see a bit of the city :). This place is beautiful, clean and has an huge terrace overlooking a lovely green space with lots of trees. The location is wonderful (safe and just walking distance from lots of bars and restaurants). Philip is a great host. He made sure we had everything we needed and was quick to respond with any questions. He left us a little welcome "home" wine and sweets (the small touches that really make you feel welcome). I couldn't recommend this place enough. Hopefully you're lucky enough to catch it when it's available!
Nestor is such a kind man, he's house is located in the heart of the city, and it is very nice and clean. I love living with Nestor! Totally recommended :)

Angelo was a great host. He was accommodating to ensure that someone would be there at my arrival time, was helpful in telling me about the city, and was concerned and attentive to make my stay a positive experience.  In addition, the location of the apartment is excellent, close to the subway stop, restaurants and shops, an artisan market, and various city attractions.
Very simple and nice apartment.  Very accommodating of odd arrival time.  Doorman building.
Top class. One of the best, if not best places I've stayed. Lovely people who will help you with anything you need. Beautiful neighbourhood and great proximity to metro.

Nestor is really helpful giving me a lot of informations about Chile, kind playing PS3 with me even not felt angry after I accidently delete his record and just like my father cheered me up when I faced some terrible things in Santiago. Playing with his kids are one of my best memory in Santiago!

The house is so warm and I was so chill staying there. It's near a park which I could just sit under the tree and do nothing or going up the hill and see the view of Santiago and even go to the central market for the best fish dishes. It's all close to Nestor's house!

The bed is cozy and it's even bigger than the picture that I could put my 30' luggage inside. It is so good that there is a toilet and a basin in the room!

I would definitely recommend Nestor's house for staying in Santiago!!!!

We had a very pleasant stay at Francisco's flat. It was spacious and perfect for our needs especially with travel with our little toddler who was provided with his own crib. Great location, very close to a lovely playground and a stone's throw from numerous cafe's and a tasty pizzeria. I highly recommend this flat as Francisco was very accommodating to our needs ensuring we were enjoying our stay. Thanks and when we return to Santiago we will not hesitate to return to this flat!

Apartment 2 blocks fm advertised address and quite small. Hostel staff were helpful but we still didn't get towels for 2 of 3 day stay.
On 5th floor looking into other windows and washing machine and drier are laundromat arrangement near lobby.
Shower badly adjusted so impossible to use without wetting floor and there's no drain in bathroom floor.
No security tag supplied so building access was difficult.
Rooftop pool "closed for maintenance" and it looks sadly neglected and closed for good!
Electric fan would have been nice.
Apartment was very centrally located. Consuelo was very attentive in emailing information and coordinating access for us.

The room was clean, perfect size for 2 travellers, and in a prime location.  We absolutely loved the view of Santiago from the balcony!  It was great to use the pool on the top of the building.  Wondeful, great way to spend new years!

This apartment is beautiful with everything you could ask for! Having stayed in a few Airbnbs in Santiago a couple of major “pluses” stick out with this apartment: full international cable package (lots of American channels), TVs in both living room and bedroom, spotless Wifi coverage, and en suite washing machine. The apartment is spotless and the maid is very nice and meticulous. The only reason I’m still not living there is that Philip needed to move in himself! As for Philip, couldn’t ask for a nicer guy/landlord. He was traveling quite a bit when I was living in the apartment but he was still super responsive to all of my questions (where can I find a good gym, for example). Perhaps the best Airbnb experience in Santiago… you’ll only regret moving out!
What a great host and property.  Graziela made this a very easy and stress-free experience for our first time renting from Airbnb.

The apartment was perfectly located in the Bellas Artes district of Santiago. Checkin was very easy at the hostel a few blocks away. Everyone there was incredibly helpful. The apartment was basic but had everything we needed and the views were unreal. We discovered the rooftop deck on our last night and watched one of the most beautiful sunsets I've ever experienced over a glass of wine. Two thumbs up.
Great location but apartment needs some attention to detail.  Cable TV and wifi was out of service.  Communication with host was poor.  Bedding was not optimal.

We had a great experience at Jean's apartment. It was perfect for our two days stay in Santiago. The apartment is less than a 10 minute walk to a metro station, which connects you to anywhere you want to go in Santiago. The wifi was excellent and the bottle of wine was a nice touch :) We highly recommend this apartment!
Yes! Everything was great! Jean (and his mother) was very responsive and helpful with everything!

The location of this apartment is excellent, and the view is spectacular.  However, we booked the apartment with the goal of having privacy since we were a trio (a couple and a single) and the door to the second bedroom didn't shut because it was blocked by the bunk beds in the room. Ari was really friendly when we checked in and when we the Internet didn't work, the hostel fixed it right away.

Cecilia was a great host, the place was in a great location close to the metro and close to nice restaurants.  Cecilia recommended one of the best restaurants we have eaten at in chile and best value too. The views from the apartment at night were spectacular, it was fun sitting on the deck watching the sun shine on different parts of the Andes.

The house was beautiful and a great location, a 10 minute walk to the Tobalaba metro and the Costanera Center. The loft is open and beautiful with rooms that have very comfortable beds. We were greeted with a bottle of wine, chocolates, and a refrigerator stocked with water, eggs, ham, cheese, and bread. Mabel also provided shampoo and conditioner in each shower. They were very accommodating and responsive, and had cleaning staff to clean the place while we were gone. Next time you're in Santiago be sure to stay at Mabel's!

Francisco was very accommodating. The apartment is as pictured, very clean and comfortable. There was a maid that cleaned almost every day, we weren't expecting that. We were able to walk many places to eat or purchase food to cook back at the apartment.
The neighborhood is very clean and safe and close to two subway stations. We walked downtown a couple to times with ease, about 4 km. When back in Santiago we will definitely will book with Francisco again.

Apartment is well appointed and comfortable. Apartment excellent size for a couple. Has very nice views and large windows with good ventilation. No TV but internet works well. The location is in a secure and modern building. Close to the historic center and Belevista neighborhood. But be aware the area surrounding can be rough especially at night. Just use common sense.
Really enjoyed host hospitality & space. Francisco arranged for driver. Located in lovely walking neighborhood. Looking forward to staying here again on our next trip through Santiago.

It was very convenient to book and stay at Jean's apartment. He's mother is also very kind and helpful.  It's in a nice location and the welcome bottle of wine is a nice touch. Our group found the apartment not too comfortable for 4 people, mainly because the only bathroom is inside the bedroom and the door wasn't shutting properly. However it is a cost benefit evaluation, as his apartment has a attractive price.

Gonzalo was a great host. He was really responsive - we booked the same day we arrived. He was helpful and met us at the apartment. The apartment is great - there are lots of extra touches which make you feel at home and the furnishings and appliances are top quality. It is a very central location but quiet. The rooftop pool is great in summer and we would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking to be in a central but quiet area of Santiago. A plus is that there a number of restaurants by the building for lunch and dinner options.

I picked up the keys from the front desk attendant as directed by the hosts.  The apartment was clean as advertised, basic amenities.  Internet connection was good.  I didn't take advantage of the kitchen to cook my own meals but it was there if needed.  The apartment has a nice vie of Cerro San Cristobal and is about 6 blocks away from Patio Bellavista.  Adjacent streets were lacking as far as groceries and cafes, closer to fashion district.

This apartment is in a nice and lively student area and very conveniently located very closed to public transportation (metro and buses). There is a decent size supermarket just a few blocks away. The apartment is cozy and has everything you need. I was able to prepare simple dinner and breakfast. Check-in and out with Jean's friendly mother (who lives in the same building) was smooth and easy.

Eduardo's place was excellent. The location (very close to parks, the metro, supermarkets, restaurants), the cleanliness, the balconies (yes, there are 2!), everything! There is also a nice pool on the top floor. My wife and I really enjoyed our 6 day stay there. The bed is a little small for two people but we were able to make it work.

Eduardo was also very responsive and even answered any of our questions after we arrived. Thank you so much and we would definitely stay here again if we return to Santiago.

The apartment is really well located and you can walk to everywhere. Booking and check in was easy. I was however disappointed as it was not as clean as I would like - there was hair over bath/shower and bathroom bin had not been emptied. Since we paid a cleaning fee I expected better. Other then that it was great!
My second visit to the apartment was excellent. Very convenient. Also found some exceptional restaurants nearby. Very handy location. Building staff very helpful. Apartment perfect for a couple.
Very comfortable apartment. An amazing view, and a very complete kitchen! The host(s) were also very friendly and helpful.

We couldn't meet Jean but her mother greeted us in the apartment.she was really kind and when there was a problem of wifi, she tried to solve it directly too. The location of the apartment is 10 minutes away from the metro station and it is pretty close to the centro of city too. The apartment was very clean and comfortable too. Recomend !:)

Francisco has a lovely apartment perfectly located in Chile. I really enjoyed my stay there. Everything is there when you arrive including breakfast. The room is cleaned everyday spotlessly. Francisco was very accommodating and helpful

Patricia was an excellent host and even provided welcome drinks and nibbles on our arrival, which was very handy. The unit was very clean and was equipped with everything we needed throughout our 20 days.

Angelo is the perfect host and the room is great. Awesome view from the 21st floor and great access to the city. Angelo is also very nice, he showed me the City and even took me to meet his family in beautiful Valparaiso. I had a great Time, thank you.
Jean's apartment was perfect - clean, comfortable, and great value. It's on the edge of Barrio Brasil - about 9-10 blocks from a lot of great restaurants. Really close to the metro.
Fransico was an incredible host, he made sure we had breakfast for the first day. The apartment was clean and comfortable. He even lent us an adapted to charge our phones. 5 stars!
Amazing and clean flat with brilliant view. Nicely decorated and great facilities including an outdoor pool. Friendly host, no hassle at all.

The apartment is great! It has an amazing view and despite being small its very functional.
I really enjoyed my stay there and I definatly recommend it!!
Gonzalo is an amazing host, very accommodating, friendly and honest. The apartment is exactly as described, very comfortable in the perfect neighbourhood to explore Santiago city.

Very much enjoyed staying at this flat while visiting Santiago. The location is ideal for seeing the downtown sites and conveniently located for easy access to the metro. It is quite small, but adequate for 2 close visitors and suitable for a single traveler. Emelina and Miguel were very cooperative and helpful. I would stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in Santiago, and Eduardo's place makes everything really accessible. We were able to find our way through public transit from Valparaiso and around the city on rented bikes. There is also a Sunday market just down the street.
The apartment itself is well equipped - full kitchen, comfortable shower and great views. When we were there, the place and two decks got way too hot during the day, but very comfortable when the sun went down. The pool was a welcome break, but good to note that it is closed on Mondays. The bed was too small for the two of us. We couldn't both lay on our back, and the photo is accurate that it will only fit one normal-sized pillow.
Eduardo was very polite and prompt with responses before and during our visit.

Mabel and her assistants were great during our trip. Not only were they able to accommodate my group of 4, but they were very welcoming and informative as well. Mabel was even gracious enough to drive us to Pablo Neruda's house when she heard we were heading there on our last morning.

I highly recommend the home as it is in a great location, is quiet and has everything you need. Thanks again for the wonderful time!

The place is very clean and has all the amenities you could need. Patricia and her mother were very friendly and gracious hosts offering me all the help I could need while I was in Santiago. The location was perfect for exploring the city and they helped direct me to local stores and restaurants, transportation, and anything else I needed. I recommend it to anyone coming here, English speakers and anyone else!

We had a great experience staying in Roberto's place. The studio is spacios with a fully equipped kitchen, big comfortable bed and a small balcony, in a nice quiet neighborhood, but close to Irrarazaval, which is a big street with lots of shops and restaurants, well connected with the rest of the city by public transport. I would highly recommend this accommodation.
Sunsets were incredible from the balcony of this apartment! Spacious, well equipped and the perfect location for exploring Santiago.  Alejandro was a great host; highly recommend!
The apartment is very well located. Close to the subway and places to go at night. I highly recommend it!

While I had airplane troubles that prevented me from staying at Jean's, my friends had a good experience. Neither speak much Spanish, and Jean and his mom, Claudia, greeted Brittany with warmth. They provided clean towels and sheets and both a bottle of wine and water. The building concierge was also very helpful. Claudia even helped Brittany with some printing needs. The only piece of advice is to bring earplugs if you stay on a Saturday night!

Felipe was great and made sure that we easily made it into the apartment and felt welcome. He was at the apartment when I arrived to show me the place, including pool and laundry in the building, and took the time to give recommendations for sites to visit throughout the city. Very nice and helpful, was available all weekend via Whatsapp. Apartment was great and as advertised, terrific views of the city and rooftop to hang out on during warm nights
The all experience was very nice. Very well located, very clean, great view, and nice place for two persons.
Nice place, hard to find. Great view and comfortable bed. Don't really understand the point of a cleaning service fee when they require everything to be cleaned when you leave.
We had such a warm welcome from Pati, nothing was too much trouble for her. in no time she became our fiend in Santiago. We were not anticipating breakfast but we were treated every day.

Nestor has a nice apartment in a very pleasant neighborhood of Lasttaria. It's a short walk from all cafes, restaurants and bars. The apartment itself was pretty good and perfect for my short stay in Santiago. Nestor is a good host and helped me out with all my needs.

Everything about the apartment was fantastic. There were six of us who stayed there. Everything was clean and well furnished. The apartment is also not too far (about a 5 min walk) to the San Isabel metro station.

Cristobal was thorough in his replies to my numerous questions about activities, locations, etc., as I have never been to Chile before. His sister, Gisela was at the apartment to greet me, and she had just made sure the entire place was thoroughly cleaned and ready for me. When I needed a couple of things, (a fan as I tend to get warm even in cool places, and a bar of soap as I prefer that to liquid soap--I guess I am finicky)...she got them for me promptly. I was able to make myself totally at home from the minute I arrived.
The apartment was very nice. I had a little issue getting into the apartment because the doorman didn't recognize me. Other than that it was a very pleasant stay.

We stayed at Eduardo's place for 3 nights and really enjoyed the stay. The apartment had a great view, it was clean and in a good location. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. The bed was a bit small but we knew that ahead of time and it was no problem. Eduardo is very helpful in providing advice and information about your stay in Santiago!  Definitely would recommend this place!
I can just confirm the positive reviews, great host and a nice place to stay. Thanks so much!
Really nice place. Very clean and new! Great location. A bit noisy but very recommendable.

I really enjoyed my stay in Graziela's apt, it is very nice, comfortable,  clean,  we'll located,  in a nice neighborhood, and close to the supermarket,  mall,  and park.  It's a great choice. Graziela is also a great host.  Communication prior to arrival was good,  she was on time, received us warmly,  took care of explaining things,  and she pays attention to detail in the apt.

Mabel and her husband are amazing hosts! We got the chance to stay in 2 of their lofts. Situated 5 minutes (walking) from the Costanera Center mall, they are both very spacious, comfortable and made us feel at home.  Mabel and her husband drove us all to the airport early in the morning when our ride bailed on us. They were always attentive to our needs and ready to help. You won't find better hosts in Santiago!
Highly recommend this place.  Great central location and attentive host.  Eduardo let me check-in early since I arrived on an early flight - very accommodating.

Felipe's apartment was every bit as beautiful as the photos. It is spacious, clean and filled with light. It was nicely furnished with comfortable beds. We loved watching the sunset light up the Andes and visiting the park across the street. We stayed here with our 8 month old so it was nice to be somewhere comfortable and centrally located. Communication with Felipe prior to our arrival and through our stay was excellent.  We would gladly stay here again if we find ourselves back in Santiago.

Eduardos flat is very clean and comfortable. Although it is small, you have everything you need, located in a nice neighbourhood and close to the City Center.
Eduardo and his wife were always there to help us out and answered questions.
We really enjoyed our stay and recommend the Apartment.
Emelina and Miguel were very good at answering all our questions and providing clear instructions on how to get around. The room was clean and well equipped!

We had a great stay here. Fantastic location, walking distance to a supermarket, Plaza de armas, Bella Vista neighbourhood. Great wifi. Good kitchen facilities. Very helpful doormen. Like previous reviews not sure what the cleaning fee goes towards as the apartment wasn't as clean as you would expect when we arrived. There was a previous guests left over spaghetti in the fridge and dishes in the sink. So that was a little disappointing. Other than that everything was perfect.

Christián's apartment is very cozy and clean, with a nice little kitchen and a great bed. It is very well located, close to La Moneda subway, and to some important places to visit. There are two markets close to the apartment, and it's very easy to walk around.

This was a lovely apartment for our stay in Santiago. Perfect location near a metro station and the center of town, with an awesome view of the city. The apartment complex is nice and felt very safe, including a 24 hour doorman. Patricia and her mother were very kind and accommodating of our early arrival and late departure.

Easy check in at Jean's place as his mum lives in the same building. It's about a seven minute walk to the nearest metro and four stops from the Alameda bus terminal. The area is full of students so it's quite busy. We only stayed one night at Jean's, and it was fine, the apartment was quiet at night and the Internet was fast. A few staples such as tea and coffee would have improved the experience.

Great apt in a central location with easy access to all touristic point in Santiago.
Also near to subway!I had a quick stay and Nestor was very helpful to give me a lot good info about Santiago. Thx again for lending me a umbrella...was very nice from Nestor in a raining day in Santiago.

Angelo has a perfect location. Right next to metro station and very central to everything in Santiago. I walked most of the time, but the metro is easy to use. Angelo works a lot---but when he was around he invited me to partake in activities, as well as meeting some of his family. VERY NICE PEOPLE.......!

This apartment is great and looks just like the photos. It is well-decorated, quiet, convenient, and fairly clean. Communication with the host was always prompt and check-in/check-out was a breeze. Highly recommended for the price!

The apartment is exactly as shown in airbnb. The kitchen has everything, the wi-fi works perfectly and the location is great, very close to the subway. Cristián was very kind and attentive. The apartment was perfect for me.

Gonzalo was kind enough to meet us at the apartment when we arrived. He showed us around the building and gave us excellent recommendations for places to go and things to do. He was also great about reaching out prior to our arrival and answering several questions we had.

We stayed on Valentina's place for 2 days, left to Vina del Mar and then come back, (see the other review on their other apartment). Nelson, father of Valentina, was our host.

We asked him to keep some food we've bought and he left on the apartment for us, it was nice from him to do it. This place is very cozy and clean, just like the other.

Nelson helped us finding a Tour on the Valle Nevado, and also, when we left, he helped us to find a driver to take us to the airport.

It's was a very good experience in Chile, and, as I said, Nelson is our Friend now.

I can recommend to everyone

We had a very good experience with this apartment and with Arnaldo as a host.
Everything was clean and in order. The apartment was comfortable and fit our needs perfectly.

Fantastic stay in Santiago thanks to Gonzalo. The apartment was really nice, modern, and clean. It's in a nice building with 24/7 front desk security in a really safe neighborhood. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures - perhaps even a little nicer. Gonzalo was a really responsive and welcoming host. I walked in to a bottle of wine and glasses sitting out for me and then when Gonzalo arrived to meet me, he explained some cool places I should see (and even brought along a map to show me). Since he lives in the same building, he was able to do things other hosts can't. For instance, when I messaged him that the iron stopped working, he immediately came upstairs with a new one. Highly recommended!

Good location but poorly maintained. We were disappointed in the general condition and cleanliness of the apartment. Only 1 hotplate on the stove worked, the lounge was dirty and uncomfortable, the bathroom hand basin drain was blocked. Plus many other things. It had be a long time since it had a good clean and any repairs done.

This is by far the best host I have ever had on airbnb and I've traveled quite a lot! His attention to every detail, readiness to help his guests and reliable communication will make  your stay in this stunning view apartment one of your most memorable experiences. I highly highly recommend to anyone passing through Santiago! The location is also great and very central!

Nestor is really nice and helpful, his apartment is located in the very heart of the city surronded by nice restaurants, parks and the best ice cream place of Santiago. It's also located very close to my favorite area of the city; Bella Vista. A good place to stay for a very resonable price :)

Mr Francisco was a great host for us. He is very kind and helpful, and was always worried about our stay. The place is nice, well located, and was cleaned every day. The beds are comfortable, and the kitchen is well equipped.
The neighborhood is safe, charming and very walkable with anything you need within a half mile.
It was really a very nice stay!

Amazing experience! My first time to Chile was an outstanding one thanks to Ganzalo and his hospitality! I arrived to Chile 5 hours before the check in time and Ganzalo was happy to have me come early to drop off my bags. He recommended great bars/restaurants and was extremely friendly and helpful. The apartment itself is amazing and has a great view overlooking restaurants etc. not to mention the rooftop has an incredible view of Santiago. I loved this apartment and the area! It is by far the best apartment building in the area.
I would highly recommend Ganzalo and his apartments to anyone traveling to Chile! 5+ stars and I will definitely be coming back again!

Fantastic stay! Felipe was very inviting and exceedingly responsive! The apartment is in the heart of Santiago with the metro nearby. During our stay we felt very safe in the neighborhood. Also, the building for the apartment has controlled access. Felipe has a maid come twice a week, hence why the apartment is very clean and well-kept. From English to Spanish dictionaries, umbrellas, a library of maps and tourist guides, and the amazing views I really cannot think of anything Felipe does not have!!
Lovely host! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Great location, and I found Cristobel to be excellent at answering any concerns I had.

Nice, basic apartment, very well located for transportation and visiting some of Santiago's landmarks. Jean and his mother are communicative and accommodating to their guests' needs, which adds a lot to the good evaluation of the experience.

It was my first visit to Chile. Angelo, although on traveling himself, has been a perfect host, in the sense that he cared about my confort covering all the details of my travel, my visit, communicating all details, before and after my arrival to the airport...during and after my stay from Chile! Impressive!
The apartment is very similar to the photos and all the facilities were there to enjoy my stay in Santiago...including the umbrella as I have had a lot of rain.
Evelyn with her smile and welcoming attitude, was of great help too letting me feeling as if I were home.
Thank you so much to both of you! Pierre

The neighborhood was pedestrian friendly and very beautifully. Access to bikes and public transportation was just a few blocks away. Francisco was a great host and very accommodating. The apartment was great and was as described.
Eduardo's place is gorgeous! Very close to everything you want to see in Santiago, full of amenities and the view is just breathtaking!! Thank you so much once again, we enjoyed it!!

Francisco is a fabulous host! He is available to help with any needs or questions you may have...His place was perfect for us and in a great location! Walking distance to club provincia, grocery stores and shops. We will definitely stay there again if ever in chile again! Thank you Francisco!

This studio is super nice, clean, comfortable, and in a great location. You can walk to most of the important places within 30 min. But it's not super close to a bus or metro stop. There is the most incredible view of the Andes from the window. The bed is SO comfortable. And the location is in a quiet neighborhood, but if the upstairs neighbor decides to have a dance party at 3:00am or chop vegetables at 8:00am, you will hear it as loudly as if if was happening in your own apartment (we experienced both). This is the only downside. Bring earplugs. Otherwise, the apartment is perfect and Eduardo is a great host who responds quickly to any questions you may have.

Had a very nice stay here. Close to lots of Universities so lots of snacking options on the street. Close to the metro so easy to get downtown and not too far to walk. Jean's mom was very welcoming. Would stay here again.

Everything was absolutely Perfect: nice contact and the quite new appartment had everything you could have wished to have including a washing mashine. On our arrival Valentina gave us a warm welcome showed us the appartment and provided a lot of helpful information about Santiago, where to go best, etc, even a seperate mobil phone with pre-selected numbers to always have the option to get in Touch with Valentina in any case, was part of the appartment. Top Service, more than we could have expected, thanks alot Valentina !
I stayed with my friends just for one night in the apartment, and it fulfilled our needs for this night. Moreover we got a welcome gift.

Pati was always available, discreet and extremely kind, her and her family making this stay unforgettable and pleasant. The location is quite an oasis at the limits of vibrant Santiago. Perfect to relax on the sunny balcony with mountain view before and after my business meetings. Bus stop is just a few steps away and brings you into the center in 45 minutes. It was a great pleasure to be able to use a fully equipped kitchen and to socialize in one of the eveneing with the entire family. I imagine the pool will bring another pleasure in the warmer season - well and it is open all year anyway. Splash!
Great stay at Philip's place, as always! Best location in Santiago, great place to stay and to enjoy the city! Hope to come back again!

Jean was easily accessible for questions and concerns we had prior to our arrival. His instructions were clear and easy on how to get to his place. His mother greeted us when we arrived and made our transition easy. The apartment was clean. She showed us the map to know our location. The metro is walking distance which is a plus It is near the university; therefore, graffiti are everywhere and sometimes we smelled MJ as we walked pass through some students. On the other hand, you can still see people around the neighborhood in the evening, which makes the surrounding safe.
We visited during winter; therefore, the apartment was cold. Jean has a small heater that helped the temperature inside the apartment. No problem in accessing the internet and hot water is abundant.
As mentioned by Jean, you can hear students in the morning but it did not bother us. I would recommend this place.

Jeans' mom was so helpful and kind with us. I felt home at his apartment. Te neighborhood is awesome, with a lot of students and universities. The facilities were perfect for 3 people and everything was clean and neat. I didn't use metro or bus while there because I rented a car. Anyway, all the touristic areas are so close that it took less than 15 to go to any of them. I could cook at the apartment and wash/dry clothes. This was a hand, because I was traveling for days. I super recommend his apartment. The price is really cheap for what you get :-)
Jean was fun to talk to for the brief time that we could. Would definitely stay again for the location.

We really enjoyed our stay in Fransisco's apartment in Santiago, the apartments were modern and comfortable. We loved the natural daylight that streams in. Breakfast was supplied for the first night which was a welcoming plus not to have to run out and get breakfast. The neighborhood is close to transport and supermarkets within walking distance. We would definitely visit again.
Highly recommended. The apartment is beautiful, in a safe building with a doorman, and in an excellent location. Nelson was very helpful. We had a wonderful stay. Thank you!

Jean's apartment was very functional and worked well for our time in Santiago. It's quite a squeeze if you have four people staying there but for three it would be perfect. The surrounding area seemed safe and the apartment is located near a metro stop which is convenient. Jean's mother met us on our arrival and was very welcoming and provided us with all we needed.

Very nice person and very helpful through our stay in santiago.
Even helped us out on a lost baggage complaint on the phone :)
We were invited to meet his family in valparaiso and felt like home during the whole time.
Thanks angelo and thanks to your family
We would always go to your place when in santiago again!

Staying at Felipe's apartment was a pretty ideal Airbnb experience. Check-in and out was easy, and the space was great. The kitchen had everything one might need for a short stay, tv and Internet worked well, and the whole place felt new and was clean. We would stay there again in a heartbeat!

Patricia was very quick on replies and gave us good tips to come from the airport. The view and the location was a plus. But the apartement was not so well mainteined as in the pictures. The bathroom was dark and unclean and the entire place had a bad smell like someone was smoking in there.

We stayed 1 brief night at Jean's apartment. Jean was very helpful and responsive and his mum Claudia was there to greet us on arrival and was lovely. The apartment was nice, clean and with plenty of hot water, hairdryer was provided. All in all a great apartment. Only minor grumble was it was advertised on the listing that we would receive a bottle of wine, but we did not. Otherwise a great place to stay.
The location was perfectly located in the heart of downtown. It's super convenient with easy access to those famous sightseeing places. Ari is a great, friendly and helpful host.

I really enjoyed the time with Inés! She is a very lovely and open host and we spend a lot of nights, eating and drinking together, having good talks or just laughing together, even then my spanish was very bad. The room was very cosy, like the rest of the apartment. I always felt very comfortable and very welcome!

Angelo was extremely welcoming and prompt to provide any answer to questions I had. The location is excellent, an easy walk to great cafes and restaurants, and the room has all one needs for a good night rest and great view.
The place was great and a perfect place to stay in santiago for a month. The hostess was excellent and responsive to any of our problems

Neighbourhood was walking distance from the main square. Lots of markets nearby for food. Hosts responded quickly when we needed help and left lots of tour pamphlets which we used and were reliable. Enjoyed Netflix and the end of a day of touring!
Everything went great.. it's a really nice Apartment and I just can recommend it to everyone!

Francisco organised a cab to bring us from the Airport. He also provided breakfast for our first morning at the residence. The location is a very nice area of Santiago and is also very safe. Trains buses and cabs were in close proximity. Also restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies within walking distance. Francisco provided us with lots of information for sight seeing and was generally very helpful in making bookings for us.

Mabel and her family were a real pleasure to deal with. We booked last minute and Mabel upgraded us to accommodations at twice the cost for free due to a conflict with the property we selected.
The neighborhood was absolutely gorgeous and the loft was truly stunning when we arrived. Clean, well stocked, and full of charm. I would definitely book again when I'm in Santiago!
Perfect location and awesome facilities. Philip very responsitive with communcation and apartment is perfect. Highly recomennded

First of all we where able to arrive early and that made a big difference to us. Pati was gracious and very helpful all around. The room was really beautiful with all the amenities of a small boutique hotel. The location was also perfect for us given the several business meetings I had arranged in Las Condes. There are also some great restaurants walking distance, not to mention the breakfast that Pati left for us every morning, which of course we wished we had taken greater advantage of. A wonderful experience all around that comes highly recommended.

Cristobal's apartment is very cozy, clean and has everything you need for having a nice stay and enjoying Santiago. It has 1 Itaú bicycle station 10 meters away, a metro station 3 blocks away, 1 castaño coffee shop at the next block and many restaurants very close.
Thanks Cristobal! Definitely I would come back again or refer your place to my friends.

The place was great for a short stay! As appeared in pictures. Patricia's mother was very kind and waited for us as we had a very late flight. Patricia was also great in responding to all questions we had.

Felipe was the perfect host. well organised and great communication. There was a 24 hour conceirge, beautiful views, comfortable bed and bathrooms and great location central to all. I would highly recommend this Apartment

We stayed in this place for 4 nights, and are happy with every aspect. A clear 10 out of 10. Rodolfo was extremely friendly, the location of the appartment could not be better and the bathroom, living room and especially the kitchen are very well equipped. Wifi works great, nice flatscreen tv for watching movies... I really can not recommend this place enough.

Great place, with easy access to everywhere. Gonzalo was so helpful and was definitely able to offer some great tips and advice on how to spend our few days in Santiago. Check in and check out process was very easy. We would stay here again certainly.

The apartment was just what we needed for our last night in Santiago. Everything in the apartment worked perfectly, was in good condition and was quite comfortable. Jean was super helpful host, very flexible and accommodating with our arrival and departure schedule. Thank you for the pleasant stay!

Gonzalo is a very friendly host, helpful, always in touch, we had pleasant conversations, the flat is cool tidy and everything worked well. The pool with stunning views from the terrace on the 25th floor is a must and a plus. Neighbourhood is posh safe and perfectly located, very close to salvador station and baquedano, a 15 min walking to city center, there is a small food court next to the building. Complete amenities in the building. I would definitely stay there again.

This was my first Airbnb experience and it was wonderful! My family and I arrived to Chile with Francisco greeting us downstairs with keys and directions on where to park. He immediately made our experience in Santiago wonderful!
He had chips, local beverages, water, and even baby detergent for our three month old! He left us a local phone which was a lifesaver. We were able to find restaurants and destinations easily since we didn't have service with our phones. Francisco was also extremely approachable to call with questions or suggestions.
The condo was stunning- gorgeous panorama views of the city and the Andes not to mention its' modern design and interior decor.
It's location is wonderfully centralized to everything in the city and the airport. I will definitely stay here again with my family!
Rodolfo greeted us warmly, exactly when we'd planned to meet. The apartment was beautiful, bright & in a great location. We wish we could've stayed longer, and we would definitely stay there again!

Felipe makes you feel welcome as soon as you enter his home, is very generous with the small things that make a difference , like plenty of bottled water and coffee, The location is perfect for Santiago, close to transport and restaurants , very safe barrio indeed.
Everything worked perfectly, Patricio was waiting at arrival, apartment clean and in good condition. Centrally located. Pool closed as it is early spring right now and not a good time to swim

Eduardo's apartment was exactly like described - cosy, clean with a wonderful view from the balcony. Eduardo was helpful at all times. A perfect, well equipped apartment for two people visiting Santiago!

Convenient location to the subway and overall a fine stay. The kitchen is stocked with some eggs, bread and butter, which was nice of the host. But I was very disappointed on arrival to know that we were changed to another apartment downstairs, without any prior notice. I was told it's due to "water issues" in the apartment that we wanted to stay in, but when i asked to take a look at it, I was told by the doorman there's someone else staying there, which is quite strange. I got a message from the host only later that day that he is traveling and couldn't tell me about the arrangement earlier.
The apartment was amazing: Very clean, nice and very well located. The roof-top pool with the amazing view over the city is great. Patricia was very friendly and gave us great advice for the city.
This is a perfect place to stay. The host is welcoming, there was a good wine and comfortable bed waiting for us. Overall, the experience was excellent. Thanks!

Excellent location, has all the facilities you could need, as well as having excellent security! Very easy to organise and fast response time. Highly recommend Francisco,Patricias brother in law, who provided airport transfers. His english is excellent, very punctual and a really nice guy! Overall fantastic value for money!
The host (Ari) was very helpful with all my inquiries and very prompt on response. Beautiful apartment and a secure complex, close to everything you need eg. supermarket, restaurants and attractions.
The contact was brief but fine, I'm not much of a talker myself. The girlfriend could also help me with certain directions in the city.

Rodolfo and his wife are very friendly hosts. The Appartment is very clean, big enough and in a safe neighbourhood. A Highlight is the comfy bed and there is also a little kitchen with mikrowave and oven you can use. They thought about many details in this appartment and also put some books, dvds, a flat iron, an ubrella and stuff like that inside.
