It took us 15 minutes to many interesting places is the city, so if we come back to santiago we would love to stay here. Highly recommended!
Very well located, easy to visit the main sightseeings of Santiago, the places are close and can be reached by foot, just few places you will need Uber or subway. Nestor is always available to help.

We loved our stay here. The apartment is central and is about two blocks from the main subway line which makes it easy to get around Santiago and walking distance to the main plaza (10 to 15 minutes). It's a studio apartment and has everything you need. Netflix was an added bonus! Clean and tidy. Would highly recommend.
We found the place really easily and the communication from Patricia was flawless. The slightest issue was that the swimming pool was closed till the start of November

We loved our stay in Mercedes appartment. It is a cosy, modern, clean and well equipped place. Internet is fast, the bed very comfortable and the location within walking distance to many hotspots. Mercedes is a great host, providing her guests with a lot of information and always  reachable. Thanks a lot!
The host is warmly welcomed, very helpful, the location is just at the historicity and subway station, very easier to anywhere.
Amazing apartment, on the top floor, amazing views during sunset and night. there is also a rooftop pool, very nice and beautiful. The host is very nice and friendly, strongly recommended!

Mercedes was a fabulous host! Unfortunately we didn't get to meet her but she was very communicative, friendly and always available. the space itself is 5 stars! Clean, well equipped and very convenient. Everything you need for a comfortable stay and easy access to prime areas. the building is secured and newer. I would highly recommend staying here and will definitely be returning when in Santiago!

Really Nice place, quiet but 10 minutes from metro or 25 min walk to downtown center. Nice view and facilities, very good Communication with the Cristobal. And very Nice parking spot (underground 2,2 m)
We really enjoyed our stay in Valentina's lovely apartment. It was clean and in a good location. Valentina was a very helpful host. Thank you!

Another lovely stay at Jean's place! His mother, Claudia, was extremely warm and welcoming during our time at the apartment. They gave us a bottle of wine and a bottle of water to share both nights we stayed there.
Mercedes was a great host. The apartment was exactly as listed. It was clean and homey and very comfortable. In a great location. We would return if we were back in Santiago for sure.
Miguel is very careful with your guests, helping wih everything is needed. Good stay. Nearby supermaket, subways  and city center.

The apartment is very nice an modern. Lots of Amenities including the greeting from an amazing host and told us everything we need to know about the neighborhood. Good neighborhood around universities and schools. The plaza de Armas is only but a 15 minute walk and that area is very beautiful with history and museums to check out. Apartment was great and the host was amazing with immediate responses and recommendations.

Francisco's place was excellent -- it is located in one of the best areas of Santiago. Excellent bars, cafes and restaurants nearby. Beautiful parks. Totally safe. Close to everything via public transport. Francisco was super lovely and helpful.
Angelo's the perfect host. The flat is located near everything and has stunning views to the city. Great place to stay and explore Santiago and Chile!

Everything about the apartment was perfect, really central, as per the description, hassle free check in and out. Patricia was always on hand for questions/advice. On top of that the most amazing part was watching sunsets on the apartment block roof terrace!!! Highly recommend place to stay.

Camilo apartment was fantastic! It was very new, modern, had everything that we needed, on a nice quiet street but in a great location near shops, restaurants and bars. We walked everywhere around Santiago as this place is so central. Camilo was also a wonderful host and welcomed us and showed us through the apartment when we arrived.
Cool place, awesome location. Nestor let me do laundry and early check in. Super helpful. The place is nothing fancy and could use a good cleaning but for the money it's more than fair
Angelo was so friendly and helpful and my room had the best view.  All of Santiago was easily accessible.  Good shower, great wifi.  Highly recommended.
Great location! 4 blocks from a supermarket and a block from multiple restaurants and bars. A very clean apartment and easy to get to with public transportation from the airport.

Nicolas made everything easy for us.  The check in was very simple - we simply picked up the keys from the reception desk in the lobby.  Nicolas was very responsive whenever we needed to contact him.  The apartment is in nice condition and very clean.  The bed was very comfortable.  There is a lovely private balcony with a view of the Andes.   The neighborhood is beautiful and centrally located. The Metro station is just a couple of blocks away and it will take you anywhere in the city for a very inexpensive price.   There are a number of cafes and grocery stores in the immediate area.  To summarize, this is a very nice apartment in a beautiful neighborhood with a great host!

Angelo is a wonderful host. He reached out just the right amount. Offered ideas, directions, and walked us to the metro. The apartment is small, but probably on the norm for capital cities.
He was thoughtful, and at the top of all host for Airbnb. Truly a great host.
Loved the stay! Beautiful location and Claudia was very helpful. Thanks so much for sharing your space with us. Got our Chilean trip off to a great start!

Pati's home is beautiful, clean and tastefully decorated . She is the perfect hostess and showed us such kindness whilst we stayed with her. Her home is as the photos depict, central to everything we needed and breakfasts were great. The neighbourhood was clean and safe to walk in and Pati's advice on local spots great - she even  called the airport taxi for us and generally was so concerned with our welfare! Her home is beautiful and serene - we will definitely stay with her again if we are ever back in Chile. Wishing her and her boys everything of the best. Blessings Kim

Martin's apartment in Barrio La Starria was perfect for our group of 2 couples exploring Santiago. Martin was super-responsive and easy to work with. The apartment is as advertised in the photos with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a well stocked kitchen - even a bottle of Chilean vino waiting for us!
The location was central to everything and the apartment sits in a beautiful courtyard with a variety of restaurants right downstairs and an artist street market just around the corner. Highly recommended.

The room was exactly as described and in a nice part of town there's plenty to do within walking distance and it's just a short stroll to the metro station. Overall I enjoyed my stay here and would stay here again if I were to go back to Santiago.

This was the best Airbnb experience I've had in any country. The attention to detail and thoughtfulness of the hosts, Camilo and Fabi, went above and beyond. The apartment is absolutely beautiful with tasteful decor, an open airy feel, and well equipped.  The location is great  - close to Barrio Italia with adorable independently owned shops and restaurants.  I highly recommend this apartment. Thanks for a great stay!

Located in the heart of Providencia, this place is surprisingly quiet. The house has everything you need, and it is very minimal at the same time. Good fit for families, since you have 2 bedrooms and a full featured kitchen to prepare your meals.
Francisco is very attentive, and he will make sure that you have a pleasant stay.
House is cleaned every day.

Location! Location!Location!!
confortable, clean, Martin was great before and during our stay, lots of good restaurants, pubs and restaurants right outside the building...awesome all aroud it 120% recommended!!!!

Camilla place is not only beautiful, airy and spacious but only a few minutes walking distance to several main barrios in town. It is excellent for 4 people and has a charming local feel to it. I would highly recommend staying here if you want a place that's quiet and beautiful but close to the lively barrio italia and providencia.

Nice apartment in a good location with a great pool and view from the rooftop. Apartment is more like 2 apartments as there are separate entrances and also means 2 kitchenettes, bathrooms and balconies - perfect for 2 couples. Really enjoyed our stay.
This apartment was great, clean and had everything I needed for my stay in Santiago! Fernando was a great host and was very accommodating with check-in and answering any questions!

Great apartment! The place was clean and nicely decorated. The host even gave us a bottle of Chilean wine to welcome us, which we thoroughly enjoyed. The location was great too, a short walk from a Metro station. Would definitely recommend!
great lively place, close to the centre, big flat wih plenty of space, arnaldo was very helpful, we had good time there, amazing view and great swimming pool.
What a wonderful place in a wonderful part of town! Metro is steps away along with best neighborhoods to hang out.  Beautiful view from the balcony, nice common use terrace as well.  Recommend 100%

This was a great place! The location could not be more perfect. There are restaurants and things to see everywhere. The apartment itself was modern and clean. The host greeted us and was very helpful. He was very quick to respond to any questions. We felt very safe in the neighborhood. We were worried that it would be loud at night because there are so many restaurants and things around, but we had no issues with noise. I highly recommend this place!
Great location, best restaurants and bars around the corner and easy walk across the river! Very comfortable apartment with a great pool too!

Staying at Mercedes's apartment was great. It's in a nice and secure building and the apartment feels bigger than it is. The internet worked very well too. The kitchen is small but well equipped and there's a pool in the building as well. Though we never actually met Mercedes, her communication was clear and quick. We had a great time! Gracias por todo

We've really enjoyed the appartment, it made our visit to Santiago a comfortable one. Looking at the Santiago heat, the pool on the roof was nice! The neighborhood was very nice as well, close enough to the center but a lot calmer than the city center. The only thing that would be nice to have is air conditioning, although this is not common in Santiago I guess. All in all, this was one of the best places we visited during our travel. Great value, totally recommended!!

It's a perfect location to explore Santiago, especially when coming with kids. There are two big playgrounds close by in parque forestal and several restaurants plus metro all in walking distance. It's your spot if you like to be in the middle of everything and if you are not afraid of some noise in the evenings. Communication was awesome with Martin and he was available for any question anytime.

I can't say if Luis is a good or bad host because I've never met him. I took the keys at the desk of the residence and I returned them in the same way.
But I can say that it's quite easy comunicate with him; when I asked him something he replied to me in a few hours.
The location is good. The neighborhood is quite and safe and it's really simple to reach it by metro.
We found the apartment not really clean, especially about bed (bed sheet with black spot) and bathroom (shower curtain's seen better days).
The swimming pool on the top of the residence is really nice and, if the weather is good, it's possible to have a beautiful belvedere on Santiago.

Rodolfo's apartment was a cozy apartment tucked in a very trendy part of Santiago. Although the streets were under construction while we were there, all major attractions were walkable and the metro was super close by the apartment. We really enjoyed our stay!

We had a great stay in the apartment. It is located close to Barrio Bellavista where the main restaurants, bars etc. are located. In addition to being a really nice apartment, Gonzalo was also a very good host. He greeted us when we arrived and explained what to do in the city. He also booked transport for us to the airport as we were leaving very early on 1st January. I can fully recommend the apartment for anyone looking to stay in Santiago.

Mabel was a gracious host that made our stay in Santiago hassle free. She was very accommodating and made check in a breeze. The house itself is beautiful and the area is nice and quiet but still walking distance from some of the down town areas. Thanks for the great stay!

Great location - walking distance from everything and easy access to public transportion. Nice building with a doorman and laundry machines.
Apartment is on the smaller side, so good for a couple or a single person. Because the apartment is part of a large residential building, it can get nosy at night.
Highly recommend, when we locked our bag in the apartment, the host rushed to the apartment to let us in. Fantastic location and lovely apartment !
We passed a comfortable night in the flat, which is clean and in a nice neighbourhood. Jean's mum was welcoming and helpful.

Camilo and Fabi were gracious hosts who were  easy to communicate with. Their place is a ground floor apartment with a small rear courtyard that is totally private and perfect for having dinner outdoors. Bathroom is modern and amenities perfect. (Nice power  blow dryer ). The neighborhood is safe and there are very cute and inviting local restaurants within a block. This is a perfect place if you want lots of natural light and access to outdoor living. We loved it!
Gonzalo’s place is beautiful, clean, and super central! We were pleasantly surprised about the possibility to use the washer and dryer. Viewing the sunset from the rooftop was spectacular!

Very well located and modern apartment, we were quite comfortable in it eventhough it´s quite compact.  It has all the necessary amenities, including a clothes washer and drier!  Super close to a mall, supermarket, and restaurants.  We never met Graziela in person but she was quick to respond any of our queries.  We recommend this property.
the place is super central, nestor is very friendly and helpful, the room is small but nice, so i can recommand it to everybody...

We stayed for three nights and were very happy with the flat. Clean, comfortable and everything we needed, and in a really convenient location that enabled a visitor to easily walk around central Santiago on foot. There were some roadworks outside, but not before 9am, and genuinely we weren't bothered at all by this. Rodolpho was an excellent and generous host, and we would happily return.

If you want to stay in a beautiful neighbourhood that is only 8 minutes walk from the metro and only 1700 to 2300 pesos from Providencia commercial area this is for you.
There are local restarants and shops and cafes that are in short walking distance.
There is on the street parking.
Francisco is kind welcoming and very professional.
Thoughtfully he stocked the kitchen with all our needs for our first breakfast even though there is a nice cafe only 70 or so metres away.
We would definitely recommend staying here
Nestor is a welcoming and well organized host. His place is in a great location and is walkable to most sights in Santiago. Would stay with again

Great place to be, beautiful clean and comfortable for 2 and easy 3 people, not to much shopping near by, but just 4 to 5 blocks away you are in the center of Santiago. Yes yes relax, you have your Starbucks around corner. You have a swimming pool that it is a plus. Great clean building and the concierge are always available for any questions. Definitely 5 star for the price and for the promptness of Mercedes !!!
Marcello

This I a great apartment, right in the centre of Santiago, close to museums and sites, but also an area that feels lived in with local bars and restaurants.  Rodolfo and Claudia are wonderful hosts and have been very helpful to us.  They have thought of everything that a traveller might need when they arrive in Santiago.  We felt really at home.
Philip's apartment is perfect for my needs and i am a returning guest. I will continue to use Philip's apartment in the future. Philip is very helpful and attentive to my needs. Highly recommended.
Higly recommended. Central, close to restaurants and bars, which means noisy in the nights. Everything was nice in the apartment, except for the bed, that is something it could be improved.
Ruben's appart was very charming and very clean place. The appart is full equipe , we did't miss anything. The location is perfect downtown. We reAlly recommend this place. Ruben was a great host .

I visited Santiago for work, and spent almost three weeks in this beautiful, clean and nicely decorated apartment.
The beds are super comfortable, the kitchen is well equipped, the bathroom is new and spacious as it is the rest of the apartment. The hip Barrio Italia with nice restaurants and little shops is just around the corner and the center of Santiago is also reachable within a walking distance.
Camilo and Fabi are fabulous and caring host, they were always reachable and took care of everything in no time. I can just highly recommend to stay with them.

Rodolfo's apartment is great and Rodolfo is a great host. He and his wife Claudia met us at the apartment to show us around despite the fact that we arrived very late. They have really thought of everything and have stocked the apartment with items their guests might need (international adapters, travel guides, metro cards). The apartment itself is in a great location and was neat and well decorated. One of my best airbnb experiences.
Great clean apartment in Recoleta / Bellavista, very central and apartment was well decorated and had everything we needed! Francisco was a great host and very responsive!

This is a very nice flat for a couple. The Santiago Metro system is about 300 yards away, and it is easy to get around from the flat with a good little grocer/delicatessen on the corner. Parking is perhaps the only downside; a helpful 3 hour visitor's park is available inside the building. After that street parking is payable. If only visiting Santiago it is far better to use the Metro than car-hire,

Patricia was very prompt to reply to communications. The apartment was secure and near good restaurants with easy access to the metro. We loved the view from the apartment and the comfortable bed. Patricia provided a good fan which we appreciated as the weather was hot.
It was a great stay at Las Condes. Macela's apartment is greatly located very close to Metro station. Ximena was nice and helpful by all means. Highly recommended.
Nestor's place was great and so was he. Super helpful, he even took me to get empanadas.
Quiet neighborhood, safe and clean. A perfect place to live if you have a car. Francisco is very nice and helpful.

Patricia and her mother are kind enough to give us instructions and convinience. The apartment is located near president house and very convinient to everywhere.and you can have a great night overview of Santiago on the top floor.

Modern and beautiful apartment! The neighbourhood has awesome shops and Cafes.
We had a really nice stay!
The apartment was very comfortable with excellent view, santiago was having a heat wave while \i was there so the pool was nice. Good value and good location would stay again.

Positives: Great location, clean nice flat with amazing views close to great bars and restaurants. Check in fairly easy because there is a gatehouse where you pick up the key.
Negatives: host not that responsive - had to message a few times over multiple days to hear back about arranging an early check in and then pay for an extra half day.
Overall would recommend staying here though.
I had a fabulous stay at Camilos and Fabis place (see my comment below) and I highly recommend this place. Thanks again!

The apartment is very nice and well furnished.  I believe it was recently remodeled.  The kitchen  has everything you might need for cooking, the beds are very comfortable, with nice linens and towels.  Lots of hot water and WiFi was perfect.  It is very safe and secure as there is a doorman on duty 24 hours a day.  Its location is right in the middle of the action of Lastarria--perhaps the only downside is that it is in the middle of a complex of restaurants.  Things quieted down around midnight, so really wasn't a big deal.  We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.
Very easy communication with Patricia. She is very helpful and she answered all our questions promptly. The apartment had everything needed, was clean and it is located near the centre.

Camilo's place was beyond perfect. My only regret was not staying longer :) it was walkable and close to everywhere we wanted to visit, yet still removed enough to be quiet and relaxing. It was bright, modern and artsy. Comepletley remodeled and beautiful-- made me feel like I stepped into the studio of a famous artist.
Camilo speaks perfect English, leaves great instructions and recommendations, and is incredibly friendly and helpful.
Nestor is great and the place is charming. Awesome location, bright, sunny and warm! Can't say enough good things about the host, super flexible, easy going, and kind! Would definitely recommend.

Mercede's apartment is well appointed and clean. Everything works as it should and a wash and dry in the building is only 2.600 pesos. It is close to everything in Santiago, the metro and grocery store are less than a 5 minute walk. I recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Santiago.

We had a great stay in Ruben's place. He was kind enough to let us check in early as we were coming from a night bus trip. The place has a great location in the center so you can walk everywhere. It has a supermarket downstairs. The apartment is very clean and comfortable, the kitchen is well equipped. I highly recommend.

Extremely cosy and central apartment. Fully equipped. The neighborhood is very nice with supermarkets and restaurants at walking distance. A near public park is a plus if you're traveling with children. Francisco was extremely helpful during our stay. The breakfast for the first day was very kind.

The place is very well located and Nestor was flexible re check in / out time, which was good.
However, sad to say, the place had shared areas (shower) and kitchen and others which were not clean. So for the same cost, I have stayed elsewhere to a totally different standard...

Great place to stay when visit Santiago! A little far from downtown but a nice residential neighbour in a cosy apartment sorounded with amenities an near supermarkets, shopping center and subway to stay in about 15 min to downtown. We've spent a great time in there!!

Had a wonderful stay at Martin's apartment.  It's in a perfect  location with many great places to eat and drink just downstairs and many attractions within walking distance.  Everything was very clean with a comfortable bed and pillows.  Well done and thanks!!

Very cozy apartment, wonderful decoration with artistic paintings, we fall in love with them.
The apartament is exactly appear in the pictures, luminous and charming.
The neighborhood is close to different restaurants, and interesting places to visit like La Moneda, Art's museums, etc.
Camilo and Fabi are very friendly hosts. Thanks you guys! We enjoyed our time there.
Highly recommended for travelers.

Nestor's apartment was clean and easy to access from the metro. There is a small private room and private half-bathroom (shared shower). There was good wifi signal in the room. Nestor was very accommodating, friendly, and helpful!

I picked this place as I read it is a good area.  It definitely was just a short walk to a nice park and great restaurants, shops, lots of people out and about.  The area was very safe and well-lit, I was not worried about being on my own at night.  Rodolfo even had an adapter for me to use which was great!  Definitely recommend if you want to be near Belles Artes.

Martin's place
We spent 5 nights at Martin's place. It was wonderful. The apartment is spacious with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. It was clean, and very well located.
The kitchen is well stocked and everything is like new.
When you exit the building you feel like you are in a resort with restaurants at your fingertips.
There is a bus stop and subway minutes away and a decent grocery store five minutes walk.
There is a concierge at the entrance. This was very helpful as they arranged a large taxi for us. Sounds simple, but our Spanish is very weak.
Communication was great.
We highly recommend staying in the wonderful home.

The studio is nice and modern, and it's located in very lively neighborhood surrounded by a lot of restaurants, small beer houses and design shops. On the other hand, Karen and Carlos were great hosts.

Gabriela's garden and house were very charming! She was a very friendly host and helped our visit be very smooth and pleasant. Her house is very close to public transit and is easy to get to the touristy places, and the breakfast was delicious! She and her son are very sweet and welcoming hosts.
Very well located, nice and clean apartment, with everything you need for a short stay in Chile.
Jean's apartment was in a great location, and was very comfortable and clean. The concierge was also incredibly friendly and helpful! I recommend staying here.

Ruben, Fanny and David are great hosts, we had an amazing time at their place in Santiago! The apartment is cosy, very clean, comfortable and has all you need. Also in a perfect location to visit the city centre. Very easy access to metro or walk around to check the main touristic attractions. Ruben and David made themselves available if we need anything and were happy to help us anytime. Really appreciated that ! Ruben was kind enough to let my sisters and nieces to check in early as they arrived really early from a night flight.
We would absolutely recommend this apartment, and would stay there again. Thanks again !
Sin duda lo mejor !

Valentina's apartment is in a great central location, with views of Cerro Santa Lucia from the balcony. It is a short walk to Barrio Lastarria, which is a charming street with bars and restaurants and to the Santa Lucia Metro station. As is pointed out in the description, there isn't air conditioning in the apartment so it can be hot, but it wasn't hot enough to keep us from sleeping. Valentina was attentive throughout and check-in was smooth and easy, we highly recommend this centrally located apartment in Santiago.

Joaquin is quick to communicate and Lastarria is a fantastic neighbourhood for foodies. Great choices within steps (although pricey!). The place itself is very underwhelming and cleanliness is lacking. Surfaces in kitchen and bathroom were visibly dirty when we arrived for a 5 night stay. Strange odours in the entire apartment (maybe mould?). Small, old and worn. Lacking basics like soap - only one hand soap in the bathroom. Only two towels provided and we were told that we would have to do laundry if we needed more. Otherwise, check in and check out were smooth. The place is in a nice, secure area.

Great apartment, great location and great host.
For a first time in Chile, it was a great experience for me and my son to stay at Eduardo's place.
I would definitely recommend it.
A perfect place to stay to be on the center of great restaurants and nightlife. The apartment was spacious and clean. Would stay again, actually extended my stay after the first booking!
Beautiful house. The location was an added bonus. Only a 7 minute walk to a huge shopping mall and the best supermarket I have ever seen.

Small downtown apartment, close to city centre. Although we did not meet Christian in person he was a great communicator and helped us with directions the TransVIP connections.  He answered all my questions with information and very quickly.  We had a wonderful star in Santiago. Thank you christian.

This was our first Airbnb and we loved it. The apartment is beautiful, well decorated, clean and in a nice neighborhood. The beds were comfortable and the garden patio is a delight. Camilo and Fabi were wonderful hosts with prompt checkin and departure. They went above and beyond to assist us and made our stay a joy. We plan to have other family members stay here later this year. Book this great spot and you will be happy.

I booked this place for my dad and his wife on their trip to Santiago.  They had only wonderful things to say about both Camilo and the apartment.  Next time I visit Chile, which will be soon because Its awesome , I hope to stay at in the beautiful and well located home.

We didn´t meet Roberto but it was easy to get the keys otherwise. Location is good and the area is safe and nice. Supermarket and laundry service are close.  We stayed during February and March and it was really hot in the apartment.

My partner and I stayed here and had the best time. The location is fabulous, so many bars, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets on the same street. There was a roof top pool and laundry facilities that we made use of that were great. Dom checked us in, he was so helpful, even went for a beer so he could give us tips and recommendations about the city!! So polite and helpful. Would definitely stay again.

The place is in a great location with nice views. Comfortable night of sleep. However, laundry was listed as an amenity but was nowhere to be found; the wifi password was extremely difficult to find and illegible.
Adrian's apartment was perfect for us--clean, comfortable and located in the heart of the city. The balcony has a spectacular view. We will definitely recommend staying here to all of our friends!

This apartment has the most perfect location for anyone visiting Santiago. There's tons of great restaurants and bars right on the street below, and it's within walking distance of a lot of other must-visit destinations.
The apartment itself was cute and clean. The doormen were friendly and overall it was a painless stay.

Camilo provided a beautiful and comfortable space for us to stay during our trip. I especially loved the artwork in the apartment and was so happy to meet his father, the artist! We enjoyed our stay very much. I will be sure and contact Camilo again whenever we plan another visit to Santiago. I highly recommend this host and this apartment.

My stay at Rodolfo's apartment was perfect; I really can't think of a single thing that I'd change.
The apartment is a very well-decorated and charming home right in the desirable Bellas Artes district. I didn't know much about Santiago neighborhoods when booking my stay, but I'm so glad I stayed here. It was 2 blocks from the metro, one block away from a museum and park, and within a 5 minute walk of everything I needed during my 5 night stay.
This is the perfect spot for a solo traveler or a couple. Comfortable bed, excellent unlimited wifi, and a shower with good water pressure. Rodolfo responded within 5 minutes each time I messaged him.
What a great airbnb experience all around. If this apartment is available during your visit, book it! You won't regret it.
My mom and I had a great stay at Camilo's place, it's very new, clean, and bright and Camilo was very helpful and responsive to our questions. Thank you!

Francisco's apartment is just what it looks like in the photos. It's close to the center, Bellavista, across from the park and a couple of blocks from the metro. The apartment was perfect for the week and the view from the apartment was great! Check-in was very easy and Francisco was attentive the whole week. I highly recommend this apartment and would love to come back again!

Mariana & Dominic's place is absolutely lovely. It's got everything you need and it's in one of the nicest neighbourhoods in Santiago, right on the doorstep of a tonne of restaurants, bars and fun things to do.
Dom was also an absolute pleasure to deal with - quick to respond, willing to help with everything and flexible with my needs. Would 100% stay here again - thanks for all!
Nestor's place is in a good and safe location. It was clean and ready for me, and Nestor made sure I had what I needed and answered questions that I had.

Great apartment. Centrally located to central market, local restaurants and parks.
Very clean and organized!
Nice apartment! Gonzalo was very friendly and helpful during our stay in Santiago. We definitely come back the next we are in Santiago.

Gonzolaz apartment is very well kept and the bed is cozy. There's an alleyway of restaurants directly below the restaurant and is next to the metro. Gonzolaz was an excellent communicator and made checkin easy. I would definitely recommend his apartment.
The apartment is extremely clean, the pictures do not showcase the apartment accurately, it's more modern than the pictures show. I had a great stay here.
A friend and I stayed here after a long day of travel and found this room to be quiet (for Santiago) and easy to sleep in.

Very nice apartment. Full equipped, very clean and close from the metro. The neighbour is very safe and quiet. It is perfect for a couple or a single person. Sebastian is a very nice person, always available to help. I highly recommend this place.

A gorgeous little apartment right in the heart of Santiago, we could walk everywhere. Valentina was gracious and kind, answering all our questions and giving us fabulous tips. Ample space, condiments, hot water, comfortable bed, safe building and all round fantastic spot. Highly recommend!

We had a very good time in Camilo's place, we could have stayed there for many weeks! It is obvious that Camilo and his partner paid a lot of importance to details when setting up the apartment (even the quality of the towels, decoration, etc.). The apartment is nice and clean and has absolutely everything you need (and more!). Camilo even provided us with a cell phone and a public transport card for us to use during our stay, which we had never experienced with any other host. The apartment is located in a quiet and beautiful street, which makes it worth the short walk to restaurants, grocery store and metro station. There are buses that run very frequently right at the corner of the street. A fantastic place to stay while in Santiago!

Nicolas's apartment is beautifully located, near countless restaurants and bars, adjacent to a busy taxi stand, and only a minute's walk from a central subway stop. The rooms are cozy and clean, with a simply amazing view, and very little street noise. The 24 hour security is professional and the neighbours are quiet and friendly. The bed is comfortable and the wifi is fast. Whether for business or pleasure, I can recommend Nicolas's place without any hesitation.

We had an amazing stay here. Walking distance to places we wanted to go to. The host was great and got us an amazing tour to vina del mar and caijon del maipo. We had such a good time. His place waa clean and such a great view and right downtown
Just like the photos. The apartment is light and open and Eugenia is super friendly. Would definitely stay again. The bathroom is tiny but it suited our purposes perfectly so we cannot complain.

Awesome people with cozy little apartment. Everything perfect except the wifi signal was weak. But ok downstairs.
Thank you for everything and the warm welcome
The location is great, the host was very helpfull. The studio is very well equipped, i definitely recommend it.

Valentina was lovely to deal with and we enjoyed our stay in her apartment. The apartment is in a convenient location with everything in walking distance. The apartment was clean and had good wi-fi and Netflix setup on the television. Would highly recommend booking here.

Fantastic place to stay! Camilo is a great host. There is everything you could need here, and the location is perfect, close to Av. Italia for great food. Local stores just around the corner, supermarket a short walk away.
Very comfortable, you feel at home instantly.

We had a good stay at Emelina and Miguel's apartment. It was a studio apartment and was fully functional. The location was good and close to a number of the sights. Communication with them was excellent with clear instructions on collecting and dropping of the keys. They were also prompt in responding to any queries and even booked an early morning taxi to the airport for us when we had some difficulty with that.

This apartment was fantastic for a three week stay: very close to the Pedro de Valdivia metro stop, great layout, and nice modern finishes. The building also has its own gym which is a big plus. Luis was in frequent contact making sure everything was okay with my stay--appreciated that he was so accessible.
Great space in a great part of town.  Convenient to check out Santiago's hot spots.  The view is spectacular, especially the gorgeous sunrises.
The apartment was just like the photos...clean and comfortable. The host was very responsive on whattsap which was really nice. I would stay here again!

SUPERHOST!
You will be very welcome in this apartment in the heart of Santiago de Chile. Central area, close to almost everything this great city has to offer. Mercedes is simply amazing. 100% recommend .

One of the best Airbnb experiences since I joined back in 2012.
The studio is modern, stylish, comfortable and well located to explore the super hip local Barrio (Italia) and beyond.
Carlos and Karen extended a very warm welcome and even helped me fix my iPhone :)
100% recommend the studio and hope our travels bring us back to such a cool city in the future.

Eugenia's place is cozy, clean and in a great location.  I had a parking spot for my rental, she communicated very well and gave me useful advise where to eat and what to do.  This place is perfect for anyone that needs seclusion but a quick walk to Las Condes area.  Book with Eugenia!

The apartment is in an excellent location to explore Santiago; has plenty of restaurants nearby.
It is quiet after the restaurants close (around 10 pm).
We look forward to returning to Santiago and staying here again!

We had a "hotel experience" with this apartment. Everything was well taken care of. It is stylishly decorated and well-equipped. The presence of a full kitchen, laundry facilities, wide-screen TV etc. makes this a place where you can easily stay for weeks.
Camilo was very friendly and helped us by booking a fixed price taxi for us.
Recommended for families up to four people or for two couples travelling together (two sets of keys are provided).
Very clean and comfortable. Claudia (Jean's mom) was an excellent host and very accommodating.
Very good apartment and location !! The building is awesome and there's a lot of restaurants / public transportation around. I do recommend
Camilio's place was fantastic! Very beautiful, clean, located near interesting neighborhoods, and full of great art (by Camilio's dad!). Check-in was seamless. Would definitely stay there again.
Nice place to stay, not so far from the train station, Jean's mother lives in the same building and she's so nice and very helpful.

The location is great and easy to find. I took an uber from the airport.  Communication was fast, easy, and reliable through the app. The room is very clean and has a great view and is stocked with everything you may need.

This is a very comfortable and well equipped one bedroom apartment in the business district of Las Condes. Easy access to the Metro and bus routes and because it is situated in an up-market part of the city it is also pleasantly green and quiet. There are a number of excellent restaurants within easy walking distance (<15 mins), a large supermarket a few blocks away and a small convenience store just over the road. There is also a gym on the ground floor and for the hardy ones among us, a swimming pool in the garden. Parking is available on request in the basement if you need it. Overall, I would be happy to recommend Marcela's apartment.

We had an amazing stay with Marcelo! The apartment is perfect for exploring the city - In the heart of Bella vista but on a quiet street. The large balcony is perfect for relaxing in the afternoon and the bed is very comfy. It's all super safe with a gate on the building. The best thing about the stay was Marcelo! He gave us so many great tips of
What to visit and where to eat. He would message us and check we were ok and help with any queries.HIGHLY RECOMMEND STAYING HERE!!!

I actually did not stay at Lyli's home. She seemed helpful and willing to communicate at first. I was not able to find here place the first night (and that is NOT a lie). I then sent her a message requesting directions, and the message was returned to me as undeliverable. So I had no way to find her home, and I did not know my way around Santiago well. Lyli should provide more clear directions. And her review of me is an unjustified attack on my character. I have nothing against Lyli - I JUST COULD NOT FIND HER HOME, and could not get directions. What else was I supposed to do?

The place is amazing, near everything, good restaurants, near the metro and the subway!! The place is very very good, there are everything that need in the apartment, clean and best localization!! I recommend!!

I can't say enough good things about Anita's place. I arrived earlier than expected and Anita and her husband welcomed me with open arms. I had lunch with her and some of her family, breakfast in the morning, a super comfy bed and the best chilean hospitality. If you come to Santiago, stay at Anita's place you won't regret it! Gracias Anita!
The location for this apartment is amazing. It is in a great neighborhood and right behind the metro station!
Apartment well located in a safe area with facilities nearby. And most importantly: Eugenia is very helpful and always available to help. Highly recommend!

Patricio was on hand for anything we needed and was able to accommodate us at the late hours of the night 22.00 after our previous host had cancelled our reservation. Highly recommend this apartment, had everything we needed for our stay and Patricio was a great host.
Perfect place to visit the city. You have everything you need to enjoy the beautiful city of Santiago de Chile
Eduardo was a great host,  very reliable and hospitable. His apartment is very well located, clean and comfortable.  His apartment is very well located, clean and comfortable. Highly recommendable

This was a great apartment--good location, clean, comfy bed, and well situated in a cool neighbourhood near cafes, restaurants, grocery stores and everything you need. Nice artwork too. I really appreciated the little extras from Rodolfo--like the metro card and universal adapter for my dual-voltage electronics. I felt very at home here and very safe walking around at night here. Highly recommend.

We cannot recommend this place highly enough. It was a perfect space for a couple during our time in Santiago. It was very conveniently located, a block from cerro san Cristóbal, and a few blocks from patio Bellavista and many restaurants. It's a great area to be in at night, but the rooms are sound proofed so the music won't keep you up all night. Very safe area and easy to walk to many of the main attractions. Marcelo was very easy to communicate with and would respond almost immediately. And he gave us some great local recommendations! All around, a great place to stay!

Everything was great. Nice and clean flat, near to the center.
Top 👍
Had a wonderful stay. Everything was very clean and comfortable, and Camilo was extremely accommodating with our arrival and departure schedule. Would absolutely recommend this Airbnb!

Patricia's apartment is a great place to stay, and having kitchen facilities is a plus. It is very easy to get around the city without transport, so close to everything. The apartment is very clean and tidy, and the view over the city of a night is stunning.  I was in a foreign country alone, but felt very safe and happy here.

The apartment was well kept and suited our purposes perfectly. Francisco was a great host that made sure the apartment was ready for us early to fit our schedule. He provided good insights into what to do and how to do it. He connectrd us with a very reliable driver to allow us to appreciate tours outside Santiago and reliably get us to the airport.

Martin's place is exactly as depicted and is the perfect location for staying in Santiago. His apartment is in the midst of tons of great restaurants and bars on the same street and is right off one of the main thoroughfares in the area . We were walking distance or a short taxi ride from the other attractions and things to do in the city. Martin arranged reasonably priced airport transfers along with assistance on things to do in out around Santiago. Our communication was great prior to and during the trip as he was only a message away.

Perfect location for exploring downtown Santiago. The host was very helpful and quick with communication. A cosy little place perfect for a couple spending a few days exploring the city. The building is secure and has 24 hour security.
The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to cute restaurants and bars.  Martin was wonderful to work with and made our stay enjoyable.  Thank you!
Everything was perfect, easy contact with Roberto, the location is so quite, we were close to our scool, supermarket, shops and hairdresser too :) i definitly recommand it

We had a wonderful stay in Rodolfo's apartment. It was clean and tidy and had all we needed for our three night stay. We enjoyed how easy it was to just walk out the building and find a quick bite to eat. You do get some noise from the street at night but nothing too bad. We still felt rested. Rodolfo made sure we could contact him at anytime if we needed something. Great host. Great stay!

The places is a very good combination as it is close to airport as well as Central very easy to go around the city and a lot of animation around the place with the universities ! We liked it . the mother of Jean hosted us very nicely and the place is perfectly as described the only thing that you should know is that the internet only work downstairs in the hall !!

My wife and I decided to take our family (kids 6, 8, and 11) to Santiago and used Martin's place.  It was perfect for us.  Grocery store near by.  Many restaurants close by.  Very trendy little area with close subway access.  Multiple  playgrounds within walking distance (we found three).  I walked at night multiple times by myself and never felt unsafe.  Would absolutely stay here again.  Either with my family or with just my wife.  Martin was great.  We talked on Whatsapp a lot before and during our stay.  We took one of his trip/tours with him and he took care of getting a rental car and driving us.  Went to Valparaiso with him.  On his suggestion, we even stopped by one winery on the way and he played with the kids while my wife and I did a tasting.  Great guy.  Would absolutely recommend  this Airbnb.
Awesome Apartment in the heart of the funkiest neighbourhood in Santiago. Very clean, spacious and comfortable, it is ideal for a solo traveller or a couple.

This was the best Airbnb experience!
I had an amazing time. The location is great and Anita and Abraham are fantastic people! I will always remember my time here! Gracias para todos! Bacan!

Loved my stay in Marcelo's place. He was realy nice and helpful during our time in Santiago. The apartment was very clean, and the location was just perfect, in a realy cute street very close to pátio Bella vista. Would definetly recomend!

This is a great place to stay in near the civic area of Santiago. Lots of shops, restaurants and public transport are a 7 minute walk away as are the important monuments.
It's a very clean and neat studio room with a well equipped kitchen and all comforts. Emelina was also great in communicating with us and letting us know basic details.
We had a great time in this apartment and would definitely recommend .

I chose Eduardo's apartment for a rather lenghty business stay in Santiago and it really was above my expectations. The location is super-centric, literally across from the Costanera Center and very close to Tobalaba metro station. Eduardo is a real host, very careful and attentive. Will definetely come here again!

Very clean apt. Close to all the action and to the tourist attractions. Also close to the subway. This place was definitely a good choice. I would stay here again and I recommend this place for the solo traveler or couple.

Great place! The apartment is pretty amazing, comfortable, clean and have an excellent location. Possess everything that you need to feel at home and for sure make our time in Santiago better. The host is adorable, helpful and committed to his guests.

Anita place is very nice one block from bar and restaurants her place was clean she offers me lunch close by there is lot of club .  nightlife not far from providence and shopping mall a place you fill like home a great family when i m back to santiago i Will go to Anita place thanks you very muck
The apartment is in a wonderful area of Santiago! The apartment itself is really nice! Clean and well decorated. My family and I stayed there and we all highly recommend it!

We absolutely loved this place. Great design, very comfortable, lots of natural light and fresh air when you want it. Close to the restaurants in Barrio Italia (and we recommend Casaluz for a delicious dinner) and the kitchen has everything you need to cook at home. Camilo and Fabi were excellent hosts and checked in with us to make sure we had what we needed. Would absolutely recommend this apartment and would gladly stay there again.

Cecilia was very easy to communicate and work with. She has everything well planned from information on local shops, to transportation from the air port. She is a warm and inviting host and I would stay there again.

This little apartment is GORGEOUS! The bed is huge and so comfortable - the kitchen is fully equiped and the bathroom was impeccably clean.
The location is walking distance from everything you could need - great bars, restaurants, parks and fun street vibes.
Nicole was a gracious and generous host - spending time with me on arrival to ensure I was comfortable and knew how to get around the neighbourhood.
Highly recommended - especially for business travel.

Everything was great like we had being expected, and Camilo was very kind by waiting for us until late night. The apartment is well located, clean and equipped with many things for the best comfort of a family like us. Our trip to Santiago was very pleasant also because of our staying there!
I had a fantastic time at Anita's place. She and her husband are so friendly. The house is a few minutes walk from the city center and close to the San Cristobal mountain. Everything was perfect!

Location: ten minutes walk to the metro we used most: Baquedano. Along the way there were several useful shops and nice restaurants (small shops even just around the corner from the apartment!). Five minutes further from Baquedano and you're in Bellavista, a beautiful neighbourhood with awesome restaurants, shops, bars etc. We enjoyed the location very much! The streets around the apartment do feel a bit unsafe... But there are nearly always people there, even at night. Locked gates with guards made the apartment complex feel very safe.
Plates, pans, cutlery in the kitchen were not quite clean when we arrived, same with the floor... We had clean sheets for the beds, but dirty blankets. Otherwise the apartment was very nice! We had good communication with Gabriel.
Heater worked well too.

Valentina was waiting for us. The apartment is secure and has a 24 hour reception desk. Even though there was unusually cold weather with sub zero temperatures over night, the apartment was warm and cosy. We appreciated the electric plug adapters and the great view of the hills and mountains out of the Windows because it is on the 16th floor. Communication with Valentina was always prompt.
If you are there on the weekend, you will need to prepare your own breakfast because the local cafes are not open early in the day. This was not a problem on Monday.

This was a great place to stay for a short visit as it is near the metro and centre.  The host Gonzalos was able to give information to enable us to get around city.  I would stay again if I was in Santiago.
This was our second stay. We loved the place and will be back again. Shops near by and doorman/ women was always helpful.

The apartament is good for two, exactly like the photos. It´s near to parks, restaurants and have coffeeshops everywhere :)
I´s downtown, but it´s really good to stay. It´s a little bit noisy at night, but nothing to worry about. Rodolfo is a nice person.
And the wifi is good ^^

Philip has a wonderful apartment and is a very careful host. If you have any problems, Philip tries his best to make you feel comfortable. I had an amazing time in Santiago due to this apartment. I would definitely book this again, it's totally worth it!!!

The apartment is wonderful! Convenient, lovely, clean, and inviting. Camilo was so accommodating and flexible with arrival and departure, and very helpful as we navigated our trip! Very highly recommend!!!
Carlos is a great host. We will definitely help you to make the most of your stay in Santiago.
Clean apartment close  to shops and restaurant. Luis was contactable  and was able to provide recommendations  to resturants and info about city. !
Marcelo was very helpful throughout our stay, and the location is phenomenal! We walked to most attractions in Santiago from the apartment.

Cozy and well-kept apartment. Close to the ski center and easy to be located. Modern and with an incredible view. Very helpful owner. She was able to hire a payperview channel to attend to my son's request, so we could watch a soccer match of our Brazilian Team (Fluminense).

Roberto's apartment is a very good place to be stayibg while in Santiago. Buses are right outside and the metro is just a short walk away. There are also several supermarkets, restaurants and bars within walking distance. The building has a receptionist on work almost all the time, and the receptionist are always ready to help.

Francisco's place is located in Las Condes, a very upscale business/residential neighborhood and it is very safe. The apartment is very comfortable to accommodate 6 people, with all the amenities to offer, it truly feels like home!!! 24 hr front desk security. One block from the Metro/ bus station, plenty of coffee shops, banks, restaurants etc..., walking distance to a very nice Shopping Mall and a relaxing park.
Francisco is a wonderful host. He met us at the apartment upon check-in and left us a very special gift " A welcoming bottle of Chillian red wine". Who doesn't know Chile has great wines????:) The number of times we rent Airbnb, this is the first time a host offers us a cellular phone to use while staying at his place!!We could not have asked for a better host and place! Thank you so much for making our trip unforgettable.

We love the apartment which is very  light, clean, quiet, safe and convenient to grocery market and public transportation,  Camilo is a wonderful host.  She is responsive and helpful and attentive to basic needs such as a local phone, electric adapter, a public transportation card which have made our stay more convenient.  You will appreciate everything provided as we do. Wonderful experience!
Very comfortable space and great views/location. I didn't get to use the amenities and I still loved my stay so 2 thumbs up!
The appartment is great. The communication with Carla was fast and easy. The appartment is very confortable with everything we needed. It made our week in Santiago even more nice.

Brilliant hosts, very welcoming and hospitable, and they went above and beyond what they had to to make me feel welcome. Definitely leaving the country with two new friends! Would highly recommend the AirBnB, not just because of the central location (right next to la Universidad Catolica metro stop) and the lovely appartment, but also the great company. Thanks Evelyn and Angelo, I'll definitely be returning!!

Valentina was a very helpful host. She kept in good contact with us and recommended local supermarkets and restaurants.
Unfortunately this apartment was not available, but Valentina contacted us three weeks before the stay and arranged for us to stay very nearby in another of her new apartments. Everything there was great.
We would happily return to stay with Valentina

One of the best places I've been (warm, fancy, great design and super clean).
Phillip answered my questions really fast and was completely helpful.
Close to lots of restaurants and cafes. Walking distance to most things. Dominic was very helpful throughout the whole trip!

Nicole and Emilio were great hosts! Even tho our flight landed really late Emilio was kind enough to wait for us and help us get our luggage to the second floor.
Also, Nicole left us cereal and food so we could have breakfast the other day!
The apartment was really cute inside. The bed is great, the shower even better.
The subway is 5 minute walk away from Universidad Catolica station. Really easy to get around!
Definitely recommend it!
Thank you Nick and Emilio, we had a great time at your place!

I really really liked to stay with Ines. We passed a lot of time together and  I was really happy to have her as a room mate. She was always happy to help me with any problem or question I had. She is a really good mooded person, with whom you can definitely enjoy your time!

Places right next to the subway station and to the Castillo Hidalgo, it is right in the center of Santiago.
The appartement is on the top floor with giant bay windows offering a great view of Santiago.
Carlos was great, offered champagne and was following up at every step.
I would definitely go there again
Rodolfo was a great host and his apartment is fantastic. The location is ideal for having a walkable experience in Santiago. Rodolfo was very friendly and accommodating.
Great  stay at the apartment. The apartment was all we could have asked for. Location is good, close to nice restaurant area, metro, providencia, etc.  Highly recommend staying here.
Excellent host, excellent location, excellent apartment.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a central location for exploring the city, with clean and comfortable apartment.

Our stay at Phillips house was amazing. The photographs of his loft do not do it justice.
Philip goes above and beyond been a super host. Would love to stay here again

Great experience staying at Inés place. Caring and dedicated host, the apartment was clean, nicely equipped, and with a good connection to the metro, and everything you need in terms of groceries, shopping, etc. communication with the hosts was flawless, respectful, and kind. It is a nice  area where u can reach everthing what you need in walking distance. I certainly look forward to another stay at this special place. I felt comfortable and safe.
Nice place and location! The apartment is well equipped and decorated. We had no problems during the stay.
This apartment was very clean, quiet and had a great location. Fernando was very nice and the communication with him was amazing. I would recommend this place 100%.

The place is clean and bright, full of artworks and with modern amenities. We felt like home. Camilo is very thoughtful and quick in the answers. Pleasant neigborhood, easy acces to metro, taxis and walking to interest points.
Great place to stay in Santiago - Luis is very communicative and the view from the rooftop is amazing!

Apartment is in a great location and has a great view. The access to laundry facilities for a small cost was much appreciated. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom shower is hot. The kitchen is quite well equipped. Overall we had a good stay.

This is a good apartment to stay in Santiago.  It is pretty well located and you feel secure walking around the building.  The apartment itself is good,  we did find a few dead bugs lying around but it wasn't a big deal for us.  However, at the time of our stay, the bathroom sink was clogged,  we messaged Soledad and she appeared almost immediately so we really appreciated the effort!

It was a great vacation in Santiago. The place is very well located, near to metros or to walk everywhere if you like to. The apartment has everything needed to rest and recover to the next day of walk to enjoy the city.  We were surprised about Santiago and would like to come back next year. Thanks for being a great host!

This place is centrally located on the heart of everything, the apt is just like the pics, beautiful !! When you look at the window you have a nice view of the mountains, I would definitely recommend this place. 👍👍
Wonderfully nice lady. Very centrally located for skiing. Had some issues with the wifi and getting hot water, but other than that it was great!

What a lovely place! Cecilia was very helpful and had great communication. It was a little cosy for 4 of us (it looks bigger in the pictures) but had everything we needed and more! I would definitely recommend this place. Thank you! 😊

Great location for skiing at El Colorado - ski-in/ski-out. It is also about a 5 minute drive to La Parva and a 30 minute drive to Valle Nevado if you want to ski somewhere else. There were only two of us and there was more than enough room - we could have fit several more. The heat is a little tricky to figure out - make sure you ask how to turn it on when you get checked in. Margarita was flexible on our move-in and move-out time which was very helpful.

My wife and I had a great time in Santiago staying at Marcelo's apartment. Its location is great, only two block from the Patio Bella Vista and four blocks from the metro. It is quite easy to get wherever you wish in Santiago from there. The apartment had everything that we needed for a week, from a good and wide bed to a mini fridge and a microwaves oven. By the way, the only thing that was not that good was the cleanness of the microwaves. Finally, everything we needed was provided by Mr. Alamiro, the building's janitor. He is a nice and very friendly guy, who gave us many useful tips. We also had the pleasure of enjoying some of his marvellous artwork. I surely recommend Marcelo's place for everyone.

Great cozy place in Lastarria, just 1 block from all the restaurants.  Emilio was there to welcome us in person even though we arrived quite and also pre-arranged airport transport for us.  The apartment looks almost brand new, full kitchen, and has 2 heaters.  Good fast internet.  Overall, a great place in a great location with very attentive hosts whose personal touches really make a difference.  Highly recommended.

Fantastic place in a great location! Rodolfo was extremely kind and thorough in showing us where everything was in the apartment and even had maps and guide books available. Check in was very easy. The apartment was very comfortable, clean, and well-equipped. Thank you, Rodolfo!

Me and my hubby loved staying here. It's easy walking distance to all the sights you would want to see in Santiago. I like that Valentina had a lovely bottle of wine for us to enjoy once we got there:) which I loved! My hubby loved the little candies she had out of us to eat. In a short time we became close to the people in the cafe right next to the building. Also, the pizza restaurant a few streets down. I liked how easy it was to get in and out of the place. Another thing I liked was that Valentina had a blow dryer and a hair straightener  for us ladies to use.

The flat is perfect for visiting Santiago: clean, brand new, with terrace to chill and relax, one step from restourants, cafes and city centre but still quiet to sleep at night. Marcelo is very kind and fast responding. Strongly reccomended

The pictures were very accurate, excellent location and check-in was very smooth. What we didn't expect were the breadcrumbs on the counter, the toenail clippings on the floor and no toilet paper in either of the bathrooms. We spent the first couple of hours cleaning the place and washing the sheets and towels, the maid finally showed up two days later to clean. After that it went great.
The apartment was perfect. Good posicion and really nice. I felt like home. Carlos was very helpfull in everything i needed during my stay. I will stay again. Really recommended.
nice hostess with two daughters.  Lily is sweet and hospitable , but Five dogs can be too much for some potential guests.   When they are all in the sitting room, the smell is quite strong for me.

Patricia's apartment was wonderful. It is located a short walk from Plaza de Armas and the main shopping precinct, including the Fish Markets. Located on the 21st floor, the views from the balcony over the city to the snow-capped mountains was spectacular. It is well-equipped, modern, and very comfortable. A pay-for-use laundry is avaiable in the condominium complex. We thoroughly enjoyed our seven-night stay.
Everything was just perfect. Camilo is a great guest and the apto is very nice. All new.
Nice apartment and Celia was just a great host. Also We got nice service from the downstairs concierses.

Rodolfo's apartment is in perfect location. It is in a walking distance to Lastarria which is a hip area with plenty of nice bars and restaurants. There are also a few cafes right outside the building. Rodolfo is very accommodating. We had a friend who needs to stay with us for a night and Rodolfo just arranged everything for her right away.
Nice comfortable place to stay and rest your head. I was looking for somewhere I could catch up on sleep after a long flight and this place was perfect.

I stayed with Lucy for over a month and it has been one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. She is extremely welcoming and made my return to Chile a warm and smooth process. Her apartment is at one of the best locations in the heart of Providencia and it is well equipped for a pleasant stay. She can provide you excellent advice in terms of things to do in Santiago and even contemporary Chilean literature or international cinema. In addition, she is a massive anglophile, with a great sense of humour and has an excellent cosmopolitan sensibility. I fully recommend staying with Lucy.

The apartment is very cozy, the location is too close from El Colorado Ski Station at Vale Nevado. Margarita and her husband are very cool and available all the time in Whatsapp. Se had a wonderful time in this Place.

Pati's apartment is meticulously planned and very convenient to stay. I have not found any bad issues during my stay at her apartment.  Equipped With all the facilities needed it is suitable for a family as well as a business trip

Camilo is a great host and welcomed us very well. The apartment is excellent, comfortable and very well located. I spent great days in Santiago and certainly the accommodation contributed a lot to that. When I return to Santiago I plan to stay there again. I have already recommended it to other friends who are thinking of visiting Santiago. Thanks so much.
The flat is in an ideal place when you arrived from the airport with the city bus. And after for visiting it's a perfect spot. The flat is nice.

Fernando was a wonderful host. Clear communication and instructions, and he ensured we were good on our stay. The place is beautiful as well with stellar views, and is in a wonderful location. I would highly recommend.

The stay was great!  The hospitality was incredible. The room was very clean and bed was comfortable. My only complaint would be how cold the room was. They did give a portable heater but it was still a bit cold.

Marcelo's place is lovely, its perfect for any kind of stays (if your spending few days or even a month). The location is amazing, we did all tours for museums, historical buildings and also the Cerros just walking (especialy Cerro San Cristóbal). We do recommend his place and I'm sure that when we came back to Santiago, we will stay in his place again

Amazing location. Super clean and cozy apartment. Loved our stay here. Ximena was very accommodating to our needs. She was kind enough to deliver laundry powder for us (it was a public holiday and nothing was available). Overall very good.
Great location and very safe for single female travelers.  Close to restaurants and easily walking distance to other locations.
Marcela's apartment is extremely clean, chic, and in a great location very close to the metro. Marcela was a great host, quickly responded to questions. Check in and out was a breeze

Such a brilliant apartment, fantastically located, so central yet enough to be away. I know Apoquindo and the surrounding areas of Las Condes well and the apartment is perfect to be well located with the metro, shops, supermarket close by. A very safe and secure neighbourhood indeed.
The apartment has everything you need, warm, a great balcony to view the sunset, washing machine in the apartment not on the roof in a washing room.
Martin is such a great host. His communication and warmth, help I will be forever grateful for. I’ll be back again.
Abrazos fuerza
Scott
This was my second time staying at Francisco's--it's a fantastic apartment and area. Wonderful area with excellent cafes, restaurants and bars. Francisco makes u feel at home.

Casa Araucaria, one of the 3 homes from Mabel's place was simply the best air b&b I've ever stayed at.  The house is a four story building - main floor kitchen/living room area with full bath, and a bed room in each of the other floors, all with reasonably modern amenities including high speed internet and cable tv.  Our hosts were extremely friendly and even provided a free bottle of Chilean wine to help us start the relaxation. We stayed towards the end of winter, the heating system made the home nice and toasty including heated floors!!  Mabel's place is about a 1/2 mile walk from the mall with plenty of shopping, dining, and sightseeing options everywhere.  I highly recommend Mabel's place for work or pleasure!

The department is very nice, very clean and new
I will stay again in next trip
Rodolfo's apartment was comfortable and perfectly located in central Santiago. We had a great time.

This place is clean, centrally located and has a great balcony view of the Virgin on the hill. Easy self check in. It was ready for me before the check in time and Francisco was very flexible on checkout when my flight time was changed. Thank you!

Anita and her husband are incredibly kind and accommodating! They provided coffee and breakfast each morning and offered maps and information on the city. The apartment is also sweet -- it's close to all the action in Bellavista, but the place is pretty quiet and peaceful. The room is super cozy as well! (With extra blankets and a little heater for the winter). I would definitely stay here again!

DEFINITELY RECOMMENDED. Close to everything by walking distance. Clean, comfortable, stylist, very very very well equipped. Safe, modern, Brand new. Emilio is an amazing host. Give me all information needed in a very professional behavior. The area is amazing, plenty of restaurants and bars. Highly recommended.
We very much enjoyed our stay in this charming apartment.  The place is cozy, but it comfortably fits 3 people.  And Rodolfo was a fantastic host -- friendly, responsive, and accommodating.

Maria was a great host. She helped me so much with information about Santiago and how to go to places.
The apartment is just in the center of the city very close to some places you will visit if you're traveling for tourism. It is also close to a Subway station.
The small apartment is exactly what we needed.

Great small apartment perfect for a single person or couple. Beautiful views and nice balcony. Loved being able to cook for myself and everything was so comfortable and well thought out. Good wifi. Very good location close to the centre and also Bellavista. Would definitely stay again.
Camilo' apartment is lovely! Just as the images show - light, fresh and easy living.

Adrian's apartment is perfect for a family who wants to visit Santiago. Very good location, next to the metro  and bus line . Everything was very clean, and  the apartment  also have 2 bathrooms,  witch made it very comfortable.  We loved our stay and we strongly recommend.

I so much enjoyed my stay on Osvaldo's place, it's well located, fully equipped, clean and comfortable. The metro is 5-min walk, there are several clubs near it and some spots to visit as well (for example; San Cristobal hill and one of Neruda's houses) at 3 or 4 blocks away. The neighborhood can be crowded on weekend nights because of the clubs.
Osvaldo was very welcoming and helpful, we could count with him almost at any time. I left my USB drive on his place after checking out and he just waited for me to pick it up.

I totally recomend this place to stay in santiago de Chile. It is a beautiful apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in the city. You have a lot places to go very near, restaurants, historical places, a beautiful park, etc. The neighborhood have a very nice places to go at night too. The building is very secure and quiet and the view in the apartment is awesome. I will come back for sure!! No doubts about it!!!

Camilo and Fabi's apartment was the highlight of our trip to Chile. Amazing attention to detail in its decoration, clean and organized, and located on a quiet central neighborhood close to public transportation. Additionally, the hosts were extremely helpful when a natural disaster in our home city forced us to reschedule the trip. Extremely recommended.
We had a terrific stay in Gerardo's place! The apartment was as pictured, and the balcony was lovely. Gerardo accommodated us with a later check-out time. I'd recommend this place to a friend!

Phillips place is so well located, the reception staff are very friendly and helpful. The huge balcony and jacuzzi are amazing. The televisions in both the living arts and bedroom are great. I could go on and on!! You should really try it for yourselves if you are going through Santiago
This is a fabulous place - we loved our stay in this very stylish apartment. Our host was very attentive and offered everything we could hope for. Highly Recommend

Eduardo greeted me personally at the apartment and showed me around, demonstrating the features and appliances. The rooms are spacious, with a dining table and sitting area. The bed is comfortable. The view is striking from both the living room and bedroom terraces. The WiFi is especially fast and stable, allow for smooth hi-def streaming of media. The building is quiet and safe, with friendly professional staff manning the front desk at all hours. There are countless restaurants and cafes in the immediate neighborhood and a major subway station only a two minute walk.
This is really a fantastic apartment with a very friendly and knowledgeable host. I can recommend it highly for anyone visiting Santiago - business or pleasure.
Francisco is a fantastic host!! He gave our family who traveled a cell phone to use in Chile, recommended places to go and eat at, and helped arrange luggage transportation to and from the airport.

This apartment is a nice place off the beaten track of Santiago but still really close to a lot of things. Mercedes was extremely quick at responding when we needed a place to stay at the last minute. We really enjoyed our stay here and would recommend it.

Francisco is a super good host and makes you feel welcome and taken care of and whatever you need, he is there to help. The flat is a little old and weary in some parts and renewed in some others, but the location is excellent. Providecia is very beautiful and it is nice to walk around there.

Nice apartment located in Centro, very clean and the host was easy going . Only down side was the check in time which was set back on the day and the location provided wasn't actually where the apartment was .

Lovely apartment in an excellent location. It was clean the beds were amazing and the linen excellent quality.
I would recommend this apartment to anyone wanting and cosy stay in Santiago.

Marcelo’s place is in a great location and neighbourhood - very close to plenty of restaurants and bars and Cerro San Cristobal.
The apartment itself was perfect - very clean and easy to access and the check in was straightforward.
Would definitely recommend!

The studio is clean and welcoming, shower is really powerful! The kitchen is well equipped. The metro stop is only a 5 minute walk away but we walked most places anyway! The hosts are great at communication and answering any questions. Would 100% recommend.

Great communication, very quick response as I needed a place to stay that day. Everything Carlos organised worked out. Apartment has an amazing view of mountains and great facilitates I.e pool & gym. Recommend.

The host is very friendly, and will try her best to communicate with travellers who do not speak Spanish.
The private room has am attached patio. The room is spacious and has an excellent desk and has an international power strip (an adapter is still more reliable). The room and the patio have individual space heaters.
The patio is a dream: an awning, wood furniture, pillowed seats, lamps, cacti, vines, and ferns, and various decorations. It is an excellent area for relaxing with a glass of wine.
The internet sometimes stops or becomes very slow. But the modem/router is in the private room, so it is convenient to restart.
There is a spacious shower and reliable hot water. The public area is spacious and clean and livened with apt. The host has a friendly cat.

The appartment and Osvaldo are great. Osvaldo is really helpful and responsive. It's a good bed and a well equipped apartment. Also there is a good music installation, easy to hook up with your phone, really nice. The only downside was with the nightlife close by. This means music in the evenings/night and party people on the streets. Upside is that there are allot of bars and restaurants close by.
The cleanest AirBnb location I've had so far. Very near to pubs, restaurants, and tourist spots. Easy walk to the metro. Felt safe and comfortable at Marcelo's. Excellent stay!!
Great location - on the same street (but quieter end) of lots of pubs and restaurants. One street away from Club's, if that is your thing. About 10 minute walk to the subway.
A very beautiful place to stay in Santiago. Perfect location - everything, from shops to bars are near - and incredible view. Francisco was very helpful when needed! Definitely will stay again.

Lovely place, clean tidy and decent location.
Carla was easy to communicate with and friendly.
Nestor is a great host, friendly and helpful. The room is simple, but cosy and the location is perfect.

Valentina is a friendly young woman, that assists you with all the information you need. 
The modern appartement is located in the heart of Santiago, close to the main atractions. You can enjoy one of the best views of the city from the building terrace.
