The appartment is provided with all the things you need plus one 'tarjeta bip' that you can recharge to use the metro, and one cellphone that you can use to contact Valentina or her 'Papa', in case you need to. Very nice touch!

Instead of visiting another place in Centro Santiago, I stayed with Marisol another week. Her home is in a great location.
To the north is a park, a library (good internet), and the main road.
Further north is Barrio Bellavista and Cerro San Cristóbal!
To the east is a hsoptial.
To the west is a small park and a library (good internet).
To the south is Barrio Italia; cafes, bars, and restaraunts, many open very late.

Really good location to get around and close to a Starbucks if you’re desperate for your morning hit of caffeine. Also, make sure you visit siete negronis as this is close by and a great cocktail bar. Overall, really good stay and good location.

We had a wonderful time here. It is just as described. The location is perfect close to restaurants, shops, public transport, park and views! Graziela was very accommodating with our checkin and checkout and a wonderful host!

Great location, close to a lot of restaurants. Check in was easy, the doorman was very friendly and jean’s mother was really nice. We were able to use the laundry facilities as well which was a bonus!

A super clean and comfortable apartment right in the middle o a great area.
There were many small things that Nicole and Emilio did to make our stay super smooth - including the portable wifi, two sets of clearly labelled keys on arrival and a thorough house manual.
The thing I liked best about this place is that it strikes the right balance between being amongst the city bustle and nightlife but also having a quiet and clean haven to wash the day off when you get home. The apartment is on the second floor so you can still feel a part of the city, unlike a high rise experience which can be very anonymous.
Thanks again Nicole and Emilio!

I really enjoyed my stay at Valentina’s apartment. Her communication was excellent from the time of booking to checkout. She was very flexible when my check in time changed as well. The location of the apartment can’t be beat - it’s a block from the metro and supermarket and quite a few sites are within walking distance. The apartment looked exactly as the pictures, very clean, and a great view of Cerro San Cristobal and Castle Hidalgo. The WiFi was excellent and the kitchen was well equipped for cooking. I highly recommend her apartment!

Camilo’s place is cozy, convenient, well decorated (with his father’s artwork!!), and very clean. We loved staying here while exploring Santiago and highly recommend it.
Camilo is super friendly and was flexible in allowing us to check in late. He provided nice recommendations for us and had everything we needed for a nice stay!!

This is an excellent deal in Santiago. Unbeatable central location in the Lastarria neighborhood. While "cozy" in size, it has all the basics for a great price and the owners/managers are extremely accommodating and friendly.  Recommended.

Martin was very responsive to our inquiries during our stay. He helped with several things that we needed information on & even called us an early morning cab when we left Santiago. The queen bed was very comfortable & worthy noting. The neighborhood was ideal & we loved the walkability of both Lastarria & Bellavista. A great first impression of Chile! It was fun to have so much activity going on in the plaza below the apartment.

What a fun, cozy place to stay.  You could not find a better location in terms of proximity to excellent bars and restaurants, La Chascona, parks, and the city center.  Everything in the apartment was clean and comfortable, including towels and sheets.  Marcelo helped us with restaurant recommendations, and check-in/out were a breeze.  We would definitely stay here again if we return to Santiago, which we hope to do!
The apartment is small but perfectly comfortable and very clean. The location couldn’t be better. Dom picked us up from the airport, answered all our questions, and communication was very easy.
Excellent and gorgeous place in one of the best neighborhoods of Santiago. Loved this place and can't wait to go back!

This space is perfect and Camilo was an attentive host.  Super clean, comfy beds and furniture, and nice design/artwork throughout.  We really enjoyed the peaceful patio.  Close walk to Barrio Italia (lots of shops/restaurants).  I would totally stay here again!

Great location near the metro and within walking distance to many neighborhoods and places to sightsee.  Gonzalo was an agreeable host who was very prompt and responsive to our messages and questions.
A group of us stayed at Mabel's place and it couldn't have been better!  The house is beautiful and the location is convenient to everything.  We would definitely stay again!
Exactly what I needed! Perfect hospitality with clear communication. I also had a problem with a taxi but Lyli sorted everything out for me! :) Thank you so much!

Nice apartment in a fun, convenient location! There was a lot of street noise on Friday night until early Saturday morning that was somewhat alleviated by closing the windows and a white noise app. Marcelo was very responsive and helpful.

Carlos's apartment was centrally located, stylish, good amenities and breathtaking views of the city.
Carlos was attentive and very communicative.
We would definitely stay again.
Marcela, everything was quite fine. The flat is amazing and very well located. It's near the subway, Sky Costanera and the stay was perfect. I totally recommend her flat for anyone.
Great location in a nice building.  Diego was a great host.  Great communication and easy check-in.

Ximena’s place was terrific!  It’s located in a trendy and vibrant part of Santiago. There are numerous restaurants and bars very nearby. The Metro is close and you can walk to some of the historic sites as well. What makes Ximena’s apartment special are the extra touches. She provided extra sheets, extra towels as well as a fully functioning kitchen. There’s also an air cooler for the very hot afternoons. A toaster and a blender make the kitchen even more user friendly. The large  balcony provides a lovely view. I would highly recommend staying in Ximena’s apartment.

very easy communication before arrival, Nicole even arranged a pick-up from the airport, the apartment is really nice and newly renovated in a great neighborhood Lastarria, walking distance for sightseeing, supermarket and restaurants

This was the perfect base for our four nights in Santiago with our two kids. The location is wonderful- we could walk to everything and made good use of all the playgrounds nearby. The apartment is very well organized with everything we needed and a good internet connection. Highly recommend staying here. We would love to return!
Excellent host. Location was easy to find and very convenient for all my meetings in the University area. Near food places, stores and University areas.

We loved our stay at Camilo’s apartment. It is well located, stylish and has many little touches to make your stay more special. It was great to experience living in the neighborhood. The only thing to be aware of if you’re a light sleeper is that the walls are pretty thin and you’ll hear the folks above you come and go. It didn’t worry us but it may bother some. All in all a great stay and we hope to be back one day soon.

It is a great apartment in a very good location both for tourists and for work. The room is perfect for two people. Alex was really helpful in every stage of our trip, a very nice welcome and very good tips after we left.
Gonzalo was a great host. Everything was as expected. The place is great to walk around in Santiago.

The apartment is very clean and has amazing views of the city and the mountains. Centrally located nearby restaurants within walking distance or a short Uber ride. Carlos was a great host, very attentive and inviting and offered us good suggestions around the city.
Great central location made our trip a breeze. Clean, stylish and welcoming apartment, overall brilliant experience.
Gonzalo's English is good. The apartment is very clean and in a good location. I small bottle of Chilean red wine awaits you in the apartment. Overall great value and location.

I stayed at this apartment twice!! Host was fantastic, helpful and very quick responding to any questions we had. The apartment was very clean and had a homely feel. Lastly the apartment was in a great location and had great transport links.
Beautiful clean place to stay with amazing view of the tallest building in Latin America. Everything as advertised. Would recommend to anyone wanting to stay in Las Condes.

Wonderful stylish apartment. Well equipped with everything. Dining room table makes a great work space for a couple of people working together. The neighborhood is awesome. Lots of local restaurants in Barrio Italia. I can't wait to go back to Santiago and hope it will be available again.

Awesome! Exactly as advertised. The apartment is super clean, has a kettle, toaster, huuuuge TV, comfy bed, washing machine and anything else you may want when it comes to amenities. It's also incredibly close to everything including Lastarria, Bellavista, Recoleta, Cerro Cristobal and a stone throw away from 2 metro stations. Felipe and Oliver are also great, they sent us tips of things to visit and checked in to see if we were having a good time and needed anything! Highly recommended.

PROS
This apartment is really good location. It's really close from metro and almost museum. The bed is large and good. Host is quick response and kindness.
CONS
Space is little bit small then expect but it's ok for two people. The kitchenwares are dirty and induction working is not good.

We had a really nice stay and enjoyed being part of the community at the building with so many friendly neighbors! A great value and nice spot to take in the views of the city and mountains and to explore downtown Santiago!
Emelina is very responsive to your questions. Location is great as it is close to main attractions in Santiago. Great value for location!

Ximena and her husband Pablo are the two of the nicest and cutest hosts we’ve come across.  Their apartment is right in the middle of all the action in the bellavista neighborhood and the amenities  made our stay especially relaxing.  We can’t recommend their place enough.

The apartment is beautifully stylish and exceptionally well situated within easy walking distance of the Costsnera center and great restaurants yet quiet and peaceful.
Mabel is a great host and responds quickly and helpfully both before and during your stay, much appreciated.
Just be aware that none of the bedrooms has doors so sound travels easily between and as a result don't expect too much privacy.

Nicole was such a nice host and her apartment is just like the pictures, lovely!!!
The location is more than perfect: in the heart of Santiago. The apparent was really clean and organized. We strongly recommend this one. Also, the portable wifi device is a plus and very helpful, as well as all the information she provided us.

Great communication, great location for connecting flight. Lyli is so sweet and helpful with all the information you will need. Her family is also very friendly and welcoming. Comfy bed and nice neighborhood
Great location for us. Lifts are swift. Roof useful for hot weather. Fernando attentive although usually not around due to work. The small apartment suited our purposes.
The apartment was as advertised. The building is secure, very nice roof top pool, and decent gym. 10 to 15 min walk to Bellavista, the surrounding area felt safe. Gonzalo is a great host as well.
The apartment was exactly as described and Carlos was always very accessible throughout our stay! Had a wonderful time in Santiago and Carlos’ apartment was perfect during our time here. Thank you!
Stylish place in a happening neighborhood. Great roof deck and great communication from the host. Definitely recommended.
Great location, great views from the apt and Juan was always easy to reach and responsive. Will stay here again when in Stgo.
Good location next to restaurants and bars. Gerardo is very nice host. The apartment is cozy. However there is a construction side that you see from the window.
Osvaldo is a great host!  This spot is right in the middle of the action!

Everything about staying at Valentina's place was very easy and straightforward, which made our Santiago stay stress-free! She was easy to communicate with and made check in and check out easy. Her place is very close to many great parts of Santiago, the front desk staff are extremely kind, and the apartment was clean and comfortable with a beautiful little balcony. And, the apartment has AC, which is definitely appreciated!

Fantastic stay here. Rodolfo was a great host with wonderful and accurate recommendations for what to see in the city. The apartment is clean and central. It is indeed very loud with buses going by much of the night which is probably true in much of the city. Don't forget to pack earplugs! Otherwise all was as advertised and we would stay there again.

Alejandro’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Santiago! Just as described, and Alex was quick to respond to any questions we had about the apartment or Santiago itself. Location was great, only a short walk to Bellavista where the restaurants are, and a short stroll to the supermarkets. Thanks for a great stay!

Arnaldo did not respond to several messages prior to day of check-in. We arrived at the property and the doorman called Arnaldo and Arnaldo told him that he didn't have an apartment for us! Absolutely unacceptable to not notify us of this prior and to be unresponsive the whole time. Would not book with Arnaldo.

We had a nice stay at Gerardo's apartment. His place is very centrally located, a quick walk to Cerro San Cristobal, Patio Bellavista, Barrio Lastarria and the Baquedano metro station (L1 & L5 train lines.) One note for light sleepers: his flat is located near Pio Nono which is a big party street. (We are from NYC and are used to city sounds so we had no trouble getting to sleep at night.) You'll likely be sleepy from exploring Santiago all day anyway!

Ximena was an amazing host!! Check in was easy and she even worked it out special arrangements for our complicated schedule. She answered every question and fulfilled every need. Her house is right in Bella Vista and a 5 minute walk from Cerro San Cristobal. Also, a good walk from the centro!
Great location for bars / restaurants. Can be noisy at night as a result. Apartment was not cleaned properly before our use.

The apartment is okay. Spaces are a bit small. Main inconveniences:
1. The kitchen was too small and the appliances not very good (i.e. the stove top wouldn't heat very fast as it was an old electric model, broker dawer, old microwave that would not heat evenly, etc.)
2. The swimming pool was not clean. It seems that it was not regularly maintained as many of the edges were covered with dried mud as well as dirt in the water.
3. Balcony shades: one section was broken (and the host tried to blame us)
4. Sliding doors between rooms and balcony. The one in the kids room couldn't lock, so we felt unsafe for our 2 years-old twins.

Valentina’s place was perfect! It was a great location walkable to Santa Lucia station and lots of cute neighborhoods and areas. Valentina was super responsive to all my questions and flexible. Had a great experience. Highly recommend! Thank you!
Cristiàn is a very helpful and accommodating host and his place is very nice, cozy and close to the centre.

Rodolfo is amazing! He helped us a lot during our stay and made our Santiago trip perfect!
The apartment location is perfect: walkable distance to many famous sites and restaurants/supermarket, bus station at downstairs, and easy to take a taxi; the neighbourhood is safe.
The apartment is very clean and warm with several paintings and flowers. The equipment is enough, and it had international charger!! We love it!
Rodolfo is very considerate and helpful. I’d stay at Rodolfo’s if I am visiting Santiago again!
Had a lovely stay at Jean's apartment. It was clean and he responded very quickly to any messages. Check-in was super easy through Claudia, who was friendly, attentive and very helpful!

Valentina's place was perfect for our stay in Santiago. We felt extremely safe and had access to all-things downtown. Valentina communicated thoroughly and we never felt unsure of any logistics. We highly recommend Valentina's place, as it was very clean and accommodating.

I’ve stayed in a few Air BnB properties and this is the best appointed I’ve stayed in
Graziela is a wonderful host and has added many nice personal touches to make this a lovely place to stay
She also speaks excellent English which made things easier for us and was quick in communications
Will definitely stay here again if in Santiago

Mabel's house is superbly styled and extremely well located. The house is on a beautiful street, 12-min walking distance from the main teleferico that goes up San Cristobal and all the nice cafes from La Providencia. When we arrived, there was fresh food in the fridge for our breakfast (bread, eggs, cheese, ham) and a bottle of red wine. The beddings are 5-star hotel quality. Everything was super easy. Probably one of the best airbnb experiences I've had.

Francisco’s place is located in a beautiful, safe and green area of Santiago. We were warmly welcomed and Francisco was an amazing host, thinking of little details as well! Will definitely be back if I get the chance to visit santiago again! Thank you Francisco for your kind help and hospitality!

We had A great stay here. There is 4 different great coffee place just downstairs of the building, all very good! Very well situated to discover the city
Nice touch of decoration
And a very nice welcome !

Up on the 25th floor the views over the city, flanked with mountains all around, are incredible. The flat has everything you need for a short city stay, a good landing point for your arrival in the city. The area isn’t the safest at night but during the day is easy to get into the centre or walk to some of the other main areas - Bellavista, Larrista etc. Uber worked well to take us to the bus station late at night.
Really powerful shower!

Many night clubs nearby and the noise from them is minimal.  Excellent location if you like night life.  Great location to see many neighborhoods/attractions.   Completely secure building—very safe.  Very chic post-industrial design.

Great place to stay for a couple of days!
It was pleasant to have our own appartment for a nice price.
Be aware just of the noise in the neighbourhood in the weekends and also the wifi is not functionning.
Thanks Marcelo for your hospitality,
Irina $ Vincent

We stayed at Carlos’s apartment for just over three weeks. It’s a fantastic apartment, located centrally with wonderful touches from Carlos.  Yet it’s still great value. We’d thoroughly recommend it, and would like to stay again!

The house is great, very spacious and bright. When you're in the house or in the patio you tend to forget you're in the middle of the city. Very relaxing to come home to after a busy day of sightseeing. You can see the owners of the house have thought about all the details, we especially loved all the art! Although the house is close to the metrostation Salvador and Parque Bustamante it might be easier (and cheaper) to take an Uber.

Alejandro’s place is in an excellent location within walking distance to all major tourist locations.  The building is very secure and well maintained,  although in a city that doesn’t sleep there are night noises even on the 25th floor.  The departmento has plenty of room for 4 adults.  The kitchen is very well equipped and the bathrooms very clean.  We found our host very responsive and accommodating . Highly recommended.

This is a very very stylish place in a very stylish suburb. Safe, Quiet, clean, comfortable, 24 hour porter/security.
Comfortable bed, fluffy towels.
Brand new space , they just opened to the public and the very small mishap of misplaced communication was not a concern. Everything was at the door waiting for us. They forgot to tell us there was a 24 hour porter! I strongly recommend this amazing space. Check the pool upstairs. A view to die for!
Great place to stay when in Santiago. Apartment is in a high floor and it is quiet.  I hope to book again this apartment.
This apartment is very nice and communication with Cristobal was easy and great. If you go to Chile in summer, the swimming pool is amazing... Great and clean apartment...

Place is exceptionally clean, tastefully decorated, has convenient amenities, and is close to bars/nightlife/restaurants/parks. Just across the street from a night club that thumps bass into the wee hours of the morning. If you’re looking for nightlife, this is your spot.

I knew that there will be dogs in the house but the way they reacted was a little bit too much for a person not used with dogs in the house. Lily was very nice and helped me with the transfer to the airport.
Osvaldo is hospitable, and his place is stylish and amazing. It can be a little loud on the weekend, but if you're heavy sleepers like us it won't be a problem.
We loved our stay at Camilos place. It is a beautiful apartment, super clean and quiet. It is beautifully decorated and has personality. Camilo is very helpful. Reccommended.
This is very good place, nearly mall, and house clean. And Carla is a very nice person for help us, and alway response quickly.
We loved our stay at Camilos place. It is a beautiful apartment, super clean and quiet. It is beautifully decorated and has personality. Camilo is very helpful. Reccommended.

Marcelo’s place is wonderfully located in the Bella Vista hood. Our stay was for two nights and it fit our needs. The place could have used a little extra attention but I imagine that wasn’t the case because the previous renters just left. This is more of a mini hotel than a typical airbnb.

Marcelo himself is a very engaging personality,  and gave wonderful suggestions for restaurants with in a 2 block area.  He has created a beautiful space with nice amenities and great Wi-Fi, and has made the check in process very easy.  The apartment is right in the middle of many Santiago landmarks, such as Pablo Neruda's house and the funicular, and has a beautiful rooftop view of the city and the Andes. I highly recommend.

Loved the location and the sunset view from the balcony
Cristobal is an excellent host !

This trip to Santiago has been one of the greatest ones I have done so far. A big reason was Francisco´s apt. Beautiful and comfortable space with access to a little balcony that´s surrounded by trees.
Even during the hottest summer days, the amount of green around the neighbourhood provides a fresh and pleasant breeze.
A block away, all across Pocuro street, you will find a running path park, ideal for jogging at any time. Don´t forget the two little food stores at the corner. One is full of organic and traditional homemade Chilean style and the other one a cool coffee shop. ( I recommend empanadas and mote con huesillos).
Beautiful home in the perfect spot to explore Santiago. Everything was clean and Mabel was more than happy to accommodate around our flight schedule. Perfect!
The flat is really well located in a nice building and very convenient. The perfect place to discover Santiago. The only downside being that it is a little noisy. But nothing too serious.

we loved Valentina’s place! centrally located, excellent value. near both the metro and a huge supermarket, we had no problem navigating and making ourselves at home. we had a beautiful view of the city from our apartment balcony and also from the roof. our stay in santiago was amazing and it helped to have a wonderful apartment such as this to add to our experience. also: don’t miss checking out the roof, it was incredible!

Very nice place, great location in a nice neighborhood. Can indeed be a bit noisy at night but that is because it is very lively. Apartment was also nice. Good communication and also generally always someone available to help you with any problems. Only thing which was lacking were some good pans for if you want to cook yourself. But next to that everything was good.

Cimilo's place was one of the nicest Airbnb places we have stayed in.  Very nice layout, spacious, quiet, patio is great and close to everything.  We arrived early and left out bags and picked up the keys, very easy.  We really didn't have much communication because there weren't any problems.  I would highly recommend the apt.

The place is very good, and I have some comments:
1. Comfortable
2. Clean
3 new and well furnished
4 Ruben is very kind
Very good experience I really had a great time

From the moment you arrive to the apartment you will be welcomed by Osvaldo, who provides fantastic local knowledge and travel tips. The loft itself is immaculate and very comfortable. It is located in the hub of the nightclub district, thus a great stay for night owls.
Cristobal’s apartment is very well decorated and the view from the balcony is beautiful. It’s very well located too with restaurants and bars close by and easy to walk to from public transportation

Sebastian's place is awesome. Well located, close to a metro station, with nice views to the Andes and the sunset. The neighborhood is safe and quiet, and has nearby places to buy snacks, coffee or sandwich (Apparently closed on Sundays). The apartment is cozy, good for a couple or a single person. I strongly recommend this place even if you are staying just a few days in Santiago like I did. Sebastian is very responsive to any doubt you have.

The apartment is centrally located in the liveliest part of Latarria and offers convenient access to public transportation. Martin is a super responsive, helpful, and enterprising young man. Highly recommend

Fantastic apartment. Only a short walk from Manuel Montt subway station. Plenty of cafes, and a beautiful park with outdoor sculptures nearby.
The unit has everything you could need for comfortable living and self catering. The balcony is lovely. Mirza has thought of everything and is lovely, communicative and generous with her time. Thanks again. Terrific value in Santiago!

The studio apartment was just like the photos. Ñuñoa is a great neighborhood, and how the apartment building is set back from the busy street, it is very quiet. Public transportation by bus connecting to every part of Santiago is on the corner, and the new metro stop is about a 5-10 minute walk away. Grocery stores, laundry, and small restaurants are around the corner. Communication with Roberto was great, and he resolved an issue with the electricity the same day.
Gonzalo was amazing host. The apartment is great, perfect location, clean. Full recommend!

One of the best airbnb experiences I've ever had. The place is brilliant, great location but most importantly for us, Carlos was a superb host and worked around our awkward travel times without any bother. Thank you!

Super nice a Cozy room and you can get a nice private balcony also.
Marisol offered all helpful information about nice place to visit in Santiago, and near with Santiago also. She tried to communicate with me even I cannot speak Spanish fluently. Thank you so much :)

This is an excellent flat , well equipped and spotlessly clean in a quiet residential road about 800 metres from the metro (all rooms true to the photos). It was a great base to use whilst we explored parts of north and south Chile and we would highly recommend it for short or long stays!!

I loved this stay because Marisol is such a great host and a lovely person. She was there to help with anything I needed and we had great conversations during breakfast! She even offered me her futon when I missed my bus. The room opens to the patio outside, which is lovely, but you can also close the door. I loved that every morning the neighbor's cat jumps into the patio looking for food! Her apartment is very artsy and cute and in a quiet street in Providencia but close to the metro and busier parts of the city.

The apartment was nice. Not very English friendly and was hard to communicate. But we were in a non English speaking country, so perhaps we should have learned a little more Spanish.
Close walking distance to some of the good spots through Santiago.
Happy with price.
Apartment is at the good location, nice neighborhood, containing all you might need for a short stay. Communication went really smoothly. Great value for price. Recommend:)

The apartment is located perfectly for exploring the city. We loved taking a walk through the park every morning and there are plenty of amenities close by. The bed is huge which was great and we spent lots of time by the swimming pool. Communication with hosts was very quick and easy, including check in and check out. Our only complaint is we found the wifi a bit slow and unreliable. Overall a fantastic stay, would definitely recommend.

Javiera is definitely a great host. Whenever we needed help, she made sure to do the best and respond really quickly.  ----------------------------                            Outstanding airbnb experience! Apartment is located perfectly! Restaurants and bars are really close and at the same time building of apartment is located on quieter street so if you are looking for calm evening it will fit as well.

We arrived to stay for our final 2 nights out of 7 and our experience of the appartment was as good as ever (please see our previous reviews ). This really is an excellent appartment for either short or long stays and we recommend it very highly!!

Location is awesome. Apartment nice and clean and in a guarded complex building. Awesome views. Had a problem when checking in but was resolved a couple hours later. Except for Check in, really enjoyed our stay there.

Awesome cozy place, modern and clean. It’s well located, close to Alcântara Subway station. There’s a concierge 24hrs if needed who is as friendly and helpful as the host Marcela. Excellent choice around Santiago, highly recommend!!
Camillo´s place is very special, in the very special city of Santiago. I would surely like to go back there again. Thank you!

Awesome place! Definitely recommend it. Nestor and his partner are great hosts, very attentive and communicative and just simply very nice people. The location of the apartment is by far it´s biggest asset. I recommend it to young folks, artists, lgbtq folks and any others looking for a quiet yet stylish/bohemian part of town to hang at. Will definitely return!
Everything was perfectly fine. The location is amazing, right amidst all the exciting bars and near the park. Nestor is a lovely and friendly host who was very helpful when I asked for it.

We enjoyed our stay here for a night! Having a room without AC during the Santiago Summer is quite the...experience haha but the property was very cool, everyone was nice, and the home had really cool vibes with a lot of things to do in the common spaces
I had a great time staying at Fernandos, it was everything I wanted, he hosted perfect and the view is incredible!

This place is very central and close to most places. The metro is close by but we did not use it, instead we used the taxi which is convenient and affordable. Make sure you join the "Free Tour" for Santiago and almost any city you visit if it is available.

Nestor is a great host and he gives very helpful insights of the city. The apartment's location is perfect, everything is within walking distance and the neighbourhood is quite trendy and safe. Thank you for the lovely stay!
Nice and clean apartment, well equipped, great and safe location, close to the bus connection with the apartment, walkable to all the monuments. Communication went smoothly, all the recommendations.

Francisco was a great host with loads of tips of where to go in the local neighbourhood as well as in the city. The flat is extremely cosy and super well located in the calm district of la Providencia. We particularly enjoyed having breakfast to the sound of singing birds and the morning light coming through the trees surrounding the house. A true haven in bustling Santiago!

The department is very nice and clean. The location is great, 10 blocks away from Costanera Center. The garage is excellent as well, perfect for security. The only thing I could say to improve is to install better curtains. The ones installed do not filter well the sun, so you will have clarity early in the morning.
Very comfortable, good located and nice place! Calm street but just few minutes to clubs and bars. The house is beautiful and perfect for a relaxed stay!! I really felt good there! Thx
Francisco are very nice and gave us a lot of support and information. The apartment  is very good and we had a very staying.

The place is wonderful. There are big double doors you can open and large windows so you can open everything up. With the courtyard and the front patio it feels like everything is outside. So comfortable and pleasant. We came back to the house every afternoon so our toddler could nap and even though it was in the high 80’s outside it was cool and comfortable in the house. The location was close to restaurants, parks and downtown, but the street itself was very quiet.
I highly recommend this house!

It is a really nice and fancy apartment with a gorgeous rooftop incl. a pool. We really enjoyed it! The only thing that wasn't too nice was that the floor wasn't that clean (maybe the cleaning lady was in a hurry) and it was too bad, that there was a dishwasher that wasn't plugged in. Therefore the plates and glasses weren't as clean as we wanted them too.
But those are just little things. All in all it was clean and a great apartment with the one of the best views we ever had.

Jean's apartment is conveniently located within proximity and walk distance to the Metro, university, Museo de la Memoria, and grocery stores.  The quiet building in a quiet neighborhood was a pleasant change to other areas in Santiago where we stayed.  Jean was open and communicative to ensure that we settled in to the apartment hassle free.
Very nice, stylish and clean apartment! And what a nice view to enjoy from the 23rd floor over large parts of the city and some mountains at sunset!

Very nice experience...Jean's mother is so nice and helpful...even we could not speak spanish ...she was patient enough to communicate with us and very smart to get our meaning...also we saw Jean later ...good communication,we talked about chinese food...nice meeting them.If you want a good experience in Santiago...appreciate this apartment...😄

We had a hard time choosing which of Camilo and Fabi's gorgeous apartments to stay in for our last few days in Chile (at the beginning of our trip we stayed in the 3rd floor attic studio). After an adventurous week in Patagonia and some very tired limbs, we knew we had made the right choice with this 1st floor apartment. Everything is exactly as pictured and the space is absolutely beautiful. The apartment was impeccably clean and close to many trendy shops and restaurants in Barrio Italia. The location is very safe and quiet, great for couples or families who want to enjoy a quiet night in after exploring the city. We can't wait to stay here again.

The apartment is perfect for one or two people. The location makes it easy to get around town with lots of things walking distance. We particularly loved the wonderful views and sun-filled rooms. Chris was easy to communicate with and checked in to make sure we were having a good stay. Would totally stay again!
A very friendly and helpful host, and the place was super clean with a gteat shower.

Perfect location. Close to everything. Flat has a great view of San Lucas Hill and also San Cristobal. Place was exactly as described. Valentina was terrific and responsive. Doormen were fabulous.  Mariflores cafe next door was great for coffee and treats. FYI front desk will not hold your bags so if you have a late flight you need to make other arrangements or carry your luggage with you.
Osvaldo was the best Airbnb host I’ve ever had and this was such an amazing place to stay at. He was so kind and helpful. I loved everything about this loft.

Lyli is a great host, totally uncomplicated and helpful, who came to my rescue on short-notice.
The flat has a warm, familiar atmosphere and i found everything i needed.
Thank you, Lyli! Would be a pleasure to be your guest again.

Absolutely beautiful apartment! It has been thoughtfully designed and provided a lovely oasis within the city. Camilo was quick to respond, very accommodating and allowed us to store our luggage after check out (as we had a late flight).

Very nice and clean one bedroom apartment in secure building in good neighborhood with nearby shops, restaurants and  metro. Excellent communications with owner, Paola. Great place to stay in Santiago.

Marisol is the perfect Airbnb host and the room is just perfect! The small patio (which is super nice with sun and plants!) connects to the room - the decorations are cute, the bed is comfortable and the bathroom/shower is right nearby. Marisol's house is great in every sense - it feels just like your own beautiful home and has everything you could want. She makes you feel at home immediately, even invited me to dinner and helped me with any questions about the city or practical stuff. I recommend this place with all my heart !
Place was really nice! Very stylish apartment with a nice view. Never met the host but check in was easy and in a nice place. Would recommend!
Great place to stay in Santiago. Close to metro stop and nice restaurants. The building felt very secure and the apartment was more than equipped for our needs.

This was my second stay at Nicole and Emilio's lovely apartment. Coming back to the apartment was a familiar feeling like coming back home. As usual Nicole and Emilio's hospitality was outstanding. While the apartment was being renovated they let me store some of my luggage for a couple of weeks while I was out visiting other parts of Chile. On my return I picked up a flu and was needing to see a doctor. Nicole immediately assisted by finding an urgent care physician and scheduling an appointment for me. Truly, she went above and beyond all my expectations. Thank you for everything and if I come back to Santiago I look forward to staying at Nicole and Emilio's lovely apartment again.

Had a great stay at this flat. Lovely quiet street and well designed space! Really near barrio Italia (can't recommend casalus restaurant enough!) and not too far to walk to the centre either. Really great C and F provided us with a metro card too to top up.

Great quiet space in Santiago. A lot of sights are only a short walk away. The room had no airco or such and could be a little bit cleaner but was very bright and the bed was really comfortable! Nice garden area as well to hang out!

Great location for what we wanted. Although noisey at night, it is worth it to be right near all these attractions. Lovely art hanging on the walls and nice balcony overlooking the pool and garden. Great to be able to do laundry too. On a personal note - Geraldo was very easy to be in contact with and check it n through exception was easy. Would stay here again

We had a wonderful stay at Francisco’s place. It is stylishly decorated, clean and comfortable. The pictures do a good job of showing what it is like. It is in a great location - just a couple of blocks from a grocery store, the metro, a large park, and a shopping mall. We even joined a gym that was right next door for the time we spent there. A very nice place to make your home base in Santiago.

Our host was incredibly helpful with tips and took time out of his schedule to meet with us and discuss good places to visit, telephone sim card options (tough as a foreigner whose Spanish is poor), and life in general. The apartment is well located to many sites, restaurants, bars etc and was well priced considering this.

One of my best AirBnb stay. The house is gorgeous, the apartment is beyond any expectation, the street quite and pleasant, the neighborhood lovely. Camilo and his girlfriend did a great job. My favorite place in Santiago, with no doubts! Looking forward to coming back soon, Luciana
Everything was fine. The apartment is clean nice view over the city and its near to the center of Santiago. We had no problems, the communication was perfect
Stunning view from every room. Very central location within walking distance from many tourist attractions. Spotlessly clean. The only negative thing is the noise from the intensive traffic.

Impeccably designed & furnished entirely with recycled & upcycled materials; lovely super hostess Mabel and 5 star support from Jacqui. Location is ideal in one of the loveliest residential areas in Providencia, extremely well served (shops and restaurants&cafes) and close to public transport. Ideal house to invite friends over for dinners and patio barbecue. Highly recommended.

Good Communication. Addressed issues / comments right away. Convenient area. However not such a quiet area as it is adjacent to a major street and during the time of my stay next to a couple of construction sites.

Simone's place is probably the most beautiful house in Santiago. It's like a green oasis in the middle of a very vibrant town. We had the most lovely days in her house. It was perfect for our family. It's definitely a place we will return to when we come back to Santiago. Simone and her daughter Clara were the most warm and friendly hosts. Thanks for eveything!

Apartment is located in a nice modern building with 24/7 security. It has a very nice rooftop pool and lounge area. The location is one block from the metro station and grocery stores and restaurants are within a short walking distance. The apartment itself is clean and modern with a comfortable bed, a great shower, and a balcony with beautiful views of the city and hills surrounding Santiago. Because the building is located on a busy avenue there is the traffic and street noice one would expect in a large city but I personally was not bothered by this.

We loved staying in Ignacio’s place! It’s cute, near the metro, and had everything we needed for a really great price. In addition, Ignacio went above and beyond to help us with some last-minute travel arrangements. We were very grateful for his help! We hope the apartment is available again after our trip to Patagonia, as we would be delighted to stay there a second time!
This is a well located spacious flat where we were able to rest up for our journey back to the USA. Javiera could not have been more helpful. She stayed in close contact and was very accommodating!

This is great value for money. The location is a bit of a walk to the main tourist things but there is public transport if you wish (I chose to walk). The one time I had a shower I couldn't manage to get hot water but that wasn't too big an issue. Cecilla gave me great tips on getting around and what to do. She also made it easy for me to check out as I was leaving early in the morning.

We loved Martin’s apartment in Las Condes, Santiago! We stayed for 2 weeks and did a lot of cooking in the well stocked kitchen. The apartment is spacious and tastefully decorated. Great location next to Los Dominicos metro stop and the beautiful craft market. Martin answered all of our questions quickly and kindly.  Definitely recommended :)

Pao's apartment is very clean and all the equipment is in good condition. The view is perfect. In the evening you can sit on the small balcony and watch the sunset behind Cero San Crystal. The neighbourhood is verry lively with restaurants and shops.

We stayed there for three nights while we were in Santiago for the Lollapalooza. We chose the apartment for the location and it was great. Walking distance from the park. The apartment is very clean and just as advertised. I'm really grateful to the host for being able to solve our issue with the check in time, it was totally our fault and he was extremely helpful. What we liked more was the location, it's close to the city center but not right in the middle of it and in walking distance to a lot of attractions and a short Uber ride to great restaurants. We will definitely stay there again if we're back in Santiago.

The apartment is very nice! Everything was just as the pictures show! The location is wonderful and the neighborhood is safe. Working with Jorge, Diego and the front desk staff was convenient and simple.  Would rent this apartment again!

Great room near bellavista. Anita has so much energy and care for her guests. Her room she offers is nice, clean, and quiet. You are also 10mins walking to Bellavista. Her area is safe and cute. Breakfast was a nice touch to wake up to! Would definitely stay here again

Great apartment with everything you need and super comfy bed! Check in worked great with the keypad - so useful. Good location close to main attractions and easy to get everywhere, would definitely stay here again!!

This apartment is in a perfect location, and Martin was very helpful and quick to respond.  The beds are very comfortable, and the wifi is good.  It has everything you need with great restaurants all around. Try the ice cream place across the street!

Overall we had a great visit. It was a very stylish space, the host gave us a great overview of Santiago and the local neighborhood, and we even spent some time on the nice rooftop deck with fantastic views. Unfortunately, the unit overlooks a street of very noisy clubs and there's very little sound proofing - so the bass rumbles the unit very late into the night, even on week nights. Bring your earplugs!

This was an amazing stay in santiago. we would definetly return to carlos apartment! this apartment is definetly forsightful fullfilled with EVERYTHING YOU NEED. carlos was helpful and kind, there was an intro with the reception and we felt perfectly housed for our stay in santiago. thank you very much. gracias
Nice comfortable apartment with an amazing communal balcony on the top floor. Valentina was very helpful and responded quickly to queries.

Mercedes was a great host. She was easy to keep in contact with and met us on arrival. Apartment was perfect for our stay. Small but cosy. Very comfortable bed and best of all Netflix!! The apartment was very well equipped. Very good hair dryer with nozzle and iron. We used the laundry facilities on ground floor and it was great too.
The apartment was exactly as described and Carlos was always very accessible throughout our stay! Location is great!!! Close to the metro and Barrio Italia.

The location is Lastarria is perfect, for local restaurants and bars, the nearby metro station, and lively and high calibre street must. Joaquin is also immensely responsive with respect to any requests, and the apartment was very functional and well-equipped.
Carlos's place was wonderful, and in a great neighborhood. Carlos was very quick to respond to questions and helpful and accommodating.
Beautiful apartment located on a 2nd floor with a private terrace. Barrio Italia is walking distance as well as the L1 (main Metro line). Super safe neighborhood ; we hope to be back soon.

If I could give this six stars I would! This is an old Santiago home full of artistic charm and quirks. It has lots of glass windows overlooking a walled garden spilling greenery. It feels like a secret Santiago garden and is a tranquil retreat after a day in the city. Close enough to walk to Belles Artes and right in the heart of Barrio Italia with all its trendy shops markets and eateries. What a find this was and Simone the consummate hostess. Beds super comfy. Thank you!
The location was perfect! We had dinner at the Peumayen restaurant 1 minute walk away, which was perfect! You could hear some music from the venues around, which we found rather entertaining!
Apartment was great - we stayed here over three nights and everything was brilliant! Also very well located and safe

Well located for all the central things in Santiago, but just around the corner from the Parque Forestal and its lovely green spaces. Comfortable two room apartment with a small kitchen, in a characterful 70s-style building. You get noise from the traffic, so it won't suit everyone. But as a 'pad' in the centre of Santiago it has lots going for it. Nice, big comfortable bed too. Rodolfo was great throughout - a very kind and helpful host, who met me at both checkin and checkout. The cafes on the corner right outside are all great - all three of them!
I can only recommend to stay at Nestor's accommodation. The room is clean and cozy. Nestor advised me local places to visit. Helped with laundry.

Location and Value. Marcelo's apartment is situated in the most lovely neighborhood of Bellavisata near great restaurants, live music and boutique hotels. The unit is bright and efficent with luggage storage and flexible checkin/checkout times. I'd absolutely stay here again.

Lyli's place was a great stop over between my flights. She went out of her way to do my laundry late at night which I greatly appreciated. Her daughters were very kind and her dogs were sweet. Great place close to the airport and budget friendly. Thanks Lyli!
Was kind enough to let me stay longer than the expected check-out as I had a flight late at night and she didn't have someone coming in the next day. Very thoughtful!

Osvaldo was a fantastic host. He left us some fresh fruit and wine on arrival and the apartment was spotless. Be aware that the apartment is in a club district, which is great for going out at night, but music can be loud. We really enjoyed the Bellavista neighbourhood and be sure to check out Patio Bellavista.

The place is excellent. Great location, luxurious, amenities off the chart. The view from the penthouse is absolutely sensational as well. If you’re coming to Santiago and want to enjoy a luxurious apartment without having sell a kidney to stay at W, don’t think twice.

The location of Carolina's place was very close to the BellaVista area and a lot of the tourist attractions were within 15-20min walking distance.
While we were there, we had an issue with the shower head as well as the shower curtain, however, we were reimbursed a fair rate and they had it fixed that afternoon. They were very responsive via the airbnb app and although we didn't end up going, we were even given some free entrance tickets to the bar they owned close by, which was very kind. The staff overall was very helpful and we felt that the area was safe and quiet at night time.

We loved stayed at Osvaldo’s place. He met us on arrival and even gifted a bottle of wine. The place is very modern, stylish and clean. It also has a roof top pool which was an added bonus. Osvaldo gave us lots of tips of where to go and was easily contactable. Great value for money. I would highly recommend. Location is also great if you are looking to stay in an area with a bustling nightlife.

I can recommend this house♡
At first, Lyli is nice host.
She is friendly and her character is very lovely and kind.
She gave me many blankets.
Second, the room was so cute. I liked it. And, room was adequate size.
I stayed there just one night but I wanted to stay more long time.
Thank you so much, Lyli.
I choose this house again if I go to Chile.

Rodolfo's comfortable apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed for a week's stay in Santiago. It was within walking distance of Plaza de Armas, central market, Parque Santa Lucia, National Library and more, and we enjoyed a number of tasty meals in neighbouring Lastarria. Rodolfo promptly answered my questions and was kind enough to get up early for my 6am arrival.

Emelina is a great host. The location is perfect for navigating the city because it is central. There are lots of great restaurants within walking distance. Thanks again for everything Emelina and Miguel.

Camilo is a fantastic host and his place is spectacular. It was sparkling clean when we arrived and it felt like a home away from home. This the perfect place to come back and relax after a long day exploring the city. The location is key with two metro lines close by and the hip Barrio Italia within walking distance. Would return again in a heartbeat!

Bit disappointed to be honest. When we arrived it was clear that the photos had been taken by a very clever photographer as it was TINY. The pool wasn’t open (the only reason we selected this appartment). There were crumbs all over the tables. The bedcover was frayed and dirty. There were no bin liners so we had to buy some. The bathroom was frankly falling to pieces. The WiFi didn’t work for the entirety of our stay. But the view from the balcony was lovely.
Felipe & Oliver's place was phenomenal. The entire building is so clean and stylish and the bed is super comfortable as well. I'd highly recommend this place to anyone else traveling to Santiago!

Lyli is great. Shared with me a lot of good local tips. Place is great, her dogs are adorable. I loved them all. Super market is close, and you get fast connection bus station. It was really wonderful being there and enjoying great time.
Mabel’s place is amazing! Beautiful, central, all one could wish for a big family staying in Santiago.

Alexander and Connie's apartment is an oasis in Santiago! I especially loved having my meals on the balcony. The place is very clean, the water pressure strong, the kitchen well-equipped, and the hosts kind! Their cat is also extremely sweet and playful. Thanks again!

Nicolas has a beautiful apartment with an incredible view. There is always something to do because the location is so good! Nicolas was very responsive to our messages and I would 100% recommend his place to anyone!
Nice, updated apartment with three separate sleeping areas. We fit 6 people comfortably and we had a short walk to some great restaurants in the area.

Cristobal’s house is very cozy, with a magnificent view of the Andes mountains. The location is great, a short walk from the subway system, in a beautiful neighborhood. We had an amazing week in the city and Cristobal was very important in this. He was always very supportive, answering our questions very fast. I definitely recommend it!

Martin's apartment is close to everything. The bars and restaurants nearby are fabulous. There were heaps of sights to explore all within walking distance. My family and I loved it. Would definitely recommend to others.
Marcela's place was fantastic!  Marcela was very quick in responding to any requests I had and help make my stay very comfortable.  Would highly recommned.

Patricio was a great host and he was very accommodating. He was extremely responsive to my messages and he even helped us book a cab from the airport! The Airbnb was clean and we fit five people comfortably. It’s within walking distance to restaurants and conveniently located. I recommend this listing for anyone traveling to Santiago.
Diego communicated well and went the extra mile to accommodate our requests. The courtesy toiletries were a nice touch! We would highly recommend staying at Diego’s place.

Perfect home away from home in one of the best neighborhoods in Santiago close to many restaurants and cafes.  The hosts are fantastic and catered to our needs.  I will highly recommend it to all my friends.
Good location close to to airport and cheap however bed was quite uncomfortable and dogs woke me up during night, very nice dogs though.  Also no hot water in morning when I tried to take a shower.

Very nice place in the heart of nightlife. If you like to drink and party, this is the place for you! Bring earplugs if you are sensitive to street noise. Enjoy the MANY restaurants just steps from the door! We had a great stay.

Osvaldo was an a spectacular host with his quick responses and great neighborhood tips. He explained everything to the T and made us feel very at home. The apartment is beautifully decorated with thoughtful touches. It is situated in a lively neighborhood with restaurants all around. Theres is a local fruit market near by that you can't miss out on. All around great stay!

I had an amazing time in this fantastic loft space. You can’t beat the views, hospitality, comfort and convenance. I wish I had a longer time to stay and I would definitely stay here again next time! Carlos is a perfect host, was flexible and was there for every step.
You won’t get anything better in Santiago! Hands down, one of the better Airbnb’s I have stayed in.

Cecilia's place was great! It looks just like the photos and has an awesome balcony overlooking the city. Sunsets from there were fantastic. We cooked dinner there a couple nights and the kitchen had everything we needed. Good wifi and plenty of space for 4 people. The room with 2 beds is pretty small but for the price it's a great value apartment. Loved the access to the yellow line which gets you anywhere you need to go and connects easily with the red line. Cecilia was super responsive and helpful.

The appartment is in a beautiful area and has incredible nice concierges and cleaning staff. Also, the room is perfectly equipped, especially the bed is very confortable and the kitchen has everything you need. Phillip is an unbelievable nice host, who seems to answer 24/7 and ever time very quick. - Thank you Phillip!!
To live here was definatly a great decision and i would do it again and can recommend it to any other person as well.

Simone was a lovley host and she has a beautiful home in an excellent location. My wife and I  travlled with two children (aged 2 and 3) and her house was very spacious and cosy for all of us. There is a beautiful garden that windows throughout the house expose which is a tranquil place my wife and I enjoyed relaxing in. She was thoughtful enough to leave us some toys for our two small children which was appreciated greatley and helped them feel more settled. Overall a wonderful host, house, and location!

Great place to stay if you want somewhere central in Santiago. Would highly recommend for international travellers as Eduardo was very helpful in helping us find the apartment and gave us some great advice on the local attractions

What a great airbnb, my family of four loved the location, it was clean and stylish. Beds are comfortable, plenty of space, compact but nice kitchen. Close to great restaurants, museums etc. I highly recommend this place.

Ximena's place was excellent. Especially the location was great because of the nearby metro station which took us really fast into the center of Santiago. The house itself was excellent. Provides everything you need. It was really nice to have the place for your self most of the time.

Osvaldo’s place is spectacular. The location in Bellavista is incredible. His attention to detail is unmatched. If I had an apartment, I’d want Osvaldo to help decorate. He has the eye of an artist and his place is spotless, warm and inviting. In addition to that, Osvaldo himself is a true gem. Think “the most interesting man in the world” meets humble host. I highly recommend this place for anyone. I will definitely be back for a stay soon!
This apartment was great. Really close to bars and restaurants, clean, comfortable bed and good shower! Would definitely stay again. :)

Great location, great stay! However we left something. I messaged the owner within two hours of leaving and have not gotten a response and it has been over a week. The person I am traveling with who left the item got a response in a day in all Caps, “IT IS YOUR RESPONSIBILITY TO GET ALL YOUR ITEMS OUT” that is not exactly what I look for when I stay at places like this. Most places I have stayed at have been more than willing to help with any issue like this. Yes, I am probably a terrible guest, who knows. But things happen and sometimes you have to leave in a hurry. It’s very close to downtown and great restaurants. They were flexible on us adding days. Again very disappointed in how it ended. I would not stay there again because of it.
Perfectly located in Bellavista near to bars, restaurants, and the funicular. The flat was extremely clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again.

Lyli is such a warm and lovely person. I would recommend to stay just to meet her. It is very close to the airport in a quiet location. Lyli took such good care of me and I loved her little puppy and dogs.

Nicole is a remarkable host and went out of her way to ensure that Sally and I enjoyed our stay - even managing to arrange transfers to and from the airport. As Nicole describes, the apartment is cozy, clean and stylish and in an excellent location in Barrio Lasstaria, being just a short walk from the main cafe and restaurant area. It is an apartment in the middle of one of the worlds largest cities, so there is some street noise and also noise from neighbouring apartments - but nothing to be overly concerned about. The other thing to note is that the apartment is on the second floor and there is no lift, so there are two flights of stairs to contend with - again, nothing to be overly concerned about, but worth noting. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and should the opportunity ever arise to revisit Santiago, I would have no hesitation in re-booking this apartment - thoroughly enjoyable !
Martin's place was clean and in a really cool location. Great place to hang out in and wind down after seeing the city!

Carlos's place was perfect for our stay in Santiago. Great location, great view, clean, huge private balcony overlooking the city, good value and prompt communication. We had a little trouble checking in with the keypad, it was 3am, but the Airbnb staff and Carlos did a great job working quickly to resolve the issue. Other than that, we could not have asked for a better place to stay in the heart of Santiago. Also renting a car to visit surrounding areas was very easy and Carlos provided great tips on places to go. Thank you!
Great space, fully renovated and very stylish. It had a full kitchen, which was essential for my month-long stay. Thank you, Camilo!

Absolutely fantastic apartment. Great location, really close to metro, super market, restaurants, coffee places and city center. Kitchen was well equipped, the WiFi was fast and the smart TV with Netflix was just a bonus. Definitely recommended for anyone going to Santiago.
Definitely the best apartment we have stayed in via Airbnb. Kat was also really helpful throughout, helping us to access the property and use things like Netflix. Really good value.
We had a great stay. The bed was so comfortable and huge and the apartment was lovely and clean. So much better value than hotels and hostels nearby.

The apartment was conveniently located in the city - I was able to walk to most of the places I wanted to go. Check in and out was easy and the building secure, with friendly people. Valentina was a great host, quick to respond to any of my questions and even helped call a restaurant to let them know I was going to be late.

What an excellent Airbnb and host. Francisco should go into hotel management! The apartment was fantastic, in a really quiet neighbourhood, and Francisco was very accommodating and even provided breakfast.

Francisco's apartment is lovely, light and very comfortable.  The beds are great and it was warm and cosy for a cool time of year.  It's very conveniently located near the subway, supermarket and cafes.  But it is Francisco who really makes this place special.  He is so friendly and helpful and easy to contact on the mobile phone he leaves for guests to use.  Don't hesitate! Book Francisco's apartment!

Really great house with everything you need, the style of the place is really unusual which fabulous art and furniture. It is also a really great location in my favourite part of town.
Mabel's family greeted us and nothing was too much hassle, very hospitable, I thoroughly recommend!

This was without a doubt one of the best places I've stayed in Santiago, and I'll try to stay here again on my next trip. The apartment is a great space for two people, the bed is incredibly comfortable, the building is super quiet and safe, and the location is perfect. I definitely recommend this place!  Really pretty space, huge TV, a great apartment if you're looking to relax for a few days.

I thoroughly enjoyed staying at Anita Maria's place. It is in an excellent location in the centre of Santiago and easy to reach from anywhere in the metro area. She and her husband were excellent hosts from the very beginning, helping to accommodate an early checking request after a long flight. Their home is a beautiful place, and I highly recommend for all guests

Fabulous, Amazing, Gorgeous, Breathtaking, Fantastic, Awesome :) :)
This place is top notch, communication was perfect, cannot fault it at all.
Highly recommended to any traveler
Really nice hostel in fun Bellavista neighborhood. The people staying and working there were so friendly and welcoming to us.
Awesome Host! He is always worried about your stay and confort. Very nice guy. The place was really clean, warm. Definitively I felt like home.
Felipe & Oliver's place was better than expected.  Everthing was well organized and clean.  Would definitely recommend this place to everyone!

Close to Manuel Montt metro, beautiful building.  I had not been this part of Providencia.  Coffee shop, pharmacy and Pizza shop 50m from front door.  WiFi and parking included.   Clean and “big enough” the apartment Exceeded expectations.

A hidden gem in the epicenter of Bellavista (the zone to be in because everything there). Nature, restaurants, bars, clubs, uni, and landmarks are all literally outside the doorsteps. Very cool because you can do a lot. Apt is safe, spacious and quiet inside and outside. The bed was large and comfortable. Metro and supermarket is a short 5 min walk.
Hector treated me like a good friend during my stay. I felt like he cares about your experience. Easy going yet attentive to everything. Accommodating above and beyond. He is well traveled and is part of the local community. Speaks clear English so communication was never a problem.
Victoria is a wonderful host. The neighborhood has so much to offer. Food, shopping anything you could need. I will definitely stay here again.
Francisco’s place is great. There’s central heating which is a plus for those Santiago winters, and it was very clean and well-located in a beautiful part of Providencia.

This space is amazing - many of the apartment details are handmade, and it is centrally located in the nightlife area of town. The building is very safe, as there is an attendant 24/7 who buzzes you into the building. The building has a rooftop pool with an amazing view of the city - I came during the winter, but I wish I could have tried it out. One important note is that the apartment does get cold in the winter - he provides space heaters, slippers, and very warm bedding/blankets, but the apartment does cool down at night during the colder months. Overall a great stay!

Comfortable and compact. Big tv, heating and good king sized bed. Kitchen could be better equipped - there was no salt, oil etc but in general everything ok and you have the necessary things for a nice stay!
Amazing apartment in a great location. They provide cleaning and coffee everyday. We loved staying there and definitely will come back. Great view of the mountains also.

Lyli is a great host with a cozy home. She was always willing to help and went out of her way to make sure I found a taxi. She even let me check out late since I told her my next bus was leaving late. the room was comfortable. It's winter and it was a bit cold but the many blankets helped keep me warm. She made sure I felt at home and she's very easy to communicate with. Thank you for everything Lyli, buena suerte.

Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay for a long wait before my flight. Lyli's place is perfectly located for getting to the airport quickly. I definitely recommend her home over staying at an expensive, and less inviting, hotel. I had a quiet and relaxing night of sleep and Lyli is a wonderful host! Helped me with transportation to and from the airport. 100% recommend!

The nicest place I’ve stayed in in my month of travelling!! Spotlessly clean. It felt like a shared house. Could do my washing, cook and everyone there was really lovely. Will definitely stay again if I’m back in Santiago. Thanks!
We enjoyed our stay in Santiago.  Cute and clean apartment, small for a family of four but had everything we needed.  Close to sights, food etc.  NB. Spanish only at reception (no English).

Amazing views of the Andes! Currently this isn't captured in the photos for this listing.
Cristobal is very open and communicative, the location. Is great, the view is fantastic, it is quiet, simple checkin and checkout.

She’s very kind and accommodating. Every member in my party wasn’t able to show up at the same time but she was understanding of our circumstance. Her home smelled fresh and everything was just as clean in the photos if not cleaner. Her home is surrounded by plenty of businesses and uber is very accessible so it in a great neighborhood. It could not have been a more perfect stay. Gracias Claudia!
Good spot, gym is ok for short stay. There is hydronic heating radiator in lounge area. Ok in winter. Supermarket short walk Starbucks around corner.

I had a awesome month in this department. I wish I could stay longer. There is nothing to complain about. The department has a wonderful balcony and nice rooms with a great kitchen. Phillip is the best host you can wish for.
All in all I can highly recommend to stay here!!

Very nice clean and well decorated flat. It was well equipped and sunny.
The street down the flat was a bit noisy due to the 1960 diesel city buses.
It’s a great place to stay and relax! The bed and TV are huuge, perfect for Netflix & chill :) The hosts are very kind and responsive.

Very cute studio, perfect for a couple! Located in the most hyped neighborhood in Santiago, next to several restaurants and bars, and right below Parque Metropolitano - wich is really worth the visit! You can walk anywhere from Marcelo's place, didn't take the metro at all. The host was very nice on letting us make a late check out with no extra cost - our flight was leaving at night and he had no one coming in, so he let us stay there.
Problem is: VERY NOISY at night because of all night clubs around. I mean, REALLY noisy until 2am! Just couldn't sleep at all so wouldn't stay there again and don' t recommend for people who wants to rest at night. Good for party people, though, who's planning on staying late in the streets.
The apartment is well located, clean, and the check in was easy. No restaurants open around after 9pm but otherwise everything was perfect.

Really good place to stay! Love the place it was my home for over a month really enjoyed staying here!
Would totally recommend! Nicole was super helpful when my flight was delayed she arranged a driver for me. Instructions were super clear and I was very happy. Overall very good airbnb! Thank you Nicole!

What a great location and excellent space. The flat has 2 bedrooms, 2 baths and really nice spaces. And the amazing feature is the incredible location. Great neighborhood with so many food, drink and entertainment options!

This apartment is in a fantastic location in central Santiago. Subway close by. Restaurants down below are very handy.
The apartment was perfect for our family of four. Clean, spacious enough and easy to check into. Martin was easy to contact and responded quickly.
I’d stay here again!

I stayed in the apartment for more than two months while studying in Santiago. I love the location, both if you're staying for short or long term. The apartment is very comfortable, and safe due to its 24hr reception. It also has quite a few practical amenities that I appreciated. The host is fast at responding.

I've stayed at a lot of Airbnb's and always had great experiences, but Maria's place blew me away! The view of the Andes from the large windows is absolutely stunning, and the space itself is lovely and sparkling clean. In terms of thoughtful touches, Maria went completely above and beyond-- she left me cookies and fruit, a bottle of wine, and even had adapters and other amenities to borrow in the apartment-- not only making my stay about 20 times logistically easier, but also making me feel incredibly welcomed. I didn't have the pleasure of meeting her in person, but she was very responsive over Airbnb messenger and Whatsapp. The location is great too, just a short walk from a metro station as well as some of the loveliest places in the city (I particularly enjoyed Cerro Santa Lucia and Lastarria). I hope to make it back to Santiago, and I would stay here again without a moment's hesitation! Gracias por todo, Maria!
Osvaldo’s loft was one of the best Airbnb’s that we’ve stayed at. It was in a great location and Osvaldo provided us with numerous tips of things to do.

The apartment is exactly as you see in the photos. Nice location, very close to great restaurants (must go to Bocanariz). Nearby subway stations make it easy to get around, but it is also possible to walk to various sights. A big differential of Nicole's apartment is the portable wi-fi modem. It helps a lot for the use of maps and directions. The subway card (necessary to recharge) also facilitates the life of the tourist. Strongly recommend the stay in the apartment.

This apartment is in a charming and super quiet neighborhood. Camilo was very responsive and flexible: we arranged ahead of time for a late (12:30 A.M.) check-in, and he provided plenty of restaurant and supermarket recommendations. Lots of nice touches in the apartment including laminated information sheets, games, and incredible artwork. For those visiting during winter (we were July), the apartment has central heat. The overall design and style of the apartment is spectacular, original and modern. The location is a 10-15 minute walk from the metro and from the main section in Barrio Italia with some superb boutique shops and restaurants. We had two rentals here: the first and second floors, and both are great.
Kat’s place was really clean and tidy. It was the perfect place to relax after long days of exploring the city. When the sky was clear of smog, the apartment had a beautiful view of the mountains.

Felipe and Oliver'splace was in very convenient location, so we walked to most of the places, it was clean and cozy. I recommend staying there just don't park in the streets, our car was broken into. Thank you for your hospitality and great communication!
The apartment is very comfortable and the location is great. The hosts were understanding (we arrived late) and friendly. Super recommended. :-)

Wonderful place! Very close to Farellones Park and also there is a local transportation to get in the park. Jaqueline´s son (Bruno) is very nice and we did the round trip from Santiago with him.  A lot of snow  during my staying. It was good to cook in the house because we we were 3 families with kids. Also we did a barbecue outside. The kids loved Farellones. Very nice sunset view all days! Would like to come back!

The apartment is in a wonderful part of Santiago and the pictures show it just as it is!  Really comfortable and Nicole has thought of everything - especially for international travelers.  (hair dryer, shampoo, card to travel on the metro, etc.)  Really enjoyed the stay.

Very charming apartment close to the Costanera shopping center. Apartment is clean, comfortable and silent although resides in the center. Mabel is also very nice hostess. We will be sure to return when visiting Santiago.
this is a fantastic place. sparkling clean. do know that it's very loud on the Weekends!

I spent three weeks at Carlos' place, and it has been very nice.
The location is quite good, in barrio Italia, and not far from the Irarrazaval subway station. For such a long stay as mine, it would have been nice to have a washing machine in the building (but Carlos had clearly told that there was no washing machine available so it is totally fine). Otherwise the studio has everything one can expect, it looks very new, it was perfectly clean, the wifi and heat were functional, and I liked the view on Santiago.
I would clearly recommend it (or come back).

Cecilia was a wonderful host, very welcoming and did everything possible to make sure I was comfortable. The room was really cozy with a huge bed. The house is in a great and central location and Cecilia was very helpful with any questions I had. I had a great few days staying here!

The Apartment is really close to the center of Santiago de Chile, it's just a 5-minute walk. The apartment is fine, especially the view was really great.
The communication and the check-in worked out without problems.
Marcela is an amazing guest and her apartment was very clean and organized! Communication was also successful! Loved the location and it has a lot of options to get around

Perfect journey in Santiago de Chile thanks to this accomodation and to his host! The flat is well located (you can go almost everywhere by walk and there are lots of restaurants/stores nearby). The private room is comfortable and the family is welcoming. I totally recommend!
Osvaldo was the greatest host!! So kind and welcoming. The place is also in a great location. I also loved the decor and the lofts style, i would 100% stay again!!

Very helpful and considerate host.
The apartment is nice and clean and has most amenities.
The area is good with short walks to the metro, a small mall with a large supermarket and various restaurants.

Kat's apartment is wonderful.  It is very comfortable and every amenity is provided.  The 24 hour staff is friendly and helpful.  Kat communicated immediately regarding every question we had. The location downtown is within walking distance to many fascinating neighborhoods and museums.  Santiago is amazing!

Marcelos apartment is situated in the heart of the charming Bellavista area. At day it's the most perfect location you could ask for, but at night, this turns into a party district, and you can hear the music in the apartment from the surrounding bars all night. So if you like to go out and party, this is a perfect place for you!
We had a wonderful time in Antonio’s apartment. Antonio was such a nice host. There was bread, fruits, juice and wine for us to use. The apartment itself is great! And the location is perfect too.

A great apartment in a great location. Would recommend to use the car parking (Saba) if you have a car for safety reasons which is only a 3 minute walk from the apartment block. The apartment itself is extremely secure and well set out for 1 or 2 people.
The use of the washer/ dryer is very useful for those traveling for a period of time.
Many thanks and would return again in the future.

My stay at Javiera's apartment was really appreciable. She was really flexible with my time of arrival and departure, she made sure everything was working out perfectly and her apartment is great. Everything was as described on the website. It is really well located, and very easy to access. I would totally recommend her apartment and I would definitely not hesitate to rent it again if needed.
