a bit far off from the pictures.  furniture and decoration was absolutely lovely, however, the bathroom needed a major remodeling

Hector was very nice, a perfect host.
The room is very confortable and the bed too.
The apparment is very well located.
Gracias para todo !

The apartment is very well located. The Bellavista neighborhood is very nice, with many great restaurants and some nice shops, as well as close to the center of the city. The apartment was great, very clean and perfect for a few nights in Santiago. On top of all of that, and perhaps more importantly, Marcelo was an outstanding host! We had to change plans last minute and stay in Santiago because the airline lost our baggage, and we would have been completely lost ourselves without Marcelo! He responded very quickly and helped us get settled and make the most of our impromptu stay in Santiago!
The apartment is fantastic. Everything is gorgeous and brand new! Kat and Piero are great hosts!

Margarita and Patrick are fantastic hosts. They did everything they could to make our stay great,  and it was. Apartment is a very short walk from El Colorado (easy to do with skis). Hot water was a bit inconsistent but nothing too hard to deal with. Lovely place with beautiful views.
It was a pleasure to get to know your place! You and your son are very thoughtful. Very nice place and view!

Patrick greeted me warmly at the house and gave me a full tour, demonstrating appliances and answering questions. The home was warm, cozy, and very clean. The location is perfect, immediately close to Las Lilas park and the surrounding restaurants, cafes, and stores. The wifi was fast and reliable. Patrick himself responded helpfully anytime I reached out. I can recommend Patrick's home to anyone planning a trip to Santiago - whether for business or pleasure.

Lyli was super sweet and so responsive! Her place is perfect location to get to the airport and her dogs are adorable. Had an early flight and Lyli woke up early to help me get a taxi at 4am. Much appreciated and definitely recommend!
Excellent little studio, just as described on the site. Mariana and Dominic are excellent hosts. I recommend this place very strongly.

Great apartment and host. Lovely area with gourmet deli, cafe, Resteraunts and supermarket close by. Train station nearby. Lovely safe area to stroll around at all hours. Apartment has a lot of space and has a kitchen. We would be happy to stay here again.

A wonderful visit to Santiago. The apartment was spacious and very clean. Beds were great! Camilo allowed flexibility on check in and we stored our bags at check out since our flight wasn’t until later that night. Definitely recommend!

The apartment is located within walking distance to many destinations, as well as the metro.  The decor was lovely.  We enjoyed a few nice afternoons on the rooftop terrace, which has a fabulous view.  Osvaldo made check in easy for us and checked up on during our stay.  The 24 hour security was a nice amenity, as was the onsite laundry.

Really nice apartment to accommodate a big group.  The apartment has recently been remodeled and feels brand new.  Great views of Valle Nevado ski resort and the Andes with incredible sunsets every night!  The box of toys was great for keeping the kids busy and a big storage area for food and drinks was convenient.  The hostess Maria was very helpful with local tips and recommendations, very proactive with making sure we had everything we needed.  I highly recommend this apartment since our family was very happy with our stay and ski trip.
Great appartement, clean and nicely put together, perfectly located if you plan on exploring the city.
Very good apartment, comfortable, modern and excellent for this kind of trip. Amazing location. The host responded all of our requests.
Can’t say enough good things about this Airbnb. Great location in Lastarria, quick replies from Nicole and very clean. The portable wifi was also very helpful!
Great host and location! Apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for our short stay in Santiago.

We stayed for 2 nights and absolutely loved the Lastarria neighborhood. It’s walking distance to the best museums, the government district, and some awesome restaurants. Dominic was an INCREDIBLE host! He picked us up at the airport and
was so helpful with tons of travel tips. I wish we could have stayed longer and gone on some countryside tours with him. ¡VIVA CHILE!
Great apartment with lovely views. Location is good - 10mins walk to metro. Cristobal was a brilliant host who was quick to respond to any of our questions.
Lyli is a wonderful host! Her home is super convenient to the airport and her family is enchanting.

Very recommended place in Santiago. I cannot think of any negative point, only positive ones:
- Excellent location
- Great 180 deg panoramic view
- Comfortable for 1-3 people (even the couch bed is very comfortable)
- Helpful host
- Well equipped kitchen
Comfy , clean and spacious apartment, location is great, check in is super fast, truly recomend.

Excellent place with great location. I was received in place by Graziela to complete the checkin and receive local tips.
The place was clean and with useful details available like soap and shampoo. The kitchen is fully equipped!
Great place to stay.  It was close to the slopes and very clean.  All the staff at the complex were so friendly and helpful, especially Arturo.
Cozy place! We had 4 guests and it accommodated us fine, but small. Neighborhood is ok. Beds were very comfortable. Kitchen is small. But we had a nice meal.
Beautiful space, great location next to many bars and restaurants, excellent host always easy to communicate and had many great recommendations

The apartement was ok but we had some trouble with the stove and some other things. On the bright side it had a great location and Dom was very helpful when we came, he picked us up at the airport and gave us great tips!

What an amazing host. Charming apartment, lovely art work, clean confortable beds, really an outstanding place to stay. I’m set! This will be the place for me to stay on my next visit to Santiago.
Camilo Thank you so much for the amazing stay .
Thanks Lyli for the great accomodation, had a great sleep and will most definitely be back soon. Her cute dogs will keep you company for sure!
Paola is a great host and the apartment is excellent! A large balcony with a nice view, thoughtful touches, easy check in process and good wifi.

Stylish penthouse with an impressive view over Santiago.
Great communication with Juan. Thaks for the stay.

Perfect little place to have a nice sleep right next to the heart of the city. You also look into a beautiful old building out from the courtyard which is gorgeous and you can go up to the roof to the pool and this stunning view! Thank-you so much!

The room was really nice and spacious. You have access to a big kitchen. Everything was really clean and the hosts really nice and helpful. Would definitely recommend it, plus the location is really great and close to the metro :)

Francisco's apartment is gorgeous, in a perfect location with nice view over snowy mountains in the winter, very nicely decorated. Francisco himself is very accessible, friendly and helpful, the cleaning lady is great! You have to learn how to operate the shower, but all in all I had a wonderful stay, highly recommend!

Nice little place in a great location. Public transport (bus, metro) around the corner. Shops and restaurants in the neighbourhood too. The apartment has a locker which makes it extra safe (on top of the always present concierge). Communication with Javiera was very good.

It's a nice apartment with a nice location. If you want to stay in Providencia then this is a very good option. Nothing about the apartment wasn't what we expected as my wife is Chilean so we knew how apartments are in Providencia.

Valentina’s apartment is fantastic. It is in a great location and is exactly like the photos. Furthermore, Valentina is very helpful! We had trouble getting the key to work in the lock when we arrived (a bit tricky  but you get the hang of it) and she was there to help us within minutes. I would definitely recommend this to anyone travelling to Santiago.

Hey awesome stay guys!! 😄👍
I raved about this place to family & friends. Other building tenants or owners are quiet and thoughtful as well. Great location and views. Awesome tv and cable. 👍
We had a great stay at Ximena’s place.  The apartment was close to many sights and restaurants

I book a room to be able to sleep but it was very very noisy during the night (bar street and bar located at the basement of the room) and during the day (construction). I don't understand why Airbnb reviews don't show up this information about this room. I will call Airbnb to understand.

Claudia's place was fantastic. It's very clean, modern, and has easy access to all things in Provedencia. It's comfortable and has a lot of amenities, and small touches I did not expect, like a candy dish and a well stocked tea jar. These came in handy for such a short stay.
Claudia's communication was clear, fast, and very thoughtful. Access to the building is very easy, and the check in/check out process could not be easier. Claudia does a fantastic job hosting on AirBnB

The apartment is nice and clean.
Building is very secure.
The location is ideal as the underground is very close by.
The views from the flat is really very nice.
Marcela responded quickly to messages
The appartment was easy to find and near to the metro. The check in is very comfortable with a code. The house is fine and the appartment also.

Location is great, close to everything. Communication with Valentina worked perfectly and we got easily access to the flat.
The apartment has no A/C, it may became a bit hot in summer.
View is spectacular, has two sleeping rooms with individual bathrooms including shower.
The Department and the infrastructures is a bit old and very simple.
We have been there with my colleague for business and used it only for sleeping. For this use it was fine.

Me and my parents had a great time in santiago, and part of that was because of her hospitality and cosy flat. Everything was perfect, from the first day to the last one.
The flat is beautiful and exactly as it is in the pictures. It was very clean also. Everything was explained in detail by the host soledád when we arrived.
The apartment is right in the town center, near to a subway line. There are also restaurants and markets nearby.
I recommend the flat to anyone that might ask me for a place to stay in santiago. It was a great stay and soledád is an incredible host!
Great place. Our host was really easy to communicate with and the place was spacious, clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend to anyone else.
Great location. Francisco was very responsive and accommodating to my early arrival. Easy check in. The location was the best part. In walking distance to so many places.

Lyli’s place was a convenient location near the airport for an early morning flight. It’s a little challenging to get there by public transport but definitely doable. Lyli is very kind and attentive and she’s really helpful in organizing airport transportation. The negatives are that the bathroom is very cluttered and the dogs are very loud.

Osvaldo was awesome. He greeted us and took us to the amazing roof top to show us around the city, including recommendations. The apartment is very nice and well designed. Prefect for two. The only complaint was the noice at night. It is in a party district which goes all night. Outside of that our stay was perfect
Unbeatable location! The host was super helpful when we ran into issues with our luggage. Great experience!

Very nice place in a good location. It looks exactly as on the picture.
I can definitely recommend it.
Great hosts. Angie and Adolfo were very friendly and communication was easy. Great location. Everything was perfect!

Simone was great host and very accommodating! the garden was very beautiful and spacious perfect four 4 guest
thank you Simone
Thanks you very much. Renato and his team was very cool and I recommend you to stay there.

Victoria's place was an amazing, cozy, excellently-located home base to explore Santiago. When the airlines lost our luggage, Victoria and the 24/7 doormen were very easy to communicate with and made it so we were able to still go out and explore the city and not have to wait at the apartment all day for our bag to be delivered. The bed was also very comfortable too! Excellent value- 5 stars!

Great apartment, clean and stylish!
Superb location, local attractions were in walking distance!
I would definitely recommend staying at Adrian's apartment!
The apartment is clean and the view is amazing. The bed is so comfortable! We appreciated everything about this apartment, I strongly recommand.

Kat’s place is by far the most stylish and comfortable apartment I’ve stayed in in Stgo.  It would be difficult to find a single flaw, so I’ll just mention the strong points:  conveniently located near the Santa Ana metro station, building w/ 24-hour security, stylishly decorated and comfortable, an amazing bed, sumptuous bath towels and linens, spotlessly clean, a coffee machine that produces a super cup of brew, the view from the balcony ... and of course hosts who were always responsive.  Highly recommended.
Really enjoyed the time spent at Phillips loft. I recommend. After a day of siteseeing, the hot tub was perfect!

A great place that is exactly as advertised! I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a spacious apartment that sleeps up to 6 people while in Santiago. Great communication and easy check in!
Thanks Luis, you have a great apt, at a great neighborhood. we had feedback for anything we asked, immediately! definitely we will come back.
Great spot in an ideal location. Javiera was very helpful and even let us check in early which was a great help!!! Thanks a million

Cecilia is very helpful and reapond quickly for any questions. I was a little nervous because is my first time visiting Chile. But check in process was very easy. And the apartment located in very convenient location close to many things.
What a wonderful and bohemian area in Santiago. There are a number of excellant restaurants just around the corner and we very much enjoyed our stay there. The nightlife was buzzing!
Osvaldo’s place is simply amazing! He is a great host, very thoughtful and attentive. Would definitely stay here again.

Apartment was cheery, clean and exactly as described online. The building has 24 hour security which is nice and is an a great location to walk to many sites, shops, restaurants and the metro. Would recommend. Thanks Felipe & Oliver

Great location in Santiago downtown. Safe and very convenient for the position. The apt is very clean and functional. Besides it has a lot of items that you might need during your trip. Totally satisfied!
Luis is a nice host. The apartment is very close to the metro and has everything you need. The adjacent street is very loud.

This is a fantastic place to stay in Santiago! The rental was clean and is in a great location for exploring the city. You're in walking distance to a lot  of great restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Camilo was  extremely helpful and responsive. We would definitely recommend it!

We loved staying at Mercedes' place. The area isn't that great but except from that it's amazing. You have all you need and the apartment is quite big. We felt really save and at home. Thanks for having us Mercedes.

Wonderful place with an amazing garden, and lovely people. A special, serene atmosphere is created in the house thanks to rules like taking your shoes off and not bringing meat into the house. The house is very cosy! You won’t be cold at night with that huge pile of soft blankets. The atmosphere is very relaxed. Thank you again to Gaby for welcoming us ! xxx
Bernabé is a great host. We had a very nice time in his apartment. We recommend his place 100%
Amazing loft in a perfect location. Osvaldo is very nice and gave us many tips. Would definitely recommend the place to friends !

Excellent stay at Valentina's place! The location was even better than expected, with Cerro Santa Lucía and the metro in close walking distance and other cute neighborhoods nearby too. It was tidy and comfy and set up with a Smart TV and Netflix. The rooftop views are incredible. Communication with Valentina was easy and her father welcomed us when we arrived.
This place ticks all the boxes. if it's available just book it. don't miss out!
Small studio apartment perfect for a one-night stay for a couple. Can be a little bit noisy as in the centre of the bar district. Spotlessly clean.
The apartment is ok, kitchen is very basic. Its a bit loud, as right next to the main restaurant and bar district. Location is perfect. Terrace is smalles as looks on pictures.

Anita and Abraham are phenomenal people. Extremely courteous and helpful in every possible way. The apartment is located at a fantastic location. It is spotless. They served breakfast every morning. They are an amazing couple.

We had a wonderfull stay in Simones house. It is stylish with a beautifull harden. Everything you might need is there. The neighborhood is quiet and safe and two metrostops are nearby. Simone was very helpfull with organizing transport from and to the airport and she gave nice recommendations for our stay in Santiago. A perfect place for our stay here.
Awesome location, perfect for couple or individuals. the owner has great sense of style, would definitely recommend

Great communication from Luis and brilliant location. Flat is perfect for a short stay in Santiago and has all the amenities you need. Road outside is quite noisy at night. I don't think it is a problem but something to be mindful of if you are a light sleeper. Recommended!

We had such a nice stay here. The location is perfect and close to the city center. Also there is a roof top with a great view.
We can totally recommed it!!

This is a really nice apartment to explore Santiago. It is a nice (and safe) neighbourhood! Also the host Evelyn is exceptional!! She responded really fast on all of our messages and we could leave some luggage when we left Santiago for 3 days. The apartment is nice and clean. And the shower is hot! All in all a really good experience which exceeded our expectations!

I booked the stay for my parents and everything was arranged well. Carlos was very helpful and the apartment looks exactly as the pictures show. The contact with Carlos was really clear and fast. The apartment was clean and the building and neighbourhood were nice too! I would recommend this place :)
Jean's place is around a lot of schools and universities which helped me to feel safe.  He and his mother are gracious hosts and available to answer questions and accommodate guests as necessary.
Terrific couple hosts a spotless. charming shared apartment. Great hospitality, warmth, and humor, and a really nice firm bed and pillows. Highly recommended!

The flat is really well located, perfect to visit the city
All the basic amenities are available

Rodolfo 's place was excellent! The apartment is located in a very nice and quit area at 5 minutes walking to the metro station and 10 minutes from the main square. The area is very well served with restaurants and grocery stores. The apartment was clean and the communication with the host was excellent! Highly recommended!

Great, stylish place in Providencia. We had a car and had no problem finding parking places on the street (free). Camilo was really accomodating and helpful especially when we had flight issues that delayed our arrival. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting Santiago.

The biggest things about the appartment is the location and the incredible view from the 27th floor of a portion of Santiago and a panoramic view of the Andes mountains. Kat and Piero were really easy to communicate with and always answered our questions in the next hour or so.
Would definitely go back.
Thanks again Kat and Piero for everything

This apart-hotel is really well located and the room is big.
The street was a bit noisy during the night (maybe because it was Friday), too bad.

Soledad is a great host, very friendly and always answered quickly. She has been waiting for us at the apartment and gave us preciously tips and a wine as a welcome. The apartment is perfect... I've felt as at home ... it's close of everything we need, subway station, Patio Bellavista, supermarket. I really want to come back to Soledad's place.
The unit is gorgeous; filled with tons of artwork, huge windows, large bed. There is no ac, but the location is a quiet oasis in an otherwise crazy city. Highly recommend.

Very comfortable space. We enjoyed the full kitchen and relaxing on the balcony.  Location is perfect, close to restaurants, bars, and shopping at Patio Bellavista. A close walk to San Cristóbal and Centro. We would definitely stay here again.

I was so pleased I chose Maria’s apartment. Maria makes sure you have everything. I arrived jet lagged, very cautious about travelling alone with two words of Spanish! There was a bottle of wine to welcome me and a container full of cakes, coffee for the morning. There were maps prepared of where to find much needed fresh food, restaurants nearby and the sights and the metro. The apartment is really beautifully presented and just fantastic. It is so close to everything - the metro was just down the street.
Maria makes sure you have everything. She is warm and generous. I was completely at home. I felt so comfortable in a country I knew little about. I am so impressed how friendly and kind people were to me in Santiago. They are wonderful people.
Marcelo’s place was nice and comfortable! No problem at all! Everything you need is there and everything was clean, the position is great as well! I would definitely reccomend it
A very nice small flat. Perfect to start your tours of exploring the city. The host is wonderful and you find in the flat everything you need.
5 Stars in every aspect - location , flat . can't find better then this! don't miss!

Sara’s places was a lovely and clean condo with a great location in the heart of Santiago.
It was cozy and very clean.
She was great with responding to any questions or concerns we had.
Thank you Sara

Victoria's place is perfect for a short stay in Santiago, the apartment is bright and comfortable and the location is great. The kitchen is quite small so only very basic cooking is possible. Only small complaint is the charge of $5 per bag to store them after check out if you have a long wait until a bus/flight.
Aline’s place is lovely and in a fantastic location, however they are currently in the process of building two new high rise apartment blocks making the noise from 8am every morning unbearable!
Victoria’s place was quiet and clean, with easy access (10 minute walk) to great restaurants.
Soledad was a great host and we loved our stay in Bella Vista! Would thoroughly recommend this apartment

Great place, great location, amazing hosts who go out of their way to make sure everything’s as perfect as can be. I can’t recommend enough. Thanks Carlos and especially Karen for everything you’ve done for us over the past month.

Location, location, location! I felt like I was right in the middle of a great area with lots of restaurants, cafes and sightseeing in very walkable distance. The place is a perfect studio. All you need for a restful evening after exploring!

We had a great stay at this apartment. The views of the city and Andes were absolutely incredible. Carlos was very easy to get in touch with and was very helpful. It is very centrally located to museums, great neighborhoods, and restaurants. I would highly recommend this apartment.
Had a great time at Felipe and Oliver’s place. They’re very communicative and accommodating for late arrivals. Area is very central and walkable. Would recommend!

Nice, clean, safe and modern place to stay in Las Condes (14th floor offers great Mountain view), just minutes to the park or the nearby shopping center. Rooftop pool is quiet a nice place to be. The host (even if you don’t see her like us) can be easily reached online. Netflix and TV wasn’t properly working but hasn’t been any issue for us.
Only thing you’ve might notice if you like to stay in bed until late (on weekdays or Saturdays), there’s a big construction side next to the building. In case you are sensitive of noise, just bring your earplugs.
Great location, a block away from one of the main metro lines. Clean. As advertised. I would highly recommend this apartment.

This is a very nice, safe place to stay in Santiago. Unique art work and loft lay out. Quiet, tree lined neighborhood short walk to green space to walk/run/bike/picnic. Short walk to shops, cafes, supermarket etc. close to Taxi, metro, Uber etc
kitchen space small but we did not do much cooking.
All of our needs were met and Mable and her husband responded with in 5” when our microwave broke and exchanged it right away. There was a nice bottle of Chilean wine on the table when we arrived and they also provided us with some essentials before we had time to shop. ( bread, butter, eggs, water)
Wish we could have stayed longer!

Comfortable and well-located apartment. Close to many great neighborhoods and on the red metro line, which is the one we used the most. Check-in was easy and Felipe very responsive. The rooftop terrace is perfect to watch the sunset. The only issue was the couch which is due for replacement. Overall, we loved the place and would stay there again.

This is a very special apartment which we felt very fortunate to stay in! The art is gorgeous, the local tips extremely thoughtful and the location great. Camilo was very friendly and nothing was too much to ask! Margarita the cleaner was also so lovely and left the apartment sparkling

Philip’s apartment is gorgeous, comfy and quiet. It’s a delight to dine or hang out on his large terrace.
We stayed there for a month and were so sad to leave. Vero, the housekeeper, is excellent.
Philip is an exemplary host. There was a bottle of wine and water awaiting us on arrival. We had some special requests which he quickly accommodated. He always responded quickly as well to our questions. I would definitely stay there again or rent another property from Philip.

Patricio’s place was quite big and in a hotel, which wasn’t what I expected. The apartment was big enough to fit six people; even though one of the rooms had a bunk bed. Patricio was quick with responses and fixed any problem we had! Bonus, there’s a pool on the roof with a great view!

This is a very modern one-bedroom apartment in a fantastic location. My husband and I spent eight nights there on a recent work/fun trip to Santiago. It was great being so close to the metro, and there were plenty of attractions within easy walking distance as well. The apartment itself was a great place to relax and get some work done - very reliable WiFi and a comfortable space. There was some traffic & city noise, but that’s to be expected in such a central location. I slept with earplugs and did just fine. Despite there only being a few pots and pans, we did manage to cook most nights using fresh fare from the local markets and nearby stores (although there are great restaurants within walking distance of course). We appreciated the ample storage space in the bedroom closet, and the excellent view from the patio. I would stay here again on future trips!
Excellent location for sightseeing, restaurants and public transportation. The apartment is comfortable but is noisy in the evening and night due to the location, which is to be expected.

Excellent location in a  bohemian neighbourhood and full of life. If you are a lover of good food and the poetry of Pablo Neruda, you can be a few meters from his house La Chascona. You can walk the streets where he was thinking, creating and fighting for his ideals. It is easy to take the subway at the Baquedano station and the studio is located a short distance from Patio Bellavista. On the first floor there is an excellent restaurant with excellent congrio soup.

I stayed at Soledad's with my family. The location was very convenient - we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to - lots of great restaurants are just a quick walk away. ALso there is a subway stop just steps from the building - so when we wanted to get away, it was easy.
There are multiple markets within blocks where we were able to purchase groceries. The kitchen is small but well appointed and you'll find what you need there. We chose to cook breakfast everyday so this was a big help.
The space was very clean and had all the essentials. The shower had nice water pressure, the towels were soft, and the beds and linens comfortable.
The real stand out is Soledad - she was a great communicator (check in and check out were a breeze) and she went above and beyond in helping us on our final day.
Camilo was a great host and his place was roomy & bright and in a wonderful location. Providing a travel card was very thoughtful. We loved it!

This house having best garden ever.
Kind hosts.gracias. The table is best part of the garden And completely private property. We spend a lot of time on the table. House is also very good. Very cozy. Have a good sofar, nice windows, Quite neighbor, nearby supermarket. Thanks. Gracias. If you need rest? You should check this house.

Very stylishly decorated apartment, just as beautiful as in the  photos, with great attention paid to detail and making you feel comfortable and welcome! We loved the location as it was full of bars and restaurants, and if you like night life, then you could spend all night till dawn surfing from club to club.

This condo is very well situated near the central market, subway stations, and great restaurants across the river or down on Constitucion.  Very safe with the 24-hour staffed front desk.  Comfy bed and well furnished.  It was pretty warm while we were there and the condo does get the afternoon sun (and only has a fan) so it gets pretty stuffy.

Lyli's place was relaxing and close to the airport, as I had a very long lay-over before a very long flight. I do love dogs and so they did not bother me and Lyli said they will bark 10 minutes when I arrived, but they stopped after 2 and we became friends. I will definitely come back again.
The apartment was nice, clean and well located! I  strongly recommend it if you want to stay in Lastarria while staying in Santiago!
Juan is responsive, friendly, and incredibly helpful. I'd recommend him to anyone traveling to Santiago.
A very fabulous apartment in a strategic location. Easy access to main attractions. I would say that was the best bed I had slept in since arriving in Chile. hahaha
Love the area, 10 mins to metro station and Uber’s always available very quickly ! Would stay again for sure !!!

Easy to find and there is a nice plaza with a good reasonably priced restaurant on one corner. The area feels quite safe. There are lots of students around  and It  is noisy at night even during the week. The apartment is ok for an overnight but needs some attention.
I had a great stay at Felipe & Oliver’s place! The location was very central and easy to get to
Great location as it is only a 5 minute walk from the Metro and close to one of the best neighborhoods Bellavista as well. Marisol is a very kind host.

Kat's apartment was beautiful and in a great location. We felt very safe in the neighborhood and the security personnel/desk concierge were very helpful. I would recommend to everyone I know traveling to Santiago.
this place is great, quiet but lively. good view at the balcony. lots of restaurants nearby. would like to return another time for sure.

This apartment is amazing. It is exactly as in pictures. The location is great near Patio Bellavista where you can find many bars and restaurants. Recoleto area is charming and very safe. it's only 10-15 minutes walk away from Centro where you will find more restaurants, shops and museums.
This apartment was super clean and there is everything you might need. WiFi is fast and the view from the balcony just amazing. When I come back to Santiago this is the place where I want to stay.
100% to recommend, super host, always ready to support you at anything, the flat cozy and very well located, has anything you might need. I had a great time at Amarilis place and in Santiago!!!

The stay at Gabriela’s was great. She is super welcoming and is just a really great person! She is open to give you tips and ideas of where to go and what to do in Santiago. Pretty much always has time for you. Her garden is a dream. Her son is also such a nice kid. My friend and i quickly fell in love with the city, Gabriela and her son (and all her friends that are often at her house), and the house.
The best place to stay in Santiago!

We loved staying here. Carolina was amazing and always got back to me right away. She met us for check in and made sure we had everything we needed and didn’t have any quiestion before she left. This place is righ next to heaps of great cafes and is basically above the train station ( although we didn’t notice any additional noise ) can’t recommend this place enough!

I have stayed in A LOT of Airbnb homes over the years and Simone’s home has made it onto my list of favorites. The natural light is amazing! The garden is a lovely; we enjoyed glasses of wine there nightly. Barrio Italia is the best neighborhood in Santiago and it’s less than 10 minutes walk from her home. Some days we just didn’t even want to leave we were so comfortable. If you’re looking for a place to stay in the area - there is no better choice. We definitely would love to return!!
Check in was easy in apt building. Very secure & convenient to walk to attractions or take the public bus if you  prefer.

Great location, great host (speaks Spanish and English and  maybe other languages too).  Small, but perfect-sized, apartment with everything you need, plus it was quiet in a very popular area of Santiago.  Fun staying there.

Felipe's apartment is awesome. The perfect size for two or three travelers. The view from the apartment is great, and the apartment is located near lots of little stores and restaurants. We also really enjoyed the rooftop swimming pool. Felipe was a great and responsive host. He was also very thoughtful -- he left my wife and I a bottle of wine as a welcome gift!

Excelente place. Very clean, great location close to subway and walking distance to a lot of places. Tne neighborhood has a lot of restaurants, pus and cafes. Alex and Connie are really friendly and they make you feel you are at home (great coffee btw!)
Really recomend the place!
Very tranquil space in the middle of a hip neighbourhood.  The garden area is amazing, we spent a lot of time there.   Quiet in the evenings, we slept very well!

I stayed here for four months. It’s a very safe neighborhood but close to a major street with metro stops, grocery stores, restaurants. While I liked the apartment and location, I would not recommend this for a long term stay because there is only a small mini fridge and no washer/dryer. Roberto is an excellent and helpful host.

Kat and Piero's apartment was impeccably clean and was perfect for a short stay in Santiago. There's a beautiful balcony and I would've loved to have breakfast there if we'd stayed in Santiago longer. Kat was incredibly accommodating and even let us drop our bags off before check-in.

the location is terrific! easy walk to a metro station, and then only a couple stops to the major sights of Santiago. The apartment had everything we needed. We could hear street noises,  but it didn't keep us from sleeping. We never ran out of hot water (in fact, be sure not to turn the hot water tap very much, because it gets very hot!).  While the apartment isn't very big, it had what we needed and the price was right.
Great place, just what i needed. I was in town for a few days & this place is located in a very convenient location, clean & nice building. Mercedes was very responsive as well.

Great place in the centre of Santiago. We were only there a couple of days, but were able to explore and get around by foot. Osvaldo was easy to communicate with. The bed was super comfy. The rooftop pool was a great place (with a great view) to cool down. As mentioned in previous comments the noise from nearby clubs is present. We were able to sleep through it, but I suggest light sleepers use the earplugs.

Absolutely lovely apartment. Camilo is an excellent host, providing a warm welcome and as much assistance as you might need. He connected us with an excellent driver to take us out to vineyards and white water rafting. Easy walk to Ave Italia etc. Not too far from Salvador subway stop. We could go on. Suffice to say a very nice place to hang your hat while in town for a few days.
The space was great, super clean and comfortable. Oswaldo was very responsive and really made the end of our trip relaxing by accomadating our odd check out hour!

This apt is a wonderful place for you to stay in Santiago. The apt is located in a good place and you can walk to tourist attractions and restaurants. The house is well decorated and Alexander is so so nice! We feel we are at home.

Casas Del Rio is an amazing place to stay. The host is fantastic, the staff are always available and have helpful hints on where to go.
The apartment itself is clean and close to everything you will need to make your stay in Santiago a great one. You have a great variety of restaurants to choose from close by and the neighborhood is calm, safe and the subways are a short walk to get to anywhere in the city.
Overall I loved Santiago and Casas Del Rio was a huge reason for that. Definitely will be coming back to Casas Del RIo.
Great stay! Easygoing and super accommodating hosts! Close to everything. A home away from home. If u‘re going to stay in Santiago this is a great place to be !
We defenitly had a great stay at this place! Felipe and Oliver arranged everything perfectly for us. We really felt like home for a couple of days! We would recommend this appartement for sure!

A bit tight but my guess is pretty typical. The rooftop access was nice for enjoying the mountains at sunset.
Valentina was a very prompt communicator!
Great place in heart of santiago! Sebastian was very quick to respond to any needs I had and the rooftop pool was a nice way to end our day. I would definitely come back to stay here.

Great place to stay in Santiago! Very clean and comfortable. Kat and Piero were always very nice. The apartment is really good, it has a nice view and it’s near to the metro station. Also is near to the city center. At weekends and at night the location is not as good as the other days because some of the stores are closed but you can go to another places and enjoy the city because it has a lot of buses and the metro station two block away.

It was a fantastic stay. The location is excellent. It is in the artsy area, and lots of cafes, restaurants, brunch places. Everywhere is walking distance. The flat is nice, clean, and cosy. And there is not noise at night which is very important. The communication with Amarili was super easy and fast. I strongly recommend this place.
Sebastian was a great host, he waited up late to let us in (flight landed at 3am). Everything was clean

The apartment was very nice and comfortable. The location is excellent and very close to a mall. Eduardo was very hospitable and though we didn't meet, he was readily available to answer questions and help with the functioning of appliances in the apartment.
Great place and amenities. The pool is fantastic and watching the sun set from the roof terrace was a pleasure. Patricio was very helpful and we had a great stay.

The apartment is in an excellent location, near Sky Costanera and Tobalaba subway station, which makes life easier if you need to buy something, eat or move in Santiago by metro. In addition to that, the place is cozy, with an awesome view and big windows. It is very clean, comfortable and with fast internet. I felt like I was at home.
Chris and Bea communicated fastly and prepared everything with instructions about the checkin, stay and checkout. Also they were very gentle on asking us if everything was good and offering help if needed.
I strongly recommend the place!

Francisco’s apartment is great. The location is brilliant near the metro, with supermarkets and a big mall nearby. The space itself is lovely with a great terrace for bbqs or just chilling out. We were 5 and it was a perfect space for us.

Graziela is an amazing host. Provided us with local information and even made reservations at restaurants for us as we did not speak Spanish. The appartment was close to amenities and the the local mall is walking distance away. The place was clean and well appointed with a regular cleaning service. I would definitely recommend this appartment and would stay there again.

Soledad' s place is very cozy and organized. She was always quick to answer our messages  and checked on us from time to time. Even left a bottle of welcome wine! Totally recommend. The one thing to note there's only one fan and no air conditioner on the apartment, it wasn't an issue for us but it would be a nice improvement.
Very nice and clean apartment, close to the city center as well as to many restaurants and bars. we would definitely recommend to stay here when in Santiago

We loved this space! It was perfectly decorated and well outfitted for a stay in Santiago. Walking distance to cafes, restaurants and the river for strolls/runs. We appreciated the portable fan as Santiago was quite hot that week. Marcel even let us use her parking spot which was appreciated! Oh and the Pool - we never used it but it was beautiful with an amazing view.

Appartment was the way we expected, even a bit better. Very clean. Great location. Host is very responsive and pleasant. He thought about every possible thing we needed, even nice bottle of great Chilean wine :).
Highly recommend this appartment.

The room was very clean and big! It has everything you need for your stay.
The apartment is located in a commercial building and it was a little bit difficult to locate it and at first it felt a lit bit unsafe. The location is good because it's close to many tourists points and it has a lot of restaurants (fast food) around but it's very busy street and it doesn't seen safe. The cars can't get in the street so be careful by walking around with big suitcases.

This is a great place to stay in Santiago. Walking distance from the centre. The rooftop pool is really nice, as is the restaurant at the 25th floor, which serves a great breakfast for a good price. Highly recommended.

The house was just as described.  New building in great location!  Francisco went the extra mile to make our stay great including helping us find a rental car!  Very clean, comfortable beds and bedding, well equipped kitchen.  Beautiful view.  The pool was great for the kids in the heat of summer!
Small apartment in the heart of Santiago. Great for what we were looking for with 2 people.

Everything was perfect! Really!
Amazing house, amazing host, amazing view, amazing cleaning!! Everything was amazing for real!!
Thank you so much ✨

Marcelo’s place was wonderful! A perfect location in Barrio Bellavista right next to both the Patio Bellavista and Cerro San Cristobal. Marcelo was prompt in responding to messages and made many recommendations for restaurants, drinks, etc. The apartment was simple, but provided everything we needed; also felt very safe during our stay. We would 100% stay again!!

Gerardo and Carolina are the perfect hosts. The apartment is tastefully decorated and clean. Close to a multitude of amenities and attractions in Santiago.  The beds are comfortable and bathrooms clean and in full use. There was an issue with the boiler and this was resolved in super quick time. Would not hesitate to visit again!! Thank you!! Xx
Our family enjoyed our stay.  The kids enjoyed the pool.  Patricio was very helpful and responded quickly to any questions that we had.

I stayed here for two months during an internship in Santiago and had the most amazing time. I have been so well taken care of and found a new home away from home here with Maria and Magdalena during my stay in Chile. There is such a warm and caring ambiance in the apartment and they are the perfect hosts, whether you are staying for only a couple of days or longer. Both the rooms available are lovely with comfortable beds and everything you need for a nice stay. If you need any tips or recommendations they are more than happy to help. The neighbourhood is safe and beautiful with a walking distance to the metro, restaurants and grocery stores. If you decide to stay here, you will definately not be disappointed. Gracias por todo!

The apartment is superb! The deco, appliances and bathroom but above all the neighborhood is simply delightful. Walter was always communicating and he waited for me until I arrived so everything went smooth. Excellent experience overall!

The place is clean, the host is super fast in replying to any question. The neighbor is safe, with excellent security in the building, and good restaurant near by. A plus for us is the Catholic Church is near by. Easy to walk to.
We enjoyed our stay and would come in.
Caryl and Bill
Carla's apartment is nicely located, is clean, and spatious, and is as represented in the pictures. We had a great stay.

Jean's apartment is very nice, located close to a couple different Metro stops and the fabulous Barrio Brasil! Jean was easy to communicate with and we had no issues getting into the apartment. If you are looking for affordable and comfortable accommodation in a great Santiago neighborhood, this is a great place!

Great place to stay, awesome views, very clean, felt very safe, close to public transportation.  Would recommend taking the walking tour Tours4Tips at 10:00 am on your first day there. You can walk to the meeting place and tour takes you through the area where you will be staying.  They offer lots of information and great recommendations.

Location is very convenient as it's close to a lot of restaurants, bars and tourist spots. Merja was very helpful with a super late check-in. She was also very reachable during our stay and had great pointers for places to visit. Room, private bathroom were just ordinary. There were no blackout curtains in the room, hence the room gets pretty bright very early in the morning during summer.
Walter’s place was so beautiful and relaxing. We loved the art, books, and plants sprinkled around the house. He went out of his way to be helpful and generous. Highly recommend!

Maria’s apartment was a great place to stay while we were in Santiago, and she was an excellent host. She responded quickly to any questions and the apartment looked just as pictured. There was a great view of the city and mountains from her place as well. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Place is nice, located a bit out of the city center but not bad especially with the use of the metro. Overall great value for your money. Perfect place for two people.

Ignacio's place has a great location near attractions downtown. It's also a very safe feeling area since there is a lot of police and military presence.  It was in a very cute old building and all the neighbors were very nice.  Ignacio was very kind and allowed us in early to set down the luggage, and let us keep the luggage there after check-out time when I had a late flight time.  Wifi worked well.

I booked Camilo's place for my brother, sister and niece who have never stayed at an Airbnb. They absolutely loved it. Super beautiful, clean, safe, and quiet. We checked in on Christmas Eve and had to make an adjustment last minute to make sure we could pick up the keys earlier in the day. Camilo responded almost immediately and made accommodations. Highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to feel like they live in the city while being close to major transportation lines and neighborhoods.

Ruben is definitely a perfect host! he made our stay extra special from leaving mineral water in the fridge for us to use, giving us metro cards, calling and helping to arrange transportation,  extra nice small things in the bathrooms like face moisture wipes, etc..  coffee, varieties of teas, comfortable beds, nice linens..

Carolina and Claudia took amazing care of us during our time in Santiago. They were available for any questions we had and graciously welcomed us into the space. The apartment itself had all the needed amenities—including Netflix on the television! We were able to easily cook and sleep comfortably for four. Located in the heart of Providencia, you can’t find a better location. A bank, grocery store, and numerous restaurants were located just steps away from the apartment. The building included a great rooftop pool and was convenient for laundry. It felt like we were right at home!
Beautiful apartment in a great part of the city! The pictures do not do it justice.  And the rooftop pool/hangout area is a great bonus!
Alex was a fantastic host, he gave us tips and suggestions on what to do and the apartment was perfect
The apartment was in a great location and was on a quiet street relative to other places we stayed in the area. The view from the room was nice.
this apartment is in a good location for exploring Santiago. wonderful having a king bed and large TV. Had everything we needed

Valentina's place was the perfect location to site see in the city. Being in the center, you're within walking distance from so many great sites. We were also very impressed with the apartment. The apartment was decked out with every amenity we could ever need. You can tell a lot of though went into the guest experience. Overall, we were very impressed with the space and would recommend this to anyone who's traveling to Santiago.
Great welcoming place (what you see is what you get) where you can feel comfortable in perfect neighborhood location.

Wonderful experience! The flat has perfect location and is very stylish (without losing coziness, which is great!). Mirza & Felipe are perfect hosts and made everything they could to make our Santiago getaway unforgettable. Would book again, hands down! Highly recommended!

Nice and clean apartment. Bed was really comfortable. Pool was great, especially at 34 degrees. Has a fan but no formal air conditioning so had to leave windows open at night which could be a little noisy. Easy check in. Great communication. Would stay again.

Nice place, centrally located on a pedestrian street. It's above a shopping center, so at night, you have to ring the bell and wait for a security guard to open the gate for you. I found the security guard to be prompt in responding to the bell.
This was a clean, quiet space in Providencia with a great view of Santiago and easy access to food, drinks and the subway system. I definitely recommend!

Patricia's place was perfect for us. In a central location in Santiago, we could walk or take a quick taxi to wherever we needed to go. There was a pizza place and cafe right at the bottom of the building, too. The view from the apartment on the 21st floor facing the downtown was absolutely stunning. The pool at the top of the building was in a great location but was a bit murky, so we didn't swim, but its a nice place to hang out. Patricia was awesome with communication and check in was a breeze.

Alejandro’s apartment was an excellent find for our stay in Santiago! Plenty of space, beautiful vistas across the city from the open air terrace, great location, clean, and comfortable. Alejandro lives in the same building, so anytime we had questions he could pop by and resolve them. He gave us lots of tips for things to do off the beaten path, and was very kind and hospitable. Highly recommend!

We had a good stay at Osvaldo’s place, but we had high expectations for an Airbnb Plus property that this apartment  didn’t quite meet. The space is very stylish but some of the furnishings and towels were dated and should’ve been replaced. Others have noted the noise at night. Overall a very good apartment but not necessarily stand-out.

Excellent service and very comfortable apartment. The place is in a great location, vey secure spot and many things around and very centered. The Host is very nice and friendly, eager to help with what he can.
Great place and awesome location and amenities. It really made my first time in Chile unforgettable and I would like recommend booking this place. Thank you.
The apartment was really clean and well looked after. Location was great and made it easy to get around.

We recommend Paola's place for a couple. The description is correct, the place has everything you need, and she is a great host that tries to accommodate guests' needs. The location is also a plus. It is close to public transportation, restaurants, supermarkets, bars.

Our stay at Victoria's place was quick. The apartment had everything we needed and is located in one of the most important streets of the city center, thus quite easy to get to good part of the tourist attractions of Santiago and its commerce. You can tell Victoria gives it a special touch in decoration and hospitality! Gracias por todo!

Great location, good apartment for the price. It is a little less fancy than the pictures make it out to be. We had some trouble checking in because we booked the apartment the same day but Marcelo was quick to respond and solve our issues. Would recommend for a short stay.

Carla Saved the Day as we had a terrible stay with a previous host that we had to cancel.I wrote to Carla and explained and she told me not to worry that she would take care of us and it would all work out.
Carla arranged for us to bring our bags and leave them at the apartment as the maid cleaned.Carla was in constant contact making suggestions for things to do while we waited and reassuring us that we would be in good hands.
The apartment was spacious and very well kept.There was nothing left out.This is one of the most professional air bnb apartments I have rented in Stgo.I would recomend any one looking for a well equipped and stress free stay in Stgo to contact Carla.The Morris family could not be more appreciative.
Great hosts. Perfect location. I loved Santiago and the apartment was part of the reason for my enjoyment. If I return, I hope this apartment will be available.

Excellent apartment with top of the line appliances.  Great refrigerator ( i cook all my meals so having a great refrigerator makes a difference), washer/dry in the unit. great view,  the bed was the most comfortable I had slept in at any airbnd location and there was a 70" super TV..  everything was great and close to two subway lines and walking distance to most of the museums and sites.

Such a fantastic little Airbnb! Great location close to lots of amenities, quaint/stylish place with little added touches, and the hosts were incredible. Replies were quick, check-in was easy, and Mirza & Felipe were very helpful with any questions we had, or information we were looking for. We had a great stay and would recommend this place and these hosts to anyone! Thank you so much again Mirza & Felipe :)

The ethnic lodge is such a unique and gorgeous experience. The finishing touches are spectacular, and also reflect the care that its host provides to his guests! Osvaldo was so lovely and gave us recommendations during our trip, and was happy to help with any questions we had also. Muchas gracias, Osvaldo!
Good location for those who want to explore the city centre.  The pool provides good relaxation space from the busy city with a great view.

Very nice apartment in center of Santiago with "almost" great view ("almost" - because of crane that blocks out this view ) over the mountains. The apartment is very stylish, new, modern, nicely designed and extremely clean. The kitchen is well equipped and has everything you need for cooking. Checkin is very easy and Kat & Piero responded to questions/concerns very quick. One disadvantage of this place is that inside the apartment is very loud. You should be aware that right next to the apartment 3 other skyscrapers are being built, so expect a lot of noise from 8am to 6pm (during the week). If you are out - that's ok, but if you would like to chillout in apartment during the day - forget about it.

Tiny, but lovely place with good view. Extremely good location. Fine stable wi-fi. For check-in you need just say your name to concierge. Apparemment is small but finely organized and contains all you need. Claudia is always ready to help with any questions.

Cute place in a great area if you’re here for the night life. If not so much for the night life, bring earplugs. The neighborhood is pretty active until late at least on fridays and Saturdays. Lots of amazing restaurants and cafes nearby, close to parks and attractions, felt very safe (at least for this complete newbie to Chile and Latin America)
The hosts were very welcoming and nice and I had some good conversation with one of the other guests. Cool people for sure!

The apartment is just as described. The location is perfect, close to attractions, restaurants and metro. the WiFi is fast and always worked. I really enjoyed the view from the balcony each morning. Maria is always quick to respond and helpful. I would stay again if in Santiago!

A stunning flat in a beautiful building. We had everything we needed and really appreciated the thoughtful touches. It was great to enjoy the pool and rooftop view as well as being able to really relax amongst the lovely decor. The noise is real so I was happy to have brought my earplugs and it didn't bother us. Great base for exploring Santiago.

Mabel is a fantastic host. The communication with her was always prompt and responsive. She went the extra mile to help us arrange transport to the airport. The wine, bread and other fridge necessities were a thoughtful touch. The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to excellent shopping and restaurants. We highly recommend staying at the place.

We stayed at Camilo's place over Christmas 2018/19 for over three weeks. We absolutely loved the apartment. It is gorgeous, full of art and objects d'art, colour and lots and lots of light. Everything is spotlessly clean and we particularly liked the sunny terrace. The apartment is located in a quiet side street full of trees and other vegetation.  We loved the neighbourhood where you can find lots of restaurants and shops. A supermarket just opened very close by where you can find everything you want. The place is gorgeous and we were very sad to leave. Book this place, you'll be very happy there.
Great location, very clean, very fast WiFi. No fans or air conditioning, however the room was still very cool and we just opened the sliding glass doors to the patio.

Simone's place very much lived up to the official descriptions - it was fantastic. The house is light and airy and the general living area comfortable with loads of full height windows/doors onto the back garden area. The garden is full of plants and trees, and really lovely to sit in or look out at from the living area and main bedroom. The house is in a very nice part of the city - quiet streets with lots of trees, and plenty of local shops - and the main city centre is only 15mins walk away. Simone was the perfect host - with easy, quick, friendly communication about arriving and leaving. We would strongly recommend this place.

We stayed 3 times with Odette at Casas Del Río. The house is gorgeous and each apartment has beautiful details and everything you need for a perfect and cozy stay. Odette and Sara are beyond accommodating and helpful. And the neighborhood is one of my personal favorites in Santiago, with a lot of character, residential (quiet and safe) and with great access to all the city. From now on, Casas Del Río is my home in Santiago.
Osvaldo’s flat is beautiful, clean and perfectly located. The must is the swimming pool on the roof top ;) I highly recommend this flat if you plan to stay a few days in Santiago!
Nice little apartment in the centre of Santiago, but it lacks some basic kitchen equipment and doesn't have an AC
We absolutely loved our stay, and stayed in two different rooms at Marcelo’s. He was a fantastic host, acccommodating us on short notice for our 5am arrival to Santiago. Everything went smoothly!

Lyli offers great advice and helpful support as to getting to and from the airport and to other destinations near Santiago. I was so grateful for this and thankful for her flexibility as to my arrival and departure. A lovely, quiet, peaceful room for a solo female traveler from Canada.

Location is fantastic. Right in the middle of what Santiago has to offer. The only thing is if you are an early to bed person, the noise prevents it. But it does get quite after the restaurants close. Apartment had everything you need for a comfortable stay. We stayed 3 weeks and found the neighborhood safe, clean and plenty happening every night. It is right near 2 metro lines. The door people were lovely and greeted us with a hello every morning and welcomed us back to the apartment after our day out. Also helped with transportation back to the Airport. We didn’t meet our host, as we were always out and about. However communications was good and we got access early to leave our bags. We will be back to Chile soon and will rebook this apartment.
Francisco is a great host, very friendly and helpful. The apartment is beautiful, well equipped and cozy. It was even cleaned daily! We would highly recommend.
Really clean and nice apartment located in a safe place. Beautiful view and close to the centre. I definitely recommend this place.

A lovely host, unbeatable location near banks, transportation, restaurants and supermarkets (literally all you need is next door!). The flat is cozy and lovely decorated. A great touch are the guides with house rules both in Spanish and English with tips, recommendations about what to do, where to eat, transportation and very helpful information even about local Chilean slang.
The host is very quick to answer and easy to get in touch with. A superb experience.
A great place, very easy to use and access, the door men are terrific and in a good location for nights out, shopping and the centre of town
Javiera is a very good host!She is thoughtful and was always available to help. The apartment is very well located, near the subway and lots of other facilities.

Hector's room is absolutely central to the better part of Bellavista animated and fun area and near the park. The location is exceptional, and still it is quiet. Hector is very welcoming, easy to get along with and organise. the large bed is comfortable and room spacious in a creative and lively apartment. I spent a very enjoyable weekend at Hector's place. Thank you.
Eugenia is a wonderful host and make you feel at home. She is caring and attentive. Well worth the try for anyone visiting Santiago
Very central location, with many restaurant choice in the short walking range, even next to building entrance! Just a bit noisy during evening! Martin is an excellent host!

Valentina’s place is clean and comfortable, with nice little homely touches and is in a very central part of Santiago. Easy to walk to nearby shops and a market.
Valentina gave us clear instructions on how to get in as well as directions to nearby supermarket and subway.
The guys in the reception were very helpful and friendly as well.
We felt very safe in Valentina’s apartment.
Would recommend to others.

Cristobal & Valentinas apartment is located in a trendy area within walking distance to the nearest metro station (Ines de Suarez). They kindly left a metro card on the table (bip card) that you can top up. It’s very reasonably priced. The apartment itself is lovely and spacious, it has an amazing view of the Andes and a big plus point is that they have a washing machine in the apartment ( most usually have it in the building for a fee but this was great for us as we had been travelling a while). Valentina was always in touch and happy to help. She accommodated us checking out later than the set time despite having guests later that day which we really appreciated as it allowed us to see more of beautiful Santiago without lugging our bags around. I would highly recommend cristobal and valentinas apartment.

Great location with seamless check-in and excellent host communication. It’s worth noting that the apartment does not have air conditioning, and as it gets very hot in Santiago you may need to keep the doors and windows open as I did. Because the city is very noisy, this can mean a loud, less than peaceful experience. That said, the apartment is very well laid with good amenities.

Great studio apartment perfectly located in the lively Bellavista area. Everything was clean, the place is nicely and not too decorated, and the bed is very comfortable. In summer it’s necessary to keep the window open in the heat at night and visitors must expect noise from the street.

The stay was great, from start to finish we had great communication. The rooms were clean and we had the necessities to be comfy for the 2 weeks of our stay plus we had soo many great days with the use of the swimming pool. Everything was very close to reach such as restaurants, mini markets, fast food, etc.
I would definitely recommend anyone visiting to stay at this place. I look forward to visiting again.
20/10, would recommend staying with Lyli. She has 5 AMAZING dogs, and a SPA in her backyard!😻😻😻
This is a nice, simple place to stay. It’s in an area we found interesting to explore on foot.
Attentive and responsive host. The location is hard to beat. Comfy and cozy apartment. Definitely recommend. Antonio thank you for everything

I had to book this super last minute as my plans changed quickly and it was so worth it! The area is definitely very residential but this makes for a nice and quiet space. The host was very helpful start to finish. I would 10/10 recommend this space!
It is a lively house with children and friends. Very, the atmosphere is relaxing well. There are lots of fruits and handmade stages and pools in the garden. It was very good.

Martin is the best! He is very attentive to your interests and assisted us in making the most of our 2 nights at his place. His knowledge of the city and points of interest are interesting and helpful. I highly recommend his place as a wonderful home away from home when visiting Santiago.
One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve been too. The kitchen is really equipped and everything was really nice and working.

Camilo's place is one of the best we've ever stayed... it is located in a quiet yet nice neighborhood, close to a lot of cozy cafes and restaurants, as well as at walking distance to a large supermarket(Tottus)... the apartment is stylish and very clean... perfect for a family with kids... the only downside is the lack of A/C(there is heating but no A/C)... since we stayed in Santiago during very hot days in January, it was a bit uncomfortable at times... other than that, I highly recommend Camilo's place...

Great location - situated on Ave Providencia in a very nice part of Santago. Good size unit in excellent condition with all the expected amenities. Felipe is very quick in communication and very helpful. The view from the place is outstanding.
3 minutes walk to Salvator metro - from there places downtown can be accessed in 10-20 minutes (depending on whether a change of line is required). The metro maps available online are out of date - new metro line 3 was opened in January 2019.
A small but full range Lider Express supermarket is 10 minutes walk away, near the Ibis hotel which can be seen from the balcony. There are numerous cafes and restaurants in this area - note the ones in the side streets as you walk towards the Ibis, as well as on the street running past the front of the Lider.
All in all this property is highly recommended.

Fully equipped apartment in a central location with easy subway access. Great the bedroom was on the backside from the street, no problem with noise.
Friendly hosts who are attentive to guests needs. Spent a week here and had a great stay.

It was amazing! She replied very fast to any messages and contacted me frequently to check if she could make my stay any more comfortable. She even cleaned the apartment and provided new bed linen when I was in Argentina for a weekend. The best host I had so far!

This place was very affordable and the owners (Felipe & Oliver) were super helpful before the trip by communicating via messaging in the app. They provided a hair dryer, which was nice because the appliances we used from the U.S. didn't work well with Chilean power (even though we brought an electric converter).  One thing that could definitely improve was the number of towels provided. Only two towels and one wash cloth were provided for a 10 day stay. Having a washer was very convenient, because we had to wash the two towels and one wash cloth multiple times during our stay. The bed was very comfortable. The kitchen is equipped with most things you will need, but the knife situation left a lot to be desired. At least one sharp knife would improve your kitchen. We had a terrific stay in Chile visiting many sites, so we didn't spend a lot of time in the place. Bottom line? This place was a sufficient place to stay. We loved our time there!

We only had a few days in Santiago.  The apartment is in a great location near parks, stores and restaurants.  We had a car so getting around was easy for us.   It is a perfect place to base camp your adventures in Santiago.

Sara Cecilia was such a kind host, she let me check in really early, she took me for breakfast and showed me the neighbourhood. It’s a great central location with lots of restaurants, cafés and bars nearby. There is a pool on the roof with amazing sunset views. I was also able to check out late. It’s a very comfortable place to stay.
The place was perfect! Sebastian was very helpful with our luggages and he answered our questions very fast! The appartment was clean, peaceful and near center city! Thanks again!
Lovely clean and light apartment with access to all as described. Hosts very attentive helpful and quick to respond!

Pricila's English is perfect.
Location is very onvenient to city centre and easily accessible from the airport - bus to Los Heroes and walk about 4 blocks to the south from La Moneda.

Claudia’s place was great... and so was Claudia! Extremely accommodating, the building and neighborhood are lovely and the apartment is just what you need to enjoy your stay in the Providencia neighborhood. The apartment is also within walking distance of anything you need; coffee shops, restaurants, transportation, sites, etc. The balcony at the apartment is perfect for sipping some wine as the sun sets or enjoying your morning coffee. Would highly recommend.
a great place to stay, quiet, well located, comfortable and with a beautiful terrace to enjoy. definitely an excellent choice to stay in Santiago !

This apartment was beautiful and full of art - it was such a nice place to stay in during our time in Santiago. location is great and bedrooms were comfortable. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

This small apartment is in a good location in Las Condes, near metro and lider. The place was very clean and well organized. The only thing that could be better is the kitchen. There's just a toaster, microwave, and mini fridge. Overall a good place to stay!

A very either newly built or newly remodeled two bedroom apartment in a high-rise right in the heart of downtown Santiago. Walking distance to all museums and historic attractions as well as restaurants and stores.

This property has a number of things going for it, namely the view, location and ease of check-in. It is a good place for a couple to base themselves in for a few days while in Santiago. Unfortunately while we were there, the WiFi was not working as they were in the midst of changing providers, which was a shame not to have known in advance. Similarly, the washing machine and dryer are located in a separate floor in the building and cost to use. Not a big deal, but again would have been good to know in advance, or more importantly, described in the listing.

A great place to stay in Santiago. The best equipped and functional kitchen we have had in our travels. The washing machine in the apartment was very handy but no powder supplied. Nice sunsets from the balcony. We used the pool in the mornings and only saw one other person. Quiet, non touristy neighbourhood with a view of San Cristóbal.
The appartment is nice, spacious and clean. It was a bit noisy and warm but that was to be expected. The location is good, metro and restaurants easy accesible. I would recommend this place.

The place was in a great location! Osvaldo was super quick to respond when we were having issues with the WIFI and the air conditioner. The space itself had everything we needed for our stay in Santiago. It was very loud at night with the nearby clubs till about 2 AM.

Steps from a beautiful park in the very stylish and completely safe area of Las Condes. Walk to restaurants, shopping and grocery stores. The location is wonderful. Easy access to well appointed apartment. Graziela was a responsive and thoughtful host. Great experience!

A perfect location for the area of Lastarria! Walking distance to many fun places and a charming neighborhood to explore. The apartment is comfortable and felt perfect for the 4 of us. We were there in the summer so it was warm and we did use the fans that are made available. Check in and checkout is super easy and the apartment front desk staff were friendly. I look forward to a return visit!

Exceptional in every way. Whether it is your first or tenth trip to Santiago this is the perfect place. Beautiful, peaceful apartment. Wonderful location. Comfortable & thoughtfully  designed, stocked and maintained. We stayed for 6 weeks and it was a real pleasure! Thank you so much Camilo!!
Super place, sparkling clean, comfortable with every amenity you could think of.  Quiet neighborhood near restaurants and grocery store.  Highly recommended.
We loved this apartment, it was in a great location and the space was cosy and clean. Having the pool on the roof was also nice to cool down in after a hot day in the city.

this is a really pleasant apartment in a cool area - it's right in the city but also a few minutes' walk to Lastarria, which is a really hip bar and restaurant strip. we were really comfortable here. sara's communication is great and checking in is super easy. being the city i did find it pretty noisy when sleeping. i recommend earplugs for that perfect slumber.
Incredible place! Amazing value for all it has to offer. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

The apartment is as described in the listing, and is in a great location in Santiago. Easy walking distance of all major sites in the city. Located one block over from Patio Bellavista, a courtyard with a number of restaurants and shops. It's a very nice & secure gated building, with concierge.  Although we had a short visit, this was a nice apartment and we would stay here again.
Super host, recommend all the people who will stay at santiago and if have next time, for sure I still will choose Camilo’s apartment.

The apartment is clean, tastefully decorated and comfortable in a well secured building. The bed was very comfortable and there is a walk in closet with plenty of hangars and shelves.
The balcony looks onto a green courtyard patio. The kitchen has nice cooking equipment and utensils. The refrigerator is full sized. The dishes are an in-tact set and attractive.
The building is in a vibrant neighborhood with many markets, cafes, restaurants, street vendors, and musicians. There are two metro stations within a short walk.
We stayed in this apartment in middle of Summer and air conditioning was not needed.
It was a great value.

Highly recommendable. The location is the best, you have everything nearby. The room has everything you need including a perfect view to Santiago. Angelo and Evelyn are the best persons you could find in Santiago. Angelo is lovely and Evelyn is so funny. You will have a great time in Santiago. I enjoyed every second.

The apartment was super nice, well decorated and fitted with all needed amenities.
The location was also very convenient, right next to Cerro San Lucia, Bellas Artes and all its restaurants, and walkable distance to most of the city’s sights.
Also loved little extras like the Nuki app used to open the door. Would highly recommend this place!
Highly recommend this gorgeous house to anyone coming to Santiago. The interior decor is incredible, especially appealing to the artistic minds. Such a perfect place to stay!
Nice stay, the apartment was stylish and clean, a tad smaller than expected but we had a great stay

Juan as always is a great host. We've been previously in one of his other aparments, and this time around was just as great an experience. I trully recommend this luxurious place. Can't beat the space, confort and amazing views of Las Condes and Santiago.
Polins place was very nice. As you would expect. What I really enjoyed was the hospitality and the location of the apartment was right next to all the bars and nightlife.
Sara Cecilia was awesome and so was her place. Great walkable location. Sara was very quick to answer any question I had. Would definitely recommend.

Awesome modern building in the heart of the city. Complete amenities just bring your personal stuff. Pool on penthouse with great views. Walking distance to La Moneda Palace to Cerro Santa Lucia to Plaza de Armas and Barrio Lastarria which was fantastic. Doorman with gated community for increased security. Being in the center of Santiago there is a lot of graffiti and party music on the weekend but the people are so nice and helpful; I felt safe.
Cristian’s apartment is great! In a wonderful location and has an awesome balcony that we were able to spend some time on in the morning before we left. I would recommend it to anybody!
Beautiful flat with tech amenities that give it a special touch! Loved the balcony and the view. Amazing bed as well!

Amazing location. Close to metro station( Estacion Universidad Catholica) about 2min away. Walking distance to lots of attractions. Many restaurants just downstairs so safe to stay out at night. Fantastic wine bar and ice cream shop just metres away and great healthy breakfasts available at La Fourneil nearby.
Having two bathrooms was great also.

Modern and stylish space in the center of Santiago! The apartment is really close to the Santa Ana subway station, as well as walking distance to many major sights!
There is a massive construction next to the apartment building, and work begins promptly at 8am. The noise level is high, so it’s not ideal if you sleep late, or want to spend a lot of time lounging around the space.
Upon arrival to the building, check with front gate security first. They have your details from the host and will happily let you in!
Overall, a good short stay in Santiago!
