Nice apartment, very good location, comfortable bed and huge TV. We enjoyed the apartment as base to explore the neighborhood and it was perfect for this. We didn't get to meet Felipe or Oliver but the check-in was still super smooth.

This is a comfortable spacious spot, beautifully decorated and well-located. It was cool despite not having any air conditioner in the middle of a heat wave. The street is quiet and the neighbourhood is safe. Spotlessly cleaned. The owner responds quickly and check-in and -out were well-organized.

The location of the listing is super good, very close to the attractions, Bernabe is very good, the local life advice is always endless patient answers, and I have experienced Chile's South American style attractions (such as Valpara) at very favorable prices. As the first time for Asians to come to South America, I highly recommend it to Asian partners and look forward to seeing you next time.

I had a wonderful stay at Marisol’s apartment. The room is very cozy and has a private garden. The area is safe and quiet, 5 min walk to the metro, and 30 to the center. And above all Marisol is an outstanding host!

Fantastic apartment - clean, bright, spacious, super modern, perfect (and very central) location. I can’t imagine staying anywhere else in Santiago!
The communication with the host was great as well! No complaints from me, just a wholehearted recommendation!
Caro's place is great. The house is amazing. The best place you can find around the area. She is super friendly and helpful also. I recommend.
Polin is very sympathetic host who is always ready to help the guest. Although the room was not so easy to find, it was cozy. IMHO it would be desirable to have more lighting there.
It is in a nice neighbourhood, but it is a party area and there are construction works in front of the house, so it is very loud, also at night.

Philip's place is outstanding, with great level of comfort, luxury and security allows for an amazing time in a great city. Philip is a great host and will make sure you are all sorted while at his place. 100% recommended!

The location is great and the building amenities are amazing. The views of the rooftop pool are stunning. Fernando was very responsive and helpful. However the apartment needs a little improvement. Some newer sheets and towels would be nice. However, his prices were cheaper than others in the building so it still was of great value.

Camilo was a great host during our stay in Santiago (two couples, long weekend in February 2019). The place was clean, stylish, and spacious. The private terrace was a great spot for late afternoon wine and cheese, and the location was in a beautiful neighbourhood on a quiet street. Highly recommended!
Great apartment in a great location.  If you need parking, be sure to arrange in advance.  We didn’t use the subway because we enjoyed walking to museums and restaurants.

Priscilla was super friendly and helpful :) The place is a bit small, but very clean and safe with a doorman in the building. I would stay here again for the water pressure & heat of the shower alone. Close enough to shops, restaurants & points of interest to be convenient while still being on a relatively quiet street (I briefly woke up in the middle of the night and was shocked to hear no sound coming in our open window 👌) Overall a great value, perfect for a night or two.
Great location, great checkin, everything you need in Santiago! Close to the metro, sights in the center, restaurants and bars, and a supermarket.

The location is great with lots of bars and restaurants close by, tourist attractions and markets within walking distance as well. The property itself was very clean, comfy bed and good hot water too!

A great space. It was nice to have the small outdoor space for coffee in the mornings. While the apartment overall was very comfortable I consider the beds the most important part and they were very comfortable!

This is an excellent location - close to public transportation, restaurants, bars and shopping.  It can be a little noisy at night with night life if you are an early to bed type - but no problem for us!!

my plans were changed at the last minute and although I didn't end up staying there, these guys were gracious in communicating while through my last minute changes! I wish them much good in the future and hope to get to stay another time.
Felipe’s place is in a good location and has great view. Felipe communicates well and was very helpful.

Jean and his mother offered exceptional hospitality during our stay in the university district. We arrived a little early and they were very accommodating. The front door staff was also especially nice and welcoming.

Very happy with everything, it was my very first time using AirBnB and it decidedly surpassed expectations. Chocolates and a cool bottle of water in the fridge in the summer upon my arrival was genuinely nice and unexpected touch. On top of that, Paola has  extremely friendly and welcoming communication manner that makes it all much easier and enjoyable. So yep, 5 stars. Muchas gracias Pao!
The apartment was excellent. Clean, accurate and had nice touches. Would definitely come back if in the same city.

if you're intent to stay in this place you can expect a nice apartment (clean and cool), nice complex (you can have breakfast and lunch for a nice price besides de pool and the view), nice neighborhood (great convenience stores around and bars), nice host (will give you all the attention you need) and a WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE!! I hope everyone can visit this place, really worth it!
Very conveniently and centrally located. Victoria was very helpful with helping us check in and making sure we were settled in!

Camilo is a great host! He was very communicative while planning our trip and even while we were staying at his apartment. We loved the apartment - super clean, in a great location, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed. A must stay when traveling to Santiago.
Great place located in a hip neighborhood, close to restaurants and bars.  Mario always responsive. Recommended!
The apartment is great, highly recommended. We didn’t met Paola, nevertheless she was very preoccupied that everything was going well. Thank you very much!

Great place to stay in Santiago. Centrally located and 24hr concierge service. Friendly neighbors. The place had everything you need and host was very responsive. As I write this review, there's a lot of construction  going on in downtown Santiago so the noise level can be a bit of an issue.

It's a very nice and clean place.  Close to amenities, shops and public transport.  Marcela, the hostess is lovely and very attentive to your needs.  I recommend her any time.  For sure when we go back to Chile, we'll stay at her place again.
Very recommendable place to stay in Santiago. Antonio is really helpful - thank you again! Its very clean and offers you a lot. You can walk through the great streets and street art of Santiago.
Appartments are fantastic in a quite hipster district. The interior is amazing and very authentic and Osvaldo is very nice host.

Very lovely owner and a very lovely apartment in a calm and nice neighborhood.
Francisco has been very spontaneous and helpful. We were more than happy to discover this beautiful apartment. It is spacious and nicely equipped. There is o dishwasher, but a cleaning lady comes on a daily basis to clean up and also wash the dishes if you were in a hurry and couldn’t get everything done.
The neighborhood is great. There is a lot of green and a few nice parks and cafes around. We stayed with 2 little kids and we have been walking to Barrio Italia, Lastarria, Bellavista etc without using a car etc. (Of course we used a stroller for the kids). We will definitely come back the next time

A comfortable, clean apartment in a great part of Santiago. Right across the street from the park and close to most everything you’d want to see for a quick stay in Santiago. Gonzalo was very helpful in making our check in and check out experience smooth.

This is such a great place — nice, cozy, clean and well located. Really good value for money.
Highly recommended for foreigners and locals alike!
As usual, Juan is an excellent host. The place is great, very comfortable with a fantastic location. Will be coming back soon!

I can not say enough good things about Carlos and his place. He is above and beyond as a host... The view has to be superior to anywhere else in Santiago.  I have been here on two other occasions and this is not to be compared with either place.  It is spotless, well appointed and located perfectly. Carlos is attentive to every single detail... Do not miss out on this place. We were here a full two weeks and all was PERECT...... pam and russ

Amazing loft in a great neighborhood. The walkability is wonderful with easy access to Bellavista, Barrio Italia and more. The only downside is that it can be a little loud at night from nearby clubs. Best for solo and couples.
I had a good stay at Claudia´s place. The location is great with many famous landmarks at walking distance, and the apartment was clean and overall very convenient.

The apartment of Francisco is great! It is  located very close to hip districts like Bellas Artes and Lastarria. Especially the view from the Apartment is very impressive. All in all, I was more than happy with Francisco and his great apartment!
Cristain’s place was centrally located near so many great places to visit in Santiago. He was a great communicator and had a stylish, modern apartment. We would highly recommend this place!

Easy check in. Hosts that reply very quickly and give good service . It's a very small, basic but cozy place in a great location. Perfect for sightseeing, eating out and enjoying the city. Everything you need is just around the corner. Def. value for money. Would stay here again.

The apartment is great, very good location, walking distance from main metro line. Very clean and organised, they provided everything we needed. Great hosts, very helpful. Smooth check in and check out. Would highly recommend and hope to be back soon.

The location is fantastic, and check in/out was very smooth. The apartment is clean and plenty of room for two people. The AC is not super strong so it got a little warm sometimes but with the windows open it helped a lot! Overall fantastic stay.

Lovely apartment, perfectly located to make the most of a visit to Santiago. Shops, supermarkets, bars and restaurants all nearby and opposite the fantastic Parque Forestal. Check-in was really easy with the great instructions we were given in advance - we loved our few days there and only wish we had more time!
great location next to the park and only a few blocks from plaza de armas, fast wifi.  would stay again

We absolutely loved this apartment! Providencia is an amazing neighborhood for anyone who wants a good access point for walking the city. It’s close to the city center, but gives a respite from the more touristy areas. Dr. Torres Boonen is an especially picturesque little street with a local vibe. The apartment is beautiful (we especially loved the terrace in the morning and evening), and Camilo is a very responsive and accommodating host. There are lots of nearby bars and restaurants on Av. Italia and Av. Manuel Montt, and Camilo has plenty of suggestions for good food and drink. Thank you again, Camilo, for a wonderful introduction to Santiago! We loved every second of it!
The check in was smooth, although I did not meet the guests. Flat is clean and close to both  La Veja market and Bellavista.

Osvaldo’s place is just as described and the location can’t be beat. In the heart of Bellavista and steps away from San Christobal Hill, it’s the perfect spot for a stay in Santiago. Sunset on the rooftop (pool and gym included!) were lovely, and there was a bottle of local wine waiting for me in the loft. Thank you Osvaldo!

The apartment is in a great location - easy walking distance to museums, restaurants, bars and the metro. It is a lovely space, looks just like the photos and is a good size for two people. The washing machine was a big plus for us!

Our host Mirza was quick at responding and provided detailed information to make the stay easier. The apartment was nicely decorated and in very good order. It was in a great location for metro and sights.
Good spot in the center of Santiago, I really enjoyed the little oasis terrace in the mornings and the evenings. Moises was really helpful.

Absolutely perfect spot for our family of 4. Everything you need and decorating spectacular- adored with artwork by his father - every detail is so current and could be in a design magazine. Camilo was so attentive to our needs, requests, questions with quick responses and wonderful recommendations!

It has been a pleasure to stay in this amazing, little appartment. Not only because it is so cosy and clean, but also because of the friendly owners Karen and Carlos. I felt at home straight away. The bed is really comfortable, there is a Netflix connection in the television and safety is guaranteed thanks to the reception downstairs.
There is no noise whatsoever from neighbours, though you can hear the cars of the avenue closeby (which is almost inevitable in Santiago).
Would definitely stay here again when coming back to Chile :)

Mirza's place is a sparking clean place very well located very close the Metro station.
Mirza's apartment is full of small details and has all necessary stuff for having a pleasant stay in Santiago. I highly recommend it.
Me and my colleague stayed in this Apartment during 3 weeks. We really enjoyed our staying here! The flat is beautiful and it has everything we need!
The place was great, super clean, and also felt really safe with the 24 hour security. It was a little hot inside, but opening the windows or turning on the fan helped alleviate the heat.

Anita and her husband are angels. The husband picked me up from airport and it was cheaper then Uber. Anita prepared for me a lovely breakfast and I could enjoy it in the balcony. And they adviced me a super cool free guided tour through the city which was the highlight of my trip. And even a place to dance salsa etc.
Really lovely family!!
Mercedes is very prompt and accommodating. We stayed with her twice and the whole process was very smooth. The area is very close and convenient to explore Santiago. Mercedes is a great host!

Cristian’s place is AMAZING!! You absolutely have to stay here if you come to Santiago. Why?
1. It’s in a perfect location. Close to everything you’d probably want access to especially if you’re a tourist like me.
2. The apartment is just awesome. Super modern. Clean. Well stocked with everything you need. Has a nice patio too. Pictures represent the place well but it looks even better in person.
3. Cristian is an awesome host. He’s super responsive and while I didn’t have any real issues while I was there it was nice to see how quickly he would respond when I had a question or two, or was just letting him know I was checking in/ checking out.
DO NOT MISS OUT IF THIS PLACE IS AVAILABLE FOR YOUR DATES!!!! Five stars all around.

We had a great 5 night stay in this apartment and would definitely stay again. It is quite small, perfect for one or two people. The hosts have stocked it with all the little things you might want and the location is excellent. Check in was easy and thorough. Highly recommended!

Camilo’s apartment was exactly as described both by words and photos on Air BnB and by other reviewers. Easy walking distance to the Metro (card supplied), supermarket and eating places. Not in the centre of the city which was my preference. A quiet, safe neighbourhood. Thank you.
Lovely space! Easy check in. Very fast responses. We really enjoyed staying at Francisco's house. Muchas gracias!!
This location can't be beat! Kat was amazingly responsive and accommodating. Wonderful hosts, I would recommend this place to anyone.

The place is convenient if you don’t have much time between 2 flights. Coming from the airport would cost you about 10$ one way. Lily can organise a taxi. The place is clean !
Lily is a very friendly host and speaks perfectly English.
Would do it again!

We had a wonderful time at Antonios. The apartment is in a great location. It is spacious and quiet.
Antonio is a super host. Nothing is too much trouble.

This is an excellent apartment (and building), located in an active Santiago neighborhood. Cafes, markets and the subway are all in close proximity. We loved our 3 day stay here and Claudia was very accessible and made our stay a breeze!
Excellent apartment. Great location near Parque Araucano, clean space, brand new building. Easy check in at front desk.

Felipe was a wonderful host! He met us early to help us with our luggage and helped us when we had a flat tire by coming to meet us and recommending a place to repair it for a good price.
The apartment was as advertised! Clean and nice with 2 bedrooms and bathrooms! Location was great. Very close to the metro and walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go. Plus the view from the balcony was wonderful and Felipe left useful tips and instructions behind. Loved our visit!

Great location and nice simple studio. The sliding doors to the balcony didn’t lock and someone could have climbed onto the balcony from the adjoining apartment or from the roof the balcony looked out on—I felt ok when I was home but it didn’t feel good to leave valuables. But, the apartment had everything else we needed and check-in was super easy :)

It has real airbnb spiritual. I love Carlos family so so so much! The room was nice and the bed was comfy, the kitchen was so nice to cook. We were so relaxed and have our private space a lot, I sincerely felt like free at home. Everyday Carlos would make sure we were all fine, he really care about the guests. He dropped me off at airport like my Dad. Of course I paid him some for gas. The house is 30mins walk distance from center, but in its good price, we didn't mind to walk. They are always welcome us, we had good time. Super recommended it to people would like to know local life. Thank you Carlos :D

If you're looking at Paolo's place, stop looking and book it now. Clean, very comfortable, and the view is truly exceptional! We made many meals in the apartment and loved eating on the terrace...but learn how to make pisco sours (easy!) and go up to the rooftop terrace each evening at sunset for the most stunning views of the city! The apartment is close to everything, and truly felt like home. Highly highly recommend, and Paola does an exceptional job as hostess! Will be back for sure!

This condo is in a great location and is very comfortable for a group of 3 people.   Diego was a great host and readily available to answer any questions. The condo has great amenities and is very secure - great concierge. Would highly recommend this condo.

Nicely located in the "old downtown", near many of the city sites. The apartment itself, although slightly aged relative to its photos (to be expected) feels nicely laid out and spacious. The host and building concierge are nice and responsive.
Light sleepers should note that the bedroom windows struggle to insulate the apartment from outside noises. Additionally, if you are new to the city (as was I) note that Santiago has two city centers, with the more modern one being in Las Condes. Each area has its advantages and are connected by a good subway system.
Bottom line: If you're looking to stay in the old / authentic part of Santiago, this is a very good listing.
This a great, cozy apartment with a perfect location! I loved staying here and would definitely come back! Thank you for hosting me!

Anita Maria and Abraham are lovely, welcoming and open minded people. I greatly enjoyed my stay with them. The place is nice, clean and very cosy. Comfortable bed and all the necessary stuff like towels provided, even breakfast which was beyond my expectation! Great location and well connected to the rest of the city. Both provided me with useful tips and tricks for Santiago and surroundings. They also offered transport from and to the airport for a good price. I warmly recommend to stay with them! Thank you Anita Maria and Abraham for your hospitality and for taking such a good care of me. I loved staying with you!

Lyli is a very warm, friendly host & has a very pretty house that is right near the airport. I am a dog lover, but she has 5 dogs who do bark loudly and climb all over you. They are very friendly, but if you aren't a super dog lover, maybe this isn't for you.
The house is a little farther from the Metro than I thought but a 10 min Uber ride is easily available. And a collectiva if you feel like waiting.
But Lyli speaks excellent English, a bonus for sure.

Beautiful place and very friendly and helpful host. Apartment is super clean and light, amazing view!!! Great location, best area in Santiago, there're a lot of good restaurants around. Staying there was such a pleasure! Highly recommended!

Rodolfo and Claudia are thoughtful, friendly and reliable hosts, and this reflects also in the accommodations they offer - clean, well equipped with kitchen basics, hot water with good pressure, and a nice collection of books, magazines, and a couple of up-to-date travel guides. The location was awesome. On weeknights there is a bit of loud traffic, but it's easy to ignore. I have a favourite apartment in Stgo now :)

A wonderful place to stay in Santiago as a family. Clean and very cute apartment. The building was also very clean and front doormen were very nice and helpful.  Kids loved the rooftop pool and the views were breathtaking of the entire city. It was very walkable area, close to interesting sites, though at night a bit deserted as the shops close but the upside it was quiet and fine with our family as we were usually home by dark. Felt very safe.

Great location, in a modern building, with sunset views and a pleasant balcony. The noise from the constructions accross the street can be a problem if you plan to sleep late, but otherwise the flat is exactly as advertised and I had a great time at Kat and Piero's place!
My stay at Osvaldos place was exactly as I had hoped. The space was clean, stylish and couldn’t have been a more perfect location. Easy walk to everything, including amazing hike with a view!
Highly recommend this, the host and her father care very much to make your stay pleasant and check in to be sure you have what you need.
The apartment is comfortable and in a great location. Hassle free check-in and loved the area.
Great place - very well located, very clean, great view and amenities! Marcela was very communicative and let us know all the details of our stay in time, great experience!
The apartment is located quite central in Providencia and in a safe area. It's equipped with everything one might need and Luis was easy to reach and talk to if any assistance was needed.

I had a fantastic stay, and the place was very nice, clean, and organized. Also, the hosts are very accommodating and communicative. The views from the apartment and location were perfect. The condo is close to shops and the metro. I highly recommend staying here, and I would book here again.
Great place to stay. Clean, stylish and comfortable. Barbara was available all the time for any questions we may have
Great room very clean able to drop bags off early there's a doorman very safe area and easy access to metro. Host responded to all questions promptly.  Would stay again
Grazielas is a great host and very prompt and helpful with any queries. Really nice place and fantastic location.

Excellent location for getting around Santiago in short order. The apartment has everything one could want. Very clean and tidy, and great attentiveness given from the host. I would highly recommend this location, and plan on utilizing it on any future visits to Santiago. Gracías Martín!

Mercedes’ apartment was exactly as described and fitted us perfectly for our three day stay in Santiago. The bed is super comfy and big, and the shower really good and hot, we also enjoyed the sofa a lot! Mercedes has everything ready for you: tea and coffee as well as shampoo, soap and really nice towels.
The apartment is close to the center of Santiago so it was convenient to visit the sights. To nice and bohemian areas such as Bellavista you can also walk from there.
There is a road (fortunately not to the apartment side of the building) which can be a bit noisy in the morning. In the evenings the area around the apartment is a bit dark but we managed fine by getting back there by Uber or taxi.
Great cozy apartment. Fantastic location handy to public transport and within walking distance of many cafes and restaurants. Highly recommended!

Patrick was an excellent host. He personally checked us in and gave us some very good information about the area. His place had all the amenities we required and then some - a very well equipped kitchen that included a washing machine. We particularly liked the covered outdoor space and the secure private parking. Patrick's house is in a very nice part of Santiago and is located close to parks, running trails and the Metro.

Hector went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  His home is trendy and comfortable and in a great location. The area has many nightclubs but the noise did not bother us as the property is slightly off the main road. Hector kindly gave us a portable WiFi device for the duration of our stay which was really useful. We would recommend staying with Hector.

Carlos and Cecilia and their son Vicente are great people. We stayed 2 days in this place and they offered us breakfast, tea and even lunch together. They brought us to the airport shuttle for free! We’ve felt like at home. So, choose them, if you’re searching a cozy and clean place in Santiago. :)
Great location in a stylish neighborhood, close to subway stops and plenty of restaurant choices.  The view of the Andes can't be beat!
A very stylish and central location in Santiago. Extremely clean and a good amount of space for a couple. Technology was cool to have- Alexa and smart TV. Would recommend!

We enjoyed our time at Felipe & Oliver's place. It was great for our 18-day stay. My husband and I "work from home" and it was good to have high-speed internet. Having a  washer was really convenient! Saved us trips to the laundromat. The apartment does not have air-conditioning, but it only got warm a few hours during the day (you'll probably be out exploring anyway during these hours). For a longer stay like we had, it would be nice to have an extra set of sheets and towels so we didn't have to wait for it to dry all the time. Also, please replace your knife or add a knife sharpener! ;) Overall, a nice place to stay. Thanks Felipe and Oliver.

I had a great time in Santiago.
The apartment is fully furnished and very nicely decorated. There are lots of good restaurants nearby and the metro station is not that far.
The room was super clean and comfortable, so as every rooms in the house ! The kitchen was super tidy and with good equipment. Carlos and his wife are very friendly and easy-going !
Reliable place to stay in as this was the third time we stayed in Marcelo's place during the trip
Gonzalo is a wonderful host. The place is a bit noisy but he has a few properties available so one may find what’s best suited. He is a kind and thoughtful host.

This was a great place for the price. It was clean and well kept. It was a bit loud at night but I always bring ear plugs just in case. The location is amazing, just a few minutes from restaurants and bars and a hub of activity!

Verónica’s house is really good and clean. The kitchen has everything to cook. There is a private small bathroom in my room. Subway station is close and the city center is walkable. 15-20 minutes from plaza de armas. The area is really safe and nice. The only downside is there is no elevator (4floors) Overall, I recommend it!
Great location near some really nice restaurants and bars. Amarillis was very helpful with local tips and the check in process was a breeze

Cristian's place is perfect, great location close to lots of restaurants and the place is great as well. A bit of confusion with our check in (talk to reception when you arrive at the building - don't try the smart lock on the building door, seems obvious now but not after a long day of travelling).
Amazing location and view! Apartment  clean and nicely decorated. TV, hot water, microwave,  oven, refrigerator...
It’s in a central location but the apartment gets very hot and thanks to the AC being vented through the sliding bedroom glass window, it is very noisy at commuter times.

Everything was really great about our stay. It did get loud at night but it’s expected because it’s located right above restaurants and bars. Windows are kind of thin so it may not be a good location for light sleepers.
A little coffee or tea would be greatly appreciated. I was surprised to see there wasn’t any in the cabinets. But communication was quick and easy. Martin really went out of his way to help us get a midnight airport drop off (for a reasonable fee). Greatly appreciated!

Camilo was really great and was very responsive to anything I asked and always had a ton of suggestions. We only spent 2 nights, but we wished we could have stayed longer. The place is tucked away on a quieter street with just walking distance to Barrio Italia district with tons of restaurants and cute little shops. Very clean, very spacious and nice decor. We were even given a metro card to load up for our stay. Would stay here again.

Well...it s already my second home! as usual, Juan is an amazing host, the flat gathers all the qualities you may be looking for, confortable, quite at night and very well located...what else to ask for...?!

Antonio's place is fantastic. It's clean and the amenities are as stated. He was extremely helpful and prompt in his communication with us, allowing us to check in early, etc. But what makes the apartment unbeatable is it's location, a few minutes walk from top sites like Plaza de Armas, Palacio de Moneda, and Central Mercado. It's in the Bella Artes area, where locals from Santiago will tell you to go to dinner. AND...as seen in the photos you will be a stone's throw from Cerro san Cristobal, which is my favorite part of the city. Thanks Antonio!

Loved our stay here. He really thought of everything (even ear plugs for those of us that sleep while the sun is down rather than party all night!) The location was so fun and the apartment had everything we need. We got in super early and the director let us leave our bags in his office while we’re out before check-in. Such a great stay.

Adolfo and Angie were wonderful hosts—gracious and accommodating at check-in and always checking in (messaging) to make sure I was comfortable and having a good time in Santiago.
The space was comfortable and clean. I especially appreciated the private entrance; it felt like my own little slice of Santiago.
Excellent apartment at a great location. Valentina was super communicative and responsive whenever needed. Excellent host.
Comfortable apartment, clean and well located. Rosi met all our demands very quickly and satisfactorily. I strongly recommend.

Nice apartment, easy to find and very quiet area ! We think that cleaning was not done when we arrived and sheets and towels were not changed. We informed Mario and he directly apologised and tried to fix it. Very good communication!

Felipe’s property was very nice. Great view of the city, very close to the metro and to popular neighborhoods with restaurants and shopping. Felipe offered some great suggestions on what to do / where to eat and also furnished the place with lots of guidebooks and maps. It gets a bit warm with the sun shining in the well lit rooms, but  it cools off quickly once the windows are open in the evening. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

The room is very very good, clean and cozy. You have a private bathroom. Also, you can use the kitchen with all the equipment. There you can find all that you want! An owner is an amazing person! Highly recommend!

The place was fantastic.  The location could not be more ideal.  Close to everything.   A little loud at night time, but not crazy.   Would stay there again in a heartbeat.  Nicole is a fantastic host.   Muchos gracias

Had a lovely stay at Osvaldo's place.  The apartment was clean and had every thing one would need.  It is definitely in a lively area, with lots of music and parties.  Osvaldo's communication was great and he was super helpful.  Check-in and check-out were easy and smooth.  The laundry facility in the building is a nice added benefit, though it requires 12-100 peso coins for each load.  The Bellavista neighborhood has a lot of restaurants and bars, and is about a 20-30 walk to downtown.
The apartment is perfect for two and quite stylish and comfortable. You do hear quite a bit of noise from outside (location is very central), so bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper.

Our stay at María Fernanda's place was great! The kitchen is well equipped, the place is clean, the bed is super comfortable and the location is perfect, with easy access to the subway. Even though the building's amenities weren't available (the spa wasn't working and the gym only had two 1kg weights - which frustrated my boyfriend a bit), we had a great relaxing time. The apartment itself is pretty safe, however there's not a lot of control regarding who walks in and out of the building (we had safety alerts by some of the neighbors a couple of times). We also couldn't find a cork screw in the kitchen... We had bought a good Chilean wine to drink later at night and weren't able to because stores around were already closed :( Besides that, this place is a perfect vacation stay for a couple or a single person in Santiago! We would recommend it!

Cristian’s apartment is a very cozy modern apartment in the heart of Santiago. Near good restaurants at Bellavista and touristic spots downtown. Strongly recommended! Also, Cristian was very attentive to us making it a very good time in Santiago.

A sunny, light-filled and stylish apartment on a quiet, leafy street. Contains all the amenities you could need. Every detail has been considered. The pictures just do this apartment justice!
Camilo is also an amazing host - replying promptly to all queries and providing local tips.
Highly recommend this air bnb!!
Location is Central to Santiago.  The apartment is beautiful!  All the amenities are available and the doormen were very nice and helpful.
Bernabe’s apartment is a nice place, good location, it can be a perfect experience for short stay!
Victoria's apartment is just what you would expect in central  Santiago,  it is a little compact but the location is great for getting around and was surprisingly quiet at night. A good weekend stay.

The hight of this apartment should be proportional to view
However there is building in front of it that is more about hiding from neighbors seeing you naked
The place is perfect for travelers but can be a little intense city wise, not clam but on the rush for office people. The personnel in the building is nice and smile. All chilenos are great.

The place is ideally located, near the subway, near many grocery stores, restaurants, and very close to "el pueblito de los artesanos" in Los Dominicos. My kids enjoyed walking to el pueblito pretty much every morning, there is a nice playground at the entrance, and some animals to watch, so it provides for easy distraction for kids. The apartement is nice, has enough space, lots of storage space if you come with big bags, and is very functional. I highly recommend it!

Fernando’s place was a perfect base for my trip to Santiago. It is on the top floor with exceptional views and is great value for the location. It is very close to the metro red line which makes it incredibly easy to get around the city.
Great apartment. Very good location.  Internet is very fast in case you need to do work. Interior is stylish with modern appliances. Better than others apartments we saw in Santiago.

We only stayed here one night. I think it’s a great location if you’re looking to go out as it’s right in bellavista. Very secure but we had a little trouble unlocking the second gate to go up the stairs to the apartment. It is clean and very nice for the price.

I only spent one night at Victoria’s loft but it was just as expected! The flat is just like the photos, very clean and with a great location, just a few minutes walking to Plaza de Armas. I totally recommend it!
Amazing place! You have good opportunity to know a lot about culture and history of Chile from lovely owners of this place. Highly recommend!

We stayed in this place before, and we liked it so much that we came back to stay again. It is a very stylish nice small apartment, with all necessary amenities inclusive a fully equipped kitchen. It is in the middle of the neighborhood with all bars and restaurants (30 seconds walking). Still, it is on a very quiet dead-end street.

I stayed 3 nights for a business trip in Sara's flat. She is a great and helpful host and very reactive to answer.
The flat is very cute, very bright and good value for money.The wifi works very well and Sara left an adaptor and a metro card that you can top up if you want to take the metro. There is a Concierge Desk at the entrance of the building which makes it very safe and secured (as I was a foreign woman travelling alone for work).It is located in the Centro of Santiago and the area is safe and convenient. You can walk around easily and you will find in the street ATM's, a exchange desk, Starbucks, mini-markets, a bakery for example. As a tip to take a taxi, I used Cabify (EasyTaxi App) when I wanted to take a taxi to go around and it works well.
Enjoy your stay!
This apartment was cute, small, and located in the perfect spot in Santiago. The host was really good at communicating. Definitely a good spot for the short period of time we were there.

Stylish apartment in a great area. Everything was excellent except that the music from the nightclubs was extremely loud. Friday night we only slept 2 hours as it sounded like the bass was inside our room. Perfect if you will be out drinking and partying, if you are a light sleeper or you want a quiet space, it might be a bit tricky. We loved the building (beautiful rooftop pool), the gym was ok (nice to have one). Great area and Osvaldo was an excellent host. There are nice touches like Netflix and a bottle of wine and fruit in the apartment. I would highly recommend it if it wasn’t for the noise. FYI it’s much worse Friday & Saturday nights. We managed with ear plugs the other nights.
Perfect apartment in perfect location , couldn’t ask for anything better . Amazing restaurant downstairs and very nice host and Jamie other host was amazing ! See you again soon .
The room was well equiped inside. Also, it is located near the supermarket, mercado central, metro and bus station so convenient.  Felipe was always helpful and responsible.

More than we were expecting, very nice place, clean make you feel like home. it's very near all the good places and hope to stay again.
Thanks, Javie r

Excellent location. The streets of Providencia are safe to walk even during the night. The surroundings have markets, restaurants, metro station, currency exchange houses and is close to great parks and sky costanera center. The condo is great, has a 24/7 doorman, so there is no concern to get the keys.
The place is cozy, clean and organized.
I would definitely recommend it as an excellent place to stay.

lovely place, clean and stylish w a super confortable bed, located just few steps from Plaza de Arma in the storic center. The host was fast in response. I highly recommend this place for a short and long stay. will go back in the future!
Great spot - and EXCELLENT value. Clean, stylish, easy arrival and Mirza will help you with anything you need.

The apartment is in a great location, many bars and restaurants around, save neighborhood, I definitely recommend it. Marcelo is an easy host, communication is quick  absolutely nothing to complain about.

Carlos' home is lovely and in a nice neighbourhood easily accessible via public bus and taxi. The beds were comfortable and the bathroom and kitchen had all the amenities you could hope for. We would definitely stay again.

The apartment is in a central location close to many restaurants and shops. It had a gym and laundry facilities on the main floor. There was some construction beside the building which was a bit loud during the day but overall it was a nice apartment and Patricia was great to deal with.

This apartment is in a safe area, walking distance to everything. Antonio is great with commutation and fast to reply.
The apartment is a perfect size for two couples. It also had great wifi so we watched Netflix at night which was nice.
Super clean and well presented.

Great apartment and environment in the heart of Santiago.
My family and I stayed at this location and had a great time. The key factor was the location of the apartment as it was relatively easy to access the subway and the historical sites in Santiago by walking.
If you are in Santiago for a weekend or a month, this is a great apartment for one or two people.
Easy to feel at home at this lovely room. Very warm reception and great and warm hosts during stay. Definitely recommend this room. Great location as well!

This is a wonderful apartment in a great location for exploring the city. Easy check in and everything you need for a city break. Excellent communication from host. Very easy to walk to all the cool and quirky streets and shops. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you very much.
Convenient location, sparkling clean, superb hospitality! The view is so amazing and Margarita the dog is very adorable!

I highly recommend staying at Anita’s place! She and her husband made my stay in Santiago: this lovely couple is so hospitable and made me feel at home right away. Although my Spanish is insufficient we could communicate via google translate, and her welcoming and warm appearance said more than 1000 words. Also the location is in this very arty and young neighborhood with a lot of bars and restaurant! Next time I will definitely come back :) thanks

This Airbnb was in a good location, had 24 hour security, is on the 17th floor, and was a great place for my friend and I during our visit to Santiago visit. The unit is very clean, has two great pillows to choose from. Would absolutely stay again. Marcela stopped by the unit at one point to pick something up, but was sure to communicate everything with me. Thanks for the great stay!

Our stay at Felipe’s apartment was amazing!  We absolutely loved the city view and view of the Andes mountains which you can see from the master bedroom and the wrap-around balcony.  Felipe went above and beyond with his communication, offering maid services, and greeting us with a lovely bottle of Chilean wine.  All in all one of our best Airbnb experiences and we would highly recommend Felipe’s apartment for your home away from home while in Santiago! 😊

I had a wonderful stay at Javier's place. The building and neighborhood felt safe, and the check-in and check-out process was easy and straightforward with the doorman. Javier also went out of his way to bring over some coffee and a heater to ensure that I was comfortable. Sparkling clean, excellent communication with the host, and close proximity to both public transportation and amazing bars/restaurants in the area. Incredible balcony view of Santiago and Cerro San Cristobal. Minimal noise from the street or neighbors, which was a big plus too. I highly recommend Javier's apartment!
Really well situated and Hector is really nice and full of recommendations! Quiet, good bed and electric blanket. We even had a portable wifi. We would stay again!

Miguel was great for communication and very helpful. The location is first class being right in the centre of the city.
However the recommended taxi driver did not show up to collect us from the airport even though he had our flight number and arrival time which had been supplied to him by our Spanish guide. We arranged for him to take us back to the airport and he overcharged us by $20000 pesos which we realised just after it was too late.
Great stay, didn't want to leave! Hot shower, coffee for the morning, space heater to turn on if we were cold, safe neighborhood, tv and great hosts! Spacious and inviting, nothing short of perfect.
Christian was a great host. Very accommodating. The apartment was an ideal location for an overnight stay in Santiago. Kitchen and bath are well equipped. Would stay here again.
Everything was just great, we absolutely recommend this place. We stayed with our baby, no issues, only good experience. Thanks for a great hospitality!

We simply loved our stay. The location is great, although close to the metro, as we like to walk, we did a lot on foot. The apartment itself has everything you need, super complete and nice. And the hosts are super friendly and always responded quickly to our questions and requests for help. Super recommend it!

Juan is kind and very helpful if needed at all. I very much appreciate the profesional treatment.
Great place to stay at

Really nice and super central Appartement.
Located within a shopping street which closes at 8pm - the doormen still let you in, but they only speak spanish. So if you dont speak spanish you should be prepared.

Emily and her husband Adolfo are excellent hosts.  They are friendly, kind, and caring. The location of their apartment is quite convenient as it is near different bus routes, metro, and restaurants. I stayed at their apartment for two weeks. I felt quite comfortable and enjoyed the good size bedroom, private bathroom, use of the stove & the fridge. To visit the Baha’i Temple, I walked to the nearby Tottus supermarket and took bus number 516 (red color), direct to the Baha’i Temple. Their friendly and cute dog Margarita is quite a delight. She loves food! I strongly recommend their apartment.

I never wanted to leave this Airbnb and it is one of my favorites out of all the places I've stayed using this platform. A truly charming and well-decorated apartment with all the amenities you'd need for a comfortable stay. The design and layout are so thoughtful and you just can't beat the natural light and warmth of the place as a space for weary travelers. The location is also fantastic with plenty of attractions and shops within walking distance or a short Uber ride.

We loved staying at Alice's and her friends' house! They are very nice! You feel at home! The breakfast very rich! It has a very good location! Very close to the metro! Totally recommended! We are very grateful!

My stay at Maria Fernanda's place has been great!
Always ready to assist, they are both super quick to respond. The place is absolutely comfortable and clean. Great location and great hosts!
Very nice apartment, just as shown in the photos. The host was very communicative and made sure the check-in and check-out process went smoothly. Would highly recommend.
One of best views in providencia! 20th floor. Quiet and very urban. You will not have a better view and you are 15 min from downtown in subway. I loved every minute in my 3 month day. Really.

Eugenia was so friendly at check in and assured us that any of our needs could be granted with a simple message! She is really fast at responding on WhatsApp and made us feel welcome even with a language barrier. Her place is cute and neat and has a heater for cold Santiago nights. Definitely would recommend.
Definitely the best Airbnb in Santiago. Great view and nice decoration. Carlos was so kind to prepare everything for the guests.

Super relaxed being in this place. Hector is an incredible host. We felt like locals living in a real Latin American home. Bed is sooo warm and cozy. Room was quiet. Authentic experience. The best. Will be back.

Camilo is a wonderful host with great spaces and we always enjoy lodging our staff and visitors in his apartment, knowing that he will always fix any problem that arises in a timely and professional manner. Thanks, Camilo.

This apartment is super cozy. We felt like we were at home. The location is fabulous! You are right in the middle of a very trendy neighborhood with everything you need walking distance/minutes away (restaurants, bars, markets). The apartment was well stocked with cooking utensils, towels, blankets, etc... I would definitely stay here again!
Loved Osvaldo's space... the "ethnic" decor was great and created a really nice vibe.  The apartment is super clean and cozy, and in a great location in Bellavista. Recommend!
Very accommodating host! Made extra touches to make sure my stay was excellent! The location is spectacular!!! Great for up to 4 people. Would stay again

Patrick's house is just as described. We found it very well-equipped for our needs, especially the kitchen. The garden/yard was great for our puppy and we were able to enjoy the BBQ. As we stayed for about 7 weeks, Patrick was available to help us with anything we might need around the house and answer questions. We experienced some down weather and he came to make sure the excess of leaves wouldn't give us trouble which we felt was quite thoughtful. The internet connection is very good and so is the location. It's walking distance to the subway and there are bus stops everywhere. There drugstores, cafés and restaurants nearby so it's a great place to stay for a short or long period of time. I have recommended Patrick's house to family and friends.
AmaIng spot, superb location! The place is better than the pictures! We wish we could have stayed longer.

Great stay that's a short walk from the sights and public transit. Felipe & Oliver let us store our luggage early while cleaning was happening with no trouble even though we booked pretty last minute. No complaints!
Great location, great apartment for a couple + 2 people. Close to metro, shops etc. Safe neighbourhood and even greater hostess. Highly recommended!

Accurate description, we had a really nice stay. Just be aware that is a very centric location so be prepared for lots of noise during the day and most of the night. Also that as everything is electric, you can only use once appliance at a time.

Cristian’s flat is very well located, sunny and cosy, everything you need for a great stay
Cristian is very professional, responds quickly, great communication
Tks Cris, cheers!!

Excelent flat, location and first of all - hospitality of the host. When we arrived early in the morning from the 15 hrs flight she let us in. More of all there was a note on the table about everything we need to know about the location around: where to eat, where to shop etc. And home made cake! CAKE! First bite and you imidiately feel like at home.
Flat. It well equiped, new. Everything you need is there.
Plobably this flat and this host is the best what happened to us in Santiago de Chile.
Great location !!! Close to lots of shopping,restaurants, and parks . Kid/family friendly . Host was quick to respond to a question I had . Would recommend this place 100%

Antonio was very kind and helpful.  If we had a problem we felt like we could have contacted him and he would have solved it. The apartment was immaculate. And there were many restaurants and clubs nearby. Highly recommend.

Pretty good location.  Nice king size bed.  Unfortunately, insufficient heater created a very cold apartment.  Not very good hot water pressure, and non-stop intense traffic noise including constant police sirens.  2 or 3 star experience...

Osvaldo’s loft is the perfect place to stay in Santiago. Such a beautiful space and everything at your doorstep, restaurants bars etc. He was a great host and happy to help with any questions, I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

This apartment is in an excellent location near the slopes. It’s perfect for a family or friends and has the necessary amenities to make it a great place to stay. The building has a nice fireplace and a very warm pool for post-ski relaxation.   We stayed in the very early season, so not all restaurants or shops were open, but Carolina gave us great tips to allow us to have a great stay.
The apartment was in a great location and was super clean, organized, and bright! The balcony was awesome to sit out on at night and look out at the city.
Marcella's place is very nice, clean and comfortable. We would stay there again if ever in Santiago!
Xemena was not here but her mom took care of me better than my own, so I hope to meet her because she must be amazing too.
Central and clean place. Hosts were quick to respond to any queries. There is a laundry room in the building which was very convenient and the hosts provided many towels which was an added bonus!

Patrick's place is very accommodating. He was very easygoing with our dog and the yard is great for pups and a BBQ. His house is very well-equipped with anything you might need and Patrick is quick to respond to any messages or concerns. The neighborhood is very pleasant and the house is near many things like small markets, drugstores, cafés, squares and public transportation. As we have moved to Santiago, we are recommending his place to our friends and family who wish to visit us here.

We stayed in the apartment of Felipe and Oliver for our 10 day Santiago holiday. The apartment is cozy and comfortable, and if you feel like a lazy night in,  Netflix on the enormous TV could be just the thing. What we liked best of all though was the location.  At least half of the sights we wanted to see were in walking distance, and we reached the rest from the Metro station which was quite close by. Highly recommended.

The apartment is lovely. The staff in the building were delightful and the apartment was spacious and super clean.  The bedding was very comfortable and it was nice to have such a contemporary kitchen. It was winter so we did not use the terrace but in the spring/summer this could be wonderful.  Highly recommended.

Francisco's apartments are great and the surrounding area is so nice. His hospitality was unbelievable. We arrived at 6:30 in the morning, our apartment was not ready yet and there where no cafes open, so he had us in his home for coffee! It was such a great welcoming to Chile! I can't recommend this place more highly! We hope to have the chance to stay again.
This was a great, small place. Perfect for two people, and within walking distance of bus stops and great restaurants. Claudia was so sweet and welcoming!
Derek’s response was always very quick. His apartment has the best location in El Colorado. The building has many amenities. Great value.

This apartment is perfectly located and has a dream view of Santiago and the Andes. The place was not "sparkling clean" as promised, but more importantly there is no heat except for small electric units, so we would not recommend it in the wintertime.

A great place to stay, with great views.
On-site parking may be a challenge for larger vehicles, such as minivans.

The trip was awesome and the appartment was perfect for it, very close to a bunch of restaurants and with everything we needed to get by. Very clean, well organized, cozy and with a beautiful view of the city.
The host gave quick responses to the little problems we had, being impeccable with the solutions and giving many tips for the city.
I super recommend people to stay there.

A great place to stay in Santiago. Very central, close to shopping and culture. The balcony was a great extra. We appreciated the hospitality. Sebastian was waiting to meet us at check in and let us know everything we needed to know about the apartment and neighborhood. Very comfortable.
Mercedes was a great host, always on hand by message if we needed anything, and she provided plenty of great tips for enjoyment and safety around Santiago.

Sara’s place was very clean. The check in process was super easy! We came at the end of June (winter in Chile) so the place was a little chilly, she has a space heater, so it wasn’t unbearable. The location is central and walkable, felt pretty safe. Overall, the perfect little spot for two. :)

The apartment is located on the border between Santiago Centro and Providencia, metro station near, shops near, Barrio Italia with trendy bars on walking distance. Small but cozy a bit cold in the winter days but it comes with a small heater that helps. The kitchen is fully equipped. The view from the building is amazing and the sunsets are breathtaking. I had a one month stay and I enjoyed it.

This place is very close to a lot of great sights in Santiago. Perfect for first time visitors to the city like us! Check in was super easy, and Emelina and Miguel left us detailed instructions with tips on how to enjoy our stay.
Lovely place!  Great location and communication + check-in was super easy.  The space heater was effective (and necessary given the cold nights).  We would definitely stay again!

Camilo’s apartment is perfectly located for a city escape to Santiago. Camilo is responsive and accommodating to requests! I would highly recommend this Airbnb if you are looking for a relaxed oasis in the city!

The location of the apartment cannot be beat.  It's in the midst of all the cafes and restaurants and close to everything. At the same time, it faces an internal courtyard so it's very quiet. The apartment if very small - a studio but it's very comfortable. One note is that in the winter most of the buildings in Santiago are not heated (the same goes for most of the hotels). The owner provided a portable heater which was good but it projected a strong light.  It didn't bother me but if you are a sensitive sleeper and are traveling in the winter, that's something to consider. Otherwise, the owner was terrific. Brought me extra blanket, gave lots of helpful suggestions.  Excellent throughout.
Great, very inexpensive place, centrally located with a doorman. Bedroom door didn’t shut all the way - May be a deal breaker for some folks
I think this was our favorite place during our trip to Chile! I tried really hard to find something wrong but couldn't. Extremely comfortable and stylish. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at this amazing home. We were a family of five and we felt completely comfortable. The house is very spacious and it is located very close a number of attractions. There is a supermarket within walking distance. The home is kept immaculately clean. The owners live right next-door and were there for any questions or anything that we needed. We would definitely recommend this location.
Great location and host! The apartment has all you need for a comfortable stay in Santiago. Highly recommend it! Thank you!

Great apartment in excellent location. Yolanda was very nice and easy to communicate with. The apartment was perfect for me and my two kids. Security at the building, we always felt safe coming and going. Building also has a rooftop that you can go on for a great view of the city.
The apartment was exactly as described. Great location. It was very easy to communicate with Carolina, and she was quick to resolve any questions.

Good location for sight-seeing in the centro. Kat is quick to respond and worked with us to allow for a later check-out.
Guests should note that new construction has blocked most of the view. A common area washer and dryer is available for use on a different floor for $1200 pesos per load.

I had a lovely stay at Valentina's place in Chile. The apartment was very nice and was furnished with everything you might need on your stay abroad. The location was ideal and within walking distance from universities, several interesting museums and cultural attractions as well as the metro station. Valentina and her father were also very helpful. I would highly recommend this place!

Excellent value for a ski apartment! Derek was immediately responsive to all of our questions. The place is small but has everything you need - the photos don’t do it justice. Also in the communal areas are a nice heated pool, a place to rent skis much cheaper than at the resort, and tables and chairs by a big fireplace. There’s also a dedicated parking space. We had an excellent stay and hope to return again!
Simply superb! Outstanding hospitality, excellent location, comfortable room. The gym was also a bonus. Highly recommended.

This apartment was perfect in all ways. Beautifully decorated and well appointed.  The original artwork in the apartment was exquisite.  Communication with Camilo was fantastic and he helped make an outstanding stay in Santiago.
Lovely apartment with a hot shower and a comfortable bed. Good location for getting around the city. It was easy and quick to get ahold of Felipe and Oliver, they were great hosts.

The apartment is in a great location, close to all the touristy areas, close to the metro and easy to spot from a great distance as the two towers are the tallest buildings in the area. The place was very comfortable and had nice decor. We would definitely stay again next time we’re in Santiago. Great views from the balcony (25th floor) and great to have a washer and dryer.

Mario’s place is well located in a nice central suburb. There is about a 10 minute walk to the metro stations. The WiFi worked well during our stay and the loft was very comfortable. Would absolutely recommend staying here. Cheers Mario!
Camilo’s place is really comfortable, perfect for a family of 4. We had a great stay!

The appartment was just like in the picture. If you want to be close to a lot of restaurants and in the heart of santiago you should book this place. It is clean and spacious and you can walk anywhere in the city easily.

This is my second time staying at this location. Easy access to public transportation and restaurants near by that facilitates ease while in Santiago.
See previous review for more detail.
Well...this is already my second home and is always a nice feeling coming back! Juan s attention to details and politeness always makes this the better place to be in Santiago

Carolina’s apartment is superbly located in a classic building with ski-in ski-out access to El Colorado. It is a cozy and comfortable unit, and we found all as expected given the listing. Carolina is a kind and attentive host, who was always ready to accommodate our requests and showed especial interest on our satisfaction. I highly recommend this unit. The building offers lots of common areas and amenities to spend your time after skiing. The heated pool is specially popular among kids!

While staying at Cristina’s place you can expect all the amenities you have at a Hotel and more for. The apartment is located near Barrio Italia and a 10-15 minutes walk from Patio BellaVista. Great location to visit.

Great location, outstanding apartment with a great view of the sunset. Cristina was super nice and quick with the responses, left me a couple of beers for my arrival which I really appreciated! Great shower with good pressure, well equipped kitchen.. comfortable bed and comfortable place all around
Thanks very much

The location is amazing! You can start riding in less than a minute out of the building. I would give more than 5 stars if I can. The apartment is cozy and equipped minimal but sufficient stuff. The price is very competitive as well. Rodrigo was very helpful whenever we had any questions. I recommend this place if you are planning riding/skiing multiple days in Valle Nevado.

Very close to the old town and sights such as La Moneda and Plaza de Armas and also to the metro. Building has 24 hour security at reception. Patricia always responded promptly to our questions and gave helpful advice.

María Eugenia couldn't be more welcoming. She kept in touch with me throughout my stay (even though I didn't meet her until I was leaving) and demonstrated empathy and concern for my well-being. She is kind and attentive.

This apartment is located in the perfect neighborhood from which to explore Santiago. It was clean pleasant and comfortable. We would definitely come and stay again if we ever get to come back to Montana.

If you're looking for a place to stay in the heart of the nightlife district, this apartment is your spot. Located very centrally close to major parks, restaurants, cultural sites like Pablo Neruda's home, the art museum, Lastarria arts district--so much is within walking distance. We had a great stay. Thank you!

Roberto is a great host, he was very responsive to any issues that came up and was quick to fix them! Apartment is in an awesome location in a quiet neighborhood, very close to several great spots in the city. Also quick access to the metro. Overall nice place.

Kat’s place was immaculate. Tidy and stylish. Check in was super easy, she gave excellent instructions and was very responsive. Our flight was in the evening so after check-out, Kat let us leave our heavy backpacks with the doorman downstairs, which was very much appreciated. Really enjoyed our stay and would recommend to fellow travelers staying in Santiago!!
Cute studio. I think it's the perfect place for a business traveler looking to explore Barrio Italia or hop on the nearby metro station.
Fantastic place in an incredible neighbourhood! Loved it all - extra comfortable bed! Thank you will be back soon

Mediocre experience. Photos are half accurate, in several respects the apartment is significantly less well-preserved that when the pictures were taken. Cleaning was not very good. In particular, the fridge had a strong smell (likely from fish) that affected whatever was stored in it and the apartment in general. Good location, easy access

This apartment is located in the best neighborhood in the city and is very close to many historical sites, museums, restaurants, bars, stores etc. It really is right in the middle of everything!! Nestor and Jessica were very accommodating and friendly, they offered suggestions and always made sure I was comfortable, but they also gave me plenty of privacy. It was the perfect arrangement. I would absolutely stay here again on future trips to Santiago.
Camilo apartment is very beautiful, quite and is a unique art place. We feel like at home, we adore it ! The beds are very very comfortable 👍😊❤️

The listing is just as pictured but there was music blasting downstairs on our side of the complex even on a Sunday night. The music lasted until early mornings so be aware it might be better to book the other side of the complex.

This place is great. In the newest part of Santiago. We had never been to Santiago and are happy we chose this place for its location and the apartment itself. Checking was easy and secure. There is no construction anywhere near the building and the apartment is on the side away from the street, so there is zero world noise coming into the place. All the buildings close that you can see from the apartment have really good and quiet people living in the apartments, so our stay was very tranquil. Santiago itself is a very quiet city in general and pristine with its views. The apartment is close to a great mall that has a really beautiful set of restaurants and walking area on top of the mall parking garage. There is a supermarket very close within walking distance and everything else you could need in the area. Las Condes is one of the best areas of Santiago and I would only stay in this area from now on.
Stay here!!!

We had a lovely stay in this great house. It is near a station but also within easy walking distance of anything we wanted to visit. There are restaurants and shops nearby, right at the door to the house.
It was great value and we could cook for ourselves if we didn’t want to go out. The bed was comfortable and the wifi fast.
I love the space very modern the shower was my favorite. With its slide in door. The balcony was a bonus with a table and 2 chairs. Worth my stay here.

Anita and Abraham were wonderful hosts! I spent two weeks with them, and they were made me feel at home throughout the stay in addition to offering great local insight for things to do while in Chile.

Was pretty expensive for what we got. Paid the same price as you would for a larger apartment in a mega resort in the European alps (with access to a lot more skiing). Terrible snow when we were there meant that you really needed a car to drive 45 mins to Valle Nevado for decent snow. In our case there was no way it was ski in ski out, but I can see how it could be if there was any snow

This is a nice room in a nice little apartment around 10 minutes by bus or metro from downtown Santiago.  Parts of the  neighborhood look a little rough at first glance but it seems perfectly safe.  There is also a metro stop nearby.  I did not meet Ximena but met her mother who is living in the apartment.  My non-existent Spanish made communication a little difficult, but I can honestly say that she is one of the nicest, warmest, friendliest and most helpful people I have ever met.  It was a real pleasure meeting her and for that reason alone (among many others) I strongly recommend this place.
Great spot ! Much better than the pictures, actually fits 5 people easy. Nice bathroom. Great heating system. Private parking included. Safe place. Recommended.

Robertos Appartment was really nice and provided a nice atmosphere for a good time in Santiago. Unfortunately the water in the shower turned cold after 5-10 minutes and for longer stays the fridge is probably too small. Still I would recommend the appartment because I spent a really good time!
Ana Maria was a wonderful host! Her house was cozy and clean, and she was very helpful with anything we needed!

If you’re going to stay in Santiago.. this is the place to be. Best location in Santiago!!! Philip is a great host. Super fast communication and will help you out in any way possible. Definitely worth it and would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Great house with an amazing view and location. True ski-in access. All appliances / WiFi worked well and there is ample storage for a large family.
Food at the neighboring hotel was excellent quality and reasonably priced for a ski resort.
The views from both patios are beyond words.

The appartement is very bright with a nice view. Well equipped and feel very cosy. Liked it a lot ! Carlos is a very good communicator and always replied quickly to our enquiries.
A small supermarket is conveniently located downstairs. The neighbourhood is very safe.
Our stay in Santiago was wonderful! The apartment was clean, easy access to all the major sites and always quick and helpful responses! Thank you!

Ana Maria is very kind and helpful, she received us showing our parking spot then went up with us to show her place. It is a very well located apartment, clean and comfy, that had everything we needed. We hope to stay in here again in the future, definitely recommended.

I strongly recommend this one
The house is modern, cozy and the location is very good
Francisco provided everything and solved all the questions we had
Very kind host

I added Alexander’s WhatsApp before my arrival. He was very helpful and compromising. I left my luggages at his place because my flight is at night. He has no problems with it. Will highly recommend this place as it is close to everything you need to see in Santiago. I didn’t need to use transportation except for going to the airport.
We had a lovely stay. Very nice and helpful hosts! Good and central location, comfy bed, nice and clean. Five stars all around.
This was a fantastic apartment! Extremely comfortable and cozy! I highly recommend this apartment to any future guest and Maria Cristina is an outstanding host! Highly Recommended!

The apartment is close the the centre and about 10min from a metro station. It is quite small, but has all the amenities you need. The shower is nice and it was all quite clean. Ana Maria cordially greeted us when we arrived and showed us everything. The only thing that was bothersome was the noise from the busy street.

Paola’s place was clean, conveniently located, and had everything we needed. The description was accurate and the check in with the building was easy. Fast responses and good communication. We would definitely come back!

Bright, sunny space with tons of art, colorful touches, and a big kitchen. Wifi was consistent and fast (61 Mbps DL, 5.6 Mbps UL), which is rapid enough to stream 4K video or whatever else you may desire. I was able to upload several GB/day of my travel photos to the cloud.
Camilo was flexible on both check-in and check-out, and he was there to greet us in person. We were able to store our bags with him prior to checkin, which gave us a little bit of freedom to explore the neighborhood.
There's a grocery store a couple of blocks away, for those who wish to cook in the ample kitchen.
I really enjoyed staying in this cozy and charming place.

The apartment is perfect and Francisco is a great host! Everything is clean and cozy! We had a great time in Santiago at Francisco’s apartment! We will stay there again once we travel to Santiago. I strong recommend this apartment for families with or without children! Thank you Francisco for the wonderful space!

Felipe is a great host who is very attentive and helpful. We really appreciate his warm hospitality. The apartment is new, stylish and modern. The interior is trendy, sparkling clean and well designed, feel like staying in a 5 star hotel! What we also love is the location is very convenient, with less than 5mins walk to Alameda bus terminal, supermarket and restaurants. We enjoyed the stay very much! Muchas Gracias!

The apartment is just as pictured. It is very clean and the balcony has a beautiful view of the mountains. Gonzalo is very accommodating. He let me drop my luggage off early and was more than willing to give me tips on traveling around Santiago and to Viña Del Mar. I had a wonderful stay.
Best location, literally close to everything. Good value for the price. Tomasa (the cat) is way beyond friendly. Definitely will stay again.
Great stay in the heart of Bella Vista. Stylish decor and feels very secure with safe and 24hour door person.

My husband and I absolutely loved staying at this AirBnb during our stay in Santiago! Carlos was a wonderful host and was incredibly welcoming and kind. The appartement is clean, comfortable, has beautiful views and is centrally located. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to call home during our trip!
The place is beautiful, the location is great, juste the noise on a Monday evening was quite disturbing.
Marisol is very welcoming and available, I had a very pleasant stay at her house, the apartment was very clean, cute and well located. Muchas gracias por todo !
Martin's apartment is located at a very convenient and charming area. steps to unique restaurants, markets and ice-cream shops. Very easy access to the metro. Great place to stay!
Excellent place to stay, we will defiantly stay here again. Felipe was very hospitable and very communicative. The apartment is in a great location and very accessible to everything within Santiago.
Natalia is a great host, always responded to me with in 10 mins.  The apartment is in a nice location downtown Santiago close to a lot of attractions.

Very amazing apartment situated in one of the more dynamic neighborhoods of Santiago.  Easy to either take the metro or walk around.  The view from the apartment is spectacular for sunsets and is spacious.  Would strongly recommend.

Antonio’s apartment overlooks the city. It is easy to access via the airport and is great for 2 or 3 people. there are two bedrooms each with their own bathrooms. The rooftop is stunning and we went up in the morning to enjoy our coffee. I would recommend as a place to stay in Santiago!
The place is quite nice and it has all the necessary things I needed for my stay. Looking forward to staying there next time I visit Santiago again

The place is very nice, very clean and very well located! Close to plaza del armas, lastarria, bellas artes and walking distance to bella vista! The bed was very nice and confy, bathroom was clean and very well thought, host left shampoo and soap along with many other little but essential things! Would definietly recomend staying there!

The location of this place is definitely amazing! The more surprising part is this incredible stylish, well decorated room! Strongly recommended! And cristian is very responsive and helpful for your needs:)

Felipe’s place was fantastic! It was the perfect location for exploring Santiago- right next to restaurants and bars and easy walking distance to bellavista. The checkin process was easy, the apartment was just as described, and the neighborhood was great. Felipe responded quickly to all my messages and provided lots of useful tips for navigating the area. He also had a bottle of wine waiting for us when we arrived:) Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting!

Perfect apartment, very clean and well furnished. Aline very fast in communications and for any problem always available. Everything perfect, at my next trip to Santiago I will definitely come back to her !!!

Wow, Marcelo is a great host.  I had an unexpected problem and Marcelo was very helpful in solving my issues.  The location is very close to everything, walking distance.  The Puquen cafe next door is amazing friendly and helpful.
Nolfas place was very clean and everything was brand new, great view of the city and many city attractions close by.
As usual...my second home! It just can't get any better!! Thanks Juan, always available , attentive and thoughtful
Francisco's place is amazing. Location is perfect since it is walking distance from many landmarks of Santiago.
This was a great experience. It's the best apartment I've had in Santiago yet and I've lived here for 6 months now. You'll be very comfortable.
A great place to stay, parking very secure, close to metro, great view, I would recommend this place to anyone.

This apartment will be the best thing u’ll choose in Santiago. Amazing, incredible and charming. Don’t waste time thinking, u’ll fall in love with this. Incredible hospitality, access, check in, the cleanest place and with THE BEST VIEW POSSIBLE. I’ll came back for sure.

We enjoyed staying here very much finding their pets, comfortable beds and Netflix very fulfilling for our desire for a cozy, homey and relaxed period in our travel.  Too Alexander was gracious in letting us launder our clothes and when asked they both weighed in on dinning choices which we appreciated.  I recommend  staying here and definitely would come back ourselves.
Nice place, value for money, a little neglected (a couple of doors didn't close properly) but very comfortable and well equipped.

Osvaldo is a very accommodating and thoughtful host. His loft is wide and stylish but our stay during the winter would have been more comfortable with higher heating capacity inside the apartment. The apartment is located in the Bellavista district, which is full of bars and clubs, as well as close to the Metropolitan parc of Santiago. The swimming pool and the view at the top floor of the building  are definitely a plus to enjoy during sunny days.
A compact, but homely, apartment. It's close to the centre of town and walking distance to many places of interest. The listing is accurate and we found it good value for money.
