Taxi may find it hard to locate the place. It's in a pedestrian / shopping street. My taxi driver kept on complaining in Spanish (I don't speak Spanish), as if it couldn't be there but it's exactly where the location on Google map shows.
I was there for one night only but I appreciated that it was close to an Italian restaurant still open at 11pm. There's a pizza place and Burger king just down the building as well.
The toilets are quite close to the wall so it requires a bit of contorsion to get in but all in all it's ok (I'm 6'1, 1m86).
I didn't try any of the kitchen appliances.
Good place, convenient and really spacious.

Emily was amazing! She and her husband were really welcoming and very helpful, they both helped my family a lot, getting around the city and tips on how to rent a place in Santiago. I just can't thank them enough for their amazing hospitality.

Great apartment at excellent location. It's located right at the heart of a vibrant neighborhood with several bars and restaurants within 5-min walks.  It's also close to a subway station. I definitely recommend it!

Loved the apt! Walking distance to restaurants and historic places. Easy to grab a cab on the street. Felts safe at all times. The laundry room (located on the last floor of the building) is great! Super clean and amazing shower. Would recommend for sure!!
Great Host! The place was very clean and the location was great,very close to the subway station, many restaurants and stores, the check in was fairly easy too.

We had a great stay in Pablo's apartment at Santiago, the apartment is very cozy, we received a small Chilean wine bottle when we arrived and we appreciated it too much. He answered us very quickly when we needed him.

Camilo’s apartment was spacious for 3 of us and nicely decorated in an arty way. Everything was spotlessly clean and it had everything we needed. The shower was great and the beds very comfortable. It was close to the metro, the supermarket and nice places to eat. We had a great time in Camilo’s  place!

Nice, cosy apartment with great wifi in excellent location. Sara’s communication was prompt and check-in was easy. Much like the rest of South America, do not put toilet paper down the loo! Or expect the worst.
Great place to stay in Santiago! Very close to a hopping bar and club scene, Bellavista is where you want to stay!

The apartment is beautifully arranged and the decor is very stylish. Really would have liked that it was our home. Camilo was very easy going and flexible with the check out hours. Would have liked the apt to be closer to the commercial area of Providencia, or shorter walking distances to the metro or such. But as a counterpart can say that the location was very tranquile and noiseless to sleep. We could hear the birds singing and that was very nice! The terrace is cute but it was still to cold to e.g. have breakfast there. If you don’t have trouble walking a bit more, I amply recommend the place.
Great location. Close to Plaza de Armas. Metro is a few blocks away. The building and the apartment is very well equipped. I highly recommend Alejandro's place. Thank you very much Alejandro.
A very good choice if you can navigate the Metro in Santiago. Quiet location & relatively central. Ideal for us. Will return on my next overnight in Santiago.
We enjoyed our stay here. It is a cute apartment that is easy distance from many of the key sights in town.

Martin’s place is in an amazing location. Walking distance to many restaurants and shops in a great neighborhood. Check in was easy, and it was nice having a 24/7 door man. I definitely recommend staying here!

Adrian was a perfect host and his home is close to everythinf even avoids traiffc from the airport. I came back to santiago tonight and if his place was available, I would have stayed with no other choice!

We are amazed to choose to stay in this apartment during our visit to Santiago, Chile. It is located so close to downtown, and from where we could start our visit around the city by bus or metro. The apartment is well equipped and well maintained, very clean and we are satisfied by what we were provided with, which includes almost everthing necessary for a comfortable living.
I strongly recommend it.

This was basically the perfect type of airbnb for me. it was a completely private apartment, and was extremely quiet almost 100% of the time. Everything I needed was provided, and between the parks and stores I had everything I needed within walking distance.
Maria's apartment was great and had everything we needed. The location was very convenient and close to the centre. Maria was great to communicate with and assisted us greatly.

Fantastic location and very well equipped with everything we could need. We really enjoyed staying here and highly recommend this house. Martin also communicated well and was very helpful. It’s a great street with lots of great cafes, bars and restaurants, and a great ice cream shop too!
Place was amazing, incredible view and super clean, host were super helpful and communication was super quick!
Mirzas place was amazing! She is so kind and helpful with everything. The space is super close to the metro and a lot of restaurants and cafes and has every amenity you could need. Highly suggest!

Nice and well-kept place in a residential area. Super comfortable bed and exceptional views towards Costanera Center and the Andes. Communicating with the owners was very easy and efficient. Metro just a couple of blocks away and bus less than a block. I'd definitely stay again.

This was not what was expected from a "sparkling clean" stay.
The pros:
- Fantastic view of the city & mountains
- Nice office space
- Proximity to upscale bars and restaurants
The cons:
- Severe lack of cleanliness (i.e. lots of moths in bedroom)
- Door only had keypad lock--no interior locks, deadbolt or otherwise
- Host repeatedly called personal number/ sent Whatsapp messages/ sent AirBnB messages 10+ times over the course of 1 hour (9-10pm) unexpectedly
- Offered parking free of charge at booking and retracted the offer several days into the stay--on short notice

Claudia was extremely kind and quickly responded to any questions I had. The Airbnb location is literally one block from the metro station, a few blocks from Lastarria (a nice European-style area with upscale restaurants and bars), a few blocks from Bellavista (the crazier going out scene), and a few blocks from Plaza de Armas and all that has to offer. Inside, the unit is exactly as described and seen in the photos. It suited my needs perfectly and I would recommend others stay here.

Such a lovely space, full of character! Nothing beats having a glass of Chilean wine (or two) on the terrace listening to Karen's record collection in a late afternoon after exploring the city on foot. Karen has been a great host, giving us local tips and even researching for us what concerts and gigs are on.  She also allowed us a very late checkout. Would definitely come back.

We had a great stay in Osvaldo's appartement. It's very clean, nicely decorated and located near to a lot of good restaurants and bars. Osvaldo is a very friendly and helpful host. Very recommendable!

Kat and Piero have been top notch throughout our stay, and even after! They have been most accommodating with our needs as travelers, and I will recommend them to any of my friends who travel over to Santiago. Apartment is as listed, wonderfully done, centrally located and check in was a breeze!

Fantastic place in the heart of the city. Very well-equipped and small touches that made it feel very cosy. Perfect for two people seeking to get the Santiago experience. Thank you for your hospitality.

The apartment was compact and in a great location, even though away from the city.  We witnessed some beautiful sunsets from the balcony, and enjoyed the Artisan markets close by at Los Dominicos.  Martin was an awesome host and guide as we enjoyed a full day tour of Casablanca and Valparaiso.  He was very amenable and his communication was excellent.

Very good location of the apartment, 10 minutes walk from the central part of the old city. No parking for Car available, so when you come by car leave your bags at the apartment and look for the paid parking nearby.

Our stay at Claudia’s appartment in Providencia was highly satisfactory. The apartment is in a lovely area in Providencia, with a short walk to the Metro and the cafeterias and shops at the ground floor.
The apartment is very well organized with two bedrooms - each with a bathroom, which is nice for families with grown children (a little strange that the toilets don’t take paper).
A nice terrace with space to eat and enjoy the view. A kitchen with everything that is necessary for cooking your own meals at home. Clean and neat. Nothing’s missing and Claudia was available at once at the telephone the two times, we needed her help. A great vacation amongst other things due to a lovely apartment”.
Camilo's place was amazing. The location was perfect walking distance to Barrio Italia  while still being tucked away on a private street. Amazing stay - would recommend to anyone.
Really nice appartment with everything that you might need during your stay. Great support from Nicole and Emilio.

Great location. Clean, secure, quiet. 24 hour check in was a breeze- just follow the instructions! Location was good if you don’t mind walking a few minutes (which we don’t) . All amenities for the kitchen to cook yourself and washing machine was a bonus. Excellent communication with the hosts. Would recommend.

At check in the evening the room wasn't prepared. That was not a great welcome after a flight. I couldn't refresh myself and had to leave my stuff with an unknown person (not the host). Later the evening the wifi didn't work. There are two passwords spread over the apartment. This shouldn't be too much of a trouble to make it right. The next day I had to shower with cold water as something went wrong.
After the first 24 hours I do not have any more complaints. It went smooth as I stayed for three nights. N

Camilo’s place is comfortable and really thoughtfully arranged - it’s a great space! Very easy walking to Barrio Italia and close enough to downtown for easy sightseeing and day trips. Camilo was super responsive and helpful. All around great experience!
Excellent location in a well equipped two bedroom two bath condo.  Great balcony with a stunning view of the park and mountains.  We loved it.
Great location. We walked everywhere we wanted to visit. Sara was great to respond with recommendations. Good size for 2 people. Would definitely recommend.

What a beautiful apartment!  The location is wonderful, near some great restaurants, Pablo Neruda's home La Chascona and the wonderful park on a hill, Cerro San Cristóbal.  It is a great value for all that you get.

Amarilis is the best host you can have. Dont think twice about booking this stay. The location is very central, but nevertheless the flat is calm. Which is fantastic. It is clean, well equipped and furnished and arranged with a lot of taste. Thank you Amarilis, for hosting me!

The apartment is neat, stylish, clean and very centrally located in Santiago! Unfortunately I couldn’t stay the full week as planned due to the local protests, however will absolutely return another time. Kat was also very helpful/understanding in working on a refund for me with AirBnB - and the kindness is much appreciated!
The apartment is ideally situated close to the centre of Providencia.  The apartment is very suitable for two people.   It is clean and easy to keep clean. Javier is a thoughtful and kind host.

I have stayed in many Air B and B apartments, in different countries. This was by far the best experience!
Camilo is lovely, helpful, and responsive.
The apartment is on a pretty quiet residential street, a short walk to a number of different charming and interesting areas chock full of trendy shops, cafes, and good opportunities for people watching. There are super markets and good transportation options very close by.
Everything about the apartment was well planned and thoughtfully executed.
They truly thought of everything, from a washer and dryer to beautiful and interesting décor. There is absolutely everything one would need to just move in.
Not only is the apartment spotless and perfectly equipped, it is also serene and comfortable. Filled with abundant natural light, and comfortable furniture.
I absolutely recommend this apartment if you want a wonderful haven while in Santiago!
-Melissa
Oakland, California
This place is very stylish, in a great location, and good value for money. The communication with the host was easy and accurate.

Well located, nice apartment! We were happy to have a nice home base as we were here when the protests started and curfews were in place. Big grocery store nearby, close to the markets... it was great!

Sara’s place is soo chic and elegant. Perfect for the traveler with all the amenities you need to live like a local. From checkin to check out it was all seamless. Sara was there every step of the way to answer and questions. The location is perfect for exploring Santiago, being less than 5 minutes walk from plaza de Armas. Perfectly safe area with lots of shops, markets and restaurants. I also had the chance to spend some time with Sara and she is an amazing woman. If you are visiting Santiago and need an oasis to relax and explore you should book Sara’s place.

I stayed several weeks as part of Sabbatical in Santiago. The place is wonderful, I felt really at home, and particularly liked the patio (a lamp in the patio would be a great  addition). I did not meet Mario in person, but he always kindly replied within minutes after I had a question. The neighbour who takes care of the place was outstandingly helpful. The Internet initially had some issues, but worked much better after a quick re-start of the router. I would always come again and highly recommend this place.

The location is perfect. Just a short walk to many restaurants and several options to enjoy the night life in Santiago. It is also a 5 minute walk to the base of Cerro San Cristobal. The place is very well decorated and the rooftop is a nice spot to have a drink with a great view of the city. Osvaldo was quick to respond to any of our inquiries. Would definitely stay again next time we are in the area.

Javiera's place was a great space from which to explore the city. It was a beautiful suburb with lovely restaurants and close enough to plaza de armas without feeling like you're staying in a party suburb. It was lovely, a great place to stay.

Natalia was a very nice host. From the moment I booked her apartment she was very responsive , helpful and accommodating. Any little issue we had ( one with a mix up with the AC and the other a fuse that was blown but easily fixed) she was quick to remedy. The apartment was perfect for one/ two people for a short stay. Very clean, cute and cozy. Again, Natalia was extremely accommodating and helpful with any needs.

We had a lovely time at Francisco's apartment in Santiago! It is located in a very quiet and green neighbourhood, in a street with hardly any traffic, nice parks and cafés nearby. The apartment has everything you need and the space was good to stay with our baby. Francisco was accommodating with the check in time because our flights arrived in the morning and he also kept us up to date about the political situation and the protests in Santiago before we travelled so we would know what to expect. A very helpful and kind host. Can totally recommend staying with him!
Perfect location, close to everything you could need in Santiago! Emelina and Miguel were great hosts, and were very accommodating and  communicative. Nice apartment with lots of amenities!

Perfect area, perfect apartment. Barrio Italia is, in my opinion, the best area in Santiago. The street is beautiful and quiet and the apartment is big bright and lovely. We couldn't have asked for more. One of our favourite air bnbs. And Camilo and Margarita were both lovely and helpful.

Such a beautiful apartment! The photos are pretty spot on, and as you can see it is light and art filled! Very bright and cheery with two courtyards. It is tucked onto a quiet side street, so although the location is great, the apartment itself is quiet. It’s very close to Barrio Italia which has great shops and restaurants to choose from. Also easy walking distance to the Centro and main sights. The apartment feels like an oasis after a busy day sightseeing. The hot water can be hit or miss, but everything was super clean, the beds were super comfortable, and we would 100% come back again when in Santiago. Thanks Camilo!
As always, just feeling at home...actually...even better...😁 Juan , a great host, the place...actually, THE PLACE ...a fantastic one...! Just hoping to get back as soon as possible

A great place with amazing views towards the mountains. At the base of the building everything you need within a few minutes walk. We were there during the protests but still managed to do everything we wanted and hide away when needed 😉

Carlos and Cecilia are very friendly and helpful hosts. We really enjoyed our time. The room is cozy, beds are comfortable and everything is very clean. We had our own fridge and were able to use the common kitchen. Bathroom was only shared with one other room. Location is a little bit outside but still walkable to the city center.
Thanks again!

Aline was a wonderful host although we didn't meet her she gave us good instructions and quick responses.  The apartment is well located and secure.  Its very comfortable and its always nice to have a washing machine and iron. It was a thoughtful touch to leave a bottle of wine. I highly recommend staying in Aline's apartment.
I only stayed for 1 night but I can definitely say that Ivan’s place is very nice. Good bed, nice and clean bathrooms and a very nice city view from the bedroom and balcony :)
Modern apartment with all amenities centrally located. Kat is a great host, very communicative and hospitable. The place is highly recommended for couples.
We have enjoyed our stay in this oasis in the middle of Bellavista neighbourhood. Many thanks for this incredible appartment!
Had a wonderful stay here.  Host super helpful with earlier than expected check in and a later check out.  Love the neighborhood.

The apartment is located in a central location close to many restaurants, supermarkets, bus stations and metro station. It is a bit out dated both the building and the apartment itself, however it is the rule of most of buildings around the area. It was comfortable enough to accommodate us 3. The check in and check out process was really easy. What I liked the most about Patricia was: 1. How easy was to communicate with her and how fast she solved doubts/issues, 2. The welcome “package” she left us, including some metro cards we could recharge and use, 3. The information and contacts she provided before arriving to the apartment, and 4. The fact that she asked how we were doing after all the social movements we had around the two main avenues that surrounded the apartment street (unfortunately we came to Chile when there were many protests and which many of them were really violent). Overall we are really happy with the experience. Thank you Patricia!

Perfect location, close to everything you could need in Santiago! Emelina and Miguel were great hosts, and were very accommodating and  communicative. Nice apartment with lots of amenities! I stayed at this Airbnb twice during my trip.

Antonio was was really prompt at communicating and really helpful.
The apartment was very comfortable and colourful with everything we needed.
Thanks again Antonio.

Wonderful downtown location, within a walking distance to many attractions. We arrived during a very busy time (with the protests) but felt very safe having a 24 door man available. The AC was a wonderful addition as well. We loved how clean it was and would definitely stay again.

Christobal is very professional.  He was very proactive and responsive.  Even though it was keyless entry, he met me upon departure (at my request).  It’s a great space for one or two people.  It’s centrally located in Providencia on a quiet street and the balcony is great for getting fresh air.

Antonio's apartment was a welcome refuge from the strife Chile was suffering while we were there
It was surrounded by restaurants and shops and was within walking distance to the city centre and other tourist districts

Very nice flat in the middle of Santiago. We loved the view. Everything you need is there. Coin Washing machine with dryer is available. We felt pretty safe and Piero answered always very quick. We can definitely recommend the flat.
This apartment looks better than in the pics. Awesome view and it's sparkling clean. Hosts are very friendly, so this place is fully recommended!

Nice apartment, well decorated, location is not the best to enjoy Santiago.
Owner's communication is terrible.
A lovely place to stay. Camilo was a great host. Only 5-10min walk to Barrio Italia.

The apartment looks even better in person than the photos represent. Very easy and flexible check-in and a great location within walking distance of many shops, restaurants and bars. Highly recommended!

A really nice appartment and a lovely host. Although there were demonstrations going on right below, I could enjoy my stay and felt safe and sound. Normally it would be a very pleasant area with nice restaurants and the Neruda Museum really close. I would recomment it defenitely.
Great location and quick responses from the whole family. Only stayed for two nights but my time was wonderful. Thanks again!

We loved staying in Jorge's apartment. The building was in the heart of downtown and walking distance to Vega Central Market, Yungay, and Cerro San Cristóbal. The bathrooms and kitchen were spotless and there is a market just downstairs that has everything you need. Jorge was easy to communicate with and very accommodating. Also, the building staff were very friendly and helpful.

We only stayed one night but it was a great night. Very easy to check in, quiet place, clean and secure. Laundry and convenience stores are connected to the building. The apartment is very nice and also has everything you need if you want to cook for yourself.
Bonus: The bed is super comfortable!
Antonio's place has a great view of Cerro San Cristòbal. I road my bike around all the neighbourhood and felt very safe. It's close to great bars and restaurants and the concierge was terrific

The apartment is amazing, clean and well illuminated! The host is very flexible.
Metro Station is just a little bit far from the apartment, but totally worth it!

We reached Juan's place at almost midnight when all the restaurants were closed. He gave us some eggs and bread so we could cook some dinner for our group. He let us share the kitchen even though we only paid for the rooms. We even used his laundry machine to wash and dried our clothes in the backyard. The rooms were very clean and hospitable. He even offered to drive us to places near Santiago for set price. Juan is an excellent host. I highly recommend staying at his place.

Camilo’s place was nice: clean, comfortable and well located. The amenities and decor in the apartment are modern and pleasant, but we’ve stayed in many non-Plus Airbnb’s Which were nicer; we’re not sure this place necessarily deserves its Plus status. Communication with Camilo via the app was good, and he provided some local recommendations for eating etc. Check-in was a bit tricky for one guest who arrived in the country without mobile phone reception and had difficulty gaining entry - this was eventually resolved however. Otherwise we had a great time in Santiago and can definitely recommend this place.

We loved this apartment, it was sparkling clean and the bedding was so luxurious that it was hard to get out of bed! Filled with modern amenities like a really good shower, great cooking facilities, coffee machine and Netflix. The location is fantastic, in a safe area close to everything you need. I can't fault it and would love to stay again, we didn't want to leave!
very cozy and central place to stay in santiago. kat and piero are very attentive and great hosts.
great place, i felt good and taken care of. Comfy place, with lots of sunlight. Great location too

Compact but excellent. I stayed on my own and loved the place, although it’s big enough for two if you don’t want to spend all your time indoors. Everything in the apartment is new and the place is very comfortable - the bed and sofa are great. Mirza was very helpful in the check in and gave me help whenever I needed it. If I come back to Santiago I will definitely want to stay again!

This Airbnb was perfect for our stay. Everything was clean, comfortable and spacious! We loved all the artwork and decor as well. The terrace was perfect for the evening as well as the morning. We felt very safe and it was also walking g distance to a big market and some other great restaurants he had recommended!
Great place to spend some time in Santiago. Amarilis was a super and very supportive host.

My husband and I had a super stay along with our 18 month old son. Camilo met us when we arrived and showed us around the flat and answered any questions we had. He gave us some great local recommendations. The flat is truly beautiful, very spacious and relaxing. We would highly recommend to others.
Beautiful apartment , very cozy and quiet location in the heart of the city. Lovely artwork. Clean apartment and responsive host, would recommend a stay here!
Ximena is a great host , quick to respond and helpful. Her apartment is beautifully detailed and in a great location. I Would stay there again.
Great apartment, very modern furniture and located in one of the best neighbourhoods in Santiago. Also Check-In was very easy and communication worked great

The location and flat are as you would expect and convenient for the bus station but what really makes this property stand out to the others we stayed in in this area is the host.
Quick responses to all queries, local advice and above all, even held on to our extra luggage when we went away for a few days. Could not have asked more.
Although the flat can get a little hot in the hight of summer and can be a little noisy due to its proximity to the bus station we stayed here 3 times and would do so again.
The flat was ideal for our brief visit to Santiago. Very clean and comfortable and well equipped.  Ideally located for exploring the centre of the city. Helpful staff at the front desk.

I had a great stay at this apartment, the host was very prompt to answer all my questions, the place was clean, confortable, and well equipped.
The location is very central, close to the metro and has many restaurants and markets close by.
I would recommend this place to anyone.
Great location nice neighborhood close to metro, supermarkets and restaurants. Very nice to walk around. Modern apartment very safe.
The loft was exactly as pictured. Rooftop had amazing views, especially at sunset. Close to many shops and restaurants. Enjoyed our time there.

Positives:
Amazing design and style
Great location for exploring
Host is great with communication.
Host leaves you a welcome bottle of wine & a fruit basket!!
Lots of light & Space
Easy to check-in and out
Very safe and secure building with a 24 hour doorman.
Tons of amazing restaurant choices nearby
Neighborhood is vibrant & culturally expressive.
Negatives:
Bed is not very comfortable (Which is normal for this part of the world unless you stay at a nice hotel)
Air Conditioner is not adequate for cooling off the upstairs sleeping area.
Noise for the Disco/Bar scene nearby
*In conclusion, if it hot, you may have trouble sleeping.
Overall, this is great place to stay in the area. I would definitely recommend it.

Very nice apartment with a fully stocked kitchen and more space than we expected. The rooftop pool was great, with amazing views. On the same block as several cafes and restaurants, plus close to a popular bike path.

Like other guests have said it the location is great in fact unbeatable if you want to be at the heart of Lastarria. Just make sure that you get an assessment from the hosts about street protests in Santiago.

Nice apartment in a great location! We were able to walk to everything we wanted to see, no need to take public transport. Comfortable bed and nice shower. The bed room is located at the back of the apartment so you can't hear noises from the street. The host is very friendly and speaks English perfectly. He makes you feel welcome and was available for help or questions. I would definitely recommend this place!
Andres has a great apartment that is well located to explore Santiago. He made my whole stay really easy and comfortable. I'd recommend to anyone looking for a place for a few days.

Osvaldos place is absolutely wonderful! It’s easy to find, a short walk to the main city and close to lots of restaurants, bars and clubs. Even with a convenient minimarket next door! The place is styled beautifully, the rooftop pool and views are INCREDIBLE. Feels very safe, as entrance is staffed 24hrs.
I loved this family and still do they made my stay safe and sound even during the protest in Santiago! Thank you so much

Amazing stay at Ines place.
From the begging I felt like home in the flat.
For instance she has trusted me on the moving in during her time in Europe but also because she has accompany me during all my stay with tips, ideas, event.
It was really a shared space where food, ideas, conversation and debate were moments of conviviality.
On top of it the location of the flat is wonderful, just opposite of supermarket, close to various market and super furnish.
So will definitely recommend.
Small but just what we needed for a few days in Santiago. Great location and comfortable. Would stay if we visit again!
Clean, upscale condo in great neighborhood. Balcony & pool were a great addition. Would definitely stay again!  Claudia was quick to respond to any questions.

Juan Francisco and his wife are wonderful people! They waited for us at the airport, and gave their best to accommodate every request that we had. Probably the best Airbnb experience that we had in Chile.
Well appointed, excellent location and the host is responsive. Had no difficulty with communication. The apartment is clean and comfortable.
This is a great apartment in Santiago. It is comfortable, clean and really nice. I loved staying here!
Had a great time at Ximena’s place! Super clean and exactly as described. Highly recommended.

My husband and I were visiting from Vancouver, Canada. Marcela's place is perfect for apprehensive foreign visitors! This is my first time in South America and I was very concerned about safety. Marcela's place is in the best neighborhood, on a beautiful tree-lined street, with many shops, cafes and a grocery store nearby. I felt very safe here! The building has a concierge and there are cameras everywhere - which made us feel very secure. The neighborhood is fantastic. The view from the apartment is beautiful and even more so from the rooftop pool area! Marcela's place was very clean (North Americans would approve!) and the wifi was fast and reliable. The shower water pressure was strong and good, the bed was comfortable, and my husband made good use of the large fan. Overall a very comfortable stay and the perfect place for tourists! :)

This is a great place with wonderful comfy beds- r doble rooms and 2 good bathrooms. Tea and coffee at hand. Panchito makes a super sandwich for jet lagged tummies
His wife is delightful
Highly highly recommended
Good value apartment close to a lot of bars and restaurants in Bella Vista. The apartment itself wasn’t the cleanest but we enjoyed our stay regardless. We were here only for a weekend.

This is a lovely spacious and comfortable apartment, decorated with beautiful artwork, in a convenient location.     It has so much natural character and style, making it a pleasure to stay here.  Camilo was wonderful, responsive, and flexible.   I hope to stay here again someday.

Our stay was great! The apartment is within walking distance of many restaurants and shops. It’s a pretty bohemian neighborhood with tons of street art and nightlife. The place was cute and quite comfortable. The host also accommodated our check in / check out time, which we really appreciated after a long flight.
Ximenas space is a great location to explore the lively Bellavista neighborhood . It was clean and well equipped with a lovely view
Stayed for one night before a flight, this is well located apartment with pool and gym in the building, clean and good value, gracias

We had a fantastic time in Ximena’s apartment. The space is perfect, and has all the amenities a person could need. The location is pretty central; with the riots right now, it’s pretty dangerous in Santiago and daily, the police are using tear gas and hosing people down, so be careful when coming here. The nation aside, the apartment was great and Ximena was thoughtful and extremely helpful. I would highly recommend this place!

This place was beautiful, lovely towels, good kitchen and comfy bed. However, we went to this place because of the aircon in the description, but it was just a small external aircon system that only cooled one room at a time, whilst making the one behind it hot. This seemed falsely advertised in the description. Other than that it was perfect!
Located very central to city center and Santa Lucia Hill. Clean and cozy appartment with good wifi. Very friendly stuff, we could easily check in at 23 am. Perfect for stay in Santiago.
It is such a great place! It is sparkling clean and has everything you need. It is also very close to lots of restaurants and bars. I would definitely recommend!

Really appreciate Camilo and how he helped us all along the way. We truly enjoyed our stay. It’s everything we expected and more. If we ever have a chance to come back to Santiago, this is definitely where we will stay.
This is the coziest Airbnb I have ever stayed in. The apartment was so cute and well designed. Camilo was an excellent host and gave us so many helpful recommendations.
The photos of the place are very accurate: simple, rustic and charming! We had a super relaxing time there!

Marcelos place was great!
Awesome location! Walk anywhere!
It was clean, fresh, new and safe!
Marcelo was an excellent communicator, responding promptly and kindly. Defiantly would stay here again!
Lovely apartment, very central and easy to get around. Host was quick to respond. Easy check in/ check out. Would stay again.

Very clean and well furnished place. Piero and Kat were super fast answering all our questions.
Highly recommended for a couple vacation or even traveling alone. Would definitely come back, if we ever come to Santiago again.
Lovely place with an amazing rooftop pool. The location was great and the area felt very safe. Luis was very helpful when I asked to check in early. Would definitely come back!
A lovely apartment in a quiet street close to cafes and restaurants in Bario Italia. We enjoyed our stay.
Great location - easy subway ride into downtown and cute safe local area. Ivan is great! Very responsive and helpful.

Pros:
-Great location (a lot of restaurants and night entertainment nearby).
-Building has security guard 24/7
-Has 1 parking space included inside the building.
-Great decoration and cool AC.
-You would have access during the day until 8 pm to the rooftop area where you may enjoy the Infiniti pool, and the amazing views of the cities (usually not very crowded).
-Competitive price.
-Very nice host

Great place to stay close to airport. Safe area as far as we know. Juan let us park on his spot and watched our car. We were sharing hose with the host. All upper floor was for us. Four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Sparkling clean. Air in all of them. And TVs. Some nice touches by host and breakfast.
Enjoyed our stay.
The house is beautiful, well equipped, clean, and a short walk from lots of great food. The back garden was especially heavenly to spend time in. Damn. We loved it here.
Felipe has been a great host! He was very friendly and helpful! The apartment has a great view of the mountains and is very comfortable!

Nice apartment in a great apartment building> Pool is very nicely located on top of the building with very nice view on the city.
Apartment also very good situated on a city park and close to the city center.

Mario (with neighbor Sandra supporting) was an exceptional and responsive host. He was incredibly cool about a late check out. He researched parking options for me before I arrived. He even replaced a dying air conditioner within 20 hours. Everything about his approach encourages you to enjoy the stay. And the place is sweet - terrific location for access to Providencia and the metro / city, and a great space to land and decompress. Highly recommend this for a single or couple.
A clean and stylish place close to the main attractions of Santiago. Gonzalo was also a very hospitable and helpful host. Great amenities. 5 stars!

Cristobal is great hoster, very attentious. Everything gone as expected, we had no troubles. The place is very organized, beautiful, and well localized in a very beautiful neighborhood. Besides that, it has an amazing view of the city.
We loved Adrian's place. It was centrally located and perfect for 3 people. The view is extraordinary and Adrian was very easy to communicate and connect with!
Such a lovely space in a great neighbourhood. We very much appreciated Mirza accomodating our extended stay at the last minute. Thank you so much!

Beautiful spot for a few days in Santiago - right in the middle of a fun neighborhood and steps away from the park. Other residents in the apartment building are friendly and the rooftop pool was brilliant.

The apartment is in a great location. It felt very safe and secure. The Manquehue metro station is a short walk away and there is a good shop at the entrance of the apartment, which sells basic foods including some vegetables.
The interior is very attractive and the bedrooms very comfortable. The double bed is large. The duvets and pillows are thick and fluffy. There is a lot of storage space.
The pool on the roof is very nice although we were busy site-seeing and didn’t get there very much.
The balcony is largely shaded, which was a relief as it was very hot in Santiago when we were there.
All in all a real gem. We would definitely return and would have liked to stay longer.
Fantastic place, there is only one air conditioner on the top floor so can get a little warm in the summer.
Graziela is an excellent host, very friendly and helpful in accommodating our requests. The apartment is exactly as advertised, excellent stay.
Fernando is a great host. We got local tips, clean replacement towels during the stay and perfect service when we needed some specific help during the stay.

Daniela's place is beautifully styled and perfectly located. She's very responsive & flexible, I was able to drop off my suitcases prior to the check in time as I arrived early from the airport. Check in/out was very simple. The rooftop pool & area was perfect to watch the sunset. Would love to stay here again!

Emily was the best hostess ever!  Very responsive, even continued to communicate with me when I forgot my sandals at her place and made sure I received them.  So many good tips about the area and would definitely stay again if I’m ever back in the area.  Would highly recommend this stay!
Excellent location, wonderful views, and very close to major restaurants and train stations. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place to stay felt very safe. A large variety of restaurants and bars in the vicinity.  Close to Metro and buses.

The place was perfect, great location, five mins away from the subway. Close to main attractions. Green areas an supermarkets.
The bathroom is smaller than it looks in the pictures.
But in general a lovely place.

Great apartment with a view in Providencia. The 24-hour doorman and electronic checkin make getting in super easy and the central location makes walking to food and drink doable. Other perks of the place include a well stocked kitchen, living room, and bathroom, along with a comfy bed and outdoor patio.

Emeline & Miguel out a lot of thought into making sure the place is well prepared for guests. Information books, a spare bip card, phone chergers for all types of phones for intl travelers etc.
The place is nice, clean and centrally located. I would stay here again. Thanks :)

We had an amazing time at Antonio's! The apartment is well located, a 15 minute walk from Barrio Italia shops and restaurants. The place is well furnished, comfortable and charming. Although we did not meet Antonio the building concierge was very welcoming and helpful and available at all times. Highly recommend staying here!
Nice apartment and comfortable bed. Good location. Walking distance to many things, 15-20min.  Apartment is clean, good size and full kitchen. Must buy spices and oil if you plan to cook.

This place is incredible — we are already thinking of staying here again in the future. It was a perfect location, had beautiful style, included everything we needed to live life as if we were at home. We cooked meals, sat on the patio (I also did yoga there), and enjoyed the fresh air from the beautiful windows in the house. Going to the grocery store was a short 4 minute walk which made cooking very simple and easy, and the house was a short Uber ride from all our other destinations. We were able to do laundry partway through our 8-day stay and that was invaluable for us. Camilo and Margarita were both incredibly kind and helpful during our stay.

We enjoyed our stay in Paola’s apartment which is located in Providencia.
The location was ideal with lots of nice restaurants and bars nearby. The apartment is also close to the park where you can walk or take the cable car up for some views of the city.
The apartment itself is modern and well equipped. We enjoyed sitting out on the balcony watching the sunset. The roof top pool was an added bonus with good views of Santiago.
Paola was quick to respond to any queries and suggested things to do and restaurants to try.
We would definitely stay again on another trip to Santiago.
Felipe, You are an awesome host -- and ambassador!  Thank you so much for your excellent hospitality.  My husband and I enjoyed staying in your beautiful apatment. Hope to visit again :)

This apartment is perfect, perfect location, perfect place, perfect building, perfect guest. We didn't need to use any public transportation, as we like to walk, we walked everywhere. There are bars, restaurants, supermarkets, everything within walking distance. And the view is fabulous. I highly recommend this place.

Perfect location, modern building that has all the amenities, apartment is well furnished. It is a small space, but functional. Location is perfect: lots of great restaurants right at your doorstep, centro is really close too. The only possible con is the fact that the apt is pretty close to epicenter of protests, and it can get really busy because of that. We didn’t feel discomforted or endangered though. Dominic is a great host, attentive, helpful and welcoming, but also really responsive. Was a pleasure to chat with him. Overall a great place to stay.

Great host and location. The unit itself is cozy so there isn't a lot of space if you have a couple of large suitcases. Tons of really good restaurants and bars nearby but we really loved the outdoor markets selling arts, clothing, and books. Close to metro stops and on a quiet (less traffic) street.

The apartment was nice, but it was hard to access. It is in a mall. When the mall is closed there is a gate and you have to call a doorman. The mall closed earlier than we were told on our first day (3pm not 8pm). Also, the apartment was apartment A not apartment B listed in the description. Once we had everything figured out, we enjoyed our stay, but checking in was difficult.

Great high rise apartment central to Santiago. Wonderful view of the Andes, city center, and pool. Building is clean and well monitored, and the big windows were helpful to let in the breeze. We stayed for one week and were very comfortable. Big bed, Netflix, and food delivery comes right to the front door. Internet went out a couple of times but the owners were quick to fix it. Wonderful place to recharge between big trips. Thanks guys!

This place is great. Mirza is a super nice and responsive host. We liked it so much, left Valparaiso early and stayed here another night! The location is awesome and the balcony is cool, plus the washing machine was really helpful in the middle of our six-week journey.
We enjoyed the stay, flat is nice, but it was a bit dirty (all the floors and walls bit as well)
The apartment was in an amazing location! The gym and pool were great! And the views were amazing!

We absolutely loed Antonio's place and would stay there again. Very stylish and practical. And it was a nice surprise to live in "Asiatown". We had sushi and korean barbeque every might. The view is wonderful and we could see it from every room. But it would be much better if windows were cleaned. But they are quit difficult to reach on the outside. Communication and suggestions were good.
Cristian was super helpful, the stay was easy and comfortable, and it was in a convenient location.
Great apartment for our group of 5. Fantastic location with swimming pool, great facilities and handy for exploring locally area.

Valentina's place was just as described and she was very quick to respond to all of our questions.  The location of the apartment is phenomenal - not even a 3 minute walk to the subway station, and less than 5 minutes from the nearest grocery store!  It was the perfect base for exploring the city for a couple of days before heading down to Patagonia.  Thanks Valentina for sharing your apartment with us!

A friendly host and a really good area to be in! Cerro San Cristobal and Pablo Nerudo’s house are both in 3 minute walking distance.
Prepare to be hot while sleeping during the summer. And bring ear plugs because this neighborhood of Santiago is known for it’s nightlife that lasts into the morning.
The apartment is much greater than expectation. Feel like being at home. Located right next to metro station and walking distance to spots. Highly recommend to everyone.
Best host ever!! Recommend everyone to stay here. Everything is super clean, location super central. Ely is a very kind and respectful host, that helps you out with anything.

Beautiful flat for 2 people in the centre of the happening district of Santiago, the area felt very safe and also close to the metro make is very useful for going around the city.
Close to supermarkets, Marcela's house was very clean and had all the basics for cooking up a quick meal with a few items from the nearby supermarket.
Very good communication from Marcela too and the added advantage of being able to stash your luggage in a safe room if you happen to arrive early like us before the check in time.

A perfectly located apartment (close to tourist attractions, bars, clubs, etc...), with all the necessaries that you'll ever need.
And most importantly - Anita Maria is one of the most AMAZING hosts that I've ever seen! I really enjoyed chatting with her every day, enjoyed her breakfast, and she even did laundry for me!
1000% recommended.
Cristian’s apartment was perfect for my stay in Santiago. Within walking distance of most sights and many restaurants. Check in was a breeze and the bed was super comfortable.

Cristobal’s apartment has a great view, it’s very clean and the location is great and very safe. Cristobal is a wonderful host. He gives great tips and responds promptly to any inquiry. I would definitely recommend his place.
Amazing Apt.  You can't beat the location.  I'd stay again in a heartbeat!!!

transportation is super convenient, bus station with the airport bus (departs every 15min) is right in front of the house
room gets a lot of sunlight in the morning

This was our 2nd stay at Patrick's place and we were not disappointed. We particularly like the location, the privacy of his yard, the great outdoor space, BBQ and washing machine. Patrick is a very nice person and responds quickly to any questions. We have already booked our 3rd stay at his place.
Osvaldo was a incredible host and the apartment was so good. We would go there any time soon again.
Victoria is a great host, she communicated well from the start and was very welcoming on arrival. The apartment is clean, well decorated and in an excellent location. Highly recommended
Loved our stay here, would recommend.  Security was good, entire building was clean, staff were very helpful.  Host was very accommodating!
The apartment was modern and clean. Easy check-in process and good location - we felt like we were at home.

Osvaldo was the perfect host, providing a tailored list of activities and local amenities to our taste. His apartment is wonderfully decorated and very clean, in a great location to take in all Chile has to offer. He provided a complementary bottle of delicious local wine and market bought fruit bowl which was a lovely touch. We couldn’t recommend more highly!
This is an exceptional place, sparkling clean with lots of extras especially in the kitchen, not to mention the view from the 15th floor balcony. Highly recommended!
Definitely give Jose and his place 5 star. Everything was amazing and Jose was the sweetest host.
there is ants at whole the apartment. on the bed and bed room. she told me she will return me whole the money, because I want checkout after one day. she told me many times and lie on me
Great stay, location was ideal, with public transit, walkable, safe. Javiera and Roberto are very professional and helpful.  The apartement has everything you need.

Best host!!! Recommend everyone to visit Ely. I have travelled a lot, but Eli is the best airbnb host I have visited ever. Ely will take super good care of you, as well as she gives you privacy. No doubt: you wont find a more central, caring, cleaner, airbnb then this one! She also has a pool in top of the building with super nice view.

Carlos was a wonderful host. He met us at the building, checkin was super fast, and the place was wonderful.
One wonderful bonus is that the wifi in Carlos’s place is an amazing 200mbps.
The place was very nice to stay in, it was as pictured. Check in was easy as well. Location was central and lots to do and eat around the place. Would stay again!

Super convenient and comfortable! Apartment is a stone’s throw away from Saint Lucia metro, the supermarket and restaurants.
You have everything you need for a relaxing stay including cooking equipment and basic ingredients like salt, pepper, oil and some herbs as well as 2 types of pillows and a good quality mattress.
Valentina was accommodating, provided detailed instructions and was responsive.
A great accommodation option in Santiago.

We loved it here.
A safe & quiet neighbourhood, close to plenty of bars & restaurants. Spectacular views over the rooftops to the mountains.
And considerate hosts who were always just a text message away.
Thank you Cristobal & Cristian.
Highly recommended.

Good Location. Nice apartment.  Air Conditioner is only in the bedroom. So when is 30to 33 degrees outside it takes about 2 days in cool the apartment down.  Internet is not reliable. Sometimes work and sometimes not.
Great location. Be prepared it can be very loud as there are many clubs nearby. Otherwise its in a beautiful area and the space is nice.

We had a good time at Daniela‘s place, everything’s was like pictured. The view from the roof with the pool is amazing. We always felt welcomed and despite language difficulties, Daniela was always there to help

Marcela’s unit has a great location, the area is full of interesting restaurants and easy transport (metro, etc). The unit is good too and have what you need for a weekend. It’s a bit smaller than you might think hence it’s only for single person or a couple.
The communication was easy and fast, Marcela was always responding all our enquires.
We would recommend the Unit and gave her 5 stars.
Very nice and clean apartment. Spacious and with a nice view. Gaston has been very friendly and always ready to help. Highly recommended!
A great location - safe and clean; comfortable bed and furnishings; attentive host. Thanks for sharing with us Cristobal!
Amazing apartment very easy to get around downtown santiago especially for tourist. Safe apartment building and great people living in the building. Highly recommend this place

Francisco’s place was lovely. They supplied things that we really appreciated, like oil, salt, coffee, glad wrap, lots of toilet paper and soap. The apartment was close to buses and metro so travel was made easy and having a doorman 24/7 was also good . Pool was very cold but on those hot days was still nice just to dunk in and out .

I had a wonderful stay here. Hosts welcomed me in person and gave me a great introduction of the home. Besides, they sent me a PDF introducing Santiago and neighborhood. Very safe and quite area. I enjoyed pleasant walk to everywhere. The APT is brand new. Gym and swimming pool were great. The Swimming pool made my holiday even better. APT is spacious, bright and brand new.  Highly recommend this place!
We had a pleasent stay and will come back. The location is very central and ideal for exploring Santiago. Easy to find, good communication, nice hosts and well equipped. Excellent value for money.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is as pictured, there is a nice pool on the roof but best of all the neighborhood was great. We were traveling with 2 kids (7 and 10) and they loved the nearby park which had an awesome playground.
We had a wonderful stay at Ximenas apartment. It was very clean and in an awesome location. Would definitely stay here again.
A good value for money AirBnB located in a cool area of the city- lots of local restaurants around. Secure entry and good local tips

The apartment was beautifully decorated and the location was great, with easy access to lots of restaurants and bars. The rooftop pool was amazing, with a view of Santiago and Cerro San Cristobal. Osvaldo was very easy to communicate with and was happy to help with all our questions.

Great location close to the subway station. Check in was easy and place the place is just as pictured. Host is responsive and the apartment has everything you need for a short stay. I’d stay at this apartment again.

Staying at Eugenia's lovely apartment was a wonderful experience. The apartment is very comfortable for two people, and is conveniently located in a super safe neighborhood, and just a short walk to the metro station (Manquehue). Eugenia is a great host, always available if we needed anything, and going out of her way to make sure we were comfortable. Gracias por todo, Eugenia!

We stayed in the Hotel in Santiago on a leisure trip. Everyone in the hotel was very happy and helpful, trying to make out experience in Santiago the best possible. The hotel was clean and bed were comfortable. breakfast was delicious!

I loved staying at Daniela's place on my most recent trip to Santiago! The location was great, close to many nice restaurants. The apartment was cozy, with beautiful decor and AC. I used the balcony and the rooftop pool most days. The gym upstairs was closed during my stay, and not sure how that could be changed. Otherwise, I would highly recommend staying at Daniela's beautiful space! :)

Martin's place has an excellent location, right in the heart of Lasteria with restaurants surrounding.  The apartment is well appointed and was comfortable for 5.  The building felt safe and had a constant doorman.  I would highly recommend a stay here when in Santiago.

This place is just gorgeous. Very secure, lots of natural light, bed is very comfy, plenty of space!! They have a beautiful French apartment theme in the apartment and it really works! The kitchen is very functional and the wide windows open out into beautiful green trees and a lovely little internal park in this secure, gated complex.
I would stay there again. Thanks guys! Love the place!

The apartment is nice with all the needed essentials and was very clean.
The apartment is in a great location close to shopping, restaurants and the metro.
Only problem was a loud party that went on all one night in an apartment down the hall. Other than that it was very quiet.

Mercedes was so incredibly great with her responses. Very easy check in, she even let me come in early at 7am after my night bus from Mendoza!
Great location, wonderful amenities, the kitchen is stocked with basic supplies and lovely location as well.
Highly recommend and very worth the price!

Great location but very noisy neighborhood overnight
Air conditioning is a mobile unit that doesn’t cool the bedrooms
Easy access to the apartment

The apartment was located in a great neighborhood with awesome bars and fun activities in the area. There was easy access to the metro and Alejandra was excellent at communicating any necessary information about the apartment. Would definitely stay again.

Eduardo Jesus' place is exceptional! Located on the top/penthouse floor of a modern condo in beautiful Los Condes. My flight arrived much earlier than check in and Eduardo Jesus kindly offered me an early check-in. He was extremely accommodating and was great with communication. The check in process was a breeze. The apartment is nice and clean with spectacular views of the city. You also have access to the beautiful rooftop pool. Perfect for swimming and suntanning. I will definitely stay here again when I am back in Santiago!

Cristian's place was fantastic. Check in was arranged remotely and was very easy to manage. The location of the home was great with awesome restaraunts and bars nearby. It was also close to many of the top areas to visit in Santiago.
On top of all of that the place was very comfortable and stylish. Would definitely come back the next time were in Santiago!

Best Airbnb I’ve stayed in. Great location, comfy bed, cozy layout. Couldn’t have been any better! Mirza also went above and beyond and helped me organize a ride to the airport for a super early flight. Highly recommend to everyone!

This is a cosy apartment in Las Condes, which is one of the best areas in Santiago. The lounge area is very small. The bed was comfortable.  The apartment is in easy walking distance to the subway, shops, cafes and restaurants.

A perfectly located apartment, really close to the metro and bars/restaurants. In addition, this apartment contains all the things you'll need - including a few ingredients at the kitchen, and a speaker at the living room.
And most importantly, the hosts are very kind!
Great air bnb!!! Amazing location!!! Arrived in very late from our flight and a 24/7 doorman made it very easy and hassle free to check in!! Very clean and very comfy beds!! Highly recommend

Perfect Location in Santiago, lively surroundings until late (or rather very early). The appartment is just pefect for two persons and very secure. I would  stay with Ximena again. Highly recommended !

This place is great, a nice and clean flat with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The building is at walking distance from downtown. The Vietnamese restaurant that is located in the same block as this apartment is amazing, don't miss it. You will have a great view of the city from the living room. Don't forget to swing by the rooftop, there is a pool, a Grill to make a nice BBQ and a nice area to watch the sunset. Antonio's will do his best to accommodate your needs, his tips are great.

Jose’s place was like staying at a Marriott 5-star hotel.  Bed and sheets were extremely comfortable and every thought was put into my needs and comfort. Plus, the door attendants are very friendly and location is surrounded by tons of restaurants you’d never go short of food. I will stay here again my next stay in Santiago. Thanks!

Yeny was very kind and helpful all the time before and during my time in Santiago. Her apartment is very well located, equipped, clean and the building when it's located the ap was very nice. Good laundry and swimming pool. I felt at home, thanks for all :)

Nice appartement with a great location and comfortable bed. Kitchen is small but fine for heating some things up or having breakfast. Bedroom is quite light at night, so bring a mask if you like to sleep in the dark.
This has been one of the best air bnbs we stayed at. The location is perfect. Thanks Felipe and Oliver!

Martin's apartment is very well located in Lastarria. The area is very lively, with lots of restaurants, caffes, and wine shops nearby.
Martin replied very quickly when we had questions and also helped us organize transport to and from the airport.
We would definitely stay here again should we return to Santiago.

Amazingly located in Bellas Artes,  can walk nearly everywhere in Santiago from the apartment. Some great restaurants nearby and has a supermarket downstairs if you like to cook for yourself. Kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to make your ow meals. We fell in love with the Lestarria neighborhood next door and would walk there most evenings to see all the artwork and hang out with the students there. Pablo was a very helpful host, even having a bottle of Chilean wine ready for us when we arrived after our long flight. Very much recommend a stay here and hope to return one day!
We stayed twice for a reason! Exceeded our expectations. If communication was faster/better this would be a perfect 5* value Airbnb! Definitely recommend.
Cristian’s apartment was clean, comfortable, safe, and quiet. It was in a good location, close to many bars and restaurants. I would definitely recommend it for anyone visiting Santiago.

Antonio’s apartment was just great! We were pleasantly surprised by how CLOSE we were to most everything we wanted to see. Loved being able to walk to so many sites, and have a metro station only 3 blocks away. At the end of our 90 degree days, the rooftop pool was very refreshing. Antonio was very responsive and fixed a stuck window in one of the bedrooms. Highly recommend this place!
Excellent location within easy walking distance to numerous restaurants, bars, and shops. Juan's hospitality and communication made everything that much better. Would definitely stay here again!

The apartment is located just beside the park，and it's very close to shopping mall and supermarket，the owner is very nice，gave me a welcome kit，made me feel at home，i really enjoyed the stay during this period.
The apartment is wonderful! No complaints! Very stylish and clean space. Great location. Very well equipped. Easy check in. Fantastic view over Santiago. We would come again any time!
Good value for money. Good location. The bed is not really good,  would be good to improve it. Great communication with the owner.
Alexis was a great host and was very friendly. The accommodation was spotless,  spacious and centrally located. I would recommend his place if you plan your visit to Chile.

The apartment is not far from city center and close to a lot of bars where locals hang out. It is well equipped, we especially apreciated the washing machine. Felipe is a great host, he gave us clear check-in instructions and help us with our luggage storage, as we arrived earlier. We had a very pleasant stay.
Nice and stylish apartment in the city centar. Communication with the host was very good and it was easy to check in.

Emelina Y Miguel are wonderful, very helpful people. They looked after us very much from the day the apartment was booked until the end of the stay. The apartment itself is also great. It is quite small, but the space is well used and the apartment is very well equipped. In addition, it is in a very good location and it is easy to explore the capital of Chile on foot;) A big plus of the apartment is also very good internet.

Relatively close to the center of the town with access to the near by metro station.
Jean provided updated information that we were able to show it to our taxi driver to get around the road closure due to protests to get to his place.
And Jean's mom (living in the build) is super friendly.
Finally despite the fact this place is without AC, it stayed related cool even in the 95F dry heat, thanks to orientation of the room/building. So it should not be a problem.

This is our 3rd time renting Patrick's place. It has served us well. We particularly like the privacy and outdoor space. He is planning to make some minor renovations in the near future and that should make his place even better.

We had a wonderful stay at Cristian's loft. It is in a great location in the center of Santiago. The building felt very safe. It was easy to get in and out of the apartment. The loft was really well decorated and incredibly comfortable for myself and my husband! We highly recommend this loft!
Everything in our stay was good. Great location and very helpful host. Only issue was the social uprising happening near us but other than that good

We can highly recommend this apartment: it is small (however big enough for us) but very cozy and comfortable. We loved the location: we could walk to the centre and the Bellavista neighbourhood easily. To make a few suggestions: the floor could be cleaner and we really missed some wine glasses. We went to a wine store and bought some good Chilean wines and then we had to drink them out of water glasses. No disaster, just a bit unfortunate. Overall, we thought is was really good value for money.

This was an amazing place to stay. Parking, wifi and A/C are all included plus a full kitchen for an extended stay. The apartment was really clean and had a warm, homely feel. I will definitely try and stay here in my next visit. Thanks Daniela!
Absolutely amazing host! Camilo ensured that we were properly taken care of. I would definitely come back and stay here in the future.

We stayed at Osvaldo's for a few days while we explored Santiago. His loft is stylish and cozy and the location can't be beat. There is a rooftop pool which offers incredible views of the city. We were very happy with our digs and would definitely stay here again :)

Juan is a great host who responds quickly and with helpful answers.
The apartment is an amazing place and a great location. I’d stay again but the apartment would need a few things modified. ( toilet downstairs wasn’t flushing and if you put both bedroom aircon on and also the 3rd one in the living area the fuse trips. )

Great apartment in Santiago. Apartment was clean and looks exactly as listed. Safe building with a front desk attendant I believe 24 hours a day.  Host was great with communication and offered organizing transportation to/from the airport.  Would recommend.

A wonderful save place to stay, enjoy, and discover the city of Santiago. The place is also perfect for a long stay. Maria is a super-friendly, welcoming host, helping with anything you need even before you know that you need something. Absolutely recommendable!
Felt like a hotel, room was spotless, location was perfect, and hospitality was amazing.

Excellent location, close to shops, cafes, restaurants.  Lovely views.  Paola was quick to respond to issues.  The apartment met our needs for the week.  Make sure to bring shampoo/condioner and laundry detergent as there was none, the dryer portion of machine does not really work.  Tried drying towels and came out wet.  But drying on the rack outside works very well.  We would stay here again.
Odette is an amazing host. She is very attentive and accommodating. The apartment is great—clean, spacious, well-located. I highly recommend it.

I stayed 3 weeks at Inés' place and loved it! Inés is a wonderful host, from the beginning i felt at home, she is an excellent cook, she took me to marches, to the theater, lend me her bike, and we had great conversations and funny evenings. The apartment is very bright and cozy, and has everything you need, including a desk for work, which I needed, a fruit press, a funny cat and a lovely roommate. I almost decided to spend the corona quarantine with them! The city center, weekly market, supermarket, metro, bars, restaurants are all very easily reachable.... I would definitely come back when in Santiago and can highly recommend it!

The apartment is amazing with plenty of space and a full kitchen. Nice location close to the centre with the costanera centre an easy 5-10min walk or plenty of ubers available when venturing further. The staff at the accommodation are equally welcoming even if your Spanish is like myself and not brilliant. Well worth it

Felipe’s place is excellently located, on a central Main Street, easy to travel with many restaurants and market near by.  The floor to ceiling windows provide a fabulous view of the hill.  We enjoyed sitting on the balcony in the evening and taking a dip in the small rooftop pool.  Felipe is a very attentive host. The place is spacious and bright and I would stay there again.
It was great, amazing!! Superb place and location, I highly recommend staying here. Very good!!!! :)

Beautiful loft in a classic and central area of Santiago.  The bed was super comfortable.  Osvaldo left a bottle of wine to enjoy which went perfect with the roof sunset.  I didn’t swim in the pool because of Covid19 but I really really wished I could.  Very easy check in and communication.  Fully recommend!

Philip's place is awesome and very located. He's also good-hearted and a real gentleman who accepted to refund me when I had to leave in the middle of my stay, at the beginning of the Corona virus crisis in South America, not everyone would do that. Thanks again, Philip.

A very trendy apartment, comes with everything you need for a long stay. Mattress is very comfortable. Very easy self check in/check out process. Cristian is very responsive and accommodating our changes.

Marcel is a warm hostess and helpful in this difficult situation in the world. The place is well equipped with all your daily amenities in a super safe surrounding. Although swimming pool n gym had closed by now, but u can still relax before checking your ever changing flight schedule. Thanks again for the hosting and hope everything will be fine soon!

I stayed with my parents at Camilo’s flat. It was an excellent choice. The appartement is very well located, in a cute two story house. It is comfortable and decorated with taste. The courtyard in the back is great to relax. Camilo is a great host, super accommodating. And communication was easy and fast.
I would definitely recommend staying there.
Clara is a great hostess and the place is amazing, super prime location in the heart of everthing. U feel safe to stay with in this difficult moment around the world, highly recommend!

Excelente place to stay! Cozy and felt like home!
Eduardo is a excelent host.

I loved staying at this gorgeous apartment. If you love light spaces, this apartment is perfect and the sunset views stunning. Very conveniently located for trips to the UN and ECLAC offices in Vitacura and with lots of cafés, restaurants and supermarkets around.

Great apartment in a nice and safe neighborhood, very good equipped.
The view from the balcony towards the sunsets behind Centro and San Cristobia is stunning and worth every penny. The garden and pool area are very enjoyable too. Also Javier is very helpful and always responded very quickly.
Would definitely book again when back in Santiago.

A very comfortable and well equipped apartment in Santiago.  Mirza is a wonderful host and we we were fortunate to have her as communications with her were easy.  A good location near the cycling route along the river.  Many shops, restaurants and services in the area.  Due to the covid-19 situation she kept us informed of the rapidly changing situation in Santiago and in the country.  She also arranged transport to the airport and requested we contact her once we were safely home.  We will definitely book accommodations with her on our return to Santiago.

Great stay at Cristian’s loft apartment. Host was warm and friendly. Check in was easy, apartment was clean and tidy. Everything we needed was provided (hair dryer, washing machine) and all of the furniture and fittings are near new. Bed and sofa are comfortable. Kitchen is a good size to cook simple meals. Big fridge was very helpful. Thank you once again for a pleasant stay. Nice decoration as well!

Cynthia was very helpful and responding quickly. The place was kept very clean with daily cleanings from Maria. Great location. Quiet neighbors. All around we really enjoyed our stay of several months.
Very nice service and comfortable place. The location is great with the metro next door! Carolina is answering your questions in minutes and trying to meet all your needs with a smile.
Carlos’ apartment is so nice and clean. The location is very good. Communication is excellent. Highly recommended.
It was a beautiful place to stay. Lots of little shops around and a great view over the city.

Another perfect week. I cannot be happier. Which is why I extended my stay :) very happy with everything I mentioned before. Attentive, kind, and amazing hosts. The apartment is wonderful and I really enjoy my time here.

Excellent location! The apartment is just a block away from a metro station and a big supermarket. There are also tons of shops and restaurants in the area. The apartment has great views of the city and the mountains and it is very bright with sunlight flowing through the big windows during most of the day. Eduardo is an excellent host and was extremely quick to respond to questions or requests. He was very considerate,  reaching out to offer help and make sure that I was comfortable. I definitely recommend this place!

This is an excellent choice for any expat who wants to reside in Santiago for a while. The apartment is located in one of the best neighborhoods in the city, it is spacious, well decorated and equipped with everything you need for a long-term stay.

Nice place like warm home，I feel very comfortable. The host is so kind ,always can reply me very fast. and also i can enjoy my spare time with one cup of coffee as it has the good view from the balcony.
Awesome place to stay defenetly recommend it. Very cozy and a lot of places to eat nearby

What a great spot just 10 minutes away from the noisy city, surrounded by nature it’s a warm and cozy cabin with stylish touches, clean and packed with everything we needed. Dogs are welcome which we really appreciate since we’re always traveling with our fur babies. We would definitely come back!
Do not hesitate to book this Appartment.  Great place & location, Philip is an awesome host and always available when required

The place is near to everything; subway,  restaurants, parks, etc. Very  comfortable to stay for a while. The communication and instructions are clear from the beginning. Thanks guys, I really recommend this beautiful place. See you!
Very large apartment, extremely clean and perfect location. The city view from the balcony was amazing and being next to one of the best parks and shipping center in the city was the  the best.
Amazing place, thoroughly enjoyed my stay! Nespresso machine, barbecue grill and huge TV set made it 5 stars. Would happily stay again.

I had a nice stay at Zip Housing. My apartment was nicely decorated, comfortable, and well equipped. The building is close to the Escuela Militar metro station and there are lots of restaurants close by. I recommend a bakery and cafe called Brothaus, which is around the corner. The apartment has a very nice view of the mountains. Daniela, the host, was quick to respond to my queries and I felt well taken care of.
I would definitely recommend staying here, and hope to return.
Everything was great - Even challenges were handled quickly and host always available to help.  I would go back and recommend this place.

I recommend this place! Great quiet and peaceful location next to subway and supermarket. It’s a private building but zip housing owns many apts. Great Smart TVs in both rooms, plenty of closet space and a comfortable bathroom and shower. Needs a dish towel and more garbage bags please! Oh the Nespresso machine is a winner - I suggest buying your own pods! I felt safe and well taken care of here. Super high end area with plenty of walking areas and great restaurants within a short distance. Laundry is available in the building 1.400 Chilean pesos per load but very convenient with modern machines. Also WiFi was great - no issues with work / video calling. Be sure to get apt # plus code to get in before arrival to avoid any issues. The concierge doesn’t have any info to help you get in.  I’m definitely expecting to stay here again👍
Great location, the apartment is as seen on the pics and Ivan is quick to answer. Check in is fast and easy. Thanks !

I spent almost two weeks in Claudia's apartment and it was great. Close to public transport, bright and comfortable. Perfect for one or two people. A little loud during the day, but no trouble sleeping at night. Definitely recommend!
This Airbnb was most of what I was expected. Eduardo was a super host and the place is very well located.
Great place, great location. I loved my stay there and I would definitely recommend it to everyone.

We had a very nice stay at Mabel’s place. The apartment is clean, very well located, close to shops, offices and restaurants. Mabel and her staff were very gentle and responsive for all the needs. Totally recommended.
Great location, very friendly apartment staff, and Gonzalo was welcoming and easy to work with. Great experience.

I am lost for words in regards to Odette and Yarin's apartment! This was our first Air BnB and what a magnificent experience! We stayed for 14 days at both Rio Maule and Rio Paule .. Odette and her son Yarin were so hospitable.. They took care of our requirements and even helped when our laptop charger stopped working. Their on site housekeeper, Sara, was exceptional too. We will definitely be coming back to this Air BnB when we return to Chile! Thank you very much for your kind hospitality!
Americo was very nice, helpful, responsive and willing to help me find places to find food.  I'd recommend a stay at his place anytime.
Wow... what a view! Spent many hours just enjoying the balcony. The apartment was everything one needs. Clean, comfortable and close to everything. Felipe was an awesome host!

This is a fabulous apartment. The view are great. The kitchen is very well equipped. the broadband is fast. The beds are amongst the most comfortable I have slept on in an Airbnb. Overall a great place to stay and explore Santiago from. Ximena is also a very responsive host and gets back to you very quickly. The location is amazing and you can walk to central Santiago easily. There are also a lot of fantastic bars and restaurants right on the doorstep. I would definitely stay here again.

Stayed at Francisco's place for 3 weeks during the Christmas and NYE break.  The place is comfortable, well located, safe, and clean.  The host was easy to reach and flexible, allowing early check-in (landed from overnight flight).  Also provided weekly cleaning. Would definitely book again.
