The apartment is great for two or three people. We stayed there with our 3-year-old and he had enough space to play. The kitchen is very well equipped, the bed is very big and the living room is cozy. The area has a lot of parks, cafés and the metro station is not far away. We enjoyed our stay and everything went better than planned.
Love our stay, Felipe is an amazing host, who solved all our questions. Really nice view on the mountains and great restaurants nearby.

Everything as expected and advertised.
Great location.
Great communication.
Eduardo was helpful & friendly.
Philip's flat is just amazing and having the terrace it's def an added value. Very well located and Philip always ready to help you shall you need it. 120% recommended!

Walter is kind, the place is small and old but it's Ok.
I had to cancel my stay due clogged bathroom and infernal noise from a construction on the side.
Airbnb did not reinburse me the night, very bad user experience this time with them.
Gonzalo and David are the best hosts I have ever had! My trip to Santiago would have never been as good without them to which I am only too grateful! Seriously, they offer a home away from home!

I had such a lovely stay here! The apartment is beautiful (I got many compliments on the cool staircase in the background or beautiful painting behind me while on video calls while staying here). The area is super fun, close to parks and restaurants and coffeeshops. I highly recommend booking this place!

Camilo has a wonderful apartment. Its the second floor in a three story old style classic Providencia home. The apartment was clean and bright. A very comfortable place to relax. I would especially thank Camilo for the fast wifi (can never be taken for granted in Chile) and the basic supplies already available in the apartment (salt, pepper, oil, dish washing soap, etc). I would definitely come back!

Very nice place in a great location for a great price. We did have some problems with the wifi given we had to work from home under quarantine. Also the pool we were told that the pool wasn’t open for Airbnb units. The apartment was very clean except for under the couch, which had quite a bit of trash and dirt underneath.
Great location in providencia, amazing place, and very helpful host. You can count on Clara for anything. Make sure to check out the pool on top as well!!

If you’re looking for value, safety and unbelievable location look no further. It also helps this place is very stylish and tidy. I think more important than ever you want to book a location that’s safe, first. This was definitely the place. Central to shopping, restaurants, great cafe’s, public transport, and overall a nice ambiance and vibe to the neighborhood. Valentina was super attentive and fast responding before my trip and during my stay. The place is very clean and overall exceeded my expectations. I’ll likely book again with Valentina on my next stay.
Clean, minimal and in a great location. Perfect for a business trip. 100% recommended 👍

Very nice place to stay in central Santiago. Cristian was a super-easy to reach. I stayed for a little over a month and any time I needed something I got an extremely prompt response. Would stay again!

The place is amazing.  Very romantic even I was alone. There is a outside area very good to enjoy the time. The neighbor supports the users of the house and she is lovely very fast and helps a lot. At all the place is perfect.  Much over than my expectations. I loved it

Beautifully decorated in a perfect location in Santiago. My partner and I had dinner stros away the apartment at some great local restaurants with tables in the street. When Santiago went in full lockdown the host accommodated our stay and extended it without any problems. We worked from there for more than a week and never had an issue with the wifi. Excellent place to enjoy the city and also to shelter in place during the pandemic.

Philip's place is absolutely fantastic. If it is available for your stay, stop looking at other places and stay here. Internet was fast, air conditioner, shower, bed, hot tub, and outdoors are all top notch.
Wonderful place, Francisco is a really nice person, will help you when you need it the most. The place is also really good, with great wifi, a cozy place, and a great neighborhood. Really recommend.

Had a wonderful stay at Cristian' place - highly recommend it! Cristian was very easy to reach and clearly communicated everything we needed to know to enjoy our stay. The apartment is beautiful, with an incredible attention to detail and beautiful overall style. Check in was very easy and the apartment was clean, with everything that was needed for a pleasant stay. Highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment, lovely details, exceptionally clean, great neighbourhood, very easy to communicate with the owner. We would certainly stay here again!
The place was amazing and the level of care of the host is amazing. The apartment is very very clean, beautifully decorated and we had a delightful experience. I strongly recommend this place!

Excellent choice for Santiago, the apartment is new, well located, best place in Santiago. Only cleaning needs improvement as include once a week, but the ladies do it very quickly. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this place

Pretty apartment, good location and decent amenities. It could use a bit of maintenance (bed sheets show aging and tearing). Host was totally unresponsive on chat, problems reported via chat were not resolved and not acknowledged.

This is the best stay in Las Condes area.
I can tell this without any doubt because I have been in many different apartment during serval months.
Best choice!

Excellent apartment and location, went for 3 weeks and we stayed for 2 + months.
Felipe is a great host, always checking if we needed anything.

Jose's appartment is great. Furnished with love to detail, very cosy and clean. It is equipped with everything you could possibly need, even a dishwasher. Location is great too, lots of restaurants and a park nearby.
The building has a gym for free use and washing mashines for little money.
We enjoyed our stay very much. Can highly recommend this place!

The location was great, everything in the condominium very comfortable and cleaned, I highly recommend this place to others travelers. The only thing I would like to suggest a better wifi speed because it was little bit slow

This was by far the best experience ever. Host was always care about any issue, quite friendly and responsive. Formidable location close if you are on a business trip. Very warm considering I stayed during the cold Chilean winter. I would definitely stay there again.
The apartment has an excellent location, and great connectivity. Despite having a minor issue with the shower, Daniela and team were also extremely responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend!

No words to describe our host and her apartment. It was worth every dime we’ve spent to rent her place due to its location, safety and cost, in addition the cute decoration enhances the apartment’s beauty and makes it very cozy.
Valentina is a very committed host and provides a great guest service. We made it two hours earlier and she allowed us to check in right away.
I definitely recommend this place.
Thank you Valentina and family.
Nestor’s place is very well located! His house is nice as well. He was very nice and thoughtful with my mom, he always was attentive to any of her needs so 100% recommended!

Ximena’s apartment it’s well located and it has all what you might need and more in the kitchen !!!! Comfortable bed too.
She is easy to talk too and ready to help if you need it .
I highly recommend this place .

Thanks so much to both Maria Fernanda and Juan Pablo.     Amasing hosts, easy going and with a great sense of hospitality.    The apartment was just great and location super handy.     Much obliged to both Maria Fernanda and Juan Pablo.      Muchas gracias !!
I totally recommend this flat. It is close to public metro (really close) and it has all you may need for a nice stay.

The apartment is small and convenient. Located on the 17th floor with a corner window facing the city, views are fantastic. the host is attentive and the check in process is very smooth. Location is convenient, near the metro and on a commercial road with tons of restaurants.

A good apartment in a great area! We booked this apartment for the location and convenience to the main roads and metro. We also loved that there was plenty of space with the 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Mountain views were a bonus. We would book here again.
Super nice apartment close to the subway, stores, it comes super well equipped. The host was really kind and easy to communicate, would totally come again 😁

Great location. It’s a cheaper stay, so don’t expect much. The place was clean, but it could have been cleaner. As soon as we walked in, we were overwhelmed with the smell of the disinfectant spray cleaner. Bed was clean and comfortable. Overall good air bnb that I would come back to.
This apartment has a great location. We loved the shared patio, and the pool was nice after a day of skiing. Derek was proactive and responsive.
Clara is an outstanding host! She went the extra mile for us, communication was excellent! The apartment is in a very central location and delivers what it promises.
German was a super host. He was very responsive and took great care of my parents during the time they stayed at his place. The apartment is very well located. Highly recommended.

Very good location in a new building.
I wish the kitchen had more utensils; not great if you plan to cook. Apartment is also very small but at least it’s cozy so we didn’t mind much. Other than that the check in/check out was easy and we enjoyed our stay.

Great and nice place to stay. Beauty and very clean. Just 1 little things ( insulation on the walls) your can heard the top apartments. Mobile wifi is a great idea for Nicole (help a lot). Love the mix between modern and old of the building/apartment. Nicole are a great hostess.

This is a clean apartment in an excellent location. The host was very responsive and immediately fixed some relatively minor issues. The apartment will be fine for one or two people. Like many apartments in Santiago, it is small, and some of the fixtures show their age. Overall, a perfectly fine apartment that I would consider staying in again.
Her place has an amazing view and location, the bed is very comfortable and the communication with Marcia was prompt. I would stay again!

I spent my mandatory 5day quarantine in the flat and it was a great time. It's a very comfortable place with a great view and amazing balcony.
I have to praise the host who waited for me for more than an hour for checking in (as getting through the airport took longer than expected). She bought some fruit and vegetables for me for the quarantine and managed to get me a mobile wifi device with data so that I would have internet access.
She was extremely kind and helping; checking all the time whether I could need anything.
Thank you for being such a great host!
Excellent place to stay, with a perfect location nearby the subway and shopping’s. Be aware that cleaning is after 7 days of stay. The personnel is warm and the co-working space is amazing.
We had a great experience with my wife in this very cozy and comfortable apartment, with excellent location to shopping or transportation. You will really get your money’s worth.

Juan is the kindest and most welcoming host. He brought me food and takeaway during quarantine. I came at a slightly dodgy time in Chilean politics, and this flat was close to the protests. But if you are coming at any other time except mdid-October, it's a great location!

Great place! And the best part, is pet friendly!!!
We had an amazing time and we are definitely going back!!! We loved it!

Great place, everything as advertised, clean and nice, fast internet, huge TV.
A couple of notes:
1. the kitchen only has table knives, the kind with round tip and serrated blade, but no regular ones
2. for the check-in, the owner asked for my ID number, saying that it is needed to generate a QR code - if you're worried about your privacy, you can give any random number and it will work just fine

Clara's place has everything you need for your stay. I really appreciated that she communicated well and clearly and I knew she would always respond to my messages in a prompt manner.
It's in a good neighborhood -- very close to the subway and very easy to explore Providencia from there.

Perfect location and size for our stay! It had everything we needed to cook at home, lots of streaming options and a fun view from the balcony. We enjoyed staying here and would recommend to others! The host is helpful and communicative as well.

The place is even better than the pictures. THE VIEWS ARE AMAZING. Everything you may need is there. The building has all amenities and the location is perfect for a Santiago visit. Andres was always available and checked in on me from start to finish to ensure everything was good. RECOMMENDED AIRBNB!
This apt is excellent, I would totally stay again in my next trip to Santiago! 10/10
Great place to stay, next to some cool barrios! Plenty of space for two people or more.
Absolute recommendation to stay here. The design, cleanliness and location are exceptionally well. Great value for money, would stay here again anytime

Emelina & Miguel’s place has everything you need. I chose their place for the quarantine which I ended up not being required but still nice to have the fully equipped flat for myself. I’m pretty satisfied with what I got for the price I paid. Convenient location, enough equipment and amenities, smooth check-in/out and communication. Thank you Emelina & Miguel for hosting me:)

The apartment is great, just as discribed. It was easy to find and get in, location is close to lot of good restaurants and, although it may get a bit loud from the street bars some nights, it didn’t bother me.
Wifi worked well, beds were comfortable and everything worked well.
I would definitely stay there again.
10/10. I stayed for seven days here with my family, and we enjoyed it. Odette and Sara are friendly and helpful, and the place is clean, comfortable, and in an excellent location.
Gisela is responsive, warm, generous and staying with her was a gift. Her oasis is a true gem. Gracias Gisela!
Very comfortable and practical, in terms of location and the accommodation itself. Staff is helpful and kind.

Great location - walking distance to the red line metro makes for easy access to other parts of the city. The unit itself is really nice and the staff at the front desk are very helpful. The surrounding neighborhood feels very safe. The property owner was also great about communication as my flight into Santiago landed super early in the morning. I would definitely recommend staying here.
My only negatives were during the day the area and building were noisy (the noise from the hall especially), and the fitness center leaves a lot to be desired as it only has lighter weights and some cardio equipment. But these are only minor inconveniences, especially if you are looking for a home base while exploring the city.

A really nice little place, quite centrally located. Communication with Emelina and Miguel was very friendly and easy. The only thing I would say is that apartment is a lot smaller than the photos make it seem, but it has absolutely everything a traveller might need 🤗

Great location and clean apartment. We especially liked the decor and Cristian was very responsive. However, we had trouble sleeping due to the street noise. The window doesn’t close because of the air conditioning unit so you’ll get all the noise from outside. If you’re a heavy sleeper then I would recommend this apartment because of the other positives mentioned.

I really enjoyed my stay at Sky Hostel. The apartment offers stunning panoramic views of Santiago! It is spotless and very well-equipped (incl. washer, dishwasher). It is located in a wonderful neighborhood (Barrio Italia) filled with nice bars, restaurants and shops. I also enjoyed the gym and the fast Internet. Cris is an amazing host. He is very responsive and has excelled at offering me the most perfect stay. I would come back in a heartbeat.
Maria is so kind and welcoming! Her spot is a calm oasis in the midst of the busy city.

We had the best stay ever, the place is really nice and Philip did go out of his way to make our stay was as pleasant as possible - we also followed his to restaurant recommendations which we highly recommend as well. No negative part, we only wish we would be able to stay longer. Don’t even consider hotel options in Santiago, we tried the nicest hotels but would much rather stay at Philips place

Alexis and Casa are amazing hosts and the apartment was perfect! A quiet and relaxing apartment with an excellent location in the heart of Santiago. The apartment was very clean and modern. Wi-Fi was great and I was able to concentrate and work there. Everything was great, and communication was perfect. Highly recommend!

Cozy apartment in an awesome neighborhood (Providencia) with close access to local transportation, good restaurants and very central to many places in the city. The space was super functional and well equipped for long stays in a very safe location with 24/hr doorman. Clara was super responsive, helpful and polite in all of our interactions. Good stay and would definitely recommend it to everyone!

Everything as pictured. Gisela's casita is beautiful and a wonderful alternative to a highrise rental.  The garden is tranquil yet in the heart of the city.  The bed was extra comfortable and I appreciated the walk in shower. Gisela was an excellent and timely communicator and one of the best Airbnb hosts I've met.  I hope for an opportunity to return.

I am a picky guy. I have never rated a full five stars in all the areas to anyone thus far. First property and host that were spot on 5 stars all around.
This is the best best place you will stay in Santiago. Location is great, property is an absolute gem and host super prompt and helpful.

This is a modern apartment building but also has short term stay, the room has a balcony a working kitchen and a living area, the lobby includes a fabulous café, location is a very residential and beautiful neighborhood with an easy access to public transport. The staff is more than helpful. The only blemish is spotty Wi-Fi in the rooms. Good Wi-Fi in the lobby
Very tidy and lovely apartment. It was equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom. Martin y Sandra are great hosts. Easy to check in. We had a great stay. 5/5.

The apartment is exactly as described! It was clean and beautifully kept. Ximena was a great host, she supplied clean towels and sheets and always responded quickly to messages. The apartment itself is great, but it can be very noisy. There is construction during the day, and at night the apartment next door plays music loudly. Also, the building next door seems to have a rooftop party every weekend from 9 pm until 2 or 3 in the morning, which is incredibly loud and can make it hard to sleep.
We had a lovely stay at Victoria's appartement. It's very cosy, especially the balcony, and it's just as in the photos. Very close to Plaza de Armas and Cerro Santa Lucía. Highly recommend it!

Jose & Veronicas home was absolutely lovely to stay in for a couple days in Santiago. There were many thoughtful touches throughout the home, like the artwork, record player, and coffee table books. The apartment is also located in a fantastic area - so many good restaurants and bars right across the street!

Great place to stay. It has everything you need. Small but perfect for a short or medium stay. I totally recommend this place.
Great place for one or for a couple, it has a supermarket super close and a few places to eat really close by. Great location.

Lovely hotel, great location and value. Sadly upon checking out a day early, I have been unable to reclaim my room pre-authorisation fee to my credit card and the hotel have stopped responding, when I have been forward leaning to try and resolve the problem.
Can’t fault the hotel itself, but you should not have to chase your pre-authorisation fee after check out a week later. Hopefully this is sorted out promptly.
Great place,clean,and close to everything,,restaurants and subway.  Dominic is great,he allowed me to get in the apartment early. Really happy, I'll come back soon.

Incredible place! The view is spectacular, almost 180 degrees covering the northeast part of the city. The patio is a good size. And the master bed and bath was great. It was slightly awkward to work out of, because of outlet locations, but not too bad. Highly recommended.

Antonio's apartment was a lovely place to stay during our short trip to Santiago. It was a quick taxi ride away from the airport, a close walk to the LaStarria, Barrio Italia, and Recoletta neighborhoods, and had plenty of space for two people to stay in. Thanks for being so accommodating Antonio!

everything was great in this Airbnb. The host was very flexible , incredibly friendly and responded always within less than an hour. The apartment itself is very homey, clean and well located. It was a little bit bigger than it looks on the pictures and very well equipped. There’s only positive things to say about this place
This spacious apartment was very comfortable and in a nice neighborhood, convenient to Metro Line 1. First floor restaurant was very convenient and front desk staff were very helpful.

Maria José is a friendly and caring person, who was always responding very quickly.
The apartment is lovely and we enjoyed a lot the morning sun that is so delightful as well as the amazing view into the city of Santiago.
The location is perfect as it is only a 5 minutes walk to Cerro Santa Lucia and there are many nice places to eat and have coffe in the neighborhood. We would definitely recommend the place and are looking forward to come back soon.

Great place with everything included in a clean and safe part of Santiago with plenty of restaurants around. Easy communication with the host. It even came with a laundry machine (not mentioned in the advertisement). A nice welcome package as well. One of the best places I've stayed - 100% recommended!
Good location, nice apartment, well equipped for cooking, super fast wifi. They also stored our luggage for almost 3 weeks, which was a huge plus! Would stay there again :)

Felipe was an awesome host and surprised us with a complimentary bottle of wine during our check-in (only right since we were in Chile). He shared some great suggestions for our stay and even extended our checkout time to receive our Covid tests before traveling. Located in the heart of Providencia, Felipe’s location is an awesome place to stay in Santiago. Thanks again Felipe!

Highly recommendable. The apartments are well located in the centre (metro station, supermarket and shopping options within a few blocks away). They are modern, clean, well equipped (including AC, kitchen, fridge, shampoo, elevator, rooftop pool and terrace ) and very comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Alejandro. I enjoyed the stay and I’m looking forward to here stay again.

I would recommend for a short stay, near the metro and city center.
The location is not the best, you can hear noise from the street, and they say it is not very safe, yet I felt OK.

The Place met all my expectations and more! I was working and wifi connection was great, I didn't need to use the co-working space at all, I was ver comfy in my room. The covid measures were great, only 3 people at the time was allowed to book the swimming pool an hour, the staff was always super helpful and the cafe downstairs is delicious!!! I totally recommend this place.

I stayed for six weeks and enjoyed my time at The Place. They are in a great location and it is a really modern building. The staff is friendly and the common working area is quite nice. The room was  comfortable and I was quite happy that it had air conditioning.
Overall it was a nice place to stay in a good location.  We had a little bit of an issue with communication but still were able to get everything figured out.

Great stay at Felipes place. He was an excellent communicator and allowed us in early. It was a comfortable stay with all things needed! The room had AC which was a huge plus for hot summer days in Santiago. I’d recommend to say at Felipes apartment!
I had an incredible stay here! This was the most stocked kitchen I’ve ever seen at an Airbnb. I could see a lot of thought put into the layout of the apartment. I highly recommend staying here!

A great place in a great location. Very nice and well equipped apartment. The apartment contains absolutely all you need. The price charged was very reasonable compared with similar accommodation in the area.
The only thing I would suggest is a slightly more firm bed and pillows, but people who like soft beds will be pleased with this one.
Thanks for allowing me to stay

Very nice place, close to the financial district and the San Cristobal mountain, which is great for hikes. The apartment has air condition which is a huge + in the hot summerdays in Santiago. Easy check in and easy to get in and out.

Very nice room and hosts! We have problems with the address since Airbnb put the wrong number  but host was extremely helpful afterwards. I would only suggest the host to add a phone number to communicate in case of problems.

Felipe is an extremely helpful host and made the check in process easy for someone who’s never been to Chile before. His apartment has the perfect balcony for relaxing, and it overlooks cerro San cristobal with views of the surrounding Andes mountains. If you aren’t opposed to taking the subway it is very close to Salvador metro.

definitely recommendable! super clean, 30 mins walk from the main bus terminal (terminal sur) and an easy access to the airport (20 mins drive by car)... the appartment is close to a hotel standard, highly recommended!

It is very easy the communication with Patricia.
The apartment is very close to a lot of supermarkets, stores and bakeries.

Beautiful, very clean and well kept apartment. Location couldn’t be better. Shopping center, restaurants and subway within walking distance. A perfect base to enjoy Santiago at it best. Good communication with the host and friendly staff at the premises.

Great location for the price! We arrived just after the elections so there was graffiti all over the streets, but the area itself was very convenient and mostly everything is within walking distance (including the food). Great art district, and just outside the place are art vendors selling stuff along the sidewalk. The room itself serviced us well and we did have issues with the laundry room, but Dominic squared everything out.

Apartment is super clean and new. Close to the subway.
WiFi is amazingly fast! Very great for working remotely.
It’ll be great if more stuff in the kitchen e.g. oil, salt, pepper, dish soap etc.
I can hear cars on the road at night, so if you are a light sleeper bring a ear plug.
Overall, good place for staying.
Great building in an excellent location with friendly staff. It’s a two minute walk to the Escuela Militar metro station and a grocery store. It was a very comfortable stay with easy check in.

We loved this adorable apartment! Right by the metro and not far from various sights and neighborhoods if you’re up for some walking, plus Barrio Italia is right there and is a lovely area for dinner, cafes, etc. There’s even a corner store right downstairs to stock up on basic groceries.
We appreciated the ability to do laundry and the air conditioning, since we visited in summer and Santiago can get quite hot. Check in was simple, as Ines was waiting for us. And check out was even easier since there is a keypad instead of a physical key to enter the apartment. It was clean and just the amount of space we needed for two people.
A 3-story apartment with a FABULOUS design in the very center of Santiago and a beautiful backyard

Small but commodious two bedroom apartment very close to the centre of Santiago and also to La Vega, the central market, as well as Metro station. Check in was easy with the keys left at the concierge
👍
Great place to stay for + 3 people, beautiful apartment, great location. We had a beautiful time
Great apartment in the perfect location.  Very clean. Easy to check in and check out.  We absolutely loved it!

The stay was great! The apartment was exactly as pictured! The view is amazing and the location is very good. Maria José was extremely kind and supportive, super available to us and our questions. I really recommended this apartment if you are coming to Santiago!

A-MA-ZING !
Clara is the best, since one day before the arrival she was in contact with me, she is very good as a host, flexible and very veeery nice.
The apartment is perfect for 1 to 2 ppl ( ideally a couple), very clean, well maintained and the view from the rooftop is fab ! Pedro de Valdivia metro station is 5 minutes walking from the apartment door itself and you can easily walk and discover restaurants and bars whatever direction you walk to.
I would stay at Clara's again 110% as the apt also have all the extras that you need for a comfy stay.
Thanks soooo much Clara, all the best for you !
Camila.
Perfectly located, clean apartment with everything you need, including a rooftop that provides a great view over Santiago.
Great place! It’s close to lots of places but very quiet and safe. Host is great, will come back next time visit Santiago

Amazing location, amazing view of Santiago. Clean, easy check-in. Excellent neighbourhood, very alive with lots of restaurants and shops. Does not have a coffee machine (which was a huge downer for me - a coffee-a-holic). Kitchen is quite basic (two plates, no oven). No desk for remote working either.

Francisco was a great host and we enjoyed our stay very much. Great location in Providencia close to "Club Providencia". The apartment is located in a side street, so that it's very quiet at day and night. The kitchen is equipped with basic kitchen accessories, so that it's also possible to cook. Cafes and small shops are very close and can be reached by foot. Best wishes to Francisco.
Very nice Pool and comfortable bed. It felt a bit dangerous at night though and it needed more kitchen utensils. Good if you’re eating out most of the time. Very good communication with the host.

We had a great stay in Santiago here. The place is very clean and very modern and is in a very safe district in Santiago. It has a lovely rooftop pool and a lovely cafe at the bottom of the apartment block- both of which we really enjoyed! We look forward to returning!

Recommended if u are tourist pass by Santiago, very good location.
No recomend if u r coming for work, very noisy the night, very hard to sleep. Also very bad wifi.
Great location. Great communication. The place is a bit worn, but no surprises when compared to the photos

What a magical place. The location can’t be  beat - central to most places to visit in Santiago, but an oasis within the city.  The space is well equipped, the bed is super comfortable, and the outdoor space and garden are unforgettable.  Gisela, the owner, is super nice and welcoming.  If you’re looking for a relaxing place to call home while in Santiago, this is the place.

This is a rare place to stay! Gisela her kindness and honesty make you feel right at home. She has two lovely dogs and a very kind daughter that made our stay for 3 nights really perfect. Very comfortable studio, bed and bathroom. Cozy and beautiful garden. One of my best Airbnb experiences so far. Thank you Gisela for everything!

Osvaldo was a fantastic host. Communication was timely and helpful. He went out of his way to help us with Covid accommodations. The house was perfect and within close walking proximity to the city. If you are not used to living in the city, it can be a little bit loud from the nearby clubs. We felt very safe with the 24 hour doorman. Can’t say enough wonderful things!
nice and clean apartment.  very well located.  Miguel was an excellent host.  Very helpful for everything you need.  I would return
Nice apartment, clean and well organized. Host was very friendly and always responsive. Very good location if you like go shopping in the big Mall or go to the park.

If I could give 10 stars for this apartment and host I would. To start, Andres is the BEST host we have experienced (we have booked many Airbnb). Andres was very helpful, multiple times and very easy to work with. The apartment is in a great location with restaurants and parks walking distance. The apartment is very well appointed, has a great view and quiet during sleeping hours. we had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend this booking.

Fantastic location in Las Condes. Friendly staff and nice modern studios. Rooftop pool and lounge areas are great.
Only let down was that the cleaning / replacement of fresh towels was sporadic; sometimes it would happen consecutive days then miss for multiple days which was not ideal when only 1 towel each and a communal laundry area. Had to ask on 3 occasions for fresh towels.
Other than that the place is perfect and would highly recommend. Great cafe downstairs too.

Amazing apartment, we had the unit 201 which has a terrace with fake grass. Our stay was great. The washing mashing is not inside the apartment; you need to get a card at the lobby and load it with cash only…
The only downside was on the cleaning. The sofa had a lot of dog hair as they are pet friendly, we found accumulated dust mixed with pet and human hair on the floor in the living room and in the restroom.

The apartment is in the prime location of las Condes. Very close to Supermarkets, metro etc. Ariel is very well communicated to all my queries. And rooms are clean and he arranged everything that we needed. Contains all amenities. Well suited for all kind of travelers. Strongly recommended. Thanks Ariel once again.

The place is just amazing, right in the middle of everything!
The club’s life is very active by night but it didn’t bothered us at all.
During the day the place is very quiet and close to all the facilities such as subway, market (right below the apartment), lots of restaurants, etc.
The roof view (with the swimming pool) on Santiago at sunset is worth the price by itself.
The apartment is one of the best loft I’ve ever stayed, furnished with very good taste!
Felipe is a great host, the apartment has views for days and it’s super clean and comfy - fully recommend

Beautiful apartment, wonderful amenities, lovely, quiet and secure. This gorgeous apartment is tucked into a little street next to a great cafe and walking distance to grocery stores and beautiful sight seeing.
Alexis is a warm and welcoming host, with great English that was really helpful when we first arrived - he was always easy to contact and happy to help!
We have already booked another stay here and can't wait to go back - an absolute haven from the bustling streets of beautiful Santiago. The best place to stay in the city!
Maravilloso anfritión! Hermoso apartamento! Barrio Maravilloso! Nosotros queremos volver!

Antonio’s place is comfortable, clean and conveniently located. I went to the terrace on my last night and wish that I’d gone upstairs everyday! The sunset is amazing. Staff downstairs are incredibly helpful. I highly recommend you stay if you feel comfortable speaking Spanish as most people here probably do not. Antonio also went above and beyond to let me check out late as well.
Great place to stay. Especially loved the rooftop pool and coworking space. Perfect for working from Santiago for a while. Would come back :)

This was a great place to stay while working remotely. WiFi worked well, the workspace downstairs was great, and the beds were comfortable. Wish the hall noise was less noticeable in the rooms, but that’s the only minor complaint
Nice apartment, great location, just like in the pictures...has a great cafe right across the street!

Gonzalo replied very quickly to our questions, both before booking and during our stay.
The apartment is well located, has a nice view of the city and the internet connection works very well.
The apartment location was in a lovely area of Santiago, about eight blocks from the nearest Metro stop. Cristobal and Valentina were very helpful and their English was excellent.

Álvaros place is a real gem! We loved it and felt very welcome. Great service and support and he always did his best to help us. The flat itself is really nice and perfect for a visit to the city - spacious, artsy and clean, oh and there was a pool at the roof top which we could use and really enjoyed! It's located centrally in a buzzing part of town with lots of bars and restaurants around the corner. Highly recommended!
The flat is just perfect, we had a great stay! It was very easy to communicate with Valentina and Cristobal. We highly recomand this place!
Great Apartment, perfect location close to metro and city. It was very clean and had all the things you could possibly need! Hosts were lovely and gave some great advice. loved our stay here!
Very good stay at the nice and charming and original apartment. All you could need, was there.
Great location and easy checkin/out. Friendly concierge. Baco and bistro ambrosia across the street! Enjoyed very much.

Beautiful appartment in really nice neighborhood, very nice view from balkony, Near to Metro and bus, central in Providencia, near to City Center and Bellavista and a little walk to Costanera Tower with big supermarket and shopping mall. Appartment is very quiet, nice 24h Concierge Service. Nice little kitchen with everything you need and with a good air conditioner and washing machine. Very nice Host with outstanding effort and very good and very fast communication. 100% recommendable!

Excellent location! Mere steps away from public transportation, restaurants, stores, you name it. But at the same time, conveniently tucked away to avoid traffic. It's perfect for a single person or a couple. Also, do remember to use the pool at the top of the building, with an awesome view of Santiago. Loved it!
Beautiful space and a magnificent roof deck! Osvaldo was also extremely helpful in the days leading up and communication was great. Only issue was the noise levels, definitely bring ear plugs.
Carla is a very attentive host. The apartment is well located with a great view. Good spot for a couple who is in town to explore Santiago.

The location of the apartment is very good and it has an amazing view especially from the rooftop terrace. Unfortunately the apartment itself is very dirty and not so well equiped. Some of the dishes were still dirty, probably because there was no possibility to properly wash them. The walls and floor is greasy and the bed not very confortable. Overall the interior is pretty cheap and only the most necessary. Probably okay if one doesn't spend time in the room other then to sleep. Even though the apartment is high up, it was very loud during the day and the fridge is loud during the night.

Absolutely 5 ⭐️ star. I love staying here. It’s a beautiful apartment, clean and new. The common spaces are gorgeous and the café is fun and delicious. This is the best Airbnb in Santiago!!!! I highly recommend it ❤️💛🧡

Great place to stay for a short or long visit while enjoying the city! I had to WFH and the Internet worked perfectly, coffee shop in the ground floor was unreal, people super helpful, the bed was very comfy and you have everything you need to enjoy a pleasant stay.

Perfect spot for getting my feet in Santiago. Easy check in, centrally located, private, and a very comfortable bed. As other reviewers mentioned, there is some street noise and noise from other apartments, but some earplugs do the trick.

A great apartment in the center of Santiago. With everything that I needed for the two weeks that I was there. The location was great for me to work during the day and also to know the city in my free time. I can only recommend to all the airbnb community.

This Air BnB is an excellent and clean place to stay in a great location in Santiago. Jean and Claudia were awesome Hosts and very helpful, they kept great communication. I would reccomend this place if your travelling to Santiago!

Cute little house with everything needed for a nice weekend. The path down to the river is a little steep but well maintained. The picnic area down by the river is perfect - shaded with many access areas and seating choices. We had a fantastic time and will return!

The host has been very flexible about me checking in a little earlier than planned. This was highly appreciated from my part after a very long travel! The apartment is cosy and you feel secure having people at the reception of the building at all time.
The flat is situated downtown and easily accessible from various train stations and a few minutes walk from the Metropolitan Cathedral.
This being said, you also get the city life vibes and it can get loud at night. But for a couple of days it is just fine. Thank you again Borealis!
Great green oasis in nice neighborhood of santiago. Gisela is a great & very caring host who will do everything to make your stay as pleassant as possible.
Perfect location for shops, bars & restaurants, and nearby metro. Sandra allowed me to drop off my luggage before the check-in, which was a very helpful, and was very responsive with communication.

Heads up…. Traveling and booking during covid.  It’s best to order your place only if and when you know something won’t change plans regarding the pandemic. Although all is well..  rebooking airline and air B and B was difficult but that was just specific to my situation..  yes I will try again …

Great chic and cozy apartment close to subway, groceries and restaurants. Location is a safe and walkable area. Apartment was clean and well laid out. We appreciated the use of the washing machine too. We mostly ate in due to Covid restrictions and ease for our family of 4. Kitchen well stocked.

The place of Álvaro is really nice, and the pool with the view over the city on the top floor was amazing. We got a pleasant welcome. The neighbourhood is very lively, with a lot of restaurants and bars around.

very nice host, fast response. WiFi didnt work but solved it well with a SIM and tried to find the best solution on short term. appartement is small but has all the stuff you need for a nice stay in the centre of Santiago.

Great apartment, great location within easy access of the bank, grocery store and Metro. A very pleasant neighbourhood. Apartment is well-maintained but could do with a few more pieces of china and some additional utensils. Certain items have seen better days but otherwise, no complaints.

What a wonderful gem! We loved staying here, the patio in the back is a true find. We were very happy overall, and cannot thank Veronica and Jose enough for their kindness and prompt responses. They recommended us to many great locations and were lovely hosts.

Super place with a super host, we had an excellent stay and I will definitely try and stay again on my next trip. The location is great, it's a very safe neighbourhood and the building is very new with everything you need including laundry, pool and gym. The suite was well appointed and had lots of extra touches to make it an easy comfortable place to stay and it has a amazing view as well.
It was a quick stay at Pepe’s accommodation, but location was good and check in and communication process easy.

I’ve stayed with Odette four times now. The apartments she hosts are centrally located, always clean and well maintained. She is an attentive host, always quick to respond to any questions or concerns. I will continue to go back.
Anita and her husband are amazing, welcoming hosts who I really enjoyed getting to know. The room and apartment are very comfortable. Located in a great neighborhood to get to know the city.

Had an amazing time at Claudia’s! The apartment has everything you would need for a comfortable stay. Well-stocked kitchen, amazing shower, nice balcony to sit out on, a comfortable bed and super fast wifi.
Location is great too. Plenty of bars/restaurants fairly close by. Supermarkets are walking distance and the metro only a 2 minute walk away which made it easy to get around Santiago.
Claudia’s communication was always excellent, she was very attentive and making sure I was comfortable. I would highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Santiago!

The best trip experience ever. Anita and Abraham made me feel family. Perfect conversation, perfect advices of what to do near there, always worried about making you enjoy your trip and making you feel as confortable as possible. Perfect place, you can make your tourism by walking, confortable room, good bathroom and perfect breakfast. Couldn’t be more grateful.
Lovely place on a very central location. Lucia is always willing to accommodate guest needs and answers any query promptly.

Amazing location! In the center of the business in Bellavista. The pool is the best spot to watch the evening sun setting!
The loft is super cute and clean, and the host responds super quick.
There is 24/7 reception which felt super safe :)

Juan is an excellent and dependable host. He is very attentive to detail and has excellent communication. The home is beautiful and perfect for my son and husband. The views are gorgeous! Highly recommend Juan’s condo!
We had a wonderful time at Cristian’s. The Airbnb was super cool and in a great location. Definitely recommend!

We booked with Vesna after several other hosts canceled so we appreciated her accommodation and good communication.  The space is comfortable enough but the biggest challenge for us was that the apartment was VERY hot with only a small fan and it was tough to cool off even at night.  The apartment is quite small. We also had an issue with water pressure which I reported to Vesna. I would recommend looking at her other properties in the building if you need more space or are concerned about the heat.
Enjoyed our stay here very much, Yeny was very helpful and communicative with the check in process and with recommendations for the area. The place was very comfortable
Best host ever!!! Totally recommended! We loved our stay at Juans place - everything was perfect. The apartment was super cozy, we’d love to come back someday.

The kindest most hospitable host you could ever ask for, Sussan went above and beyond, always - to help us feel comfortable and welcomed in the city.
Her flat was beautiful, light, comfortable and clean with a pretty terrace you could relax on. We just wish we could have stayed there for longer, and spent more time with Sussan also! A truly amazing find.

Elizabeth is so nice and always quick reply. Accommodation was awesome, clean, safe location, private room, terrace!
Thank you for everything and I could spend good time on my last day of Chile.

we had an enjoyable and comfortable stay here during the summer in Santiago. the apartment is in a secured-building, with great facilities (cafe, pharmacy, market, etc) and metro station on the doorstep. the view from the balcony was a great addition. thanks again

A good value for money stay in Santiago. Check-in process was smooth with keys at reception and Patricio was very quick to respond to any questions. Apartment is fine, although be aware its really two separate apartments connected with a shared entrance. 2 double beds, then a room with 2 bunk beds. Everything you need but fixtures and fittings are looking on the tired side, with raggedy towels.
A good value option if you want to be getting out to explore Santiago.
We enjoyed our one night stay. Jean's mother, Claudia met us and checked us in. she was very sweet.

The apartment is very comfortable and in s good location, right next to a metro station and many shops and grocery stores. The communication with Luis was very good, he made sure that our stay was perfect. The apartment is just like the pictures and has everything you need for a short stay.
Great location! Daniela was very communicative and helpful! A little more more outdated and musty than the photos but great spot nonetheless!!

The apartment was lovely and well kept. Ximena was responsive to all our needs. The apartment also has a beautiful rooftop pool and a warm water pool in the basement. The apartment is also well located next to Parc Arauco. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely recommend Ximena's apartment ❤️

Stayed here for 6 weeks with my wife. spacious and bright with a nice layout. we loved the view and balcony. strong water pressure. stable WiFi. concierge are all very nice and accommodating. only complaint is that during our stay the street noise was very loud. on nice summer nights the sound of bars, bar goer's and cars would last until 5 am. noise gets worse after the bars close. for shorter stays this is likely less of an issue.

Apartment with private parking, very well positioned in Providencia with a lot of services all around. The private balcony and its view are really enjoyable. Natalia was very attentive and the communication was fast and effective. Thank you.

Central location in artsy neighborhood. Very clean apartment with a lovely view. The windows are effective at blocking the noise that comes from the clubs at night. Álvaro was a great help at checkin  and was readily available during our stay  for assistance. We would definitely stay here again.
The apartment is in a great location in Santiago. It’s very cozy, comfortable and clean. It also has a great view to the mountains which makes it lovely!

Fast response from the host, easy check-in and out, fast internet (280 mbps download). Basic amenities but bed sheets and towels were clean. Lots of restaurants and bars around. super loud music between 10pm-5am. if you love night life and clubs, this is the place. Otherwise, book somewhere else. The noise level at night was unbearable but everything went back to normal during the day.
Staying here was great. the location is perfect and central, the communication with German is very clear and good and the appartement it self has an amazing view and is beautifull
The Oasis is the perfect place to relax and enjoy historic  Santiago . We would not hesitate to return.it is small but efficient and is well equipped.

Here is a perfect calm spot in the middle of Stgo.
First class service, very friendly host and staff.
Gracias🙏

Fantastic and lovely building that is located near to major metro station, but also just far enough off the main road that it is quiet. The co-working space and cafe were perfect and the rooftop pool had wonderful views. Highly recommend and will look to stay here again on future trips.
This was a great place to stay to explore central Santiago. It was very clean and had all the essentials. Gonzalo was also very communicative and helpful host.
Very nice place in a very good location. Very good response from Pablo. I will stay there again
This is our second time here and it continues to be our favorite place to stay in Santiago. It is perfect!!!

Álvaro’s loft was a great place to stay in Santiago. Excellent value, great location, and Álvaro is an amazing communicator and super helpful— he really goes the extra mile to ensure that you are having a good stay.

We had such a wonderful stay at Osvaldo’s apartment. The space was so beautifully done, cozy with eclectic and worldly decor. Just down the street were wonderful eateries and bars, and it was so close to other areas of Santiago to explore by foot. The building felt super safe with the doorman downstairs, and the views from the roof were fantastic! Definitely recommend staying here in Santiago.

Excellent apartment for our stay in Santiago! Ximena was very helpful answering any questions we had. Check in is very easy. The location was great and had an amazing view (especially during sunset!) 2 bathrooms with showers, and a well equipped kitchen. A bit noisy at night due to the area but overall a very great stay!
We really enjoyed our stay in this very nice and spacious apartment with big balcony. There’s also a cool café downstairs where they serve good coffee and food!
I really liked the accommodation, good sector, everything very calm and quiet at night and it is located in one of the best sectors of santiago, I will be back.

This is the absolute best location imaginable in Santiago. Tucked in a courtyard of restaurants, steps away from all that Lastarria has to offer, walkable to most places in central Santiago, and near a Metro stop for anything further away. We can’t recommend it enough. Thank you Catalina for the perfect perch in Santiago. We hope to always stay here whenever we are lucky enough to return ❤️
What a fantastic apartment! Great location, bright and stylish and reasonably priced. Alexis and Zule were lovely hosts - friendly, helpful and welcoming. I recommend everything about staying here! 🙂
We had a very nice stay at Ximena’s apartment. It was very clean and really easy to communicate with.

Jose was a great host, from the first moment very responsive and delivered all the important information in a timely manner, the apartment is tastefully decorated and has everything you’d expect and need in an excellent location.
Great location for all things in Santiago. The only negatives were that it was not very clean and the wifi was spotty.

This apartment is in a clean, modern building in an excellent neighborhood. About a 20 minute stroll to a street full of good restaurants. Just steps from a grocery store and the metro. A couple of things needed fixing, and the response and remedy was quick.

Very spacious 2 bedroom with 2 bathrooms. It also has a pull out couch in the living room. The beds are very comfortable and nicely sheeted. Great location and overall just great experience! I would recommend this apartment to anyone!

The loft is very nice and in an excellent location. The place itself is very spacious and comfortable. The rooftop is an extra special addition; wonderful for an evening drink or coffee in the morning to enjoy views of Santiago. Osvaldo was very thorough and helpful as well.

Listing shows a gym and pool but guests are not actually allowed to use them. Still working with Airbnb to get a partial refund.
Location looks out on a noisy highway. Place was ok with regard to cleanliness. Old stained sheets and towels. No toiletries provided. Host was slow to communicate.

Mabel, her husband and her team were very nice, even checking us in at 4.30 am. Great location with plenty of restaurants, shopping opportunities and the park nearby. The apartment is comfortable and has everything one needs. It is a bit lived in but well maintained. The price is a bit steep for the value.

Very happy with our stay. Ñuñoa is a lovely neighbourhood and the location is great for shops and transport links. The flat is perfect for a single person or a couple. We also managed to take a dip in the pool on the roof top. Ignacio is a very friendly and responsive host. We decided to hire a car and he arranged parking straight away. Santiago is a beautiful and vibrant city, and I can highly recommend a visit and a stay at this flat.
Mercedes was very down to earth and very responsive whenever I had any question or concern. The place was very neat I would definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Great apartment in cool area. Look out for women waving at you to lure you in to their happy hour bars. There is also a great chap selling wine behind a counter next to a fried  chicken cafe. Ask at reception for the pool and enjoy a swim with the most amazing views. Go to the museum of pre Chilean history to find out about the Mapuche peoples. Great gift shop. Get a bip card for the amazing metro. Flat is quiet and very nice and Clara super supportive and communicative.

Great location. Host is a good communicator. I would recommend this place if you don't plan to stay in it all the time. I stayed for night and it was perfect.
It's on a low level so you can hear the buildings air-conditioning. The unit is also small so you hear the electronics like the fridge people coming out of the elevator

Great little apartment near Bellas Artes museum.
Super location, comfy and good value for money.
Manuel was very accommodating and quick to reply.
Highly recommended!

The space was very up to date and thoughtfully designed and decorated. Even though it was a small loft, the design provided plenty of space for 2 people and all the amenities we needed. Christian was very responsive and answered all of our questions. We had an amazing stay!

Amazing hospitality, great communication, beautiful apartment, close to beautiful parks and museums. Quiet and tranquil.
We have traveled around the world for two years now and this is the BEST Airbnb we have experienced.
We recommend it to everyone we meet in Chile
Cristobals Apartment was really nice and we felt there like at home. I can warmly recommend this apartment and Cristobal 🤞

We loved staying here. The apartment was clean and had all the conveniences we needed for an amazing stay in Santiago. The Bella Vista neighborhood has amazing character and was so much fun to walk around during the day and night. Ximena was very easy to communicate with and helpful with getting us settled. The only criticism I have is the door is a little tricky to use at first . We look forward to staying here again next time we're in Santiago.
Good view, responsive host, Wifi is good, and solid location. The apartment can be a bit warm for some.
Fantastic location! The apartment is just steps from the metro and an easy walk to San Cristobal park and a lot of great restaurants. The bed was comfortable and the air conditioning worked great.

Loved this cozy apartment right in the center of Santiago! The location was super convenient and fun- shops and cafes right downstairs as well as the metro right around the corner. If you’ll be exploring a lot this is the perfect place.
Great apartment as advertised in photos. Air conditioning worked well in the bedroom which was important for me.
Small spot perfect to crash in couple of nights . Very well located, just 2 min walk to the metro Station and few blocks from Costanera Mall.
Was a good location and nice experience to stay, quick response, and always feel home welcomed staying in Catalina’s place
We want to live in this appartment and this place. Perfect appartment, gym, coworking offices, cafè, pool etc. etc.
Nice appartment, clean and right next to the bus station for early morning bus out or to the airport. Otherwise a few subway stations from downtown.

A very beautiful home located near shops, restaurants, hiking trails and parks. Mabel and her helpers were great with communication and helping us anytime we needed anything. The house cleaner also does an amazing job every week making the place feel like a home and hotel at the same time. Definitely worth a stay if you're in Santiago!
I absolutely loved this place, it is in an excellent location, close walking distance from the Metro Station and grocery store, park and fun neighborhood Barrio Italia!!!
Gonzalo was a wonderful host  super helpful and quick to reply. The place was just as advertised with a great view of the city. Cozy and functional. I had a great experience.

The appartment was very nice, clean and included everything what you need for a stay. The check in and out was easy and perfect. Rodolfo is a very nice guy and we will come again if we go again to Santiago. ;)

Everything was uncomplicated with Patricio: check-in and -out, communication, staying one day longer.
The flat is small but very comfortable: As it's facing northwards, it doesn't heat up by sunshine, and as it's in the 23d floor, you have a fantastic view and don't hear the noises of the street. The metro-station is 3 Minutes away and you only need 10 Minutes to get to a very nice barrio to eat and drink.

Our stay at Paula's place was wonderful! The apartment has everything you need for a short stay and the hosts are incredible. They shared lots of great information about the area with us and helped us organize a taxi for a very early morning flight when we were leaving Santiago. We would definitely stay here again in the future!

Really nice, new, and quiet apartment with a great 180-degree view form de balcony. It comes with a good kitchen with new equipment, and with a dishwasher. In the apartment you have also a high-quality washing machine, which is very useful for a longer stay (also with hot water program!). Bigger supermarkets and the metro stations are in short walking distance. Mini-Markets and Botillerias are directly in the neighborhood. Other shops, restaurants and bars are along the street.
Easy and fast check-in/check-out. Very kind and fast communication with Cristóbal. Many thanks.

The apartment is just as pictured, adequate for 1 or 2 people and in a good location. During the stay we didn't have enough toilet paper, the wifi didn't work for 3 days, and the pool was closed due to COVID.
Great location! the apartment is perfect for one person  it has all what you need, and the neighbourhood is lovely.

The apartment has a great location in the Bellas Artes neighborhood. Close to Plaza de Armas, and several wonderful parks. Bernabe goes out of his way to take care of anything you may need (airport pickups, provides a selection of items for breakfast, etc). The Wi-Fi is sufficient to stream / work if needed. Thanks for a nice stay, Bernabe!
Very tasteful apartment in a cool part of town. Cristian communicated well. The streets are a bit noisy but other than that great stay. Thanks
A great host at a great location.  I recommend staying here if you want to exploring Santiago!
Very comfortable flat, with everything you need and well located. The gym was unfortunately unavailable but the pool is great to cool off! Vesna was quick to respond to my queries!

The apartment is great. The location is close to Metro Station of Los Diminicos, and walk distance to Supermarket Santa Isabella. The apartment itself is well organized, with full set of assets of Kitchen. Two separate bathrooms are really helpful when you are not alone.

This apartment is very cozy and is perfect for a short stay. The location is perfect, since it's in the heart of Providencia close to everything you need. You would think it's noisy but it's surprisingly not!
I would recommend having a few basics for cooking, like oil and salt, and a drying cloth.
There was just a detail in the bathroom cleanliness which was quickly solved.
The staff is very very attentive, extra thumbs up for them!

The best apartment in Santiago.
The best location, the best neighbourhood, a wonderful stylish apartment that match the pictures perfectly and a great host - so very helpful and kind.
It is not big, but we lived there for 3 months, and it felt like home.
This apartment will be our first choice when visiting Santiago.
this is my second stay. I like the Palenta appartment. though los conquistados road is busy it's quite at night. the host is easy to communicate with
Lovely place. Great communication with Sofia. We enjoyed the pool and the surrounding areas. I wish I had more time to stay there
This place is awesome.  The appliances are are new and the location is ideal to explore the providencia and surrounding neighborhoods.  Close to the metro station, I highly recommend this place!
The apartment is comfortable with all the basics needed after a day enjoying Santiago. Emelina and Miguel are good communicators and keen to ensure that you have a pleasant stay.

Amazing host! This apartment is in THE greatest location in the entire city (in my opinion!). Surrounded by some of the best restaurants in Santiago. Catalina was great to work with, effortlessly extended my stay after I originally booked, & was extremely kind throughout. Check in was seamless & every person that works the front desk is extremely kind & personable. When I return to Santiago, I will absolutely be staying in the same place.

I really enjoyed this stay. The place was clean, pretty and well located. No noise during the nights. The café downstairs is good and with a great atmosphere. I will definitely considering for my next visit to Santiago.
Very comfortable place, helpful host, we had a great stay! Little bit noisy from the main road but not annoyingly.

Andres is a  great host, friendly and very helpful. The apartment is located in an amazing and safe location. The best apt in Santiago. The place is clean, well decorated and the view is amazing. I hope to be back soon.
Very well furnished flat in the center of Santiago, with a metro station closeby. The hosts were also extremely helpful! To be recommended

The location is fine but the apartment is very dirty.  The walls are dirty, kitchen table is dirty, the floor was dirty, the couch and bed spreads are ripped and stained, it smelled funny.  The furniture is different than in the photos.   We were woken up both nights at 3:00 for the garbage truck. I tried to use the washer/dryer but the cards would work so I had to walk the laundry a few blocks away and pay there.

One of the best places I have been!
On the 29th floor, you really get quite above it all - relatively quiet for being the busiest area in a metropolis. Looks south to Avenida Manquehue and the mountains. Check in was a breeze with the reception and smart lock. Jessica is a particularly kind and attentive host, she even brought me a smoothie maker upon request. The place itself invites for relaxation and work flow - a well stocked kitchen, comfortable living, balcony for contemplation, well decorared space and high quality fabrics.

5 stars all around! This apartment is in an awesome location with so much within a few blocks! The view from the balcony is gorgeous for sunrises!
The security is top notch and you won't hear any noise from the neighbors!
There is a great playground on the property open and available for the kids to enjoy! A very walkable area, you can't beat the location and the price is great for Santiago!

This apartment is great! We stayed for 2 weeks and it really felt like a home - spacious, thoughtfully decorated and well equipped. We especially appreciated the two bathrooms, the large desk and the balconies. It was also nice to have a washer available. The location is perfect, much quieter than Providencia and still close to everything. Ariel was communicative and provided a toaster and extra towels when we asked.

The appartment is fantastic, well mantained, clean and with everything needed for the stay.  The location is perfect pretty close to mall, supermarket, restaurants and entertainment.  Ximena was very kind and always available to respond.  Fully recommended, perfect fit for 4.

Clean, good location, and good communication. In the middle of the city so there is some city noise (as to be expected). The apartment had a great view, a nice balcony, and was walking distance to sites and restaurants. Self check-in was quick and easy. I would recommend this apartment and would stay again!
Gabriel was a great host, made our check in and out very smooth. The place is amazing, very quiet with a beautiful view. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Excellent experience. Communication before arrival was very accurate, help was continuously provided it asked for it during the trip. The room itself is very high standard, kitchen has got all supplies you could ask for, the bed is comfortable and the bathroom facilities are excellent. I would really have loved to use the pool upstairs, however it had already closed down for the season. The building is very secure, location is excellent. If I were to return to Santiago I would probably book the same accomodation.
A very nice apartment, sunny, with an amazing view, great facilities. Special mention for the smooth communication with the owner, I recommend this place

I was in Santiago for a month for work purposes and it was the ideal place, close to the Metro station, supermarket, coffee shops, a couple of restaurants, a park nearby, and it's cleaned weekly.
On the downside, it's close to a main street so if you are a light sleeper it might be an issue, for the rest of it, it's a great place.
Very nice and clean apartment! The host helps you with everything and is very flexible regarding to check in time! Thanks again Alexis :)

Anita was absolutely fabulous, and such a great host. It was lovely to stay so locally, and she was the perfect representative for the lovely folk of Chile. The room was immaculate, as describes and very comfortable. Breakfast on the terrace in the morning was just what the doctor ordered. Such a great experience, I had to give her a big hug at the end. This is what Air B&B is about.
Maria is a wonderful host, taking my reservation an hour before I checked in. She is kind, clear, and the suite is clean and comfortable.
Nicole is a great host, she was always supportive throughout my stay in her place. Moreover, the apartment is great and it is located in a great region of Santiago.

Alvaro was the most welcoming host, and made us feel at home and taken care of.
The duplex apartment had an amazing view to the city, which was incredible to wake up to.

Jean is quick to answer and Claudia made us feel very comfortable. The apartment was clean and well equipped for our short stay - wifi worked great during meetings, the metro, supermarket, pharmacy and money exchange places are nearby. Nice and lively street by day, with lots of students.
Very well located and clean.  Very responsive host.  You must also try the little cafe that just opened next door!  Best breakfast and coffee we had the entire trip!!

Cozy, good location and has everything you need for a good stay. Aracelly and the building’s staff are super helpful too!
Recommended ✅

The perfect stay for your trip to Santiago! The balcony and windows made for the best natural light in the morning and a beautiful view at night. Providencia is a fun area, which I found to be well located between Bellavista and Vitacura. Provided all the basic necessities to make it feel like we were at home.

Decent place to stay in Santiago.  It is a private building with a great rooftop view.  The balcony view was the reason I booked, and it didn’t disappoint.  I enjoyed many hours just sitting and gazing at the city and mountains.  That being said, the apartment is on 11, not quite half way up the building.  The view in the pictures is not the actual view, as the pictures show a view from higher up.  Still very nice view.  The building is a little worn out and the apartment as well, but it was comfortable.  Good communication.  Gonzalo was very easy to work with.

This apartment is really nice and the perfect location on our favorite street in Santiago. The balcony is wonderful. We did have a problem with pigeons making their way into the roof above the room, which was rather loud at night. I would check to make sure this problem has been solved before renting. But otherwise a perfect apartment.

Great location, smooth check-in and very clean and well-kept apartment. Friendly host as well, who took the time to explain all details during the check-in and made our stay easy and comfortable. We would recommend it highly!

Neighbourhood is conveniently located, walking distance to a major mall. Building is full amenity, modern, well managed. Apartment is well appointed, with all the necessities and a commanding view of the city and the full mountain range. Andres is a gracious, responsive and attentive host. We enjoyed 7 day stay here and would come back and recommend

It is an amazing and beautiful flat with all the comforts, the pictures you are seeing are completely accurate. Alvaro is an excellent host , always attentive to any questions from the beginning ‘til the end. If you are coming to visit Chile, I will recommend this flat without any doubt. Close to museum, zoo, restaurant and more.
Amazing location, close proximity to metro, amenities and trendy neighborhood. As noted by other reviews, street can be a little noisy at night.

Five stars all around. Great location. Well decorated and cleaned space. Super secure apartment building. Doorman and neighbors are very friendly too. Stunning view from the balcony. I love that the host provided detailed instructions for everything and even left a public transportation card for guests to use. If I ever come back to Santiago, I would stay here again. :)

Very clean, beautiful building and apartment.
The location is not the best for getting in and out of the building. A bit of traffic and big highways. Although there is parque Araucano right around the corner is not the best spot to go for a walk with a baby as you get out to a big traffic area. But once you are in the building/apartment is very beautiful and safe.
I recommend this place for people travelling without kids!
The appartement is very comfortable with beautiful view. It has everything that is needed for a stay in Santiago. Antonio answers quickly and let us check in earlier.
Accurate, nice, great location..... Super nice Team of people working there and in the cafe, too! Recommended.
Amazing host by Claudia, very friendly, good and quite neighborhood. The house is very clean and the kitchen is free to use.

I recommend Alvaros place whether staying for a few days or  for longer.  Alvaro was a great host, very accomodating and available, he meet me at the AirBNB and showed me everything the place had, and where locals supermarkets were etc.  The sunset from the large windows were amazing, the bed was super comfy and shower hot.  The art and vibe of the place was inviting, 5 stars Alvaro

Relaxing stay with an amazing balcony view and location. Jose is a kind host who looks after his guests. This was one of the most fully equipped Airbnb I've stayed at,  from a complimentary bottle of water to different tea pots utensils and all you need items, more than you can think off (and dishwasher was a bonus!). I liked the interior design details, the warm touches. The bed, sheets and pillows were top quality. Loved the balcony and view, contrast of the mountains with high rises! Safe location with professional and friendly 24hr concierge. Thanks! Lisa

Our first trip to Chile but certainly not our last, thanks to our host Sue and her Airbnb. We had an overall great experience in Sue's apartment and the location was perfect with easy access to the metro, mercado and the rest of the city. Sue was also very helpful with her local tips of places to go and visit and even brought us fresh fruits from the local farmer's markets. The fruit salad was muy delicioso!
Fernando an excellent host always taking care to the needs and very friendly. The apt could not be better located and the view is amazing

Great stay. I had a small leak in the kitchen faucet and they arrived the same day to fix it. The shower water loses heat after about 10 minutes, if that matters to you. The internet was great and the bed was good. No complaints from me. Thanks!

The apartment was nice. The location is really good, there are many restaurants and bars in the neighborhood but the apartment is still really quiet. It has everything you need for a few days in Santiago. Alejandra is a kind host who answers fast and the communication is really easy.
This location was great. Right in centro everything was walking distance. The studio is inside a guarded apartment with doormen so super safe.

Gerardo's spot is perfect. We love the neighborhood and it had everything we needed to enjoy a short visit in Santiago. Gerardo was amazing to communicate with and very friendly. Definitely recommend staying here.
Nestor was a great host, very communicative and very flexible (he was kind enough to accommodate me even if I arrived super late in the night).

Super fast response
It has everything you need
Lovely apartment, very comfortable
Great location in a safe neighborhood in santiago
Its a good apartment right at the heart of all the best restaurants and happening places. We stayed for 2 nights and overall happy due to the proximity.
Gabriel is a person of easy communication and always willing to help.  The house is very nice and has everything we need.  The location is perfect.

kat was super helpful all the time. she was always keeping an eye if we needed something. she s a great host and her apartment has a great location particularly if you go to concerts in Movistar Arena.

The apartment if fine, a few basic things missing (cutting board, coffee maker...) and a sofa in bad condition that was about to being changed. Rest was ok. Diego is a great host, always available and willing to help o resolve any issue or question you might have.
We would rent it again if needed, no doubt
The place itself is lovely but it is in a corner of Bellavista that is not safe — multiple people told us it was dangerous and we moved after a week into our month stay because of safety issues.

Felipe's apartment is a gem - the photos are very accurate - its an amazing view, and a very warm and comfortable apartment.  In a great location - close to everything in Santiago.  Felipe takes care of the small details as well - there are a lot of very helpful, friendly touches and information provided in the apartment that makes the stay even more enjoyable.  A shout out too to the Ground floor reception staff - they were friendly and very helpful.  I have no hesitation to recommend Felipe's apartment.

The flat is ok, not particularly located on the best area of the city but alright, it was just a non really comfortable stay due to a poor cleanliness and not proper maintenance . Strongly  recommend the host to look better after cleaning and proper maintenance .

host and staff were very accommodating, the place beautiful and had access to everything you would need.  food, malls , bikes scooters, definitely one of the nicest places I've ever stayed at!! can't wait to come back.
the place was amazing and the staff we're super helpful, it was in the perfect location close to train malls and places to eat.
Great apartment in a perfect location. The apartment was equipped with everything needed. The host Christian was great and very helpful.

Nicely curated space. Bellavista has taken a turn for the worst - trash everywhere and a lot of homeless who will approach. Don’t park on the street and try to verify the exact price of the private parking before booking.

The best place to be in Santiago! Great apartment with an excellent host! Leonor is very lovely! She was always there to anything I needed. The room is clean and comfortable with a beautiful view of the city. Amazing!

Felipe's apartment was great, petit, cozy, with beautiful views and located in a nice, safe area. Felipe was very kind by welcoming us with a complimentary bottle of Chilean wine, and also allowed us to check out later, so we can pack up and relax a bit more before flying back home. Communication was very good as well, fast responding and clear instructions made our experience even more smooth. Apartment is clean and has all the basics that you might need during your stay. Thank you Felipe, and wishing you all the best.
