Camilo is an excellent and attentive host - guests had a wonderful time and felt at home.  The decoration, amenities and location of the apartment are excellent.  Will definitely rent from Camilo again!
The apartment was great, amazing location! The only problem is that it’s by a very busy avenue, so there’s a lot of noise day and night. Other than that everything was excellent.
The place was exactly as depicted. Very clean, great location by Parque Arauco and an unbeatable view. Amazing

Great apartment! Extremely clean and Pepe was an awesome host. Super attentive and responded immediately.
This Airbnb is a 10/10!
Definitely recommend

It's a beautiful apartment
There is a subway station and a supermarket within a few minutes.
The Wi-Fi works without interruption and there are several elevators in the apartment, so it was very convenient.
The kettle broke down on the first day, I contacted the host, she took action immediately, so there was no inconvenience.
If I go to Santiago again, I want to stay here.
Luxurious apts in a very elegant area of Santiago. Reception service is amazing. Definitely recommended especially for business stays.
Sure would definitely stay there next time I am in Santiago. Everything you need nearby. Mercedes reached out and gave me a lot of recommendations as soon as I made the booking. Gracias!
The place was great! The concierge are the best in the game - honestly, I have never seen anyone as alert and ready to go as the team at the front desk. Would absolutely recommend!

Great apartment with Spectacular views. I work remotely and seeing the mountains every morning allowed me to disconnect from work for a while and appreciate the views. There’s restaurants next to the building and there’s a park across the street. The building staff is friendly and I enjoyed my stay.
100% recommended to any future guest. Modern building, clean and cozy apartment, located near to shopping malls, supermarkets, a park, etc. we really enjoyed your stay!

The location is great and very safe, the afternoon staff from the building is amazing. Communication was always within couple hours. Only some small details were not so accurate, but I would totally recommend the place specially in summer, spring and autumn.

We had a great stay at Cristians place. Cristian is extremely helpful and provided us with all the information that we needed prior to arrival. The space is excellent and had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again!

The apartment was truly amazing!! Not only the apartment itself, also the location was so perfect. You can reach everything from there so easily and you have a lot of nice places near. Also the people working at the reception were so kind. Thanks a lot Philip!
Totally amazing place. Very much recommend it to everyone looking for a long or short-term stay. The beautiful apartment and location is great.

This is a beautiful place, perfect for a long and comfortable stay. Juan and his people are so helpful. The place has incredible views of sunrise AND sunset. I stayed there for a three month work assignment and was so glad I chose it. Amazing area to live, too!

this apartment is great for any occasion. its location it's a perfect Gateway to visit anywhere in the city. The receptionists are friendly, there is food across the street and transportation is great. I highly recommend this place and its host.

This apartment is in a great location- very convenient to the metro and a short walk to all the wonderful restaurants in Bario Italia. We had everything we needed and the host was very accommodating- allowing us to check out late and not have to drag our luggage around prior to our evening flight.

We had a great visit at Giselas! The apartment and court yard are both quaint. The neighborhood is fantastic with lots of good restaurants nearby.
The bed is comfy and we appreciated the heating pad for the cold Santiago nights. I would definitely come back.

Javier's apartment is perfect, spacious common areas, great bathrooms, big kitchen and great terrace with an amazing view of Araucano Park and Los Andes mountains. We visited as a family and everyone loved it. We will definitely return!

The stay was amazing, we had a very good experience. Alvaro is a great host, he was very thoughtful, always being supportive with the online communication. The loft is beautiful, well furnished, clean and had everything we needed. It matches perfectly the descriptions and photos.
The neighborhood is very bohemian, with many nightclubs and bars.

Great Location at Las Condes, near all the amenities. top floor of the building with the best view of the city and the beautiful mountains. Definitely recommend it and would stay again. Host is also amazing as well with great communication and prompt response to any issues or concerns or questions.

Really nice and cozy apartment to spend a short stay. The place is really quiet, although is in the city center. That, plus the comfortable bed makes the place ideal to rest after a long day. The pictures are accurate, and the apartment is well connected via subway,  just a couple blocks away. The apartment is in a third floor, and the weekend I spent there, the elevator was out of order, but only for maintenance, so it was a temporary thing. Other than that, my stay there was perfect and I highly recommend it!

Borealis and Paolas place was right in the heart of downtown Santiago, very convenient spot near Plaza De Armas for food and shopping. They were very helpful with providing recommendations to where I could eat and visit. I would totally recommend them.

The mountain experience was unforgettable for my family. The apartment is exactly as in the photos. I recommend it to any family that wants to spend incredible days. Margarita is extremely helpful, Alexis, the concierge, is also stupendous.

The apartment is located in a good area of the city, near to a subway station and with two groceries nearby. We had a great stay there, Clara is great in hospitality! You’ll be well equipped in this apartment!

There is a baseball sized hole in the window that allowed cold air to come inside and make the apartment feel like an igloo. The heater that is in the apartment was literally bought by a previous guest because of how cold it gets in this apartment. And despite how cold it is the host made it clear that you had to purchase the gas for heater if you used it. This place is absolutely awful. Dont stay here unless you want to freeze and get sick.

The apartment was great. As advertised with excellent location. Check-in was easy and communication with Nicole was very good. There is some traffic noise from the street below, but it was not an issue and is worth it for easy access to shops, restaurants, and the metro.

Location is very good and communication with host was fast.
Overall the apartment needs a lot of basic maintenance specially on the walls and on the floor.
Kitchen is poorly equipped .
Hi! The aparment is wunderful, super nice and cozy. But I would not recommend it in winter though. It never got warm, the heaters where just not powerful enough
Best location in Santiago with many great restaurants nearby. The home was super cool and Juan was an excellent host!

Nice place to stay, excellent internet, very clean and also easy to keep warm.
Check in is really easy and the location is really good. There are lots of shops nearby and very near to public transport. This is great if you are going downtown, on a long distance bus or to the airport.
Felipe is a very communicative, well organised and very accommodating host.
It was a very nice stay that I can highly recommend.
This place is very nice and in a great location! We stayed nearly a week and it was comfortable, clean and safe. Would highly recommend!

this place is perfect for a weekend or a month, it has everything you need and more, the Owner are amazing, very good communication, clean, very spacious and the view.... can we please talk about that Andes Mountains view.
I will definitely come back!

Susan was an amazing host, very friendly and accommodating. The apartment itself is small but very cute and clean and was the perfect size for 2 people. We will definitely stay here again if we come back to Santiago!
Well the place wasn’t very clean. We felt a bit uncomfortable. But besides that the host was very attentive and nice.

The apartment is great and ha everything you need. The location is really central and you can reach the city center on foot.
The only thing that was a little disappointing was that there was no heater because it got quite cold

Brilliant place in the best area of Santiago. We very much did enjoyed the stunning views of the city and the place is comfortable well equipped and Juan made a very good effort to provide the apartment with welcome amenities to make our stay fantastic

Such a wonderful place that is quaint and makes you feel immersed in the vibrant neighborhood of Bella Artes.  The balcony offers a nice place to unwind and listen to the street artists play their music.  Would highly recommend if you’re looking for a centralized location with everything you could ever need within walking distance.
Really nice cozy place .  With a beautiful view to the center of Santiago . Definitely I will recommend this place . Thank you so much Felipe & Oliver .
Kat was an amazing host. Great place, a little bit cold and I think a heater bigger would be better.
I had a pleasant stay at Odette’s place. The apartment is located in a convenient part of town, just across the river and close to superb hiking trails with panoramic views. Highly recommended!
Hot water didn’t work consistently (sometimes it doesn’t heat or takes a long time), but host was nice and its great value!
Great place, great location! Safe! Very confortable! Super market really close! I highly recommend!!

Trendy neighborhood with the essential metro station just around the corner. Haven’t had much time to explore the area, but there is certainly good cafes, restaurants and bars around. Apparently safer then some other neighborhoods, if that matters to you.

The place is great, in a very good location.
I would definitely recommend it.

A stylish apartment in a safe suburb of Santiago, with great cafes and restaurants nearby. We stayed as a family for two weeks and it was such a success I stayed on for a further week. Francisco is an excellent host, always happy to help and highly recommended by us.
Great place, well equipped, and super comfortable beds! It is very central but on a quiet street, so perfect overall!

The photos of the apartment are accurate and views are spectacular. The apartment was super comfortable and the central heating was perfect. Location is ideal and close to anything you could possibly need, including public transport, public park, shopping and groceries.
Would definitely recommend and would visit again! Thank you!
It was my first time at an Airbnb house shared with the owner, however it was great. My family and I had privacy, there was great communication with the host and his service was friendly.

I enjoyed staying at this loft! It’s a great size, good location for me and my husband. It’s close to things, but not super far either.
We learned that Friday nights, the clubs stay open until 6am!! It’s a prime spot to stay if you’re into clubbing and partying. But after Friday night, it’s quiet.
The building has a 24 hour person at the door. And a gate to get in made it feel super safe.
Great spot overall! Minus the bathroom in the closet!!! That was a strange spot for it.
Ski park is just downhill and it looks like shuttle buses are available too. House is comfortably warm with amazing views, private rooms and plenty of equipment including a new BBQ. Gracias!

Best rooftop views! Wow, we were not expecting the beautiful mountain views on the rooftop area so we were very pleasantly surprised we we went up to do our laundry! Also, Maritza was so nice and incredibly accommodating. She left us some food, metro card with 1 pass credit for each of us, laundry change, and was more than willing to help on anything we needed throughout the whole stay. Highly recommend it!

Anita and her husband are two very welcoming and warm-hearted souls. It felt like being part of a family staying with them. Their place is in one of the interesting areas of the city close to Patio Bellavista and all its beautiful urban art.
Good and modern apartment in a central location, just a few minutes from a metro station and local markets. Adrian is a great host, always available to help and support

It was nice neighborhood! Lot of fiestas and restautants to go! Also it was so close to the Cerro San Cristobal to visit it easily! The room was nice and comfortable and clean. Sometimes at the weekends you can hear the music from the bars. Also there is no big supermarkets near but you have lot of minimarkets. Marcelo is obliging and helpful person!

I stayed in this apartment for two months as a student from the United States. The front desk staff is great and very accomodating, and I enjoyed my time here. The location is very central and close to shops and restaurants. I do think that for long-term stays, they could upgrade the cooking and cleaning equipment-- currently extremely basic on both, so keep that in mind-- if you plan to cook, you will probably have to buy many things you need. Otherwise, enjoyed everything about my stay. I would stay here again.

Whilst it’s a great location, unfortunately there were a few things that weren’t working well in the house including shower and toilet. We have given feedback to the owners and hope it will be fixed for next time. If all things were fixed, it would be a nice place to stay.

Amazing place in one of the most incredible neighbourhoods in Santiago, I had such a great time in Cris’ place.
The internet is great, everyone in the block is super friendly and the view is mind blowing—especially on a clear night!

Convenient location, very near to the metro station. And around 10 mins to Santa Isabel and 15 mins to Jumbo on foot.
Nice apartment same as what the pictures show.
And reception speaks fluent English which is really helpful for non Spanish speakers.

Lucia is an amazing host! The apartment is just as described and exactly as the picture. The check in and check process was extremely quick. The apartment within walking distance to everything you need: subway, Starbucks, supermarket, so many types of restaurants! I had an incredible experience and we would definitely recommend her apartment.

A great find! Perfectly located for exploring the city (blocks from a main toll road through Santiago) and for getting up the mountain to ski! Spacious and comfortable - a wonderful spot for a group of friends and/or family coming together. Looking forward to returning in warmer weather to enjoy the outdoor patio space and the pool!
Hosts were communicative, easily available, and incredibly helpful.
The host is very friendly, and if there is anything uncomfortable, it resolves quickly for the guest.

The hotel is located in an ideal area close to public transport be this bus, train and colectivos. It’s in a relatively quiet street, just far enough from a main artery of the city. The room needed a bit of cleaning on arrival, but housekeeping quickly rectified this issue. The room in itself was spacious, comfortable, modern and offered the standard items any hotel has to offer. All in all I would rate it 4.5/5 stars.

Perfect location in the cultural hotspot of Lastarria/Bellas Artes and just minutes walk away from the nice Centro district. Susan is a very thoughtful and communicative host and she was very helpful to me during my stay!

The place was great! There are space heaters, but it can get cold in the evening and morning during winter. Lots of great cd’s and fun stereo system which was fun to go through. Location is 10/10 if you’re looking to stay in Lastarria. Only difficulty I had (which is more my fault) is that check-in has to be coordinated with the host at an exact time, and it is hard to change the schedule based on the hosts’ schedule. I prefer self check in system, but that doesn’t seem like the norm throughout Chile at Airbnb’s.

Beautiful and comfortable place to stay. Easy access to subway and the shopping center. Amazing panoramic view of the city and very warm during the cold evenings in Santiago. Definitely recommending this place, and the host is very promt in answering any inquiries you may have.
I felt very comfortable and safe in the apartment. A good location to explore the city.  He was always available and had great advice on which places are worth seeing.
gorgeous place! beautiful patio, trendy common area, yummy restaurant that is vegan/vegetarian friendly. very clean and safe area!
The apartment was well located, with a lot of markets and restaurants around, really nearby Santa Ana's metro station and with a bus stop in front of it. Loved!
Great apartment in a great area. We felt very safe with the 24 hour security and the apartment was super clean. I would definitely recommend it!
Great location, close to metro and buses, good price. Clean apt and excellent communication. Be aware that apt is all electric so there is a small electric heater for the winter.
it was an excellent stay, Jessica is a fantastic host that took care of all details. We definitely going to contact her next time that we come back to our home country.

The host was super easy to  communicate with.The place has just enough to be perfect for a ski in/out vacation in the Andes mountain resort of Valle Navado. It is pretty easy to get to the nearby resorts of La Parva and El Colorado.  If you plan to use the kitchen and like to cook, I suggest stocking up at a super marcado before heading up into the mountains.  My only suggestion is if you really like to cook bring up your own good pot and pan for the 2 burner and a pan for the oven! Just book it and do the snow dance!!
Cristians loft is located in a great part of the city. It has a view of Saint Lucia hill from the balcony and very easy to walk to nearby restaurants.

As mentioned the apartment is dated by charming. The location can not be beat. Very close walk to restaurants, grocery store, pharmacy, bakery, hair/nail/massage salon, and metro. Bed was comfortable and the host was great. Great hot water for shower and filter for drinking water. Washer and dryer were great. Would recommend and stay again.
Excellent apartment and location! Very clean and comfortable. Barbara was a great host! Would definitely recommend to a friend..

The appartment was clean and well located. The bed was comfy. There were a lot of utilities like a washer, hair dryer, hanger, which were really helpful. Ignacia was really helpful. She always responded promptly.

Manuel is such a good host and an amazing person, always ready to help and make you feel at home.
The apartment is pretty and super central positioned, in a super safe zone. 100% recommended 🤍
Comfortable apartment in a very central location, 1min from the main metro line. Alejandro is a great host, attentive and responsive. I warmly recommend !

Excellent view, quiet apartment, and extremely easy access to the metro.  Within walking distance (~15 mins) of many restaurants, shopping, and grocery.  The building was well secured and felt very safe.
Excellent location, close to a lot of places, the apartment was very nice love it. Rodolfo was super nice and helpful.

Rosario's apartment is very well located and secure. People at the reception desk very helpful and polite. the whole country seems to have a shortage of change so I suggest you unload the app needed to run the laundry machines if you need to wash clothes during your stay, that will make your experience much simpler I have nothing but good thing to say about Rosario's listing and her predisposition to help as much as possible to ensure you have a good experience
Best location possible.  Would definitely stay again.  And Alejandra was a fantastic hostess.  Recommended.

The apartment was quaint and has character which the pictures have accurately depicted. The location was superb, around 2 blocks from the metro and within easy walking distance to Bellavista district and the bottom of San Cristobel - a great base for my short stay. Ignacia was friendly and communicative whenever I had questions.
Conveniently located steps away from the resort, the place has great views of the slopes.  Acoomodations were very nice, would definitely recommend.

I stayed for two months and would highly recommend Lionel’s apartment to anyone, short or long stay. Great location. Well stocked for a long stay. Responsive and extremely nice host. Very safe area with great access to the metro.

Modern decorated apartment, in a central location, with heating and all the basics covered for a work or pleasure stay. Good for a single person or couple. Communication was slow at times and cleaning was not the best. However still a recommended place to stay for periods longer than a week. Probably one of the best alternatives in the area.

Me and my friends vacationed at Daniela's space and it was a lovely stay.
The apartment is well equipped, well located and Daniela is a very helpful and attentive host. We recommend and if possible we will come back for sure!
Amazing apartment, good location, near markets, coffees, restaurants. Super clean! It was a very good 7 days there. Luis is amazing host. We’re very satisfied!

Perfect location since we skied at Valley Nevado, El Colorado and La Parva. Million dollar View from the house. Host Matias and Marcelas are so friendly and helpful. Great experience for our group of 8.

Mario's place perfectly suited my needs. It's in a great location for accessing the lovely Barrio Italia. I felt safe and comfortable in the space. The bed was very cozy, the wifi worked great, and Mario was quick to respond to anything I needed.

One of the most epic air Bnbs ever. Waking up to the Mountain View every morning is the best way to start the day. The ski trail right to the basement  elevator let’s you ride right to your door. The ski benches in the hallways make it super easy to put your boots on and keep the house clean. To top it all off Marita was extremely accommodating. Thanks so much!

Beautiful spot tucked in the lower corner of the building. Still having great views but felt secluded. Super close to the mountain. Staff was very helpful and even washed a load of laundry for us. Communication was great and there was always someone around if help was needed.

Such a sweet spot! Javier was very responsive and easy to communicate it- we were extremely pleased with it all!
This was our first time on Chile and I'd definitely come back. Having the park right infront of the building and tons of restaurants nearby- was a perfect location. Apartment was very clean and a great space. Would highly recommend!!

The penthouse condo was great.  The view and location are amazing.  Juan the host was very accommodating.  He kept in touch with throughout our stay even though he was on a cruise in Alaska.  I would highly recommend stay at this penthouse.
Great apartment with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. A big balcony with views of the mountains. Located close to the subway station and supermarket. Catalina was easy to contact. Highly recommended
Incredible view. Great for two people. The bed was comfortable. Very convenient location with bars and restaurants downstairs.
What a great place to stay! Right in the centre of Santiago in a quiet and safe building. I would highly recommend
Amazing, beautiful and cozy place to stay, also Felipe is a amazing friendly and replies back quickly!!

Great place to stay :)  The apartment is clean and cozy, metro close by. The only downside is that the street outside the living room can be a bit noisy at night with the windows open, however it gets quieter as it gets later. Would recommend :)

Great stay! The apartment was very clean and spacious and communication with the host was very easy. The apartment has everything you need, the kitchen is well-equipped, the bed and sheets are comfortable and the bathroom is clean. It is also very close to a metro station.

Unfortunately, We will not recommend this listing and host to anyone.  This was a bad experience that we reported in detail to Airbnb. Beware, the host Gaston never showed up or communicated with us while we stayed in the Airbnb.

The place is as described, and the views are incredible. We spent a lot of time on the balcony enjoying the panoramic scenery.
It's an easy walk to the chairs from the condo. The place is well equipped with the things that make it feel at home.
Margarita was accommodating with suggestions before we arrived, and her on-site property manager Alexis was very kind and helpful. We had a couple of minor issues that were urgently handled.
Recommendations would be to use Margarita's driver, as they pick you up from the airport and drive up the mountain with over 40 hairpin turns. We were there during the end of the season for riding, and it was very quiet, so make sure you get food in Santiago as the mini-mart is limited and very expensive.
Great place for family, couples, or friends as we enjoyed our stay.

Great location , for metro and taxi . Nice security , you can walk around at midnight . Easy to find breakfast and fast food nearby . It is some special massage and strip club opposite the building , interesting to stay at the community .

Very well apartment, very well located in the center of the city.
Alexis is really nice and helpful. I recommend it.

Beautiful, comfortable apartment that met our needs perfectly. Camilo was an excellent host, checking we got into the apartment okay and also providing helpful recommendations for food in the area. We really enjoyed our stay!
Good rate price/quality. Excellent location. Some noises at night by the neighborhood, but not so terrible.

We enjoyed our stay and can fully recommend it. Osvaldo was very nice and even helped us out after we forgot to print copies of our ID’s. We stayed over the weekend and it was pretty loud outside, but totally manageable.

- great location
- amazing views
- appartment has everything thats needed (even for longer stay) +welcome gift (wine)
- great communication with host and overall amazing hospitality

Camilo was very attentive and helped us coordinate an early bag drop off (a must for travelers from the US) The apartment itself was beautiful and well organized. Exactly as seen in photos. We enjoyed our short stay and could not recommend more. Thank you!
Nice and clean small apartment close to the centre of the city. Host was responsive. Shower was hot with good pressure.
Great location. Simple, clean and has all of the needed amenities. Francisco is a great host and I felt at home for my stay.

This unit is located in a perfect location if you plan on walking to all the important site in Santiago.  The room was cozy and clean.  Valentina is a great host and even managed to help us when I made a mistake with our check-out date.
Great spot, within walking distance of lots of great things to do. Nice apartment for my wife and I. Good views.
Sandra and Martin's apartment provided a very nice view. The location is great and close to the Metro, restaurants, cafes and the magnificent coffee shop Club Columbia.

Cute apartment. Very comfortable beds with nice linens and great hot shower. The neighborhood may not be ideal for single women but to be fair, we were here during a holiday weekend and things were shut down. East communication with host, door man building, safe secure parking.
Great stay at Francisco's place. Great location, quiet, and nice lighting. Internet was fast and he was very helpful and flexible. Easy communication. I would recommend it and stay again.

The Apartment has an amazing view of Santiago and the Andes in the background of an 11th floor balcony. Gonzalo was very helpful when we arrived several hours before check-in and stored our bags for us as we explored the city, we would definitelystay here again.
Very nice apartment in las Condes near to the metro and also nice shops, restaurants and bars. Very clean and ideal for a couple.
Very nice neighborhood, the building is safe and nice stuff, the apartment itself is basic, if you like to cook is not for you

This apartment, though cozy, is  one of the best ones we have stayed in!  Ruben and Fanny have thought of everything, from toothpaste, soap, shampoo, conditioner, TP, water in the fridge…you name it!  The location is fine, but many stores and restaurants were closed on the weekend since office workers were not around.  We did find several good places to eat nearby, nonetheless.  We would absolutely return to this apartment, and would recommend it to anyone!
great location, cute little place, but very slow response time which was frustrating during check in. other than that, very friendly host.

The apartment looks gorgeous in the pictures, but is not quiet the same when  you get in, Neigboorhood had a wierd feeling of not safe ,everything is barricaded and looks like an abandoned city, I been in Santiago in a different neighborhoods and is totally a different nice and beautiful - but is not the same here.

Cristobal and Giselle were very nice and friendly. They always responded within 15 minutes.
They provided a lot of information about the area around the Apt- supermarkets,
cafe, emergency contact #, etc.
The Apt was fully furnished and the kitchen had all the pots, pans and silverware you need if you wanted to cook…like I did in the mornings.
Incredible view of the Andes from the Apt. it was nice to have a doorman buzz you in to the lobby so you felt safe. There were different doormen during my stay and they all asked me who I was since they didn’t recognize me at first. That’s a plus.
Did I mention the view from the Apt of the Andes was incredible!
I would stay there again.

Nice apartment which is in a great location in Santiago! The apartment is very close to some of the most popular barrios in Santiago and is in a nice neighborhood. The apartment has all the amenities you’d need and was very comfortable for two people. Soledad also is a very attentive host, quickly responds to messages, and was a huge help to us on a few occasions. I definitely recommend staying here.

One of the best Airbnb hosts I have ever met.  Incredibly generous, warm and lovely.  The house is very nicely decorated and the bed is very comfortable.  The house is surrounded by many great restaurants.  I recommend everyone visiting Santiago to stay here!!!

Great location, very responsive and friendly host. I don’t know Spanish and she doesn’t know English but there was no communication barrier. She provided information on where to go, what to eat and even made breakfast every day. Could help with laundry for a small fee too. The room was very clean, toilet was great, overall everything was amazing!
it is a good living. the owner provided everything.  and it is closed to kennedy mall.
good location! we walked or took the subway to everything we wanted to see and Rodolfo was a great host

Super responsive host
Easy check-in
Clean apartment
Convenient electronic lock
Great shower
Well stocked kitchen
Amazing views
Friendly doormen
Well located - if staying in the historic center.

This place was/is everything u need for a perfect, resting, family vacation, will go back every time is possible, thanks Chile great country, great place and furthermore ,unforgettable place, Thanks again....es

Fernanda was extremely easy to communicate with. She responded very promptly & was super nice & accommodating. Her place was clean, beautiful, comfortable, and sufficiently stocked with essentials like coffee & tea.

Nice clean apartment near Baquedano. Ideal for trips to city center.
The communication with Ignacia was very uncomplicated and made our stay very comfortable.

Outstanding location. Gorgeous views. Great responsive host.
I would stay here again for sure.

Claudia was very accommodating and easy/quick to communicate with. Her apartment was clean, full of all the amenities we needed and the location was perfect for a good all around introductory to Santiago.
Very nice duplex in the heart of Las Condes, close to everything you need for your stay. The apartment is very well equipped and communication was flawless. I'll repeat!

Few minutes to metro station and also close to the attractions in Santiago.
Good communication and quick response from the host.

Our stay at German's place was not great. The apartment was dirty (stains on the couch, moldy food between the cushions, black marks on the wall, the bathroom smelled like pee), and although German was accommodating with our check-in (we were late by 15 mins because we had a person in our party with limited mobility), he did so with an unkind attitude. There was also a lot of wear and tear in the apartment and it did not seem to be kept up. The wallpaper was starting to peel off at the seams, the sheets had holes in them, and the tub did not have the right stopper for the drain. It was well located and had nice views, but it has been the lowest value for an Airbnb I have had in a long time. A final detail was that it had a very small, used roll of toilet paper and we had to get our own.
Really enjoyed our stay at Soledad’s apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and in a prime location. Soledad was a great host and speedy to reply. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Good location near metro station but not the best neighborhood. Besides the issues we had with the door lock, the room was as advertised. Big building with many units with security. Administration staff was also friendly and helpful.
the apartment is excellent, very comfortable, and with a magnificent view. Ximena is a perfect hoster and help me a lot during living,  asked me what I need additional and always can help

The apartment is perfect for a stay in Santiago. It is really comfortable and has everything you need. The area is also very good and bars/restaurants are close. Juan has been really nice and helpful at all times.

Fantastic apartment same as show in the pictures. Metro station alcántara (line 4) is just in front of the building. There are also mini markers and supermarkets nearby. And the owner and the staffs are really helpful and friendly.

Ely was incredible,
Her place is great and comfortable and clean. She is extremely helpful and very responsive. I rarely travel alone and it can be really stressful, she totally put my mind at ease and helped to make my first night on vacation incredible! Thank you so much. I would definitely stay here again!

very nice place. well located, close to subway station.
it was a very pleasant stay

The apartment was very clean and Said was always available to answer any of my questions. I was able to work without issues and the building was quiet and peaceful.
The only downside is the location as it is a bit far from the neighborhoods I was interested in. As indicated in the ad, the building has a gym, game room, etc but they are only accesible for those staying six months or longer. Thus, all the amenities will not be available to the guests who are staying for a few days/weeks (as indicated by the host)
I would stll recommend this place.

It was such a beautiful spot! Would highly recommend. The garden as you enter the property is full of flowers, succulents and citrus trees! The guest house was clean and tidy. Gisela was very kind and attentive, even making us the most perfect scrambled eggs for breakfast one morning. Also, her two golden retrievers are so friendly and affectionate. Stay here if you can!

The apartment was dusty but otherwise it’s fine for a short stay.
The best part of staying here was the view from the balcony. The sunset is absolutely gorgeous.
This was the perfect place for us in Santiago. Cannot beat the location and the 24 hour front desk was super helpful for all our travel needs. Would stay again

Catalina's place was a great stay for us.  Location is very central and is walking distance from almost anything you'd want to do.  the subway station is also just a few min away by foot.  Host was extremely easy to communicate with.

Very nice and well-furnished apartment in a new building with security. The location was relatively convenient as well. The apartment amenities were great and very new, and we were able to enjoy the balcony in the daytime.  Definitely recommend!

Excellent experience at Ximena’s place! Everything is exactly as pictured, and the view from the balcony at sunset is incredible. Clean, great communication, and very safe gated building. The kitchen was nice for cooking, and the bed was very comfortable! Neighborhood is lively in the evenings, so it can be a little loud outside the apartment.

The place had all amenities required and was clean. The check in was easy.
The only suggestion for improvement is to have blackout curtains in the bedroom.
Thank you for a wonderful stay.
The apartment was beautiful, clean and perfect location.  Jessica was communicative   throughout my stay.  Thank you for your generous accommodation.  Highly recommended
This is a beautiful apartment with incredible mountain views. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Jessica even made pool reservations for us downstairs.

Great place to stay in Providencia. Location is perfect, youre in a nice neighbourhood and close to everything you need.
Pepe is a great host and people in the concierge are also very nice.
Id definitely return and recommend it.

Communication with Felipe was super smooth, and the check-in process was so easy. The location was perfect for us, with access to all of the areas we wanted to visit. The view from the windows and balcony were breathtaking - we loved watching the sunrise from the apartment. The host, Felipe, pays great attention to his guests’ needs - he left us a cute welcome note and some fun goodies! Highly recommend!

The apartment is great! We loved the kitchen, the bed was super comfortable, shower was great!
Rodrigo was an incredible host, always willing to help!
My only concern was the location, the neighborhood is not the most friendly and secure, but other than that, everything was perfect!

Gonzalo is a great host and his place is really convenient to explore Santiago. The views over the mountains are fantastic and the place is well equipped for a really pleasant stay. Gonzalo was also quick to reply with any questions we had. Would recommend to anyone as their base in Santiago!
The apartment is very comfortable and we felt very safe. The location worked very well for us. We appreciated Claudia’s quick responses to our questions.
Easy communication and check in! Jean’s mom claudia gave us a warme welcome! good value for 1-2 nights.

The apartment was the perfect place to call our base while visiting Chile. 2 weeks there and check in, check out, and communication was very easy.
Great apartment and a good central location for exploring Santiago. 5/5 !
A beautiful and peaceful home away from home, walking distance from the restaurants and supermarket. Also close to two Metro stations, and thanks to the Bip! card loan was perfect!

The location is great. In safe neighborhood with lots of nice restaurants, coffee shops and bars.
Catalina always responded quickly and nicely. We were so comfortable staying there. Thanks
The apartment was well located and clean. Perfect for a short stay. 5 out of 5. Thanks Ivan!

Mostly good things to say about this place. Great view, good location so close to Barrio Italia, comfy bed, good size tv in the room, good wifi, parking lot, a little bar…and he even left a juice box for us! Apartment is in very good shape! The only things I missed was A/C as it might get very hot and a table with chairs. All the rest was really good….and the view is by far the best.

Mabel’s place is lovely. We really enjoyed our stay. The location is great, walking distance to Costanera Center, Jumbo and a lot of good restaurants. They’re quick to respond to our questions and requests. 100% would stay here again next time we’re in Santiago.

Spectacular place.  Great views of the city and best location.  Juan went above and beyond what I have come to expect from AirBnB stays.  He was communicative from the day I booked and then was a wealth of helpful information during our stay (And he speaks completely fluent English).  My son and I lived in the flat for 6 days and it was the perfect base camp for exploring Santiago.  We found Santiago to be a very cool city that is completely walkable from the flat and the El Golf subway is 2 mins away. On Sunday, many of the city streets close to traffic to allow families to ride bikes around the city.  I hope to have the opportunity to go back to Santiago again and would definitely stay at Juan's place.

Really great place, clean, safe, great location and the host was very attentive. The apartment has a dishwasher, which is rare in Santiago and a laundry machine. Although the apartment is located at a busy street, it was quiet and our baby could nap perfectly in the crib, which was provided by the host. There is a small supermarket just across the street and a nice playground and cafe 2 min by walking from the apartment. There is also the possibility to park but make sure you can leave when you need to and no other guest is blocking the way. You can only park one after the other.

The perfect stay in Santiago. Location was wonderful. Easy access to the centre of the city and great bars and restaurants nearby.
The view from the apartment and the roof top was unbeatable.
The bed was very comfortable and the apartment was spotless and had everything we needed for a few days stay.
Alvaro was a perfect host. Great at communication and offered thorough advice on ensuring we had a great stay, thank you.
I would thoroughly recommend.

Our apartment had a beautiful view, nice furniture, a comfortable bed, and a beautiful bathroom. The rooftop pool and view was gorgeous and we would love to stay here again. The building is nice and the staff are kind and helpful.

Claudia's place is super cute and cozy! It was everything we needed for 2 days in Santiago. The location is close to great neighbourhoods for walking and exploring.
Highly recommend!

Eduardo is an excellent host. He helped me check in at 9am since my overnight flight landed very early. The view is incredible. The apartment is in a great neighborhood and has all the comforts you need for a great long term stay. Very close to the best mall with a great super market. The staff of the building is also very nice and welcoming.

Everything was great - desk staff are extremely friendly and IG feels like a very safe building. I have no hesitation in recommending it. I extended my stay at short notice and the whole process was smooth and easy start to finish. Thank you for a great stay.

Location is amazing, however be prepared that it is quite loud on the main street if you are a light sleeper. Rodrigo was easy to communicate with and fixed a few things very quickly and was very friendly. Would definitely recommend and would stay again!
great location! 70s style building! beautiful view from rooftop. ( pool is closed until summer)

PERFECT location for people who love to eat out and be surrounded by a lively and vibrant neighbourhood! Surrounded by the best restaurants, there is nothing bad in that neighbourhood! Everything you need is within 1 km!  Hosts are responsive and hospitable. We very visiting during the Oct18 protests and hosts contacted us to make sure we were ok. Really perfect place to stay to discover Santiago ❤️
Everything is perfect, I stayed 3 weeks in Aug and Sep, when Oct I come back santiago from Madrid, I chose here again.

Really wonderful, the beds are comfy, hot water, great location (close to Avenue Italia and public transportation), and it feels extremely homey. Camilo is an AirB&B host that we wish to have at all places, taking feedback and immediately resolving the issue (the Wifi was spotty and as we were working from home, he immediately came the next day and put in a new router).
Location is convenient to the subway station and convenience stores all around. Comfy and clean space for 2. Self check in and out was smooth. Thanks for letting us stay!
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Amazing location, really well equipped little apartment and Felipe & Oliver were very helpful and easy to contact.
Thank you again. Your apartments are always so nice! The towels are super and you are kind to leave snacks :)  Will be returning to Santiago will always look for your Hosting! 🌞
The apartment is lovely, very cozy, I felt safe in the area and the front desk staff is very lovely.
We had a good stay at youre appartment. The metro's are near by. Like some nice restaurants and bars

Nicole’s place was awesome, just as the listing. Even though I didn’t have a pleasure of meeting them in person, They were so thoughtful and great with communication. I also loved the janitor, Juan Carlos, of the building. He helped me with my bags and was always so kind and helpful. ❤️

A green oasis located in the middle of crowded and buisy Santiago. In walking distance to the city center, the metro is also directly nearby. Cute 2 dogs. We have felt very comfortable and would definitely recommend the place. Its the kind of place you want to find on Airbnb

Such a great stay. The highlights include: great recommendations and flexibility by Phillip, amazing jacuzzi, nice and safe area, and spacious and nicely furnished apartment. 5 star stay all the way through and will def stay here again in the future.

Spectacular stay in the loft! The views were breathtaking, the location ideal, and the rooftop pool a real treat. The host was super responsive and the flat is outfitted with everything one would need to have a perfect stay (like pool towels and kitchen essentials.) We loved loved our stay and waking up to Cerro San Cristobal / watching the sunset from the expansive windows. Highly recommend!!

A very comfortable apartment especially the bed was super deluxe comfort, very clean, the neighbourhood of Belle Arte was quaint with nice shop so the location made a memorable stay. Rodolfo and family were very kind and popped by once to help my Mum and I.

This place is great! Sussan is a great host as well: she's happy, and met me to deliver the keys. She promptly responded any questions, and even allowed me to a late check out. The place is great. Shower could use a bit more water pressure, but other than that, it was awesome. Location is also very good: some good restaurants nearby, as well as a market and a subway station. Internet worked great.

Worst things first- the place was not kept very clean, and communication was basic and sparse. That aside, the location is central and relatively safe, metro access is close, and the view is stunning! Multiple bars and restaurants within walking distance. There is a GO market and a bank close by that will change bills to coins for the washer/dryer on floor -1. Bella Vista is just across the street and highly recommended, and is where you can access the trails to climb the hill for even better views.

Maritza's place was exactly what my partner and I needed: clean, tidy, well-kept flat in the centre of Santiago. Maritza is a conscientious host who has thought through the visitor's experience. The place was well-equipped.
I would recommend staying here.
The apartment was very clean and fully refurbish. Great location. Communications with Brian were clear and easy. Impeccable.
Thank you again! It was our second time staying in your apartment.  As always impeccable and very attentive service!

Hector's place was great. Very clean, very comfortable and lots of character. But the best part of my stay was Hector himself. Hector embodies what every Airbnb host should be. Very friendly, very helpful and he made me feel like I was a member of his family coming over to visit.

Loved everything about this gorgeous hotel. The breakfast was perfect, everything was clean and, even though the neighbours had a Halloween party, we didn't hear anything and slept all the way trough the night.
Gonzalo is a very friendly host and responds promptly. The area can be noisy, but that’s the nature of being near active nightlife.
Very nice place to stay in Santiago. Jessica was very helpful, the place was very clean and had all amenities required to stay at. I would highly recommend this place to anyone
This is a hotel.  Pretty good value and service.  The staff is nice as well and speaks impressively good english as well.

I had an awesome stay at Clara’s home. I would definitely stay here again. She went above and beyond and was very attentive to my requests. Clara has great communication and made sure to reach out if I have any questions/concerns.
Clara’s home was comfortable and modern. I didn’t get to meet her personally but I get a great vibe from her. Can’t wait to visit Santiago again! 😎

The house was very well located and clean. Check in was easy and the staff was very helpful. We did miss having basic supplies (trash bags, paper towels, napkins, laundry detergent). Wifi was spotty. They had a helpful flexible check in policy. Would recommend this place.

Ruben is the nicest most helpful person you can meet.
very kind and caring. keeps the apartment well stocked and clean.great neighborhood.

Nice apartment within walking distance of the old town and Lastarria. Also close to the metro station. The apartment is nicely decorated with all the amenities needed (although could do with a sieve).
Whilst mostly clean, I think the apartment probably needs a deep clean, as some of the cupboards and surfaces were a bit sticky, and some of the ornaments dusty.
Great place to stay with a lot of shops and stores nearby located in one of the best neighborhoods of the city

Jessica runs a professional system
she was very attentive during the check in process
the people that work in her building were very kind and helpful
highly recommend her place

Good value stay. Internet was strong the entire time. Host was highly responsive. No issues to note. Would stay here again.
Jordan&Soph on YT

We loved this apartment!   The location is ideal.   We could walk to so many places! The apartment is clean and comfortable.  The back patio is lovely.   We had such a great time and would definitely stay here again!
Great apartment, accurate photos, very accommodating hosts. AMAZING location. So many great bars and restaurants near by and close to everything
Camilo's place was an all-time favorite Airbnb. A great space with art and charm and everything you could need. Recommended!

Pretty cute place to stay in Santiago, you can find many place to try the local food nearby, there are a lot of commodities just a few blocks away such as pharmacy, laundry and groceries. It's a quiet neiborhood so if you are traveling for work this place is ideal. Also the kitchen is pretty well equiped. there is a small and cozy backyard.
Something to note is that the subway is not very close so make sure to find the necessary bus routes for you.
Mario as a host kept in contact and provided very clear rules for the apartment. A good price value relation for this stay

Excellent location! Well-maintained apartment building! Make sure to bring your own toiletries (including toilet paper) but other than that, it was comfortable and clean. Walking distance from many desirable locations.

Karen and Carlos were excellent hosts. Communicative and helpful. The space was perfect for our needs - cozy, beautiful, and well equipped. Coffee on the balcony in the morning was a treat and the location was wonderful. Steps from the best Barrio Italia has to offer - cute shops and great restaurants right around the corner.
I would just point out that the bathtub might not be ideal for anyone with mobility issues as it is quite raised (there’s a pretty notable drop to the ground).
Thank you so much for your hospitality Karen & Carlos! Can’t wait to be back.

Alejandra’s place is well located at the heart of many Santiago’s attractions, with easy access to public transport. Lastarria is a charming neighbourhood that you will definitely enjoy. Alejandra is also a great host. She was very responsive and collaborative. Her place was clean and well-equipped. I recommend this place without any hesitation.
The area is really great and unit is as described. Easily used the laundry room as well! Highly recommend, clean and comfortable!
Everything about our stay was great - Camilo was responsive and helpful, the apartment was very homey and comfortable, and the location was excellent. Would definitely stay again!
The location is great and very comfortable for at least 4 people, on the lobby, there are a lot of restaurants and in the street, very secure place and great for people of any age. Fully recommend!

I booked this apartment for the view and all I can say; it is amazing! I loved waking up here and have the great view over the city and the mountains in the background. Simply amazing!
Apartment has all you need for a short stay, very comfortable bed, kitchen utilities, nice bathroom. Safe neighborhood and close to restaurants, bars, public transport. Perfect location, loved every minute of my stay!

Carmen's place was in an amazing location. It was in a quiet neighborhood with tree-lined streets and was close to a variety of stores, coffeeshops, and restaurants. It was an also close to the subway so you could get to any part of the city.
The desk and balcony made working and staying the Airbnb very calming.
The main thing that could be improved is streamlining the communication. There's a host and co-host messaging you the same information via Airbnb and text. It ends up being dozens of messages.
There are a lot of rules posted in the apartment, but a lot of the information (for example about laundry) is out of date.
The host and co-host also message reminders about following certain rules but don't message you about important updates like when when the hot water is shut down for several hours.
Overall, it's a great place to stay short-term and long-term.

I had a very positive experience staying here. It's an extremely modern and secure apartment that feels virtually brand new. Brian was an exceptionally friendly and attentive host and I would highly recommend staying here (as I hope to again).

Awesome place to stay. Lively area that can be intimidating at first but turned out to be my favourite neighbourhood in Santiago after staying in a few areas over the last few weeks. I wish I found this place sooner after spending lots of money on disappointing places and expensive hotels. Thanks for providing such a great place to stay.
The place is more like a hostel with private rooms than a boutique hotel. The hostess was great and I had a nice stay.

Great location - one min walk to the metro and in the centre of the city. The hosts are very helpful and friendly. The apartment itself was cosy and neat with a reasonably well-equipped kitchen. Definitely recommend!
We had a very nice stay in the apartment of Carlos in a nice neigbourhood. I will recoment it to anyone! Comunication was friendly and fast :) soo yes SUPER!
This apartment is perfect if you want to be near all the action in Santiago. Brian was a very friendly and helpful host also.
The place was as described. Communication with Jose was very good. He even got us some stools to sit on the balcony.

Such a perfect location and perfect apartment! The neighborhood can't be beat - coffee shops and restaurants right out your front door and a great atmosphere on the weekend. The apartment itself has everything you need - well appointment kitchen, good hot shower, and very strong internet. Christian is very helpful and responsive and the the porters are there for anything you need. I would definitely return!
I liked the accommodation because it was clean and the location was good.  It wasn't much of a problem so I didn't have to contact Pepe.

This apartment is a gem in Santiago. The quiet street  close to Barrio Italia is Perfect and the best for a stay in this buzzling city. Everything was designed carefully in the spotless clean apartment, the beds were most comfy, the bedding pure and tasteful linen. The kitchen has everything necessary , Wi-Fi great and quick, the whole atmosphere of this beautiful house was perfect an inviting . Camillo answered very fast when we had a question and his tips for restaurants are unbeatable.  We slept perfectly in the comfy beds, nothing to be heard from the very quiet street. We really recommend staying at Camillo‘s house and hope to come back one day. Cornelia and Ulli
Javier was extremely kind , answering fast, delivering the apto in a very good condition! The apartment has everything we needed! Well located, beautiful view! I would definetly recommend

I'm very happy I found Cristian's place. He is always very helpful, and just an allround nice person. I had never been to Chile or South America before, and he really helped make my experience of getting used to Santiago a lot better.

The studio appartement in Gisela’s backyard is very charming and well thought out, it has everything you need and is very comfortable. Gisela is a wonderful host and the garden area is beautiful as well. It is well located within walking distance to Barrio Italia, highly recommended !
Great spot. The rooftop is a gem! Alvaro was super helpful and the apartment is a well designed clean space.

I can really recommend this hotel! The building and the interiors are very beautiful and also the staff is friendly and helpful. The location in Providencia is excellent, there are a lot of good restaurants and bars around the corner of the hotel. Our experience overall was great and we would definitely come back!
We enjoyed our stay a lot in Manu's place. It was very well located and well-equipped.

My friend and I had a lovely stay. The location was very central and safe. And the Airbnb was clean, comfortable and had a beautiful view of Santiago. Beware, there was no body wash or extra toilet paper. Otherwise, this was a perfect stay!
Wonderful view in a great part of the city. Cristobal is very attentive with his communication
Super Location, beautiful department, easy parking, everyone was very responsive and friendly. Will definitely stay again.
Great place, clean and well decorated. Great rooftop. Location rocky a little, lots a noisy clubs just outside.
Felipe's apartment in Providencia is very comfortable and convenient, with good views from the 13th floor balcony. Clean and modern, with good kitchen accessories.

Very nice apartment in a great location. Host is responsive and supportive. Highly recommend staying here during a visit to Santiago. Good for couples or an individual traveling for business (internet was good, small table to use for flexible working setup). Building has a 24/7 concierge and felt safe to stay in.
Adrian was super helpful and responsive during our stay. We felt very safe in the building and the apartment was very clean.

We had a wonderful stay at Jessica's apt. Jessica was a wonderful and responsive host.
The balcony of the apt was an added bonus. Would recommend Jessica's apt. without hesitation.

We loved staying at Christian’s place! Perfect location to explore the best part of the city! It had everything we needed for a great time. Secure, clean, and cozy in an incredible neighborhood! Thank you!!!

The apartment is very centrally located and yet calm because you are in the 25th floor. Great area to explore the city. The apartment is very well equipped, modern and offers all you need. Communication with Brian was really easy and very helpful. We can definitely recommend to stay there.

Great apartment, very clean, well equiped, quality beds and excellent location.
Also a very good selection of music.

Great location! Close to so much and a very safe neighbourhood. 24/7 concierge which was nice to have! Pool was closed for our stay so just check prior to booking if that is a priority for you. Shower was not draining and overall the bathroom situation was not ideal- but for the price it aligns. Luis was great and very responsive! Checking in and out was easy and for a basic place that’s close to everything this apartment meets those needs!

This is a really nice and good sized apartment for 2 people. The location is good as you can walk to the historic centre or to the nearby restaurants and bars. I think the area is safe, but the streets are very quiet at night anyway so it is not noisy at all as you are on 23rd floor. The view from the balcony is really nice when you want to relax outside. The wifi was very good without any problems and there was hot water in the shower with just a little wait for it. Communication was always fast and helpful. The kitchen had quite a lot of things to cook with and the washing machine saves on visits to the laundrette. Definitely value for money.

I worked remotely from Osvaldo’s place for a couple days. It was perfect — very spacious, good Wi-Fi, helpful front desk, lots of nearby cafes and restaurants. Osvaldo was extremely communicative and helpful. Only downside is that the neighborhood is hopping at night so expect a lot of noise and bring ear plugs!
Mabel was an amazing host going above and beyond! We can't wait to get back for another stay soon!
It was a comfortable stay and convenient location next to the Metro. Patricio was responsive when needed

The view from this place is spectacular! It was also close to markets and some fun going out neighborhoods. The host was really communicative as well. We struggled a bit with no air conditioning though. Otherwise loved our time there :)

Francisco’s home was amazing and pictures just couldn’t capture all the beauty. It was a nice getaway from the city. I was traveling alone and felt very safe. Also, I was able to order groceries through Uber with ease. The Wi-Fi was strong which is a huge plus. Finally, the two dogs were so sweet and friendly. We hung out for all three days I visited. Francisco was a great host and I’d recommend his properties with no hesitation! Beautiful!
You guys have an incredible team of kind people! Thanks for all your attention and welcoming spirit. Gracias!

Bernabé was a great host! He picked us up from the airport, took us to the bus station at the end of our stay, and was very attentive to everything and anything we might need. The fridge was stocked with food for breakfast, the wifi was good, kitchenware in case we wanted to cook, dining table set up, and a comfortable bed. The balcony and windows were very nice and provided great air circulation even with the hot weather. Even after our stay Bernabé answers our questions about Chile and travel. My mom and I traveled together and he gave us the safety do's and don'ts about the area. It was a nice stay and we felt well cared for!
Great host! We had an amazing stay here. The beds were very comfortable and the wifi worked very well.
Had a great stay here! In a great location and was comfortable. Having two bathrooms was a big bonus !
We really liked  staying at Susan"s place. If we go back to Santiago we would like to stay there again. The apartment is very centrally located but  it can be noisy at times.

Very good communications. Always responsive. The place looks like in the pictures as well. Close to the metro station.
Only one suggestions: would be very helpful to have some device chargers for international travelers.

The apartment is beautiful, exactly as shown in the pictures. Perfectly located, very luminous, and fully equipped. We really enjoyed our stay at Nancy's home and if ever we return to Santiago we would definitely love to stay at her apartment again.

Great depto! Beautiful location and Marcelo
is great. I had to cancel my last two days of my stay with a 24 hour notice. Marcelo replied super quickly and accepted my request without questions. The money will be to a 100% reimbursed. 5 stars!
Great place in the heart of the city with access to restaurants and the subway. It has all the essentials for an extended stay.

Flat was as described - location is quite central, but not really las tarrias. Flat was clean, WiFi worked well and the desk and chair were helpful. They charged an additional 5,000 pesos to check in 1 hour early, which was not so accommodating
Perfect location. Lots of eating and drinking options right at your door step. Apartment was just great. Highly recommended!
A wonderful apartment with the perfect view of the sunrise over the mountains. An oasis in the sky. Also a very central location and easy to get around with several options nearby.

We had a wonderful stay at Cristobal’s place. The views are fantastic. Location is great. There was a little problem with the wifi at first but the host resolved it promptly with a backup wifi. Would highly recommend.
Claudia was very friendly. It was easy to communicate with her and get prompt answers to any questions we had.

Wonderful  place for our family. The location was perfect. The concierge was pleasant and helpful. The condo was very well kept and so comfy. I felt right at home. Claudia was a wonderful host and would recommend in the future.
The apartment was great, in a great location as well. We had an amazing stay at Cristians place! It was very easy to check in and Cristian was very helpful.

Great location in the heart of Santiago.  Parks, museums, shops, bars, restaurants and clubs within walking distance.  The place was clean and as described. Well worth it. Some nights you can hear music until late in the morning, but my son and I were able to sleep through it.
Host was friendly and welcoming, which made my stay in the city safe.    Everything’s perfect and just like what was offered in the ad.

The place is well located in the Providencia area. Lots of restaurants nearby, plus a nice park right across. Others mentioned some stains on the couch, but honestly it didn’t bother us. Our only issue was the living room floor was a bit dirty. Not the while place though. Overall it was a nice stay at German’s apt. Would recommend
Clara’s place in a perfect spot to explore Santiago. Had a great stay and would come back next time. Very flexible and excellent communication!

Location, location, location! This spot is right where you want to be in Santiago, you can walk to cafe’s, restaurants, bars, shopping and site seeing. Check in was a breeze and it’s easy to find. About 20-30 mins from the airport via taxi/Uber.
The apartment is very spacious, 3 stories with 2 bathrooms and tons of room for a group or large family. We loved the private patio in the rear and balcony in the front.
The only reasons for not giving 5 starts is that there were some hairs in the bathrooms - nothing major. Also, the hot water did not work in the basement bathroom. There was no AC in the unit which was difficult. We were in Santiago on some pretty warm days - 95°F/35°C. The owner offered to have fans delivered but we would’ve had to have been home for a 3 hr window and wanted to spend that time in the city.

Our stay here was the final part of our month-long journey in Chile and Argentina. It was a great place to spend four days, foody places, local markets little shops, and just a great all around area to spend time relaxing after hiking 10 days on the O in Torres del Paine. We walked everywhere including to the museums. Would recommend this apt, host was excellent. Thanks for relaxing stay.
Felipe and his mum weee super accomodating with my plans . An awesome spot and the view is absolute amazing . Watching the sun set over the city and the Andes was stunning .
Susan’s place was a great stay for a couple days in Santiago. Everything was as described and the area is quite walkable!

Alvaro was a fantastic host and his apartment was very beautiful. Alvaro also allowed us to store our luggage before check-in, so we could explore Santiago. The neighborhood is a very exciting one, with lots of restaurants, bars and nightclubs, but also San Cristobal mountain literally out the window, which is a FUNicular place to see.

Mariana was very professional and everything worked good! The area is in the center of Santiago, in the middle of a really cool area plenty of bars, cafes and restaurants. In the room was really quiet and we could sleep really well. We definitely recommend it for future travellers :)

Great place and great location. The check-in process with the front desk of the building went smoothly. Adrian communicated well and always responded promptly. I sometimes didn’t have network access, so I couldn’t respond as quickly as him, but he was always on top of things.
Good location in the city, close to everything we wanted to see and do. Clean, lovely place and had a great time.
we absolutely love staying here. beautiful place, fantastic location and the host was super responsive. we would most definitely stay here again.

Good value. Decent location and only a 30minute walk to downtown. Gym and Pool are not 100% usable due to building regulation. Inquire before booking. The building had maintenance during my stay so it was not 100% quiet. The neighbourhood is good.  The owner is very communicative. The church beside has bells ring throughout the day.
This is an amazing place with an amazing host. I would definitely stay here again and strongly recommend this place.

Very convenient location. The apartment is modern and clean. Communication was great – quick response to any questions. A bit of street noise noticeable at night; but, it wouldn’t keep us from staying here again. We enjoyed our stay very much!

Thank you so much Jessica! We had a wonderful visit to Santiago and your place was lovely. Great neighborhood, easy to get around, and a well outfitted home with all the comforts. Will highly recommend!!

I was very happy with my visit at this departement. The host is super friendly and helpful with whatever you need. if you like training i highly recomend OCR Camp on the other side of the building, we managed to get access to train for free during our stay.
Very nice apt, enjoyed my stay. One downside though: the room has no direct window to the open air, it connects to a staircase instead, and because of this, it gets really hot (I was there in summer)

Comfortable apartment for short term stay in Santiago. Only a short walk to Parque metropolitano, Sky costanera building and short cab to mercado central / main plaza. Great café & produce store in the park over the road. Kitchen equipped with all basics; 2nd bedroom a touch small to fit travel cot for our 1 year old so had her in our room; secure building in what felt like a safe part of Santiago.

Excellent location for exploring the city of Santiago. Easy access to the subway system, lots of coffee shops around and restaurants close by. The area is super green and leafy if you’re into running or walking. The host is above & beyond. This is a really great deal. Recommended!

Diana was very communicative and was more than happy to assist with an early check in. Her place is in an excellent location in Santiago and gives you easy access all the amenities you’ll need during your stay. I would definitely recommend Diana’s place for anyone staying in Santiago

Amazing view! Maria was the best at communicating and keeping us updated on the apartment. We felt safe in this area and would recommend! There is no AC and got very hot, but otherwise was a great space. Had a couple issues getting into the apartment with the keys but we eventually figured it out.

The location in Lastarria is great and so lively! Many restaurants, bars, coffee shops, stores, markets, and more right outside the building.  The house was very spacious, clean, and felt safe. The garden in the back and the balcony in the front of the house were lovely. We ran into an electricity issue but the host was very responsive and addressed questions/issues immediately as best they could. Highly recommend!
Jessica’s place was beautiful and exactly like what the description said. A big mall nearby which made it easy to get anything we needed as well.
Great apartment for our short stay. Marcela communicated well and felt safe in the neighbourhood. Pool was great to use on the rooftop.
Stylish large place walking distance from lots of restaurants. Parking is easy on the street in front of the space. A great stay!

The location was perfect and central to all the main sightseeing spots. Very convenient with mini markets and coffee/bakery shops nearby. Maritza was very communicative and shared helpful tips throughout the process. The space was just enough for us as we were always out and about.
Close to a very nice park and areas and the subway. Made it easy to get around. Would recommend

Manuel’s apartment is lovely! Great location for walking and public transport. Very clean, great water pressure in the shower, strong wifi, and well stocked kitchen. There is a lovely courtyard in front of the building as well. The check in process and communication was very smooth. I highly recommend!

Soledad was very responsive throughout our stay. Helpful to organize a cab to the airport very early in the morning and was there to greet us when we arrived. The second bedroom was a bit smaller than expected but didn't hinder the stay at all. Would stay again.

Ana María is amazing host! Our communication was really good during month. I was on vacation. Great apartment for summer time, no any direct sun on window. I will be glad to stay in that apartment again. Thank you

Gerardo was an excellent host. He always responded very quickly and was always helpful.
The place is in a nice neighbourhood with many restaurants and bars. The only down side is it can be noisy at night time due to the bars which are very close and stay open until very late in the night.
We loved all the local recommendations he had in the place and the place was exactly as described. He had all the basic amenities such as tea, coffee, towels etc.
thanks for the easy stay!

Camilio‘s house
is a dream! very good location and Camilo gabr as super hints and tips for our stay! wherr do buy groceries, wine, bread! famtastico

The place is nice and just like the pictures, the only problem is that there is just 1 fan for the entire unit and it is not even enough to cool down a single room, a side from that everything is great

This host was hard to communicate with, unclear instructions. Fees were greater than expected. Very unprofessional wanting to come to room to check something about internet even though we had already been staying there for a day.
Jean was a great host! Very responsive to all our questions. Great place to stay, close to airport.
Good location. Clean apartment. No AC in the living room, only in the bedroom, so it can be a bit hot in the day. Good wifi. Overall, great place to stay.

Lío is an amazing host!  He thoughtfully ordered a kitchen appliance I had asked about and sent a fan when the weather got hot, both without my requesting them.  The place is as attractive as pictured and seemed more spacious in person.  It’s on a quiet, pretty street, and close to the metro and lots of shops and restaurants.

We were happy with our stay as the apartment was exactly as described. The apartment is very close to the city centre and public transport, which made it ideal for us as we only had two days in Santiago.  It was very secure and the host, Rodrigo, was flexible with the check-in time, gave us lots of advice on how to get around and allowed us to store our baggage after we checked out.  Great value for money - definitely would recommend!

Hector is a great host, and the location is excellent for being in the heart of nightlife & restaurants. When I stayed unfortunately there were some wifi issues, so do check if that has been sorted if you need to use Zoom from there, (though if you have an unlocked phone you may be able to sort it with a local SIM.)

I didn't spend a lot of time in the apartment but it was good for me and the view was amazing. It was pretty accesible from the airport, I just took a bus and the subway. The only downside is that it doesn't have an AC but leaving the window open fixed it (unless you're a light sleeper). Also, the guy at the reception when I checked in was super rude, good thing I didn't see him again.

Buenísimo! The stay here was perfect. Felipe was incredibly responsive to my questions. He had such a nice amount of information on the area and the apartment! The apartment is in excellent condition, very clean and all amenities needed. The pool on the top floor was a treat to cool off during hot weather. I would like to stay here again!

Ximena and Pablo's apartment is excellent and was the perfect home base to have while we explored Santiago. The balcony and views were so pleasant that we sometimes didn't know whether we preferred to dine out at one of the many restaurants in the area or make a meal and enjoy some wine while we looked out over the city and watched the sun set. The apartment was easy to find and the keyless check in was very convenient. The apartment had all the amenities we needed and was clean and well organized. Ximena was very responsive and was even kind enough to offer us a space to store our bags after check out so that we could explore Santiago unencumbered before our flight left that evening. We didn't want to leave this amazing little spot and highly recommend it to anyone else looking for a city apartment to call home while they explore Santiago!

Everything about Lucia’s apartment is fabulous. Great location, good building and a very nice and functional space. Great balcony and comfortable bed.
Lucia is a great host.

The location of the place was perfect.  It was one half block off the Main Street.  Close to Metro. When we come back we will definitely stay there.  The neighborhood was safe for nice walks in the morning and evening.

Susan was an incredible host, always accommodating to our needs. She was very nice to show us in herself and talk to us about the flat and the neighbourhood. The flat itself is perfect for a couple, has an incredible balcony with a nice view, just perfect if you want to be in the vibrant neighbourhoods of bellas artes and lastarrias. Would definitely recommend!
The place was clean, and in great location. Paola was responsive and made sure we have everything we needed. I will stay again when I come back! I highly recommend staying here!
Clara's place is so central and is quiet and clean. Plus a great rooftop pool with a view. Clara is very responsive and a great host.

Cool apartment, perfect for a couple. Very nice patio!
Overall great location - short walk to Metro and lots of restaurants & bars in walking distance.
Philip is a very responsive & helpful host. Minor issues were resolved immediately. The doormen and cleaning lady are also very friendly & helpful.
Absolutely enjoyed or stay and definitely will book it again for our next stay in Santiago!

The hosts were amazing always asking how one was and very responsive and cooperative. Great people. The place was in a great location close to most things via walking and the concierge was also helpful.
María was a great host, always helpful and responded very quickly to the messages. The place has an amazing view and the location is very convenient, has many amenities nearby. Would come back :)
Antonio was really great at responding to any questions we had! His place was clean and exactly as pictured! Antonio let us know of several things to do during our stay!
