The apartment is small but has everything what you need and is well located. Everything to a walkable distance. I did have trouble to check In because my flight arrived late and the host didn’t send me the check in instructions on time. So there was some delay that when you arrive from a long flight is not what you expect. Besides that, everything was good.

Alejandro’s place was great. He was extremely helpful and made the trip very easy. The apartment had everything I needed and great wifi which made working extremely easy. The neighborhood was nice and friendly and the apartment concierge were always so helpful.

Highly recommend Gisela and her beautiful accommodation. Gisela makes you feel instantly at home and we had a lovely chat. The garden is so peaceful and feels like you are in nature within the city. Bed and room is super cosy and had everything you could need.
Go for this place- you won’t go wrong!

Lovely apartment on 8th floor down a quiet street. However as you are in the middle of the city there is still quite a lot of noise from other streets.
Hot shower (after we turned up the boiler) and the fan was a very welcome addition as it was in the mid 30s when we were there so very hot.
Susan was incredibly helpful in helping us sort out a transfer to the airport with all our luggage.
We had a great stay the only negative that we had was that the sponges etc for washing up breakfast things were old and dirty

It was a great stay at Leonor’s cozy room. She is a great host helped me everything I needed. The location is in prime area, easy access to shopping area and point of interest. I felt like at home and the warmest hospitality I ever had. Highly recommended. Thanks Leonor!
Juan’a place has amazing views. Awesome location too. He’s very helpful, so be sure to ask him for advice. Don’t hesitate just book this place!

Great place to stay if you want to discover Santiago de Chile.
Everything is withing walking distance and if it's a bit further away, the metrostation is also very close by.
The apartment itself is very cozy and has everything you need.

Beautiful apartment with Japanese-esque decor. Absolutely loved the rooftop pool/patio - would pay what I paid for this airbnb just to access it. Place was very clean and quiet at night. Will definitely come back if I visit Santiago again.

This has become one of my new favorite Airbnb available in Santiago in the Bellas Artes district!
Brian is a great communicative and attentive host. The process from beginning to end was easy and without hassles.
Everything worked well. Everything was functioning. Everything was clean.
The area is super walkable and close to everything.
The internet is top notch. I was able to work while staying there.
Instructions are clear. Amenities are nice.
Great, easy, lovely stay.
This place has a must see view!!! The balcony is a perfect ending to the day from eating and drinking in this wonderful neighborhood. So many delicious options within 2 blocks.
Small but well located apartment. question marks over the cleaning standards, in particular the crockery and cutlery were dirty

Beautiful rooftop terrace with stunning view! The building is perhaps a little bit shabby otherwise but the apartment is nice. Huge plus for private parking and pool facilities (time in the pool needed to be booked due to COVID)

This place was perfect! We were able to walk to most places (downtown, Santa Lucía, San Cristóbal). Lots of restaurants and markets around (big and small). Soledad was friendly and easy to get a hold of if we needed anything. We felt right at home. 100% recommend if you are coming to Santiago

I corresponded mainly to Yajaira who was super responsive, very friendly and helpful. The apartment is exactly as described and pictured, very clean. Option to pay and use the shared laundry machine in the basement if you ask the host/apartment manager. Great location. Strong wifi. Would recommend!

This place was a great welcoming into Chile. The apartment is has a fully equipped kitchen for all your needs. The view from the 10th floor is gorgeous. The bed was extremely comfy.
You can easily access the apartment by foot and it is close to the metro. Also a 10-15 minute walk to the park /art museum/hippy area for food, shopping, and other things.
Highly recommend.
The hotel was nice and was pretty close to the train station. There was laundry on site, which was extremely helpful. They allowed us to do late check out as well.
Mabel’s place is amazing! Such a beautiful home, everything was as described. Would definitely stay again. Thanks for everything!

Anita and Abraham are two of the nicest sweetest people you will meet in Chile. Really make you feel at home. They were more helpful than any other host I can remember. Even took me to the airport.  Nice.  Recommend highly.

Jessica is a great host, very responsive and helpful. It is a beautiful location. We enjoyed our stay.
The only thing missing was condiments like salt, pepper and soap.
Gonzalo is a great host and easy to communicate. Apartament is great. Nice and very secure neighborhood.
Good place at a great location. Pedro is very friendly and was always available to help resolve any issues. Would stay again.

This place is awesome! There was a GREAT view of the city and we really enjoyed the table on the balcony while having our morning coffee. Cristobal was super responsive and helped us through all of our issues within minutes.  I hope I get to stay in this place again the next time I'm back in Santiago!

My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights while in Santiago. The place was super clean and looked exactly like the pictures. The best part of the place is being almost on the top floor with 2 balcony doors that fully open over looking Santiago and Santa Lucia hill. The views make this place spectacular and worth it. The place is a bit small but for 2 people we found it cozy and enough room for us. We were really only in the place to sleep anyways while we were seeing the town. Brian and his team were very responsive with all communications. Would highly recommend the place to anyone looking for a centralized location while in Santiago.
cosy apartment, homey feeling, looked exactly as in the photos. amazing amenities- the hosts thought of everything, impressive

The hotel was great! The atmosphere was lovely, staff was extremely helpful, and there was a nice restaurant attached to boot. being centrally located, the hotel made it easy to navigate the city as well as enjoy the cool area of bellavista.

We stayed at Claudia's for a week in Dec 2022. In general we had a good experience.
The positives:
Apartment is in a upper middle class neighborhood and feels safe. The appliances were modern. There are supermarkets, coffee shops right down the building. It is a 5-6 minutes walk to the Metro station and 10 minutes walk to the shopping district. Building has 24 hrs. attendant.
The negatives:
Apartment is by a one-way street which cars speed so it is noisy. Swimming pool is not well maintained. Refrigerator is rather small. (Dorm size)
One discrepancy that I saw , description says dedicated work space. There no dedicated work space or desk. If you what to "work from Home" like me, you have to utilize the kitchen island and is very inconvenient.
But overall we enjoyed our stay.
I was visiting Santiago from San Francisco. The area was excellent, the room was spacious and clean, awesome rooftop pool. Overall - excellent!!

This place is a steal with incredible views of Cerro Santa Lucia and Cerro San Cristobal. It's right in the heart of downtown in a relatively safe area, and the building feels very safe. It was a great location to walk around the city. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and tastefully decorated. Would gladly stay here again!

This apartment is all about location. The views day and night are breathtaking. The neighborhood is peaceful and safe (we were here with our 2 kids). And the building is walking distance to so many things. Walking around the neighborhood you can find any food you want, items to stock up the apartment, and easy Uber to anywhere you want to go. The beds were comfortable, the apartment was clean, and the doormen were very friendly and helpful.
The only thing I would want to improve on this place was to have more items stocked. We had to immediately go buy things like toilet paper (only one roll per bathroom), paper towels, etc. No big deal, minimarket was right there on the same block. I would definitely use this is a base to explore Santiago again and again. We felt very much at home.
The apartment was lovely and is located in a great area. We were very happy with everything and found Pepe to be very helpful!

Amazing spot right in the center of Bellavista happenings.
Lovely additions such as included breakfast and even access to bar and coffee for leisurely refreshing.
Would definitely return for next Santiago trip!

Gisela’s guest house is even more charming than the photos let on! The garden area is beautiful and feels like a little oasis in the city. She was a very thoughtful and attentive host. I would absolutely recommend this place to others! :)
Really enjoyed our stay. Everything was spotless; comfortable bed, good air conditioner and hot water. Easy access to the restaurant in the building, food is pretty good.

Gerardo was great! Really strong communication. I left some cash there by accident and he was quick about returning it. Great service!
Apartment was clean and in a vibrant neighborhood. We walked to plenty of bars and restaurants!

The most gracious and accommodating host we’ve ever had! He helped us store our bags so we could focus on exploring the city. The place is gorgeous and close to many of the things you’d want to explore in the city. The neighborhood is very young with lots of discotheques. He provided ear plugs and we closed the windows at night. We enjoyed sunset views of the city from the roof each night and the pool one day. Highly recommend this spot in Santiago!

Apartment was very clean. Plenty of kitchen utensils and they also left some basic foodstuff such as oil, sugar, tea, coffee etc. Area is very handy for the metro and other forms of transport. Lots of shops and restaurants. Online shopping (Jumbo, Lider) was also very easy. The neighbourhood also feels very safe. Cesar always responded very promptly to any of our questions. Fast internet connection. I would definitely stay there again.

Alexandra is very kind and helpful. The place is located right by the metro, very convenient location. Don’t expect so much from the swimming pool but nice view. It’s a bit noisy to open the windows, otherwise we had a wonderful stay, everything is as described!

A well appointed apartment in a good location. Very clean and fully equipped with modern appliances. The building is modern, everything works well, and the rooftop swimming pool is excellent with views over the city and to the Andes mountains.

Gisela's place truly was an oasis in the middle of busy Santiago. She is constantly looking for ways to improve the experience of her guests and her warm personality makes her the perfect host. The cottage is cozy, has everything you need, and is complemented by her beautiful garden and outdoor sitting area. We enjoyed exchanging ideas, laughter, and a few glasses of wine with Gisela. Would definitely return!

My family of four stayed here over Christmas.   The apartment is very tastefully decorated and very functional.  Loved the balcony and the  closeness to the mall and park.  Jessica was very responsive and helpful with a few questions we had.  Overall, would stay again and recommend to others.
had a great time at Susan's place. She was an amazing host who was always willing to help 100%. Location and place recommended.

Great location and apartment. Host was also very accommodating by letting us check in early and store our luggage after checkout. However, A/c is a portable unit in the front room so bedrooms are pretty hot and there is a lot of noise at night so bring earplugs.

the flat was practical and comfortable in a very beautiful old building. the bed was very comfortable.
Thanks, I recommend!
Host very responsive and accommodating. Location great right near big bus terminals.  Bed very comfortable. Spectacular view from the apartment.  Very nice experience here
Great location, excellent value. Very relaxing place to be with good access to metro system that takes you wherever you need to be.

This place was amazing, and one of the best views of Santiago that you'll ever get. We were traveling from abroad and it was easy to get to, and quick and easy access to the bus station. Amazing little apartment, nice kitchen, shower, and bedroom, really nice patio!! The neighborhood wasn't the nicest (we had an egg dropped on our taxi's car as we arrived), but inside the apartment building and inside the apartment itself we felt safe. It's on the 25th floor (top floor) of the building and the view of Santiago at night was truly incredible. There were some food options for dining and some markets nearby. Really great value for the price. Would highly recommend!

This place is truly a gem in Santiago. Gisela's background in landscaping is evident in the backyard oasis she has created. Perfect space to come back to after spending a day exploring. She is very friendly and accommodating. If we return to Santiago, we will surely rebook.

Felipe and Oliver are excellent hosts. Communication was easy and they sent all the details well in advance. Their place is cozy and well equipped for your stay. Looking forward to staying there again when i'm in Santiago next!
Pepe and Erika make a great team. With any queries or issues, Pepe responds very quickly, while Erika is on the ground and extremely helpful!

Valentina's place is cozy and well located to explore Santiago. The apartment is close to the metro, several cultural attractions, and many great restaurants over in the Lastarria neighbourhood. We enjoyed our short two-day stay, though would enjoy more space for anything longer than that :)

It was a great apartment. We loved having the balconies.  Loved using the pool but it was closed for some of our stay due to it being NY.  Very close to a shopping centre, restaurants and big supermarket.  The nearest tube is a good 20min walk.  I would def recommend this apartment.

Perfect location if you have any transfers via bus terminals. The place is spotless. The host was friendly and very responsive. Super easy self-checkin process. Amazing view of the city since it’s on the top floor!

The apartment was absolutely lovely! Daniela and the other host were always so helpful, and responsive! They went above and beyond to make our experience in Chile relaxing and smooth! Highly recommend this place for any amount of time you spend in Santiago.

Mabel was an exceptional host. She went above and beyond to make us feel at home in the space.
The home was centrally located and close to shopping and public transportation.
The space was large, well appointed and comfortable.
We had a marvelous time and highly recommend this property as it is a tremendous value.

Nice apartment with amazing balcony. The balcony was the highlight as we spend more time than expected admiring the view of the Andes. The apartment had lots amenities, bed was comfy, good shower pressure and the building felt safe. Overall good stay.
Fantastic place to stay!! Highly recommend this place as a base while you are in Santiago. Juan is awesome and very attentive!
Close to the zoo/park. Secure entrance into the apartment complex with helpful people minding the front desk at all times.

We really enjoyed our stay at Juan’s place. The place looked even better than in the photos. Juan was really welcoming and friendly. His daughter was there visiting for the holidays. We enjoyed meeting both of them. Would highly recommend!
Victor’s apartment is ideally located to walk to some great neighborhoods. It is also very safe because it is right next to a university and an urgent care hospital. Definitely recommend!

The place was absolutely perfect for our needs. The location was great, and there were so many nice touches, such as the huge balcony, access to a laundry room, and the security of a 24-hour door person. I also thought the pictures didn’t do it justice; it was even cuter in person.
Walkable for us to all the places we wanted to see. The balcony is very nice and it’s a good spot to return to for a few days while exploring the city.

We loved staying at Daniela's apartment. Everything from check-in to check-out was super easy, and the location right next to the metro station made getting around the city quick and easy. We really liked having the terrace to sit out on, and having the option to use the AC unit when it was super hot was appreciated. Providencia is an excellent place to be. We would stay at Daniela's place again.
Awesome clean and cool place to say for first few nights in Chile. Great location and Christian is very responsive to any questions.
Great space within walking distance to everything. Patricio was a patient and good host. Would recommend.

I had the pleasure of staying at Javier's place and really enjoyed my stay. It was the nicest place I stayed at during my South America trip 😊 The apartment was well equipped, the location was good and Javier was an excellent host.

Soledad was very friendly and helpful letting us in herself. The place was comfy and has beautiful views from both the duplex and rooftop. Right in the heart of bustling central Santiago.
Note: make sure you have coins for the laundry room
Amazing city views, located in a great area close to restaurants, shops, public transport. The doorman was always attended to help. Juan is a great host, very responsive at any inquiry.

Susan is an amazing host! Our flight from Mendoza was delayed by 1-2 hours due to which we landed pretty late in Santiago. When we arrived at the Airbnb, Susan was waiting for us to hand over keys in person and did so with the most genuine smile on her face. She was warm and welcoming and chatted with us about all the wonderful things to do in Chile. The apartment is in a great location and we walked or took Uber to all the major touristy spots. Highly recommend this apartment.

Nice modern apartment with great facilities. By Chilean standards its 5 star. Nothing to complain about, had a great stay. Good location, close to metro, everything looks just like the photos. Would definitely stay again. Thanks

Place is well located , near to restaurants , pubs and cafés. Nestor is amazing host, well communicative. always helpful.
Highlight recommended!!!

Marcela’s apartment was nice, clean, and in a good location.  The rooftop pool has  great view of Santiago.  Apartment was close to San cristobal hill, close to the metro and there are plenty of places within a 10 minute walk of the apartment.

Stayed for 5 days while attending a class. Location was great for what I needed (close access to school, coffee shops nearby, a park to run). It felt safe, and las condes overall is similar to financial district.
Really appreciated the small touches Elizabeth provided - candies, cup for water in the room. My favorite part was the balcony access

Cristobal's apartment was one of the highlights of our accommodation experience across Santiago. It's spacious, thoughtfully decorated, and features a gorgeous plant-filled balcony with stunning views of the city. The apartment was perfect for our week-long stay given all the amenities (laundry, etc) and we felt right at home.
Cristobal is also an incredibly responsive and communicative host who really cares for the experience you have in his home. 10/10!
Fantastic quiet stylish place with wonderful views of the city. Convenient to stay as a launchpad to walk around the city seeing the sights. Close supermarkets.
Lovely place in El Golf de Chile, the host was very quick with responses and checked in regularly to see if everything was good. The view is also amazing.

Nice people, but the room is indeed small and with no ventilation. As the room is on the service area, it is a but uncomfortable to go inside the apartment and use the amenities. But for the price, it was okey.
Lovely clean stylish apartment right in the centre of town. Claudia was very helpful and a gracious host

Our stay at Patricio's apartment was truly amazing! The apartment was comfortable, clean, nicely decorated, and had everything that we needed for our stay. I think my personal favorite part about the apartment was the view! The location of the apartment was great as well, walking distance from shops, restaurants, and sites to see in Santiago. Last but not least, Patricio was a great host! He was readily available to answer any questions we may have had and made everything very easy for us. Overall, it was a very pleasant stay and I would highly recommend Patricio and his apartment to anyone visiting Santiago.

I wish I would have found this place earlier. Great accommodation, fantastic service, and the location is excellent.
I will totally come back on my next visit to Chile.
Mabel and her staff were very responsive and helpful during check in. The place was everything we wanted.

Gonzalo’s place was exactly as described. He responds quickly and is more than willing to help you. His recommendations for food and activities were great. The bed was comfortable and the house itself was spotless. I highly recommend staying here for a comfortable stay with amazing views that’s within walking distance to many great parts of Santiago

Mabel was a really good host and she took time to greet us when we arrived even though someone had already helped us with the check-in. The place was cute and the little details that she kept from when it was originally built were nice too. Overall, a pleasant stay!

Gonzalo and David were like family. they were so welcoming and helpful and showed me the best that Santiago had to offer! their place is beautiful and perfectly located. everything i wanted to see was within walking distance and it's close to the subway. David and Gonzalo went above and beyond and i can't wait to stay at their place next time i come to Santiago.
Perfect location. Rooftop was amazing for seeing the night sky. Nice to have the pool at the end of the day to cool off. Jessica was very helpful. Would definitely stay again!
This area is like a college dorm, there was loud music playing throughout the night until early morning. It was loud and inconvenient

The apartment is located close to Los Dominicos Metro Station. If you need to use the underground to move it's a great place, with nice view to the Santiago Basin. We were 4 (2 adults and 2 kids) and it's a comfortable place to sleep. We almost didn't expend time in the apartment (just a good place to sleep).

My son had an accident and the host, although not here, was truly helpful, he is connected 24 hours to adivse on hospitals and everything---without his advice we would not have chosen the hospital to do the surgery.
When we were checking out he also automatically extended the stay to 12pm (simply as it is booked for the same day)---which was perfect for us as the next host starts from 1pm---all the hosts in Santiago are just so nice and helpful!
The location is right opposite the big supermarket which sells lots of seafood, there is also corner store and metro stations near by. Security guards 24 hours.
This is the safest accommodation in Santiago---the host looks into all detailed and safety measures, this is the only anti-slip bathroom we had in Chile and the safety standard inside the flat is high.
We definitely want to come back!

I personally found this place to be quite overrated, based on the high rating it has. It is extremely small, with no space whatsoever to maneuver and a bit worn out with old walls with some damage, moldy shower, windows that don’t block any noice from outside etc. It is not all bad as the location is good, the owner is friendly and the price is not high, but I personally expected better and hence I checked out after one night, mainly due to noice at night from a neighbor.
Excellent location with the convenience of reception and a lovely cafe downstairs. The host was super welcoming and the place was beautifully decorated and spotless. Will definitely come back
Arnaldo was such a good host and very easy to communicate with. There was no problem. We had a great time in the apartment even though we looked forward to the pool which was closed for our visit.

great place super fast and reliable internet, safe, with a parking spot, pool, well equiped kitchen, nice bed, nice balcony with nice view with a mall and a park nearby  i stayed for a month and would stay here again
Great location, clean, 400 mbps down WiFi, super nice to have the two full bathrooms. Everything I could want for a two week stay in Santiago!

Very central and walkable, but at the same time quiet and safe. Flat exactly as described, comes with ultra fast internet, modern TV and fully equipped kitchen. Alejandro was super responsive and very accommodating to our request. highly recommended

Camilo’s apartment was a true gem in Santiago. The space is clean, quiet, safe, and feels like home. The design is spectacular and the apartment is very well laid out. There was so much natural light and windows that opened for a lovely cross breeze. The kitchen was well stocked and we were able to cook meals with ease. There are markets and a large grocery store just within minutes. The internet was also fast and consistent. Camilo is one of the most considerate and responsive hosts we have ever had on Airbnb. He accommodated us with early check in and a later check out. It was a true joy to stay in his lovely apartment and will return soon.

Alexis & his wife were very friendly and welcoming. They had lots of great recommendations especially on safety in a big city like Santiago.
The apartment was very clean, kitchen very well stocked.
It had everything we needed for a 4 night stay to explore the city.
Highly recommend it!

Soledad was so attentive! She let me in the appartement earlier than planned and even let me stay an hour later than the check-out time. Once I asked if something in the appartement was olive oil, but it wasn’t then 10 minutes later she brought olive oil! great service, I was shocked!
About the neighborhood: at first I wasn’t sure but after one walk alone it felt safe and the metro is just a one minute walk, from there you can get anywhere, awesome!
would recommend!

Great place. The only issue is that the room was not very clean when I arrived. Perhaps an honest mistake, but I always expect a high-standard, clean place. It is the minimum (especially for the price). The manager fixed the issue, but it took more than half a day to get this sorted. I hope this can improve—otherwise, a nice place to stay.
Beautiful little hotel in a great area. Staff were friendly and helpful. Thank you to everyone who made our stay wonderful.

Natalia’s apartment was just what we needed. We were only in Santiago for one night, but her place provided the perfect spot for quick adventures to Cerro San Cristóbal and La Chascona. It was also surrounded by great restaurants. Lastly, the apartment itself was spotless and has an AMAZING view from the 21st floor. Natalia herself was super responsive and flexible with checkout. Highly recommended!

Positives:
-Very close to the park & cafes.
-Secure building.
-Silent.
-Good WiFi & TV.
Negatives:
-The space is a bit more run-down that the photos make it look.
-It gets too hot during the day with direct sunlight and no AC.
-One side of the neighbourhood seems a bit sketchy.
The room is beautiful in an independent building set in a lovely garden. Area is very pleasant and a 20minute walk from the interesting street of Barrio Italia!

We had a great stay at Cristian's place during our travels in Chile. The apartment was clean, comfortable and secure in a great neighbourhood which was walkable to lots of the attractions we wanted to visit. We'd thoroughly recommend!
This was a great spot for our Santiago stay! Perfect location with lots of stuff to do ❤️ highly recommend staying at this location.

I stayed at Javier's place for one night. The apartment is nice with a very good view and it has a lovely balcony. Javier as a host was excellent: welcoming, very helpful and with a great sense of humor.

¡Fantastico! Highly recommend this cozy little apartment right near the Bella Vista neighborhood.  I felt very safe and welcome at Claudia’s place.  Claudia was always responded quickly for any questions I had and gave good recommendations for me.  ¡Gracias!

Apt was just as seen on photo with beautiful art! Camilo was very flexible and communicated easily with us. Would have liked more comfortable pillows and bed  as have come to expect this with superhosts (first time in Air bnb in South America).  Shower wasn't really strong and very old. Also no air-conditioning, which was our mistake as we assumed, but fans did work great.  However, we really did enjoy the apt and it's close to many restaurants in cool Italia section of Santiago. Would have been nice to have list of things nearby in apt, but he did text to us.  I would recommend staying here as really nice place. Terrace a bonus too!
Fantastic location right next to a very trendy neighbourhood. Good communication from the host and very good value for money.

The 25th floor was a great place for me, quiet, great view and easy to get in and out. Great host, super detailed and made it very seamless, the whole process. Slept like a baby on the bed, super comfy. Great food nearby, and very secure apartment building.

It was our second time at The Place. And we will come back again, and hopefully again. The studios are well equipped, clean, nice and modern. The balcony is nice for an evening wine. The restaurant/coffee place downstairs yummy and convenient, the co working place a clear plus. Location is great too. You are in walking distance of a fantastic park, restaurants and a mall. Would recommend 100%

Rodrigo was an incredible host. He was so responsive and helpful to all our needs - from advice on how to get to/from the airport and things to do. We really appreciated the extra thought and support he gave us. Highly recommend.

I had a wonderful stay at Marisol's. The room is cozy, clean and spacious, everything works great, the patio is very enjoyable and Marisol is very nice and helpful - she has very good recommendations. The location is highly convenient, in a very quiet street and safe neighborhood. I highly recommend this place! Thank you Marisol!
She is a very kind and quick host. I was not uncomfortable during my stay because of her kind response and neat accommodation. I extended my accommodation.

Paola’s place is a great location and is very clean and well maintained. Great view from the balcony. There are convenience stores and Starbucks right downstairs. The only thing is to remember to bring your own detergent for the washing machine. Thank you Paola for a great stay!

This was a great stay. It was about a ten or fifteen minute walk to TONS of bars and restaurants. It was quiet at night, which was a HUGE plus. The host had provided towels,  sheets and lots of extra blankets, dish soap, body soap (not shampoo), hand towels, etc.
Beautiful place! Especially view from the balcony. And Susan was very helpful with check in and everything.
Fernandas place is exactly as described.  a short walk from the centre and also very close to public transport. Cafes, resturants and supermarket all in close proximity. a great stay.
Claudia‘s place is small, cute, cosy, and in a very charming neighborhood. We had a great stay!

Great place in an amazing, busy and fun neighborhood, near plenty of restaurants and bars and a short walk to the historical center of the city. Just be aware that you are right in the middle of a busy nightlife and things don’t quiet down until after 10:00 pm. We loved it but it may not be for everyone!
Super responsive hosts and a great apartment! Wifi was great enough to work with numerous zoom meetings throughout the day

Honestly the best Airbnb we stayed so far! Right next to Lastarria- the nice restaurant and shopping area!
We felt very save and didn’t want to leave!
Victor is so nice. He allowed us to stay a bit longer and was always helping us with questions. 10\10 you won’t regret it!
Fantastic place to stay for a few nights in Santiago, the apartments are great and the area is perfect!
Cristian’s place was excellent! He was very communicative when needed and everything was clean and perfect. Good location in Lastarria also!

Soledad's appartment is perfectly located to explore Santiago for a few days. Metro stations is nearby, bars and restaurants within walking distance.
Plus: small pool on the rooftop!
Amazing centrally located gem in Santiago . The balcony views are out of this world . Walking distance to the metropolitan park and a nearby train station . Will definitely come back again.

Perfect location and lots of stores within walking distance. Our kids used the pool a lot, it was a very kid friendly apartment. I would recommend it.
The cleaning wasn’t up to standard, the floors were dirty and dusty, but that’s an easy fix for future tenants.

We loved our stay and would recommend staying here while visiting Santiago. It is close to public transportation but still in a more quiet area. The view is incredible!
Cristobal was very helpful if we had any questions and the process of check in and check out was super smooth.
Jean and his mother were great from beginning to end. Communication, warm welcoming, flexible and understanding on the check in. His mother even brought toys for the kids which was very kind.
I enjoyed my stay at Soledad's. Very centrally located in walking distance to downtown Santiago.  I really liked the set out of the apartment. Very cool. Would stay again

This little apartment is very well equipped and in one of the best neighbourhoods of Santiago city: Lastarria.
All recommendations of things to do, restaurants and transport were excellent.
Even had a lovely bottle of wine waiting for us.
Highly recommended!!!

Amazing building, lots of amenities and surrounding places to walk around. Great rooftop lounge, pool could be bigger.
Great staff, if you ever need anything just call reception and they will grant any request.
Great place to stay with an awesome view. Super close to Plaza de Armas, walkable to Lastarrias, etc. Brian was a great host and the apartment was spotless. Can definitely recommend!

Wonderful experience! Apartment is beautiful — clearly designed by a professional, as he notes in his description. Everything was very comfortable. It was also quite a private spot, which was nice. Only issue was that Internet wasn’t always super fast — it sometimes cut out. But that wasn’t a major problem. Camilo was also a great communicator who was ready to help with any needs or questions we had. A big bonus was the free cleaning after we stayed for 7 days! Made a big difference for the second week of our stay.
This place is wonderful!  The bed is extremely cozy with the best pillows. The sunset view is amazing. The neighborhood is good for waking around and finding food.

Gisela made us feel so welcome! The house was very well equipped and practical. We loved sitting outside under the trees drinking our coffee or sipping wine. Despite being in the middle of Santiago it was so quiet, cozy, and relaxing. We would love to visit Gisela again!

Victor is a fantastic host — he’s easy to communicate and helped us greatly with checkin / checkout times. The building isn’t super new but the place itself has pretty much everything we needed. It’s very well located — 2-3 mins walking distance to a lot of bars, cafes and restaurants but the house itself is very silent and calm.

Everything was as shown in the pictures, the building was pretty new and the apartment was clean and nicely decorated and had A/C in the bedroom.
The check in process was a bit of a pain (web registration) and I was a bit concerned with sending personal information thru a website were I am not sure about it’s security controls

Everything was great. The location is close to many restaurants, supermarkets, el parque metropalitano, the metro etc. The neighborhood is nice and not as busy as staying on the other side of the river.

Apartments are very stylish, it’s rare to find this kind of interior- with lots of plants and small details. It’s just a pleasure to stay there. Huge balcony. Comfortable beds and bed linen. Bathtub a bit old, but for taking a shower it’s totally fine. Boris is super responsive, accepted reservation very fast. Guys at the reception (concierge) are very friendly and welcoming. Location is good, close to metro and main attractions. Boris gave us great recommendations for Valparaiso and Vina del Mar. Thanks a lot

I had a great experience staying in Said’s modern styled apartment. The location is close enough to the old town center by walking or by the very efficient subway, but quiet and relaxing. The well stocked kitchen has all you need to cook a light meal. The communication with Said was flawless. Great value. Highly recommended.
Great, shinny clean, friendly, helpful, organized, good English, many extra touches make it extra special. Thank you to whole family.

Very nice and spacious apartment with a great balcony with a view on Cerro San Cristobal. The apartment was very quiet and clean and has all you need for a longer stay (washing machine, fully equipped kitchen etc.). The host and the concierges were extremely friendly and helpful. Full recommendation!
Greatly located and cafe on site was helpful! Only recommendation would be and update to the bathroom. Would recommend!

Except for language issues with the concierge, check-in was easy. Could have used more than 1 towel per person; pool towels would’ve been a nice bonus; poorly lit, though, but we managed and enjoyed our time there very much

Everything ok. Didn’t have phone reception in the apartment, WiFi took a while to get working and impossible to get a hold of someone. Location and house are great, just hard to communicate with the ownership group

As a traveler with a lot of anxiety, I chose Boris’ place because it looked so serene and relaxing. I’m happy to report that arriving to his apartment was every bit as peaceful and comfortable as I was hoping. It’s so well-decorated with lots of interesting accents and the serene blue color of the walls is very soothing and pretty. I felt completely at home and it felt like I was at my own apartment when I was there. Boris was an awesome host. He was so on top of it, reaching out to me first about every important detail and making sure that I checked in okay. He responded to me almost immediately every time I messaged him. Definitely a 10/10 experience. Thank you so much, Boris.
It is a great apartment, as described in pictures. It felt a bit small, but the big windows compensated to feel spacious.

This was a great stay and I would recommend it to others travelling to Santiago. It is minutes walk from interesting things to see and blocks from train and bus routes. The mountain/skyline/sunset views from the pad are excellent! The building is very secure and we felt quite safe there. Thanks again!

Lovely little apartment close to many of the sites of downtown. Comfortable bed, fully stocked kitchen, nice view. The air conditioning worked hard and didn't always keep the bedroom completely cool, but it was an unusually how few days.

Amazing location, the street can get a little hectic but all nightlife activity seems to end by 11 most nights so it didn’t affect our sleep at all. The place was comfortable and of most of the neighborhoods we explored in Santiago this was our favorite.
Maria’s apartment is wonderful! It’s very close to great parks and restaurants. The view from the balcony is also incredible.
Great new apartment with all the required kitchenware and amenities. Self check-in with a key code so no problems getting in even if you arrive late. Beautiful neighbourhood, close to metro station.

Comfortable apartment in a secure building with 24h security at the front desk. Apartment is mostly as pictured, with some  details missing (carpet, plants, decor). Clear entry instructions provided. Wifi, AC and TV all worked. There was no hair dryer and as others have mentioned, the place could certainly be much cleaner. Overall a decent experience.
This Airbnb was a fantastic place to stay! I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to be near to restaurants and the mall.

We arrived late and we’re very nervous about the location. However, the place was located near key sites and restaurants. We walked everywhere! It’s a small apartment that works fine for two people. Brian even helped us find a place to store luggage. Thank you!
They were absolutely lovely. They picked me up and dropped me from airport. Very kind and accommodating. I was there for a day layover and they easily helped me.

Great apartment close to the city center and the subway. The kitchen has everything to cook, wash up and clean. The washing machines are in the building for which you'll need change. The host provided detergent, soap, toilet paper, sponges and dish soap which was very considerate. The flat was very clean and I felt at home quite fast. The internet/ wifi speed is excellent at more than 100Mbit so I had no problems working. The internet connection was very stable so I didn't experience any issues during video calls. I reached out to the host a couple of times. She answered fast, friendly and always tried to help as much as possible. I can highly recommend both the flat and the host.

Amazing flat, loved the powerful, refreshing shower. Great location, easy access to good places to eat and drink as well as museums and parks.
🙏
We loved this apartment, it is spacious and very peaceful, lots of great art on the walls and really enjoyed having an outside patio to sit in the shade

Gonzalo was always able to communicate even though my flight was delayed and I arrived on the next day. Their place was located just 15 minutes away from the centro, and also the access from the airport was easy.
Gonzalo and David were very warm and welcoming. We had a great time in the evenings drinking michelada and wine with their friends. This was my first trip to Chile and I wanted to meet the locals, so the place I stayed was perfect for me.
Thank you! See you again!
The apartment had a lot of light and good amenities. The restaurant downstairs makes the stay so much easier.

Amazing location to the Lastarria area! We enjoyed walking around, the close restaurants, bars and park. Juan was an amazing host who helped with checking in and out. The area is busy, but quiet inside. Cannot wait to book again.
Great apartment with beautiful vue. Paola had been awesome. Very good location in Provindencia.

Amazing location, host made check-in very easy and place was exactly as described.
Would highly recommend and would definitely stay here again
Great location and responsive hosts. The place feels bigger than I thought it would be from the photos.
Enjoyable place to stay. Gonzalo was an excellent host, even allowing us to drop off our bags a few hours before check in. Recommended.
A spacious, clean and well equiped apartment in the center of Santiago. The host is very nice and accommodating.
Marcia is a fantastic host. We had an amazing time in Santiago thanks to her. The pool certainly also was a highlight! Will definitely stay here again ☺️
Excellent stay! Host was very responsive. Sparkling clean and very comfortable with access to many amenities and a great location.

Lovely clean, new apartment. In an area with good connections to other parts of town via two metro stations. Said is a very responsive host, most replies in less than 10 minutes! He was also flexible in letting us check in late and check out late .
Booked for the same day. Checkin and communications were prompt and smooth. The neighborhood is amazing for cafes and restaurants and their host guidebook was very helpful. Glad I chose this place!
Nicely equipped apartment in a great location very close to taxis, market, subway, museums, restaurants, etc. I would stay here again.
Eduardo is a kind host. The location is very central, all the sights are only a few minutes to walk. High Standards of hygiene and cleanliness. Good stay for a good price.
We enjoyed staying at Felipe & Oliver’s place, especially the pool area, and the TV was great too. Their communication was great, and the check-in process was easy and simple.

This apartment is very conveniently located in a nice neighborhood. The building was safe and comfortable. The kitchen could use a few basic things - cutting board, cooking knives, paper towel, but otherwise was a very nice place to stay for a few nights. I would recommend.
Great spot, nice patios, caro is super helpful. Very well located for both nice walks and easy access to transport.

Awesome location. Lots of walkable restaurants and bars, lively street nightlife. Place is very small, as advertised, but basically just meant for crashing after a night in the city so that was perfect for me.
Fantastic stay. Location was perfect. Front desk was super easy to work with. Great recommendations in area.
Thanks you very much!! Perfect location with all the comforts of home. Very cool 40s architecture!!! First time in Chile! Very safe location!!

This place was great for our first visit to Santiago. Veronica was great to deal with and quick to respond to correspondence. The neighborhood was very lively, which we really enjoyed. One of our highlights was sitting on the front patio people watching in the evening. We would definitely stay again and recommend Veronica as a host. One small thing was there is only air conditioning in the master bedroom. They did have fans for all the rooms but if you are there during a hot time of year the second bedroom upstairs can get pretty warm. Wouldn’t stop me from staying again though.

Mario’s place is in a great neighborhood and provides all the necessities you would need for 1 person. I can also easily see myself coming back with another person.
The neighborhood is home to a great bakery and some great restaurants. I would and will 100% go back
Really enjoyed our stay in Santiago!! Very walkable and we had fun exploring the Bellavista neighborhood. The pool is amazing too!!
Amazing place; highly recommend! The staff was super helpful when we arrived late at night, the room was lovely and the breakfast was excellent

This place is seriously a gem! The garden is stunning, Gisela is very friendly and an amazing host, her dogs are lovely, and overall its a really nice hideaway from the big city while still close to everything. The garden and greenery you are tucked away in is what makes it truly special! And walking distance to Barrio Italia is amazing, a very cool place in Santiago, we loved it :)
Gisela was also extremely flexible with our timing which helped us a lot!
Highly recomended.

Great place to stay, stylish apartment look like in pictures. Borealis’s place has A/C  is perfect for Santiago in Summer and I like floor plan also house decoration. Easy to check in and Brorealis responsive
We unfortunately couldn’t stay due to a visa issue however the host immediately refunded me full amount at late notice, highly recommend
Great neighborhood and the free breakfast was a bonus. Location location location ! Free parking was safe as well!

Place was really nice. In a very safe neighborhood. Instructions were very thorough on checking in/out and how to get wifi access. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to stay in the Providencia area!

We enjoyed our stay at Odette's apartment. It is in one of our favorite neighborhoods in Santiago, walking distance to Cerro San Cristobal and great restaurants in Providencia. The apartment itself was impeccable, extremely clean, comfortable bed, and even a welcome gift of a bottle of wine. We had some issues with the internet which they tried to resolve, but as we were only there one night there wasn't much time to fix the issue. The parking space was extremely helpful for us since we were traveling with our car. Assuming the internet is working order, we would definitely stay again.
Great place in nice barrio Italia in Chile. Nice view over the barrio. An apartment that has everything you need to enjoy your stay in Santiago

In Bellavista. Pool can be booked if available. No ac but given price, it was okay. Could be a bit cleaner but overall decent stay and well situated to get around. Would be cautious staying here as a single woman
We had a good stay here. Jean’s mom is a lovely person and will help you check in!
Great apartment, location and excellent services and concierge. We travelled with a 7 months old, and this place was really convenient. Many thanks! Totally recommended!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Alvaro’s. We loved the condo, the building and the location. Alvaro was easy and a pleasure to communicate with. It was really nice watching the sunset and looking out into Santiago from the rooftop terrace. The neighbourhood is busy at night and music goes on till the very wee hours but we didn’t mind at all. Closing the window and wearing earplugs provided us with good sleeps. Alvaro’s place was the perfect place for us. We have already booked to go back!

Gisela's Airbnb is an oasis of calm and tranquility, although near to delightful restaurants and the buzz of Barrio Italia. The garden is a beautiful place to relax and enjoy on a hot day.
Gisela is a delightful host, helpful and kind. It was also a joy to meet her dogs.
We would highly recommend this Airbnb.
We booked Mario's place for a week we ended cancelling after seeing the place in person. This place needs some love and care. Mario returned our full refund and was understanding.
Very nice apartment, very good location, very clean. Everything was fine, and I'll book again.
Bit loud at the weekend and the lock on the door didn’t work properly but was fixed quickly.  Overall an enjoyable stay.

Jessica's place offers guests a convenient location in a desirable neighborhood, close to shopping and grocery stores. The accommodation itself is nicely decorated and well-maintained, with thoughtful touches like snacks and drinks available for guests. While some guests may miss the presence of a TV in the living room, the overall atmosphere of the place is comfortable and welcoming. Jessica is readily available to assist guests with any needs or questions they may have during their stay. Overall, Jessica's place provides a good option for those seeking a comfortable and convenient place to stay.

It's in Bellas Artes - a neighborhood that has lots of bars / clubs / lots of life. But it's also not the fanciest area. Check on maps street view first if this fits your travel style.
The apartment though is exactly as described and very high value for the price! The view on the San Cristobal mountain at night is amazing and the two rooms were also just as decorated and set up as in the photos! Great value!
Lovely place, even nicer than it looks. Great staff, very helpful. Very convenient having a restaurant downstairs. Would stay again if given the chance.
This apartment was in such a great location there was so much to do just right outside our door. The hosts were extremely responsive and we had a great stay!

great spot to stay in Santiago. Just as advertised as far as the space itself, Clara is super responsive with any questions or issues and given the size of a city like Santiago, my wife and I found the condo to be centrally located to get around by uber, foot or metro--and the bonus of lots of nearby terrific restaurants to satisfy any and all--even vegans!
Excellent place. Very clean, great service at the desk and good location in the city. Can only recommend!

Anita Maria and Abraham were fantastic hosts. They are two of the most caring hosts I've had on this platform and I would recommend them to anyone staying in Santiago. Their neighborhood is very conveniently located with lots of stuff to do. My Spanish is not got but there wasn't a communication barrier because the hosts are pros at using Translate app. You really feel like a member of their family. For a fee, Abraham even drove me to the airport at 4:30am to catch an early flight. Five stars

Great stay in Santiago, modern and comfortable apartment with a small private garden in a luxurious and safe neighborhood of town.  We would stay here again and can recommend the place without reservations.

Stayed for 2 weeks while working remotely. Nancy is a great host! She was responsive and accommodating and really took care of us. Her place is clean, comfortable, well-equipped, and in the perfect location for a feels-like-home yet fun stay in Santiago. Highly recommend!

We loved Rodolfo’s apartment. The apartment is nicely decorated and very comfortable. There are two rooms: a bedroom and a living room with a dining table, a small kitchen, and a large bathroom. The kitchen is small but it has everything that you need to prepare a simple meal. We end up even cooking a simple dinner for two. The most important is that Rodolfo is a fantastic host. We were able to leave our one suitcase when we were flying to Patagonia. Rodolfo agreed to store our luggage for us during our trip to Patagonia.
The only small problem is the nosy streets. You need to sleep with a closed window because of street noise.
excelente apt even has a washing machine. Paola arranged parking really easily. would highly recommend it. clean comfortable and in the summer has AC which is def a bonus
Great little place, nice & clean, in prime location. Stayed cool during hot days, and simple , functional layout. Host was always responsive to our queries. Would select same location in heartbeat…
Vesna was a great host, we forgot some AirPods on the bed, and she went out of her way to meet us to return them the same day. Very grafteful

We had a nice stay at Jorge's place. We wanted to be close to the cultural area of the city and Jorge's apartment was in the perfect spot. Jorge responded to us in a timely manner always! Additionally, the people at the front desk of the apartment building were helpful and kind.
I would recommend Jorge's place 100%

Carmen’s place was the perfect spot to stay in Santiago for a week! It is in a quiet part of Providencia but just a short walk from restaurants, bars, shops, and tons more. It is also very close to the metro for easy movement around the city. It felt very safe too.
This was the perfect place to work while in Santiago, the desk and outside table were great to use as desks and the WiFi was very fast even with 2 people working.
I would highly recommend staying here!

Epic place to stay! Also best neighborhood in Santiago in my opinion. Convinently located near the highways too. The appartment is also better in real life than on the Airbnb page.
Lovely and very responsive host, made sure we were having a good stay.
Will try to stay there next time for sure
Thanks for everything Maureen

We had a very nice stay at Valentina’s place! This Airbnb was small but clean and comfortable and had everything we could need or want as a couple for a night. The doorman downstairs made us feel very safe in the building, and there was plenty to eat and do nearby.

I stayed in the flat for about a month. The flat is clean, has a super wifi connection and has everything you need to cook. It's close to public transport.
The hosts are very helpful and messaged me several times to see if I needed anything. The congieres at the front desk are also quite helpful.
I definitely recommend staying here and the hosts are absolutely wonderful!
The host was flexible with check-in time. The place was clean and located in a safe part of the city for a solo-traveller.
Yajira was so helpful. Clear instructions for check in. Modern apartment with lots of space. Great location close to subway and restaurants.
Great place, great location, easy check in, nice little rooftop pool. Very responsive hosts, comfy bed and decent apartment overall. Worth the price, would stay again!
I stayed 10 minutes in the apartment and then left - it was not at all like on the pictures - it’s completely worn out. Thankfully got refunded by Airbnb.

GPS map was a bit confusing to us because the turn around was not over the bridge but under. Once you find the house, everything makes sense. We took over the second floor of this big house. 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms were spacious and comfortable. They let us share the sitting areas and the kitchen/dining with them, thus, we could eat in if needed. Very kind and generous owners & we managed to communicate fine even though our Spanish was limited. Just a $10 Uber ride to the center.
Charming place to stay out of the tourist fray but close to restaurants and shops.  We really appreciated the spot on recommendations for food, wine, grocery, and coffee shops.

Excellent location . 5 minute walk to a very nice mall with plenty of dining and shopping options.
Plus a beautiful park just across the street.
Great location and love the restaurant connected to the apartment. The apartment was also very clean and comfortable !

Our stay at Soledad's was comfortable and enjoyable. The location is great -- close to restaurants, grocery stores, and a metro station. The apartment is small but has everything you could need. It was very clean and well-equipped. Soledad was always quickly responsive and allowed us to check out later due to our late flight, which we really appreciated. We would definitely stay in this apartment if we were to return to the beautiful city of Santiago.

Philip's loft was the perfect stay for us. The location is fantastic, lots of restaurants and shops in the neighborhood. Philip was very responsive and even checked on us half way through our stay and gave us some great recommendations. Philip is a perfect example of a super host!

We had a wonderful stay at Gisela’s place. Excellent location, we loved the neighbourhood, but mostly we loved the house, the garden, the good taste and the wonderful company of Gisela. She is a very special person and her place is special as well. Definitely you will enjoy it a lot!

We stayed for about a week at Fernanda’s place. It was very clean’ modern and cozy apartment. It was exactly like she described. It is about 20 minutes walk from the downtown area and has many restaurants and convenient stores minutes away. Taking an Uber from the airport to the Airbnb was very fast and affordable! She was also very accommodating and let us stay longer after check out time since our flight was departing at night.
Highly recommend her place!

Great place in a central fabulous location. apartment has everything you need and a nicely stocked kitchen .
thank you
We loved our stay here. We spend a bit more than a week here. The pool was nice, we spend every day there. It was a very nice apartment.
Super easy checkin, Micaela was very helpful! The place is clean and well stocked with kitchen supplies. It is also in a great neighborhood with lots of cute cafes and little stores.

German's place is very well located and is walkable to tons of restaurants, bars, cafes and shopping. It is close to the metro and all Uber rides show up in under 5 minutes.
The condo itself is well appointed and has everything needed for one person or a couple.
German was very responsive and friendly. I had to make some changes to my plans and he was super flexible and went out of his way to make my trip comfortable. 5 stars!

Although close to city centre and public transport, the immediate area was a bit run down. So walk or taxi to restaurants etc. The apartment was as described, clean and tidy with everything we required. The concierges were very helpful in helping to arrange a taxi when Uber let us down, even taking us to the main street and flagging down a taxi for us. Boris was very prompt at answering queries and recommending restaurants etc. It's not posh but good value at the price.
It was a very nice stay at Nestor’s apartment, everything went well and Nestor is a very nice Person.

We had a great stay at Ignacia's place. The flat is really well located between Lastaria and Provi. The check in is very easy and you have everything needed to spend few nights in Santiago. The bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped. Sofia is very helpfull and reactive if needed.

It was super easy to communicate with the owner.  It is in a great part of town.  Super clean studio.  It is not a big studio but I was traveling alone and it was perfect.  Very clean.  Wifi was fast.  I would stay there again. I had to cancel a part of my reservation for a family emergency and that was easy to do.

Had an excellent stay here. Location is great, right in middle of lastarria and barrio Italia.
Clean place with great views and comfy bed. Thank you for a great stay!

Host Maureen is attentive and responsive. The apartment is located in a quiet and beautiful part of Santiago with lots of restaurants in the vicinity and it has a great view of the Bicentenario park. The apartment was nicely decorated and we felt at home while staying there.

It’s a nice apartment. Living room with a nice view of the city and a nice bedroom with an adjoining bathroom. The neighborhood is nice. A couple of restaurants nearby. The neighborhood is lined with a lot of trees.
The most important thing I can tell you is that the apartment is clean. That’s the most important thing when I use Airbnb. I had no concerns sleeping on the bed.

We had a great stay at Victor's apartment. It was a five minute walk to the cute restaurants and cafés of Lastarria. It is also close to the metro and supermarket which was very convenient! Victor was very communicative and left the keys with the concierge so we could check in at our leisure.  He also accommodated a late checkout, which we really appreciated! There is no AC, so it got a little hot in the middle of the day, but there was a fan, and the open windows let in a nice breeze. The apartment hasn't been recently renovated but was clean and spacious.
The apartment was just as advertised. The view was amazing. Gabriel was very responsive. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

Great place to stay in Santiago for solo travelers. It's very close to a huge park and the metro station which takes you everywhere in the city. Cristian was very kind and would be happy to help you with information about Santiago.

Beautiful place with an amazing rooftop and pool. As many noted, it is in a club and party neighborhood, so expect some sound late into the night. But it didn’t bother me. It was blocks to all the clubs, zoo, and parks. No complains.

Ok place for a night. The bed was too small (both width and length) for two Dutch People :) The room is many warning signs on how one could get a penalty (e.g. not doing the dishes properly, using a towel too many).

10/10 would recommend.
Great location, comfortable bed, very easy check in/out... couldn't have asked for anything more.
Maria Isabel will try to fix any issue to ensure you have a nice stay. Beautifull place with good taste. Very clean.

Gisela’s place is very cute, perfect for a couple or single traveler. Barrio Italia is a great neighborhood - full of restaurants, bars, shops. Gisela is very warm and welcoming, has plenty of recommendations, and will go out of her way to help you feel at home! Highly recommend.
Great apartment.  Nice pool on top floor of building with amazing views of city.  Perfect location near San Cristobal funicular and Patio Bellavista. Alvaro was very responsive and kind.

This Airbnb was nicely located where you can walk to all the main city attractions.
Cynthia was also always responsive on anything I needed.
I totally recommend this Airbnb.

I had a great stay at Marcia's. Her place is beautiful and centrally located. Marcia was very helpful and accommodating, she promptly replied to any messages and went the extra mile if I needed anything. I definitely recommend staying at Marcia's place and look forward to going back on my next visit in Chile.

I stayed at Maritza’s place for one month while working remotely. It has excellent wifi, is in a very convenient location central to everything, is less than one minute from the main metro line running through the city, and is well equipped, including a full kitchen. Maritza was very proactive in her communication and went out of her way to make sure I had everything I needed. I highly recommend staying with her.

Great little apartment in Bellas Artes area. Totally worth the stay. The place is tight but is comfy and has a great view. Two things to mention on the apartment is that the bathroom is a little too small if you are a tall person, but nothing serious. The mattress feel a little hard at the begging because it is retractable, but after the first night you will get use to it, no problem. What stands out is definitely the beautiful sunset view. Great kitchen with all the stuff you will need and great Wi-Fi. The neighborhood is amazing. Lots of great places to eat, near the metros and beautiful spots to visit. We really enjoyed the staying and Claudia is a very kind hostess. 10/10! You will not regret it.
Accessible neighborhood, good location, public transport very nearby. Restaurants and shops around the corner. Clean and spacious apartment, nicely decorated and  well equipped
Rodolfo's place is wonderful. We liked everything (cleanness, location, nice paintings...). Rodolfo is very responsive and easy to get in touch with.

Ac was not working and made really much sound…so the apartment was really hot and it was hard to sleep because of the noise and the temperature….Zip Housing helped us to get a fan, that helped with the temperature in the living room.
Everything else with the apartment was really nice!

The apartment is clean, and in a great location. The reception staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. I enjoyed my stay.
Check-in was a little confusing as I was given incorrect instructions, however, Eduardo was very quick to respond and help.
No problems with the apartment, however, some instructions for the laundry, garbage collections and recommendations of things to do would have been helpful.

The stay here was seamless and impeccable. Easy check in and out. The host Jessica was readily available and answered all questions and inquiries in a timely and courteous manner. Could not recommend this place enough!
Okay stay- somethings were not presented accurately and issues with wifi so not suitable for remote workers.

I feel like we hit the jackpot on the location for our stay in Santiago. Castillo Rojo is in the desirable Bellavista district which has a multitude of restaurants and is also walking distance to Pablo Neruda La Chascona house, the zoo, the funicular railway and so much more.
The room was very clean and fresh and I especially loved the coffee and tea provided in the common area. Daniel at the front desk was very helpful, friendly and went out of his way to make sure we had everything we needed. Breakfast was delicious and Diego in the cafe was prompt with excellent customer service. Our taxi ride was arranged by the front desk and made transportation to and from the airport stress free.
The stay is located in a popular area so weekends are a little noisy but not over the top crazy. I highly recommend staying here, it’s worth the price.
This place is clean and close to the subway line, bars and restos. The view of Santiago is perfect, AC was a lifesaver for the two hot summer days I was workingin Stgo. I highly recommend it!
Comfortable studio with modern amenities. Well located, close to metro stations and supermarket. Said was very responsive. Would stay here again!

Brian’s place is really great, the interior is modern and clean.  Our main issue was that we had booked it specifically for the pool and unfortunately it was out of service 2/3 days we were there. I would double check this if you are looking for a place specifically with a pool. We also had some technical issues with the wifi and smart lock but Brian fixed these very quickly.

Silvina’s place was exactly like the pictures. The flat was very comfy, having a washing machine in the flat was an extra plus. Very quiet place, very secure and central. Lovely balcony to chill out. The flat was super clean. Keys and communication was Silvina was perfect. I arrived very late and the keys were there at reception waiting for me. They have a 24hr person at reception. They have a building management which will resolve any issue super fast.
Beds comfy. As a whole great value for money, I deffo recommend this place.

The apartment is very nice, new and spacious. Kitchen appliances are plentiful, so it's not a problem to cook. Valentina communicated very well throughout my stay.
The best part: the views from the balcony are absolutely stunning.
Well equipped, clean, safe apartment. Lots of good bars and restaurants nearby. Might be little noisy because bars on weekends, but it did not bother me.
We loved staying in this apartment- very good location, Rodolfo was very responsive and kind. The apartment was pristine and very well equipped, with all the basic necessities.
Had a great stay at Alejandro’s apartment! He was very attentive to every need and question we had. The kitchen and living area was well equipped and the shower was great. Would recommend 100%!

The apartment was in a really nice, newer building and the perfect space for one person. The air conditioning was amazing especially after a long, hot day of walking around. The neighborhood felt safe and is only a short walk to a cute plaza and plenty of fun restaurants and bars in either direction. Definitely feels more “local” but is still not too far of a walk to the downtown//touristy area. The shower takes a couple minutes to get warm, so just be patient. Otherwise it was perfect for a weekend in Santiago!

My husband and I stayed in Camilo’s lovely Airbnb for 10 days. Wonderful space, tastefully done ( fabulous original art) clean, safe and great location. Camilo was super responsive and provided wonderful suggestions. Our friends stayed in the Camilo’s apartment above us, which made group gatherings super enjoyable. LOVED this Airbnb and would not hesitate to book again.
Perfect flat for visiting Santiago. Close to everything and nice apartment complex. Host was responsive and flexible.

We had a very pleasant stay at Soledad’s place. The apartment had everything you need and Soledad is a very friendly and helpful host. While the place is very near the metro station and city centre, it is not a very safe area during the night. We got recommended by locals not to walk the streets at night… also, some kitchenware was still a bit dirty. Also take into account that laundry costs you 1600 pesos. Apart from that the apartment is worth the money!
thanks Loreta, for the nice stay. I was mostly busy with the car, but you were great Company

We stayed at Bernabes place early March 2023.  Bernabe was amazing.  He is a kind, generous and beautiful spirit.  He picked us up at the aiport and dropped us off for our return flight.  His place is clean, charming and very beautifully decorated.  The bed is extremely comfortable and the balcony that opens up to Santiago very wonderful.  He had the dining room table exquisitely decorated and checked in with us throughout our stay to ensure we were enjoying everything and to offer helpful tips on visiting Santiago.  Bernabe is a super host in life!  We highly recommend staying here when visiting Santiago.  The location is great, safe and close proximity to the city's highlights.  Thank you so very much to Bernabe and we hope to visit again soon!  John and Cynthia, Kingston, Ontario, Canada

I had a very nice time at Ines's place. She was really friendly and I felt like home. the appartement is very well located and the decoration is pretty.
I would definitely recommend this accommodation!

Daniela’s place is very good! Great appt (clean), centric location, and with very easy access to public transportation. Also, Daniela is an amazing host. She was always available and provided everything that we needed.
I would fully recommend her as host!
Thank you!

Pros: location, good for people on a budget.
Cons: bathroom vent was filthy; air conditioner only in living room, very hot inside; air conditioner was dirty. Not good for allergies. Used all old furniture, pots/pans. Dingy towels. Everything old. Very limited dishes/pots/pans. Not as shown in photos. Quite disappointing.
In Recoleta, private space with good amenities in the apartment. Just across the way from centro, bellas artes, metro access.
Location for this apartment is fantastic for all the best restaurants. Apartment is nice and met our needs.
There are a lot of great bars and restaurants nearby! Awesome rooftop view as well, and the park across the street is a very peaceful place to relax. I would recommend!
Really nice flat, a lot of space for two people. Everything you need! We felt welcomed, Check in was very flexible! Everything was clean. Highly recommended!!! We will come back:)
Gonzalo and David were great hosts. The place is super well located, walking distance from most places I went to. They also helped me out when I needed. I would totally recommend their place.

Valentina was amazing!!! We were able to access the apartment early due to an early flight. She helped us set up transportation back to the airport and was always very responsive. Checkin would have gone smoother had I known how to speak Spanish, the front desk staff weren’t super warm once they learned I only spoke English. This is not a reflection of Valentina’s hosting or apartment. The neighborhood was easy to navigate and very close to the metro. Valentina even included a metro card that we just needed to load instead of buying a new one, very thoughtful!
We were very thankful to have A/C in the bedroom as the apartment gets mostly full sun all day.
We truly loved our time in Santiago and would come back and stay here again.

This place is across the street from a restaurant so it is a safe area. There is a concierge 24/7 at the front. The elevator in the apartment made it easy to come and go from the apartment. From the location there's  grocery store 2 minutes away, along with bars. If I come back to Chile, I would stay here. The host was very responsive. I recommend this apartment.
A very nice place for a couple. Gabriel has thought of everything you would need. They view of the Andes is spectacular on a clear day.
Marcia was great and the rental is beautiful with a lovely pool and a few restaurants just outside.   Great view as well!  Close to the metro. I recommend!
Great stay, no complaints. Very nice and safe location, pool was amazing. Definitely recommend this Airbnb

This place was fantastic. barrio providencia was beautiful, great restored buildings, lots of restaurant and cafe options, grocery store near by. the patio was a great add. very centrally located, very easy to walk places. the host was very attentive, always communicating, great recommendations for restaurants
I very much enjoyed my stay.  It's clean and secure and comfortable with museums and theater close by.  I worked remotely without any issues.

We had a pleasant stay at this boutique hotel in the heart of Bella Vista. Every encounter we had with the hotel staff was pleasant and efficient. The space is comfortable, clean, well appointed, and has a lot of history. The location is ideal- walkable to many restaurants and sights (a block from Neruda's house). We would happily return again!

We couldn’t have been happier with our stay at Camilo’s place. The space is beautiful, featuring tons of local art (felt like we were in a gallery!), and the neighbourhood was very walkable and had lots to do.
This place was in a great location to explore the city. With the ac and fan on, it is pretty comfortable even in the summer

Great place for a business traveler with nice shared workspaces and a rooftop deck with a small (cold) pool! The staff is engaged and has a good service ethic and the restaurant is good with the same . Pro tip is to use the shades at night to reduce street noise if you are sensitive to that .

Excellent location, lots of shops, metro. Comfortable beds with the softest sheets. Reliable wifi. Water pressure was variable but always adequate. Safe, secure. Laundry requires an app & a card so not practical for foreign traveller. We didn't inquire how to access gym and pool require.

Veronica and his son are friendly and helpful The rooms are spacious and clean and the beds are comfortable. The local bus (# J10) that pass near the house are frequent, so getting to the metro is not a problem. The long distance bus stop is not far away and can be reached by public transportation or Uber.
Loved Castillo Rojo! The hotel and our room were beautiful. The bed was very comfortable. Felt secure and enjoyed the historic character of the place. Would absolutely recommend!

Highly recommend this Airbnb. The apartment was spacious and artsy. We especially loved the outdoor terrace. There are plenty of great restaurants and cafes within a short walk. Camilo offered recommendations and was very responsive whenever we needed something. I would stay again if I were back in Santiago.

Bernabé’s place was exactly as it was described.  His apartment was very comfortable and the bed was excellent.  The provided breakfast and snacks were an extra bonus.  I liked the neighborhood. There were numerous restaurants and attractions within walking distance.  Bernabé was an excellent host! He was always responsive, helpful and caring.  He also picked me up and dropped me off at the airport, which made everything easier! Overall, I would recommend staying here on your next trip to Santiago!
The place is great! We were able to drop out bags off before checkin to explore the city. Very responsive host and easy self check in.

Gisela and her place were great! I would definitely stay here again. She was so friendly and gave great recommendations for restaurants in the area and had great conversations. The place is just like the photos and as described with a beautiful garden and the sweetest dogs.

We were very comfortable and felt secure at The Place. The hosts were friendly and very helpful. Beautiful rooftop pool where we cooled off and relaxed after being out and about. Las Condes is a great neighbourhood.

Great one bedroom apartment with fantastic views. Apartment has all the amenities you need. in addition the complex has a great rooftop pool and gym.
Location is great, just off the main street and minutes from a metro station.
Plenty of places to eat and drink, neighbourhood is safe and we felt comfortable walking around at night.
Jose was great host, proactive and checking to make sure everything was ok. Checking into the apartment was easy, location was described accurately, and key box made for easy check in.
For next visit to Santiago I would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay here. It was very clean and the space was super comfortable. The host was very responsive and communicative and check-in and check-out were both really easy. The balcony had a really beautiful view. It is a very busy area so it was not very quiet, but there was tons to do and many restaurants and cafes nearby.
