IS 6 * POSSIBLE? a light and art-filled sanctuary in jamming santiago, every positive detail in previous reviews true. camilo is a superb host, and to me, is as gifted in designing a generous, delightful home, as his artist father, whose brilliant work fills this happy space. great cook’s kitchen (w the xlnt markets a few minute’s walk—esp the fruteria around the corner—go left left left—so easy to enjoy garden meals). terrific bed and linens. gorgeous wood floors. french doors for breezes, very secure. first quality laundry. super quiet ‘hood, w barrio italia 5min walk, lastarria and DT minutes by uber (so easy and reasonable we didn’t try metro). green bike tour great fun for getting oriented. camilo also responds asap, very clear, and kind to allow bag stash last day while we explored a bit more. mil gracias!

Great and Beautiful appartment with everything you need! Sonia was a great host would was always available.
The neighbourhood is beautiful and has everything you need in walking distance.
I would definitely stay here again when in Santiago.
Eduardo is an excellent host.  There were a few minor issues and he was very responsive.  He is a super host

The place is really great! Exactly as pictured. Next to Barrio Italia with all the restaurants or there’s many grocery stores within a short walk. Basically next to the subway and a short walk to a bike share station.
There’s also fast wifi, a large kitchen, and lots of space.
Only downside is the noise. The neighbour plays guitar for hours randomly and there’s construction across the street. Ines let me know about the latter before I checked in, which I very much appreciate. If you’re from a city it’s nothing too crazy loud, from 7am to about 5pm, 6 days a week. Once construction’s done this will be eliminated.
If I go back to Santiago I’d rebook in a heartbeat.

Really loved our time spent at Christian’s Airbnb. It felt right at home, roomy and at the same time very lived in just in the right way. It had everything we needed in the Airbnb itself, and you really cannot beat the location. The location itself is so close to the best area and sights that it just is absolutely ideal.

Charming ,cozy ,boutique hotel tucked into a walkable neighborhood close to shopping ,restaurants ,and historic sites . The staff ,especially Greg front desk was pleasant and helpful with providing information  on the area and the kitchen chef/staff was warm and inviting taking care of us for breakfast with delectable eats  and animated conversations . Thank you Castillo Rojo for a perfect stay!

Gonzalo is a helpful, kind host. He provided clear instructions, helped with airport transfer and provided a lovely space.
The balcony is terrific.
Cristobal is a great host and the place is wonderful, great sunset views and a lot of restaurants and antique shops!
We had an excellent stay at The Place. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable bed in a building filled with beautiful design and great amenities.

Nicole’s home was perfect for my husband and I visiting Santiago for a few days. We arrived late in the evening, so the caretaker, Juan Carlos, waited to help us with our check-in. The location is confusing on first arrival (go around the corner!) but our taxi driver called Juan Carlos, and he was immediately responsive, kind and helpful, despite the late hour. Nicole was responsive whenever we wrote to her, and even tried her best to find us transportation options when we were in a bind. The house is so cute and just as it’s advertised. We even had to make changes to our reservation last minute, and she was fully understanding. I would definitely recommend this flat to our friends and family.

Good stay - as it looks in photos. The kitchen worked fine; comfy bed with TV. A little living area. It is quite stuffy in the building so whilst we weren’t expecting to need AC, we did have it running for the night we stayed here. The decor is a little dated but perfectly good for a stay. We had a little confusion on arriving about finding their office in the building to leave our bags before check in - if you’re instructed to go to their office, this is NOT the concierge at the ground floor, it’s on the 9th floor and looks like it’s going to be an apartment room but just knock and they have a little office in there! They were all very friendly, helpful and nice.

This was the first stop in a 2 month journey to S.America and our first time to Santiago. Maureen’s condo is right on the Bicentennial Park, with great walking and jogging paths, vendors and forever views of the hills and mountains. Restaurants, shopping and tourist destinations are easily accessible and walkable if you enjoy that. We highly recommend staying here, and Maureen is a fantastic host. A great all around experience.

We stayed in this apartment for almost a week, in general it’s a great place to stay. It’s location is perfect to find restaurants around or move by metro.
Things to take into account:
Host was not very responsive, and took hours to answer questions about Wifi, or no answer at all regarding other requests.
AC and TV is just in the living room, and a little noisy from the bedroom wall at times, but we slept with white noise so it didn’t bother us.
Other than that, this small apartment is well equipped with everything you need. Kitchen is very complete. Also towels, blankets, and comfortable bed. Even an Ironing machine, a safe and lots of power strips, but don’t forget to take adaptors, since the electrical plugs may differ from the ones used in Central and North America.

The apartment was as described and reflected in the pictures. The area surrounding the building wasn’t the greatest. It felt some what safe during the day but the receptionist warned me not to be outside after dark. Other than that the apartment was nice and cozy. It had all the amenities that you would need during your stay.
Gabriel's place is very comfortable, with amazing views of the Andies Mountains to the east. Walkable to the town centre as well. There is also a nice gym and rooftop pool. I highly recommend!

Just completed another fabulous stay with this amazing host. This is our second time in Chile and she always goes above and beyond to make us feel right at home. She is extremely rapid to reply to us, when we’ve had questions. Would absolutely rent from Jessica again!

Great host and great location to bus terminal, especially for early or late bus to airport!
Very responsive host.
We really enjoyed our stay, apartment had everything we needed and location was ideal!! Would definitely stay there again!!

We had a comfortable stay at Valentina’s. I really appreciate the extra things the place was equipped with like a universal adapter, metro card. The apartment was neat and clean and the location is great. Lots of restaurants to try around. And the best of all was the view. Would highly recommend.
This apartment is a great deal! We enjoyed our time here as we explored Chile! Ana Maria is very responsive and always communicates. Would recommend.
Love it !!!!! I will stay again when I am back !!! Thank you !!!! Ohhh and the view was great !!! ♥️♥️

We really enjoyed our stay at Susan’s Apartment. Susan was incredibly friendly and helpful - prior and during the entire stay. The apartment is located right in the city center, which makes it quite noisy. But is a perfect spot to discover Santiago with all its sights and restaurants.
We would definitely book it again! Thank you Susan.
Jose was an excellent host and his place is very central & easy to get to on the metro. Highly recommend! And the rooftop pool is an added bonus :)

The apartment is located in a vibrant neighbourhood with plenty of restaurants and things to do. Moreover, the location was great, as you could walk to the city centre or other important tourist attractions quite fast, without a need to use public transport. Upon arrival, I was impressed by how clean and well-maintained the apartment was – it was spotless. Additionally, it had a nice views on the city.
But what really made the experience exceptional it was the host – Antonio was incredible friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout my stay. From providing recommendations for local food places to ensuring that we had everything we needed for comfortable stay.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place to stay with amazing host! I would definitely book this place again in the future.
Beautiful space with a great balcony and rooftop! Walking distance to everything and quiet despite being in the middle of the city.

Waldo and Claudia were supremely helpful host, and their apartment was private while being very walkable to great restaurants, coffee shops, and parks.
One helpful thing would be a second set of keys as it is a two bedroom and we stayed with two couples. But otherwise the AirBnB was everything we could have wanted.
Recommended spot in a very central area of Santiago. Host was extremely helpful and easy to reach. He alado provided great recommendations on what to do around.

Great place to stay in Santiago with plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance. The metro is very close by if you want to venture out farther. The apartment was as depicted and everything was very clean. The balcony had a great view of the city/mountains. The wifi was fast and I worked remote for a couple of weeks without any issues.
Beautiful place, just as it appears in the pictures. We had a lovely stay and the hosts were very responsive to our needs.
Aracelli's appartment is great, great views and I feel as home with privacy. She was nice and good host also. Next time I will be in Santiago definitely I come back
Probably the perfect location to stay while exploring Santiago. We had a few hiccups, with a cockroach situation & wifi, both promptly addressed by the host.

We had a wonderful stay here! The location is great and provides easy access to public transit. Gabriel was a wonderful host and was quick to respond to any of our inquiries. The host is doing a great job keeping the place neat and comfy.
Great location. Safe and quiet. With no AC, the apartment got very warm in the summer. There is a fan, which helped a bit.
Pleasant stay, everything was clean and matched the description. Location is lovely and the entire check-in and check-out process was super easy.

Maureen’s apartment was spectacular! Everything was as described and expected. She responded quickly to the few questions we asked via the Airbnb website. It was quiet, private, close to great upscale shops, restaurants, and there is a wonderful park across the street. We had no complaints, and would go back again and again!

Paola was available for all of our needs and her apartment was comfortable and just what we needed. Would recommend for anyone wanting to visit Santiago and stay in a good neighborhood with access to public transport and dining and entertainment within walking distance. Thank you!
Loved my stay! Very accommodating my host and extremely responsive to any problems or concerns. Cute apartment and great location. Would definitely stay here again!

Karen and Carlos' place was amazing! If you stay there, you'll find everything you'll need for a relaxing, cultural and gastronomic visit to one of the best neighborhoods in Santiago, Barrio Italia. Check-in and check-out can't be simpler and the hosts are on top of everything all of the time. Great place to stay if you rent a car or if you take public transport. I would stay here again 1000%.
Really good spot for the Metropolitan view and good for metro travelling and good dinning aswell. The host is great

Alvero’s Airbnb in the Bellavista neighborhood of Santiago is just fantastic! This was our second stay and it felt great to return. The apartment is very attractive and super clean. We enjoyed a cocktail on the rooftop patio and watched the sun go down. Alvaro is a great host who is very responsive, a pleasure to communicate with and very helpful. I certainly recommend this Airbnb!

We enjoyed our stay at Camilio's lovely apartment!  Beautifully and artfully furnished- great art on the walls.  Comfortable beds.  Well-stocked and functional kitchen: we made breakfast every day and dinner two nights.  Quiet and great for sleeping, as well as hanging out with family in the main room. Got hot one night as there is no A/C, but the fans worked very well.  We would stay again!
Great location in the heart of the city centre. The apartment is like new condition.  We all enjoy our stay and I will highly recommende it  to other peoples.

We had a lovely stay at Gisela's place! The space is cozy and having access to the outside courtyard was so nice. Very peaceful to be able to have coffee and meals there. Gisela was proactive with info about check-in, very friendly and helpful, and she was so welcoming and kind to our dog. Her dogs were also gentle and very sweet with our pup. Highly recommend this spot to others!
Our staying was great! Very comfortable place in a great location! Javier was a great host and provided all The needed information in a Very Nice way
Great studio apartment for the price. Close to cool restaurants, shops and the subway. Also, easy to find with clear instructions on how to enter the building etc.
Hugo was helpful and communicative, apartment was a great deal for the price. Would stay again

My boyfriend and I stayed for a few nights and it was perfect. The location was walkable to popular destinations but also quiet and away from the hustle and bustle. We were able to feel at home in the heart of Santiago. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there.

Maria was helpful and spoke English which was a plus during my stay.
The apartment is close to most of the tourist attractions right in the city centre and it’s just a few minutes walk.
Everything was exactly as advertised.

Very nice host, very helpful.
I would recommend this place to everyone who is looking for a place in Santiago de Chile.
See you soon,
Angela
Her Airbnb is very well maintained. It's the best Airbnb I've ever used in Chile. She is very kind and quick.

Francisco’s place is in a very nice and safe area with hip restaurants nearby.
Communication with the host was great. Unfortunately, the apartment itself was not clean, which made us a bit uncomfortable.

Clean and very accessible to many restaurants and activities!   It is a little confusing for Uber drivers to find the apartment building, we always messaged them a road intersection to meet at, which helped.  Susan is very responsive.  The apartment is on the 8th floor but there is a small elevator which was nice for our luggage! We always felt safe and comfortable in the location.  We enjoyed our stay!

The host was very helpful when I texted her with questions, etc. check-in and check-out was a breeze. The condo is very clean and conveniently close to tourist sites, gas station and grocery stores. The concierge were very helpful and friendly. If I return to Santiago I will most likely look for the same accommodations

Enjoyed a brief stay here in the middle of a vacation week in Santiago.  The apartment is in the downtown “Providencia” area, making it very easy to walk to stores or restaurants.  It is a busy area and very safe.  The host always kept in communication and offered his assistance if needed.
The place was just as pictured and in a great location with all the ammenities we wanted.

Great host, lots of thoughtful amenities. Quiet for sleeping, kitchen well equipped.
Neighborhood seems very safe - walked midday to central mercado and Plaza de Armas in 30 minutes- streets adjacent to parks etc.
Whenever I'm in town I always stay with America's deptos. What you see in the pics is what you get. Clean, easy and safe access, next door to a supermarket, close to city activities. 👌
She was considerate of everything while I was staying at the accommodation. I was the best host while living in Chile.

Beautiful, tranquil apartment, truly an oasis. Had everything we needed, and more! Really well located to walk to the buzzing area with restaurants etc and a supermarket round the corner.
The gorgeous dogs were a delightful bonus! Hope to return someday

The apartment was cozy and I felt safe and home. The hosts were extremely kind and flexible with checking in time, letting me in very early in the morning. Good location close to the metro and restaurants in barrio italia as well. Totally recommended.

Very friendly host, always supportive, more like a friend. Place exactly like described, photos accurate. Laundry facilities much welcome!
Only thing missing for me was AC, as it was very hot in Santiago that week - but listing doesn't include one. Would be worth investing in some local small unit in the future
Thanks again for everything Maritza (Isla de Pasque was awesome)

I cannot stress how great of a value Javier's place is. I love the natural sunlight, beautiful views of the mountains, and comfortable bed. Javier answered all of my questions and really made me feel taken care of. He always responded right away (within minutes). He was also willing and able to give me any information about the city I needed. The apartment felt very safe and is within walking distance to many bars and restaurants in Barrio Italia.
Check-in was quick and easy. I would highly recommend staying at Javier's place.

Our flight to Santiago was cancelled by our airline. We notified this Airbnb as soon as we learned our flight was cancelled and we wouldn’t be able to make it the next day (outside of 24 hours). They would not issue a refund or allow us any credit toward staying a different date.
We expect people to run Airbnbs to be more human than big hotel chains.

We had a great stay! Cristian was a very responsive host, he responded to all of our questions about the area & the culture. In a great location to the city centre (plaza), the metro (train station) & all the cafes / restaurants/ bars in Bella Vista & Barria Lastarria (highlight of the area - lots of markets / restaurants). The airbnb is also very close (next street over) to a really cool sky bar called Somelier (worth a stop for a cocktail). Would recommend others to stay at this airbnb!
Very clean apartment, nice finishes and modern. Building has necessary amenities and Adrian was very communicative. Would recommend

Felipe was super helpful and very accommodating and even had a welcome to Chile gift for us!  He is a great host and his place was crystal clean!  The location is a cheap Uber ride from many places and we found it walkable (1-2 miles to a number of good places).  It felt safe as well and had good lighting at night.   Certainly would strongly consider going back here in the future.  One should note it can get quite hot in the afternoons and evenings but I would suggest balcony time when you aren't out and about in the city.

Excellent stay. Very clean apartment / room in a great location. Great communication, very friendly hosts and even let us drop our bags of before check in time.  Recommend it and would stay again when in Santiago Thank you Camila and Diego.

Osvaldo was great being flexible and working with our travel times. The space is beautiful and a perfect loft experience in the city. It was fun to hear the nightlife, and it was soundproof enough that it did not keep me up at all. We loved the area and suggest taking the cable car up the nearby San Cristobal Hill. I loved the artistic touches of the place and it has a trendy yet homey atmosphere.
We had a great time in Santiago, the place and location was great.  Really comfortable beds!

Francisca was an amazing host! She was incredibly responsive before and during our stay. She also checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. However, what I'm most grateful for is the kindness she showed us when we lost our documents. She personally helped us get to where we needed to go--really above and beyond.
As for the apartment, it was super clean, exactly as described, and looked just like the photos. There were also snacks and a couple of beers for us when we got there. Would definitely stay again!

I had a wonderful  stay at the Castillo Rojo Boutique Hotel. The staff was amazing. Very communicative and reaponsive to requests. It's also walkable to everywhere you'll want or need to be. The hotel has a turn of the century Bavarian Chalet style and feel and I quite enjoyed the common areas with comfortable sofas and coffee and tea stations...but again, it's the staff that made my stay a very nice experience.
The location was wonderful, the house was very clean and well decorated. The host was quick to reply and accommodating.
We had a short but pleasant stay in Santiago at Gisela’s place. The garden is absolutely stunning and the home is an easy walkable distance to barrio Italia. Very calm and quiet spot.

Gustavo and Gabriela are excellent hosts. They were always alert and responsive with any extra requirement I did need. Friendly and talkative to suggest things to do or visit around the city centre in Santiago. They know really well their surroundings and have a lots of tips in relation almost anything.
No doubt my choice will continue to be this place on my next visit to Chile.
Well done guys!

We were not able to stay here due to travel delays but Brian was very responsive and refunded our cleaning fee for us. On a stressful trip filled with issues it was a lovely gesture and very appreciated.
We had a great time staying here.  The apartment is beautiful, spacious and very comfortable.   The balcony is large and has excellent views.  Maureen was a very understanding host.

Perfect place to stay in Santiago! It's in the Lastarria neighborhood with lots of great bars and restaurants.  Bocanariz across the street is amazing for wine and tapas.  We stayed as a group of 4 (2 couples) in the house and found it to be ideal and within walking distance to most things.  Highly recommend!
Comfortable, nice and tidy place. Hosts were very kind, clear and responsive. Would definitely recommend to stay at their place!

All was good and how descriped.
The appartement is directly at the bus stop so perfect for travels.
Would book it again.
All good again. it was my second time staying at Brian's properties and I will stay again.
Great stay with a very responsive host! Wonderful value for money and lovely place to spend a couple of nights. Thank you!

The place was very welcoming. Excellent location. The restaurant/coffee shop on the ground floor was nice to have. I used the gym nearly everyday, which was a great convenience. The hosts were accommodating and friendly. The neighborhood was quiet and the room was just as represented in the pictures. Ample closets, which was important since I stayed for 10 nights and brought more clothing than usual. I will stay here next time I come to Chile.

We were very pleased with location and the security. The beds were comfortable and everything was very clean and in good working order.
The smaller bedroom was a little warm as there was no fan or aircon. The other rooms had good ventilation and fans so that was adequate.
The courtyard was a bonus and the laundry facilities very handy.
We loved the location as there were many interesting places near by to explore. Also handy to supermarkets.
It was safe and secure which makes it highly recommended.
Camilo always answered questions promptly.
We would recommend this place to others for its comfort, security and appointments. A pleasurable stay.
Genevieve

A great stay in Barrio Italia! As a solo female traveler, I wanted a place that felt like home, was safe, and was close to walkable areas - and this flat delivered! It was tidy, well-maintained and felt more spacious than the pictures showed. My favorite part was the back terrace, which was shaded and cool (perfect place to enjoy some Chilean wine!). Easy check-in and check-out process. Definitely recommend, if you're traveling alone or with others!

Javier's place was fantastic and very well located. The place was as described and very comfortable. Javier was very responsive and friendly. He was also very helpful when I had an issue with leaving one of my belongings behind!
Do note that the place is noisy if you are sensitive to that (which I am not).
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would highly recommend it to other travellers.
Great place in a lovely location! Safe neighborhood. Tons of restaurants and coffee places around. The apartment is fully equipped and very cozy. I can highly recommend this place.
It was so amazing to stay there and Agnatio was so friendly and serviceminded. Everything was fantastic . Thanks so much.

This Airbnb boasts a perfect location and wonderful hosts who are always willing to lend a hand. Despite the occasional noise when leaving the door open, which is typical of any central location, I thoroughly enjoyed my extended stay. Would be happy to stay again when I'm next in Santiago.

We enjoyed our stay in the apartment. Very well located, close to the metro and various buses, very walkable neighborhood. The apartment was as advertised, comfortable and a good space from which to explore Santiago.

I had a great time staying. Marcela was a great host, extremely friendly, forthcoming with advice and made me feel at home. The check in was very straightforward.
Flat was clean and as advertised. The view from the balcony is lovely, particular for sunsets.
Takes a bit of time to get to grips with Las Condes as an area but there's lots to do, and its generally a relaxing place to stay, particularly with problems not plaguing the city centre!
Overall the apartment comes highly recommended.

Camilo and Fabi's place was perfect for our family. It was so inviting and easy to feel at home. It was close to good restaurants and shopping, just a walk away from Barrio Italia. We were traveling with a toddler and we had a couple of kid parks within walking distance. The apartment was also sparkling clean. Communication with Camilo was easy and I had no problems reaching out to him to ask him with questions about the apartment or local recommendations. It was the ultimate way to end our two week trip in Chile.

This is a superb location, very spacious for its category.  The host was outstanding and made me feel safe and secure as he always answered questions immediately.  I benefitted from the transportation he offered and it was very convenient and affordable.  He was extremely generous allowing me a very early check in as my flight arrived first thing in the morning.  Bernabé always made sure that i was well informed of every detail.  I would highly recommend Bernabé and his apartment.  You would not  be disappointed.

Very nice place, walkable to all amenities you need. Apartment is facing the park side which I very quiet at night.
Host is very responsive and flexible.
Definitely recommended.

Gisela was an amazing host. We had a lovely chat when we arrived and we all shared cheese and crackers and had great conversation. Her English was impressive! There was plenty of room for all of our stuff and the place was very cool. We loved the art! We wish we could have stayed longer. Gisela was so nice <3

The place was very nice and pretty, great location. Laundry and dryer inside the apartment was very convenient. The room was well-equipped.
Antonio responded quickly when we messaged about some problems, and was very helpful.
There’s a road with high traffic, so it can get a little noisy, if you’re sensitive to that.

Maureen’s place is situated in a great location. There’re great restaurants nearby, a nice park across the street and a short distance to other neighborhoods you would want to visit. Maureen is an extremely helpful host and is quick to respond to your questions.
Great views. Easy check in. Very walkable to local attractions. Pool was closed but overall a great stay.

Easy to reach by car and with a private underground parking. The apartment has a very good view from all rooms and it's well equipped. The hosts are very proactive and the self check-in and check-out procedures are very easy. We had a nice stay there, so we'll choose this property again when we'll arrive in Santiago.

Cozy and modern space perfect for what we were looking for during our stay in Santiago. Walkable location close to a lot of great restaurants. The street can get a little noisy at night so I would recommend earplugs for light sleepers.

The Place really is 'The' Place. Could not have asked for a better stay. The Loft was incredibly comfortable and quiet, the apartments very nicely furnished and we'll equipped. It was like a green  the city, very tranquil and unique. There are wonderful public work spaces and even better a phenomenal cafe attached which is open from 7am through 10pm. The food is absolutely delicious and has a great vibe. Also huge shout-out to the entire staff - front desk crew incredibly helpful and genuinely nice and the reservation person who assisted with the booking also extremely help. I'll definitely return!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Caro's home. She has created a comfortable and cosy atmosphere that allowed us to immediately feel at home. She was incredibly accommodating throughout our trip which made it extra special. I would definitely recommend her place to any travellers on a budget!

Felipe’s place is conveniently located next to a bus terminal and about an 5-10 minute walk two subway stations. The place is small but it boasts amazing views of the Santiago skyline along with the Andean mountains in the backdrop (amazing sunrises by the way!!). During our stay, there was initially an issue with the hot water, but Felipe was on hand to communicate with the reception and resolved the issue. The stay was definitely worth our money!
Value was good for what we got. Front desk very helpful and kind . Beds were decent. Adrian was kind . Area was ok - but wouldn’t recommend walking around at night alone.

Lovely apartment with a brilliant location. The flat was beautiful but was missing simple things like instructions, cleaning equipment such as hoover/ sweeping brush which if stayed longer would definitely need also little touches like tips & recommendations for the area such as good places to eat, things to do.
Would stay again.

We had a fantastic time staying with Carlo and the family. We felt right at home from the very beginning as they were super friendly and helpful. We had everything we needed and lots of space. The room and kitchen area is separate from the house so you have your own space which feels nice and private. They provided recommendations and helped with any questions we had.
I can’t recommend them enough.
Thank you so much for making our stay so great :)
Great stay in Chile. Thank you for everything. The apartment was very comfortable and met all of our expectations. Would stay again.

Brian and Pablo's place in Centro Santiago was perfect.Situated 2 blocks from Plaza de Armas which is a great location . The apartment was new and very well laid out.A great view from the 25th floor.Very important the apartment was very clean . Easy for the taxi driver to find with a keyless entry.Security in lobby 24 hrs.Brian was very responsive to any questions I had.I would stay there again for 1 night or 30 nights.Great place
Great host, clear communication & very responsive. Apartment was very clean & full of light. Loved the balcony with a great view of the city!
We very much enjoyed Gisela’s little oasis. She was genuinely friendly person and truly a super host. We would love to stay there again for sure.
We had a great staying at Pablo’s place. Well located and close to shopping malls and supermarkets. The view is impeccable! Highly recommended!

We had a great time and the apartment met our needs to the point. For us the location was excellent and the hosts have been very communicative and accommodating. Thank you. We’ll be back on our way home in a weeks time.
What a great stay. Close to the action but peaceful. A great spot for 2-3 people.

Fantastic spot in the heart of santiago. Cozy but extremely well equipped and laid-out. The rooftop has absolutely amazing sunsets and the view of Cerro Santa Lucia is fantastic. Great comfy bedroom and extremely quiet building. Walking distance to tons of great restaurants in Lastarria and less than 5m from the subway. The host was extremely friendly and responsive with all of our inquiries. Definitely a great spot for a longer term stay if so desired, but just overall great!

The location is very good if you want to explore historical center and other artistic neighbourhoods like Lastarria, you can walk or take uber very eaisily. Marisol does not speak English but she understands English well if you have any questions or need help, she would try her best to help you.  A pleasant stay in general, I highly recommend the place!

We loved staying here! The flat felt like a home it was so clean and the staff downstairs were so friendly. Francesca was brilliant with communication and was helpful with questions. She even spoiled us with a few treats because it was our honeymoon. Highly recommend this place

Very accurately described and comfortable place. Had everything you would need and was very close to many tourist attractions. Only thing worth noting is that the washer/dryer is not in the unit itself and costs some money, but still very convenient to have.

Ximenas Place is nice and you’re right next to the Bellavista Barrio where you can have food and drinks. It’s loud in the night time though!
Apartment is well equipped and you can cook there.
Nice and big balcony!

The flat is amazing: Clean, central, and with a spectacular view. The communication with the hosts was even better, they provide a lot of recommendations and are always available for help. I definetely will book this place again when I return to Santiago, thanks guys!
Very nice stay, the view of the mountains was absolutely BEAUTIFUL. Very comfortable bed and plenty of basic household supplies.
Really enjoyed Camilo's place - he let us drop off our bags early which I so appreciated. We were also able to do laundry! I would highly recommend it.

Great location and very comfortable apartment. Very nice reception and staff in the building.
Only thing is that a lot of basic kitchen utensils were missing and make almost imposible to cook. You should buy salt and oil, before entering!

Clean, comfortable apartment in the heart of Santiago.  Fast internet.  Awesome location, within walking distance to offices, major hotels, shopping, dining and metro.  Accommodation is as comfortable and convenient as in a 5 star hotel, for a fraction of the cost. Thanks for offering such a great deal!

I stayed here for a month. It was a nice place to stay - it’s pretty quiet at night despite being right in the middle of a commercial block with a subway station, and the apartment looks over a small street and out onto the Andes.
The apartment itself is good, perfect for short stays. For longer stays, it’s not really set up for living so you’ll need to buy some of the everyday household items or sort it out with the host. I asked for some things while I was there and though it was a bit difficult with communication and coordination, she provided them.
It seems like the building is a bunch of Airbnbs managed by different people and communication varies about how things work there. The concierge cleared some things up for me when I was confused about laundry, and it sounded like that happens a lot. The staff at the front desk are very kind and there at all hours.
Very nice place! Super walkable and very clear instructions for access. Nice layout and very well equipped. Definitely recommended for a visit to Santiago!
Clean and comfortable apartment, close to most places of interest in Central Santiago. I liked the  view from the apartment. Javier is responsive and easy to communicate with.

We stayed at Antionio's place for a month while I was in town for work. It was a perfect family place and well located for the metro, a park and great restaurants. A well stocked kitchen meant we felt right at home cooking, and we really appreciated the olive oil from Antonio's farm! Antonio and his parnter were gracious hosts and very responsive. It was great they were right across the hall in case we needed anything. And when I left my earring there on checkout, we were easily able to come back and pick it up. Would definitely stay here next time I'm in Santiago.
We loved our stay at Graziela's place. Even our dog was welcome. Everything was as described, the 5G Wifi is super fast and we enjoyed lenghty walks in the nearby beautiful parque Araucano.

This is a great apartment close to mercado los dominicos with a nice view of santiago. Catalina was a great host, always quick to respond! Check-in was quick and easy and the place was easy to find. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a place to stay in santiago!

A great place high up in the building with huge windows and a panoramic view over the city and the surrounding hills. Two rooms with 2 bathrooms, two TVs, great kitchen fully equipped and washing machine which also serves as a dryer. Great mini-market just down the road.  Super rooftop view from the top floor of the building. Friendly porters at the entrance. Best off all: the apartment is super well located near the Pararque Arauco shopping center with a cinema where we say JOHN WICK 4. All in WELL WORTH EVERY PENNY and I highly recommend it. My girlfriend too loved the place. 20/20!!!
The place is nice but its kind of laud neighborhood.  Very easy to navigate around. Walking distance to everywhere. Host is super nice and responsive.

Communication was good and located close to public transport. However, it requires some maintenance as the shower head kept falling off and one of the door locks is broken. We also had to kill a few cockroaches.
Loved the place. It was cozy and close to pretty much everything. I walked to most of the stuff or took the metro its pretty cheap. Overall i loved my stay over there

Jessica‘s place is gorgeous! Not only is it beautifully furnished & super clean, but also the views from the balcony are gorgeous and it’s super close to shopping and restaurants. Jessica was super sweet and responded to all my questions very fast. She also left us breakfast goodies to start our next day since we arrived super late and offered us to do late check out if needed. She was amazing!!!
We loved staying at this beautiful apartment and would highly recommend!!!

The place was very clean and the location was great.
It was freezing at night and in the mornings. The bed didn't have blankets and the portable heater didn't work.
He advertises Netflix and other streaming services but there were issues trying to watch movies. After a few minutes into the movie, I got a message of insufficient memory causing it to stop working.
A mat to get out of the shower is necessary.

Maryori’s Airbnb is very well located, there is also a great supermarket just downstairs which is ideal for longer stays. The apartment was quiet and comfortable and we would certainly stay again. Only thing I would note is that the bedroom/bathroom area smelt quite strongly of cigarettes which wasn’t nice, but we might have just been unlucky with the people who stayed there right before us.

We enjoyed our stay. Great room,
friendly staff and perfect location. We would definitely stay here again.

Absolutely fantastic ideal location close to many different neighborhoods. Building concierge friendly and helpful. Apartment perfect for a solo stay exploring the city. Claudia was helpful and I would definitely recommend her place and stay there again. Gracias!

The place was so clean and had a fully stocked kitchen! Seems brand new! Very clean! And really appreciated the addition of the space heater at it was chilly. The very immediate surroundings and neighborhood are nothing special but we walked everyday to Lastarria, loved it! The location was super convenient for us as we were there for work, so being right in the middle of the city was so convenient. Perfect space for 2 people! Thanks so much!

Bernabe is the most attentive host I’ve come across. He provides breakfast and he made us a celebratory drink upon hearing that we just got engaged. He provides other affordable services such as taxi from airport and storing luggage - much better prices than you’ll find through official services. We were super thankful for that (even drove us to the airport at 2am). The apartment itself is well equipped, quiet and the location couldn’t be more perfect, an artistic hub and you have the fine arts museum nearby. Recommend Chipa Libre which is very close to the flat for Pisco sours and ceviche (went there twice during our stay). Thanks for looking after us!
My stay was amazing! Manuel is such a great guy and super communicative and even sent a bunch of recommendations in the area. Will definitely stay again next time I’m in Santiago! :)

Nicole and Emilio's place was very clean and had everything we needed to feel comfortable. it is very close to lots of attractions, restaurants, and shopping places. Communication was great too and the hosts were flexible with the check-in time. We highly recommend the place.

Anita and her husband are the sweetest! They’re very warm and always made sure that I have everything I need. The apartment is well located, near St. Lucia park and Cerro San Cristobal. The cool neighbourhood Lastaria is just 10min away walking. The place is clean and has everything one needs for a great stay. Def. recommended.
100% recommend, in the center of Santiago so close to everything. Camila and Diego are super friendly, always making sure I was comfortable. I enjoyed my time staying with them!

Spent a day in Santiago and this was our airbnb. The place is clean. Host was responsive. There was only two towels in the room for my reservation of three guests but after messaging the host, an extra towel was delivered shortly after. Some stuff was missing like hand soap in the bathroom and the shower is very small and there was only enough hot water for 2 short showers (after my family took their quick showers, I had to shower with cold water). There’s a paid parking lot about 5 minute walking distance as there’s no parking on site. Also, this is on the 4th floor and no elevators.

This place was perfect just stunning from the view and to how clean the place was and Pablo was an amazing host right from the start everything yoy see in the photos is exactly the way you see it in person just stunning and best off all in a great location everything is walking distance or a really really quick ride amd surrounded by so much food places just amazing

I really liked my stay here. The studio is quite spacious, has a big bed for 2. Lots of grocery shops nearby, a Friday market with delicious fruit is 5 min walk away. The flat is centrally located, walking distance from several subway stations. Lots of restaurants also in walking distance. The flat has everything necessary to live there: plates, pots, etc. Eduardo is very nice and very helpful, he speaks English well.

I have absolutely nothing to complain about, loved the location and the apartment was super nice for what we paid for! Whenever we encountered issues or had questions, the hosts were very communicative with us and helped us. I would highly recommend this apartment and location to anybody staying in the Santiago Metropolitan area.

Everything ok with the place, all 5 stars.
I just hated to have to deal with another platform besides AirBnB to be able to access the apartment. Won't be using it ever again.

This unit is a great place to stay, clean all amenities that we need, beautiful view of city, i really recommend Pablo’s place,
Thank you Pablo will see you in out next visit to Chile.
Mario
and
Kriscia

Location of Valentina’s place was perfect, we were able to walk everywhere easily and felt safe. Valentina was easy to communicate with and the place was how we expected it to look. Unfortunately not as clean as we would have liked, due for a deep clean.

Great location in  safe part town. Close to public transport, supermarkets and restaurants. A modern apartment with electronic access.  24/7 security guard at entrance to the building. Clean, tidy and quiet.  Very helpful and responsive owner.

Silvia is very nice and helpful; my flight back home was delayed and she allowed me to check out an hour later than expected. Her place is very comfortable and has everything one would need, even for longer stays, and there’s a supermarket about 2 minutes walking distance.
I would definitely book this place again.

Had a wonderful time at the Airbnb. Felt extremely safe with 24hr security. Extremely walkable area too. Brian was extremely responsive and even helped us with checking in early. Overall I would not hesitate to stay again!

Very clean place and linens, great shower, felt safe and cozy, quiet, someone at the front desk at all times, beautiful view of course.
I would advise paying the parking fee and using the offered garage if you are traveling by car/motorcycle as we had our motorcycle parked on the street and someone did try to steal it and managed to break it

The apartment was super clear and felt like home! Amazing location, with everything we need close to it.
Apartment was well equipped and had everything we need! Amazing bed!!
I definitely recommend this place to others
Centrally located and well suited for one or two people visiting Santiago. I had a pleasant stay at Sara's place and would recommend it.

One of my favorite airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was perfect. Apartment, amenities, location, communication, ease of use/access, everything. I looked through probably over 100 different places before picking this one, and by the end of my stay I couldn’t believe how incredibly priced this place is. You 100% get your money’s worth. I didn’t meet Maritza in person, but she is a very responsive person through the app. She was able to answer all my questions. Also, the staff in the building are very helpful and friendly as well. A perfect Airbnb 👌

It's the perfect apartment - cleaning, decoration, facilities, with an amazing view of the hill! Marcela and Maricela are great hosts - highlight for the communication, super welcome and available. It's located in a quiet and residential neighborhood, with markets and restaurants 10min away walking. It's not super close to the most touristic places, but there are subway and bus stops very close walking that can take you anywhere.

This is the second time that I have stayed at Camilo’s home.
I decided to stayed there because it is not only a wonderful and comfortable home away from home but also because the location is perfect for me and my family to go to eat out or wonder around the neighborhood that has so much to offer just a couple of blocks away and is centrally well located in Santiago, which is a big city.
I absolutely appreciate the quick response from Camilo and so accommodating when we had to drop our luggage earlier the day we arrived.
The home is immaculately clean and with amazing art all over plus all the necessities to make this place your home during your trip.
I hope that we will have the chance to come back here again next year.
Mil gracias de nuevo Camilo!!!

Superb listing. Cynthia’s listing is extremely nice, well decorated and it has all the amenities you may need for longer stays. She is super responsive and goes the extra mile. I can tell she has put a lot of effort in creating this space and is genuinely interested in making your stay super comfortable. Totally worth the price.

The space was beautiful! Even with the language barrier, check in and check out was easy and everyone was very accommodating. It was a great and walkable spot. There is a supermarket and many restaurants within 5 to 10 minutes. Thanks for an incredible experience!

Cristian was great! He allowed us to check in way earlier than check-in time and allowed us to check out later than check out time to accommodate our flight schedule. He was responsive and super friendly!
The place was beautiful! Beds were very comfy and we had everything that we needed in the apartment. Would definitely recommend!

Gisela’s place was wonderful! It is so beautiful, charming, artistic, and cozy, and the garden is amazing. It was the perfect refuge in the city. It’s an easy walk to Barrio Italia, which is great place for shops, restaurants, and wandering. And, Gisela herself was wonderful, and so kind - we wished we could have stayed longer to chat with her and share a glass of wine! I’ve already recommended her place to a friend, and would absolutely stay again.

This place was amazing! We loved the amenities and layout of the apartment, the large couch was excellent for relaxing evenings. The view from the balcony was excellent as well, it’s a great place to watch the sun set. We very much enjoyed our stay and Adrian was an excellent host: always responsive and friendly!
Everything is very nice and comfortable in this apartment. Love the kitchen, the bed and the big TV. Definitely recommend! I had a good time staying here.
Great stay! Recommend if you are only spending a night in Santiago and need to be near the airport. Not much to do in the area, though felt very safe. Hosts were great, very friendly.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Airbnb studio apartment located in downtown Santiago de Chile, and I could not be more thrilled with my experience. From start to finish, everything about my stay was fantastic, and I would gladly give this place a five-star rating. First of all, the location of the apartment cannot be beaten. Situated right in the heart of the city, it was incredibly convenient for exploring all that Santiago has to offer. I was within walking distance of some of the top attractions, including museums, cathedrals, and parks. The host, too, was absolutely wonderful. They were incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay, always available to answer any questions. Overall, I cannot recommend this Airbnb studio apartment highly enough. Whether you're visiting Santiago for a short stay or an extended vacation, this is the perfect place to call home. Don't hesitate to book your stay here - you won't regret it!
Very nice house near restaurants and shopping.  House was great and even better than the pictures and description.  We will definitely stay here next time we are in Santiago.

Wonderful place, beautiful view and incredibly responsive host!
Gabriela was very attentive and helpful. The best host!
Location is very close to the mall, parks and 30sec from the metro station.
Apartment has everything you’ll need for short term and long term stays.
Would love to come back again

I had lots of trouble using the Automatic Front Door lock. It took ages to activate. Even though I liked the area it is very very noisy especially during the weekends. Don’t forget your ear plugs. Over all it was a nice and cosy apartment with plenty ammenities around.
Been staying here repeatedly for some years now and have always had a great time. The owners are very attentive and helpful.

We stayed one week in this apartment. It is beautiful and modern, but it looks smaller as on the pictures. It has everything you essentially need, but if you want to really start cooking you might find it uncomfortable to not have sharp knives, a second pot, dish towel, spare garbage bags (no change within one week) or salt, oil and vinegar.
Check in was very easy also in the middle of the night and receptionists very friendly and helpful. Restaurants, Shopping Center, Metro Station etc in walking distance, safe area.

Excellent! Anita and her husband are extremely friendly. They will immediately make you feel at home. Lovely place, very convenient neighborhood. I would recommend their place to anyone going to Santiago!
Had a fantastic stay. The location is great and the host is very responsive and so very kind. Would stay again here next time I am back in Santiago.

Jose's Airbnb was good! It was in a great place and was central to nightlife in Santiago. However, we ran into heating issues at this place - the heater in the living room was just not working. they had individual heaters in the bedrooms, but it made the experience a bit more difficult. Otherwise, the value was good, and if you will be in central Santiago during your stay, you should choose this Airbnb.
Amazing apartment in a great neighborhood. Has everything you need for a nice stay. We would stay here again with pleasure.

This place will forever stay in my heart!! Without a doubt next time my stay in Santiago will be again with Valentina! Both her and her father are extremely nice, helpful and sweet! Fantastic hosts, fantastic place and positioned in an awesome location. Both Valentina and Nelson, provided everything we needed and even more - they made us feel like home! Super happy we find this gem!

Great location.  Maureen was a great host, provided very clear descriptions and instructions about her place, and made us feel welcome and at home.  She was also very quick to respond to any questions.  The apartment, amenities and location were all great!

The stay was very good. Alvaro was always attentive and gave us immediate support. The only caveat is the very loud noise from the neighborhood. Several clubs that go on until 4, 5 am and even with earplugs, I had trouble sleeping.

Anita makes you feel like you are arriving to your own home where you are met with family. She is by far one of the best host I have ever had during my 7 years on this platform. She is so sweet and thoughtful and kind. I honestly want to book a trip back to Chile just to visit her. I cannot recommend staying with Anita enough!!! ❤️

Antonio’s place was perfect for us, in a great location and close to many restaurants, markets and the metro.
Check in was easy with Luis the mayordomo walking us through the apartment. We would stay there again.
Vey Close to  the center of the city But not on a neighborhood that I will stay again.
Excellent downtown location close to everything.  Cooking pans and utensils were a bit minimal for 4 people

This place was great and the view from the balcony/terrace was amazing! The host was very responsive and gave clear instructions regarding check-in and other questions we had. The location is also great as it right by a couple of restaurants and a nice park.
Enjoyed our stay, and place was centralized in the heart of the main tourism parts in Chile. Host was very helpful in check in and very modern place.

Matias's place is super clean, comfortable, and very close to the most part of attractions.
We had a really good time in the unit.

We had a wonderful stay in Maria’s place. She was so helpful and kind. She both collected us and dropped us to the airport for a reduced fee and it was great. The place itself was perfectly located, very close to all the attractions and everything was in walking distance. The area felt quiet and safe, and again brilliantly located.
We would definitely recommend this place to anyone travelling to Santiago!
Thank you Maria!!

We had a great stay!  Great location, very central and close to metro.  The accommodation was very comfortable and clean.  They were very accommodating and allowed us to store our luggage on the last day for our evening flight.  Would definitely recommend.
Great apartment, well-decorated and in a very nice building! Jose was very responsive to any question and accommodating.
Great stay in a quite neighbourhood. Would recommend again. She also had off street parking for us which was great.
Very nice host, and cozy home. The host is very accommodating and allowed us an early check-in. His pro communication is very helpful. The apartment has all you need. I would stay here again.

This is the fourth time we have booked Ximena’s and Pablo’s apartment. They are the best- the layout of the space, the quality of the furniture and linens, and of course the balcony and the view, especially at sunset. On Fridays and Sundays there is a farm stand in front which sells lovely produce, and there is a tiny and absolutely lovely cafe across the street with excellent coffee, from freshly ground beans and freshly baked pastries. We couldn’t have been happier with the apartment and location.
It’s been Just amazing at Anitas place! She was so friendly, helpful and thoughtful with everything. You will have the best time staying at hers and Abrahams place,  they made me feel right at home!
Awesome cozy place, very close to everything recommended to anyone,  Alvaro ig great, very easy to communicate. Thank you Alvaro!

I had booked Christian's place for some friends of mine while we were all staying in Santiago. It was a great place for them and they enjoyed their stay very much.
The only thing that was a slight issue was the overwhelming amount of information for entry into the building. We got there in the end though!

The place was small, very clean and provided basic necessities. Great bathroom! We appreciated we were able to check in early. Wonderful to walk out the door into the bustling nightlife, a beautiful and historic area of Santiago.

I really enjoyed my stay at Cristián's!
Thanks to this beautiful and quiet place in the heart of Lastarria, I got to experience both the vibrant lifestyle of this neighbourhood and the rest and cosiness when needed.
The place is spotless, very comfy, it has everything needed, the little outside space was appreciated, and Cristián was very helpful and flexible the whole time.
I recommend!
This apartment is absolutely gorgeous. I loved it. It felt like home, and the design was impeccable, I’d definitely stay again!

Aldolfo and Angie are excellent hosts! I am so happy I chose to stay at their Airbnb while traveling to Santiago solo. I felt safe and right at home. I will definitely be staying at their Airbnb again when I am in Santiago!

We absolutely loved Camilo's place. It is full of great art and tasteful decor. The linen and towels were also of fine quality. Located  in our favorite part of Santiago. It was peacefully quiet at night, which was a plus considering you are in a big city. It is one of   the best Airbnb we have been at. Highly recommended!
We had issues checking in but the staff in the building called the host and this was sorted quickly. The apartment was perfect for our stay and had everything we needed. Great shower.
jose Manuel was always friendly and responsive when we needed, also flexible with dates... I'd recomend for sure!!

Camilo's place is beautiful and comfortable. It's a great place to come back to after a long day exploring Santiago or nearby locations. It is a beautiful space as well that was enjoyable to stay in.
Camilo was very responsive and a great host!

The apartment was in a great location, surrounded by lots of restaurants. Susan Andrea was extremely helpful and kind when we had questions, and made check in very easy for us when we arrived earlier than the listed check in.

Antonio is amazing! He’s super nice and friendly, he is flexible with check in/check out, is a fast responder. I would
Highly recommend staying here. The location for the air b and b is perfect, right by a great places to eat and shop.

Great location, close to Santa Lucia metro station, easy check-in and very responsive Host.
The place is clean but needs some maintenance. Photos are fairly accurate for what you get

I would highly recommend booking this AirBnb. The place was spotless and in close proximity to a lot of main tourist attractions. The hosts were absolutely amazing and effectively communicated with me throughout my entire stay. The balcony view was also a 10/10! Definitely was worth the money!
Great home base for our visit to Santiago. Subway and supermarket were very close by. Apartment has spacious kitchen, a lovely terrace and a terrific view of the park and the Andes.

Super comfortable apartment, well-located, beautiful view. Host was easy to communicate with.
We felt at home.

Pablo’s apartment has one of the most amazing views I’ve ever seen. I absolutely loved staying in his place. Pablo is super friendly and he’s a YouTube superstar! :-)
I want to stay in his place again when I come back to Santiago!
Pablo is a legend.

Cristian’s place was perfect to explore the city center of Santiago. Within walking distance of Bellavista, San Cristobal, and Plaza de Armas, it offers an excellent place for two. Cristian was incredibly responsive to messages and took care to ensure the stay was an easy experience. I highly recommend his place to anyone passing through Santiago.

We absolutely loved our stay with Jose! The place was darling and beautifully decorated! It was located on Lastarria street so it was in walking distance of local artists, great restaurants, and all the sites of Santiago! Our host was very responsive and was willing to accommodate all our needs! Would highly recommend staying here when planning a trip to Santiago!

Easy check-in and check-out. Better than the pictures place, amazing view, 24/7 security in the building. I even had an issue where I had to add a night at the time of the checkout and we solved it in 5 minutes. Thank you!
Good location within walking distance to town. Valentina left a BIP card for use which is very thoughtful. Secure building close to metro

Boris is an amazing host! Great communication and fast answering. The apts location is great. It’s near by some museums and monuments. Also, very close to markets and liquor stores. Besides that, the apt has a nice balcony and the heated blankets.

Nicole was so friendly and helpful during the check in. Also they have a bus card and portable wifi for guests and left us a bottle of wine to enjoy. She clearly is very thoughtful about all the guests’ experiences and we had a great time staying there. Bocanariz wine bar around the corner was also amazing!

Absolutely stunning spot in Santiago. The space is beautiful with great art. The building was very safe with color coded keys and an incredibly organized system for unlocking the maze of doors. The apartment itself was clean and modern with modern amenities.
Great neighborhood, very comfortable and quiet street - a very quick 5 minute walk to Barrio Italia and 25 minutes to Lastarria and Bellavista. Fantastic location!
Camilo was quick to respond and super friendly. He very much went above and beyond for us, providing great restaurant and activity recommendations. He even was willing to mail some postcards for us when we couldn’t find a post office! Really an incredible host! Would highly recommend this location for your stay in Santiago!
Excellent host, very responsive and accommodating. The apartment was very clean, with a nice view and in a great location.
Instructions for check-in were clear and the apartment was very comfortable for our short stay. Valentina and her father Nelson are wonderful people/hosts!

i had a great stay here! it’s walking distance to a lot of restaurants, cafes, theaters, museums, and supermarkets and very close to the metro for everything else. inés was an amazing host! she was so kind even inviting me to join her and her family for a holiday lunch, gave me a ticket to a theater production and always asked if there was anything i needed. a great bonus was her sweet sweet sweet cat!!

A clean and modern apartment with a beautiful view of the city. The location was convenient for exploring Santiago. We walked to San Cristóbal Hill a couple of times and really enjoyed the restaurants and city attractions. Check in was easy and the security working at reception are very friendly.

Catalina and team were very available and helpful. The parking was secure and easy.
We loved the location and it was great for my family (two adults + two kids). Thank you, we will be back!

A great location and house for our group of 5 - bedrooms on separate floors with large common area and kitchen.  Walk to subway, parks and nearby shopping.  Mabel was extremely flexible and helped us meet some changing plans during our stay.  Highly recommend.

The place is exactly as you see in the pictures. Location is great, very close to metro station and Costanera center. The view is great, and the apartment has a very nice balcony for you to relax and enjoy the view.

They are excellent hosts, willing to help with anything you need. The apartment is very nice, comfortable, quiet and has everything the advertisement says. They were very friendly at check-in and provided various facilities for the stay. Excellent place, I fully recommend it!

Jessica was very helpful. She had great welcome snacks and ground coffee.
She responded to every question right away. One of the best Airbnb host we had.

The air bnb is very centrally located. You can walk to places like Santa Lucía hill and San Francisco church within a few blocks and it is about 15 min walk to the Plaza de Armas where you will find more attractions.  There are also plenty of restaurants and shops all along the same street. As a host Cynthia is very responsive and communicates well. The space is as described and good if traveling alone or with a partner. Overall satisfied with my stay!

Amazing place, and Pablo is a great host. We asked for washer detergent and he brought some within hours - and he didn’t even have to. Overall amazing throughout, a little distanced from center but you know what you’re booking so no complaints here

the location was perfect , close to restaurants,  public transport and city centre. Alexis and Zule are amazing hosts. vary kind and always available to help with good recommendations. the place was clean and well equipped, including the ac unit. It was a bit noisy sometimes during the night if u kept the bedroom door open or from the neighbours. we had the second booking 3 weeks later during our trip to SA.
I really enjoyed my stay. Room and apartments were great. Loved the layout and decor in the building. The apartment restaurant has a great menu and staff are friendly. Would stay again

Great place! Close to park, metro/subway,grocery stores and restaurants. We didnt rent a car while we were in Santiago and didn't have an issue walking around and using public transport. We felt very safe walking around the area.
The apartment is exactly as described and it offers beautiful views of the city! Highly Recommended

This is a really nice place, safe and fancy neighborhood, nearby good restaurants, groceries, metro and Sta Lúcia park. The depto is clean and cozy. The host was very prompt and friendly. I’d Definitely  be back again.

Emilio and Nicole have an amazing flat in the best area in my opinion in Santiago. The Lastarria barrio is great. The flat is exactly everything you need as a solo traveler or a couple. Great hosts, one of the best AirBnB experiences I have had in my 8 plus years booking AirBnB’s. Great shower, great bed, a complimentary bottle of wine. They helped me have a late check-out too due to a late flight, which was a huge help. I loved this flat.

Fernanda’s place is clean and was well equipped for our stay. We never ran out of hot water and the shower had great water pressure. There is a grocery story and many restaurants walking distance. Fernanda is great at answering any questions in a timely manner. We asked to check out a little later and she was very accommodating by letting us. I highly recommend Fernanda’s place.
Matias was very helpful with the check in, always answering my questions. The apartment is very cozy and the local is good, you can walk to the main places with no problem.

Great location and place. It is close to the metro and not far from really nice restaurants. The view from the balcony is amazing. The place is highly secure. I recommend it for couples or single travelers.
Mario was a fantastic host. Beautiful home and perfectly advertised. Good communication and recommended a laundromat nearby that was very helpful. Super nice, highly recommend staying here !

We had a great time at Susan’s apartment - it’s centrally located and we were able to walk everywhere, which was amazing. Susan was incredibly helpful with a lot of recommendations and answers to our many questions, she made the experience so fun for us!

I had a great time at this Airbnb! Hosts were friendly and very hospitable. The included breakfast gave me a chance to relax in the morning before heading out to explore. Grocery stores and restaurants were within walking distance. I especially liked having a space heater in my room for those chilly winter nights!

Highly recommend this place! This is the best location, very trendy neighborhood. Near to amazing cafes, restaurants and the best churros. The apartment is very secure, amazing view and very good value for money. Alvaro was a very responsive host.

You get what you pay for honestly. The appartement matched the listing, has a good location and has 24/7 security.
The building is definitely old and the appartement could use a bit of fixing, almost all the ceiling lights were missing their socket and only had a hanging lightbulb, you can hear pretty much everything from outside and the other apartments/corridors which was a problem. Woke up both nights to loud noises from neighbors/people in the corridor and on the second night some music played from someone on the same floor until 3am. So would not recommend for light sleepers or people who wake up easily.
Great, clean place in an amazing location, right in the city center. The bonus is a beautiful view from the balcony to the mountains.
Francisco is a good host, thanks! Appartment have anything you need (and more). 5-8 minutes to nearest underground station

Apartment was as advertised. It was walking distance to many restaurants and activities. Alexis was super responsive and helpful and was able to accommodate us to stay longer for check out since we had an evening flight. Highly recommend!
Had a wonderful stay at the apartment. Very calm atmosphere and everything was in perfect condition and very clean. José Antonio was very helpful and attentive. I would definitely stay there again!
Lovely apartment - it was spacious and had everything we needed. The neighborhood is great as well. The hosts are especially amazing! Thanks for having us.

Great hosts.  Comfortable bed and room.  The only issue, which has nothing to do with Eduardo, is the street noise.  There were motorcycle drivers that were making their engine go loud and setting off car alarms several times. Bring earplugs.

the apartment is located in a perfect location, you can enjoy Lastarria and surroundings by foot. The apartment is perfect for people who are going to enjoy Santiago and go back to a nice place to rest for the next day. The smaller room has a very small bathroom, so pick someone small to stay there. Alejandra is very responsive and gives clear instructions.
The place is very nice! Well located, close to everything you need and the communication was always very good!
Very nice place, located in a very nice area, a lot of things in a walking distance, lots of options to eat and very safe area. Public transportation is very closed as well.

Amazing Airbnb in Santiago! The view is even better in real life. Very comfortable, great location with good access to all of Santiago. The unit has everything you need. You can walk easily to the center, Barrio Italia, Barrio Suecia, Lastarria, and all the great restaurants.
It's also unique for Santiago Airbnbs that there is enough space for two people who are working remotely to be on calls at the same time, with one person at the desk and one person on the enclosed balcony.
Gabriel is a great host too responsive and flexible.
What a great place,  the neighborhood was very hip and vibrant.  I absolutely loved the area and this cozy place here in Santiago.  I hit the jackpot with this place , can't wait to come again.

Great and spotlessly clean apartment at an unbeatable location in a very safe neighbourhood. Pepe was always very prompt to respond to any queries and unforeseen circumstances, aided by lovely co-host Erika. Totally recommended!

The apartment building is located in a very secure area with lots to do.  The area is specially family friendly (park and kid activities nearby).   I would stay here again. Aline was super friendly and was quick to respond to my questions.  The building also had very friendly staff.
An affordable place downtown Santiago.  The main bed is great, the second is not too comfortable.  It was a great place to stay for a night.
It's close to everything you need! Cristóbal was attentive to everything I needed. Thanks again for hosting!

Valetina's place is excellent! The place was clean and very cozy. The apartment has a great view and the location is really nice. It is very close to Santa Lucia station and there are lots of restaurants and bars nearby - we also felt safe walking around during day and at night. Recommend it!

I have stayed in a lot of Airbnbs. This was my absolute favorite.  The house is full of character. Francisco left us info and recommendations on what to do. The artwork in the house is amazing.  It felt like we were visiting a relative.  I love to be able to visit a city and feel like I can live like a local.

An amazing amazing location! Loved staying in Lastarria. The space was cozy and comfortable and I appreciated their was a kitchen as I was traveling for a few days. The building felt safe and secure and is on a well-lit road.

I spent a week at Danny's apartment (hosted by Thiago), and had a good experience overall. Thiago was waiting for me when I arrived, gave me a nice orientation on the apartment, and was good about responding to my inquiries throughout my stay. The apartment was quite comfortable, with a nice big bed, and plenty of heating for the chilly nights during my July visit. No issues with the bathroom, including a good shower with reliable hot water. Wifi was also very good. The kitchen wasn't super well-equipped, but it was still good enough. The location is good - Near a mid-sized park and two metro stations, some good food options, several supermarkets, and walking distance from downtown. The neighbourhood felt safe at night, and the building itself was also secure. Overall, it was a good option for my first visit to Santiago.
great place, full equipped and really beautiful. position was good because you could walk to whatever, and in the back has a supermarket. really good!

Great place to stay at a very fair price . The bed was exceptionally comfortable . The view was beautiful . Kitchen was fully equipped . The hosts were incredibly professional and helpful . I would recommend this place for a wonderful visit to Santiago … apartment is very close to many restaurants, the theater, parks and shops .

My stay at Patricia’s welcoming home was one of pure joy.
A spacious and uncluttered room flooded with natural light, a superior quality bed dressed with soft and fresh linen, a cozy and well equipped kitchen and overall, the smile of an attentive, generous and respectful hostess, transformed a casual stopover into a faultless and memorable experience.
Thank you Patricia!
This is the best place to stay in Santiago. I have stayed at ton of places over Santiago and this is hands down the best.
The nicest place I’ve stayed at in chile. Very elegant. Best view in the city by far. Very close to everything that is needed. I will be staying again
This is a really great space in a great part of Santiago Chile. It’s location right of the Main Street makes getting around very easy.
Apartment is smaller than appears in the pictures. The neighborhood is a little sketchy but is fine during the day and early evening. The neighbors can be loud at times.

Excellent place to stay! The apartment is very nice and new, and I found it fully equipped with everything I needed during my two week stay. All necessary conveniences (and great food and drinks) can be found in the surrounding neighborhood, and proximity to public transit makes it extremely easy to get around the city. Also, Karen is a fantastic and supremely responsive host :)
Great location and well stocked condo. Philip was responsive with any questions I had and also gave many recommendations.

Álvaro's place is exactly what you expect from the photos. Beautiful and charming, in a very cool brutalist building. We found everything we needed and had a lovely time. Plus, the view is amazing! Thanks, Álvaro!
It was a pleasure staying at Maria's place. The room and spaces were perfect for my stay, and Maria is very kind and helpful. A great place from which to explore Santiago.
Good location and overall value. Basic apartment but does exactly what you need it to do. Comfortable. Good communication.

Wonderful last minute stay due to an airline cancellation. Camilla and her brother Diego were super communicative, helped me above and beyond on the way in and the way out. Lovely old building with so much character, a super comfortable bed with nice linens, but best of all was the warmth of the hosts. I recommend fully and I’ll be back! Great value for the money.
Beautiful appartment with everything you need in a central but calm area. The view is stunning (especially sunrise and sunset). Eduardo is a nice host, very responsive.

That was an amazing experience! Great apartment with all the needed. The washing machine has a dryer too which is awesome :)
Super close to the best shopping mall with everything, not too far from the subway.
We enjoyed the swimming pool and sauna in the building.
Easy check-in and check-out. Smooth communication with Jessica! 10/10
Amazing location in the heart of Lastarria. On a bustling street but the noise didn’t worry us and we all slept fine. A nice courtyard, living area and kitchen. We would stay again.

Mabel is a fantastic host! This is the second time I´ve stayed in her property and it was just as wonderful as the last time.
My family and I greatly appreciate her and her staffs flexibility! They checked in with us throughout the stay, and were very helpful with check-in and out.
Highly recommend!

Álvaro is incredibly gracious and responsive host. The loft is beautiful and has a gorgeous view of Cristobol and 360 degree view of the city from the roof. It was nicely furnished, clean and had basic amenities to cook light meals. It is a Doorman building so security was excellent!
But.
It is LOUD from 11pm-4:30am on Friday and Saturday. I pride myself on being able to sleep anywhere and through almost anything, but with the windows closed, foam earplugs, and Noise cancelling headphones there was still the noise of the many nightclubs in the district. If you are a light sleeper definitely take this into consideration.
Felipe was super responsive and very accommodating to our whacky travel schedule. Felipe's place was so nice to go to rejuvenate to after such long travels.

My sons (10 and 13 y/o) and I had a great 2 week stay in Silvina's apt. Check-in was smooth and flexible. The front desk staff were very helpful. The apt was very clean and fully equipped. The location and building were very safe. The neighborhood has lots of restaurants, bodegas, and cafes.
Thank you very much. Sorry for delay but couldn't connect! Lovely and clean, nice and cosy and quiet...except for  a yappy dog one afternoon :-)
Amazing stay at Claudia's apartment! Beautiful view, private and easy to find. It's really close to a metro line that goes everywhere. The place is exactly like the pictures.
