Thank you for a great place! The receptionists of the building are very kind and welcoming. The apartment is in a good location and perfect for a family. Highly recommended!

The Place is in an excellent location, walkable and peaceful in a beautiful area. The apartments are beautifully decorated with a lot of light. The Restaurant/coffee shop in the building is of top quality  and  wonderful services. I would  highly  recommend The Place.
I can only quote my previous evaluation: this was yet another flawless experience on Pepe‘s premises.

Very nice stay and apartment in general, but during our stay we had no (hot) water for several hours during two days due to construction working on the house. It would have been better to not rent out the apartment during that timeframe.

Great place to stay. Near to the metro. The appartment is nice decorated. It felt good to live and sleep there. In case anyone is staying like me in winter (August) and is freezing the first night: the air-conditioning can heat as well and is very silent! I definitly can recommend this place. The interaction with the owner was perfect.

This Airbnb is in a great location, many areas of the city are walkable from here and there are several great restaurants and bars within a 5 minute walk. The hosts were very responsive. However, we were never able to get the hot water going in the downstairs bathroom (the upstairs bathroom water was fine). Overall, we had a great experience and would recommend staying here.

Mabel was very responsive, flexible, and helpful! The loft was as described and very comfortable. Very close and easy access to all major 'places of interest' in Santiago. We ended up having 2 rental cars to accommodate all of our ski gear coming back from Valle Nevado, and Mabel allowed us to park both vehicles inside the gate and in front of the lot.
Highly recommend Mabel's flat and we look forward to returning.

It's a Bohemian Rhapsody, funky neighborhood, but quiet and with a great variety of restaurants of great quality. The view from the balcony will live in my memory. Plus, great value for the money and Cristobal was super helpful throughout our visit.

Very comfortable apartment, great beds. Warm and very sunny flat even in winter. We enjoyed the balcony. It is quite noisy in the lounge and small bedroom with the traffic on the busy road below. But the main bedroom is much quieter. Nice to have two bathrooms. The only thing that would have been good was to have a cafetière/coffee plunger or coffee filter to make coffee in the mornings. But you can get coffee from the small cafe downstairs.
Check-in was very easy. Communication with Felipe was excellent he was very proactive. We arrived to find a welcome note and bottle of wine. Good local recommendations for restaurants.
Thank you Felipe for a great stay. We will recommend your apartment to friends.
An amazing space, very clean and comfortable. If I visit Santiago again, I will definitely look for ZipHousing again.

We’re from the US and wanted to come skiing in Valle Nevado. This was a great studio that was right on the resort property, so you could ski from the resort easily. It’s about a 2 hour drive from Santiago, we rented a car, but there were plenty of options to get up the mountain. There were also plenty of food options with the resort connected to the condo. Cecilia was very responsive, translating instructions into English on how to get into the building and it was very easy with the 24-7 concierge and parking garage. Cecilia also allowed us to use the sauna/hot tub which was very nice.
Definitely recommend Cecelia’s place if you’re looking to ski in the Andes and have an Icon pass!
I really enjoyed this condo. it was cute, modern, and had a great location.  I'd definitely stay here again

Susan was the most endearing host. She was very good with communication, providing recommendations, help with anything if you needed it, and hospitable-- providing some fruits and water. On the day of check out, I had a flight at night and it was raining all day and she was happy to let me to do a late check out so I did not have to worry about anything. Susan is the perfect host and and just wants to make sure you are happy and comfortable. Thanks Susan! Can't wait to return again one day!

Very well located apartment just 5 minutes away from some great restaurants. Apartment has a nice equipped kitchen,great lounge area,comfortable bedroom and one spectacular view.I would definitely be back. Thank you Eduardo !

We had a great stay at Camilo's beautiful apartment. Camilo was extremely responsive and helpful with lots of good food recommendations. The area felt extremely safe and the apartment was stunning. Thank you very much!

Great spot located in the heart of Las Condes. Close to the Metro and a bunch of restaurants. Space was a little small but otherwise great. Bed was very comfortable. Hosts were kind enough to leave a bottle of water and some chocolate for my arrival. Only con would be the noise in the area. A lot of barking dogs. I’m a heavy sleeper so it doesn’t bother me but if your a light sleeper it might be an issue.

Jose’s place is a no-brainer for anyone visiting Santiago. The neighborhood is lively but not wild, busy but not crowded, and full of great shops, restaurants, and bars. The apartment is very nice with three private rooms and two full bathrooms. The kitchen is clean and the back patio is lovely. Highly recommended and I’d stay here again without hesitation.

Maria is a great hostess!  She is very responsive to questions or concerns, and in general very helpful.  The room is large and the bed very comfortable. I enjoyed the stay so much that I am already planning a return trip for next year, and hopefully will be welcome back at Maria’s place.

Everything was great. The only thing was that i was told I could not check in until 5pm which sucked since I had all my personal belongings with me in the city. I was told I would be compensated for the delay but never heard back about it. Thought we would at least be given the opportunity to check out later but that wasn’t the case. Besides that great location, great space and clean.

VIEWS for miles or kilometers, wherever you are from. This is an eclectic apartment that provides a perfect location to walk around the Italia area, private, secure parking, and a quick elevator ride to a view you would pay to see.  Loved it and would repeat!

This apartment was exactly what we wanted. It’s a great size with a comfy bed! The location in Lastarria felt very safe. Great shower size as well! Nicole was very communicative and made our stay easy!
Christian was a great host, in constant communication and very flexible. The space is clean and chic, and is in a great location in Santiago. would stay again!
Location and the apartment were nice, fast wifi and all amenities were there. However, there were multiple instances of cockroaches (many of them) in the bathroom, and kitchen.

I booked this place a week or so before arriving and only needed it for a night, and there are not a lot of options in Valle Nevado.
The good: The place was exactly as listed and it had better Wi-fi than any other place i stayed at in Chile. The view out of the window was very cool. The storage for ski equipment was also very convenient. The host is very responsive to questions throughout the whole process.
The bad: This place cost about TWO TIMES what the resort cost, except the resort also included lift tickets and meals - this Airbnb did not include any of that. While the host is responsive, they did not provide a ton of useful information. For example, i needed to drops my bags while they were preparing my room. However, the host had no idea that I could store my stuff at the ski mountain.
Great place to stay in Santiago ! Close to great restaurants and safe area :) would definitely stay again !

Gabriel is an amazing host!! He was very responsive and accommodating. Our flight was much later than our check out time and we were grateful that he let us keep our luggage at the Airbnb so we could explore the city. Very clean, great location, and looks exactly like the pictures. Thank you Gabriel for making our stay amazing!

I travel a lot and Susan was one of the best AirBnB hosts I’ve had. She is very friendly and extremely responsive and helpful. She was flexible with my late check in. The apartment was clean, organized, and in a great safe-feeling location. Highly recommend.

The apartment was comfortable, clean, beds and linens were clean and comfy, beautiful kitchen and bathroom. Walking distance to great shops, restaurants and coffee shops!
Highly recommend! We would definitely stay here again!
Thank you!

Nice and clean apartment with very friendly host. A supermarket is directly in front of the apartment and another around the corner. With just a few minutes walking distance to the metro (4 stations to the plaza de armas) and the Barrio Italia it is well situated. Perfect for a city trip.
it's really nice apartments for travel,Aline also very nice to help everything,thanks really nice trip

The apartment is exactly as described, cozy, clean and close to everything I need for my stay. Hugo always answered my questions, always friendly.
I recommend it to everyone.
Great place to stay! Host were great in accommodating our additional dates and very responsive. Would stay again.

The space was cute, VERY clean and just as described with a few extras! Also, this location is great - the BnB is off the main strip, so quiet, but close to some really cute/nice bars and restaurants.
Things to be mindful of of - the host was pretty responsive but sometimes more than one message was needed to get a response. Hot water was available, but not unlimited (I got a VERY hot ~10 min shower). Lastly, the system to check-in requires ringing a doorbell and someone giving you a key-tag on arrival. There is 24-hour check-in, but I arrived very late at night and it took a bit and multiple times ringing to get someone to answer.
Overall - I'd gladly book again.

This space was everything we needed during our stay in Santiago and the views were breathtaking. There were so many amenities within walking distance, including a nice coffee shop in the ground floor. Our host was attentive and helpful. Highly recommend.

Very good apartment, literally 2 minutes from Valle Nevado hotel and ski resort. Location was perfect, apartment is as the photos, everything worked well, good shower, good bed, clean place, beautiful view of the mountains. Worth the money. Highly recommend 👍🏼

I had an excellent stay in Santiago, in this Airbnb that exceeded my expectations. The apartment was incredibly well-equipped with all the amenities I needed, making my stay comfortable and convenient. The location was perfect, allowing me to easily explore the city's attractions and enjoy local dining options. The host was friendly, attentive, and provided helpful recommendations, making me feel welcomed and ensuring a memorable experience. Highly recommended for a fantastic stay in Santiago!

I stayed at the apartment for more than two weeks and really felt like home. The apartment is as beautiful as shown in the pictures and is located in a very safe building and neighborhood. The communication with Claudia was perfect and I would definitely stay there again in the future.

Francisca was am amazing host. So quick to respond and help make our stay lovely. She is the perfect example of a super host and then some!
The place is perfect for two people!
Nicole was a great host, easy communication and very responsive/informative. The location was perfect for me to hop on the ski bus everyday.

Maria Alejandra is a great host! She is responsive and gentle. She kindly allowed us to store our luggage in a storage room since we had to go on a tour before check-in time. Her apartment is so well located in the Providencia neighborhood! Is close to everything you need: the metro, good cafes and restaurants, etc. I definitely recommend!
Excellent! Place was stunning and Alvaro was amazing - super responsive and had great recommendations. Definitely would stay again!

Carlos’s Airbnb was in a great location for shops and an abundance of great bakeries and restaurants. Barrio Italia is a perfect place for dining and walking. By foot you can teach many touristic attractions by foot within 30-60 minute walk. Might sound a bit much, but not for city walking/exploring.
Carlos and Karen were always available if we had questions with quick response times. They let us store our luggage upon leaning so we could go to wine country before flying out in the evening.
The neighborhood is safe and depending on the day/time very full of life.
Apartment was extremely clean and the bed and lines were like a cloud!

Mabel and Jacqui were the best host and housekeeper I've ever experienced. We travelled from the United States so we were far from home but felt at home immediately. They were welcoming and kind and helped us with whatever we needed. Mabel gave us many recommendations for getting to Valle Nevado, restaurants, shopping, and more. At the end of the trip a few of us weren't feeling well and they allowed us to stay in another room until our flight later that evening. It was so comforting to be cared for like that in such a vulnerable time so far from home. The house itself was beautiful, clean and had everything we needed to feel at home for our almost two week stay. The neighborhood was safe and really lovely to walk around in. It was a quick $2-$5 uber through the tunnel to Espacio Riesco- the conference we were visiting for. Our group was incredibly happy with this accommodation. Many thanks to you all!

Great for one person or a couple, but the apartment had a weird metallic smell that we could never get rid of. Also the bathroom vent hardly worked. Pretty close to the metro, but you have to cross the Mapocho which is never nice.

This place was better than expected. There was plenty of room for all 4 of us. Also, it’s in such a greattttt location, I can’t stress that enough! We were able to walk almost everywhere and right outside is a busy street with vintage stands, restaurants etc. Although it’s great to be on a busy street to have access to a lot, there is a lot of noise at night/morning and it was difficult to fall asleep. But I would still stay here again because of location.

The location of the apartment made our trip to Santiago that much better. We were in close proximity to great restaurants/cafes, the supermarket, and parks. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the shower got lots of hot water.
Great place to stay. It can get very noisy, but host provided earplugs for sleeping. Checkin was super easy, and Alvaro answers his messages very frequently.
nice apartment top floor places to buy food nearby great view a little noisy from the bus station down below.
Fantastic place, clean and very cosy. Exactly how it was published. Fantastic location too and Alejandro was responsive to any questions I had! Would recommend highly!
This is a great place-- very cozy and quiet, but located just a block from the main metroline.  Comfy bed and nice living area/kitchen. I would stay here again, for sure.

Great location for our three-day stay in Santiago. Loved being in Lastarría, such a beautiful and walkable neighbourhood. The place was clean and matched the photos, check in was easy (and bonus points for the security). A great stay!
The apartment itself was very clean and nice. It is very noisy as you can hear the neighbors and all the noise outside. Very close to Santa Lucia Hill.
I loved this appartment. The best part was obviously the view from the balcony and the bedroom window. The instructions are clear, I have nothing negative to say. I recommend it.
Cami and Diego are so friendly, the place is really cozy and comfortable, we're so grateful to be there with them, I hope to come back someday, thank u so much.

Nestor is great value as a host. He is willing to chat, and to give advice, but does not intrude. His place is quiet and comfortable, and the bed is fine.
The apartment is on the seventh floor and is very secure. It only takes a few minutes to walk to Plaza de Armas and the centre of town. The Bellas Artes metro station is a few minutes walk away, and there are lots of restaurants and museums in the area.
Nestor’s place is a great place to stay and he is a great host.

I booked this stay for my brother and his friends. Unfortunately I was unable to join. Regardless, a very responsive host that helped them find their way to check in. Close to the slopes as advertised. Awesome time in the powder from the pictures I saw!

Was able to check in early after arriving in Santiago from Valparaiso. The room I booked wasn't available due to some issue, but I was given a room that was bigger than what I originally scheduled. It had it's own bathroom which is nice(I think all the rooms do). there were two refrigerators available since other guest stay there, but both had plenty of room. I was also able to use the washer and dryer, and this was the only place that had both available so consider this when deciding where to stay if you like to pack light and don't bring a ton of clothes.

SUCH a cute boutique hotel, i swooned at both the inside and the outside courtyard area. Very very secure building. Free wine in the evening, parking and breakfast included. Lots of other English speaking guests there. Cute neighborhood with tons of walkable places.
Our bed was very squeaky (probably just a one off). You can hear the people above you and outside the room but honestly, would book here again!

Waldo is super responsive. Late night check in was easy and smooth.
Location is great - short walking distance to plaza central with tons of cafes, restaurants, bakeries and grocery stores nearby.
Apartment was specious and clean. Kitchen was fully stocked.
Waldo was very helpful - addressing any question and quickly attending to any technical issue we had.

Great, extremely central location. Despite being so close to everything the apartment was surprisingly quiet and cosy for 4 adults and one child. The crib/cot was in new/spotless condition and the beds/bathrooms clean and comfy. Would recommend to anyone wanting a central location.

My wife and I stayed at Nancy's place for one week. Nancy's place has an excellent location: Close to the Metro, restaurants, supermarkets and shopping. It is very well equipped and has a washer/dryer, which is extremely nice.
We would stay there again and we would recommend Nancy's place to anyone visiting Santiago.
Eleanoras place was clean . As advertised. Comfortable . Safe . Well located and she was responsive and helpful. I would definitely stay there again

The place is good for the price you pay. Anyhow, we strongly recommend to check how the owners or whoever represents them deal with guess when delivering the keys: the lady was somehow rude at that time as we went with a friend to receive the property and immediately we were questioned on the number of guests without even asking. It was awkward for us and our companion.

An incredible experience staying in Francisco’s house!
An unbelievable host with fantastic artwork throughout the house.
We are extremely grateful for his hospitality throughout our stay
Lots of assistance with whatever we needed, extremely clean, lovely amenities, and the kindest people you could ever meet. Nothing short of excellent. We were extremely pleased to stay here!
The apartment is in a fantastic location and has in incredible view of the Andes. Zip were fantastic at helping us navigate check in and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.

Susan was a lovely host, met me at the apartment in the pouring rain and made sure I was settled in. Place is as depicted, it’s comfortable and has everything you need, bed was very snuggly. TV with Netflix. Area is a good location, close to metro and a nice café downstairs to have breakfast. A little noisy late at night with some individuals shouting on the street, but to be expected in a city. Overall a good experience.
Great spot in el Colorado! Staff was so helpful, from check in to check out. Juanito was always there to help. Def would stay again.
Comfy bed, good location close to the metro to get around town, however kitchen could be better stocked (minor if you aren’t planning on cooking)!

Great stay! The place was just as described. It felt secure with 24/7 concierge/locked entrance. The place is in a nightlife area and can be a bit noisy, however unless you are looking for a library silent area, it will not be an issue. If you are looking to enjoy yourself in Santiago while staying in a walkable area with tourist attractions, many food/drink and nightlife options that are more use to tourists, this is it. Many convenience stores nearby also. The space itself is also very nice with photo worthy views. Alvaro is a master communicator and even made sure to help me out with some issues I hade with my luggage with the Airport. 5/5 is specifically reserved for places such as this. Highly recommend!

Maria José is a wonderful and caring host, very helpful and responsive to all communications. Her place was beautiful and was as she described and shown in pictures. Amazing view, fast Wifi, very hot water in the shower, and a very comfortable bed. The staff at the desk were kind also.

Matías was an extremely helpful and friendly host.
The apartment was in a convenient location and was exactly as described. We found it to be clean and comfortable! Matías went above and beyond by storing our luggage for us after we checked out, which really helped us to explore more of Santiago before our flight. Matías was also incredibly responsive, using the translate feature to ensure clear communication.
Would highly recommend!

Great location. Felt safe and comfortable. Adrian was very responsive and accommodating to my needs and requests. Early check in and late check out wasn’t an issue. Would stay here again when in Santiago.

Francisco’s place is an oasis in the city. If you think the house is pretty in pictures wait until you see it in person, it’s even prettier.
The greenery in the house is absolutely gorgeous also beautifully decorated. Located close to subway station,parks and restaurants.
Communication was easy and clear, very accommodating host.
I’d absolutely stay here again and you should too.

We stayed st Claudia’s for 4 nights and wished we could have stayed longer. We needed a space to rebuild our bikes after the flight, and the garden was perfect for it. The kids had a lovely time playing with the pets and the toys. There was lots to keep them busy! Independencia is close to the centre as well as the cycle path that runs across the city by to the river. The cycling infrastructure is pretty amazing in Santiago.
But the best thing about our stay was meeting Claudia herself, she’s really friendly and helpful and looked after our needs really well! We had great conversations even though our Spanish is very basic. We’d love to stay again! Best wishes!

Felipe is a great host - responsive and helped us a lot by storing our luggage while we do a short trip to Atacama. Apartment is nice with a beautiful view of the city. The apartment building and surrounding is not the greatest - quite dirty and noisy. Otherwise all good. Thank you Felipe

After a hiccup checking in with the concierge I really enjoyed Gabriel’s place.  It’s probably the best Airbnb that I’ve stayed in!  Gabriel was very responsive and the apartment and that view were awesome!  The place was clean (thanks Vivianne) and quiet and the kitchen well stocked and good shower water pressure.  I’ll surely try to stay here my next trip to Santiago as the apartment made the trip a success!  You can see the view from every part of the apartment.  Gabriel accommodated with an option for my late departing flight.  Good restaurant next door and downtown less than 25 min walk thru a park and subway nearby.  Area felt safe too.
Valentina and her father were very accommodating and helpful. the place is great for what we paid and the location is very central in Santiago. I would recommend it again.
Alvaro's place was amazing and he is also a terrific host. The only issue was the noise at night but there are ear plugs provided to help with this.

The apartment was amazing and Juan was the perfect host. I normally don't rely much on my host when traveling but Juan gave consistently excellent advice for my stay in Chile, he is worth listening to.
Couldn’t recommend Po Wen’s apartment enough! The stay was wonderful and Po Wen was a great host giving me recommendations and helping whenever I needed!

This was our second stay at this wonderful Airbnb, and this time we brought the whole family!
Our parents rented the first floor unit and our brother rented the studio Airbnb upstairs. If you’re bringing a big group to Santiago, consider using all three of Camilo’s rentals to stay together in this lovely home. This unit worked well for our toddler, too!
this place is a 10/10 just like the pictures the host is wonderful by far one of the best experiences of Airbnn you can find! I'll be back anytime soon thanks Jess 😊

I had a fantastic experience staying at Caro's Airbnb in Santiago. She was incredibly friendly and kind, and her recommendations for things to do in the city were spot-on. The room was comfortable, clean, and well-equipped. I highly recommend staying with Caro if you're visiting Santiago.
Fantastic location, felt safe and there was lots to explore. The host was responsive and helpful. The North was great and smog-free.
Really great place and great host. I had a lot of questions and Sara was always responsive and helpful.

Great place in the heart of Barrio Lastarria! Lots of restaurants and close to transport/metro to see other areas of Santiago as well. Apartment was clean and comfortable for our stay. Would recommend!
A spacious and attractive apartment in the centre of Lastarria with interesting bustling street life, eateries etc Close to main attractions of Santiago
Great apartment in a great location, with super friendly and helpful hosts - would definitely stay here again!
Very comfy apartment in the secure and quiet neighborhood close to the metro station. Constanza is a very kind and responsive host, really felt myself like at home

Even before confirming the booking, Maria was very responsive and communicative to ensure our schedules aligned. Maria is a welcoming host into her warm home. The apartment is as described, simple, clutter free, and has a wonderful view of the mountains between the other high rise buildings from the bedroom window.
Maria's home is only about two blocks from Plaza De Armas, making it very convenient. The location is only a few blocks from the central market as well. Without traffic, the airport was only about a 22 minute Uber ride.
it was to my delight that I found multiple warm blankets on the bed, it felt like home after a very long series of flights getting here.
Maria offers a great stay, in a central part of Santiago. Since Chile is full of fantastic food and restaurants, I am glad I took advantage of this fantastic deal and warm host to have a comfortable bed and use it as a hop off spot for activities and restaurants.

Osvaldo was a great host, and the apartment met our expectations in full.  The flexibility of access, and the levels of communication were outstanding.  The apartment was exactly as described and the views of the mountains from the window were breath-taking.  We loved it!

Ivan’s place is exactly as he describes it and the pictures published.
Magnificent view, everything works perfect and it is a great place to stay in Santiago.
Bus / Subway station near by, fast and proper food restaurants, etc…
Not only that, communication with him was great, fast and clear.
He’s flexible and open to go beyond the host’s needs with the apartment, and he helped me out storing my bags for a couple of days while he helped me rent another place to stay in the meanwhile… Life saving, really.
For that, Thank you Ivan!

Loved staying here for a month. Great location in Barrio Italia, close to metro, buses, grocery, bars and restaurants, but not on a busy street. This apartment was so cute and had everything you need for a longer term stay. I would absolutely stay here again if I returned to Santiago

Second time I have stayed with Maryori and Jose - different unit in the same building. Unit was as described and I was able to check in a little earlier than the posted time which was helpful. Unit is great value and no problem recommending!

The apartment has a beautiful view of the Andes in the background, the city skyline and cerro cristobal hill.
The place is centrally located and great for getting to know Santiago.
Javier is an excellent host, a proactive communicator, and I would highly recommend staying here.
Had a great time at this Airbnb. Charming place, and a warm welcome from the host and the housemates. The surrounding area is quite peaceful. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay!
Just like the pictures and Lucia is a great host! Responsive, clear and friendly.
Right in the heart of the Providencia neighborhood.
Thank you very much!

Convenient place in Valle Nevado. Very small studio apartment, but it was perfect for two for the weekend. Very close to the resort - a 2 minute walk to the rentals, restaurants, and chairlifts. Easy check in, paid an additional fee for a late check out. Good communication. We had a wonderful weekend. Comes with lockers to store skis and gear!
Really nice place to stay! Can walk to most areas downtown. Also has a great sunset view!

Great location, really comfortable and clean apartment. Alvaro responds really quickly and is helpful. Very central to lots of bars and clubs and places to eat. Easy to get to other parts of the city. Some nearby clubs stay open to the small hours so you can hear them if you sleep lightly, but Alvaro provides earplugs which is very thoughtful.
Overall greal location, clean and comfortable. Would recommend.

Thank you very much Ivan!
Excellent host, flexible, very responsive and the place is exactly as the pictures.
Thank you!
Well located, close to subway Station to move anywhere in he city. quiet apartment. Good amenities, such as hairdryer in the bathroom. we'll proportioned for 2 people with enough closet space.

We had an amazing time in Camilo's beautiful space! We were blown away with the decor and design of the apartment on this very quiet and cozy street. It is gorgeous, with fantastic art, an awesome kitchen, and relaxing outdoor space. Camilo was incredibly kind and responsive to our needs, and he made our stay easy and fun. He recommended many places to eat and explore in the area. The neighborhood is lovely and safe - we were 5 minutes from the grocery store and within walking distance of the park, the zoo, Pablo Neruda's home, and many other exciting neighborhoods.
We would love to return in the future! Thank you, Camilo!

Great location, clean and spacious apartment. We were able to leave our luggage early and we were given information in advance to access the apartment with ease. Great space for 4 people to share, thank you!

Great place to stay as a couple or with a friend, really close to the metro station and some mini markets
No issues at all

Really central with incredible accessibility to st Lucia and local restaurants and most other central city landmarks. Security conscious accomodation with every thing we needed…especially washer and dryer. Would highly recommend this place and Christian was very responsive to any questions

Loved this place! Walking distance to everything, not too far from the airport. I definitely enjoyed a few days here exploring the city. It was also a huge plus to do laundry and have a place to relax outside and drink some wine. Would stay again.
Good apartment with fun decorations. Centrally located and easy to find. We had a great stay!

I wanted to express my sincere appreciation for the fantastic stay at your Airbnb. Your place is simply wonderful!
I loved the cozy atmosphere and attention to detail in the decor. The location is perfect, with easy access to nearby amenities and close commutes.
Thank you for being a fantastic host. I had a memorable stay and would highly recommend your Airbnb to others

This is a great place!  Walkable to Cerro Santa Lucía and Plaza de Armas with plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. The hosts offered tips and suggestions upon arrival, including holding our bags if needed. Highly recommend!
We are so lucky to have booked Juan’s Penthouse Condo.  The views were magnificent, the space open and comfortable, the location perfect, and Juan was a great host.
The place is beautiful, clean, and close to great restaurants and cafes. Paz met us at the elevator and check-in went very smoothly. We enjoyed our stay at this place very much!
Great stay for a couple of days. Although the area is surrounded by music bars, inside the hotel is peaceful and quiet. Very friendly staff in the reception and in the restaurant.

This place was beautiful! My fiancée and I truly enjoyed our stay. The view of the mountains was breathtaking. The place was close to the mall and restaurants. We definitely look forward to booking with Jessica again in the future.

The apartment was clean and sufficient for a short stay in Santiago. Jose was easy to communicate with and gave us detailed instructions on how to arrive and access the room. This accommodation is close to metro stops, Santa Lucia park, plaza de armas, a grocery store and lots of restaurant options.

Comfortable apartment in a perfect location -- countless great restaurants within a stone's throw and walkable to many of the major sights of downtown Santiago.  Cristián was a great host, very communicative and helpful, and check-in and check-out were easy and convenient.  Highly recommend!

Fantastic location. Safe. View is beautiful. Perfect for a couple as the home has everything you need.
The host even gave a wine bottle and tried to take care of us well.

A very easy-to-find and pleasant place to land when we first arrived in Santiago.  The room and bathroom were comfortable and clean, there was nothing too fancy but we had everything we needed.  Perfectly centrally located near Cerro Santa Lucia and Bella Artes.
Jessica was a great host. Very responsive and made us feel at home. she left us a wonderful welcome package! Absolutely perfect stay!

Silvia’s apartment is easy to access from the metro and you can easily travel throughout the surrounding area. It was clean, cozy, and had a nice little patio to watch the city. Silvia was very responsive and helpful.

Great location, apartment was clean and exactly as advertised. Alexis and his team are very helpful with recommendations and responded to all our questions very quickly. We would definitely stay here again.

apartment was as described and shown in the photos. took a few minutes to gain entry into the carpark as there was some confusion with the front desk. once in the parking garage, however, very easy to navigate and get into the apartment. great view of the mountains, comfortable bed. many nearby restaurants and quiet at night
Very nice modern apartment with a fantastic view. It's located in a good neighborhood, in a short walking distance from a park that we liked very much. And Pablo is a great host!

We loved our stay in Gabriel's place! The views are spectacular, the space was lovely and just as described, and we were super close to restaurants, etc. in a very walkable area. Gabriel is so kind and went out of his way to make our stay a great one! We appreciated his proactive communications and responsiveness. Would happily stay here again on a future Santiago visit!

Bernabé is a super host and eager to please. Bernabé is keen to ensure your stay is everything you want. His place is perfect for two and fantastic location for sights and restaurants. Great value for money and everything you need is at your fingertips. Thanks Georgie and Jesse
Nothing to complain, great location, the host is very kind and helpful, the place was  clean and organized
The place is beautiful but the best part is how nice and accommodating Jessica is. She was very attentive to our needs during our trip. Totally recommend the place.

Claudia was an exceptional host! Whatever issue I encountered (not so many), she responded quickly and with warmth. The reception did not speak English but Claudia helped me translate when it was necessary.
The location is very good with regards to communications. Both subway and buses are very close. Also close to supermarkets.
The place is nice and modern. It has most of what you need for a longer stay. You don't get much noise from the neighbours. However, light sleepers will want to bring earplugs as noise levels from outside the apartments were occasionally a problem. Nothing out of the ordinary, though.

Jessica is an incredible host, very communicative and kind. We felt very welcome.
The apartment was modern, well-decorated, comfortable and most importantly very clean.
I went with my grandmother and parents, and every night we enjoyed the beautiful views of the mountains.
Just a walk away was the beautiful parque Arauco and luxury mall. Lots to do, and many great options for fine dining.
I would recommend this stay to any of my close friends with high expectations because this was above and beyond!

Cristian’s place was an excellent location. Restaurants right on the street yet the place was set back so away from street noise. Cristian was very responsive and helpful. Great comfortable place in the heart of town.
Super tranquil and silent place in the very heart of Santiago de Chile. Automatic check-in and check-out. Couldn't be more perfect for single travelers and short-term visits. A must!

Daniela’s place was perfect for our visit. It’s close to all the things we came to Santiago for, as well as being in a secure building for added safety/security. Daniela was very great with communication and providing recommendations for things we were looking for (groceries, restaurants, gym.) We would definitely stay here again.
Excellent location and view. Easy walk to many bars and restaurants in Barrio Italia, and an easy walk to the metro station to get anywhere. Clean space, great balcony.

Mabel’s home was as described. It was beautiful, clean and homey. She was really helpful with our check in and check out. I truly enjoyed my stay in her home. I recommend Mabel’s home as the place to stay when you visit Chile

Camilo’s place was perfect for our 3-night stay in Santiago! I wish we had more time just so we could relax on the patio or explore more of the neighborhood. The apartment was spacious, filled with beautiful art and had so much sunlight! The street is quiet and we were able to walk to many different parts of Santiago from the apartment (we are used to walking 15-30 minutes to get to places at home but there is still a lot around even less than that!). Camilo was super helpful, communicative, and accommodating!

It was very very clean.
The location didn’t feel safe at night. Everything closes early (besides the strip clubs)
While the Airbnb itself is non smoking, that wasn’t the case for the adjacent units - very heavy smoke smell throughout.

Antonio was an amazing host. He was very responsive and even was able to get us an early check in. The place was clean and has a great view, but the location seems to be a bit on the rough side at least at night
Javiera was proactive in answering all of our questions and helping us have a good stay in a great area of Santiago.

The problem was that the water had been cut off for the duration of our stay because the owner DID NOT PAY HIS WATER BILL. Three people (one small child), 14 hours, no showers, no toilet flush. A stressful and uncomfortable stay. The owner lied about the return of the water supply and refused to make a reimbursement.
Had a Great time! Everythings clean and Gastón was always responsive, felt at home from day 1

Looks just like the pictures. Easily walkable to nearby restaurants and bars in providencia, as well as the subway. There was ozempic left in the fridge— assumed from a precious guest? Otherwise everything else was tidy and as stated in the ad. The housekeeper Sara was very responsive and helpful when we needed more towels.
The place is very centrally located, very clean and spacious.  Cristian was very responsive and helpful. We enjoyed our stay. Highly recommend! You can walk to many coffee shops, restaurants, etc.

The girls were very responsive and helpful, they gave me tips and recomendaciones about restaurants and some other stuff. The apartment was clean and cosy, had reception 24 hs, and easy access door lock with code, instead of keys.
On the not so bight side, the hot water didn’t work properly for the first 24 hours, wich wasn’t ideal.
Thanks for everything.

This was a great place to stay. The garden is beautiful, and Gisela is very friendly and responsive. The neighborhood is safe and located close to public transit, or walking distance to Barrio Italia. I can't recommend this place enough.

Perfect place for our stay. Really clean and had everything we needed, as well as a very comfy bed. The location was great for being able to walk everywhere, would definitely stay again - the ideal Airbnb!

This beautiful apartment is located right in the center of Santiago, which makes it an easy starting point to quickly reach any destination within the city. Two metro stations are only minutes away. Supermarkets, pharmacies, cafés and restaurants are also in walking distance.
The apartment is well equipped, clean and comfortable.
Pamela is a very friendly host who was always available in case of any questions.
We enjoyed our stay there and would warmly recommend this apartment to others who want to discover Santiago.
If you want to meet the next standards of good arbnb need to improve these facilities. Our standards were so high that these places look like garbage.
Osvaldo’s place is as lovely in person as it is in pictures. It was also very clean, including the bed linens. He also provided helpful information the first night we arrived.
Wonderful place and location. Pablo was very quick to communicate and was super helpful in accommodating us. Fantastic host!!

We had a wonderful stay at Matias his apartment. The place was spacious, well described, and nearby the Santa Lucia metro station. The check-in was very easy. Some herbs or olive oil to cook with would have been nice, but there are supermarkets nearby.

This historic home made our visit to Santiago!  It was truly an experience to enjoy Francisco's modern artwork in this well maintained and beautifully decorated home.  We enjoyed the luxurious bedlinens and many amenities including a  stocked refrigerator. The host welcomed us upon our early arrival and gave good recommendations for local attractions and restaurants.  Everything was easy and very enjoyable.
Gustavo and Gabriela were very thoughtful and attentive, communication was also excellent and the unit was clean, well equipped and very well located.

The apartment was as described with small kitchen with everything one can need. It is situated about 20 minutes walk from the Plaza de armas.
The sound Insulation of the apartment is pour. It is in a noisy part of Bellavista with clubs having loud music until early morning. It is not safe to wander around after dark. A few homeless people are in that streets. The view from the apartment is on inhabited sheds.

Camilo’s place is absolutely stunning! It’s decorated beautifully and is so clean. The location is perfect and on a quiet street. Camilo is so friendly and helpful - the absolute perfect host. I could not thank him enough for accommodating us. I highly recommend staying at Camilo’s place!! I would love to stay here again when I come back to Santiago in the future.
This is one of my favorite places to stay when in Santiago. Very nice location, elegant enviroment and overall good service at the place

The stay was great and this home allowed us to be right in middle of the action. Innumerable restaurants and bars within walking distance and the check-in/-out process was simple. For those looking to be a part of the hustle and bustle of the city, this home is great!

Cristians place was a perfect location for a quick weekend stay in Santiago.  It was very comfortable, close to many restaurants and bars, and the host was extremely accommodating around our travel schedules.  We would definitely recommend and stay again!

I spent there only a few hours, just to sleep during a stopover in Santiago. A decent, comfortable and cheap place in Central Santiago, as advertised. The instructions for the check-in and check-out were very clear. All good overall!
Nice little apartment. Perfect if you‘re an active person and only there to sleep as it is quite small. Perfectly located! Fran was super helpful and easy to contact.

We loved staying at Camilo’s place. The apartment is a really good size with fabulous interesting decor, especially the paintings. We really like the little courtyard too; a nice space to have breakfast or a drink after the day’s travels.  The local recommendations were super helpful- and we found the supermarket and restaurants in Bario Italia easily. Santiago is a little grimy everywhere, but this area felt safe once we got used to the local conditions. The street is surprisingly quiet given it’s close proximity to some bus routes. Overall, a great stay. Muchos gracias.

Wonderful hostel like stay at caro’s place! Very well located in the lovely Bellavista neighborhood. Wonderful host with lost of great recommendations. The room was very spacious and clean and private bathroom was also nice.

Excellent place to stay. The apartment is in an extraordinary location, near the Metro and the Mall. It is also fully equipped. The host was very friendly, responsive, and cooperative. I would definitely come back to this place.

This apartment is in the nice neighborhood of Providencia, with the metro and buses very close. The apartment has everything you could possibly need, plus a terrific view of Cerro San Cristobal and the Andes. When host Felipe learned we had no matches, he showed up with a box! Very pleasant stay.
The place is well located and was nice and clean. Boris was really helpful with clear instructions and some local restaurant recommendations.
Amazing and very well located apartment,  I love it! Thank you so much Ximena for all your help!
Gabriela was an awesome host. Very communicative and excellent host. Hope to stay again. Thank you!

Valentina’s place was a nice 1 bedroom apartment in a secure building. The location was great- easy access to the metro and walkable to restaurants and other points of interest.
Valentina was very communicative and answered questions.
We loved the washer/dryer after coming back fro hiking in Patagonia.

Osvaldo’s place is very nice. Modern, clean lines, minimalist decor. Looked exactly like the pictures. Location is very close to many bars and restaurants, though as with any big city, be careful at night and it’s better not to be alone. There is 24h security, so the building itself is safe.
Osvaldo is very communicative and responsive. He was flexible when we had a mishap with our flights. He also stored our luggage for half a day as our departing flight was late at night, which was very nice and convenient.
Super nice stay! Great location and amazing view all day long from all the apartment and the balcony. Cristobal was also very responsive and suggested us some restaurants/bars and clubs. I recommend!

Long stay (almost two months), neighborhood is great with the park at 30meters with lot of restaurant and great connections. We are in four (two adults and two children) and while the apartment is not large, it had everything we needed (two rooms, one with separete beds for the children), two bathrooms and a fully furnished kitchen with a proper refrigerator.
Very cozy apartment,  close to restaurants, a pleasant area to explore. A great communication with the host. The stay was very good.
Apartment was well equipped. Convenience stores and supermarket close by. There is some construction going on during the day, so expect noise and less privacy from your balcony. Overall, great stay!
Jose was a wonderful host! He had great recommendations for restaurants and places to visit. We especially loved Ambrosia! Thank you, Jose.

Great location. Was central to everything we wanted to get to! Location felt extremely safe. Gabriel was quickly responsive and attentive, and willing to help with a few of our requests. Overall great experience

Great location, very well equipped apartment.  Very comfortable, we were very happy with our decision to stay here. lovely balcony, clothes washing facilities, well equipped kitchen. Great restaurants nearby, and close to a metro station on the main L1 line. The only downside was the noise from the nearby nightclubs.

Great location. Highly recommended if you want to be in the center of restaurants and within walking distance of quite a few attractions. Bring your earplugs if you’re a light sleeper as it can get pretty loud from activities that happen right outside of your window. Overall recommended!
A roomy two bedroomed apartment, located in an attractive upmarket area of Santiago with magnificent views of the hills and mountains to the north.

Paz is an incredible host, if you have the pleasure of staying here, you will be in good hands. Also, the accommodation is really enjoyable. It's a nice place to spend time and wind down, and the metro station just around the corner will allow you to go out and explore.

Absolutely everything we expected, Javier the host is a class act, very responsive. My guests are very well travelled and expect perfection, that is what they got , we would all come back and will rent from him the exact unit

Definitely The Place to be in Las Condes! We felt right at home from the moment we walked in the door. The staff was helpful and friendly with recommendations and we enjoyed eating at the Living Cafe. I nearly forgot that I was in a hotel when I climbed into the cozy bed.

Bernabe’s apartment is pristine and it is like staying in an art gallery or natural history museum because of all the beautiful artwork and amazing collection of furniture and objects.  Bernabe was so friendly and welcoming - and he provided so many extras that we were just charmed from the beginning.  The place is perfect for visiting Santiago and the bed is soooo comfortable.  Great location and just all in all a perfect place for a stay in Chile.

Pros: kind and fast responding host. Nice interior. Close to the city center, relatively safe neighborhood (at daytime). Supermarket within walking distance. SmartTV works great. Water pressure is amazing (maybe too much so because it's hard to keep the bathroom dry). Airconditioner is great to cool or heat up the living room.
Cons: bathroom needs a deep clean (mould between tiles). Sewage smell sometimes hangs occurs after using sink or shower. The place is a bit more worn than the pictures imply, stains here and there, a lot of little things but not major. The important things (bed!) are clean and comfortable.
Main downside is the inescapable Santiago traffic noise, which is unfortunately made worse by the windows that do not seal well.
Overall a good stay.

This was a great choice of accommodation for my stay in Santiago. Alexis and Zule have a great place that's really close to the downtown attractions of the city. They were really helpful with my early arrival and communicated well.
The apartment was spotlessly clean, very comfortable and represented excellent value for money.
I would stay here again without hesitation if I were to return to Santiago.
Aline's place is very near to places to eat and to where we had to gather for our trip to Antarctica. so the property is super suitable for us

Fantastic apartment in a nice place of Santiago!
Gustavo is a gentleman, thank you for all!

We enjoyed our stay at Mariana and Dominic’s place! The location of the apartment is fantastic with great restaurants and cafés rights next door. Mariana and Dominic replied quickly and even arranged an early check-in. Thank you!

Second time staying here. Cannot recommend enough. Host and colleagues were so welcoming and kind. Let me check in early after some hard days if traveling and brought up some fresh fruit when we checked in! Perfect touch.
Had a nice stay and it is close to some nice areas. Super comfy bed and big TV which is nice for longer stays. All good.
We loved this stay so much we are staying again on our way out after doing the o circuit in Torres del Paine. Great location and responsive host. Great value and comfy bed.

It was exactly like the description. It was in a secure apartment complex with 24/7 security at the main gate, who were very friendly and gave good recommendations of what to do and where to eat. I highly recommend.

This apartment is a little gem.  It's in a building inside a courtyard with restaurants and a bookstore. There's a doorman, which is a nice addition.  The apartment itself had everything we needed for a 4 night or longer stay.  It is simple and functional.  The Lasteria neighborhood is amazing, fun, and lively; it's walkable and bohemian and stuffed with great restaurants, and sits close to the Catholic University Metro stop.  The Metro is easy and clean, so the apartment makes a great base for exploring all of Santiago.  Location was the best part. Because the apartment is tucked away, there is little traffic noise, but some people noise from the restaurants. We enjoyed looking out the window to terraces where people dined and to the romantic light-strung trees.  I would stay there again!

I have stayed at this place three times, and I love it. It is a small apartment located on the 29th floor, with floor-to-ceiling windows. It feels so open, and the view is stunning. The place is loaded with everything you can think of you may need. Jessica ensures you feel welcome, and there is always a nice snack tray. Checking in and out is a breeze, and the personnel at the garage entrance is always so attentive—big thumbs up to my favorite Airbnb rental in Santiago.
This is our second time staying here. Just as good as the first time. I’m sure we’ll be back.

We really enjoyed our stay at Osvaldo’s place! He was very  responsive and helpful when we messaged him with any questions. The location is great with many restaurants and bars close by. So much to do and see within walking distance. The music from the clubs nearby didn’t bother us at all, we slept great!

Maria and Diego are awesome hosts. Very responsive and helpful. The place is located in the heart of Santiago. The apartment was clean and well stocked. Specifically the kitchen has everything you need to cook a proper meal at home. The internet is fast around 300Mbps and the desk makes working comfortable. The views from the Apartment are amazing. Beautiful sunrise and sunsets looking at the Andes mountains. Overall, I would  be happy to stay again.
Amazing location! Would stay here again and will recommend to others in a heartbeat! Loved it! Great hosts

Cristian's place was my first stop on my multi-city/town adventure in Chilé. Lastarria is a great neighborhood with lively nightlife - great street shopping, restaurants, and street music all within walking distance. The apartment was exactly what I needed for my time in Santiago, in a great and safe location. Cristian was very responsive and helpful as well. I arrived in the very early morning and he let me check in early. I definitely recommend staying here - it is a bonus that the building is gated, so only residents can gain access.
We had a great stay at Waldo's place. His friend Claudia greeted us on arrival and was very attentive to everything we needed. Would definitely stay there again.

Comfortable oasis in Nunoa.  Nice bed.  Pequeno = small = tiny house within a beautiful, relaxing courtyard.  Courtyard is gated and locked so you feel secure.  Trees and beautiful flowers draw you out of the house to enjoy coffee or snacks on chairs and tables out in the courtyard.  Close to the National Stadium.  Lots of nice little shops where you can buy food and pastries.  Very nice neighborhood.  Close to the Metro and a large commercial street where you can find anything you might need to buy.  Good restaurants nearby.  Very nice art on the walls inside.
Amazing views of the city and the Andes. Place felt very safe and location was great. I would stay here again :)

The apartment was spacious with lots of light and a view of the mountains. The living room was set up nicely and the wifi was great for work purposes.  We were able to cook breakfasts and the grocery store was within 10 minutes walking distance.  The laundry facilities in the apartment were also vey handy during our two week stay.  Overall, the neighborhood was very pleasant and safe, and walking to the metro was very easy. The concierge was very friendly and helpful.

great stay here, the place is close to all the action with great restaurants and bars around. spectacular views from both living and bedrooms. night time can be noisy with music coming from the bars but didn't bother me. Alvaro was also a great host and helped me along the way :)
This place is fantastic! It’s more like a private suite. The shower is amazing, kitchen is great, beds are comfy and hosts are super nice and helpful.

It’s so good that I came back to say goodbye! Hehe
Lovely airbnb, great location, hostess are awesome! I recommend a lot

I can only give 5 stars. Maritza is very attentive, provided lots of useful recommendations and great useful advices. The place is cosy, clean and safe. I immediately felt comfortable there and enjoyed my stay!

Thank you Matias for the warm hospitality! The apartment is as-described and was sparkly clean when we arrived. Matias is also very responsive whenever we needed assistance. His apartment is a 5 min stroll from Santa Lucia station and within walkable distance from Plaza de Amars. Definitely worth checking out his apartment if you are visiting Santiago!
Nice accommodations, very close to restaurants, shops and fun walkable streets. Very quiet at night, hot shower great WIFI everything you need!

Thank you for a lovely stay. The apartment was very clean, centrally located and as listed. Perfect for a few day stopover we had in Santiago. Added bonus were the restaurants right downstairs; really convenient!

Juan’s place is a great stay. I felt right at home in the apartment. He was very accommodating and helpful. I will stay at this location in my next trip to Chile if it’s available. Highly recommended. As a plus the views from the apartment are beautiful!
10/10 would recommend this place. Spotless and new. Has absolutely everything you need and extra. They thought of every detail. I would gladly stay here again.

A GREAT host!! Po Wen checked in with us to make sure we were ok and if we needed anything. He was super responsive and helpful. The apartment is clean and had everything we needed. Great part of town. Highly recommend
Patricio was a very responsive and kind host! The location was great and the building felt very safe, which was a huge plus. Perfect size for 1-2 people.

Stayed here for almost 1 month. Was a good spot, had a rental car and parking was great right next to the elevator. Was a little under equipped as I was cooking everyday, but they got me a new frying pan as I asked and they were very quickly to respond to any issues. Overall it does the job, I enjoyed it, beautiful views of the mountains and very central location. Thank you

Felipe's apartment was perfect for me to work and live in Santiago. The location was great. The apartment was comfortable and clean. The internet was very fast. No complaints. Felipe even gifted me an experience to see the Pan-American Games in Santiago. It was very nice!

This cozy apartment was perfect for my time in Santiago. The area has lots of great food options, is vibrant during the day and quiets down in the evening, and the bed was pretty comfortable. I would definitely stay here again!
I had a very comfortable stay here. Friendly and accommodating hosts, great location, and the balcony was quite the spot to relax in after a day of exploring the city. :)
We had a fantastic time in this apartment, it was very tidy and clean; the apartment is  very close to many restaurants and only a short walk to downtown Santiago.

I can’t even begin to describe how sweet and caring Camila and Diego are. They took very good care of me and made me feel welcome. You can come to them with any question you have and they will help you in the best way possible. The appartement is very cosy and has all the amenities you need. I would revisit Santiago just to stay here again!

I loved the place, I felt at home and I would definitely stay here again
Brian is very attentive and understanding

Fantastic apartment in an amazing location. Everything was perfect from the bed to the shower, with a cute balcony. Washing machine worked well too. The wifi was so good and the hosts were responsive and kind. We stayed here after 2 weeks in the desert and it brought us back to life! Everything you could want in an apartment!

Waldo and Claudia were great hosts and the apartment is in a great safe location
There is no lift so you need to walk up 3 flights of stairs and the kitchen cupboards need some attention
I would recommend to stay here
Had a very enjoyable stay. Host was very communicative and responsive. Location was amazing, area felt very safe. Would stay again!
Very good apartment if you have work to do in the very downtown of Santiago. Very silent as well. :) A reliable stay every time I'm in the city.
Beautiful, comfortable apartment with a fantastic view. I thought it was nicer than the photos! it was spotless and Gabriel was very responsive and helpful. I would highly recommend this apartment!

The apartment is just as cute and charming, if not more, than the photos and description suggests. Lovely space to come back to after a long day of exploring Santiago. The location felt very safe, trendy, and there’s a conveniently located bar and Coffeeshop/sandwich shop downstairs. Nicole and Juan were great hosts and were quick to respond to any queries I had. The location is great, literally walking distance to Parque Forestal, the Fine Arts Museum, and Barrio Bellavista if one is into streetart, murals, adorable cafes and restaurants, bars etc. I had a very pleasant stay so thank you so much once again!

Camila and Diego are amazing hosts. They are extremely friendly and kind. The communication with them is the best. The room was perfectly clean, very cozy and private, just like the pictures. The apartment is located right in front of a metro station, very easy to get around. We had a delay with the checkout and Camila was very understanding.
Definitely recommend it. ✨

We really enjoyed Camilo’s place. The apartment was thoughtfully furnished and beautifully decorated which made us feel right at home. Camilo was always very helpful and responsible. We were sad to leave!
Highly recommend Matias’ apartment, it is cozy and close to Santa Lucia and Barrio Larrastia- both gems of Santiago. Matias is very responsible and attentive.

Beautiful and spotless home. Nicely decorated. Safe, convenient location. Helpful building staff. Jessica was always responsive and helpful. We stayed here for one night at the end of a two week long stay in Chile and didn’t want to leave because it was so comfortable! Would stay here again!

The place was beautiful. Really well maintain. Easy to find and no problems at the moment of checking-in.
Thank you !
Alejandro was a great host, everything worked fine and even when I arrived a bit early I was welcome!

We will be back had a lovely stay felt right at home coming from Australia we had another Airbnb booked but we're disappointed and luckily enough we booked this place and within an hr we were out of the other and into this spot. Thank you 🙏
Great apt in Providencia. The pool is only available in the summer time  fyi. The shower was great, the bed was comfortable, and the building was legit.

Carlos and Karen were very attentive and amazing hosts. They contacted us a couple days before we arrived to give us check in instructions. The location was easy to find and the building staff were friendly. Their apartment was clean, cozy and quiet and was in a beautiful neighbourhood with a lot of little markets and restaurants that was easy to walk to. The Metro station is nearby if you need or you can use Uber to get around the city. Everything was easy to access and it was fun to explore the area around. They kept in contact throughout and were very friendly and prompt in their responses. Would love to come back one day!

I selected this apartment at the last minute due to an issue with an alternate AirBnB. I am so glad that I was able to make the change because Cesar was an amazing host. He checked in often to ensure that everything was going as expected. The apartment is in an ideal location with many restaurants and is walkable at night. I highly recommend this location and hope to visit again soon.
SUPURB airbnb!! Would absolutely stay again. Completely immaculate and great and safe neighborhood. A must stay!
Marcela’s home was perfect for my stay. It was close to transit which made exploring the city easy. It’s also only a short walk from the park which was an added bonus.
A nice basic apartment in Santiago. I was able to work from home here with good internet no problem
This was was everything like it was described. easy to access and communicate with the host. the restaurants and metro was very close. overall a very great experience.

Honestly one of the best experiences I’ve had staying here. Host was very friendly, helpful and responsive. The place was very clean and cosy. The area was perfect close to nice restaurants and shops. 10/10

Excellent accommodations and fantastic views of the mountains! A bnb hosts take note.
Juan offers a large private penthouse with all the amenities guest will ever need. He left us a well stocked refrigerator, breakfast and snacks. There was no need to buy food immediately. The kitchen is well stocked with dishes, glasses every cooking utensil, plenty of coffee, spices, etc. There are plenty of towels, paper products, house coats and bedding. Comfortable furniture a hot tub and a large king size bed.
Incredible space. Highly recommend
Thanks Juan for everything.

Wonderful apartment in a conveniently located neighborhood of Santiago. The apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, making meals, and strong wifi for working.
The apartment is walking distance to many key locations in the city including cerro San Cristobal and barrio Italia. Some say the neighborhood can be a bit dodgy but we felt completely safe and there was security in the lobby 24/7.
Francisca was helpful, responsive and even accommodated an early check in for us to accommodate our early flight time. Very much enjoyed our stay overall.
Fantastic location! Right in the middle of the action. Surrounded by excellent restaurants. Would 100% book again.
amazing place to stay in Santiago! The hosts are super friendly and I felt right at home. They provided breakfast and local recommendations. The bed was very comfy!
We had a nice stay for a few days in the apartment. It can get quite noisy at night. Marcelo and Jaime were very kind and quick to respond.

Really great spot! On the 14th floor of an apartment building right downtown. It was very clean and comfortable although quite small. The only bummer was that it’s rather close to the highway, so when the windows are open it’s loud. With windows closed it’s very quiet though. Overall we were super happy with the place. Maria is quick to respond and helpful. We would totally come back.

Central location in a secure building, be aware that the translate function actually changed the street name from Merced to Mercedes for English speakers but the actual address is on Merced, thankfully the host was helpful and we were able to identify the issue.

Had a great stay at Alvaro's place. The apartment is very nice and very centrally located. Alvaro was very responsive and gave some great recommendations on where to eat in the area. Would definitely recommend.

Our second time here and it has become our home in Santiago. Mabel is amazing and responsive and attentive to all our needs. Location is amazing, right across the river from Costanera, and everything you would need. They’re not super fussy about cleaning and the space is so stunning.
Great apartment with a wonderful view. Very close to the metro and supermarkets. Miguel was always very helpful.

Very nice apartment that is close to many cafes, restaurants, and shops. Easy checkin, amazing view of the city and mountains, clean apartment, and the host was super responsive to any of our questions!! Would definitely stay again if we’re in chile

Arnold‘s place is really nice if you stay in Santiago. The location is perfect, surrounded by a lot of restaurants. The flexible check in is really easy. The apartment itself has everything you need. Arnold was very helpful as well. I really recommend the place.

This was one of the best airbnb's I've stayed at. The location is unbeatable — in the heart of Lastarria, close to lively streets with many restaurants and bars, and steps away from metro line 1. The building complex feels very safe, and the apartment faces an inner courtyard so it is quiet. Eugenio and Sofia were lovely hosts; they met me at checkin and checkout, and were very flexible with those times. The apartment is very clean, spacious, and has everything you need for a longer stay. I would definitely stay here again when I come back to Santiago!
Valentina's place was perfect! We had no trouble finding the place or getting in. It had all the amenities and a great view of the city, and was very central to all the things to do in Santiago.
Nice host and very comfortable apartment. There are a lot of things to do in the surrounding areas.

We stayed here for two days/three nights during our Chile vacation. The loft has everything you'd need for a short stay, and the space is perfect for couples. Solidad was very communicative, and accessing the building and the apartment was easy.  It also has a great location, a 15-minute walk from the metro and most downtown attractions. We would stay here again.
Great communication, clean place to stay. The neighborhood is very walkable -  the Italian district is very vibrant. I would stay here again.

Javier was really accommodating with our late check in due to a late flight. We had a bit of trouble getting the key pad entry to work but Javier was very responsive and helped us to get it working. Overall it was a nice little apartment to stay in, neat, clean and well decorated.
Apartment exactly as described. very close to the metro, super market and attractions. excellent building security
The location is fantastic. Having a metro station 1 block away was perfect. All the activities made for turism are super close. Great place.

Graziela’s apartment was as advertised in every way. She let us check in early which was so helpful. Really fast wifi. The  las condes area feels very safe but you’ll need to take a 20 minute Uber to see any of the attractions in Santiago.

Gonzalo has a lovely apartment with stunning views over Santiago and the local mountains. Barrio Italia is within walking distance and this was our favourite neighbourhood for breakfast, dinner and wandering around. Recommend Mala Mia for breakfast!

Fantastic place to stay in Santiago, centrally located and a very friendly neighborhood. Waldo was highly communicative and flexible, and the house manager Claudia was friendly, helpful, and really made our stay the best it could possibly be. Really can't thank them enough and looking forward to our next stay in Santiago!

Great apartment in Santiago! The building is close to main city cites and has many restaurants close by. Felt very safe with the 24/7 sercurity to get in the building. Apartment was cofy and clean. Would stay here again.

We loved our short stay in this apartment. Barrio Italia is one of the best areas in Santiago in our opinion, lots of great cafes, bars and restaurants in walking distance. The apartment has everything that you need. Very good wifi / internet. Johnny was a great host.

we had an excellent stay at Jan's place, it was a perfect location to acesss all the main attractions in Santiago. We are two females and felt safe in the neighborhood, even after 10pm walking outside athough we were only there on weeknights. Really enjoyed the balcony for viewing the sunset in the evenings!

The apartment is just like it described in the photos. Comfortable bed and good plumbing.  There is a 24/7 doorman for entry. The views from the small balcony are amazing. Direct view onto the Andes and the vista of the city. Located in a safe and secure part of town. 30 min walk to downtown and grocery store within 10 min.

Wonderful location for a young family! The access to the park, grocery store and mall were fantastic! Jessica was great with communication and the apartment was clean and beautiful. We’d definitely stay there again!
Great location close to all the night life, but located on a quiet cul-de-sac to enable a good sleep.
Soledad’s place was beautiful and exactly what we needed! Thank you so much for having us:)

What a location and what a view of San Cristóbal hill! We loved the art and the the neighborhood. It got a bit noisy late. But it’s a pretty cool custom, this Chilean group singing. Lots of energy and a very positive experience.
The place in the host were great. I would absolutely stay here again I worked for three days with lots to do around the area and great Internet. :)

Well-located tiny studio! The place is within walking distance to key areas of interest, making it super convenient for exploring the city. The 24-hour doorman adds an extra layer of security and the self-check-in process was a breeze.
Antonio was very easy to communicate with. He was extremely responsive. He actually went above and beyond to accommodate our requests.
Valentina is incredibly responsive and very kind! Just had a quick stay before getting on the road but we would gladly stay again!
The location was incredible, and the apartment was a perfect space to pass a few days in Santiago. The apartment came with great amenities, and we were very happy with our stay.

We felt completely at home in Said's accommodation. There was nothing missing and the communication was good.
The apartment is super equipped, the location is advantageous. The pool is a great extra on sunny days. Unfortunately, as temporary guests, we were unable to use the gym.
All in all: great accommodation, friendly host, above-average value for money.

The place’s air conditioning did not work. They make a big deal about the a/c in the listing title. When I told them in check in they already had an excuse so they knew it wasn’t working. It’s dishonest to advertise a listings with a/c and know it doesn’t work.
We had a great stay! Easy check-in with the concierge. Catalina was very responsive with our messages and made sure we had what we needed.
Lovely place in a nice area. On a quiet street but easily walkable to barrio Italia and fun places in Providencia. The bed was super comfortable as well!
Easy check in and out of this modern, clean and well appointed apartment. Short walk to the metro. Would stay again.
Claudia is a very warm and beautiful person.  She made us right at home. She arranged transportation for us, and told us how to get to the big market. This was an authentic Chilean experience.
host was great! location was also secure to walk around, very good situated near to a market, many restaurants and metro station

This is an incredible Airbnb right in the heart of Providencia. The decor was so cute, the space was outfitted with everything we needed, and the host was incredibly responsive when we needed to communicate. Added bonus, the sheets and towels were amazing! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Santiago.

Juan was extremely responsive and a very gracious host. We had to cut our stay short due to a family tragedy and Juan was very compassionate and kind. He arranged a ride for us to the airport and was very supportive. We hope to return next year and we will absolutely stay in Juan’s place again. The apartment is lovely and the views are fabulous. All the kitchen basics you’ll need are provided for you and the area is very close to fantastic restaurants. Highly recommend! Thank you so much for your help and for being such a kind human, Juan.

We came in from a red-eye flight and the front desk of The Place were very patient and accommodating to us. They clearly told us where everything was and gave us recommendations for the area.
Thee room had a stocked kitchen (in terms of plates, pots, pans, and silverware), stove, and large fridge. The room was beautiful and the private terrace was equally beautiful. Although we are nearby so much, it was so quiet in the room! Would recommend it to anyone looking to stay in the Las Condes area.

Beautiful place. A good frying pan, a bread knife and other kitchen basics are needed. The bed sheets made my skin itchy. Maybe a different detergent should be used? But overall, great place, great value
My friends and I had a lovely time in Santiago. The apartment is close to many restaurants and parks, very walkable!

Minutes away from Santa Lucia Hill, subway, buses, restaurants, grocery stores and a vibrant downtown Santiago. Apartment is as described and pictured. Friendly hosts allowed flexible checkin, recommended sights to visit and ensured that everything met my expectations. Individually controlled AC was a plus (other places the AC cannot be controlled by the occupant). The immediate area is bustling with activity, walkable and safe 24/7. A perfect find ending my visit to Santiago, Chile on a high note.
Susan is the most lovely host, and her place is in the perfect location if you want to be close to restaurants and bars. Would definitely stay again!

We were here for a week exploring Santiago and also attending a friend’s wedding. This premise is very convenient as there’s a supermarket within walking distance. It allows us to cook meals for days we don’t feel like going out.
There are also metro stations nearby that allows us to explore the city with ease.
The balcony view was amazing and it’s perfect to enjoy the breeze during meal times. Apart from some slightly clogged basin in the toilet, everything was as described.
Will definitely recommend this premise to anyone!

The Place team is amazing!! There is always someone at the front desk ready to help with whatever you might need.
They are totally customer service oriented and made my days in Santiago so much easier.

This place was a great choice when staying in Santiago for a few days! The apartment was clean and safe, and the view from the patio was spectacular! You just want to skip all your plans and sit out there with coffee or a glass of wine!
Communication was excellent, when there was a miss-communication with checkin it was resolved quickly and effectively.
