The barrio Italia neighbourhood has so many good restaurants and bars, and the apartment is extremely walkable.
I highly recommend to anyone staying in Santiago.

Ivan's place was a perfect spot to explore and get to know Santiago. It was in a fantastic location and very safe. I particularly enjoyed the guys at the front desk who were extremely helpful as well. Would definitely recommend!
Amazing place near to Metro and shopping mall, very confortable and silence place to rest if you want. Great communication with the host.

Jose’s apartment is perfect for a family or group looking to stay in Lastarria. The location couldn’t be better, right across from Bocanariz and Chipe Libre, and next door to the art-house movie theatre. The beds were comfy, and despite being in such a busy location the bedrooms were relatively quiet. The private patio in the back of the apartment is cute and a nice respite to have some drinks or make an asado. Being a child of the 80s-90s, I appreciated the alternative rock musical taste of the host. A great CD collection! Highly recommend the apartment. Having lived myself in Lastarria for the last 5 years, I can say there are few apartments that could compare!
Catalina’s place was perfect location! Great places for dinner and drinks just steps away! Felt very safe. Wish we could have stayed here longer.

Hector’s place was perfect for our short stay in Santiago. The Bellavista neighborhood was lively and walkable. Hector was extremely nice and accommodating…even allowing us to check in very early when we arrived from the States. It was a pleasure!
I enjoyed staying here. It was the perfect location for exploring Santiago and Rodolfo was the best host!

Well situated, although the taxi driver made a point to tell me the neighbourhood was dangerous,you're actually right on the border with some very safe neighbourhoods. We didn't have any issues.
Everything was great, no complaints.

I’ve stayed at many AirBnBs in the States and in Europe and this was definitely one of the very best.  The Apartment is beautiful, exceptionally well equipped with everything you need, in a lovely neighborhood and close to points of interest and public transportation.  Francisco is absolutely the best host I have ever had with AirBnB.  He was incredibly helpful to us, had great recommendations and was very easy to communicate with.  I 100% recommend Francisco’s place and will definitely stay here again if we ever make it back to Santiago.

Room is around 30 minutes (walking) away from the historic center and roughly 25 minutes away from the airport (depending on the traffic)
Access was absolutely easy and Vanentina provided a range of mobile sim cards to start your travel in Santiago. A chip card for the public transport is offered as well (you only need one and scan it twice, if you travel together). The kitchen provides everything necessary and the bed was large and comfortable.

We are so glad we found this apartment for our stay in Santiago! Not only was the view from the 25th floor amazing, but the flat was spotlessly clean and really enjoyable to be in, and José was really helpful and friendly. The location is great- safe, near to the metro, and just a short walk from Barrio Italia’s lively shops and restaurants where we enjoyed a few meals, coffees etc. We can’t recommend this place highly enough!

Nestor was very welcoming, and made me feel at home. He respected my privacy and was always helpful and responsive when I had any questions.
The apartment is at very good location, near shops, restaurants, and just a 20 min drive to the airport.
Beautiful place! It was a lovely oasis right in the heart of Barrio Italia with lots to explore nearby. Would absolutely recommend and we loved our restful and comfortable stay.

A beautiful apartment with everything we needed. The apartment is close ( easy walk) to lots of restaurants and a supermarket and felt very safe. Camilo was really helpful with tips and always responded quickly. I recommend staying here if you are visiting Santiago- we would definitely return! Thank you for the wonderful stay Camilo!

The host was very informative and attentive. He provided me with great detail of the place and very clear instructions to make the check-in process totally seamless. The whole place felt very homey and was spotless. Great location surrounded by numerous bars and restaurants.

This place has an incredible view of the city. It's small but cozy and the bed was comfortable. It doesn't have a large living room but has everything you need for a short stay in Santiago. There's a nice big TV in the bedroom, a large balcony in both rooms, and I loved the shower water pressure. Cristóbal is very responsive and went the extra mile to accommodate my late check in and check out. I would come back!

The apartment is perfect in a prime location. Ignacio communication was on point always.
Highly recommend it.

A nice apartment in a great location. Having two rooms was very useful for the two of us, so one could nap while the other worked in the living room. Kitchen was a little sparse, but convenient to have a full refrigerator and oven and range.

Christians flat in Santiago was amazing. It is in a perfect location walking distance to all of Lastarrias best restaurants. The house was very clean and we enjoyed our stay. Note.. if you are a light sleeper bring earplugs as the flat is on a Main Street and you get traffic nose / construction somewhat early in the morning.

Comfortable, well-equipped apartment in a great location. It's just a few minutes from Mercado Tobalaba, the metro, and lots of restaurants. The bed is comfortable and water is strong with high pressure.
Great location, easy to access. Daniel is very responsive. His check in instructions are very clear and easy to follow. He also helped us connected with the airport driver, nice service!

The building was easy to find and very well located. A grocery store, pharmacy, several restaurants, and cafés are located right across the street. Money exchange places and banks are within walking distance. The subway is also close by,  but I did not feel the need to use it. The apartment had all the needed amenities. I did not have any reason to communicate with the host besides check in and check out. I recommend Clara's place.

Pablo’s apartment is perfectly appointed and worked well for our small family. The view is amazing and we could walk to wonderful local restaurants, parks and shopping malls. The amenities in the apartment building were brilliant - we used the warm pool every day. A safe and beautiful apartment - we recommend it!

Felipe was one of the most helpful hosts we ever stayed with! Always available and willing to help far and beyond his responsibilities. He was flexible and accommodating to our early morning/late night flights. He helped me book two unique events that end up being highlights of our trip! I can’t say enough how amazing he was and apartment was just perfect for all our needs, highly recommend!
Great view, the shared terrace with the pool is lovely and Soledad is very helpful with all things!

It is a nice sunny apartment with a beautiful city view, on a clear day you can see the mountains in the background. Everything was comfortable, I enjoyed staying. Additionally, the front desk is very friendly and helped me with a personal issue. Small grocery stores are nearby.
we booked this place very short notice and everything was fine. The location is really good and 24/7 support is given at the hotel reception next to the department.

Marcia is an amazing host. She’s friendly, helpful and was very accommodating. We had trouble with the internet and she increased the speed for us so that we could work from the apartment. We were also able to arrange an early check-in.
The apartment is smaller than it looks in the photos, and if you like cooking, this isn’t the kitchen for you.
That said, the location is amazing; you’re surrounded by great restaurants, things to do, and neighbourhoods to explore.
The view of the mountains and the rooftop pool make it well worth staying here.

What a great apartment with unbeatable view! The apartment is walkable to most neighborhoods and spots that we want to see in Santiago. Very clean and easy to find. Check in was seamless as well. Highly recommend Gabriel’s apartment!

Marcela’s apartment is in a great location, two minutes to everything you need. Easily can take  a bus from the airport to the metro to her place in less than an hour for 2500 pesos. Great pool, laundry and plenty of space for 2. Would not hesitate in staying here again. Mucho gracias!

Maureen was such a gracious host, that communicating with her felt like chatting with a friend. The apartment's expansive windows offer commanding views of the park. The generous open terrace feels like an outdoor living room, and is a relaxing spot for friends to enjoy the evening breeze and a glass of wine.
We found it quite simple and pleasant to walk to quite different neighborhoods, from the residential to fashionable shopping districts, and to a restaurant row. Maureen's place is well-situated. We feel lucky to have found the apartment and her.
Good location to walk around.  Gonzalo gave great suggestions and was responsive when a question was asked.  The very small draw back is the street noise while in the apartment.

The location was incredible! Lot of mini markets, restaurants, pubs around. The place was tidy, comfortable bed, nice view, great shower. It had some first useful kitchen groceries, like salt, sugar, olive, very much handy! Marcelo was very helpful and friendly. The self checkin was gold!
The only issue is that there is a pub/club in the basement and can get noisy at Fridays. Other than that, I’d stay again and I recommend!

Anita Maria and her husband are gracious hosts. When I first arrived after a few minutes, I felt like I belong there. Anita was gracious kind and very welcoming. She was very helpful. If you ask questions, she made wonderful suggestions, and was a joy to talk with. I highly recommend staying there. It would be difficult to find a nicer host.

Loved our stay in this cozy apartment with view of San Cristobal hill. An easy walk to the vibrant Lastarria area and St Lucia Hill.
The flat has a compact but practical layout with a bathroom off each bedroom. It had everything we needed. Beds were comfortable.
The host Antonio was very helpful with local information and recommendations.
It was great value for money and a cute home away from home.
I would definitely stay again. Muchas gracias

Perfect location
Great host
Everything as described
Nice and clean please
Would recommend

We stayed two nights at Camila’s place. She wasn’t here but it was her mom Ana who showed us around. She’s a very cute lady and very thoughtful. Camila responded all my questions before arrival.
The room is clean and well organised. We are very grateful and we recommend this place for people who travel to Santiago!

The accomodation is like it is described, the neighborhood is safe and calm, so I recommend. I did find some hair on the floor and I felt that the host was contacting us a bit too extensively (sending us many messaged asking questions and giving instructions) - all politely, but i just felt that it was a bit too many. Overall it's a nice place and the bed is soft and comfortable.

Great apartment, the receptionists were very friendly and we felt very safe.
It was very loud at night with music playing until 2am and there were barely any kitchen appliances (no toaster just a kettle). Had the bare minimum but good for the price and location was good.

Pepes apartment is great for a couple with all of the basics covered.  The bed is comfortable with nice linens. Small kitchen with everything you need. The pool on the top floor has a nice view of the city and is a great place to relax. Security desk was helpful in answering questions. Highly recommend.

Great place, highly recommend. Nice apartment, located a few minutes walk from a metro station, walking distance to major attractions, and lots of restaurants and shops nearby yet, the immediate surroundings are calm and quiet despite being in the heart of the city. Really the best of both worlds.

Osvaldo was very friendly and the communication was very nice, he responded very quickly and he was very helpful. The appartment was very clean and besautiful and we loved the places around. There are many nice restaurants and bars around. Also many clubs what you can hear from inside, but for us it was ok. I would recommend the place definately.
I stayed only 1 night but i was very satisfied. Everything is very clean , nice people location in city center but very calm during the night. I slept very well. Thank you for everything

We had a great time in Santiago and were so glad we booked this apartment. It was a quick walk to many things including the Lastarria and Santa Lucia hill. The apartment was clean and comfortable and check in was easy.
Would recommend this apartment and would stay here again!

What an incredible Airbnb experience. The host was accommodating and very helpful. The place is within walking distance to Lastarria and other fun surrounding areas. Extremely clean, comfortable bed, great shower and well stocked kitchen. The family who runs this Airbnb has not overlooked one detail and their passion shows in how welcoming and caring they are to their guests. I highly recommend this slice of heaven in the city! Thank you for making us feel at home in a new country. We loved our stay with you.

Great apartment in a central area, super close to Lastarria with its great restaurants and bars and terraces. The apartment was very clean and we enjoyed the comfortable bed. The windows are not very soundproof so for light sleepers I would recommend having earplugs, there is traffic noise below day and night. Cristian was quick to answer to our questions and let us check out later because of our late flight, which we appreciated so much!

The place was just as described. When we first got there, they took us to a smaller space than we booked, but as soon as we pointed it out, we quickly were moved to a bigger apartment. Nothing fancy, but well located and clean.
Maria is really nice! When I arrived, I mentioned that I need change some money and get a SIM card. She came with me just in case I couldn’t find it. Really nice person and lovely dog as well!

Such a beautiful spot in a great location! Parks and shopping nearby as well as great amenities in the building itself! Jessica was very responsive and very helpful especially when I requested a late checkout for an evening flight! I would definitely stay here again!

Breathtaking view in a really nicely located part of the city next to a well connected metro station. Miguel was very helpful and even bought a desk for me to work, as I stayed for more than two months. Gracias Miguel

José's apartment is small but beautiful and equipped with everything you need for a short or long stay. Both the view and the surrounding area is amazing. You will find several good restaurants in walking distance and have perfect access to the rest of the city through the metro station nearby. Jośe was a very good host and always available when we had questions.
The place was great, exactly as it’s described.  The hosts were super responsive and more than willing to accommodate certain special requests.  I would highly recommend this place.

Diana's place was easily accessible with the metro and the apartment was lovely.
The neighbours were a little bit noisy and the terrace could have used a table outside.
But in overall the place was really nice

Apartment matches the photos: fresh, clean, with guarded entrance. It is also quiet there. Swimming pool water looked strange so I didn't try. Host is responding within 20 seconds which makes it very comfortable to communicate with him. Fits the price, would rent again.

Camilo’s place is a great spot, close to amenities and good for metro links. The flat itself was a real treat to stay in with its original furnishings, and very clean and well equipped. WiFi was excellent. Would happily return some day.
It is great apartment, everything is working, clean and like a new one. The neighborhood is very nice, close of malls park, no more than 10 blocks from subway. I really recommend it.

Cristobal was an excellent host, very communicative and allowed us to do early check in for a fee. He also helped us buy tickets to a local show. The apartment was as described and the location is near great restaurants/bars.
Camilo’s home was perfect for our stay in Santiago. Plenty of space, and waking distance to many bars, shops, and restaurants. Highly recommend this place!

Only stayed one night but it was a great stay.  Nice place in a good location.  Right next to a large grocery store which is super convenient.  I only had the one day but I was able to easily walk to the places I wanted to visit.  Marcella is quick to respond and Jacqueline, who met me to show me the apartment was wonderful and a pleasure to meet.

Maria’s apartment was perfect. I even returned to one of her properties when I missed my flight and had an extra night in Santiago. Maria was very responsive and helped me check in even late at night and allowed me to store my bags in the lobby the next day. The neighborhood is great, very walkable and felt safe.
Very clean and tidy. Nice view of the city from the top, and right in the heart of it all. Easy access to the metro as well! Definitely recommend.
Super nice place to stay. Justo was proactively reaching out and checking on us if everything is fine and if we need help etc. place was as described and very clean

This is a beautiful, historic home meticulously cared for with so much attention to detail! Very comfortable beds and fully equipped kitchen. Francisco went above and beyond to warmly welcome and accommodate us and our needs! The atrium and outdoor balcony make this an extra special home!

My partner and I stayed here while making our way out of Chile after hiking Patagonia. It was super convenient and easy to check in and also located near great cafes and the best ramen we’ve had this whole trip. The apartment is cozy and perfect for two people. Would stay here again!

A great stay for a few days in Santiago. The apartment is clean and cosy and the pool on the rooftop is perfect for an afternoon dip and to help orientate yourself in the neighbourhood.
Close to transport, the funicular to explore the cable cars and park, and lots of places to eat and party until late. The noise is a lot though so my sleep wasn’t so restful, but much better once I used earplugs. Also, very friendly concierge staff! They were fun and helpful and we spoke Spanglish together and laughed. Thank you, Osvaldo!

Manuel’s place is in a very convenient location close to spots like the Bellas Artes metro, Santa Lucia Hill, great coffee shops and restaurants, Plaza de Armas, Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes just to name a few. Manuel is a very nice and accommodating person. I enjoyed cooling off on the balcony at nights and watching the sunset. The building feels very safe and the place is spacious. Thanks for a great stay.
German's place was easy to access and he communicated well, but the toilet flusher was broken so we had to manually flush from inside the tank.

Nice place centrally located, even though it’s not too close to the best bar districts. The apartment was nice, but it didn’t seem properly washed as there was quite much dust under the table for example.

This apartment in Lastarria is a delightful find. Perfectly located amidst the cultural heartbeat of Santiago, it offers a cozy, well-decorated space that combines modern amenities with local charm. An ideal spot for exploring the wonders of Santiago. Highly recommend!

Álvaro's apartment was fantastic. The place itself is well equipped and nicely designed. The rooftop pool was great to cool off in after walking around on hot days. The door staff helps add to the sense of security. The location itself very centrally located, with multiple metro lines a few short walks away and no shortage of hip bars, restaurants and attractions (like the metropolitan park) just steps away. Overall an awesome place,  and I'd definitely stay here again on my next trip to Santiago!
The place is fairly clean and easy. Ximena is responsive to give instructions and repair helps for the toilet’s flashing system. But the facilities at the place are kind of old.

We had a wonderful stay in Santiago at Javier’s apartment.  The flat is beautiful - very modern, well decorated and with good spaces throughout and a lovely balcony on which you relax, eat and drink and enjoy the views over Santiago.  It also provides a great and very safe base from which to explore Santiago.  Javier is a kind, helpful and responsive host.
Great stay in Santiago. The apartment has an amazing view and the building feels very secure. Gonzalo was easy to communicate with and helped with luggage storage on the day of departure.

We stayed at Gisela’s for the final night of our stay in Santiago and it was wonderful! As per other reviews, we found it to be a peaceful and beautiful oasis where it was easy to unwind and relax. Gisela is the most kind and generous host and is so very accomodating. We were also able to safely leave our luggage and explore the city before our late flight home. Gisela’s 2 gorgeous dogs were a bonus to sit with in the garden as well! Walking distance to all the amazing shops and restaurants in Barrio Italia and a short walk to the metro made it easy to get around also. Highly recommend- thank you so much Gisela!
Rosario’s place was as described and check-in was easy. The location was excellent. Within walking distance to the historic center of Santiago.

Excellent location to bars and restaurants. Waldo was very responsive and flexible! Only thing to watch out of is that it gets very hot. You need to open all of the windows to get a cross breeze!  Great stay all together!
Javiera is a very friendly and helpful host with love for details. I highly recommend her place to stay.
We had a lovely stay at Camilo’s place. The apartment is beautiful and the area very calm but close to cafes and restaurants. Would definitely recommend!
Susan and her partner were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home. Perfect place to stay for a visit to Santiago.

The apartment is a bit older than it appears on the website but was comfortable, clean and well equipped. The sofa could use a thorough clean or best replaced. Great location and lots of space for a family of four. Located near supermarkets, grocery stores and all conveniences. It has a convenient parking space.

What a wonderful experience! Alexis was a fantastic host, and the place was perfect! Clean, well located, and had everything we needed. Alexis shared many helpful tips with us upon arrival, and was a great communicator both before and during our stay. The area is safe and walkable to most of what you’ll want to see, and is right on the subway line for easy and quick movement around the city and from the airport. Very highly recommended!

Maritza is so kind, informative, and checking in & out of her place is a breeze! I loved the apartment, it was great for working (the wifi is incredibly fast ~450mbps), and very comfortable. Looking forward to the next time!

I simply loved the appartment. Everything was clean and beautiful. The location was a big surprise: placed on the middle of a really good neighrborhood, with lots to do, from restaurants to touristic places.
Ximena was also an awesome host.
Thanks for the stay, I'll 100% stay there again on my next trip to Santiago.
Amazing location and exactly like the photos! So much to do in that area with a park and many restaurants nearby. Felt very safe

We had a great stay in a vibrant neighborhood. The apartment is in a family-oriented area, with secure surroundings. The space is clean and nicely decorated. The bed is very comfortable. The balcony was a bonus, with a lot of people watching and hub-bub to entertain us. We also enjoyed the many restaurants and shops at our doorstep.

This is one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. As a remote worker from the USA, the WiFi was fast and I found it easy to stream and take video calls. The place is pristine, well-equipped, and very close to the metro. I found it easy to run down to bodegas nearby for food too. Francisca was responsive and incredibly flexible/generous with me when my flight was delayed a whole day!
Great views, great value. Patricio was very responsive and helpful. We stayed a week working remotely while seeing the city and really enjoyed it.

Like a few others say, Maria's place is not enormous but we had already figured that out in our calculations as a trade-off for the location which was fantastic. It's clean, well equipped and the bed was very comfortable. Santiago gets very hot in summer and so the pool up top when located was a lovely bonus with quite the view as well.

Excellent location as everyone has noted! Veronica and Jose Manuel were very responsive to Airbnb  messages.  They even let me drop off my bags early before check in, which was much appreciated. This apartment is loud because of all the excitement on the street. Also had some difficulty with hot water for a night.
Great apartment. Beautiful views. Great location. Very comfortable apartment. The hosts were very helpful with everything!!
Gisela was a great host and her beatifil dog. Thanks you amazing place to stay
Gustavo’s place was perfectly located, comfortable, with everything you’ll need to explore Santiago. He was very helpful in getting us set up in the apartment and responsive for everything we needed.

Absolutely beautiful home. The photos do not do it justice. It felt like a home transported from another era, framed by artwork from the host and completed with modern amenities.
Francisco was incredibly accommodating and helpful throughout our week long stay. I’ve been on Airbnb for almost a decade, and this was my favorite experience.
It is comfortable and the finishes have good taste.  I enjoyed everything about the place and location.

It is an absolutely great place to stay with amazing hosts. A room has its own private bathroom. There are many parks and restaurants nearby. Also, the apartment is less than a minute away from a subway station.
Highly recommended!

Great place, great location.
I have stayed there a few times and would do it again for sure.

Nice and clean. Sufficiently equiped. Quiet area, a bit empty in the evening but very near the lively area Lastarria. Many food options. We felt safe even though we had heard a lot about taking caution in the area beforehand. We were not out after 11 pm and followed basic precaution. A hotel-like stay.
Perfect stay for a last minute trip to Chile. Street is lovely and quiet, but close to everything.  Host was fantastic!
Waldo and Claudia’s place was a great stay in between our travels in Patagonia and Atacama. Spacious, clean, great location!

Got this place for the night after a late arrival in Santiago. It was perfect for what we needed. Clean and cute. A small hike up to the 4th floor but the guard was super nice and helped with our bags.  Note: Thin walls.

if it is available, do not hesitate to get this apartment. It has an amazing balcony on the 14 floor with an amazing view over the city. it is also right next to a metro station, and the mattress is very comfortable, and the bedsheets were very clean. it was definitely worthy!

Thanks so much for our wonderful stay Javier, it was exactly what we needed! It is a cute & very clean apartment and we absolutely loved our stay here! Javier was fantastic, he gave us so much information and was always very quick to respond if we had a question! Again, thank you so much! ☺️
An excellent place to stay if you want a quiet spot but in a bustling district. Really close to the parks, museums, art galleries and loads of restaurants.
Perfect location, exactly like the pictures and good instructions. Some nights the noise from the street was a bit overwhelming. Great value.
The place of the apartment is very good. It's really 5 meters away from the subway station. The host and the hostess are very friendly. Thank you very much.

We stayed at this place for a month and it felt like home. The staff was very helpful and friendly. The apartments have everything you may need: a good kitchen, big comfortable bed, clean bedding. It has a lot of natural light. The underground station is just a couple minutes away by walking. Plus there is an amazing vegetarian restaurant El Huerto really close to.
The only concern was the internet speed. Me and my wife were working remotely together and the speed clearly was not enough for both of us. Though Anita gave us a dedicated modem we could use which was a great relief.
We would definitely recommend this place. Looking forward to coming back there for our next trip to Santiago!

Rueben's place is everything and more than what is in the description.  He has thought of everything including providing power adapters for foreigners who forgot to bring them.  He has also provided toothpaste, q-tips, baby wipes, and even a bip card to use on the metro.   He is truly one of the most outstanding superhosts that I have ever booked on Airbnb.  The location is perfect for seeing Santiago sites.  I would return to his Airbnb in a heartbeat the next time I am in Santiago.
We had an excellent stay at Maria Jose's place ! The apartment is very clean, well equiped, has an excellent location and has a solid wifi connection. We recommend this Airbnb!
Great funky space in a vibrant neighbourhood. Restaurants close by which makes or a little noisy but the location was fantastic. Great for our family with teenagers.

Fantastic place to stay during our visit to Santiago. The apartment had reception, which made us feel safe. The area was within walking distance of everything - parks, museums, restaurants. Gustavo was also a GREAT host. He checked in with us and was even quick to answer any questions we had. Definitely a place I’d stay again. Thank you!
Wonderful experience for stay. Good location which is near the subway. The host is helpful and friendly.

We loved our stay at Camilo’s AirBnB, had lots of fun restaurants within walking distance, and the neighborhood was really safe. Barrio Italia was actually our favorite neighborhood in the whole city. The apartment itself was really pretty and paintings were truly pieces of art, lots of space in the apartment, and the bathroom was large and the tile was great.
Maureen was extremely helpful and attentive to our needs. She responded very quickly to any requests that we had. I would definitive return to her house next time in Santiago.
Very good place. Pool is very nice. Good neighbourhood. Doorman speaks only Spanish, no English at all.
Camila was an amazing host! Very helpful and considerate! The room is perfect for long or short stay, would definitely stay again!
A beautiful view, a peaceful apartment in a great neighborhood, a responsive and friendly host... What more could you want?
We had a wonderful stay on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.  The location in Lastarria was perfect if you want to get a good feel for the energy and atmosphere of Santiago.
Great place located in a beautiful neighborhood! Paz is such a nice host , always attentive and respectful of my space. I’m staying for a second time! Thanks for being so kind, Paz!

Álvaro‘s apartment was exactly as expected and we would highly recommend. In a great location within easy distance of all the different Santiago barrios as well
the city centre with all the wonderful museums on offer. Bellavista is a very lively barrio and yep, it can be noisy at night, but you are one of the most happening parts of the city. We liked the buzz and coming from London, we prefer to see and hear life.
Álvaro was a wonderful host; always super prompt in answering any enquiries. His rental offered excellent value for money and if you want to experience this vibrant capital city properly, this loft is for you.

Lovely cosy flat, good kitchen space for cooking and nice to have access to pool and washing facilities. Walking distance to a few nice areas but area right outside flat sometimes felt a little unsafe. Overall would recommend

Wonderfully located apartment with fantastic view of the city and the Andes.
I highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Santiago.
Felipe was very kind, responsive, helpful and simply - the best :)
Excellent host - checked in regularly to make sure we had what we needed and provided recommendations. Place was clean and in good condition. Would recommend and stay again.
beautiful place to base yourself - we absolutely loved spending Christmas here! Host is responsive and helpful and the area is incredible - would recommend to everyone

Sarah was very responsive, even allowing us to pay for an earlier check in last minute when our flight arrived very early. The place is as you see in the photos and there is so much in walking distance. One thing to note was the rooftop pool was closed during our stay, not the host's fault but something to look into if you're hoping to swim. Thank you for our stay
we had a great stay at Javiera's place. it's well located, secure and has an amazing view.
Perfect stay in Santiago! This is a hotel, clean, comfortable and quiet. Great deal for the price vs other hotels in the area. 10/10 would stay again!

We loved our stay! Karen was super responsive and accommodating to whatever we needed/asked. We only had a quick 24 hour trip to Santiago, but neighborhood has so many cute shops and restaurants, we’ll definitely be back!

We had a great time at Francisca’s place. The apartment was extremely clean and Francisca was very responsive and attentive. The area feels very safe. Although it is not located in one of the main tourist neighborhoods, it was a good experience to stay in a more local/residential area than the classic super touristy neighborhoods. There was a great Thai restaurant next door. The interior is decorated very nicely and modern. There was also a great supply of basic cooking items that we used to cook a few times. There was also great storage space in the closet for our clothes which we used since we stayed for a few days.

Gabriel responded immediately to all of our needs, even a last-minute request for help with parking and a help finding a lost key. He was an amazing host, and we loved his space. The view was lovely and made a great background for morning coffee.

It was great staying at Eduardo's place.
Rafael was very kind and proactive when I was in need for some help.
The apartment also is very clean and has a good location.
I would certainly stay there again.

thank you for letting us stay and leave luggage.  for non spanish speakers, I would recommend to do some research about neighborhoods, we walked into some markets where tourists need to be super cautious.

The place was nice, very quiet, compact and clean but there’s not a lot of places to eat around it.  It was 13 mins to the metro and 30 mins via Uber from downtown or Providencia.  We were only there for 2 days so it was worth it for us .  We saw the most amazing sunset from the condo.  And Kevin was very responsive.   We ran out of soap and toilet paper on the 2nd night so we had to buy from the supermarket.  Otherwise, it was value for money .

This place was very nice and exactly what we needed for our week in Santiago. It was right next to several bars that were quite loud on the weekend. There is not central AC; there is a window unit and a fan. There are stairs to get to the bedroom and bathroom. There were only two burners on the stove, which was fine for us since we only cooked a few times. Overall, a good place for people wanting to explore the city and have a place to sleep. I would recommend greeting the doorman so that they know you since they change throughout the day and will question why you're in the building.

This is a very unique place in the very best part of Santiago--Las Condes. Modern, convenient, safe. You can't find a better location. And you won't find a more amazing view of the city and the mountain range behind it.
The place itself is best suited to a couple or single person rather than a family. Two levels with a staircase that takes you up to the bedroom and main bathroom.
You have all the conveniences here: air conditioning, excellent wi-fi, good water pressure, easy access, and most of all, superb communication with Juan.
Highly recommended and would stay here again, for sure.
Great price for big city accommodations with off-street parking. Good location. Two bedrooms, shared kitchen, bathroom and living room. Bathroom could use some love.  Everything else just fine.

Sol's apartment is extremely well located. Just cross an avenue to get to the Tobalaba metro station and it is very close to the Costanera Center. In the streets around the building there are all kinds of snack bars and restaurants, as well as grocery stores and even a 24-hour convenience store. The region is safe for walking. The apartment was clean with comfortable bed linen and towels, the shower is hot and has great water pressure. Air conditioning and heating are available. The condominium has laundry facilities at a very affordable price. We stayed for 8 days and really enjoyed it, we already want to return for the winter. Highly recommended.
Place was very clean and resembled the photos. It was walkable to restaurants. Washer machine in unit was a plus.
Gisela is a welcoming host! The space is lovely and calm. Perfect for a short stay in Santiago.

This was a perfect place to stay for a few days while visiting Santiago. Providencia was an excellent neighborhood to explore and being so close to the metro was very convenient for getting to other parts of the city. We appreciated that the apartment was quiet at night for sleeping. An added bonus was the rooftop pool with an incredible view of the city.
Clara was extremely helpful and communicative in helping us to check-in and giving us very clear instructions on how to access the property. We soon felt right at home.
Great place for visiting Santiago. The location was easy to find and very walkable. Sara was super responsive and helpful. Would stay again.
Cristian’s place is great!! Spacious, safe, great location - very walkable to key points across the city. Highly recommend!

My friend and I loved our stay! The neighborhood is perfect, the apartment was spacious, with comfortable beds and some nice personal touches from the host (eg they leave you a cell phone with data to use when you’re exploring santiago). The kitchen was well equipped and we had everything we needed for our two days in Santiago :)
Apartment is comfortable and is located in an excellent area of Stgo close to great restaurants and entertainment.

This place is very conveniently located near lots of shops and restaurants. The host was very communicative and helpful and the instructions for checking-in were very well laid out. The apartment is well equipped and comfortable.

We loved Camilo’s place. It was perfect for our young family. Great location, nice and quiet, walking distance to all things needed to have a great time - cafes, bars, restaurants, convenience stores, etc. Kids had a wonderful time. Camilo provided some lovely recommendations, which we tried and really enjoyed. He was a great host.

Gabriela is the best host EVER! She made everything possible to make our stay smooth and cozy. She even came to pick us up at the airport in the middle of the night since our plane had been delayed. The apartment is perfect, very clean and comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet and safe, and the subway station is very close. The pool on the roof of the building is amazing, with the view of Santiago and the Andes. It takes your breath away! I highly recommend this Airbnb.

Really clean and comfortable apartment with beautiful views. The place is very near barrio italia which has great places to eat and drink. Javiera was really communicative during and after our stay, and even left some champagne for new years which was a lovely touch! Thank you!
Loved this apartment, felt right at home! Very close to everything in Santiago. Bed was super comfy, huge tv and the washing machine was a huge bonus 😀
Great place to stay in Santiago. Good communication and location. We were able to leave our bags before checking in while we had lunch.
Felipe’s apartment was superb. Neat, clean, with everything you need (including a washing machine!) and an amazing view of the city. I would be delighted to visit again!

Wonderful view from the balcony. Comfortable bed. Nice apartment. Centrally located near museums, supermarkets, public transportation.
24-hour security at the door. Would definately stay here again.

Diego welcomed us during our stay and was such a fun, helpful, and responsive host - he really made us feel right at home! The apartment and building are beautiful and historic, and is very close to the wonderful Lasterria neighborhood with tons of restaurants.

This place was fantastic value and is really well located in Santiago, close to the metro and the Barrio Italia area which was a really cool area. Carlos and Karen are great hosts and their communication was great, Karen was so friendly and helpful. Thank you!
Fabulous place to stay in the city.  The location was outstanding.  I would highly recommend staying here!!!

Camilo was a lovely communicative host. The apartment was beautiful, clean and very well located. The details of the apartment are thoughtful and the architecture is just beautiful. I will definitely be back!

We had a great stay in Santiago, we had everything that we needed in the apartment, we definitely would recommend it and we would definitely stay again!
The co host Mauricio lived in the same building and was extremely helpful upon arrival and check out also allowing us to store our bags whilst we collected a hire car.
The apartment is in a great location too to explore Santiago ☀️👌

Mirza’s place was very nice as shown in the pictures. It had everything needed. It is small but comfortable for one (possibly 2).
Mirza responded to inquiries quickly and with good information about local things. Short walk to public transportation and local restaurants.
Would definitely stay again and recommend!

We loved Felipe’s place. Easy to get around because it’s in walking distance of lots of restaurants and shops and super close to the metro. The balcony is gorgeous with beautiful views. After walking around the city for a whole day we got some food and brought it back to the apartment and had dinner with wine Felipe left for us and watched the sun set over the city and mountains. Possibly one of my favorite evenings in the city. Would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay! Location was wonderful and apartment was as pictured. Would recommend without hesitation.

Thank you, Felipe and Irmelys, for a great stay! We appreciated how communicative the host was and also appreciated the flexibility. The apartment is small, but the large patio outside made it well worth it! It was also really helpful to have laundry in the basement. It’s in a great location with lots to do nearby and public transportation five minutes away. One caution: the neighborhood has become less safe over the years with theft of personal items which we witnessed, but if you’re careful about your belongings, you’ll be fine.
Thank you again for a great stay!

Located in the epicenter of the Lastarria neighborhood, with a lot of people in the evenings and several nice restaurant. Some people might find this neighborhood a bit noisy, but it quiets down around midnight at least during weekdays.

i stayed with my wife for three months and it short words it was fantastic we stayed in the summer time nice breeze quiet and .ost importantly safe! I recommend this place and if I choose to come back and rent an apartment best believe this is my first anD last choice. thr owner wS very responsive and respectful. there is many positive things I could give on for a long time! I recommend bringing coins from.a bank because laundry and dryer 3000 pesos and local ships don't have change for laundry aside from that highly recommended. thanks you Cbs!

Great place with a fab rooftop pool located very close to a metro station and lots of neighbourhood restaurants. The apartment is off a main road with single glazing windows so can be a little noisy if you are a light sleeper. Great location and amenities for the price.

Thank you for the great stay, this was my second time staying with Carolina and it was just as good if not better than the first time. I would recommend to anyone looking for a place in Santiago. Safe and with a great location.

Valentina was a very accommodating host. She stayed up well past midnight just to make sure we checked in okay. The place is clean and thoughtfully furnished (just like the photos). Valentina left plug converters and different sim options to facilitate the stay for first time arrivals. The location was amazing. You can see Cerro Santa Lucia (one of the main attractions) from the apartment. It’s close to Lastarria’s main restaurant strip and Plaza de Armas without being in the centre of the hustle and bustle. The area was quiet at night and centrally situated… we walked everywhere! Highly recommend.

Gerardo was very helpful to accommodate our check-in requests. The apartment is very nice. We particularly enjoyed the balcony with awesome views. The location is excellent with access to many great restaurants and central attractions of Santiago.
The place looks exactly like the pictures, neighborhood is safe and there is security in the building. The hosts are very responsive and proactive, always willing to help and I felt right at home!

Netflix is not available as advertised and the TV was unusable for us. There are two towels and no broom to sweep the floor. Very basic items but good location and clean. Conceirge were helpful but host was useless.
Diego's place has a great location and was good for our family of three. Balcony, Smart TVs, and the pool on the 29th floor was great.

I love staying at this location :) there are so many great restaurants and activities around, and the space itself is very cozy and clean. The host is very helpful and responsive, and I like to stay here any time I’m in the city. Thank you!

Very kind and hospitable host. Clean, comfortable and spacious home. Excellent place for our family with children age 3-17. Hot showers, kitchen downstairs plus a private refrigerator and drinking water upstairs, and a TV and strong remote controlled air-conditioning unit in each bedroom. Safe neighborhood with a nice plaza and playground. Host was very accommodating with our late hours and helped us with laundry, finding great food, travel advice, etc. We've already booked to stay here again. Many thanks!

We really enjoy the apartment, spotless cleaned, well decorated, nice neighborhood, quiet and safe area.
Would definitely recommend to family and friends!

Very happy about the few days with Eduardo and Rafael. Very welcoming.
Easy to find and the instructions are very clear.
The airbnb is located in the center of Santiago. Perfect to visit the city for few days.
I recommend this nice apartment. Everything looks perfectly like the photos.
Can’t wait to be back :)

Great place, I highly recommend. However, a face lotion mysteriously disappeared from the bathroom and that never happened to me before. The air conditioning was great, the amenities were great. I wish them all the success
Stuff was very helpful, communication great, the room looked a bit tired but great location. Also be aware of the night life. Too noisy for us.
Had a good stay overnight for our flight the next day. Check-in was easy and had the opportunity to leave my luggage before check-in. Walking distance to lots of shops and restaurants!
It was in a very safe neighborhood. The apartment is maintained really well. Pablo is very responsive and helpful. The view from the apartment was beautiful!
Good place, well located and clean. However, the owner did not have a cordial treatment with the building worker

Beautiful place in an amazing area of town. Within a short walk of the best shopping, restaurants, etc.. Apartment is well laid out and spacious. Kitchen is modern and well equipped. Highly recommend.

We had a very good stay.
At night we were advised not to walk around after dark but during daylight hours it was fine. Lots if restaurants and bars nearby and the funicular. Swimming pool is good for views and a relax.
Other residents were friendly.

My wife and I stayed for a month in Ines's apartment. The kitchen is well stocked for making any kind of meal and we cooked a lot. The shower is great. There is a nice cross breeze with the windows open, so even though we stayed in the summer, we only had to use the air conditioner a single time. The bed has a high quality mattress and was great to sleep on. It's only one block from the subway or we could walk downtown in about 30 minutes. Overall it is a very nice apartment. It has everything needed for a long stay. If I had one complaint it's that the futon/couch is not very comfortable. If that were replaced with a real couch, the apartment would be perfect.

Gisela's place is an oasis in the city. We enjoyed sitting in the beautiful courtyard in the evening. The room itself is extremely tiny; hardly room to get around the bed. The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was also extremely tiny but had a great shower. It could have been cleaner in the corners. If you don't mind small for a night, this is a nice place to stay.
Central location, great communication with Manuel, apartment as described with all you need for a long stay, definitely recommend.
Veronica, her Son and the dog are just lovely beings. Felt like home from the first moment and would come anytime again :) high recommend!
Amazing place in the perfect neighborhood!! I had some problems with my airline, and he was very accommodating and responsive. 100% stay here if you're traveling to Santiago!!
Great location, great place. A little smaller than it looks on the photos but it was more than enough for me. Would recommend!
This apartment is worth it just for the amazing balcony - I can’t imagine a better view of the city and mountains. Apartment was comfortable and very well-located. Pool area was a big plus, too.
My parents were very happy with their stay at the apartment. The apartment was well located and comfortable. Communication with Gisella was easy, and she was very accommodating.
Osvaldo’s place was lovely, in a great spot and he was super helpful! Would definitely come back here :)

Great choice for a couple of days in Santiago between flights. Conveniently located near Parque Arauco in Las Condes, thus close to stores and restaurants,  good WiFi for remote work, air conditioning helpful during hot summer days. Also excellent views from the pool area on the top floor. Communication with Aline went smoothly, clearly on my list for future travel through the city.

Carlos/Karen were very helpful and communicated well. Their place is well located in Barrio Italia - in our opinion - the best neighbourhood in Santiago. It is close to many restaurants, mini-markets and very safe overall.

We enjoyed our stay very much and were very comfortable. The bed was nice and big and comfy, along with the pillows. Everything was very clean. The apartment itself feels very private. We appreciated having the security at the front gate as well as the code to get in the door. We felt very safe. The only thing missing was an air conditioner, but the fan worked for us. They hoped to install one while we were there, but it fell through. The hosts were very proactive and responsive when needed. Also the location is superb — close to bars, restaurants, coffee shops… we loved this neighbourhood! One of the best in Santiago.

We stayed here for a week at the start of a tour through Chile. A great accommodation with lots of privacy in a quiet and safe area of ​​Santago. A good base to explore the city on foot or by bike. We arrived from Europe in the morning and Camilo had arranged for us to be able to move into the apartment straight away. Very nice and that applies to our entire stay here. Highly recommended!

We felt right at home at Angie's place! Angie met us at the door when we arrived and showed us the space, the keys, and made us feel at home. She spoke flawless English and her space was the perfect size for 2 people to comfortably stay long-term. Extremely private, beautiful and safe neighborhood, easy to get Ubers from, and THE BEST BED we had our entire 3 week trip in Chile with a firmer memory foam mattress that left me feeling rested every morning. We would love to come back to stay again.

Our stay in Santiago at Jose's spot was great. The high floor of the apartment gave amazing views of the city and sunrises over the Andes. We took advantage of the small gym space and left our luggage with the front desk when we checked out to enjoy a bit more of the city.
Odette is one of the best Airbnb hosts we've ever had the pleasure of working with. Great rental, great neighborhood and we loved Santiago.
We stayed here for the third time. And will come back again. What a great concept. Location, design, service, value for money. Just perfect.

We really loved our stay at Franciscas flat . It’s Located in the very centre of Santiago, which meant that there were a lot of cool things to do within walking distance! We were greeted by lovely Santiago who gave us a lot of great tips ! The apartment was spotless clean , with a super comfy bed and equiped With everything we needed and a lot of thoughtful touches . Francisca was a wonderful host ! I highly recommend this gem !
Perfect stay, highly recommended. Great communication from host. Make sure you check out the rooftop for incredible 360 views of Santiago and beautiful sunset!
This was my second time staying at Paz during my vacation in Chile. I strongly recommend it, Paz is a lovely host and I felt right at home. Thanks Paz for having me!
We loved the views, the room was comfortable and clean, and the area is very safe and nice!
An unbeatable location near cafés, groceries and the metro. The apartment is surprisingly quiet. The staff at the building were very friendly and the apartment has all you need for one or two people.

Absolutely stunning and unique home with beautiful art. Mabel was super responsive and flexible with our check-out time. It was so nice having a gated parking space right outside the door.  The washer/dryer combo was also nice to have. If you are sensitive to light, wear an eye mask because the rooms on the second and third floors can be bright in the mornings.

Felipe was a great host and his place is exactly as described. Unfortunately I had to leave early due to an illness, and Felipe allowed me to adjust the days of my stay to accommodate me, which was very nice and unexpected. Felipe is definitely a super host!

The apartment was exactly as advertised and its location provides walkable access (10 - 15 minutes) to many activities and sites. Cris provided very detailed and easy to follow instructions for access to the apartment, laundry, etc, and was quick to respond to questions! The apartment is situated on a lively street, but if the sliding glass doors are closed, it muffled the sound well for sleep. It is a great space for a couple or lone traveler to call home base!

This apartment has everything you need with the perfect location. Jessica was a great host and looked after us at every point.
It will be on the top of our list when we return!

One of the best Airbnb apartments we have seen this entire trip. 👏
Thank you for everything. ♥️

The view is awesome from this apartment, but we also loved the location. The apartment has everything you need for a great stay in Santiago. Carlos was super responsive and we enjoyed the neighborhood as a jumping-off point to many of our trips into Santiago and beyond. Don't forget to walk into the iconic Santiago public library across the street where you can sit and work in any of the public reading rooms.

We loved our stay here. The apartment looks exactly as shown in pics,  very clean and modern. The kitchen is really well stocked so you can actually cook in it! Amazing location - you can walk to public transport links, the historic area, bars/restaurants and a big supermarket really easily. And lastly the host Gustavo is so lovely, he went above and beyond when we thought we’d left my partners passport in the locked apartment.

Great location! The apartment is a short distance from the Plaza de Armas and Bellas Artes subway stations. I recommend taking the subway at Bellas Artes station because, at night, the area is surrounded by vendors and seems less dangerous.
The place was quiet, spacious, and comfortable. The view from the rooftop was amazing. I highly recommend watching the sunset there. You can enjoy a 360 view of the city, similar to the observation deck at Sky Costanera. My family and I really liked Yolanda's place!

2nd time staying here. Juan Francisco is a very caring and hospitable host and we learned a lot from him about the area and culture. His home is very clean, comfortable, and in a friendly suburban neighborhood.

Great place in a very peaceful and pretty part of Santiago. Close to metro stations and bus connections. Had everything I needed for a long stay and Patricia was very welcoming and helpful. Overall a very comfortable stay. Gracias Patricia :)

The location was very good! A quiet neighbourhood far from the touristic zone. The only issues we had were electrical. The irons (2 of them) ended up not working so we had to wear wrinkley clothes. Also, the bedsheets, pillow covers and blankets had a smell as if they weren't washed.
Cristian was a super responsive host! The loft has a very nice design and good amount of floor space. We had a nice stay, the bed was a bit uncomfortable for us.

Great host, beautiful place in the middle of Santiago, we really enjoyed our time and appreciated Gisela’s taste in decorating the place and providing us with advice on restaurants - would definitely come back!

Alvaro’s Airbnb is a great spot. It is within walking distances of most of the major spots to visit in Santiago. You can also get to the metro very easily. Lots of good food close as well.
It is in the night club district so there is music until late in the evening, but Alvaro provided ear plugs and the apartment is high enough up that you can’t really hear it. The pool is fantastic. I would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to everyone!
The apartment is very stylish and beautifully looked after. The facilities were great and it is in a lively, fun neighbourhood. Would definitely recommend

What can I say?  The Place - is really THE PLACE!  Amazing staff at the front desk, the housekeepers are also very nice.  Great location in Las Condes, one of the two areas you should be staying in when visiting Santiago (Vitacura being the other).  The apartment itself was just incredible, very large by SA standards, and had a beautiful and large garden terrace.  Awesome coworker spaces and the attached Corsini restaurant was incredible!  Shouts out to the staff there too very nice!  Awesome breakfasts!
Great location really close to many points of interest. I had a great stay at Javier's place. :)

Located at a perfect spot in the city, very easy to walk anywhere to explore the city. Beautiful balcony, and the rooftop with a swimming pool and barbecue area was a perfect place to enjoy the sunset. Since it’s in the city, it can be little noise during nighttime.
A great location for walking and sightseeing. A spacious clean apartment. Easy check-in and allowed us to drop our luggage early so we could go sightseeing.

Such a beautiful apartment in a amazing area. Perfect for one or a couple. The apartment is right in Lastarria which such a great place for restaurants and cafes right on the door step. Clean and stylish space with a lovely outdoor patio so sit and have coffee.

Great place, very clean with awesome building amenties. The host is extremely responsive and very helpful. Just be aware that it is extremely noisy at night with the clubs nearby. If you plan to be out partying, this would be the perfect place for you! If you want to go to bed early and have a full night of rest you might want to consider staying elsewhere.
Close to the airport and the area is nice, useful for a night or 2 if you’ve got a short stay or connecting flight.

Álvaro is a friendly and very attentive host. We arrived before check-in time and Álvaro made sure we could drop our luggage early. The apartment itself is very spacious and clean. The view really is spectacular and the location is conveniently located within walking distance to the entrance of San Cristobal park. At night there is some noise from surrounding bars, but this didn't bother us.
It the second time I have stayed at this place. I like the apartment, the location, and the friendliness and collaboration of the host. I really felt at home.
Camila’s place is great, and she is a wonderful host! I fully recommend to anyone visiting Santiago.
Great place, definitely worth coming back if I visit Santiago again. I fully recommend it. Zip team was helpful and very responsive

My stay at Andrea's apartment was fantastic. The apartment was the perfect size for my dad and I; we were very comfortable. The kitchen was well stocked to cook at home and the laundry AND dryer machine was a huge bonus. Throughout our stay I had to contact Andrea with questions or needs and she was always very responsive. She even came to the apartment to fix an issue we had with the TV. She's a super dedicated host. And the location of the apartment is fantastic. Restaurants, convenient stores and shopping close by. Having the pool was a great bonus too since it was very hot in Santiago during our stay. I HIGHLY recommend this rental. You'll be in good hands with Andrea.
I loved Francisco’s place! It was cozy, nicely decorated and well-equipped with everything needed for a long stay. The area is safe and Francisco was always responsive
This was a nice accommodation with good location. My stay was very pleasant and many thanks belongs to Maria, from whom I received valuable advice for a smooth stay.

A very comfortable, clean apartment. Bathrooms were very clean as well.
Kitchen fully stocked. Great price for the place. Highly recommend!
Just a small point to note - the 2nd bedroom doesn’t have AC so in peak summer can be quite warm.

The host was super responsive. It was easy to get in as there is always a security guard on duty. There is a nice view of the mountains from the apartment. There is a supermarket directly next door which was nice. Internet is good. I would stay again.

Fantastic apartment in the centre of Santiago, the best we had during our trip to Chile. Self check-in worked great for us as we had a flight that landed at midnight. The area is also really good and central which is super convenient.

I recently stayed in a charming Airbnb apartment in Las Condes, Santiago de Chile, and overall, it was a fantastic experience. The cozy living room, although a bit small, had a welcoming atmosphere, making it a perfect spot to unwind after a day of exploring. However, the real highlight was the rooftop pool – absolutely amazing! The breathtaking views of the city and the refreshing pool created a memorable stay. The apartment's location in Las Condes added to the convenience, making it an ideal choice for anyone visiting Santiago.

Antoni's apartment is located in an ideal location, in the very center of Santiago, close to all the most important monuments and places of the city. The apartment itself is nice, although the equipment is not the newest. Antonio is very helpful and polite. Thank you for a wonderful stay :)

We had a wonderful visit at this Airbnb!  Alberth was a super helpful and responsive host.  We like this much we decided to stay another night, and he helped coordinate that for us and made our experience even better!  The place was exactly as advertised. There is one king bed, and one twin bed in a separate room although there is no door. There is some privacy though. But by far the best part was the bedding and pillows. We were so comfortable and slept like babies. And the neighborhood is just perfect. I would highly recommend this place.

One thing awesome about this rental is the area. Close to the Metro, points of interests and restaurants. I visited on the summer time, there’s no AC. I guess the fan was okay, though opening the windows would just let in hot air.  But otherwise stay was okay.
The build is awesome with laundry and a pool, the loft is nice and spacious with a a beautiful view. I loved it, I would absolutely stay here again!

I had my phone stolen my first time in Santiago. My family could not get ahold of me and was scared. There were able to reach out to Ximena and she was able to check on me through the Airbnb app. I am so grateful to Ximena for the the wonderful stay and for looking out for my safety. Fantastic listing!!!

Osvaldo’s home is perfect to discover the Bellavista neighborhood. We loved our stay and had everything we needed inside the Airbnb, beautifully decorated, and clean. Friendly host, staff, and residents. Make sure you go to the rooftop patio and watch the sunset over the city.  Thanks for the memories. I highly recommend Osvaldo’s place.
The appartement is great and close to the center without being in a loud neighbourhood. Patricio is very kind and proactive
Great place with cute decorations! Hosts were lovely and really helpful especially with being able to store our luggage even when we checked out. Great place to stay

Place was in a good location where it is walking distance to constanera center, restaurants and the metro. Easy to get around. They have simple cooking utensils to heat up bread, make a coffee and fry an egg which were just right for me. They don’t have a gym or the pool but I don’t use them anyway. They also have an air condition in the unit which was helpful during summer where it can be very hot. Thumbs up for this place. I would highly recommend this place to everyone
Juan was amazing!! This place was perfect to crash for the night, and Juan was so helpful with checkin and accommodating us. Would stay here again!
The view.. is amazing! Best view we had of all our stays in the city. Eleonora was very accommodating as well. Great location in las condes as well. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Perfect stay for my husband and I. Super cute Airbnb in a great location. Short walk to Lastarria and we felt very safe here.

Ignacio kindly responded to my multiple questions about best way to get from the airport, where to get sport supplies, etc. The apartment was in perfect condition and the neighborhood is in a great location. Being so close to the huge Mall La Costanera, you can find all you need at a walkable distance. The Mall is also a perfect spot to take the hop on hop off Turistik.
Would have been a better stay if the a/c worked and I was able to check in at the time listed. Otherwise, it worked fine for me.

Just as it looks in the pictures, the place is very nice indeed. Being Lima, be prepared for some fuzz outside during the day. Thankfully, it gets quieter at night. To get away from the noice, you can just walk a couple of blocks towards the cliffs.
I had a great stay and Miguel was a perfect host.
A beautiful apartment in a great location.  We love Camilo's apartments and highly recommend them.

Everything was great from start to finish. The place is absolutely amazing. No complaints from us. The 1 question we had, Andre answered it within the minute. He is very attentive and if we ever come back to Santiago we are definitely booking again.

Great location in the middle of everything.  BUT…if you like to get to sleep before say 2-3am…?  Really, it’s a great place, amazing location and at a terrific price, I’m just a bad sleeper so that was hard.

Osvaldo was very responsive. The apartment is very cool - stylish and nicely decorated. There is lots to do in the area - right next to the zoo, lots of bars and restaurants etc. Thanks for having us!

Wish we could have stayed here longer! Miguel is a great, accommodating host and provided us with many restaurant recommendations within walking distance of the apartment. It was very clean, comfortable, secure, and in a great location.
Raina and her family are very friendly, helpful and polite. We enjoyed our stay very much.

We had a great stay in Santiago. The view from the apartment was amazing and we loved the rooftop pool, as it was very hot when we were there. The neighborhood feels safe and the apartment is close to the metro and in a pretty neighborhood.  It was a good value. Would stay here again.
My family and I had a great time at Jessica's place. Everything was as she described in the listing. She was very responsive and helpful. We will recommend this place 100%.

Apartment is nicely located and it has a pool on top of the building.
We were there end of January and it was a bit warm in the apartment without an air conditioning.
Gonzalo was very friendly and responsive.
The floor and curtains were quite dusty. I understand it's in the middle of a big city, but it would be a nice to have it cleaner.

Lovely host. Lovely place. Perfect placement for what I needed. Always quick to reply to messages. The accom had a newly painted smell about it. Love that they keep on top of the decor. I've rebooked for after my trip south to Chiloé.

Nice place, great location, Manuel and his wife were just amazing, great knowledge of the city and surrounding.
Will definitely go back

Very nice appartement and good contact with the host. Appartement is within walking distance of the city centre and of the nice bistro neighbourhood, and next to a beautiful park with good view over the whole city.  Apartment was clean and Gustavo was so nice to let us drop our baggage beforehand as we arrived way sooner than the check-in time. Good host and good location!

Relaxing place with peaceful balcony. I had a great stay. It was easy to get to the market and metro and has a convenience store nearby. The door workers are super nice and help keep the place safe. The laundry room was very clean and convenient. Overall, the place had everything I needed. I even did a long run over closer to the mountains and university. Very pretty.
Excellent! This apartment was the perfect space for a few days, beautifully furnished, modern, kitchen well equipped and in a fantastic location to explore the city by foot or by bike.

I loved this neighborhood in Santiago and Cristián’s place is both in the heart AND exceptionally peaceful. The flat has everything needed including a lovely patio. Cristián is super responsive and helpful. I ended up adding a day because it was so very nice.
I would really recommend this apartment in Santiago! The apartment is super nice, clean and quite big. The bed is really comfortable and the option to cool down in the pool is amazing.

Stayed at Cristian's place for 2 nights and would highly recommend. Everything was exactly as described. Clean place, comfortable bed, amenities as described. As mentioned in some other reviews, was a bit loud at night, but seems to be the price of being in a good area with lots to do within walking distance. Cristian was responsive and made check-in easy.

Fabulous interior decorations, love the black and gold theme. Clean. Easy check in. Air conditioner is very loud and I was unable to sleep with it on and can hear people in the halls talking. Great building, wonderful host.

Place was in a good location and the building had nice amenities.  The ceiling of the shower had some mold. The unit has AC in the bedroom but is gets a bit warm during the heat of the day. Otherwise, nice stay.

Good location. Apartment was big enough for 2 couples. The furniture is a bit cheap and well used. The apartment could do with more furnishings as there was no cleaning equipment, limited towels and wobbly kitchen table & chairs. In general, did the job and worth the price.

everything was awesome!! we had some trouble to enter the apartment, but it was fast resolved. the worst was that we checked out one day before and wrote a message to the host and he hasn't replied yet.
One of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed in! Really cool views, good location, easy to check in and out. Apartment was extremely comfortable to stay in. Definitely recommend!

Camilo’s place is a must stay! It is beautifully decorated and serene with private outdoor terraces. There are numerous restaurants within walking distance and multiple cute shops to browse. Would love to visit again,

Emelina Y Miguel were great host and super proactive in their communication and one step ahead of what we needed.
This cozy apartment is just steps away from everything in Santiago and offers great accessibility to all the things you want when touring a new city. Thanks!
The ladies at Casa Marcoleta were very kind and welcoming when I arrived. The apartment is in a great location!! Thanks for sharing your space!

I appreciate Francisco's flexibility in accommodating an early luggage drop-off and his prompt response to my additional supply requests. However, I feel that the reality of the place falls short of the photos. The living room overlooks a parking lot with a regular view of the parked car, and lacking the promised privacy due to frequent passerby activity as people come passed the window to collect equipment. The outdoor table and the back area is dirty.  Maintenance issues are evident, from a malfunctioning bedroom TV to a loose hallway light fixture and deteriorating paint on doors. The furniture is functional but, for me, it was not comfortable, especially the uncomfortable couch. Cleaning was challenging with minimal supplies provided, contrary to typical Airbnb expectations. Unfortunately, this apartment did not embody the home away from home experience, making it, in my opinion, not worth the asking price.
Camlia and her brother are very friendly,the house is nice and have everything we need,is easy to everywhere.
Nice, basic place. Everything you might need. Great location and price. Safe and secure! Very responsive host.

The neighborhood is a bit sketchy, so I recommend taking uber. The A/C is very noisy and its exhaust tube doesn't allow the shades to fully cover the window (the flat is on ground floor). The cleaning person forgot a soda in the fridge. Overall an ok stay!

A beautiful and modern space which is a treat to stay at. The rooftop pool had stunning views and was a very relaxing space. Enjoyed our time, not many places for working from home to situate yourself but we made it work. The 24/7 doorman provided ease and feeling of safety in the busy nightlife area. I would recommend!

The place is well located about 800m walk to supermarkets, Bellavista and Cafe strips. It was very clean. Well equipped kitchen. It had aircon which was a god sent as it was hot. The building is quite old. Apartment has 2 bedrooms which was handy to put suitcases in and give you more room.
Soledad is a great host and was very accommodating.

A great location from which to explore Santiago. We found the apartment to be at the intersection of several of Santiagos most desirable destinations and sights. The neighborhood is very vibrant and welcoming, although some behavior can get a little rowdy in the wee hours. We were not bothered by this, but some may be.
If we return to Santiago, we'll definitely stay here again.

The location is great. Everywhere is walkable and close. I stay in summer and it was very hot inside. The apartment is missing air conditioning in one of the rooms which it was hard to stay inside. The other 2 rooms are okay

We had a wonderfull stay at Jonathan’s place! The best region in Santiago (Barrio Italia), restaurants and bars within walling distance, super friendly and flexible host, nice extras of the shared pool and fitness in the appartement building.
Great location. Clear instruction about how to get there. There are everything that need for comfortable staying. Recommend

We stayed at the newly renovated apartment in the property on the last floor. The apartment is beautiful, renovated with taste and have all amenities you need to feel at home. The surroundings are stunning, walkable distance from a giant park and the mall. The host was super helpful and welcoming, and helped us resolved an issue. I would definitely recommend this place!

Great apartment in the perfect location in Santiago - Providencia. Easy walk to Costanera center and lots of bars and restaurants on Gral. Holley and Barrio Suecia. Smartfit gym across the street was great also. The apartment is on a high floor with great views, washing machine and solid air conditioning.  Even though it is a mixed-use building with commercial offices and residences, it was very quiet especially at night. German was a great host who checked-in with me regularly. I highly recommend staying here while in Santiago if the apartment is available!
Lovely little place to spend our last couple days in Chile. A little oasis in a very relaxed neighbourhood.

Had such a lovely stay at this flat - has everything you need for your stay in santiago. Good location, with lots of lovely cafes, restaurants and bars below - obviously a little bit of noise but most places were closed before midnight on the weekdays so you aren’t actually that disturbed at night. Host was fabulous and was generously flexible with our checkout which so lovely. Laundry facilities a big bonus and everyone in the building seemed friendly and helpful. All in all a great stay and would recommend!

Great location, very clean, great views, kitchen was a little small for cooking but we cooked most of our meals in the apartment.
Host was helpful and flexible with checkin and checkout.
3 min walk to a bus stop, 10 min walk to bike rentals, Barrio Italia was a 5 min walk.
Highly recommend this property and host!

The location is really amazing and the place is small but fine for a few days of exploring. The only downside was that we were here in the heart of summer. The sun shines into the apartment all day and there is no airconditioning. This makes the apartment extremely hot and we weren’t able to cool it down because of the high temperature.
Other than that the place has the basics and is good for a city trip.
Host is superb and house is well located. Good for a solo traveler. Would like to recommend here.
My friend and I had a good stay here! The view is amazing and Maria Jose was very responsive.
Great location,  building security 24/7, small space but just what we needed. Friendly, helpful and responsive hosts. 👍🏼 👍🏼
Very neat and tidy apartment, lovely plants and artwork make it feel like home. All as pictured. Location convenient to get to airport and back

This place was in a great location and I really enjoyed my month-long stay. Even in January, with temperatures in the mid-90s (mid-30s C) the veranda was usually cool and breezy. Lots to do nearby, and great restaurants. Getting around by bus, subway, and bike was easy. I especially liked going for a walk up Cerro San Cristobal every morning.
