Mirza was very helpful and responsive and a very flexible host. When I needed to change my schedule, she not only agreed, she did it for me!

Great apartment with two outdoor spaces in the best neighborhood. We ate dinner at the restaurant across the street and it was so fun! The host was helpful and easy to communicate with through the whole experience.

We really enjoyed staying at Casa's apartment.  located within walking distance to many things and in a nice neighborhood with many available amenities. The kitchen was well appointed,  the bed was comfortable and the amount of space of the unit was good.  All aspects of the space and stay were wonderful and we would definitely stay there again next time we visit Santiago.
During my 4nights stay in Santiago with Veronica was awesome. The location, neighborhood was so good, the room is clean, Veronica and his son, lovely perrito are going to welcome you.

Everything about the apartment was great - great location, friendly front desk attendants, very accessible, but the real highlight of the trip was Francisca who went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Santiago.
Was a great host! She was very friendly. We ended up not staying because it was too hot for us without the AC. But description was accurate and place was clean!

The apartment and is great, everything is exactly as described. The Wi-Fi is extremely strong and fast, and the amenities, bathroom, and bed are all very good. Location is excellent as well. I would recommend!
Great experience and great location at a great price.  VERY walkable to lots of bars and cafes. Check in and check out was smooth and easy. Cristian was very responsive and helpful.

We loved our stay at Camilo’s apartment. The location was amazing for our time in Santiago and there are many great restaurants nearby. Perfect location for our week in Santiago! The apartment is beautifully decorated and a great size for our group (4 women). We loved the patio and enjoyed sitting out there at night. Camilo was so accommodating and let us check in early as the apartment was ready to go. We really appreciated this due to our early arrival in Santiago! Highly recommend this apartment. Thanks Camilo!

The apartment is very clean and you will have a beautiful view of the skyline. Your own bathroom is in front of your bedroom. We felt very comfortable! Please note, that there is no lock on the door of your bedroom. Gianina was a very lovely host and always reachable. The flat is only 5 minutes walk away from the metro station. To the city center or the next bigger supermarket you will need about 20-30 minutes by foot.

This is a nice, new place. Everything works as expect, though the hot water takes a while to arrive.
It is on a courtyard so it is quiet at night. If it is hot outside you'll need to have the doors open all the time, even at night, or you will boil. The courtyard seems very safe, though.

Pablo was such a wonderful host and helped us to feel right at home. The apartment is just as pictured, very cute and the location is perfect. We also very much enjoyed the pool on the roof! Would highly recommend this stay.

Amazing place in the heart of an amazing neighborhood. We were walking distance to so many shops, bars, and restaurants. Lots of people selling things on the street outside. I loved it here and would gladly stay again.

Very central ground floor appartment with building security an outside patio and relatively quiet. We easily walked to most of the main sites in Santiago and had a good stay. The bedroom is comfortable but tight, with a small step to get onto the high bed and be careful not to bang your head on the hanging tv. Recommended.

Cristiano is a superhost and his loft is perfect spot for seeing Santiago - close to centre, walkable to Cerro Cristobal and Lastarria and Bellavista neighbourhoods and easy access to the metro. Peaceful end of town for busy Santiago. Well stocked supermarket practically in the building. We would strongly recommend his loft to anyone thinking of staying in the city.

We had a fantastic stay at this cute and cozy apartment. Had everything we needed for a few days in Santiago including a washer and dryer! Very walkable and safe neighborhood. Loved the 24h front desk. We would happily stay here again! Francisca and Emanuel were very responsive and helpful with any questions we had!

You won’t be disappointed with the views! For the price, I would say it is well worth it. Great location for a short trip to Santiago!
Windows open up for a nice cross breeze during the day or night.

We had a great stay in this very nice apartment in the heart of the city 5 minutes walk from the metro. The apartment had everything we needed for a very comfortable stay. Great communication with our wonderful host. Highly recommended, we would definitely consider returning.

Carlos’ place was fantastic—well located, with a beautiful view of the mountains, abundant light, and excellent setup. The amenities were as published. It was great to have a pool to cool of during Sanriago’s hot summer days.
Carlos was a helpful host, responsive and clear.
We will return!
Excellent place close to san Cristobal. Can be a bit loud as there are quite a few bars in the area but nothing unbearable. Would stay here again

I loved my stay at 868, I couldn't ask for a better location, very peaceful building area. I wanna thank Emelina y Miguel for their care, guidance and instructions. The neighborhood was filled with restaurants, shops, attractions at a walking distance since I love to sightsee by foot. Best of luck always.

The apartment is nice and stylish, the access is super easy and location is perfect.
The main problem for us was a party in an apartment next door - teens 16-20 years old.
At 11:30 pm we asked them to be a little bit more quiet but it didn’t really help. Ok, I have earplugs - didn’t want to argue.
Antonio was so helpful and the apartment was as described and very close walk to touristic areas such as patio bellavista. Thank you Antonio

fantastic apt in central Providencia. Simple and uncluttered was perfect for a business trip. Fantastically fast wifi too. Nice terrace and was just super clean. Erika his assistant is on site most days. great for single or a couple travelling. would highly recommend it and def would stay again which I porbably will. it's on a lower floor so if you wnat a city view may not be to your liking but it felt much more quiet and private than higher up. Have absolutely no complaints. Nice building and staff.. great location and like I said super simple and uncluttered which made it feel big for a one bedroom. apt. loved it
The place was great !. The host were so lovely and it’s situated in a good location, close to eveything.

This is an awesome apartment! It's on the 8th floor so you get a nice view of Santiago. The building and the apartment itself are clean and well-maintained. Neat location too, close to many of the main spots in the city. Recommended. 👍🏼

10/10, will stay again.
Lovely place for two people who are close but wish to have separate bedrooms and bathrooms. Great views and in a location no more than a 15-20 minute Uber to wherever you are trying to go in the city. We did not Uber to/from the airport so that may be longer than 20 minutes. There is a metro stop and a grocery store within easy walking distance.
Carla and Matias were excellent hosts, they were quick to respond and treated us as though we were all lifelong friends. They exemplify the Chilean spirit that makes this country so special.
There is a Peruvian restaurant a short walk away called Entre Mar y Tierra (as though one comes to Chile to eat Peruvian food…), their Duo Marino is one of the most delicious things I have ever eaten. Don’t try to eat it all by yourself though.
Great place to stay in Santiago, close the the metro, really safe area and very walkable!! We would stay here again!!
Eleonora is very kind and was patient with our schedule changes. The place is beautifully put together and the location is great!
We were so happy with our stay. The host was extremely accommodating, very responsive and super friendly. We absolutely recommend staying here.

Nice, spacious, good looking, well equipped apartment with a nice view. Shared pool on the rooftop. We felt safe because of the concierge (had to take an early flight and the nightlife in Bellavista was still going). Would recommend to everyone.

Very nice apartment walking distance from the city center. We walked to many restaurants and parks, but if you don't feel like walking, the metro is 2 mins walking or you can get uber for cheap. The apartment has everything that you'd need for a short vacation, Valentina even left different sim cards in case you need 1.

Book this place immediately. A charming neighborhood, with a well appointed restaurant attached (did not disappoint with breakfast and dinner or cocktails). As you dine you will see neighbors walking their dogs or families with strollers. The actual room was well equipped and decorated complimented with  a serene garden view. The entire building was clearly well thought out with an emphasis on  design details that will keep you intrigued. Overall a great stay in Las Condes, would definitely come back.
Very lovely place.  Beautiful house converted into apartments.   Very walkable neighborhood.  Super nice guest and we absolutely love the housekeeper Sarah.

I would recommand Boris's place. He is very responsive and gave us good restaurant suggestion.  The location of the place is excellent and walkable to bus and metro stations.  A very spacious apartment.
We had a great time at Gabriela’s place. The location is fantastic, lots to do walking distance, and the apartment is well equipped and comfortable.

Ruben’s place was absolutely one of the best AIRBNB places we stayed in. It has EVERYTHING. Ruben and his son David met us downstairs, helped to carry the luggage and then in minute details gave the information about EVERYTHING. They were extremely responsive, answered all our questions, and we felt very comfortable in their place. The location of the apartment is perfect - very close to the subway station. The AC units in every room were a blessing for the heat wave in  Santiago. To make the story short - book this apartment, it is a must!

Susan’s apartment is in the perfect location. Highly walkable for Lastarria, Bellavista, Bellas Artes and even Barrio Italia. It’s also directly next to the Bellas Artes metro station which makes exploring the city incredibly easy. We really enjoyed all of the restaurants nearby!
Susan was incredibly kind and helpful throughout our whole stay and allowed us to check in early so we could sleep after an overnight flight. I highly recommend staying here!

Beautiful place with impeccable style and very clean. The Jessica was very quick to communicate and we felt very taken care of. The apartment is close to shopping and restaurants and we walked to the big park nearby as well.

Great apartment in a wonderful location. The neighborhood has many places to walk to including restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and groceries. For a beautiful longer walk we enjoyed going to the Japanese Gardens.  Check in was easy. The building is well kept and has 24-hour security. The apartment itself has everything we needed for our week long stay. The view was beautiful with a cute balcony.

Bernabé was a great host - very helpful and always making sure that you were not in need of anything. The apartment was comfortable and as described. Easy walking distance to nearby restaurants and tourist sites. Thanks again Bernabé !

staying at Soledads was perfect for our short but nice Santiago visit. walking distance to plenty restaurants and neighborhood like Barro Italia. The rooftop space was a big bonus. overlooking pretty much the entire city.

Really lovely apartment in the center of Lastarria. Tons of cafés and restaurants within 1 block, plus the beautiful park, but the apartment is at the back of the building so remains peacefully quiet. The outdoor patio space is really nice if you need to do a bit of work and there's enough space for two people to spread out a bit. Building felt super secure and it was a breeze getting in and out every day. Would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting!

Excellent stay! Daniella was very flexible, and a great communicator.
We loved the comfortable space, fully equipped and overlooking the pretty yard.
Excellent location close to transport and amazing choice of restaurants and shopping g but yet a very peaceful spot!

Beautiful apartment with a beautiful view! Really great place to stay while exploring Santiago as it's only a short drive from the center and other popular attractions. Very remote work friendly too with fast internet and comfortable furniture. Rooftop pool was also fantastic on warm, sunny days. Pablo was very helpful and responsive throughout. Overall, would highly recommend staying here if you're visiting Santiago!

Manuel and his wife were very kind and informative. Manuel made sure I was at ease and offered asaistance if I needed help getting around. This is a great place to stay.
thank-you again julie😊

María Eugenia’s place is in a safe and perfect location, close to metro, shopping centres and restaurants. Apartment is clean and cozy. Has everything we needed. Maria Eugenia is very nice and quick responding hostess.
Would definitely stay at her place the next time we are in Chile.
very kind host made thr staying just like home. safe and clean. walking distance to the office.

This apartment is in a great location in the Italia Barrio of Santiago. It is very close to many restaurants and points of interest. The apartment is equipped with all necessities for a comfortable stay. The bed is comfortable and cozy with nice views. Recommend for a stay in Santiago!

We’ve just had a lovely few days at Camilo’s place. The place was even bigger than shown in the photos, and lots of art and personal character around the place. It would be a very comfortable place to stay for a longer trip. Lots of space including a cute outdoor courtyard. Camilo was helpful and responsive. Thanks for hosting us

This is my second stay with Susan and Mauricio, so that about says it all!  They are 2 of the kindest, most open airbnb hosts that I have ever met.  I had the great chance to meet both of them in person.  Their space is very welcoming and well-organized,  and the whole neighborhood has so many interesting walkable places to explore.  Be sure to check out Bocanariz, if you are a wine afficionado.  Truly superb food with all types of tasting flights.  I couldn't recommend this airbnb  more adamantly and confidently that I am doing.
Thank you for being such a responsive host. We enjoyed our stay and the nice apartment you have set up.

This apartment was perfect for what we needed. it was so perfect we extended our stay, not once but twice and ended up spending a month there. Felipe and Oliver were great and helped with all our requirements and requests. Thank you so much for having us.
Eugenio and Sofia were great, kind and responsive. I got to the city pretty late and they took the time to meet me and show me to the apt.

We had a lovely stay at Mabel’s! The place was comfortable and had lots of space for our group of five to relax and really enjoy our time in Santiago. Comfortable beds, solid location, and Mabel was responsive to all of our questions! She was also able to offer us a flexible check in time, which was truly appreciated given our very early arrival. Overall a wonderful stay and somewhere we would definitely recommend

We really really LOVED our stay at Cristobal’s appartment! It really had everything we could wish for: amazing view from the balcony, really well equiped kitchen, nice bed and shower, lovely neighbourhood with great restaurants, swimming pool… We spent a lot of time watching the streets and lights from the balcony :) Also Cristobal was a great and communicative host. One of the best airbnbs ever!!!
A great stay! I would totally recommend this. As Chilean and having travelled around a fair number of times with Airbnb I can tell Valentina's listing is a 5*.  Gracias!

Anita and husband Abraham made me feel so welcome. It was like home from home. We conversed at length on the facilities in the area and how to get to the central area. I would recommend this Airbnb option to anyone who wants a homely stay in Santiago. I hope I can visit them again.

Place is a studio apartment in the heart of metropolitan Santiago. We went for just the weekend not knowing everything is closed on the weekends. Also I hadn’t realized the apartment didn’t have air conditioning. The apartment is on the 21st floor so it was definitely hot as an oven in the. A small fan is provided but even still we had to sleep with the slider completely open at night to cool off. Other than that the stay was perfect.

We stayed at  Jose's place for a month (February). It was everything we wanted and we would have been happy to stay longer! from arrival to finish everything was perfect, and Jose was always responsive the couple of times we had a question. You can pretty much walk anywhere from the apartment in any direction to find literally 100s of restaurants, bars, parks, etc. and apartment is close to a main metro line and multiple buses that get you anywhere else you want to go. The apartment building is great, with friendly 24/7 front desk assistance. Finally, as the apartment is in the shade in the afternoon/evening we spent many an enjoyable evenings on the balcony enjoying the view of the Andes (and a glass of wine). Thank you, Jose, we hope to be back!

Good stay in Santiago. Apartment was small but fine for a quick visit.  Great location in central Santiago and within walking distance of main attractions. Check in was smooth and instructions worked well.

We truly loved our stay in Francisco’s home. The house itself is beautiful: stately, clean, comfortable, with fabulous artwork and furniture. The location is great! We walked to many places with ease and felt very safe. Francisco gave us recommendations on restaurants and we are happy to say we went to 3 of them and loved each one! We would definitely stay here again!

Ximena's place was just what we wanted, a comfortable and secure place within walking distances to eateries and places of interest as well as to a metro station.  I recommended her place to my family members who booked it for a date in April.  Thanks for everything, Ximena!

The location is excellent (5 mins from the metro station). The host introduced a lot of Chilian food to me and places to visit. The house is very clean and has a comfortable bed. Would 100% recommend to stay here if you visit Santiago.

We had a great time staying at Camilo’s place! The location was excellent for a lot of sightseeing and his recommendations for food were great. The space was so lovely we were always happy to return and sip wine or tea on the patio. We would definitely come back in the future!

Cristian always responded within minutes.  We asked for an accommodation to stay longer because our flight was late.  Cristian was flexible and accommodating.  The place was clean and beautiful.  The only downfall was the garbage pickup was early in the mornings. But that is not within Cristian's control.

Our stay with Camila was amazing. She was a wonderful host and so helpful with all our needs. Camila went above and beyond helping us when our flight to Buenos Aires was cancelled due to a strike.
I would highly recommend her apartment.
Thank you so much Camila 🥰😊
Second time at Aline's place between flights. Everything very good as before, definitely a great choice for Santiago.

Perfect location in the center of Providencia. Modern building with doormen.
The apartment was very well kept, welcoming, with all the little amenities.... including a nespresso machine! Pepe and Erika were very prompt to answer all my inquiries and helpful in arranging for early and late checking. I certainly would recommend their apartment and hope to stay there when I return to Santiago.

the apartments is situated right at the parks entrance perfect for a morning jog or bringing a dog as i did. the place is spotless clean and has all necessities provided! furthermore the beds are very comfortable and the windows have great curtains providing a good nights rest. i will definitely be back! thabks a lot!!!

Felipe's place was great. I stayed for two months. The one time there was an issue Felipe responded immediately. The apartment is clean and comfortable and safe and so well located. You won't regret staying here. I recommend it for short or long term stays.

Amazing place to stay in Lastarria. Beautiful space with everything that you need. Secure, walkable and smooth check in. The area is great for food, culture and nature. The host is very helpful and kind. I highly recommend this place. Thank you.

A fantastic place to have as a base for exploring Santiago. The area is full of great bars and restaurants.  The vibe is lively and invites you to join in. The accommodation is clean and comfortable and has everything you need for a great stay. Cristian is a great host and very helpful and responsive. Highly recommended.

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view! Gisella is a great host, she’s easy to communicate with and very accommodating! Apartment included all the essentials and it was very comfortable to stay at. Would stay here again next time I’m in Santiago!

Javier’s apartment was a fantastic option in Santiago. It’s close to many sights, restaurants, bars etc and has easy access to public transport.  The views are wonderful and the balcony is a very special spot to eat breakfast or enjoy a glass of wine. WiFi worked great. Javier was a great host with good, prompt and proactive communication. While it was a bit warm (no AC but a standing fan) with windows closed and a bit noisy with windows open, these were minimal inconveniences for the benefit of a great affordable place to stay in a fabulous location.
Honestly one of the best places we’ve stayed in South America. Beautiful flat with amazing panoramic views, a great pool and washing machines that were easily accessible. We had a fantastic time.

Edgar David's place in Providencia is located on top of the Manuel Montt metro and very walkable as well.
LOTS of places to eat of every variety within a blocks as well as a small grocer and farmacias. The pool is nice and he let's you know lounge chairs are first come first serve. While there is no view as stated, lots of natural light without the heat. AC worked great as well as opening the patio door. Looks exactly as the photos. Bed is comfortable, lots of hot water and pressure. Bath and shower.
It is across from the elevators and trash room, so some hallway noise but not all the time or disruptive - just FYI.
I would book again when in Santiago. Highly recommend.

Susan's apartment is in a perfect spot. It's in a quiet street lined with trees and very good breakfast cafes are right across the street. And it's perfectly situated in Lastaria bordering Bellavista. It's also very sunny (which can get hot in the summer). There's a vintage feel to the place, so don't expect the newest fixtures but that's part of its charm.

Jessica was outstanding. I began to think that Jessica was AI generated as she was always exceptionally responsive. You can teel that she knows the business and delivers like a true professional. We lacked for nothing. I only wished that we could've stayed longer. Thanks so much Jessica!!!!

I spent just a day in Santiago and Camila’s place was the perfect spot for an overnight stay in the city. It is central to the hip and trendy neighborhoods and walkable.
In addition, Camila was responsive to any questions (Diego as well). Thank you!

The apartment is amazing. Well located.
Luis is super nice - always helped whatever was needed and super attentive

Paz is a gem of a person. Stayed here for a month, felt right at home. She was always responsive, very caring and proactive. Location is super nice and quiet and close to pretty much everything you need. Definitely going to stay here whenever I’m back in Chile.

His place is convinetnly located in the center of Santiago. Santa lucia Hill, Plaza de Armas Central Market Bellavista are all walking distance or only few stops away via bus or metro.
It is a great to place to enjoy bustling Santiago neighbourhood.

The apartment is absolutely amazing - clean, safe and secure, and in an amazing neighbourhood close to really cool restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Also very close to bus and metro links. Amazing hosting and very flexible with our check out and dates when our plans changed. Cannot recommend highly enough.

Place was as described, great location. Unfortunately when we arrived we saw the bathroom was clogged and had some flooding, which had to be fixed. However, Orlando was very communicative and he got the plumbers to fix the problem during the very same day. He also sent someone to clean as we requested

Great cozy apartment in a great location. The apartment was clean and had everything for a comfortable stay. The Checkin process was easy too. Matias always responded to messages and was helpful. Has shops and restaurants closeby. highly recommend.

This was an excellent apartment with all the amenities exactly as described.  the kitchen is fully equipped for cooking.  The neighborhood has many options for restaurants, bars, and cafes and the apartment is in a great location, walking distance to two metro stops on two different metro lines.  Christian is an excellent and responsive host.  I experienced a minor mantainenece issue during my stay but Christian took care of it very quickly and completely.  would definitely recommend and stay again in the future!

I really liked this place. It different than all the same condos out there. Decor and spaciousness is amazing. It has its issues as mentioned in past reviews but it wasn’t a big deal for me. Very cool, lively area. I would recommend for the right people.
The view from this place was incredible! It was super clean and José Antonio made sure I had everything that I needed. Great stay!

Camila and her brother made us feel at home and were very friendly and supportive! The location of the apartment is perfect to explore Santiago and right next by the metro line 1. Thank you for having us :)

She was absolutely wonderful to work with! She was proactive in ensuring we had a fun stay and was a tremendous help coordinating transportation to and from the airport.
I’m trying to learn Spanish and she was patient with me and helped me along the way. She was very gracious.
She is very proud of the place (and should be!) and did everything she could to ensure our stay was great!
This apartment is very convenient and location is perfect. Jose was very helpful and gave good suggestions and responded very fast.

Cristián’s apartment was the perfect location in the hip, bohemian Barrio Lastarria. Great neighborhood with a lot of great restaurants, cafes, bars, etc right outside the apartment complex. Very central to many sights in Santiago! The apartment is located on the 1st floor with a very nice patio just for 1st floor residents. Although the neighborhood has a very lively nightlife the apartment is relatively quiet because it is located at the back of the building away from the street. It is nicely decorated with lots of natural light. The bed is very comfortable and it was nice to have Netflix after camping and bike touring in Patagonia for 2 months. The fan and opening the sliding glass doors made it a good temperature for sleeping. Nice modern kitchen with everything you need. We would stay here again!!!

This place was perfect for a few days in Santiago!  The neighborhood has plenty to do- cafes right on the street for breakfast/coffee as well as restaurants and walkable to Santa Lucia Hill.  It was warm inside since we came in the summer, but between opening the windows, using the fan, and enjoying the patio- we were comfortable!  Susan Andrea and her partner met us upon check-in right outside and it was very easy.  I would recommend this place to someone who wants to be close to the Bellas Artes & Lastarria neighborhoods- it was perfect!

It could not have been closer to great restaurants and activities. The beds were comfortable and the place was in the best condition of any air bnb I have been to. The neighborhood is very busy, but it never felt unsafe.

Francisca was a great host! She was super responsive and accommodating. She provided lots of great restaurant recommendations and things to do. The flat is spotless and beautifully decorated. It was the perfect location for us! So grateful 🎉
Location is good - next to Baro Italia a lot of restaurants, super markets, gym. The apartment is quite and clean
Ronaldo's apartment was exactly how it was described and check in was very easy. The location is great, near restaurants, coffee shops, shopping and the metro. Overall a great value!

One of the best airbnbs I’ve stayed in during my travels! Soooo clean, and very modern. It’s also located in a perfect location in Santiago close to great restaurants and coffee shops. So great—I actually will be returning soon!
Beautiful apartment and great location! Eleanora was very responsive and helpful. Thanks for a great stay!

The stay at Alvaros flat was great. the flat was modern and spacious, with a great view. Alvaro was very helpful and fast to respond, and the check in process with the concierge was very easy. we also hired a car and used secure parking at the apartment, which was a very easy process. The rooftop pool was fantastic and the rooftop had a lovely, friendly feel on our Saturday night stay!
Clara was the best host; flexible, friendly, and available. Her apartment is perfect for a short-term stay in Santiago; the neighborhood is leafy and gorgeous, with restaurants all over.

It was a beautiful apartment, with a great view, and great location.  It was well decorated, provided everything you needed and more.  Host was very responsive, proactive and had always asked if there was anything we needed on a daily basis.   We really enjoyed our stay.
Excellent apartment in a great area of Santiago. Close to metro and close to excellent bars and restaurants. Christian explained check in and was always on hand for any help needed! 10/10 stay.

This place is simply amazing. It's super clean, beautiful design and decoration. The shower is awesome and the bed is very comfy and has hotel quality linens.
The hosts are incredibly sweet people. I'll definitely stay again next year.

Our stay at Antonio’s was great!  We loved the rooftop patio. The apartment had everything that we needed and was very close to everywhere we needed to get in the city. Thanks, Antonio for everything!!

Beautiful little apartment with a balcony that has a view of the sunrise over the mountains! Well fitted out, feels like you're living in a home away from home :) the area is very peaceful and it's nice to be away from the noise of the city.
Great location, comfortable bed, hot water, spacious, clean.  Bath does not work ie no plug is available.   Would definitely stay again.

Truly a perfect location in Santiago. The neighborhood is lively (but apartment remains mostly quiet!) and there is lots of stuff within walking distance ! The inside is beautiful as well. I would definitely come back here !

This is the best place in town, it is very cozy and beatiful. The whole flat ist ful of art and we really felt at home. The room is nice and quiet.
Hector is the nicest host. He is very helpful, friendly and attentive. But also he gives you privacy. We really made a friend here.
Amazing style! We had a gorgeous stay in a very safe and walkable neighborhood. I couldn’t have asked for better. I am so thankful for this experience.

Nice place to stay in Santiago!
Bellavista is a good place to go out by night but very noisy in the flat until 6am, its surrounded by night clubs ! Be careful if you’re looking for quiet time!
Very clean and beautiful design in the flat and building

We had a great time at German's place! The view was really spectacular and the location was really good, close to restaurants, supermarket, and the park.
We only missed some little things like towel hooks in the bathroom and some more utensils in the kitchen.
In any way, it was an excellent stay and we'd stay there again.
Great place to stay! Awesome location and nice building manager. It’s not super touristy so you get a feel for the neighborhood. Going back!
Miguel was very helpful always. The place is very small but beautiful and very clean.  We felt very secure.

We very much enjoyed our stay in Ximena's comfortable flat, especially the chance to sit on the balcony. Everything went to plan. My only word regarding the location would be that it is lively, alternative and busy. This may not suit everyone but we were perfectly happy with it.

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at this place. There was everything I needed to make my time there feel like home. It’s in a super safe building with a 24 hour doorman. Check in was quick and easy, Gisele communicated perfectly, I wouldn’t ask for anything more. Highly recommended.

A perfect place to stay in Santiago and a perfect host too. Susan Andrea is one of the best hosts I have encountered in 50 Airbnb stays. Totally responsive and helpful with any of my requests. The apartment is beautiful and sunny. A very comfortable bed, a nice shower, easy check in with her, good Wifi, a good elevator, a safe and convenient neighborhood with a short walk to the Lastarria neighborhood with loads of restaurants and bars. I highly recommend staying with Susan

I stayed in Pamela's apartment for well over 2 months. I would stay there again, when back in Santiago. The apartment felt like home from the very first day. It has everything you might need for a shorter or a longer stay. Pamela is a very kind-hearted, welcoming host.

Had a great stay! Fantastic location and place was as described on Airbnb. Had a small issue with the shower head and Jose responded straight away with how to fix it. Good value. Amongst all the restaurants and near the metro.

The room was exactly as described, and Camila was super nice and kind with us, answering all of our questions about Santiago and Chile in general.
Also, there is a vegan place just downstairs, which was fantastic.
Loved the home, felt at ease and was so close to so many amazing restaurants, attractions and shops.  Hosts were very responsive and friendly.  Loved the home, neighborhood and Santiago!

We really liked staying with Valentina! The view from the apartment is fantastic! Valentina was also very helpful about communicating about the apartment and also making sure we had everything we needed. We would stay here again :)

We enjoyed our stay at Victoria's Santiago apartment. She was attentive and friendly. The internet worked well., The hot water and water pressure were great, and the sunrise view from the bedroom was breathtaking. The unique decor added to the experience. The building staff were friendly, and the location was perfect for dining and entertainment.
The kitchen could do with a little maintenance, some equipment wasn't clean, and the towels and bedding could be replaced.
Also to note that being on a main road with constant hum of the city.
Despite this, we had a pleasant stay. Thank you for hosting us!"

This was a very convenient location with a spectacular view. A very comfortable space, with an attention to details: thick and plush pillows, quality toilet paper, and a strong fan for if you’re hot. It was secure and an absolute pleasure to stay there.
If you can handle 3 levels of gated security as well as horrendous acoustics in the building, the rest is the charm.
My stay was short but great. Very close to the metro station, many restaurants and convenience stores in the area. The space is small, it’s just one room but it’s cozy and enough for a quick trip.

Very clean space with easy access and well located. Place looks exactly like the pictures and host was very responsive and helpful with information about the city, location, checkin. Overall very good experience

I liked it a lot. It's 2 blocks from Costanera Center.
The service was great.
I just needed to cook for my daughter, and there was no stove during our stay. They did let me use another apartment to cook though. They were very very nice.
The place is a bit dated, I stayed at another one of their properties a while back and it was far superior for only about 20 usd more.
However, I still highly recommend this place.
An easy location to be based out of for our explorations in Santiago, walking distance to many destinations!

Maritza's place is perfect. unfortunately I could stay there only for one night and Maritza was very understanding of my situation. The apartment is exactly at it looks in pictures, very clean and in a nice and safe area of Santiago. I have been in other airbnbs in Santiago and can definitely say this is the best!

What a beautiful Airbnb! Francisco is the most gracious host. He was there to greet us at the Airbnb when our flight came in early. He is very responsive to questions and left a list of restaurants to try. The house is very spacious. The beds and linen were super comfortable and there were tons of hangers in the closet to hang up our clothes. It’s felt very centrally located. We easily walked to Lastarria, Bellavista, and Barrio Italia. Highly recommend!

great location.
good showers
nice view
excellent for 4 people. sofa bed not comfortable for a 5th person
militar school is right downstairs so they jog and sing loudly at six am, just be aware of that. other than that it's a great place and location

This is my home away from home in Santiago. My second but not my last stay here. Edgar David has a number of apartments and he's a great host. Very helpful, responsive and goes above and beyond in answering questions re local happenings, places to eat etc. Highly recommend him as a host and any of his locations. This is one of my favs!
Well stocked and clean apartment with gorgeous view of the the financial district and surrounding hills. Location couldn’t be better with easy access to two metro lines.

It was all good as described. The host is responsive and described the apartment well. They don't have many tools for the kitchen and it feels like the whole place is a little bit worn but well, that's okay for a couple of nights.

"Staying at this apartment was an absolute delight! From the moment we stepped inside, we were greeted with stylish decor, impeccable cleanliness, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. The host's attention to detail was evident in every corner, from the cozy bedding to the well-equipped kitchen. The location couldn't have been better, with easy access to all the attractions and amenities we desired. Plus, the breathtaking views from the balcony added an extra touch of magic to our stay. Communication with the Pablo was seamless, and he went above and beyond to ensure our comfort throughout our visit. Without a doubt, this apartment exceeded our expectations in every way, making our trip truly unforgettable. I am returning to chile in a few months and will returning to this airbnb.

Rosario was super helpful, giving us all the info we needed to get there easily and always shooting back fast answers to our questions. The place was just right clean, easy to get to, and the metro was very close. It was a lively spot by day, and even though the locals suggested keeping it close to home after dark, we ventured out at night without a hitch.
The apartment has a great location and amazing views! Alvaro was helpful throughout and always quick to respond to any questions. I would definitely recommend booking this Airbnb.
Gerardo was very pleasant and responsive. The unit was clean, well maintained and comfortable. Can't go wrong in renting from Gerardo.
A fantastic clean place next to parque arauco and the mall. Loved the short term stay at this place.

Jonathan was an amazing host! He truly went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable. His place was impeccably clean, cute, and cozy - I felt right at home. Jonathan was extremely friendly and welcoming, making me feel like a friend rather than just a guest. Truly the best host ever!

My partner and I had a really lovely two night stay at Gisela's cute little accommodation in her absolutely dreamy and relaxing garden. The Airbnb is on a quiet street and is a pretty quick walk to Barrio Italia. Gisela and her two sweet older golden retrievers welcomed us and we enjoyed coffees and good conversation in the garden. Gisela provided some great recommendations for places to check out, and was also very quick to help when we experienced a major flight delay and needed help contacting our rental car company. We loved everything about our stay at Gisela's and would have loved to stay longer at her special place.
We enjoyed our stay at Francisca's. The place was as described and we would stay there again.
i would go back. I loved the location and all the restaurants and everything was in walk able  distance.

It was noisy because of the dogs barking and fire station being very close, but we survived. The most disappointing was communication. Host communicated good at the beginning but later for some reason started talking in passive aggressive tone.
Great location, good WiFi, tv and comfy bed. Some stains on walls and a smell at times from the bathroom. Overall I would recommend!
Claudia’s place is excellent place for solo travelers, it was everything you need for exploring Santiago on a walking distance. Great location,
Loved our stay here! Very nice and helpful hosts! Room is a bit small, especially the shower, but for the price it’s really good. Very clean, great location. Would recommend!

Great stay at this apartment in Providencia. Very close to the metro station and lots of bars and restaurants close by.
We didn’t have any issues with the QR code to get into the building.
Po Wen communicated throughout our stay to make sure everything was ok.
Overall a great Airbnb.
Good place for a few nights in the centre of Santiago. Small space but if you’re only there a few nights it’s fine. Pretty comfortable and affordable stay overall

Jessica's place is stunning: so well decorated, such a beautiful view and such a great location. shower was great pressure and heat, kitchen is fully equipped and has everything to cook a meal just like at home. I 100% recommend Jessica's place

I had an absolutely wonderful experience staying at this Airbnb. The place was perfect in every way – impeccably clean, recently renovated, and beautifully maintained. The location couldn’t have been better; it was incredibly walkable and surrounded by a plethora of restaurants, shops, and exciting things to do. Whether I was exploring the local cuisine or wandering through charming boutiques, there was always something new to discover just steps away from the apartment. However, the only downside was the internet connection. Despite this minor inconvenience, I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a fantastic stay in the heart of the city.

I had stayed 6 nights in Centro but I needed to extend my stay and I couldn’t. So glad I moved to Said’s.. barrio Yungay is great - good restaurants and fantastic street art as well as the Memory Museum.
The flat is super modern and is very international in style with a good shower. Personally I prefer grungy and character but that isn’t the owner’s fault. The building is a labyrinth. Beware lifts that go to building sites - just use the main entrance lift. The swimming pool is very cold.

Camilo is a great host, nice, flexible and very responsive. The apartment and hallway are full of cool art. Very close to a lot of restaurants. It's not as bright as in the photos but the apartment is very nice.

I’ve been using Airbnb and similar services A LOT for the past 7 - 8 years, and Maria Jose is BY FAR one of the best, if not the best, host I’ve ever met. I don’t have much else to say, except that I highly recommend her place!
Super clean, everything was walkable distance, near metro… she was always in communication. Great place and service!
Gisela was an excellent host and the area was great! Some minor hiccups with checking out but overall the sweetest and best stay of our trip

We enjoyed staying at Adriana’s place.
It is like our home in Santiago to visit familiar cafe and restaurants nearby. Grocery store is just next door.
Midori

The apartment is in busy Providencia, an upper-class area in Santiago with restaurants, bars, and many businesses. Everything is nearby and convenient. Marcela’s building has a distinct advantage - it’s on a small side street between the major arteries of Providencia, so unusually peaceful. The apartment is also on the 17th floor, away from street noise. The apartment itself is clean with everything you need for short or longer-term stays. The bed was too soft for me, but that’s a matter of preference. Hot water works well and there’s a great balcony to look out over the city.
The location is amazing and hosts are super responsive and helpful. Looking forward to the next trip to Santiago after such a great stay! Thank you, Pablo.

The apartment is right out of central casting.  It's a third-floor walk-up that's somewhere between modern and cosy.  It's a 5-10 minute walk from dozens of restaurants, a big park, museums, the subway, everything.  And yet it's on a quiet street where you hear almost none of the city after 10 at night.  The co-host, Claudia, is super accommodating.  Our flight was delayed almost 4 hours, and yet she still met us right as we pulled up to the door.  After a horrible travel day, she made everything turn out right.

Danila was an incredible host since day one. Quick response, very professional and always tried to help.
The flat it's in an incredible location. Just 2min away from the tube and a great Shopping Centre where you can find everything you need
Also, the flat is very well equipped, comfortable, it was pretty clean and Daniela such an amazing host. thought in even the most smallest details.
fully recommend to stay here!

Francisca was very welcoming and the apartment was beautifully decorated. It is easy distance from some of the cities main attractions and restaurants.
There were noisy neighbours partying downstairs but otherwise our stay was perfect.
Very nice apartment with a great view on the mountains and the city. Good location, especially for those who like walking.

Our stay was absolutely fantastic, we couldn’t have wished for a better place to stay! The highlights were the rooftop pool and watching the sunset from the balkony. Also an extremely friendly host - thank you, Po! :)

Jaw dropping VIEWS! This was the perfect Airbnb! The balcony and the views were the icing on the cake. The neighborhood was chic with great walking, shopping, restaurants and everything you could want. The host was always responsive and he went above and beyond to make my stay perfect. This was a great place to work, explore and just take in the wonderful city of Santiago! Great amenities and perfectly located building:)

Such a beautiful accommodation! Mabel met us late at night when we checked in and made us feel right at home. The place was so cozy and beautifully curated. We loved the location - walkable to restaurants and the city. It also felt very safe.
Mabel was also very attentive and responsive. She gave us extra amenities upon request. Would 100% recommend!

The time we spent at Jose and Veronica's home was lovely. It is right in the heart of Santiago with many fun and vibrant things to do. Museum, restaurants, bars, music. Upon check-in Veronica and Jose had clear directions and were very responsive and willing to answer any questions we had. The house was tidy and ready for our stay. We loved their apartment and would recommend anyone to stay and enjoy their time there.
Thank you for an amazing stay! We hope we can go back another time.
Awesome location. Couldn’t get better. Loved the apartment. If you are a mega sensitive sleeper  the clubs close by are noisy but we slept fine and had a great time.
great location.  Public transportation very close.  The hosts were amazing and very accommodating.  Worth the price.  Walking distance to many restaurants and downtown.

We had a great stay at Gustavo apartment. It is very well located, the building is secure and very close to buses and metro. The apartment is very clean and the kitchen is well equipped. Gustavo is a great host. Highly recommended
Perfect acommodation in good location close to the airport. Great for overnight transfers. Host was nice, definitely recommend!

The flat was beautiful and clean, situated in the center in a very safe neighborhood.
I'd stay there again.
Jose was very responsive and helpful as well

We had a wonderful stay in Cristian’s apartment! It was very clean and perfectly spacious for two people! It was also a good location to all the things we wanted to do around town. We especially appreciated the self check in so that we could be flexible in when we arrived. And his instructions on how to enter the apartment were very detailed making the check in process stress free. The building also has front desk security which we really appreciated. I would highly recommend this apartment if you’re traveling in and around Santiago.
A Gem! You have to stay here, one of a kind not to be missed experience, 26th Floor Penthouse with amazing views, great jacuzzi and an insightful caring host 10 out of 10!

Lovely stay at Casa twice. Very comfortable, super clean and amazing value. Alexis is an amazing host and was always there to help or offer recommendations. The apartment is well located, in 20 minutes you can walk to the Plaza de Armas and it is a 5 minute max walk to the metro which will take you to most places in Santiago.
We really enjoyed Juan’s hospitality and helping us when we came in late. He’s a wonderful host, highly recommend!

Highly recommend to anyone, great central location and felt safe. Apartment has everything needed and has a lovely balcony which has a nice view of the mountains which the sun sets behind. Adrian is a great host, very good with communication and happy to answer any questions needed, even let us check in hours before the scheduled time because the apartment was ready. 10/10

Fantastic location, beautiful apartment and great communication from the host! Thanks very much for having us, Borealis. One small tip is that the kitchen table and chairs have some bolts missing so they’re a bit unstable. Otherwise a perfect stay

We really enjoyed our stay at Osvaldo’s beautiful loft - it’s very nicely decorated, has all the amenities you need and is spacious and comfortable. The location is great - close to everything and walkable. As mentioned in other reviews, it can indeed get quite loud on weekend nights so be prepared for that (earplugs / headphones did the job for us).

The home is 3 times nicer than the photos. Anita and her husband are very welcoming. It is like coming back to your parents and grandparents home. They invited me to eat with them when they had friends gathering. Appreciate the Chilean hospitality.
Located in a super safe area, with very good service and almost everything you need for short term stays, I will recommend this nice apartment to everyone who comes to Chile.
The place was perfect for two people! Clean and tidy. My husband and I felt right at home. Thank you for hosting us again!
We had a great stay ! The apartment was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. The location is perfect, everything is a walkable distance and there’s many restaurants / bars nearby.

Honestly, this place exceeded my high expectations. I enjoyed the gym, direct access to laundry in building (conveniently across the hall), the self check in, doorman, and ultimately, the rooftop infinity pool! The photos do not do this place justice. Checkin was easy, the place was immaculate, and had finishing touches that were hotel grade. The massage chair was an incredible way to relax and I felt very secure, safe, and productive here. Highly recommend for rest, relaxation, or work!

Unbeatable location! Walkable and safe. Has everything needed for a comfortable stay. Bernabe is a great host, respectful, kind and helpful. He went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Airport ride and a tour to Valparaiso are just some of the perks. Thank you, Bernabe 😊
Great place to stay in a good central and safe location. The hosts are very nice and accommodating. Thank you for everything :)
We loved our stay in Santiago! The apartment is in the perfect location with lots of restaurants and bars. Would stay again if coming back to Santiago
Clean comfy room. Very secure through the concierge at the entrance.Everything you need. would recommend

Even I did not meet German this time (he was out of the country), we were in touch thru e-mails and always he was ready to help me to fix minors problems. This was my second year that I stay at German' place because of the excellent location near the Metro and supermarkets.

We were lucky to find this gem for our first trip to Santiago! The apartment is charming, much larger than it looks in the photos, and clean and comfortable. We loved spending evenings on the patio with a glass of wine. The neighborhood and nearby restaurants and bars were wonderful and Barrio Italia was our favorite area of the trip. Hope to return sometime soon!
This was a very nice and convenient place close to Providencia shopping and dining and the metro. the area is safe to walk around, but it is also a very busy area and lively.

The place was very comfortable and in a fabulous location we would never have thought to explore. Very happy we were here instead of in the central/downtown area! It is smaller than the photos make it seem, and the pool is only in sunlight in the AM, otherwise very cozy stay and host was very responsive!

This is a really nice apartment in the beautiful Providencia neighborhood at a very reasonable price. It is perhaps not the largest or most modern in its furnishing -- but this is not a complaint, it was exactly what I was looking for.
Super close to the metro, easy check-in, walkable neighborhood, nice views. Highly recommended for a visit to Santiago!
The location is very near to metro and Jeka hosted me very nicely and also helped of any issue, so highly recommended, thanks for everything:) Jeka

The place is very good matches the pictures. It has some downsides. Only one bathroom with a very small shower box. The sofa in the living room is very small and not comfortable, so I missed having a better place to relax after a long day of walking. It can be a bit noise during the day and early evening- but it is quite in the night. We missed having air conditioning as we went in a very hot time of the year. Apart from that, all was very good
Terrible host did  deals with criminals were stolen credit card one contacted host for help or information posted. Nothing about it.
It was a very comfortable place for us as a family with a toddler, safe and close to supermarkets, mall and parks . The communciation with Mabel was very good and i highly recommend this place
We’ve stayed here before. Great location. Simple housing, but clean and easy check in, etc. close to so many things to do. Recommended for the value.

House is beautiful, just like the photos. Was cozy and had everything we needed for our family stay. We really enjoyed spending a little time on the terrace. Francisco was super responsive and so helpful. We enjoyed the neighborhood and walked to many places. Just a note - there are a lot of stairs!  Not an issue for us, but if you have trouble with stairs not the place for you. Otherwise would definitely recommend for your stay!

Fantastic apartment with great view. Very quiet. Lots of restaurants, bars, and cafes within walking distance, and the heart of the city is easily accessible by the Metro. Gabriel was always very prompt and helpful in responding.
Highly recommend. Apartment is fantastic with beautiful views of the city. Location is excellent and in walking distance of many restaurants, shops and mall. Pablo is a helpful and responsive host

I only stayed two nights, but really enjoyed the brief time I had in the apartment. Nelson and Valentina were quick to respond, the apartment was clean, the kitchen had utensils/equipment, the shower was hot, and the bed was comfortable. I especially liked hanging out on the balcony. The AC only seemed to cool down the living room and kitchen, but that's my only negative. There is a large window in the bedroom for air circulation if needed. Overall, I would recommend!
When thinking of visiting Santiago this is the place you want!! It’s in a hip, walkable neighborhood with plenty of dining options, street fairs, and things to do. Did not disappoint!!

If you’re considering a visit to Santiago for a few days, I wholeheartedly recommend Natalia’s exquisite accommodation. Not only does it boast exceptional accessibility, but it also radiates warmth with its abundant natural light, creating a cozy atmosphere. And the last but not least Natalia’s unmatched hospitality, which truly enhances the overall experience.
Great location and well furnished apartment. The only point to improve is the air conditioning, it makes the room extremely dry and cold. It is hard to adjust to a good temperature.
Mabel is a very kind and responsive host. The place matches the description and photos, and we were very comfortable here. Thanks, Mabel!

Great location with lots of restaurants and sites in walking distance. Apartment is cosy with all the basic amenities. Kitchen equipped with very basic items, so you wouldn’t want to be cooking anything too extravagant. Check-in was super quick and easy, and Christián was very helpful and quick to respond

Brand new place which has everything you need to live. Spotless with a beautiful view and all facilities you would need.
Major issue for me was it didn’t have WiFi even though the listing said it did.
Isabel's flat was comfortable and looked like the photos. The apartment was located within an area of  multiple high rise flats which made it noisy at times.

Incredibly friendly and welcoming hosts. Even let us store our bags in their office until our flight so we could enjoy our final day in Santiago.
Thank you!

Maritza’s place is very close to public transport (metro and busses), also walking distance from many attractions in the historic city center. Her place is a bit small, and some furniture has signs of wear. Especially kitchen utensils need replacing (pans are sticking, knives dull etc). In the first day, the floor was very dusty. We reached out to her and she explained that could be the dust as Santiago has pollution problem and immediately arranged cleaning next day. She is a very responsible and proactive host. Communication was very fast. Internet speed was great, the apartment has facilities like 24h open reception, small gym and paid laundromat. On 25th floor, there is a common terrace with amazing views, especially during sunset. So overall I think her place is great if you plan to stay in Santiago couple of days, but if you plan to cook and would like to feel at home, maybe not the best option.
Very lovely apartment with a beautiful view. Maria was very helpful with checking and out. Would recommend this place and will be back again!

Golfo’ apartment in Providencia is located in a nice and silent area, surrounded by all kinds of services and very close to the subway station. Despite que great location, the place is silent and private, with a breathtaking view to the Cordillera. There is a 24/7 doorman service and we even had a chance to enjoy the swimming pool area, quite pleasant in a sunny day. We recommend it for a short or longer stay in Santiago

Great location and Antonio was super responsive. The beds were very tidy (which is most important), though the space could use a deep clean. Santiago can be hot and there is no A/C, so if that is important to you, check the forecast. Antonio provides a fan for each room which is helpful!
The rooftop patio is STUNNING. You have a nearly 360 view of Santiago and the surrounding mountain ranges to enjoy a sunrise or sunset from. Don't miss on this!
An easy walk into the Bella Vista community and an nice stroll to the center, including the super fun Lastarria neighbourhood.
Thanks Antonio for a great stay.

This is a great place to stay if you want to relax for a couple of days. The apartments are clean and modern and the building has a loting facilities. Nearby you can find good gyms a nice park to run to. The neighbourhood feels very safe and also has lots of restaurants. The staff at the frontdesk are very nice and always prepareren to help and assist. We would definitely recommend staying here.

We really liked this apartment. It's nice to open up all the blinds and get so much natural light. There is also an air conditioner, which is a plus. Internet is very fast. I tested the download and upload speeds and both exceeded 600 mbps. It's a first floor unit, so getting in and out was easy. The unit has a nice little outdoor area that's semi-private. It's not out on the main road. There is somebody at the front gate 24/7, so it's really safe and check in was easy. Google maps gets you straight to the front door. The location is great. As soon as you walk about of the front gate, there are coffee shops and restaurants everywhere. Everything was clean and well organized. Highly recommend.

A beautiful apartment with fantastic hosts. The apartment is located within walking distance of the city centre where you will find everything you could need. It is also close to the many stunning walks and views of Parque Metropolitano de Santiago. The apartment is setup well for long or short stays with great wifi, water pressure/temperature, a fully stocked kitchen, comfortable bed and a large desk. The hosts are extremely helpful and the reception staff in the building are really friendly. As if that wasn't enough the view from the apartment is simply breathtaking. Waking up to the sunrise every morning was the perfect way to start the day.
Best place i stayed in Santiago. Very clean. Comfortable furniture. Nice view and safe building. I would definitely recommend
Had a great stay here for my birthday ! The views are the real winner for me! Absolutely stunning. And a great area to walk around and access any necessities.
Great location with metro nearby and good restaurants. Bocanariz was my favorite spot for food and wine/drinks. Apartment is good for solo or couple travel.

Gustavo's apartment was clean and lovely, in the centre and walkable. Check in was easy and we were greeted by a co host who explained every thing. Gustavo was quick in responding to all our questions and helped us in everything we required.
All the important sites were about 15-20minutes walk.
We came by an airport taxi which cost $24 and returned by Uber which cost $20.
comfortable stay, Claudia is a great host. very quiet, we were able to do laundry for a small fee and enjoyed meeting the cats 🙂 would recommend!

Perfect apartment in the city. Super clean, well-equipped, and awesome location. We loved the huge windows and the balcony, and while some people have noted the noise from the street, this was not a problem at all for us. Check-in/out was easy. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Santiago!
Valentina was a great host who communicated very well and helped us with any queries, the apartment is fully equipped and is centrally located. The small balcony was also a plus!

It was a beautiful AirBnb in a very nice and safe location.
Pablo was fantastic, and allowed us to drop our luggage early when we had an early flight. He was also very responsive on all our needs throughout our stay.
Would highly recommend and would love to stay here again!

Perfect location among all the delicious bars and restaurants — what a fun place to stay for couples! The unit was surprisingly quiet given proximity to nightlife, so we enjoyed the stay! We will plan to stay again if we return to Chile.

Great home.  Located close to all Santiago has to do.  We enjoyed a few glasses of wine on the terrace and the old architecture.  The home is equipped with black out blinds which was nice especially if you have jet lag.  We will stay here again next time for sure. 👍

Very nice, clean and peaceful appartment which is located in the middle of Lastarria barrio ( very lively, safe area and with very good restaurants around). Claudia was really professional and ensured that our check in went smoothly and also shared with us many local tips to discover Santiago. Definitely a good place to stay in Santiago.
Thank you for a wonderful stay, Lazaro & his team wee great. The apartment was perfect, the neighborhood was beautiful. We hope to come back soon😍

Second time here, the apartment is very well put together and the bed is probably the most comfy one I ever slept in. Will definitely choose it again if it's available when I visit Santiago next time.
20mins from the airport, in a safe and nice location. Clean apartment and had everything you need. Would recommend!
Our stay was exactly as we were hoping for. Very clean, well maintained and easy access in and out.  Definitely recommend!

This is a great apartment, the location is perfect and it has everything you could need. The host is really friendly and communication and check in was easy. I will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Santiago. Thanks for a great stay :)

The place is safe and well maintained in a beautiful neighborhood. Unfortunately we did not stay in the loft we booked over a week in advance. Upon arrival we were put in another room - after discussing with the host we were able to get a price adjustment which we appreciated. The staff were helpful finding solutions once we asked for it but we were a bit frustrated that there was no communication prior to arrival that our space had been occupied by another guest and we would have to downgrade from loft to apartment. We felt the apartment was great overall but were very uncomfortable with how the host handled the situation from the beginning.
We loved our stay! The place was beautiful, the view is amazing, would return any time. The neighbours are loud, though and watch TV late at night
nice apartment ! all I needed for a break from hostels. Oliver was responsive and helpful. good value
Great location for exploring best neighborhoods in Santiago.  Bernabé is so helpful and kind!  He always checks to see if you understand and are happy.
Everything was good for our stay. The checkin was easy and the apartment was clean and cozy. Perfect for our relaxation.
It's a beautiful building with a nice rooftop, spacious rooms and it's a very nice part of town.

My partner and I were thrilled with this apartment, one of the nicest we have stayed in on our travels. It's comfortable, homely beautifully decorated and in a great location close to restaurant and bars. Luis is such a nice person and very helpful and responsive. Definitely recommend!

Place was well cleaned.
Furniture seems old and the couch was heavily stained which is different from what was written in the listing. The neighborhood is dangerous- walking at night is not recommended.
Olivier was quick to response and the appartment was easy to find

Anita and Lazaro were very friendly and accommodating. They allowed us to check in early and helped situate ourselves in the neighborhood.  The unit was conveniently located to restaurants and point of interest. Would definitely recommend.
A lovely flat in a great barrio. Conveniently located for bars & restaurants & for getting to the centre of the city.

Checking in was easy. The apartment was tiny but had everything we needed for a short stay. Internet was stable and fast. Host was kind and responsive. There were adaptors and metro cards. Very convenient.

Elena and David's place is amazing, it's on a pedestrian street around lots of restaurants and cafes. It is also close to multiple train lines. The apartment is great with lots of kitchen equipment and we felt right at home. I would recommend their place!

We enjoyed staying at Mauricio's place. It's in a great location, near many good restaurants, shopping centers and the US Embassy. We especially enjoyed the cityscape and mountain views from the balcony. When the weather permits, it's an excellent space to eat breakfast, dinner or have a drink. The linens and bedding are new. Mauricio was very responsive to our need for extra towels and a new frying pan and pot.
We also found the apartment to be quiet compared to many other places in Santiago.
The gym was a plus for us, allowing us to maintain our workout routines.
There was an issue with the batteries of the electronic lock and Mauricio fixed it.
We would gladly stay there again.
Manuel is a lovely person and was there to help me when I needed it. The apartment is great, and there is everything and more there that you need.

Great place, right in the middle of a buzzing  location with perfect views close to San Cristobal funicular and a bohemian neighbourhood, great nightlife here! If you want to stay in the beating heart of Santiago, this is place.

Apartment is like the photos, the view is quite nice as the flat is high and in front of an opening between 2 buildings. You're right next to barrio Italia which is the best neighbourhood in Santiago. You also have access to the pool on the roof top. Bed is comfortable. Bedroom is quite calm, I could sleep the window opened. I would suggest Miguel to review the bed headboard as it is flimsy and doesn't fit properly with the wall and the electric outlet.

Two friends staying for a week in Santiago.
Great property we chose because of the style, furnishings and overall finish of the property.
Check in was key collection in person from the cleaners and was easy and straight forward. The street feels quiet and safe. Spacious communal areas and walking distance to Barrio Italia for bars restaurants and shopping.
Good location and place to stay in Santiago, would recommend.
Nice place, on a green street, with a great view and everything you need. Jose was very friendly, flexible and quick to answer any questions.

Place looked like the pictures, only downside was it was a bit dirty on first arrival and lack of Essentials such as Cleaner and Toilet Paper which we had to buy ourselves. The lobby was beautiful and very easy to access at all times.

The view is absolutely amazing, totally worth booking for!  Great location, close to lots of restaurants and shops, and also to the metro and buses.  The neighborhood is really cool and felt quite safe.  Cristobal was very friendly and responsive, and gave lots of great recommendations - we went to most of the places suggested and all were great! Highly recommend booking!
Staying at Susan’s place was so lovely! The neighborhood has so many restaurants, the house was clean and as pictured in the photos. 10/10 would stay again!
Best location you can find in Santiago.  Within walking distance from anything you need and well connected to all public transportation. The most pet friendly place I have been to yet.

This was a great place to stay for my week in Santiago! The space was very comfortable for one person, the building was clean and secure, and the location was walkable to a lot of sights and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again!

It’s my second stay here and it’s still one of my favorite Airbnbs. Perfect location, right in the middle of Lastarria. Cafés and restaurants right outside the door. Nice window balcony overlooking the street. Feels like you’re in Europe.
There can be a bit of noise from the restaurants and people on the street below, but nothing that bothered me at all. It definitely dies down by 11 PM.
I’m just disappointed it wasn’t available for longer!

The place is close to everything, the hop on and off bus is just three blocks away. The historic plaza is central to tourist attractions. The apartment is nice except a bit noisy during weekends but acceptable. Overall speaking, it worth the money.
We had a great stay here. The host was very friendly and responsive, and we would definitely like to stay again!

I had an incredible experience staying at Jessica's place! The apartment is located in a very exclusive area, just a short walk from the mall, which was super convenient. The 24/7 security made me feel very safe during my stay. Jessica was a fantastic host, very welcoming and responsive. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Santiago. I'll definitely contact Jessica again for my next visit!
We only stayed one night. Diego and Camila are very responsive and friendly hosts. Everything was clean. We definitely recommend!

We had a great stay. Unfortunately the pool was shut during our stay despite very hot weather. There are great amenities and cafes nearby. The room was spotless and like staying in a hotel. We would stay here again

Amazing apartment with stunning views. The two bedrooms and two full bathrooms was so convenient. The apartment is well organized. Felipe was a great at host and thought of all our needs before and during our stay. Super recommended.

A great place in a safe neighbourhood. Close to great restaurants & places to see. Easy access to apartment, incredible views of the mountains & great facilities. Futon was not particularly comfortable to sleep on, however, main bed was great!
Gabriel was extremely prompt & helpful with all enquiries!!
Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area.
Excellent oasis within the city. Thoroughly enjoyed my visit. Had an awesome stay. Would highly recommend!

Overall, our stay at this modernist Airbnb apartment was nothing short of exceptional. From its stylish interiors to its prime location and impeccable hospitality, every aspect exceeded our expectations. We would wholeheartedly recommend this apartment to anyone seeking a luxurious and memorable stay in the heart of Chile.

Susan's flat is wonderfully located: close to the city's art museums, parks and a host of cafes, bookstores and trendy street stalls. I felt very much at home in the flat and loved the afternoon sun that lights up the space - the balcony is a great! Susan was also very flexible with check-in and helpful with any questions I had. Would highly recommend and hope to return soon! :)

Pamela’s place was beautiful! Super extra clean and beds were so comfortable! Bathrooms and bedrooms were very spacious. If you are traveling with young children this space is really safe since she gad the whole outdoor area/balcony closed with glass, and the other small balcony by the kitchen it was also protected with mesh! This Airbnb had everything we needed for a nice stay. All the appliances were modern and in perfect condition. She had multiple portable fans/ac and heaters! I would definitely stay again at Pamela’s place. I am originally from Chile and that area is very nice and there is a big grocery store right across the street! Building is really safe and the parking is inside the garage. Just make sure when you get there talk to the concierge first and they will give you all the directions! Pamela is very responsive and helpful. We had a lovely stay!
Lovely place with beautiful art and a nice kitchen that opens to a small private courtyard.  Comfortable beds and a clean space.  Amazing!

We had trouble getting in with the lock but Osvaldo was very accommodating and he came over and fixed the lock  , stayed in communication and  let us checkout early for the inconvenience caused. He is a great host and we recommend this place. few blocks from santa lucia hill
Nice place in the middle of everything. Would stay there again🤘Hector is a nice person, he even gave me his bicycle for a day.

Teresa's place was perfect for our needs. Our flight arrived very late, we took the bus into the city and Teresa's place was 500m from the airport bus stop, with a 24/7 concierge. The apartment was perfect for 2 people and had everything as described. We would stay here again.

This place was excellent overall. Easy access by car (with a parking spot). Beautiful view from the balcony. The apartment was clean and had all the amenities necessary for a short stay. The host was very responsive and friendly. I would recommend this place.

Bernabe was the Best host, just what  you need as first timers to Santiago! To be met at the airport and then sent off (at 5am!!) was just awesome, made our stay so enjoyable and stress free! Everything was perfect as in the listing. We slept well. This was a  great base to explore all the sights, handy for the metro just a few steps away. Shower was a bit small for the husband but the big washing machine made up for it! Bernabe was so generous with breakfast items. We ate out though as there were so many good restaurants and bars around and in neighbouring Lastarria. We felt very safe at Bellas Artes. Thank you for sharing your home with us and making us so welcomed. Muchas gracias!

A good location, close to Patio Bellavista, street market feel. parry people around at night. lots of street art. After an initial false start at check in, the wrong apartment, the apartment we booked was good on 18th floor. Great views. Enjoyable

Location was great, walking distance from restaurants, bars and other options.
Staff was great and the apartment itself was really good

I stayed at Eduardo's for two nights. It was easy to get inside and the room was very clean. You're sharing the common space of the apartment, but there was a good balance between friendliness and privacy. I can highly recommend the breakfast, which was delicious and had some options for local Chilean food. Good central location too. Good value the price and would recommend!

1. I work remotely! Love the desk and chair
2. I love AC! Great AC.
3. Perfect for single or a couple
Javiera was lovely and very helpful. The place was clean and the location was quite convinient
What a perfect apartment. Really comfortable and homely. In a great location near food cafes and restaurants. Just wonderful for our few days in Santiago.
Great located flat just a few minutes from the metro. Nice and simpel, with everything you need. I can totaly recommend it.

Great location in the heart of Barrio Lastarria! Super close to restaurants, bars and cafes.
Check-in was easy and comfortable with all necessary information provided beforehand.
The apartment is a bit more worn out than it looks like at the pictures, however, it’s a great apartment and matches the overall description.
Would book it again!

This is an excellent place with GREAT views and close to many restaurants and shops! Juan was an excellent host — super responsive, knowledgeable, friendly, and went above and beyond! We would definitely stay here again

Excellent place to stay! It was our first time in Santiago, and we couldn’t have chosen a better or safer location. The apartment was spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, and felt just like home. It had everything we could possibly need. The view of the surrounding mountains was stunning, and watching the sunrise and sunset every day was a definite highlight of our stay.
