Communication with Cristobal and Gisela was quick and easy, and they really went the extra mile to make us feel comfortable. When we mentioned the internet was a bit slow for our needs, they had it upgraded to the fastest connection available the very next day. Absolutely amazing!!
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this airbnb for anyone visiting Santiago.

This was a fantastic place! The sunset and the sunrise every morning was absolutely beautiful. It was very close to the metro station so I was able to move around efficiently.  The portable air condition was very helpful because some days the Chilean heat was intense! The washer and dryer combo in the bathroom was also a very nice touch. I enjoyed my stay :))

The location of this apartment is amazing. It is right in the hub of nearby restaurants and bars but equally safe and quiet.
The apartment had everything we needed and had been well decorated.

The location is perfect--quiet yet right in the middle of the action in the city. Alberto was an excellent host that went above and beyond the necessary to make us feel at home. This is a GREAT place to stay.

This has been one of the best places I've stayed in Santiago. The area is incredibly peaceful, with easy access to restaurants and shopping. Valentina is exceptionally friendly and helpful; she promptly addresses any request, no matter how small. I will definitely be returning to her place on my next trip to Santiago.
The place was perfectly located for both leisure as well as business life. The flat itself was very spacious and safe with everything needed inside. Thanks for hosting us!

We had a fantastic stay at Camilo's place. We cooked most nights and there was a well set kitchen for us to enjoy home cooked meals. The location is great just steps from Barrio Italia; all the necessities for food and getting around were steps away. The home is very secure and in a great neighbourhood. Highly recommend.

Felipe was an incredibly kind and gracious host! He was very responsive to whatever we needed. The space has an *AMAZING* view -- out of this world! It's also centrally located so you can cover many sights and restaurants without the stress of a wildly long commute. It really did start to feel a bit like home; I'd highly recommend it!
Very nice apartment with a nice city view. Jose Antonio was very responsive and professional. I recommend this place to anyone interested in staying in Santiago 🫡

The apartment is in a good location. The kitchen hadn’t been cleaned very well with food drips on the chairs and a microwave that hadn’t been wiped. There was a small stain on a pillow.
Our main issue was with Jan the host.
We booked our stay at 20:55 the night before the reservation. On the day, we were told the border between Chile and Argentina was closed and so our bus was cancelled. I immediately informed the host but he declined to reduce the stay to 2 nights from 3, even though with our late booking he was unlikely to have filled the room that night anyway. Despite me explaining and keeping him as up to date as possible, he refused. He then stopped replying to messages and only resumed once I had involved Airbnb.
We have stayed in nicer, cheaper places with kinder hosts in Santiago. I would not recommend this Airbnb.

Second time at stay at this place. My favourite things are the location, near Cerro San Cristobal, the Metro station and restaurants. The conveniences stores (kioskos) next to the building entrance are very handy.
all good exept,no heat and the entry pad is treacky,everything alse is good.
Americo was very helpful. The location was amazing. The only thing is that you can hear the outside noise at night but other than that everything was perfect. Would come back

Alexis is a great host, very warm and super helpful. He personally welcomed us to the property and gave us some really good tips on how to spend our time in Santiago. The apartment was spotless when we walked in and had everything we needed for our stay. Alexis even allowed us to stow our luggage for the day in a secure area after we checked out.

Beautiful, clean, modern apartment. Close to a grocery shop and some nice restaurants (which Camilo) recommended.
She even provided cards for public transportation.
Located in a nice, quiet area, in a one way street.
good and quiet place to stay,  it needs a little fresh up to get 5 stars. excellent communication with owner, and great location.

Our second stay here, started and finished our trip in Chile here as we liked it so much. Would definitely recommend staying here for the view and location! Felt safe and close to shops and transportation. Cristobal was super friendly and responsive.  Was great to have food and drinks on the deck and watch over and listen to the city below!

Hotel staff were extremely helpful and very nice. Location was very central and easy walking everywhere within Barrio Bellavista. 5-6pm complimentary wine hour is also a great touch.
Slightly noisy at night.

Our stay would have been worth it for the magnificent view alone. But in addition to the view  the apartment was very spacious and comfortable, its location very convenient, and Carlos himself was an excellent host.
Camila and Diego are very friendly host. This place is located closer to everything you wanted to see in Santiago . So I walked around and enjoyed my visit. Highly recommend this place for stay

A wonderful space in a residential area - lots of restaurant and grocery options nearby, and close to bus and metro stations. Wifi was reasonably fast and stable. Host Pamela is fantastic! Always very responsive and helpful. Thanks again for allowing us to stay!

There were several things that made this stay stand out. I liked the skylight in the room. The wifi is fast, especially the upload speed if you need to do video calls. The TV is a good size. There are plenty of power outlets where you need them.  The rental is on the ground level so there are no stairs to walk up. It's easy to get in and out of the room and it felt safe. There is a deadbolt in addition to the door lock. The kitchen has an oven, microwave, and gas stove burners. The hosts are really nice and take good care of the rental. Overall, my stay was a good value.
I loved it! It felt like home. The condo had everything you needed, and it was beautiful, clean, and well-located.

Great apartment, the managers were very responsive, explained everything in detail, esponded quickly and clearly. I’m glad they speak English. The apartments are very cozy, clean, warm, and we were very pleased with the coffee machine. The location is excellent on a very green and beautiful street. Thanks for letting us leave our suitcases in their office for a couple of hours before check-in. I recommend 100%.
My girlfriend and i had a wonderful time in Daniela’s place ,  very well decorated and on a perfect location .!

The view was incredible!  The mountains were RIGHT there!  We enjoyed our morning coffee on the enclosed terrace and a glass of wine there in the evening.  Beautiful!  The apartment was light-filled and clean.  We loved the location, too.  We walked everywhere!  We would highly recommend to anyone spending time in Santiago!

Wow.....what else to say about our stay. Fabulous, the views are exceptional. It was so quiet at night. I loved the apartment itself. Juan was very attentive and responded very quickly to all requests and questions. We had to stay longer and Juan helped us through the requirements and made it very easy. The apartment is very well located for all restaurants and city amenities. So much to see and do. Also there were goodies in the kitchen which was fantastic...my favourite was the bouquet of flowers, thank you Juan.
Overall we enjoyed our stay. Great location with restaurants and coffee shops around. Beds were comfortable. The staff at front desk were awesome. Recommend

What a pleasure staying at Hector's gorgeous home. The neighborhood is lovely, tons to do, and walkable, but the home has a private courtyard. The house is gorgeous and the room spacious and clean. Hector is so lovely and was kind and patient with me despite my  limited Spanish. Definitely recommend!
Nth time I've stayed here, still remains my go-to for when I go to Santiago.

Everything was neat and tidy,, and the host was always responsive. the location is close to all the hot spots and tourist attractions so I never felt like I was in an inconvenient location. Definitely recommended!

One of the best places to stay in Santiago as it is located exactly in the center of where you wanna be and walkable distance to every single place. The hosts are super nice and are ready to be helpful whenever you need them, loved my stay.
We stayed just 1 night before flying home. Great location, right next to metro station. Parking available also. Maria was very welcoming upon our arrival.

Valentina’s place was close to the metro station and close to a lot of the main food attractions making it easy to walk around in the city. The apartment was clean and spacious and it was situation in a safe neighborhood. I would stay there again.
All was perfect, everything you need to feel at home. Recommended 10/10 and will come back next time I’m in Santiago.

One of the best hosts. Location is amazing! Just next to the defense ministry. Lots of police and armed guards which you do not see in other areas in Santiago. Neighborhood looks grand and massive,. It is only 6 minutes walk to the metro. Walking distance to attractions. Near to supermarkets and restaurants. The apartment was quite chic, European style of decoration. It has everything you need. Including shampoo, blow dryer, hand soap which usually you need to buy them yourself with other hosts. But not with this host. He is very responsive. The apartment felt cold and the host immediately brought a heater which made our stay even more cozy. He has good manners and friendly. He responded to our questions with patience. Great price for what you get. There is basic kitchen that you can cook lots of different things. And, really great sound proof building. You do not hear much even in the same apartment. We are happy with our stay.
Incredible place with an incredible host. Gisela was kind, thoughtful and generous and her rental is a solace in the city.

Amazing apartment, amazing location, felt like home. Micaela was very available, perfect!
For the washing you need 3000 pesos in coins (washing plus drying), it's not in the apartment.
The apartment is small but has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Friendly staff at reception and 2 blocks from the metro
Great location in Las Condes and very clean, nice apartment. Jessica was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

It was easy to reach because of its proximity to the highways which was great for day trips by car. The view from the big windows or the rooftop and the sunsets are spectacular. Cerro San Cristóbal is only a few minutes away.
We did not like the environment because it is a nightclub area and it is really loud almost every night. Although Álvaro did provide us with earplugs for the night, the noise was so loud that it was not easy to relax while watching TV and even hard to fall asleep. If you want to party we definitely recommend it though.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Had no issues with the host and communication throughout our stay was easy and efficient.
Lovely little apartment in a secure complex and equipped with everything you need. It is located on the edge of a really safe neighbourhood (Barrio Italia) lots of cafes, restaurants, bars and shops etc. nearyby with in walking distance.
As other people have already mentioned the only con is the late check in time of 4pm. Although the oncierge staff were very friendly and let us use the communal facilities while we waited.
Diego and Camila were great hosts. The apartment is in a great location next to the metro station and walkable to many neighborhoods. Very comfortable home base for my stay in Santiago

Mabel's place was a great find. Very affordable, nicely sized for our group of 5, and walking distance to the Jumbo (supermercado) and two metro train stations. Mabel was very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions or concerns.
Highly recommend.
Beautiful place, with everything you need inside. The host is very friendly and helpful too. I definitely recommend this place!

We spent our return from Easter Island back here because the place is perfect.  Walkable to many area attractions, good restaurants, and bars.  Or just for a leisurely evening at the apartment, there are plenty of good grocery stores nearby.  Thank you!

A wonderful stay with a beautiful person
Amazing location and Camilla helped us with everything !
Good appartment, located in a good area with plenty of restaurants around. Antonio is super friendly and helpful too. I recommend this place.

My stay at Mariana Y Dominic property was nothing short of exceptional. Situated in a prime location with a metro station practically at the doorstep, fantastic restaurants nearby, and within walking distance of both the zoo and the cable car/funicular, it offered unparalleled convenience and access to the best the area had to offer. The attention made me feel right at home, while the ease of exploring the city and enjoying its attractions made for a truly memorable experience. I recommend this studio apartment to anyone looking for a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and good location.
The place is small, a bit smaller than it looks in pictures, but it works as a place to sleep. It was clean and the water pressure was very good and it's in a good location.
Perfect apartment with everything you need, as well as an easy walk to many great restaurants and attractions! Was a great spot to stay for my 2 weeks in Chile!
Spacious and clean apartment, good location , walking distance from shops , downtown and coffee places ,  like a home away from home . Highly recommended !

Great apartment in the best area of the city. Bed is of a excellent quality. Ignacio is one of the best host I have had in 12 years travelling using this platform. He was always responsive and gave me great tips for restaurants and places to visit. Thank you very much Ignacio.

Pablo‘s place was fantastic. From check in and throughout the stay until our last day communication was awesome. The views from the 38th floor are spectacular. The place is clean and neat and quiet and very secure as you have to check in with 24 hour security upon entry. Very convenient and easy to get Uber lifts or scooters or walk to wherever you need to go. Highly recommended.
Really !!… excellent place clean perfect to stay and relax , our host Jan was perfect and friendly everything amazing and very quiet !!!

pros -
very nice building
beautiful view
nice apartment, for 2 people max
responsive host
cons-
bed frame not attached to bed correctly , causing noise
would not suggest neighborhood for first time visitors to Santiago

Andres was great.!! Very responsive and excellent communication.!!
The place was very nice and cleand and beautiful view.
The only downside is for a business owner like myself it would be nice if there was a desk to work at with a computer but I understand the space is not huge and I made do with the counter top.
Overall a great place and i will stay here again when i am back.!!
Thank you

Osvaldo's place was a good base from which to explore the neighbourhood. Quite noisy at night but we were expecting that based on previous reviews - be warned though, if this bothers you then this might not be an ideal place as the noise continues until 4/5am. There is plenty of space but it was unexpectedly cold. A real bonus though was the rooftop view of Santiago.
This accommodation is fantastic in Santiago! Providencia is a more residential neighborhood in a safe location, so it’s perfect for someone’s first time in the city. I would definitely stay again!

We had a great stay! Lovely place, clean and cozy, with both heaters ans air conditioner. The bed imwas good, with warm and comfy blankets. Very close to Cerro sta Lucia and the metro station, which is cheap and you can use to quickly get anywhere you need in the city. It has a supermarket nearby, and a few panderias. It was just great!
We had a great stay here. Within a few minutes walk of the subway, and several neighborhoods within 20 minutes walk. Plenty of corner stores to get water and snacks within a few blocks.
Excellent location. Spacious apartment, very comfortable for us. Responsive host; even left some grocery items in the fridge for our arrival. We enjoyed our stay.

The place was very homey and cozy. The bed and pillow was so comfortable and loved having the entire place to myself. Didn’t get to use the rooftop pool although it looked so nice and the view from above was fantastic. Easy access to subway station and to nearby commercial areas.
This place is amazing—a must-stay! The views are worth it. The host is responsive and leaves a lot of nice things out for you in the apartment. I greatly enjoyed my stay!

Great central option to get around in Santiago and if you're visiting other parts of Chile. The apartment was spacious and very clean and the building had staff at the front so I felt very safe. There is an enclosed balcony so you can keep the windows shut in the winter or get fresh air in the summer.
I spent a month here, and I would stay again if I ever find myself back in Santiago.

Gisela is very friendly and fun to talk to. She also answered my questions very quickly. She also gave me a lot of information about the area (as well as the country) when I was there. I learned a lot from her! The place was very charming and was just like the pictures.

One of my best Airbnb stays i have ever had ! Very flexible in relation to check in times, and the apartment has much more to offer than what is says. The views are incredible, and they gave us a bath towel offered for each room, and the suite had a hair-dryer ! Just perfect ! If i ever come back to el colorado, i already know where im staying !
Great stay, location had a lot of food, bars, clubs and other entertainment within 20 minute walk or less.

It was a great place to spend three days in Santiago. There are many places to eat and to drink coffee.
The apartment is close to metro stations.

The good:
It’s a great location, very affordable and has a lot of charm.
The bad:
While I was there, the WiFi was so spotty that I stopped using it. The water heater was also weird. I had to turn on the water in the sink so I could take a hot shower (which I didn’t find out about until my 3rd or 4th day.)
Lastly, the heater was powered by kerosine and would make the place smell of fumes. Plus, it would turn off randomly even though it was filled up.
I hope the host will fix these issues in the future. This place has a lot of potential.
Excellent stay in a great location. You can hear the music playing through the night but it didn’t bother us. Lots of good restaurants around and close to public transport and the Santiago funicular!

The place was great. the only thing keeping it from being 5 stars was things that other customers had already mentioned. during this time of year it's a little cold with no heating options except blankets. The internet wasn't that great either. And 4pm check-in seems late, but adding 50%-100% to the cost for earlier check-in is unacceptable.

A 6-star stay in Santiago! Felipe is a very dedicated host, that communicates often and makes sure your stay is the best possible. His place is exactly as described in the listing and has a beautiful skyline view of the city of Santiago! The apartment has everything you may need for your stay and accommodates solo travelers and couples very well. The staff at the front desk is friendly and helpful, making you feel right at home.
The surroundings are easy to get to know after your first hours exploring, being really close to a bus station and the subway. There are popular restaurants and neighborhood grocery stores for your immediate needs and also big brand names on the main avenue close to the building.
Is it relatively safe to walk around if you are an experienced traveler and it is really easy to get there and leave using apps like Uber.
A great stay with a great host. Highly recommend it!

We wanted a place to stay while in transit of different flights, so fairly close to the airport. And clean place too!
Slightly loud from outside street noise, but not that bad that it would ruin sleep.

I liked the apartment, the location is also pretty good.
There a lot is restaurants nearby.
The house was clean and the checkin smooth.
However the communication wasn’t good: the first night the shower didn’t worked well, my girl friend couldn’t take a shower.

This AirBNB is super clean with great wifi! The bathroom is also very nice. It is in a great location near the metro and around multiple places to eat, which I greatly appreciated. However, I did find it to be stocked a little poorly with not enough extra paper towels. Besides that, it was a clean, nice place with a beautiful view. It is a little pricey though, but if you have the money to spare, it is worth it!

Camilo’s home was absolutely beautiful, in a great neighborhood, and extremely walkable to great restaurants and shops. He was extremely responsive, friendly, and made us feel welcome in Chile during our first visit. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

We had a wonderful time at Juan’s apartment. Not only did he help to coordinate travel to and from the airport, but the drivers were also helpful and kind. Juan himself is extremely communicative and helpful - we felt very taken care of! The apartment itself is better than the photos - it’s clean, comfortable, and has everything you need (there were even breakfast food, drinks, and flowers provided when we arrived). The bed was big and comfortable and the shower is spacious with a great rain shower head. Everything felt well planned for our comfort.
The view is INCREDIBLE. This was my favorite part of the entire stay. Many thanks to Juan - we’d love to stay here again next time we’re in Santiago!

We had a lovely stay at Camilo's place. The apartment is as described and easily accommodated three individuals. The neighborhood is walkable with many restaurant options and a gigantic supermarket with great food options. We tried a couple of Camilo's restaurant recommendations, such as Casaluz, and had outstanding meals and service.
Travelers with mobility issues should consider that the bathtub is not an easy in and out. Even our 14 year old made a comment. The only other advise for travelers is that the original windows facing the back of the property do let in some street noise.
Having the metro cards available at the apartment was a very nice convenience. Camilo even insured that there were three to accommodate everyone in our group. Thank you.
Paz's apartment is very clean. She is very organized, attentious and kind. The apartment has a very beautiful Andes' view, especially during the winter.

Carlos was an excellent host! Very communicative and friendly. The apartment has a beautiful view and is right next to public transit. Plenty of Santiago sightseeing close by. Doormen were very friendly and the area was busy, but felt very safe and walkable. I would most definitely stay again when in Santiago!
Nice place, good location. If you're looking for something simple but nice, then is place is good
very convenient location. close to the heart of the city. near by stores and attractions. highly recommend this place if you plan on staying in Santiago.
Pablo was a great host, so helpful with answering any questions we had. His apartment was amazing and made our stay in Santiago perfect. Good location and clean, well described flat.
Very well appointed apartment in a fun location if you are wanting to go out and have a few too many beverages.
Great stay in comfortable apartment. Close to the airport and walking distance to great restaurants in the plaza Brasil - would definitely recommend!
Leonor was a great host, communicated the check in process clearly and answered any questions that I had. The space was perfect for my stay and walking distance to many stores and the metro.

Marcela is a great host. She was responsive and provided me with all the required help whenever I asked.
The apartment is great. It looks like exactly as in the photos and has all the listed amenities.
It is quite spacious for 1-2 people.
The instructions for the check-in and check-out process were pretty detailed and clear.
Thank you very much for this experience.

Beautiful apartment in a very nice area of Santiago.
Host was very helpful and always available.
Very close to a nice mall nd restaurants
Wonderfull cordillera view from the balcony
100% recommended
Everything was very clean and comfortable, the only negative of this apartament is that the building doesn't have elevator.

The apartment is very clean and looks like the photos. The view in the morning during winter is great because the sun shines above the mountains directly on the bed 🌞
Alida and i communicated online very efficiently.
There is construction in the area, but keep busy during the day and it's fine

I stayed here for a week for a work trip and felt very comfortable here. The building felt safe and it was a short walking distance to museums, the subway, and the Lastarria neighborhood. It was also close to the mercado central and other restaurants. The apartment itself was very peaceful and clean, and it was nice to have a balcony. Manuel was very responsive and a great communicator, helping me with whatever questions I had. I would definitely stay here again!

Quaint condominium perfect for a couple. Easy to find, perfect instructions.  This location is the absolute best. A safe and secure building located near shops, restaurants, banks, etc. A short Uber ride to Costanera and Funicular.

Mabel was a gracious hostess, and her home is incredibly lovely and comfortable. She has a designer’s eye and the home reflects her good taste in art and culture. It had all the comforts including nice beds, bedding, and towels. She even had a few items of food in the fridge for our arrival, which was very helpful. She also allowed us a late checkout. We appreciated that greatly since our flight wasn’t until 11:00 pm. We enjoyed our stay very much and hope we can be back.
The position is nice, near lots of attractions. The host is very nice and kind, reply to message quickly.
very cozy apartment, all is clean and new. host is super friendly and helpful. will book again if in Santiago!

Beautiful place, very responsive host and manager.
The place is basically the attic turned into a unit, it looks great but could do with better insulation. Especially in the back room with the single beds as it can get really cold.

This was one of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. The host was incredible and accommodating and also quick to respond to any of our questions. The apartment is incredibly clean, and in the best location. We would absolutely stay here again, if I could give it 6 stars I would!!!
Definitely would recommend staying here in Santiago! Everything was great and the place was super clean and comfortable.
Nice apartment in a great area, the view from the balcony is incredible! Comfortable for 2-3 people - would recommend :)
Great place.  Short stay but suitable for longer ones as well.  Very well located.  And well equipped. You will need a cellphone with internet connection (fancy system to get in and out).
Easy check-in, good communication, convenient property and had everything we needed …. With a beautiful view. Gabriel was accomodating in every way and made the stay much more enjoyable.

Valentina’s place in Santiago was just what we were looking for. It was in a safe neighbourhood fairly close to the city’s center, with plenty of places to eat and shop. We stayed here about halfway through our 3 week trip, so the in-unit laundry was a lifesaver, helping us get through the rest of our trip with clean clothes. Check in was also quick and easy, as we just registered with the front desk and headed up to the room. I would certainly consider booking this unit again if I returned to Santiago.
We had a beautiful stay here - the house is lovely with amazing artwork and interior! Great kitchen and super clean. The house is close to lots of eateries, would recommend!
i had a great time with Gonzalo and David! they're not only hosts, they are friends. very much recommended!
Great communicative host.  Location was great.  Lots of great bars and restaurants in the area.
Mauricio was a great host! His place was in the best location and I had no trouble finding it and checking in. I would definitely book his place again and cannot recommend it enough.
Highly suggest staying at Osvaldo's!! The location is prime!! So much to see and do within walking distance. Osvaldo, thank you for an amazing stay!!
Beautiful, comfortable apartment with gorgeous view. Easy access to metro as well as nearby restaurants and cafes and bars.

Mirza was amazing! Every request that i asked she fast replied to me. The house is great!! Everything that i needed i saw over there, the check-in was very easy. The building also has good concierges that helped me 24/7… Next time in Chile will be of course in Mirza’s house! Thanks.
Gabriela was a great from the beginning, assisting us in everything and giving us tips to enjoy the most of our stay in Santiago, I definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at Gianina's apartment! The bedroom was comfortable and perfect for me and my fiancée. Gianina was very responsive and accommodating, especially with our late check-in. The location is excellent, just a short walk from the Matta metro station. Highly recommend!

We stayed at Carmen's apartment for one month and it fit the description well. My husband and I both worked from the space, and the internet was good. There is a nice office space in the converted balcony but it gets chilly in the winter. We were grateful for the space heater provided. There isn't really space for another person to work, so I used the couch and one of the barstools. The space is small, but you can tell from the listing, so we knew to expect it. You can reserve time to use the laundry at the front desk, and make sure to ask for tokens (fichas) at the time of your reservation at the front desk. The neighborhood is nice, walkable, and has anything you need close by.

This was a perfect place to stay in Santiago, safe area, walking distance to Barrio Italia which have amazing nice places to eat. Close to the metro and all around beautiful neighborhood.
Gisela was super kind and helpful, always answered quickly.
The accommodation was super nice and the garden as well, we enjoyed cooking outside.

Patrícia is a very nice host, attentious and fast responding. The apartment is cozy and very well located, easy to get by, lots of things around, such as malls, markets, restaurants and metro. We had a great stay at Santiago!

Camilo was very helpful. Check in was easy even though we arrived late in the evening. The apartment was very clean and the kitchen had all that we needed. We shared the apartment with a friend and the two bedrooms were very nice with a king bed in one and two twins in the other. There was a little street noise, but no noise from other apartments and it was peaceful sleeping.

Had a pleasant week stay, the apartment is quite new, it has a well equipped kitchen and a comfortable bed. The internet is fast and reliable, never had any issues with it. The washing machine and dryer listed is shared by the entire building so if you wish to use it the wait can be long and requires cash.
Great stay! Eduardo and Rafael are excellent hosts - apartment is pleasant, comfortable, tidy, and well-placed within Santiago. My wife and I would love to return!
Stayed at Martin's place for more than 2 months, perfect location with great views and lots to do. Martin & Cecilia were always v responsive, 10/10

Anita and her husband were absolutely wonderful people, kind , generous, loving .
I will be forever grateful to both of them for letting me checking at early hours of the morning as my flight arrived very late at night.
The house was clean, had heating, hot water available, generous breakfast, clean linen, comfortable bed. I would certainly recommend this listing for those who are far away from home and want to experience all of the above and a touch of true family experience.

Mario's charming loft is inside a traditional alley. Its location is excellent, with easy walking distance to Barrio Italia and supermarkets. It felt like home! With some TLC, this would be the best AirBNB unit in all of Santiago!!  Mario was flexible, and communicated well. I would stay there again!

This was our second time at José’s apartment and it was just as great as the first! We love this location for navigating Santiago - safe, centric, walkable, and the apartment offers the perfect home base for a couple or solo traveler. José is kind and professional. 100% recommended!

Christian is very helpful and friendly. He helped me with the check in at midnight and allowed me to store my luggage in his place after checking out. He also shared a lot of culture about Chile which helped me to know more about his country. The room is located in the city centre where is only few minutes away from the metro station. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay in Santiago! The accommodations were spaces and clean and the building was really centrally located to all the best that the city has to offer! I highly recommend staying here whether you are on business or just for fun

Excellent location with awesome restaurants and shopping nearby. There is a metro station nearby so exploring Santiago was very easy. All of the staff at the apartment complex were welcoming and helpful. Overall, the apartment had everything we needed and more !

9/10 Good hostess, very responsive, the place look better than pics, It would be nice a better TV and Netflix account to complete the entire experience, it would be nice some personal soap and shampoo items in the bathroom (like hotels).
In general a good experience!.
The location and home are incredible. The host allowed us to check out late and was extremely accommodating. We had a phenomenal stay and would highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Santiago.
This was a lovely stay and everyone made me feel very welcome. I wish I had more time / less jet lag to hang out!
Susan was very kind and helpful. Everything is as advertised on Airbnb. The location couldn’t be better, it’s a very cozy home that feels like it belongs to someone. Really recommend :)

Good location, the neighborhood felt safe to me. the Metro is about 3 min walk around the corner. There are a lot of bars and restaurants in the area. The place is good, small but works great for a few weeks. Mirza is fast at responding. One street over from the apartment has a nice long walk near the canal to the big tall building. And it shuts down Sunday morning for biking and running if you're into that. I think it's probably one of the more affordable areas that are still safe in the city. So overall I would say it's a great value!

This apartment is perfectly located in Lastarria, but on a quiet street. Easy to get most places on foot and near subway lines. Kitchen was outfitted well enough to cook a nice seafood meal. Great place and a good value.

Perfect place for people who are travelling solo. Nestor is a really nice and helpful host. The appartment has everything you need and is in a really good location. Be aware that the room gets cold at night in winter
Jesus's place had what we needed for the day we stayed. It is a few meters away from the metro, good location and it was quiet at night.

The building has safe access, and the concierges were helpful. It's a great choice for a Chilean (like myself) or a foreign visitor. The apartment is in excellent condition. It has everything needed, including a safe entrance with a security code and perfect internet. The apartment is on the 8th floor, facing west, and is quiet despite being in the city center. There is little noise from outside and no noise from neighbors. It's central, very close to the Santa Lucia metro station. I feel it's in a safe place. Good price/quality ratio. Cynthia, the host, was kind and helpful. I hope to be back in the near future.

Very good wifi
Decent location
There was a pretty efficient heater which a lot of other places in Chile in general had subpar or none. So, it was nice being able to stay warm during the winter time there.

nice apartment , well equipped with necessary things. And it is the only one in the whole building with a nice belcony that has snow mountain view, on which you can take sun bath in the morning , a plus point in the winter time.
Just a few steps away from nearby office buildings so is super convenient for people come for business.
Joaquin is a warm hearted land lord and always solve problems in no time.
Will come back when possible.
Sofia is very kind and response quickly. The house is very well maintained. The surrounding area is also good to take walk. I could spend good time there!!

Maritza’s apartment was very comfortable and clean. Close to all the main sites and metro. Very convenient!
Maritza was always very responsive and helpful with any questions.
Highly recommend her place!

Wonderful host! Super responsive and very accommodating, regardless of what time of day messages were sent. Would totally recommend this place, it’s in a good area and there was lots to do within walking distance. Metro station and bus stop were only a 5 minute walk

I booked this apartment for my daughter, who was coming to Santiago as an exchange student. We were so pleased with the apartment. It was exactly what my daughter needed, and it was very centrally located. It was clean and comfortable, with a great view over the city. What really stood out, however, was the excellent communication with Valentina and Nelson. They answered every question promptly, and stayed in constant contact when my daughter was checking into the apartment. Truly they went above and beyond what was necessary, and we very much appreciated it. We will definitely be back, and I highly recommend staying with them.

We had a great stay in Santiago and in Carla's apartment in Las Condes. This is a great, safe neighborhood with a huge Unimarc supermarket within 5 min walking distance and a metro station Manquehue less than 10 min away. The building is gated and the apartment has everything you may need including a parking garage. It is very clean, spacious with great heating if needed, amazing water pressure and a well equipped kitchen and a washer dryer.
We had no issues and Carla was very good with communication from the time we booked. We highly recommend her and her place if you wish to visit Santiago

Cozy apartment in the heart of the city.  Easy walk to all the historic sites, and short uber ride to other parts of the city.  Secure building and clean apartment with amazing views.  Great hosts and overall great stay!

A little noisy because it is close to high way. Otherwise, good location and well maintained.
No extension with compatible connections

Victoria’s husband is very attentive and let me drop off my luggage before check in.  Excellent location!! They go all the way to help you in anything you need.  However, the apartment needs a lot of maintenance.

The apt was exactly as posted in the pictures. It's simple and affordable, and in a residential area so not as noisy as the center of the city. There's plenty of shops around and the very long park of the city right there. Jose Luis was a really great host, very warm and I liked him a lot. Very cool guy. Plenty of hot water and the internet works very well. I highly recommend booking Jose's apt!

The location is great and the apartment is beautiful (when clean). I messaged through airbnb when booking and a few days before arriving but didn't recieve a reply until after I sent a message through a third party app, 30 minutes after checkin time. The apartment hadn't been cleaned from the previous stay and a cleaning person turned up 2 hours after the checkin time and the place wasn't available until an hour or so after that.

This place is very convenient if you want to ski in el Colorado! However, it is a bit hard to navigate around in a car. Make sure you have a good all wheel drive SUV before thinking about driving up here! The parking lot and way leading to this place is quite bumpy

Practical and convenient apartment near our favourite area of Santiago (Barrio Italia) and the underground. Value for money is ok for Santiago and the flat has all the basics for a comfortable stay - and a good, hot shower. But the apartment is looking a bit tired and could have been cleaner.

Our stay at Rodrigo was excellent. The flat is comfy and well equipped. While we stayed I had to work remotely and it was the perfect place since there is a good desk and great internet connection. Although Santiago is cold in the winter, the flat counts on a portable heater and mattress heater. The flat has a good kitchen with utensils available to cook, which allowed us to prepare breakfasts almost every morning. The flat was very clean and the shower worked with great pressure of hot water. Upon our arrival, Mai welcomed us and was helpful and kind, and every time we needed to speak to Rodrigo he was promptly available. The location is easily accessible via metro Santa Isabel where you can find a variety of bars and restaurants. It’s not as fancy as Las Condes but great cost benefit for who’s looking for a safe, comfortable and easily accessible place to stay. I would definitely return and highly recommend this accommodation. Five stars!

Cozy shelter, well located near the ski resorts. Host is very friendly and takes care of keeping the place warm and tidy. Only thing to note is access to the accommodation is difficult and there is no wifi. Overall good experience and stay and we recommend it.

Great location, really close to the ski resorts. Unfortunately, place was dirty and bed sheets were stained. Wouldn't mind if price was lower. Derek was really helpful and gave great recommendations. Also kudos to Nicolas (the building janitor) who was extremely nice to us

Enzo's place was perfect for us! Great location by the metro, with restaurants, bakery, and minimarkets close by. Very secure and with beautiful views of the mountains and city lights. We enjoyed several meals while watching the sunrise and sunset. Heated bed was cozy on cold winter nights!
the place is great. 2 bedrooms and bathrooms. 1 for parents and 1 for our 2 daughters. flat is well equipped, very clean and in a great location.

Alberto was an amazing host. The property was very clean and safe. It was less than a 5 minute walk to various restaurants, the mall, and metros. The house had everything we needed to feel at home.
Alberto was easy to contact and gave us great recommendations.
We have family in the area, and will definitely be staying here when we visit again in the future!
Nice place! It is a great location to walk to nice neighborhood. Also the host is very responsive.

Cristian is a awesome host. Very helpful and ready to help. The apartment is good! Right in the center!
Just take care if you have a car to no let parking in the street in the front of the airbnb and always use a private parking place.
Very responsive hosts, great, neat and attractive apartment in a building that I like and will continue to return.
Very nice place. Ideally located. All appliances worked very well. Responsive host. Well maintained. We loved it

The apartment is very well located in Lastarria which is a great neighbourhood with lots going on, great restaurants and bars, and easy to walk to many of the main attractions in Santiago. The apartment was comfortable and well equipped. Accessing the key was quirky, but it worked! Overall it delivered everything we needed.
Our second stay as a family! Wonderful place and host. So close to the slopes! Our family had another wonderful holiday!

First of all, the host Antonio is a great guy.  He answered all our questions sincerely and quickly.  He took care of us.  he is really a very kind person and host.  The house had everything I needed and more.  For example, a public transportation card, multiple sockets, maps... A washing machine with dryer is a great idea for travelers.  The location of the house is very good, you can walk everywhere.  This house helped us have a wonderful time in the beautiful city of Santiago.  We definitely recommend it.  Thanks again for everything Antonio...

Estabán was a very friendly and helpful host - very quick to respond and communicative with us. The flat is as on the pictures - it is very spacious, with relatively well equipped kitchen. Some of the furniture is older and worn, and the bathroom in particular could use a refresher, but for a winter week long stay in Nuñoa, it was great

The stay was lovely!
The flat was exactly as pictured, very beautiful, clean and comfortable.
Check-in and check-out went smoothly.
Said was always prompt with his messages and very helpful.
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay in Santiago!!

"I rented the apartment for a colleague who was visiting us for work. We had an initial misunderstanding at check-in, confusing the keys for the door, but David was quick to help us. My colleague had a pleasant stay and was able to work and communicate with his family abroad. In summary, we had a good experience with this accommodation, and it is an excellent option for future visitors to our workplace."

José was very nice and helpful, he answered right away and takes time for you!
Great visit!

The apartment is uniquely decorated. Great bathroom! If you are a light sleeper, you might find the street noise a problem. But, for such a convenient location downtown, it's expected. It's comfortable and homey. Stayed two weeks. Inés is super nice and helpful.

good place and very friendly hosts. loved chatting with them. good area to walk in and value for money listing.
only shortcoming was that the wifi was a little slow because of the storm.

Great location close to many great restaurants and bars. Felt very safe and walkable.
Checking was very easy and Christian was very nice and responsive.
Highly recommend if you are visiting Santiago.
I love staying at Maria’s place. This is a beautiful family, and they make me feel like a part of their family. Large room, comfortable bed, full use of kitchen. I will stay here again!
I had a nice stay there. People are very friendly. The district is also nice and safe. Good connection to the city.
Camilo was super responsive. This place is big, private, well decorated, and I wish I had more time to spend there. Barrio Italia, a cool Neighborhood, is a short walk.

Great place to stay safe clean and central to what you could be looking for in Santiago
The shower was great tons of hot water ..
Super TV massive warm bed
The only negative issue was the lounge area was very cold even with the heating on, it never really warmed up or kept any heat in, especially the morning and evening time.

Marita’s place was perfect for our first time skiing in Chile. Right next to the slopes and awesome views. She was very responsive whenever we had questions and the apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Look forward to coming back.

It was excellent location for a solo skier. Would have been a bit tight for two skiers. It has sleeping space for 4 but I would only recommend that for summer season and for short stays. Kitchen was a bit tight but had everything I needed. Due to snowstorms, there were significant electricity issues in the region while I was there, but I am told that that is not normal. I was never able to get the room above 62 degrees F and never found a refrigerator setting that did’s freeze everything but inside window sill was an excellent alternative. Best part was ski boot storage bench happened to be next to a heater so every morning I had toast boots waiting for me! Ski-in with easy walk to ski-out. Access to hot tub and gym.

Great place! I think this place is new to Airbnb so hopefully they will get the communication aspect down for their future stays. Other than that, this place is great and I will stay here again when I return!

We really enjoyed our stay in Waldos and Claudias AirBnb. It was a great experience and also the apartment was great. We can definitely recommend this apartment. It was clean, the location of the AirBnB is also amazing and we felt also pretty safe.

We had a wonderful stay at Claudia’s.  The home was well stocked, had a beautiful sunset view, and was conveniently located to restaurants and skiing.  We would definitely rebook her place if we plan another trip.

The location is very good.
The photos did not exactly match the unit as the configuration of the kitchen layout was different. Still, it was quite similar, but perhaps a bit smaller.
I understand the owners manage multiple units in the same building.
Each unit really should have its own listing, but I presume all are more or less the same experience. The published check in/out times were different from what I was told by the host via chat. However, they still respected what was published except the place not being ready until an hour later. The concierges at the building were very friendly, and it was an easy check in as I was met by the host at the front desk and let into the apt. She was kind and accommodating. Heaters worked well during the cold days. Hot water is not an instant heater (calefont), so it does start to get colder if multiple people shower consecutively.

Perfect location and great value for the price. The apartment is very cozy and Vilma is an amazing host, so friendly and helpful - she figured out so many things to make us more comfortable.
Only comments for improvement: the apartment has no wifi and the infrastructure is a bit older, like no double window and shower gas heating inside the living room.
Great stay, Pepe was very fast to respond and very accommodating to allowing a slightly earlier check in and check out. The apartment was in a great location and well equipped, thank you!

The location is great and thr hosts were very helpful. One thing that could make the experience better is including some shampoo, bodywash and conditioner in the bathroom.
For the kitchen a knife will be helpful, i ended up using a butter knofw to cut my tomatoes.
There r two super markets that are across the park and the metro is litterally half a block away. Super easy to access and see the city. Also cant say enough about the view from the apartment.
This was an amazing apartment for our trip to Santiago!  Easy to get around to the metro or even walking to restaurants and stores.  The artwork in the apartment and building is an added bonus!

Cristian was a great host. He was very friendly, and responsive, and flexible with my travel plans. The airbnb was exactly as described and was located in a perfect spot of Santiago. Most places you’d want to go to will be walking distance. The flat had all of the essentials I needed. There was a grocery store super close and check-in was very smooth. AI wouldn’t hesitate to stay with Cristian and his airbnb again.

Had a great stay here for a few days. Great location, easy to walk to major attractions. Kitchen was well stocked, we were able to cook. It was great having a washing machine as well. Very easy to check in. Overall a great stay!

Everything was so great. The communicate was easy, he was flexible with the check in, the location was excellent!!
The apartament has everything you need. And around the apartament has supermarkets, restaurants, metro…
Maria's apartment was even better than it looks in the photos.  Very cozy.  Fully equipped with everything you need.  Great communication.

Very good and lovely apartment, the room has everything you need, is warm and cozy. Gianina let us feel like home from the beginning, was very helpful (even with Metro Cards) and we had some good chats. Very grateful that we stayed here!
Very beautiful apartment with a great view. We work remotely and the internet worked great. The laundry machine is super helpful and the location is close to everything. I recommend this place!

I had great two weeks at Ines' place. The room was very nice and comfortable, the whole appartment as well. I found everything I needed in the kitchen. Ines is a great host, always checking in and happy to help out, I felt very welcome. The check-in was spontaneously possible a little earlier, which I appreciate a lot. The location is nice as well. Overall I can highly recommend this place :)
Great place in the historical district of Santiago! Close to a bunch of restaurants and metro stations. Would definitely stay again!

This was a great stay in the Providencia area. the room has everything you need for your stay, the bed is heated which is nice in the winter, and the massage chair is a fun accessory. Be mindful that this is a spot in the city and on the 2nd floor, so if you're looking for a very silent spot this may not be for you, however we are city people and don't mind the noise. some mornings there was jazz playing or a live band at night us other street sounds. All in all it is super close to transit and lots of walkable restaurants. We loved our stay!

Would recommend this place to anyone traveling to Santiago. The host takes care of the place and ensure that the hospitality is felt. Very walkable around the area and good places around to eat, close to a couple metros.
Lovely space for a quick stay or if you’re solo or with a significant other.  Thank you for the hospitality.

Paula and Vincent were so friendly before , during and after our stay. I spoke to Vicente a few days before the check-in and mentioned that I would like to check out late. We did not concrete anything but one day before the checkout date he wrote by the chat offering me the alternative and very kindly allowing us to store our bags for a while longer. That was the extra mile. Regarding the room is like WYSIWYG. It is the same as the pictures, additional, the neighborhood is secure (even the president private residence is two blocks down the building so the police is all the time checking the zone)

Nice little old style apartment in the BEST location in Valle Nevado. Amazing view of the mountains. Everything is conveniently close. The hosts & concierge were very nice. Ski right to the elevator.👍⛷️
Great host! The location was great, a lot to do a very centric neighborhood. Easy public transport around

We had a number of transportation snags with our group that Bruno and his team went out of their way able to help us rsolve. The house is cozy clean and in a great location. We were a group of 10 and while the place is not large we never felt cramped.
Wonderful location, great host can't say so much great things about the area.Wonderful food and easy to get to and get around from a plus plus plus rating
The place was exactly what we needed. Very accommodating host able to be flexible to my needs. Very clean place, many things to do in the area
It was a lovely place. A nice studio apartment with what I needed for a 1 night stay

German is responsive and timely. Any concerns we had were addressed in a timely manner, and he was incredibly helpful. The location has staff who are always friendly and it’s centrally located. We plan on coming back in the future and hope German continues to offer this space!

I visited Santiago with my dad and we stayed in Felipe's place. The apartment is located in one of the best neighbourhoods in Santiago with easy connections (close to a metro station) and amazing view to the mountains from the living room and balcony. Felipe's place is also very clean with all amenities you need and well prepared with heating and hot water if you go in the Winter time. I don't have anything negative to say – definitely recommend his place!

Spacious and sunny apartment in very convenient location. Camilo was responsive, friendly, and helpful. The Barrio Italia neighborhood is lively, but the apartment is quiet and private. A great place to stay while exploring Santiago.

A very comfortable and bright flat, clean with good heating considering a cold season.
Francisco was very proactive, friendly and approachable. I will definitely like to come back here!
Excellent place, location. Very quiet, clean and comfortable. Mabel is a great host. the place was so nice I decided to come back the following week .
This was above and beyond my expectations! The apartment was beautiful and the staff were all phenomenal and extremely helpful. Would absolutely stay here again!
Great location for both conferencing and traveling! The apartment was well-stocked and comfortable, and the host was communicative. We had a great stay and would recommend this apartment!

A very nice studio, very comfortable and Lionel and Cesar are very nice and  reply very quickly! For light sleepers: although the street is rather small, buses go through it. But the double layer glass windows are good and help a lot in this regard.

We enjoyed our stay at Mabel’s! Wonderful place in a nice neighborhood and close by many restaurants and bars. The house was very spacious and comfortable. Mabel was very responsive, accommodating and kind. Thank you!

Wonderful place in a thriving district. Osvaldo was really nice and really easy to communicate with. I didn’t spend too much time in the Airbnb only there at night, but it was very nice. I would definitely rent this place again but in the summer but in  the winter it’s too cold. It’s an open space so it takes too long to warm up, but I would definitely rent again.

The most gorgeous apartment and person. Loved staying here would rank it higher if possible. I didn’t think it was possible but the flat is even nicer than the photos! It is so beautiful it was hard to leave. Absolute gem.

Yolanda was extremely attentive and responded quickly.
The apartment is in a great location, we did almost everything on foot.
Nice two bedrooms apartment with spectacular view over Santiago and the mountains. Access to facilities is not the smoothiest and some did not work (the sauna) but overall its good place to stay in.

Alejandro has been the most kind and friendly host I had ever met in my time on this app and others, he was very helpful and communicative when checking in, the apartment is basically what you see on the pictures, it’s very well located because you can get walking to the subway station that can take you anywhere on the city and also close to the mall Costanera Center if you need anything from food to clothing you can find it there! Once again Alejandro thank you for your kindness and for all the advice!
really great Airbnb. zero issues or problems while I stayed. great Airbnb for a long term stay.  alot of room and great location in general super close to the gym and everything.

Felipe is a great host, quickly answering, gave me lots of tips of Santiago and places to go. The apartment has an incredible view, very clean rooms, excellent beds.
I recommend to all.

Good location in Providencia. Nice view of the city. Good internet. The host was responsive and addressed an issue with the dedicated workspace in a timely manner. Overall, I had a good stay and I would recommend this apartment for those traveling to Santiago.

We had a wonderful time at Juan’s place. He was very helpful from even prior to arrival. All the services he provided made us feel like being at a hotel, yet having the privacy and coziness of an AirBnb. Definitely a gem!

Perfectly situated apartment with an unbelievably gorgeous view of the mountains. Javiera's place was a great home base for skiing: a short walk from the slopes and convenient lockers for skis and boots. We loved our stay and would highly recommend it to others.
Carla was a great host. Very responsive and helpful. I had to leave my bags there early and Carla helped me. I’m grateful for that. The place was exactly what I needed. Thank you
Beautiful apartment, clean, and great location but check in was confusing and building amenities couldn’t be used during our stay

Matias was very supportive. The apartment was small,  yet very functional, clean, and had a wonderful view. It was walking distance to ski lifts right in the main area of the resort,  right by the restaurants and bars.

Carlos and Cecilia were amazing hosts, very open, accommodating and caring. When we arrived Cecilia offered us a delicious soup and spent some time to chat to us. The family offers accommodation in a real spirit of airbnb- where you actually get know and interact with people. They are very interested in what you have to share and super willing to share their own passions, experiences and knowledge. One of best airbnb I had in the last 10 years. Highly recommended.

Luis was very attentive from the minute I made the reservation. He kept me informed at all times and promptly advised when te place was ready. I am very pleased with his hospitality… I would definitely stay again at his place.

I had a great time! The company and the house felt like the place to be immediately. The girls had been super nice and sweet since the fist day. The house is great and the location too. Is one of the few Airbnb that still makes you feel you are not just renting a room but getting a full wonderful experience out of it. Extremely recommended!!!
Such a lovely hostess who did everything to make the stay as positive as possible. We love this apartment and can’t wait to return.

The place was way to find, accesible to both bus and metro.  Just a couple blocks away, great restaurants.  Nice small cozy space with a desk in event you need a place to do a little work. I do recommend.

The apartment was as described and was in walking distance to just about everything. If I return to this country, I would stay there again.
Thanks Felipe!

Kat was super responsible and the checkin instructions were definitely super well organized, I felt very secure and well informed before coming to the apartment.
The location is excellent and there are plenty of mini markets in the neighborhood. We were in a group of three and the space was definitely good.

We spent a weekend at Camila's place to attend an event, it was our first time in Chile. Camila sent clear instructions for us to self checkin, which was very convenient for our late arrival. She was also very kind to allow us a late checkout as well so we could rest a bit more before going back home. The apartment was clean and tidy and we had everything we needed for our short stay. Thank you again for having us!
Christian was an absolutely fantastic host. This place had everything I needed during my two month internship - perfect for a student!

Maritza was a great host and gave some very good advice for what to do and where to go in Santiago. This Airbnb was located in a perfect location to balance peaceful area with seeing the city. There is a close metro station and everything else you need. The apartment was clean and has all the amenities I needed for my stay. I recommend this stay to anyone looking for a great place in Stgo. The view from the balcony is incredible and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you!

Mabel was an amazing host, not only extremely responsive, but made the check-in process very easy. We had some issues with the WiFi and she immediately went to figure out what was wrong and gave us alternatives that worked. Not only that, Mabel was so friendly and approachable, we ended up talking about how she was involved in the construction of the Metro during her first years as a professional architect.
The place was very well designed, extremely clean and located in a very nice and safe neighborhood, close to a bustling area of Santiago, crossing the Mapocho river. I would stay again here in a heartbeat.
The apartment is in a great and safe location. There are many eateries and other shops. Plus, you're not fair from Gran Torre Santiago. The tallest building in South America by walking.
Gonzalo is very kind. Gonzalo and David good people.  I enjoyed my stay at their  place and enjoyed my stay in Santiago.  I Recommend it.

We loved our stay at Maritza’s studio! Even though it is attached to their house, it is sectioned off and private and cosy. It was modern, clean and warm and we really loved spending time outside in the courtyard. The location is EXCELLENT, across the road from the metro and within walking distance of parks and shops. Maritza and her mother were prompt to responding to our messages and were so accomodating to all of our needs. We would have loved to have stayed longer. Thank you so much! :-)

Matias was an awesome host! The house was perfectly located and both Matias and his mum were very helpful for our whole trip. They both went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable and had a good time. A very cosy house and we'd highly recommend the house and Matias as a host.

Great place to stay specially if you are going shopping. Easy access and close to big malls
The place felt secure and peaceful. Good to have a mini market nearby . Andre was always responsive and helpful. The place was like it looks in the picture
Vilma is warm and welcoming. Her place is well located, clean, and has good views.
We loved Marcelo’s place! Perfect for adults and children, loved the heated pool/jacuzzi. Definitely recommend to everyone!

A garden that could hardly be more beautiful than straight out of your dream, a sweet little house you can't help but fall in love with and a peace that is hard to find anywhere else in such a city-center location. Short and simple - the perfect Santiagohome.
Great stay with a private balcony. The furniture setup was different than the one shown on the pictures but made the place look a lot better.
Great value for money and also a great location! The apartment is as shown in the ad. The only negative point is that the bed linen was not very clean.
Roxanne's house was excellent. Its location is convenient to the airport and Metro giving easy access to Santiago. The room has a private bathroom and is very comfortable
We had a great time stay at Mireya's place. Everything was as advertised and building's front desk were really welcoming. Looking forward to our next stay there 😊

We LOVED staying at Nancy's apartment.  It is right in the heart of a fun and safe district.  We are avid runners and bikers and the apartment could not have been better located for these activities.  It was clean and Nancy has documented the instructions for everything in the apartment (although it was all easy to use).  It was great to have a washer/dryer.  Even though the apartment was near lots of restaurants, it was super quiet.  Nancy responds right away. This is an absolute top rate find.   We will always fondly remember our stay here.
The place was amazing. Near of everything, easy to get inside, and equipped with everything you need for a perfect stay!

Great location and very comfortable apartment.
Ivan is a great host, was always just a short message away.
I recommend Ivan and his apartments. I will definitely be looking at staying at one of his properties on a future trip.
Gracias Ivan !

The decor is a little old but it had exactly what was needed. Anita and his husband are both very friendly and were ready to answer any questions and provide anything needed to make the stay comfortable.

Everything was great.
I don't even know what to add.
If you want to live comfortably in Santiago, come to HOM. It has everything and more.

From the first moment we met Ruben and his son we felt welcomed and cared for.
They are so friendly and respectful.
helped us so much with everything to get to the apartment, gave us helpful tips on how to behave and where to go.
The apartment feels like home, they provided everything for the shower from soap shower gel to wet wipes.
it doesn't exist everywhere.
The apartment was clean and the view is very beautiful at sunset with the mountains behind the buildings.
The building is secure, with 24/7 guards.
We've had such a nice stay in Santiago and it started here.
We recommend it to everyone who cares for clean, nice feels like home places to sray in.
Thank you Ruben and family.

The place was being Reno drywall was being put in and mold in bath, good for single who can’t afford better but bathroom needs work! Felipe was helpful and responds quickly, has dogs so if you have allergies do not.
Very central place with lots of bars and restaurants around. Still very quiet in the apartment. Very charming and helpful host.
It was very nice place to stay, nice neighborhood and I wish to come back again sometime. I hope my next year visit, it will be available. Thanks so much for everything.

The apartment was perfect for a longer stay as we had everything we needed, including a shared laundry that works with coins. The host was very responsive and tried to solve any issues we came across. The location is great, close to the bars and restaurants in Lastarria, yet quiet enough to sleep well. There is also a big supermarket right next door.

Javier and his place was great!!
He and Hector were Fantastic in responding to my questions.
Fantastic area
Near mall and restaurants
Great trip!

Nelson and Valentina had a lovely place which was very conveniently located! My husband and I spoke minimal Spanish and found the front desk very helpful and patient with us. Both Valentina and Nelson were very kind, informative and pleasant to talk to. The place was perfect for our 5 night stay in Chile! :)
Great place! Great vibes! Great building! Felt right at home! Really enjoyed the place!

Beautiful, quiet and clean apartment with plenty of space and amenities. There was absolutely nothing I was missing during my stay. The location is perfect, lots of bars and sights are close by.
Cristian is an excellent host and made me feel right at home. If you’re looking for an AirBnb in Santiago, this is the most perfect place!!

We stayed for 4 days during this time we really enjoyed the amazing views of the city and mountains every day. great location to move around close access to transport, shops and restaurants.
it was great having everything you need in the kitchen and nice hot water. we will definitely recommend this place and we will be back for sure.
thanks to the host for the great communication during our stay.
the Baez Family from ,Australia 🇦🇺

Great location with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby to chose from.
Clara was great at proactively reaching out to make sure we had everything we need to check in and checkout. We arrived earlier than the standard check in time and without hesitation Clara made sure the flat was ready for us.

I has a wonderful stay! The apartment was spotless and beautiful. The building has a well-equipped gym, parking was easy and the location was perfect. Lots of shops around and a beautiful park right behind the building.  The bed was comfortable and the view to the Andes was beyond gorgeous!  I was very pleased with my stay.
The host was attentive and accommodating.  The place itself was just as described. I recommend anyone coming to Santiago to stay there.

Very clean and comfortable. Very well equipped and great location; near many good restaurants.
Highly recommend.

Excellent location and super clean and organized. Max use of a studio space with all the amenities of a hotel room.  Ignacio provided all the details I needed to check in easily. Will recommend to others!

Eduardo was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating. Check-in instructions were detailed and helpful.
The apartment was very clean and well stocked.I could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place;I would stay here again easily!
Great little place in Ñuñoa close to transit and in general very well located. Safe building and very attentive host
We love this place. Second time staying here and we will probably keep booking it the following years.

Stylish apartment near Parque Arauco in Las Condes. Lately I like to stay in that area when in Santiago, usually between flights, it is more quiet and modern compared to other areas but still with great access to shopping and restaurants. I actually stayed in this building before, this apartment is a bit larger than one I used earlier in the same building. It has everything one would need, including good WiFi. A couple of good TVs as well. Very spacious, clean, warm during this time of the year when still chilly during the night. Everything nearby, groceries, restaurants. Good view toward the mountains from the balcony. Communication with Jessica very smooth, will try to use this apartment again during a future trip.
Small house but full with all the equipments you need, very cozy and warm, Gisela is very nice and her goldens are cute and welcoming, plus the location is great 👍

Overall, the place was clean and good. The location was great for what we needed and the area is nice.
The only thing I would recommend the owner is to change the pans as it was very hard to cook and clean.

This is a lovely 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment. The kitchen is well stocked and we cooked all of our meals there. Everything was very clean and comfortable. You can walk to the Colorado ski center but we found it easier to drive with all of our equipment. The view is unreal. The concierge also allowed us to check out a couple hours late. I highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again.

This place is an absolute vibe. Killer views from everywhere in the house and a terrace with a panorama of the city that is difficult to beat anywhere in the world. The bed was comfortable. The shower was piping hot. The location is killer. And to top it off, Juan is ALWAYS on top of communication and can recommend great restaurants as well as arrange reliable and professional transportation to and from the airport. Bottom line, if you're a bachelor or traveling as a couple, look no further. This is the apartment you want.
Great stay, comfortable bed, good location. Good wifi too + comfortable desk if you need to work online. I recommend it!
I really enjoyed this location and the apartment was great as well. I would absolutely stay here again!

I went with some friends and our stay was amazing. The place is exactly as it is in the photos, it was super clean and the bedlines were like in a hotel.
The neighborhood is safe, close to restaurants and cafes. Besides all of this, the hosts provided clear instructions and were super friendly.

A gorgeous apartment, perfect for 2 people. It was clean with plenty of storage and the amenities were great, had everything we need to cook meals etc. Nice balcony, tv with loads of applications & comfy bed. The shower did get cold quite quickly though it was difficult for 2 people to shower one after the other without it getting colder. There are also laundry facilities in the lower level (for us the washer and dryer both required 1800 in coins, and needed to purchase/ bring detergent - it took us a while to figure this out with the language barrier with the very lovely lady at the lobby but it was great overall). Location is decent, less than 10 mins to subway and a minute from a supermarket. Loved our stay

The location is excellent. Good restaurants and places for drinks at the entrance surrounds of the building. I'd highly recommend Quitral for dinner. Close walk to Cerra Santa Lucia which is well worth exploring. Kitchen is well stocked. Water pressure in showers is fantastic.

This apartment was efficient and located across the street from a subway / bus hub and across the street from a supermarket.  Very convenient for exploring the city  The view of the city and the Andes is spectacular. The building is doorman controlled. The bed is comfortable!
nice secure apartment and apartment building with security. place is a little smaller than expected but for the price is worth it. close to metre and many bars and restaurants. area is very safe.

Ana Maria and her husband are wonderful people - kind, caring, warm and love hosting and meeting people. Great communication, flexibility on check-in, and breakfast was provided.
My visit to Santiago will be more memorable. Thank you for everything.

Good apartments for one week staying with 1.5 year-old kid. Big supermarket 5 minutes far. Walkable distance to historical places. Nice comfortable building area with playground, coworking, reading room which our baby liked the most 😁
We're grateful to have stayed at David's apartment! It's a little cozy for a family of 4, but we spent a lot of time going out, so it was fine. Highly recommended

The apartment was just as described- comfortable and clean. We were greeted warmly by Susan's husband Maurice and Susan was easy to contact if needed. The area felt very safe and the locals are open to tourists. It was great being in walking distance  to cafes, restaurants and a vibrant street life . The downside to that is that there can be street noise in the  early hours of the morning ( not uncommon in Santiago) . Even so, I would happily stay again .
Cristian was extremely responsive and reflexive with check in which was much appreciated. The apartment is perfectly located in the middle of cafes and restaurants and well priced
very well located, a big grocery across street, lots of shops & restaurants less than 5 min oof walk. The place is clean and nice. I cannot complain of anything but the lack of a good cork screw 😆
Great place to stay for a few days as we first got to Santiago. Accommodated an early check in with no issues. Place was clean and comfortable.
Great place in a beautiful neighborhood.  The hosts were incredibly kind and accommodating.  Would absolutely recommend staying here!
this location was excellent and easy to find. I would gladly stay here again on a future visit.
Wonderful experience, I will definitely be back. The  studio is  safe and centrally located and Ana Maria very kind and helpful.
Jessica was incredibly responsive. If we needed something she always replied within minutes. She is a wonderful host. Nothing to say about her. Totally recommendable.

Maichle is excellent host.
Arrange my luggage storage before
checking time.
I will definitely come back again .

We were happy with the apt, it had everything we need to cook a few meals and work remote. It’s a 15min walk to the metro and there are good bus lines near by. The balcony with the bbq was great. Unfortunately there are a few large dogs in the house around the street that constantly barked at all hours.

Ivan was very responsive.
I had some misunderstanding about where to return the key after, but that was my fault. I asked the receptionist of the apartment what to do with it, and I thought they had said to put it in a box, but that was me misunderstanding the Spanish.
The only problem with the place itself was the lack of shower curtain--there was a hard plastic barrier that partially blocked water, but no real curtain, and I had to be careful in the shower and then still dry the floor after. That's why I gave 4 stars instead of 5.
Otherwise, great place!

Excellent host and apartment! Mauricio reached out before check in to coordinate time and provide instructions. Apartment was just like the pictures, with a great view of Santiago.
