Air Conditioner made the stay comfortable and was controllable from remote. Building had concierge 24 hours and small gym access. Would definitely recommend and stay again!
It was in a perfect location. The train and restaurants were all just a few minutes walking. The views from the balcony were amazing! Felipe was also very helpful and responsive!
Good location, close to a big terminal! Easy access to bus and metro. Neighborhood is not the best, but the apartment is pretty clean and well organized.

If you are a group of friends or a family looking to spend time in Santiago, then this house is for you.  3 bedrooms & 3 bathrooms allowed us, 5 friends, to have our own space but also provided common areas  including a patio. We felt safe here walking around the neighborhood. The Costenera Center, the tallest building in Santiago with a shopping mall & a huge grocery store, was within easily walkable. A nearby pedestrian mall  had many restaurants. Two metro stops were a 10 minute walk and provided us with easy access to downtown and the museums as well as other attractions. The nearby San Cristobal Hill  Teleferica provided us with a view of the city.  Mable was an excellent host, providing some breakfast staples knowing we were tired after traveling and stocking the freezer with ice.  She was easily accessible and answered all our questions quickly. We hope you enjoy the house as much as much as we did.

Very central location. Walking distance to all places of interest in El Centro, Lastarria and nice little parks & cafes. Description matches the apartment 100%. The views from the apartment are stunning: don't miss the sunset. Communication was most excellent. I'll be back :-)

the loft was beautiful & had amazing amenities.
noise was as previous guests have explained but nothing to bad.
safe & security fully aware of whoever comes & goes!

Beautiful and modern apartment, located in a very secure area with a lot of restaurants around. Philip was very polite and always quick to attend our needs. Always making sure we were okay. We had a great experience. Thank you Philip!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our 10 night stay …..the location is fabulous, easy access to the Metro and key sights, supermarkets and Cerro San Cristobal.
Accommodation was as described and perfect for our needs and good value for money.
Lighting is limited but ok for our needs and some cooking utensils are a little tired if you do want to self cater at all.
Many thanks

Amazing location! Closed to convenience stores, parks, subway and mall. We loved the area and the surroundings; we always felt safe. Only 15 min walk to Pueblito Los Dominicos which is one of our favorite landmarks to visit and highly recommended since it has lots of artists showcasing Chilean arts and crafts.
Place was exactly as pictured and communication with Catalina was always prompt. We had a lovely view of the city and watch amazing sunsets every evening.

Providencia is a great neighborhood home base if you're staying in Santiago for more than a few days, and Nancy's apartment is in an excellent location in Providencia - less than 5mins walk to the metro and rental car place and garage. Tons of restaurants, markets, and shops around, and very safe to walk around even late at night. The apartment is cozy and comfortable for 2 adults, but I would find it too cozy for a larger party.
Nancy is an excellent host: very responsive and always available for questions and assistance. And the building staff were all very friendly and helpful.
The only issues were that the half bath wasn't functional during our stay and that the apartment is not well insulated from noise. Construction was going on on the upper floors during our stay, and we heard a lot of banging during the day while we were working.
Otherwise great, and we'd happily stay there again.

Ive stayed in this room for over 2 months and I have had an amazing time. The room is clean and has everything you need. The kitchen is complete and the bed is good. The hosts are very responsive and help you with everything. For example, because of the lenght of my stay I asked for cleaning, which they provided!
The area of the building is fine, I felt safe. The only downside I can think of is there arent that many good restaurants on walking distance.
All in all, ive had an amazing time. Very good hosts and chill room!

Mario was very attentive, responsive and helpful. The place was very comfortable and felt like a home for our stay in Chile. Would absolutely stay here again and would recommend to others. Area is fantastic and the place is just perfect.

That stay was terrible!
Toilet was broken! I write to STR to fix the problem but they didnt fix it for three days, then i fixed it myself.
Wifi disnt work! Also write to them and they didnt fix it for 14 days, entire stay.
And at the end of stay they send me an email that next time i can get a 3 percent discount.
Disaster!
Camilo's place is beautiful!  Lots of light, spacious, and comfortable beds, plus it's near great neighborhoods and restaurants. I highly recommend it!
I had a great time at this place. Christian was very helpful for both check in and out. I also thought the area was both amazing and a relaxing setting. I would go back!

Great place to stay for checking out Santiago. It’s near a couple of metro stations so you can easily get a ride elsewhere in the city. There’s also some food trucks and good cafes nearby. The apartment is on the 27th floor so there isn’t much street noise. The host is polite and responsive which was helpful.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Francisco's home. Francisco personally met us at the house and walked us through all of its unique rooms, features, and even the story behind some of the artistic pieces in the home. It is perfectly situated and walkable to nearby restaurants and shopping, or a very short car ride to most anything you could want to see. We spent a great deal of time out on the private terrace enjoying wine and the sounds of dance lessons taking place across the street. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the house spotless, and overall...everything was just fantastic. Highly recommended for anyone visiting beautiful Santiago!!!
The getting warm water for the shower was a bit tricky. But overall, it was a great stay. As females, we felt safe there.

the place is just as described. great location, great apartment, great and understanding host. wifi was super fast. it is in a busy area and there can be some noise in the morning. but that's true everywhere is Santiago. would recommend

Mireya’s place is very comfortable for a few days stay in Santiago. It is equipped in everything you might need. Mireya’s been very helpful and communicative, always responding quickly to any questions. The instructions to access the apartment were accurate and easy to follow. Smooth experience and a comfortable stay in a comfortable environment.
Fantastic stay, very nice area and very nice appartament. Definitely reccomend, walking distance to everything you need. Host very helpful.

We had a very nice stay in this appartment! It had everything we needed; a nice bed, a fully equipped kitchen and a possibility to wash our clothes. We felt like home and had a nice communication with the owners. The only downside; it costs us €15 to store our bags for 2 hours after check-out. Francisca mentioned that there would be a price for the storage, but €15 is overpriced in our opinion.
We would recommend this place :)!
Thanks for acommodation. Incredible place and near a trains stations, markets, museum and historical places. I appreciate it. see you next time!

We had a very pleasant stay at this Apartment. Tomas and Nacho made us feel right at home and the apartment is just beautiful and has also a top view. Our room was cozy and the bathroom perfect and clean. I would definitely book again. Wish you all the best!! :)

Stayed again with Carlos and Karen and can inly repeat again:
Perfect apartment, lovely host and absolute beautiful neighborhood. Host is very friendly and supportive of all asks. We were able to check-in earlier and also leave our luggage. Entering the apartment via code makes it easy and flexible. Would 100% recommend and will stay again once back in Santiago. Gracias!
Elderly costumers need to know the apartment is located on third floor in building without elevator.

I’m so happy I chose to stay with Vilma and Nikita! They welcomed me like family and made me feel at home right away. Their place is very clean, and though it’s slightly outside the city center, both the bus and metro are just a short walk away, making it easy to explore Santiago.
Their warmth and hospitality really stood out—free use of the washing machine, amazing Peruvian food, great conversations, and even showing me around on the weekend. It truly felt like the good old days of Airbnb! I’d absolutely recommend staying here and would love to come back. Thank you so much, Vilma and Nikita!

Everything is good, location and all.
I recommend this place to others.
Thank you!

Great place in a fantastic neighborhood, with lots of coffee shops, restaurants, pharmacies, souvenir shops, retail, public transportation (subway station is just a block away), and several landmarks within walking distance (city center, Neptune's fountain, Pablo's Neruda neighborhood/home, etc.). Easy and responsive communication with the hosts. I also appreciate the early check-in.

The apartment is in a nice area with many shops. Enough space. The shower is a little bit difficult to handle because the shower head is damaged. The kitchen could be more clean and some things could be renewed.
All together I would recommend the apartment👍
A smaller but very comfortable space in a great neighborhood! We enjoyed our stay and Alejandra was easy to communicate with and made sure the space was ready. Recommended!

Beautiful apartment with a nice view to the mountains and great location close to the Costanera Center and the subway.
There is security all day and night and I did not had problems to get in to the building.

Great location, just a 10-minute walk from the nearest subway station, quiet neighbourhood, but close to bars and restaurants. The place itself was very clean and has all you can need for a good stay.

The apartment was in a wonderful location, near the metro and Pueblito Los Domínicos. Very safe. The bathrooms had mold and mildew on the ceilings.  The walls were very scruffy, could use a coat of paint. The balcony had a beautiful view but was in need of repair. Host was kind and let us keep our car parked a bit longer.

Good location and Great views!  This apartment in Providencia is a close walk to several great areas to check out: Barrio Italia, Bella Vista, Lastarria and Bella Artes. The views are spectacular from the apartment and roof terrace. There are a few restaurant options just outside the building and several market options nearby too. The hosts were responsive and very helpful. Highly recommend!

We stayed at the apartment twice and both times it was ok. We had to reach out ourselves on the day of the arrival to get instructions, but then it all worked out well. The bedroom/living room is nice. The kitchen and bathroom could use some renovation as they are rather old. Also, the kitchen could be way better equipped: there wasn't enough cutlery for two, the sponge was an used one. We got just one roll of toilet paper for our stay. There are some things to improve, however, allover our stay was good.

A good stay! The location was great for a lot of the things we wanted to do in Santiago. The neighborhood is very peaceful and not to far from the metro. There’s even a few restaurants across the street and a convenience store. The apartment was clean and a great value for the price! We had one issue with the bathroom but the hosts were quick to help fix it. Truly appreciated it. A great stay in Santiago.

I was in this Airbnb for almost a month.  It was a wise choice because it had all the amenities I could have asked for.  The kitchen had diverse pots and pans, things to store food in, plenty of places and bowls, etc.  Nice four burner gas stove.  One big attraction is dual washer/dryer. I used it several times.  I have never used a combo like this, but it worked great. The apartment is close to many restaurants and shops and is right next to a big famous historic park (Santa Lucia).  The neighborhood felt very safe.  The host was quick to respond whenever I had issues, but I rarely had issues.  Highly recommend and I've been in Airbnbs all over the world.

I would highly recommend Cristians apartment. It's not only very practical, but also has a comfy vibe to it. It's  in a nice neighbourhood, super central and close to the metro. We really enjoyed our stay.
Loved everything about this place, and the host is so helpful. Highly recommend to anyone wanting to stay in Santiago.

This is a really cool place to stay. The location couldn't be better - you are literally in the heart of Lastarria. This means it can be noisy in the evenings but the noise stops at a reasonable hour way before bedtime. The hosts communicated really well and everything was as expected and more. The home was great for my wife and my parents during our short stay in Santiago - close to all the attractions we wanted to see.
Very nice apartment. Central location. Great and friendly host. Wifi worked great. We could work from the partment. Can fully recommend.

Our second stay at Camilo’s place. Our plane came in late and Camilo sent very simple clear instructions on how to use the key box and enter the apartment. We love the area it is in and Camilo sends a great list of local restaurants, our favourite is  Casaluz only 5 minutes walk from the apartment and the food and the atmosphere is fantastic!

Francisco was a wonderful host and very easy to communicate with. Whenever we saw him (he lives across the hall) he would make sure we had everything we needed. The street where the property is located is beautiful and quiet but still very central.
The apartment could use a few updates—the door of the bathroom swells with the moisture of the shower and will get stuck and the blinds could use a clean/be replaced. But the bedding was incredibly clean and crisp which is the most important to me. Overall it was a good apartment for us and I would stay there again.
Second time I booked this apartment, and it was as great as the first time, very recommended.
José was very helpful and communicative. The apartment was clean with a very nice view and in a fun neighborhood

Héctor is very nice.
Always here for a small talks but just enough. So it's very nice ! He also gives good advice.
The apartment is very central. Close to restaurants, to the zoo and to the Funicular.
We really enjoyed our stay 👌
We had a wonderful stay in Santiago. The place was exactly as described, and communication exceeded our expectations- the hosts were flexible, clear & SO friendly. Would absolutely recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay here - the view of the mountains was amazing, and the parking spot in the busy city was definitely a plus.  Thank you!

Cute place in Lastarria! Convenient location for exploring by foot- Santa Lucia hill, cerro cristobal, Bella vista, plaza de armas. They were able to offer early check in for a fee which saved us after taking a red eye flight and arriving at 6am.

Great place to stay in central Santiago. The apartment was well equipped and comfortable. Plenty of restaurants nearby and within walking distance of the beautiful Santa Lucia hill. We would definitely stay again if back in Santiago

We stayed for 4 nights and this place is great. From the initial communication to adding an extra night, everything was super smooth. There is 24h security at the door and we felt always safe. Supermarket just downstairs, great coffee shop within 2min.
The unit is exactly as described, which suited us well

Great place to stay in Santiago for up to 2ppl. Amazing location, great view, super clean and as described. Not to mention that compared to similar price options in Santiago is the best you can find!!
Excellent apartment, close to many good spots. Very clean, spacious and bright. The hosts are very attentive and their communication is good. I would stay here again if I ever come to Santiago again.

It’s a very cozy apartment located in a neighborhood with lots of good restaurant options. Maria is very responsive and attentive to our questions and needs. The bedding is super comfortable! I highly recommend this place
This is one of the best airbnb we have stayed in. Period. Nothing else to say. Juan was excellent in communication.
Great location, walking distance to heaps of restaurants and bars. Nice streets and lovely neighbourhood. Room has everything needed for a 2 person stay.

Everything was great! Apartment clean & had everything you needed. Cristian was really responsive and went out of his way to accommodate - he even provided a few additional items for cooking that we requested! Location is great, walkable to everything and the metro is super close to reach the bus stations / Providencia.

Cesar is very helful to the guest's request.
though I arrived at airport early in the morning, he proposed me to do early check in.
though it is my first time to use coin washing machine at basement, the staff was eager to help me how to use it.
thanks Mr. Cesar

The place was fantastic - felt so comfortable and spacious. The location was great with superb restaurants and bars nearby, and an easy walk to the metro. They were so communicative and the most helpful leading up to our trip!
Well located for several tourist spots. Everything in the apartment is well kept and is a good base for anything you could want in the Providencia area!

Location Location Location. Great little unit - perfect for 2 people. Not knowing the area well at all it turned out to be a great and very safe location…lots of restaurants, cafes, major shopping Center - including the attached Sky Costanera Tower as well as a grocery store were all very close by.  For those who like to take the metro this was also just around the corner.  It was just a 20 minute walk to the Oasis Station ( cable car for San Cristobal Hill) Ignacio was super proactive with easy check in instructions as well as airport  taxi tips.
We loved our stay here, very walkable, coffee shop next door. We had a late flight and we were able to hangout on the rooftop/terrace after checkout! 10/10 recommend!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Mabel’s.   The house was beautiful and the location perfect, very walkable to many places downtown.  Mabel was highly communicative.  Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Santiago!

This is a good base to explore Santiago from because of the nearby subway station. We went everywhere using the subway and our Bip card.
Just a few blocks away is lively Avenida Italia with lots of restaurants, galleries and bars.
Maria was very accommodating and always available to help. Her English was good enough for us English only speakers, but Google Translate was able to help if needed.
Antonio was very responsive and helpful. The apartment was clean and as described. Good location near Cerro San Cristobal
Place was great, location and distribution. We definitely enjoyed the days we were in Santiago thanks to the versatility of Providencia

We had a great stay for 3 days 2 people. It’s was the perfect neighborhood and location for our trip. Filled with excellent restaurants, cafes, bars and shopping. The apartment is clean and nice and looks like the photos. Just know that even if the kitchen is fully equipped there’s so cooking oil, spices etc. and if the pool is important to you, double check so it’s not closed for winter season. Could also be good to know that they’re no luggage storage and for later check out you have to pay extra. But overall we had a great stay!

Cristian‘s place is perfect for a stay in Santiago. Exactly as the description and easy to find access with lots to do nearby.
Cristian is a very friendly and responsive host.

Conveniently located, easy access, 24 hour friendly and obliging concierge, excellent cafe with very friendly staff next door where we had breakfast. Some very good restaurants nearby. Found a really fabulous restaurant a couple of blocks away (cant remember the name unfortunately) where we had a memorable meal. We were only in Santiago for a couple of of days and thoroughly enjoyed our time.
Place was as described and in a safe area. Pool in the roof top was an added touch.

Great appartment located in one of the best part of the city!
The view is superb, not only from the appartment but from the roof as well. And there is a pool up there.
The area is very active at night, as there are tons of bars and night-clubs. Also many good restaurants just 5mins away.
And special mention for Alvaro, one of the best host out there, always looking to help!
If you want to be in a vibrant part of Santiago, then this place is for you :)
I would recommend staying here to all of my friends! Felipe is a great host and the listing is a great place to stay. Close to the metro, restaurants, and things to do.

Alejandro’s apartment is a perfect spot if u wanna visiting Santiago. Location is great, apartement is comfortable. Alejandro is a very helpful host and also a nice companion if you feel a bit lost in Chile.
We had a great a great stay! Philip was incredibly helpful and responsive and the location was perfect!
Andres Enrique and wife were most welcoming. The place was clean and well provided and the location was excellent.

Valentina was a lovely host who was always available to help with our questions! The accommodation was in a perfect location - easily walkable to many sights and restaurants. The apartment is small and cosy and just like the photos. thanks for having us Valentina!
Excellent place to stay! The place is very close to the subway station and with easy access from the airport. Also a safe place to stay. Alis was very helpful and proactive. Would stay again!

Bernabe’s was a great host and made us feel very welcome at his accommodation. His apartment was comfortable and clean and walking distance to museums and places of interest. Bernabe was very attentive , offered to collect from airport and offered / provided a great tour to Valparaiso and Vin a de la mer . We would highly recommend to stay at Bernabe’s place on your visit to Santiago.
It’s a lovely apartment and we had a great stay. If we needed anything Oliver was quick to respond. Would happily stay here again.

Can’t say much because everything was perfect. Andrea and her family were super friendly. I was feeling quite homesick and choosing to stay with Andrea and her family was the best choice and it made me feel right at home from day one.
Thank you for your kindness, it won’t be forgotten - and I’ll definitely be back 🌷

great place to stay, walkable distances and great wifi.
has no elevators so keep that in mind since is just 3 floors by stairs.
yeny is amazing, always available and friendly

Camila and her family were very welcoming to us and their 2 month old kitty was adorable! They generously lent us their travel adapter when we both forgot ours. The house/room was clean, easy to find, and in the center of the city near fun neighborhoods to explore. The only downside perhaps of our particular room was that the window faced the "interior" of the building, so we did not get much sun or fresh air, but that is a minor personal preference that did not affect our stay. :)

I will say that the home is beautiful and we were very excited to stay here. We were unhappy that the television in the living area was missing and so our plans to be together in the living room to watch tv didn’t happen. The place could have been cleaner as well. I think most disappointing was the response times after we checked in. In some cases several hours before a response which led to a changes in plans due to not hearing back from host in a reasonable time. Carla did make an accommodation for us for a later check out due to the missing tv. I do greatly appreciate that.

Stayed in this room for 2 days for some sightseeing after a business trip in the area.
The neighborhood and the building is particular is very high standard and very calm. Elisabeth was very nice and I even had a parking spot for the rental car which was very convenient for me.

Wonderful cozy apartment. Feels like home. Pleasant smell of fragrance . The kitchen has all the utensils. There is tea, coffee, oil and spices. White clean quality linen. Soft warm blanket. Comfortable soft mattress. The bath is clean and has nice white towels. Shower cubicle with a comfortable good shower. There is a hairdryer, shampoo, soap, conditioner. Balcony overlooks a quiet backyard. Near bus stop and grocery stores.
Really enjoyed living here! Thank you
We loved our stay here! A beautifully decorated flat with lots of natural light, in a building with 24/7 security.

Perfect location in a quite neighborhood    close to barrio Italia ! Gonzalo was friendly and provided useful recommendation. The apartment is spacious , though it is not super bright . Not an issue for us . Good value for money. Recommended
Our first stay here was great, but this time around the bed was damaged and cleaning wasn't like before. Sara apologised and said they would fix the issues.

Cristian's house is a great place to stay in a perfect neighborhood - Lastarria.  My expectations were exceeded in every way. Plenty of space inside, extremely walkable to multiple restaurants, bars, and the Metro, and the feeling of having a true home to come back to in Santiago.   Perhaps the best part of this experience was meeting Cristian himself. He is super friendly, responds immediately to any needs, and goes out of his way to ensure we have a wonderful time in the city he loves. (We even Facetimed his brother in Miami for additional food and activity recommendations!)  I now feel like I have a friend in Santiago, and am already planning my return!

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The apartment was spotless, and had all the amenities I needed to feel right at home. The location was fantastic—close to public transportation, great restaurants, and local shopping.
Justo was incredibly friendly and responsive, providing helpful tips about the area and making sure everything was perfect throughout my stay. I would absolutely stay here again on my next trip to Santiago and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

We came to APT because a terrible airbnb experience the night prior. They didn’t accept our request yet but we walked in and they didn’t everything on the spot. We are digital workers so this space was amazing. Good coworking space,adequate gym and great apartment! The spot is located in a beautiful and safe community. Would stay again!
Perfect for long and short-term stays. Area is extremely safe for gringos and gringas. Andrea was a great host and wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.

Felipe’s apartment with a view in Santiago was a haven for us. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, good-sized balcony with views, workable kitchen and a welcome bottle of wine as well as water. Felipe was an impeccable host, always quick to respond and very helpful. Only quibble was the single bed in the second bedroom is not very long if you are a tall person. But recommend highly.
Great place to stay, comfortable and clean. Very nice location. Patricio was friendly and responded quickly.

This is one of my favorite Airbnb experiences ever. The house has a fascinating history, and each apartment honors a different Chilean couture designer. The decor is stylish and beautiful, with hand-crafted objects, and architectural details. It's also very comfortable,, quiet, and ultra-safe.
I loved the location, an easy walk to the Costanera shopping complex, complete with Jumbo (giant grocery store) and surrounded by restaurants and shops.
Mabel and the staff are friendly and kind.
One suggestion, if you're not familiar with it... get the DiDi app. It works like Uber, but is more popular in Chlie, so you know the price and the driver knows the address.
I hope to return to Casa Cardoch the next time I'm in Santiago,
Wonderful and clean space about only 10 min walk to the center, and absolutely loved the company of the cutest dog Marley!

Incredible views over the city and over to the Andes mountain range. Really great central location to get out and explore the city. During the day the street outside is bustling with activity & street markets with a wide selection of souvenir gifts and food.
Like many big cities you do need to be more wary at night time when the streets are much less busy.
The apartment was comfortable and clean. Carlos was friendly and helpful with great recommendations. We really enjoyed our stay here.

Loved the place, you can watch beautiful sunsets from here. The check in and check out experience is really easy. The only caveat is there are some homeless people a block away from this place but i never felt threatened/concerned.

Highly recommended, would absolutely stay again. Very friendly and responsive host, clean and comfortable accommodation with great amenities. Appreciate that there was even a sewing kit available. The area of Santiago felt safe and there are many good restaurants within walking distance.
Magdalena is an incredible host. Always friendly and helpful and kind. Also a beautiful garden and terrace area out back.

I had a great time here. The apartment was small, but clean and everything worked ok. The gym and swimming pool in the building were great. The area is good - you can easily reach the centre of Santiago by foot and there are plenty of good shops and restaurants nearby.
Camila was friendly and approachable. The space was great. The shower was a little tight but we were able to manage.
perfect space and well located with city center a few minutes away. the apartment was as described and very clean

Great little find and spectacular view! Neighbourhood is very safe and is within walking distance of good restaurants and parks. There is a laundrette in the basement which was very useful for us after a few weeks of travelling. Gabriel was very helpful giving us information during our stay.

Fantastic location and definitely worth what you pay. Communication on where the apartment is and how to enter, park would be helpful. Slightly hard to figure out for foreigners. Overall very happy with the accommodation itself!

We had another great stay in this apartment   Pepe and Erika are extremely responsive. The apartment is well appointed and comfortable, in a great location. Great cable TV and we appreciated the access to the paid washer and dryer. Just across the street from some great restaurants.  We will be back.

Great place for few days in Santiago.
We reached it easily from the airport by Bus and metro. Santa Lucia Station is only a few minutes away. Also lot of restaurants closeby as well as a Supermarket.
The Apartment itself had everything you need to feel at home. Great kitchen and wifi!
Highly recommended!
Rodrigo had a nice place and was responsive but the shower drain was clogged and unfortunately was unable to get it fixed during the full duration of my stay.

It was great place for a business trips . Metro is walk in 3-4 minutes. It was very nice restaurant around this out. I was very enjoyed outside terrace. It is very safe apartment. 2beds with 2 full size baths.  This place is very good for a family or long term staying. I am highly recommend this place.Thank you Carla.

This apartment was perfect . Clean and very comfortable . It’s in a safe building with a secure guarded front entrance .
Just a short walk to a small grocery/convenience store . Also only about a 7-10 min walk from
A couple of very nice shopping areas with lots of restaurants .
Highly recommend las Condes area .

Very comfortable apartment, walking distance to pretty much anywhere in central Santiago. Metro station is literally around the corner. But the best of all are the hosts Alexis and Zule, who made everything to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Thank you!

Boris was such a great host. Highly recommend his place. He was very communicative and responsive. Apartment was centrally located and the area is very walkable with anything you need near by. The apartment is as the pictures. Nice place to stay, it has everything you need. Thank you Boris for everything!

Gustavo was super helpful from the very beginning of my reservation, trying to support me with some local information that I needed. The place was exactly what we needed for our stay in Santiago, well equipped, located and comfortable.
My stay at Andes STRs  place was absolutely wonderful! The home was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect,

The place was really well located, at walking distance (1km) from key tourism locations like the Cerros Santa Lucia and Cristobal, patio bellavista. There is a subway station that has 2 different lines less then 500m away.
The apartment is a bit date, but very comfortable, clean, lit and ventilated. It is also very quiet around the place, so good to recharge after long day walks.
I would definitely stay here again were I to come back to Santiago.

Great location, very very clean and pleasantly decorated, the little balcony is definitely a plus. Safe and quiet environment. Clara and Cristina were very accomodating, they helped me with everything I needed. I totally recommend it!

I would definitely recommend Luis’ place! The apartment is beautiful and has a lot of character. It had everything that I needed and he even left me a bottle of wine, fruit, and snacks which was awesome! There are plenty of restaurants nearby, it’s close to public transportation, and it’s walkable to nearby attractions.

This place was great! The location made most sights and many restaurants walkable (if that’s your thing), or everything is a short metro/uber away. The view from the enclosed balcony was great for breakfast and the people at the building’s reception were kind and helpful. A great launch pad for Santiago.

Outstanding experience. Mabel and her team went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. We had great communication. The apartment is beautiful and has a great view.
I really appreciated their extra effort to help me check in early after a red eye flight.

Clean and comfortable stay.  Great location, just a few steps from the #1 Red Line/Santa Lucia subway.  The apartment was just as described.  The washing machine inside one of the bathrooms was very helpful to have.  Lots of cafes, stores, and street vendors just outside to help you find anything you need.

We had a great stay! The apartment is in a brilliant location with lots of bars, cafes and restaurants within a few minutes walk. Daniela was a great host and very responsive - thanks for a great stay

Francisco was a gracious and accommodating host. He provided us with a high chair and crib prior to arrival, and he was always available to help if we needed anything.
The space was airy and bright, with green trees on a quiet residential street. It had everything we needed for a longer stay with our young children. The neighborhood has many great restaurants, and a fantastic walking and biking path, giving access to the city without the need for driving.
I would recommend Francisco’s place to anyone. He is a lovely person - kind and cheerful - and clearly cares about his guests and the space!

I had an amazing stay at Luis' place. He brought my heavy luggage upstairs, and provided some recommendations on places as well as a Bip! card for the metro. Place was in a perfect location - close by to everything but on a quiet street, and the set up was amazing. Very accommodating providing an adaptor and anything that as needed. Highly recommend :) (Also the place was spotless!)

So many walkable restaurants and shops, close to San Cristobal which was a great day of exploring. Rooftop view is incredible and the pool water was refreshing! The nights go late and so do the noises associated - not an issue just important to know ahead of the stay! It is close to 2 colleges so the neighborhood is lively. View from the loft was beautiful and everything was very, very clean. Great pillows and a comfortable bed, too!

Host was very helpful when we had a unique situation with check in time. We were able to uber or walk to all the restaurants and places where we needed to go. We loved the pool, and the hot tub was used everyday! The space is great and has lots of sun. Easy stove also to use. Great hot water
Alberto is an amazing host. He let us check in earlier, which was greatly appreciated. Can highly recommend staying here.

Nancy’s place was the perfect get away for our week long stay in Providencia. Pristine space, local recommendations, and extremely walkable locations. Nancy is so friendly and responsive and sincerely cares that you have a nice stay. 10/10 will recommend to friends. Thank you Nancy!
Such a lovely and perfect airbnb and the host Ximena an angel. She is 100% the best.

Walking distance to everything you need. So lovely to have 3 floors, each with their own bathroom. Great for 3 different parties/people. We were 5pp, so 2 couples and one single. It was perfect. Great communal areas with plenty of private space as well. Kitchen was stocked with bread, butter & eggs. It was perfect to get us thru our first morning. I will DEFINITELY stay again. I felt very safe in this neighborhood. And great birding as well.

We stayed at the Orly apartments two different times and enjoyed our stay both times. Anita and Ivan were wonderful. Anita connected us with a driver who could get us to and from the airport. Ivan was very friendly and helped keep our bags before check-in. The place is located in the heart of Providencia, 5 mins walk from the metro and nearby restaurants. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and will surely stay here in the future.
Perfect spot for our short stay. Jose was very helpful and responsive. Just like the posting, we felt right at home. Thank you for hosting us!
Beautiful place with an incredible view! It's a really nice apartment in a cool building. Very comfortable. Very clear instructions and helpful host!

This is a fabulous place to stay and get to know Santiago. It's superb location and a lot things to do around the area. It's bit small, but it's worth its location. It's perfect for a couple of solo traveler.
the apartment had everything and more, I had the best experience in Santiago also thanks to this apartment, I felt straight at home and I can't wait to go back
I had a great stay at Constanza’s place! It’s easy to access, cozy and has all the amenities I could ask for. Would highly recommend!

The apartment was modern, clean, has all the amenities you need with internet, cable TV in living area and main bedroom. The complex is modern with parking for your vehicle,  great security with concierge, pool, gym and BBQ area. It is centrally located in Santiago so you can walk to restaurants, markets, plazas, government buildings, museums, etc. The owner (Sebastian) is a respectable person whom went out of his way to meet up with us on the first day and showed us everything in the unit / complex and provided advice on tourist destinations and what to do. We've travelled from Australia 🇦🇺 and my family is very pleased with the decision of staying here. I would strongly recommend it to anyone especially if you want 'Western' standards in  terms of toilet / bathroom and security. We couldn't  have asked for anything more. We strongly recommend it and will happily return in the future.

Wonderful location and home. The patio was wonderful to relax and the kids enjoyed the swing set downstairs before we went out exploring for the day. Very comfortable beds and had well supplied kitchen if you wanted to cook. Very helpful host-great communication! Loved the location, was able to walk to the park, food trucks, etc with our small children. Highly recommend!
Great place, quiet at night and  comfortable. Could do with a some complimentary toiletries, etc but overall a very nice apartment

All around great place to stay. Area was very nice, safe, and pretty central to most tourist sites and hiking. Apartment was very nice as well, and balcony and roof were great added bonuses for hanging out when not out and about.
Great location, easy check in, apartment matches the description, great communication with Javier. Very comfortable apartment with good facilities. We would go back.

This was a fantastic place for my stay in Santiago. The apartment was very clean and comfortable, with everything I needed for a pleasant stay. I liked the large windows with nice sunlight coming in. The location is great for exploring around Santiago. I was able to cook some nice meals in the kitchen as well as get some work done with good WiFi and a peaceful environment. Alis was an excellent host, she was very friendly and responsive to messages, with clear instructions for check-in and check-out. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

The hosts were really helpful! They walked us through the check-in, gave us local recommendations, and let us store our bags for a few hours after checkout. The location near the metro and neighborhoods was also excellent. The hot water in the shower came and went in cycles, but it wasn't a big deal.

Susan and Maurucio are wonderful hosts. The apartment is spacious and nicely furnished. Perfect location in Bellas Artes district amidst many restaurants, museums and national monuments — and an 8th floor balcony to overlook it all. Late checkout was very generous before my overnight flight home. A great experience highly recommended.
Great place for a short stay, and two really cute cats.  It's a pity that the host is moving, but I understand they'll have an Airbnb at the new place as well.

Catalina´s place was great for us, our office was in the building right next door, so we could just walk there. The metro station was also within easy walking distance making it very easy to move around the city. The Domínicos park was beautiful, and right there for us to enjoy if we wanted to. Supermarket within walking distance, mall also within walking distance, although a little further than the supermarket. For us it was the ideal location. The apartment was nice, not very big but for our needs it served its purpose.
Thank you Catalina, would love to be back to your place next time.
Stayed here for 4 nights would recommend, only downside not cooking utensils and dirty in places .
Such a lovely, luxury accommodation! We enjoyed our stay. Everything was clean and we even spend some time at the pool.

It was a pleasant stay. Host is very responsive and accommodating.
Great location, nice views and balcony. It is a secure building.
Internet works well, walkable in town to restaurants.
Highly recommend .

This is a lovely, spacious and private apartment. Felt very much at home. Filled with lovely art, thoughtful touches like books and games, cards for the metro etc, kitchen well set up to cook if you wish, fantastic dining and shopping recommendations. Kind and welcoming hosts.
The area is very quiet despite being so central in the city. Felt safe and loved wandering out daily from our Santiago haven.
Highly recommend booking here.
We were very very happy.

We stayed at Maria s place for a few days and loved it. There s lot s to do and great restaurants walking distance and our son.lovrd the pool and garden. The place was super clean and had all appliances and comfortable beds and Maria was super helpful and responsive. Thank you for everything!
We had a great stay. Good and safe location. Communication could be better but overall Said is a good host and the room was very nice.
Great little apartment in Providencia. We felt very safe and secure. Perfect spot for two people. Plenty of restaurants and cafes to walk to as well!

We loved the location in Barrio Italia.  The apartment is charming and really functional.  Very nice street and safe area.  The bed was comfortable and the place was spotless.  It is as pictured.  Gonzalo came out to meet us which was nice.

Very good place to stay, in a safe building with guards
The flat was sparkling clean, and beds confortable.
Location is ideal, we highly recommend

Very well positioned apartment. A short walk to metro and next door is a group of restaurants for easy catering. Coin laundry facilities within the building were a bonus after being on road. Bed in living room is a single but met our needs. We had a slight issue with an electrical outage and the host was extremely responsive.
Excellent stay and host.  Great location within walking distance of several restaurants and financial district.  Mini markets close by to pick up essentials.
The view is amazing. We enjoyed watching the sunset with a bottle of wine from the balcony. Plus it's a central location, with a park across the street, and a metro station very close.

Hector Daniel was an amazing host with great energy. He provided clear explanations of the house and excellent recommendations for the great neighborhood all around. He was also flexible with checkout time and accommodating with laundry needs. Highly recommend. Thank you a wonderful stay

We really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb.
Fantastic location. Easy to get to all attractions.
Loved the decor and how well the space worked.
Very nice touch with the wine, fruit and chocolate.
Very flexible check in and checkout.
A great spot and would love to return.

It was as pictured, great place right across from the huge park. The park even had restaurants and bar right in the middle. The smart card registration and access was a slight pain, but it worked out just fine. I would definitely recommend and I would stay here again.

The apartment was comfortable, with all required amenities for a short stay. Moreover, the communication with the host was great. However, it is important to be alert to the surroundings of the building at night, even at moments where the streets around are busy. The staff at the building entrance was alert and helpful.

We stayed 4 nights at Cristian’s Airbnb, it was super convenient, clean and looked like the pictures. There’s many restaurants nearby and a supermarket literally next door to the building. The apartment was quiet and comfortable and made our stay a breeze.
The flat was in a central location and had enough space to stay for a couple of days. It even had a shared pool.

Great spot in Santiago! We had a great stay. We really appreciated that the host had a spot for us to out our bags so we could explore more before our flight out. The balcony was so nice and we enjoyed it every night before dinner.
Fellow coffee drinkers, just an FYI that there isn't a machine to brew or make coffee so we bought ourselves a small French press. There was instant coffee though if you are good with that!
Thanks again,
Sarah
The stay was fantastic. Great location close to everything. Maria was a great host as well. highly recommended in Santiago

Beautiful place with a great location. Beautiful mountain and city views from the balcony. Super clean place. The perfect apartment to enjoy and experience Santiago. Cristobal was very responsive and friendly!

Unbeatable location. A bit noisy at night but the music from nearby bars dies down by 11. Host was an excellent communicator. We requested a baby crib, and when the first one provided was broken, he made sure a brand new one was delivered that same night. Great stay!

We had a lovely stay at Paz’s place. It was the perfect amount of room for two people and the location is great- everywhere was in walking distance. Paz was also an amazing host. She was responsive, had great recommendations, and went out of her way to make she we were comfortable. Would 100% recommend.

Poor communication with the host. If you want informations or simple détails like the wifi password you need to reach airbnb assistance in order to get the host's number and call them because she doesn't reply to any message on the platform. She only contacted us to know when we were leaving.
5* - clear recommendation. The apartment is small, but perfect for two. Not much to add - a perfect stay for us, would always chose this apartment when returning to Santiago. Thx!

We had a fantastic stay in the apartment. The apartment was exceedingly clean, fresh and tidy. It is well equipped with a washer drier and the ability to dry clothing outside on the enclosed balcony. The furniture is clean , stylish and comfortable. I loved the open plan ,clutter free environment!
Access to the apartment is safe and secure. Staff are very helpful and friendly.
The apartment is central with the shopping centre within 10 minutes walk. The park opposite is a vibrant hub with many different activities to take part in from open air concerts to yoga classes and skate boarding competitions.
I highly recommend staying and very much look forward to returning in the future.

Everything was good. Very good location. Easy to move around. There are a lot of things to do around and it is safe.
Gonzalo is a very good host. He was communicative and kind. He welcomed us in the apartment to give the keys and show around.
Apartment is clean, bed is comfortable but we didn’t like the pillows :) there were bathroom amenities. Shower is good. Kitchen helped a lot during our 9 days stay. I really enjoyed spending time in the balcony as it has very beautiful mountainous view. Wifi is good and fast. We had a tv in front of the bed and it comes with netflix. Apartment is quite spacious and has everything you need. I was able to use the laundry room in the building. It was very handy.
All in all, we really enjoyed our stay here. I would totally recommend.

I had an incredible experience staying at Carlos’s apartment in Las Condes. The apartment is beautiful, cozy, and truly felt like home from the moment I arrived. It’s impeccably clean, well-decorated, and equipped with everything you might need for a comfortable stay.
Carlos is an amazing host—very nice, friendly, and always willing to help. From answering questions to offering great local tips, he made sure my stay was as smooth as possible.
If you’re looking for a place to stay in Santiago that combines comfort, style, and exceptional hospitality, I highly recommend this apartment. I’ll definitely be coming back!
Great location in residential complex in Santiago. Comfortable and clean flat, very kind host. With family we enjoyed it very much and would come back if there is an occasion.

I appreciated Gabriel's prompt responses to my questions. He was always helpful and the apartment is clean and comfortable with breathtaking views. A fantastic experience for my first visit to Santiago!
Great location with all the essentials. Gustavo was super responsive and helpful for a flexible arrival and departure!

Host was very helpful. she had kept eggs, bread and some other stuff in freeze. This was very helpful. Also allowed late check out.
Would recommend this place to all our friends.
really lovely stay, easy to check in, felt very safe! reception staff in the apartments were all extremely friendly! overall good stay, thank you!
nice location in the heart of hippster tourism.  Many nice places all around and easy access to the metro and the city center.  Would absolutely stay again.

Wonderful stay, perfect amenities, great location. Maria Jose was a wonderful host - good and prompt communication. The apartment is spacious and we had a great time staying there. The only thing that gave us some trouble was the internet/wifi which was a little annoying but I’m sure that can be improved easily. Thank you for welcoming us to your home Maria Jose!

A really tastefully designed flat, spacious and well appointed with a nice, sunny kitchen. The location is nice if you’re hoping to explore Barrio Italia, it’s a pretty short walk. Quiet at night, and they provided, coffee and tea which is always appreciated. Would recommend, would stay again. Gracias Por todo.

The place itself is fantastic, well equipped and perfectly located. The housekeeping lady was very friendly and helpful.
My only complaint is regarding the people or AI behind the Airbnb app, they are extremely unhelpful and provided extremely unclear check in instructions. I ended up waiting for 20 minutes on the street because I arrived that many minutes before the check in time. Lastly, I asked for them to fix something in the house and claimed they’d send someone who never came.

The apartment was beautiful and clean. The location was within walking distance to the metro and Arauco mall, with plenty of shopping opportunities in the local vicinity. The neighborhood was quiet and safe. Felipe was a wonderful and responsive host.

Maritza’s place was our first in the country. She was very responsible and sent useful tips including of safety for foreigners. Apartment was centrally located, we walked everywhere. However if you need a metro, Saint Lucia station is only a few metres up the road.
I was travelling with my infant and husband, we felt very safe. The building itself has max security and a proactive concierge.
Amazing place amazing stay Juan was available at all times for questions. Juan made my stay incredible. I can’t wait to stay again.

The location was good, the host friendly and reliable. The appartment looks recently renovated in the photographs, but in reality requires refurbishment. The bed in particular needs replacing. The chairs in the terrace were to dirty to be used.

We loved our stay here. The apartment was well appointed, clean, well laid out, close to everything we needed. I would love to stay here again if I came to Santiago in the future.
Add to that that Jorge and Dominga were always attentive and helpful. It was great. Absolutely recommend that you stay here if it is available.

The home is amazing. It must have one of the best views in the city. There is amazing light, breeze and pool. Between these if you close your eyes you feel like you might be on the coast! At night, the city lights up and you have an amazing view to enjoy. The grill works great for cooking up an amazing meal, too! I would highly recommend for anyone looking for an absolutely amazing getaway right in the middle of Santiago!

Stayed for five days is very good experience and enjoy. The facilities and photos in the house are very good. The hot water supply is sufficient. wifi is very good,  There is a terrace to see the surrounding environment. The owner's reply is very effective. A good restaurant is provided. The building is close to the main road, so there will be a little noise. Overall, I recommend this accommodation.

Beautiful condo in a secured building in a wonderful neighborhood.  Across the street is a nice big park and there is a large shopping center within walking distance with lots of shops and restaurants.  Excellent views from the deck.  Beds very comfortable and kitchen fully stocked.  We would highly recommend this place.

Easy check in and good communication. the loft was nice for 1 night before our next flight. the only issue was a location near nightclub (s). decibel level was too high to sleep, so this to be considered.

We had a great stay at Consuelo's place. The space was spotless and well-designed, and we appreciated all the attention to detail. The location is within walking distance of most major attractions in Santiago. Consuelo was very helpful in answering all our questions. Thank you!
Really beautiful and cozy apartment. It’s located on a quiet street and close to a lot of nice restaurants and shops.
Great little apartment in the heart of Lastarria district. A little on the noisy side into the late evening which is to be expected due to proximity to restaurants. Earplugs are an easy fix!
We had a great time at Francisco's place. The location was amazing: it was in a very nice neighbourhood, very close to supermarkets and the metro. Communication was clear and nice!!

We had a wonderful stay at Casa Marcoleta's. The space was exactly as described. The hosts are very responsive and allowed us to leave our luggage in storage with them for a full day after checkout. The house is located in a great area and we felt safe the entire time. I highly recommend you stay here at Casa Marcoleta's 😊
Absolutely fantastic! Could not recommend Maria’s apartment enough! The apartment was beautiful and the location was brilliant!

Hector's prompt reply always makes me feel the priority, he is kind, attentive, always take care of your all requirements, you are always the first. He is a wisdom uncle for me, many experiences can share to you.
His home is located at the center of Bellavista de Providencia, everything is good.

My wife and I stayed here for a week. We both worked from here as well. There were 2 wifi networks which really helped us. The house was plenty big, especially for both of us. Could have got another 4 people comfortably. We enjoyed speaking with Mabel. Her and her husband were very welcoming. The place is walking distance to a major shopping center, restaurants and the telefonica, among other sites. Thanks for a great stay! We recommend this place.

I was here for a study abroad for two months and found the apartment to be very comfortable! The apartment was incredibly clean, close to public transport and had many grocery options nearby. The hosts were friendly and were willing to accommodate our requests.

Francisco is very helpful, always available and flexible for our needs. We came with our baby and he offer a cod and a baby chair. The flat is luminous and fantastically located. We will definitely come back!
Alejandro are a great and helpful  host. The place was very good for us, and right center in an interesting neighborhood.

Diego was a very friendly host and the apartment is in an ideal location close to everything! The kitchen is pretty small for cooking for a group but the space is very comfortable and cozy. Thank you!
Everything was great! Very beautiful and comfortable flat! I can highly recommend this flat! Thank you for a great stay in Santiago!
Fantastic location, very easy checkin, AC in the bedrooms is great, space is well laid out, and two bathrooms is quite helpful. Definitely would stay again.

Jessica’s place is a gem. Great studio apartment perfect for two people, super comfortable bed, very well stocked kitchen. AC was a life saver in the hot weather. Host was very responsive and accommodating, went above and beyond to help us.
The rooftop area is amazing, it has unsurpassed views of Santiago at night.
I would absolutely stay at this place again.
Excellent place, in a beautiful zone, the room is comfortable, quiet and the host is very attentive and nice. In any chance for sure I will repeat.

I appreciate the excellent communication. The apartment is exactly as described. It is a very secure building and the parking option was perfect for me. For the best experience follow the instructions and you will agree this is an excellent choice.

My week-long stay at Americo’s place was great! I loved the neighborhood and enjoyed the many cafes and restaurants nearby. Grocery store was a five-minute walk away, and the WiFi was excellent for work calls.
Americo was a great host. He checked in frequently and sent very clear check-in instructions. He also helped me use the local bus to arrive from the airport, which I appreciated. 100% recommended.

Maritza was a great host while we spend our first part of our honeymoon in Santiago. She was kind enough to give us tips of security when walking outside, and so kind when I requested a battery, and she bought for me so I didn’t need to struggle trying to find it. She’s a star host in my heart. Thank you!
The apartment was everything that the host advertised, and more. The balcony was a nice feature, as was the underground parking. Recommended!
There is no better location in Santiago!  We would love to come back and stay at Catalina’s place again!

Great location,  easy to walk to many of the tourist locations as well as groceries and restaurants.  The washing machine was a nice bonus to clean up for our next leg of our trip. Rooftop area has great views of the city and sunsets. Kitchen has all the necessary items to cook at home.
Had a great stay at Maria Jose’s place! The apartment has a beautiful view and is stocked for a long term stay. WiFi is good too.

Awesome place to stay. Caroline helped me a lot with organising things. Checkin was smooth and the place just super comfy. I wish I could have stayed over Christmas but the place was booked. If I come back tonSantiage and the place is available, I would lilove to stay here again. Thanks for everything. 🙏🏽
Very easy to communicate with Arnold, AC in the room was much appreciated in the summer heat. Very centrally located
Carlos was an amazing host! He provided great recommendations and was very helpful and responsive. Can’t wait to visit Santiago again!

Great location! Walking distance to San Cristobel and lots of restaurants.  Great views and nice roof top pool. The bed was very comfortable.   The night clubs below do get a little loud especially on Christmas Eve but this was mentioned in the description so it was expected.  We would definitely stay here again.
Gabriel was a super responsive and kind host. The apartment is well situated and the view is amazing!

The views were AWESOME! Bed was comfortable. Living/dining areas were nice. Kitchen was small but extremely functional. Lovely  neighborhood esp. with the Christmas lights at the city hall. We would not hesitate to come back!

Very nice apartment and exceptionally clean!
Great roof pool and possible to walk to Costanera mall & tower.
Would recomment to friends, this is a great and safe location!

Pros: Great customer service, always responsive and attentive to client's needs. Great luminous bathroom.  Great that it has a has a clothes washer in the unit. It also has a fan and heater unit available.                                     Cons: No view. No kitchen counter space. Needs different spot for microwave..only space is above dish sink..will need to build a shelf. No air conditioning. Pricier than larger airbnb places in the area for for what it has to offer.

Beautiful house in a beautiful fancy location in Santiago. The view is gorgeous and the space is perfect for large families or groups. Olga is very reactive and easy to communicate with. The only downsides I would mention are: while the house was clean overall, the floors were not. The kitchen could be better equipped in tableware (only 10 of each tableware item).
the moment I walked in this studio, I could feel the attention of details made by the host. I found it impeccably clean, equipped with all essentials, and conveniently located.
super lovely stay, very homey and welcoming apartment. gorgeous view and perfect location. highly recommend 💛

Our stay at the apartment was excellent! We found everything we needed and where impressed by the fully equipped kitchen that even had a water filter as well as many kitchen tools. The apartment felt like home and the sunsets were impressive.

Veronica and Jose were good hosts and responded promptly when we reached out.
The location is very central, an exciting neighborhood with many restaurants and bars close by. The outdoor patio was lovely and the space was nice to have three separate floors. The space worked well for our group.

This was a great place to stay for a group of four (two couples). Each room has its private bathroom which made a huge difference. The balcony also helped moderate the temperature of summer in Santiago. The unit is located in a safe building and neighborhood with lots of good restaurants to visit. Moreover, the apartment is located close to points of interest such as Bellavista, cerro San Cristobal and Lastarria.
Maria Paz was super helpful and quick to respond! Thank you Maria Paz!

Besides the extremely slow draining bathroom sink and the fact that the immigration documentation is never stated on the listing, I was happy with the actual room. (If you bring your immigration paper given at the airport, they wave a tourist tax.)
An amazing place to stay for your vacation. The stuff was very helpful and we had an amazing time during our stay. It was a very same environment for us. We felt at home❤️
my stay Carmen's was A1. absolutely incredible. very kind and knowledgeable about local reccos
Modern apartment with all the essential amenities. Great location, close to the main sites. Host was friendly, making sure everything was ok with our stay.

I had an exceptional stay at this newly built property! The apartment is fully furnished with brand new, modern decor, making it incredibly comfortable. The location is unbeatable, right across from Metro Hernando de Magallanes in Las Condes, with easy access to public transport. Plus, there are plenty of shops, restaurants, and plazas within walking distance. The building offers 24/7 security and concierge services, ensuring a safe and hassle-free experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for convenience and quality!
Perfect location with so many fantastic restaurants all within walking distance. The apartment had a lovely garden to sit in too. Perfect for a short stay ☺️

Po Wen’s studio apartment is in a great location. The apartment was very small, clean and basic. It’s a good spot for one night. The building security is intense, but good. We appreciated Po Wen’s clear instructions and quick communication.

The apartment is a modern, space, with all you need for a comfortable stay.
It is in a great location, close to bars, restaurants and right in the heart of the action in Bella Vista, especially if you like to party and be part of it, this would be great. It was too noisy for us as the clubs were going till early in the morning every night. This could have been the period we were staying there too.

Camilo and Fabi's apartment in Providencia is a gem! My family (including two kids) had a wonderful stay. The apartment is beautifully decorated – from the color-coded keys (a fun touch!) to the luxurious Turkish bath towels and Egyptian linens. We especially loved the tastefully selected art and the charming, peaceful courtyard where we enjoyed many morning coffees. The location is perfect; it's incredibly secure and within easy walking distance of tons of restaurants. Exploring other parts of Santiago was a breeze with Uber readily available. The apartment was perfect for our family and we highly recommend it to other families visiting Santiago
Jessica's place, was clean, close to shopping and had the building had two amazing pools and incredible views for sunsets at night on the top floor.  We enjoyed our stay!
We really enjoyed the convenient location, pool, large and very spacious apartment and amenities. The view from the balcony was amazing and very enjoyable daily!

We absolutely loved our stay at Gisela’s little oasis. She is a fabulous host — super friendly with lots of recommendations for sightseeing. She is very knowledgeable about her country which is great for foreigners who are learning about Chile’s history. Her garden is a highlight as well as her beautiful dogs. Highly recommended! Thank you so much Gisela 😊

Good place at Providencia, everything was exactly as described. Hotwater working nicely. Nice surroundings with plenty of restaurants and bars close to the place: Metro station 100m, Supermarket 80m, Pharmacy 30m. Patrícia is a real SuperHost, proactive, communicative and also a nice person.

Amazing views of Santiago!! Cristobal was a great host - he provided very clear instructions, was responsive, and had a wonderful apartment space. We are so glad we were able to spend our last few days in Chile at this location.  Thanks again for sharing your home!
Great stay! The hosts were excellent at communicating and made it really easy to check in after a long flight

Great place to spend few days  and get to know Santiago. Camilo's appartment is nicely located and clean. We enjoyed the time we spent at Camilo's place. Definitely worth to consider for anyone planning to visit Santiago

The apartment was clean, well stocked and has an excellent location. It’s rare to find a place that has 2 bathroms! The shower was the best we had in Chile as well. Gerardo was very friendly and responsive.
Guille was the most attentive host I’ve had for an Airbnb! Very prompt and thoughtful responses.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean , and very centrally located . We would definitely stay here again.

Nice clean and comfortable place, in an interesting and convenient location. Art was as fun as it looked in the posting, and the little patio with a table and chairs was a nice bonus. We enjoyed exploring Barrio Italia. We’re hikers, so we walked  to the central district and other neighborhoods. But the metro is also nearby. Camilo was responsive and helpful.
Eduardo’s place was perfect for my stay which consisted in just getting a shower and a good 6 hours sleep for my connection flight. Will definitely recommend for a longer stay.

Stayed here a few days after hiking torres del paine and I was really happy with the apartment. It’s on the too floor of a 24 story building so the view is amazing. High ceiling, modern TV and washer. The area is ca 5-10 min walking distance to Lastaria.
The gym isn’t good at all so don’t expect to use it if you’re looking to work out. There is however a great gym 2 min from the apartment where you can buy day passes for ca $7USD.
Would definitely stay here again if I’m ever back in santiago.

Francisco is a fabulous host! Super quick responses, very amiable, and genuinely wishes for you to have the most comfortable experience you could possibly have at his place. He truly goes above and beyond in every way.
The space is comfortable, the kitchen well stocked, and everything is within walking distance. Highly recommend!
Best place to stay in the city with great view of the whole city and the mountain range. Apartment is very great. Would recommend to any friend and family.
Alvaro's loft was perfect for us. In a good location, plenty of space and very clean. Alvaro was also very helpful. We would definitely stay there again.

Wow!!! Perfect stay for me. I like to cook and the kitchen was awesome. Everything was amazing in this neighborhood and apt. Really really enjoyed my stay. As I arrived Manual gave me so many great suggestions on restaurants and resources. I would come back for sure and recommend this spot to everyone 😁

Great location in Lastarria, right next to the beautiful Santa Lucia hill and on the street where so many cute little cafes and restaurants decorate the neighborhood. We loved staying in Lastarria, which I think is the best place in Santiago. Apartment is quiet and well-equipped. Cristian provided all instructions ahead of time with detail which made everything easy. Highly recommend !
We would highly recommend this spot for a stay in Santiago. Beautiful view of the mountains and easy walk to the mall and cute corner market.
Well stocked for a long stay.  We had a small issue with a plugged sink and Miguel was there quickly to remedy the situation.  Overall, a pleasant stay.
Javier’s place was beautiful and cozy. It’s also very convenient to shopping areas and restaurants . Lovely park for walking and exercise right in front of apartment .

the place is nice and centrally located.
dealing with the host was unpleasant. this is the first property that mandated all documents and pib forms prior to telling you how to check in. The host was reluctant to provide any flexibility about checking in and checking out or leaving anything at the property.
if you like to be told you will be charged extra if you aren't out by noon when you didn't even ask if you could stay pass noon, this is the place for you.
nice place but not worth the experience.

Jaime's apartment is very well located, at walking distance to everything you'll need.
The kitchen is tiny but functional, and the double bed is comfortable. We really enjoyed having our morning coffee on the balcony that overlooks the San Cristobal mountain, which is a well-known tourist attraction. We would certainly book this place again.

This Airbnb is in a house with a couple of units just a block or so from Barrio Italia. It is on a quiet, nondescript street. The unit itself is cozy and charming with a small courtyard patio. One bedroom is just off that courtyard, a couple of steps from the kitchen, and the other is inside. When we were there, it was hot outside, but the owner provided two powerful standing fans. Those were good except they made too much noise for us to leave them on at night. We kept the doors open, since they had iron bars. During our stay, we walked repeatedly to Avenida Italia and that area, which is a few blocks away. That was a great thing to have nearby -- so many shops in addition to the many restaurants. As vegetarians, we found a lot of great food for us there. The walk to the metro is a little bit far, but not too bad. We highly recommend Camilo's place.
Really nice stay in Santiago. Appartment is good and clean. The swimmingpool has a stunning view over the city. Surroundings of Providencia are calm and touristfriendly. Really recommendable.
Friendly host, but it's a guest house in a backyard. Not a complete house as listed.
Nice apartment in great location. Close to the metro with a supermarket and convenience stores nearby. Only a few minutes walk to some great restaurants.
Great host that was extremely quick to answer all our questions. She was great with an early check in and letting us store our backpacks after check out.
5*, clear recommendation. All fine, friendly host - everything as it should be and I would definitely stay there again. Not one thing to complain about - perfect.
Great place, it has everything you need. Unfortunately no wifi when we were there which was really disappointing as we work remotely, had to check out early.

This was one of the best apartments we’ve rented in the last three years of traveling. And definitely the best apartment we’ve stayed in Latin America.
The kitchen is amazing, fully equipped with everything you need. Bright, spacious, and incredibly comfortable.
The location of the apartment is just perfect— we fell in love with the neighborhood and enjoyed it every single day. If the apartment hadn’t been booked after our stay, we would have extended our rental and stayed longer in Santiago.

Lucia's apartment in Providencia was fantastic! The location is perfect - steps away from the subway entrance and close to everything else you need in Santiago. The balcony view is absolutely stunning. The apartment was in great condition, and everything was well organized and comfortable. Communication with Lucia was smooth and easy, which made the stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Santiago.

Good spot to stay, the place had everything that you can need, pool was nice outside and I made use of the gym in the building.
Only change that would be nice is to have some blackout blinds as the position of the apartment and bed is so that the sun shines right in your eyes in the morning as I’m not a morning person. If you don’t mind such things the place is recommended! Safe building with concierge.
Great location and felt really safe with the concierge downstairs! Everything we needed for our brief stay in Santiago
Great flat in a great location. Spacious, modern and comfortable. It worked really well for us.
Valentina's place is perfect, a great to start your trip in Santiago and end it has everything there you need and some. 5 stars all the way.

the apartment is in a very safe and central location, you find big supermarket around. I didnt take public transportation but there are metro stations very closed by. The communication is always very fast and he helps me to store the luggage very convenient.

Very comfortable and clean apartment. Luis was a great host, always attentive, responsive, and accommodating. The location is excellent, surrounded by coffee shops and restaurants. It’s only steps away from the metro station.

Our second stay with Jessica and as good as the first time. Just perfect. And the fiber optic wifi is the best we have encountered over the last months in LatAm; perfect place for a digital nomad with the luxury of Las Condes.

This location is AMAZING. Safe, multiple restaurants 1 minute walk away, a great convenience store next door, a laundry room downstairs, pool upstairs. Paz and Rafael were very responsive to messages and we even ended up extending a day because it was so nice. The apartment is a small studio with a large balcony with a table and chairs which is very nice to relax as well. The building is secure with a receptionist in the lobby too. I HIGHLY recommend this apartment for your stay in Santiago.
Great apartment right in city centre, very close to metro station. Equipped with everything you need. Great host who offered very flexible check-in times. We can definitely recommend!

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Las Condes, Santiago. The apartment was spotless, modern, and well-equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location was perfect—close to great restaurants, shops, and public transport, making it super convenient to explore the city.
But the highlight? The rooftop pool! The views of the city and the Andes were absolutely breathtaking, especially at sunset. It was the perfect spot to relax and unwind after a day of sightseeing.
The host was incredibly responsive and went out of their way to make sure everything was perfect for my stay. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I would 100% stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Santiago! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The apartment served us very well. It is in a good location, is clean and has good amenities such as the swimming pool.
The place was a wonderful aparthotel. It gave my wife & I the space needed to work on some projects while we were slowly exploring Santiago.
Our 2nd time with Camilo,  and all went well. This apartment is even better than the one upstairs!  Roomy, well equipped with everything you need.

Maria was very flexible with the check in time as I arrived late at night . The room and bathroom were so so clean it felt so good coming from a long flight and rest there, everything smelled so good I really appreciated it . Marley is an awesome bonus , I miss my dogs when I’m away and he knew and chilled with me awesome host too ! In love with Chile

We had an excellent experience at this Airbnb in the heart of Santiago. The apartment is exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and with a lovely terrace that was perfect for working on our laptops while enjoying views of the city. The location is unbeatable, just steps from Cerro Santa Lucía, Lastarria, and everything worth seeing in Santiago’s city center. The only thing to note is that the apartment can get a bit warm in summer, but the fans provided make it manageable.
Susan is incredibly friendly, responsive, and flexible. We had coordinated an in-person check-in, and even though our flight was significantly delayed and landed late at night, she was immediately accommodating and made everything seamless. She was very communicative, gave us great local tips, and truly made us feel at home. Highly recommend!
