Great place nearby to main attractions on foot and supermarket, cafes etc. comfortable apartment with a fan for summer heat. Lots of wardrobe space. Very comfortable bed. Great to have freezer space too!
Building is clean, safe and easy to find.

We enjoyed our stay in this loft. Checking in was easy. The loft was impeccable and it had air conditioning which is hard to find in Santiago. *Keep in mind* this is located on the 4th floor and there are no elevators so, if you have lots of luggage, it will be a workout lol
Barrio Lastarria, is a bohemian neighborhood; it’s artsy, vibrant and has lots of great bars and restaurants. Street parking was not recommended but we found a garage up the street where we parked our rental and it was safe during our stay. Would recommend :)
hector was extremely friendly and nice! very flexible when i had to extend by a day. the house is beautiful and covered in art. this place is certainly worth more than you pay for!

We had a great stay at Carlos' place. Good place for staying with kids, we were there with a four-year-old and an infant. Great view from the 22nd floor and even better views from the rooftop. Communication with Carlos and Pablo was great. We arrived early in Santiago and it was possible to wait in the cool lobby until the apartment was cleaned for us, which was about an hour before official check-in if I remember correctly. Pablo also offered to store our luggage in case we wanted to take a walk, but we were tired from the flight and preferred to wait in the lobby.

Had a lovely stay here- the location is close to everything and felt safe with friendly 24/7 lobby. We appreciated the attention to detail- the unit was well equipped with everything you’d need, from kitchen supplies to shopping bags and international adapters. Thank you!

We loved it! The apartment is conveniently located, very close to various public transport options. It is well-equipped, very comfortable and clean. It (almost) felt like home away from home :)
Dani is a great host, he was super attentive during our stay and reacted very quickly to any question we had. We would definitely stay here again and can recommend it 100%.
We stayed in this flat for the 2nd time, all good, thanks a lot Carlos!

Carla’s place is in a perfect location, close to all major sights and transportation options. The apartment itself has everything you need to have a pleasant stay and a comfortable night of sleep after spending the day walking around Santiago. Carla is responsive and helpful, and will make sure you have everything you’ll need. Great value for the price, and a wonderful experience overall.

The condo was exactly as advertised, in a good way. The area is safe and peaceful and the condo feels like home.
More importantly, Carla was very responsive and helpful to all of our needs.
If you are travelling to Chile for work, this place can´t be beat, right next to the metro in the heart of business district.

My wife and I stayed at the apartment for 10 days while I was working remotely and just loved it. The location is hard to beat if you want to be close to great restaurants, coffee, ice cream, parks, and pretty much anything you need for a longish term stay in Santiago.
The washer and dryer came handy and the kitchen was just enough for what we needed with so many great food options nearby.
Waldo and Claudia were super responsive and helpful with anything we needed.

Very terrible customer service given how many people work there, I had to switch rooms twice. Because there was an issue with the toilet and in the next room the door broke and kept making noises.
Property is pretty run down, some rooms are nice, some are just poorly maintenaned. The staff mean well however they are extremely poorly organized and can not get anything done.
They are very nice and smile at you, however can not get anything done.
The cleaning staff missed the clean of my room every time almost except for 1.
Given that Santiago has a very vibrant Airbnb market, I would recommend booking elsewhere especially if you have high standards.

Great location clean 👌. bit on smal side but OK for one or 2 people to stay there. super friendly concierges
I will stay there again.
Valentina is an excellent host very prompt responsive and kind host I recommend to anyone who wants to taste of class .

We had a nice easy stay. The area has good walkability and access to transit, with pharmacies, markets, cafés, and restaraunts within a two minute walk. The place was clean and as advertised. Gabriela was flexible and provided nice recommendations for a first time in the area. It could be helpful to share the app and location for the laundry, but easy enough to figure out. Would recommend staying here.

Your trip
To Santiago is incomplete without This trip. This was the best thing we did and you will
Love it! Juan Francisco was amazing!!!!!
Beautiful, upgraded apartment in Providencia. We enjoyed the location and the host was very responsive and helpful. She even helped us store our luggage in the building after check out.

clean & well lit with a wonderful view. shower had good pressure and hot water, fast wi-fi and some working cable channels. Bed is on the firm side, but I'm good with that. Brian was friendly, responsive and accommodating. public laundry facilities on the first floor (1600 per wash, 1600 per dry). pool on the roof,  with a 360° vista of Santiago. Located between Central and LaStarria. Nice walkable location.
My stay at Clara’s was great. The apartment is spotless and in a great area of Providencia. I had everything I needed including an amazing view from the pool. I highly recommend staying here.

Thank you so much Tania, for that warm welcoming with treats. great place for enjoy in Family. really greatful. 100 % recommended.
God bless you 🙏

Gabriel was very proactive with communicating on the app messaging ahead of time. The location was beautiful with views of the city skyline and mountains, the laundry facilities worked well, and we enjoyed the rooftop pool! We'd highly recommend this apartment in Santiago!
Francisco is a great host very friendly and responsive. Apartment is spacious and quiet. We had wonderful time and are planning to stay again at Francisco’s place next time visiting Santiago.

The flat is lovely and clean. Situated in the best location, next to all the city restaurants and attractions. The flat is nice and warm, well equipped and has a lovely bedroom. Very comfortable and a lovely stay.
We stayed 18 days. We love staying in this apartment. I think this is our 5th time staying here. Obviously, it works for us. It will for you too.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at said’s apartment .
The space was clean, stylish, and thoughtfully equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable visit.
The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, providing helpful tips about the area and making sure I felt at home.
Thank you for the amazing experience

Loved it! Perfect location, perfect apartment which had everything we needed. We cooked every meal and always had all the essentials and the space was great for a trip to see Santiago.
Manuel was a great host, checking up to see if we’d made it ok and was super helpful with suggestions and any questions we had.
We’d love to come back when next in Santiago! Thanks 😊

Beautiful , centrally located apartment in Barrio Italia, carefully decorated with art and comfort in mind. The apartment also has a nice outdoor terrace for reading and enjoying some outdoor space without the direct heat of the late afternoon. Bonus points for an extremely comfy bed!
I spend 3 days here ,,,, absolutely recommend,,,,,thanks people at the front desk always friendly to help ,,,,
Good stay, it's nice to have that air conditioning during the summer months.  Very nice view there at the apartment.

I was in Santiago for one day. Maria was a good host, flexible with check in check out timings. The room doesn't have a fan or AC, it's on a high floor, so there's air circulation.Maria informed me about it. In summers, it's a bit inconvenient. Marley is the sweetest pet! Overall, a good stay, value for money. Good location, walking distance from plaza de armas and public transport.

The apartment was super clean and comfortable. Easy access to the subway and buses, walking distance to Gabriela Mistral Center and Lastarria neighborhood. Soledad was helpful and super easy to communicate with.
The perfect place to stay in Santiago! Close to beautiful scenery and local restaurants have so much to offer! Great food scene. Host is kind and responsive!

335 / 5.000
What a gem! This is Valentina's place! So beautiful, so strategically located, so clean and with so many facilities for an excellent stay. The communication was wonderful and Valentina even went out of her way to make our check-in flexible. Thank you for everything. If I return to Santiago, I will definitely try to stay here again.

Perfect Stay – Highly Recommended!
I had the most wonderful experience staying at “Mall Parque Arauco…” From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and at home. The space is exactly as described—and even better in person. The apartment is impeccably clean, beautifully decorated, and well-stocked with everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The kitchen was fully equipped, which made cooking meals a breeze. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and I slept so well each night.
The location is perfect—quiet and peaceful, yet close to points of interest, groceries and restaurants, making it easy to explore the area.
I also appreciated how communicative and helpful the host and building concierge were.
Would definitely book again if I return!

Thank you Camilo for a wonderful stay at your beautful aprtment in Santiago.
Will love to come back one day.

The apartment is clean and comfortable and has a great view. It can be quite noisy depending on the time of day and the neighborhood does not always feel safe. If you're going to be spending most of your time in the apartment or around the city, it's an excellent option.
nice apartment on the 23rd floor, close to restaurants and the shopping market, had a desk and chair to work at. everything was good

Place was walking distance to many attractions and places to eat. Myrlan was also very responsive to any questions or problems we had and were very accommodating.
Everything was also clean and very homey

The highlight of the apartment is definitely the view. You can see the mountains and the skyscraper.
It is right on Avenida Providencia so expect to hear the traffic. The advantage is that many bars and restaurants are close by. From the pictures we expected the place to be more modern. Overall the place felt for us a bit soulless - however we would recommend it for a short stay of a couple nights.

Such a lovely apartment with a great vibe in a really cool location. Sussan was such an incredibly kind and communicative host who went the extra mile to help us and answer all our questions. Thank you Sussan for such an amazing stay in Santiago!

This was one of the best AirBnBs we have stayed at! Manuel was a lovely host- so responsive, informative and considerate. The property was in an excellent location and was clean, and really comfortable. We would 10/10 stay here again!!

We had a great stay at the appartment. Many of the main things to do are in a good walking distance. The appartment ist very well furnished, has a great view and comes with some nice items/gadgets (tv with ESPN and Disney+ for example :)) The Coffee machine and french Press safed our mornings. I can really recommend this appartment!

Book this one, it was súper friendly Javiera and the Apartment is way better than the description from all the little details that she will left to us, even a metro card and we needed one so yeah Javiera thanks for the amazing apartment and service that you are offering.

Thanks a lot Sebastian! We really enjoyed our stay. the apartment is in a nice location and the apartment is cozy and clean. sebastian gave us some recommendation  for the city and was nice chatting with :)

Wonderful stay,  Patricia went above and beyond to accommodate us and the place was a perfect homebase for our Santiago stay. I picked this place because I used to live in this neighborhood for years, and the area is just as lively, full of great restaurants and shops, as it was back then. The apartment itself matched the photos and description. Would stay here again!
Natalia’s place is super comfortable and practical, with all the amenities to have a great base of operations to explore Santiago. It’s also super close to great shopping and restaurants.
Was a lovely stay! After forgetting something in the room upon checkout, Tomas went out of his way to send keys via uber to let us back in as it was urgent. Very grateful to have such a great host!
Beautiful and clean apartment in a good neighborhood at a great price. Owners are very friendly and responsive. Definitely recommend!
Sandra and Eddy are wonderful hosts. The property is beautiful, the breakfast was nice with fresh eggs, and the view of Santiago is great. I would stay again given the right opportunity.
Great property ! Very clean with amazing views of the Andes mountains. Located close to San Cristobal. Lots of restaurants close by. Lastly host is great and very responsive!

The place definitely needs maintenance and caring. The shower wasn’t working properly and we had to handle the shower as it wouldn’t stand properly. There was shower matt and we needed to use on of the towels to dry our feet and don’t slip. it was unsafe and slippery to come out of the shower, there was not kitchen cloth to dry dishes or hands.

Very nice apartment. Spacious and comfortable, in the heart of Lastarria.
Pros
- On an extremely lively, fun street in Lastarria. Lots of restaurants, cafes nearby.
- Spacious and well lit.
- Kitchen well equipped.
- Hosts very easy to communicate with and helpful.
- Surprisingly quiet at night, given the level of street activity.
- Good WiFi.
Cons
- You need to text hosts when you’re outside the door in order to get in, since no lockbox or code and hosts have to operate buzzer remotely.
- Lots of street noise during day, since apartment is on very lively street.
- Not too much privacy in living room on ground floor, since looks direct onto street.
- A/C only in master bedroom.
This is very nice place. Very clean well equipped with many beautiful pictures etc. Very good location.

Valentina and her dad are absolutely kind amazing hosts. They were so incredibly welcoming and attended to our every need for peace of mind. So helpful! To have someone who is so supportive in a place you are not familiar with or speak the language is a blessing. The apartment: the hot water, kitchen, bathroom.. Spotless. Location safe central and QUIET! The concierge always smiling. Above all the bed and sofa bed were so comfortable and bonus.. A/C was a life saver. It has a very good washing machine. Every detail of the apartment is thoughtfully applied for the guests comfort. 100000% recommend the apartment. Thank guys for your warm and kind hospitality!

I stayed for the second time with Magdalena and can only recommend her place. She is a great host, always ready with helpful advices about the city, and since it's a place, where many different people can stay, you can also get in touch with other people traveling. The house is big enough though that it always spreads out, the courtyard and garden are beautiful. Located centrally directly next to a metro and bus station. I had a beautiful time, thank you, dear Magdalena!
Great apartment in a great location. The pictures are accurate and we had excellent, detailed communication from Miguel

Los Condes was a great place to stay. This condo was near the subway, comfortable and had a pretty nice view.
I would've rated 5 stars if not for the lack of AC. It is summer in Santiago amd it would get hot during the day. If not for the breeze leaving the windows open and the small fan available, it would've been uncomfortable.

I just loved this place. I only had two days to enjoy it, but nearly everything I wanted to do was a walkable distance, the supermarket was a 5 minutes walk, and the apartment itself was very clean, with a comfortable bed, light-blocking curtains, and AC (it was very hot). Last but not least, Gustavo always responded quickly & kindly. I'll definitely try to stay here my next time in Santiago.

We thoroughly enjoyed our two night stay in Camilo’s clean and comfortable apartment during our first visit to Santiago. The apartment was centrally located and Camilo was always responsive and helpful with suggestions on what to do. He never led us astray!

I feel extremely lucky to have landed in such a perfect location for a first visit to Santiago. Lively and hip Lastarria is a great area for getting to know and explore the city. There's an abundance of good restaurants, an art museum, and a significant park, as soon as you step out the door. Irmelys was super-patient, diligent and helpful.
apartment  is cozy and very well located, Ñuñoa is a quiet and safe neighborhood  even though it's close to the most famous Providencia
Convenient location, very smooth communication, place as described with a nice bed, equipped kitchen, everything i needed for a short stay :)
Susan was very friendly and helpful during check-in and checkout. The apartment was clean and just as described. Great experience!

We had an amazing stay at Cristian's place. It's a beautiful loft that was a treat to enjoy for a couple of days. Location-wise it's very close to heaps of great bars and restaurants, and is very safe to walk around, even at night.
Cristian was very friendly and even let us check out later to accommodate our flight time. He was also very kind about a wine glass that I accidentally broke (sorry again).
Would highly recommend this stay if you're in Santiago for a couple days and looking for a little more of a luxurious stay.
Wonderful place! Everything like on photos. As for me, pull is a little bit cold, but come on, there is a pool :) The apartment is cozy and clean, bathroom is beautiful! Recomendacion 👍

Great place in an excellent safe quiet neighbourhood / quiet and cool with fans - big and spacious / good TV a very short walk to tons and tons of of restaurants and bars all pretty good in Barrio Italia - 3 mins walk from the flat - the door entry system with 4 x different lock codes and 2 x keys to get in is over complicated
And could / should be simplified with keys as nobody can remember 4 x codes late at night - the addition of some coffee or tea and some bottled water for the first night would be hospitable the flat is really spacious however - I would stay again due to the close proximity to a great area as above and it was good to be able to stow our bags for a few hours prior to check in at a rather late 5 pm - which I had not fully appreciated. Thanks
Very friendly and easy going host. I felt very comfortable and her dog is very sweet. Bellavista is a beautiful area and this is located in a nice quiet part.

Great studio apartment located in a nice neighborhood with lots of restaurants nearby. Eduardo is a great host, very accommodating.  Apartment was very clean and exactly as in pictures. Would definitely return!

we stayed at Costanza's a few days. the apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need. the location is great, just around the corner from the metro station. lot's nice small shops scattered at a max of 10 minutes walk. recommended!

My stay at Camila's apartment was just what I needed. Well located, central and spacious at a fair price. She was helpful in terms of communication and both the check-in and check-out were  smooth. All in all a very recommendable location for anyone who needs a comfortable place in Santiago.

We loved staying at Osvaldo's cool apartment in the hip and arty Bella Vista area of Santiago.  Easy walk to the Funicular and great restaurants. Loved the sunset views from the rooftop, and the rooftop pool. Lovely friendly apartment complex.

The perfect airbnb for our stay over the weekend of our friend’s wedding. The apartment must have one of the best views in Santiago!
The pool, bbq and kitchen space made it such a comfortable stay. 8 of us shared the space very comfortably.
The location was extremely handy for everything we needed and easy to taxi from and to other parts of the city

As the saying goes you get what you pay for, the place is located in a very noisy area due to traffic, it would be nice if sliding doors and windows would seal better to avoid the noise, the place needs some upkeep and care, on the other hand Raul was a very accommodating host

Everything was perfect.
The apartment is in a beautiful neighborhood. Close to really good museums and good restaurants.
It is super clean and has all that you need to cook.
The beds and pillows are very comfortable.
And the shower is 5 ⭐️.
We would return for sure.
Great location. close to several great tourist spots. really nice patio/balcony. It was really nice to have a fan in addition to AC.
Loved our week in Santiago. Staying here felt like we had an apartment in the city. Loved the location and the different neighborhoods around it.
We were very happy with Raul's place, it was quite nice and clean. It was also a great location, close to everything that we wanted to visit. We would go back to Raul's place. :)

Had a lovely night's stay at Rodrigo's. The hosts very kindly did a quick turn around of the previous guests to let us check in slightly early, which was greatly appreciated as we were stuck outside with our big rucksacks.
The flat was comfortable. There's a big smart TV which we didn't actually use. And the big surprise bonus was the massage chair which was ideal after just having hiked the W Trek in Torres del Paine.
Unfortunately there is no AC, but there is a large fan in the bedroom to compensate which kept us cool through the night.

While Jose Antonio's apartment is quite small, it has everything required for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
He went out of his way to ensure that some damage done by the previous guests, only discovered on the day of our arrival, had a minimal impact on us. This was exceptional.
First of all, the communication with Tomás was great, he helped us with everything we needed. The location was amazing too right in the neighborhood Providencia, beautiful and very safe.
We had a great stay. The apartment is clean, quiet, comfortable and close to shops and restaurants. Would definitely stay again.
Very nice place. It looks better than expected. Good location, nice pool and the sunset view from the balcony.

Great small apartment in Santiago, with a garage and lots of things to do around, you can go walking to bars and restaurants. Lacks a bit of privacy when the curtains are up (because there is a building upfront), but it very cozy and the small terrace is a nice place to look at the city.
Mabel’s place is fantastic! The apartment has an impeccable artistic decor and is quite comfortable. Carina, who manages the property, is nice and super attentive. Highly recommend this place!

We really enjoyed the unobstructed 180 degree views of Santiago as well as privacy, no other buildings are looking in at you.  Nice blinds that were fully open most of the time.   Noisy traffic, a busy intersection below but that was not a problem for us.  Wonderful breezes, comfortable even with temperatures in the high 30s without air conditioning. Loved the roof top terrace to enjoy spectacular views and cool breezes.  Location was very close to transit (buses at the front door and metro 2 blocks away). Walking distance to many places of interest, shopping and great dining.  We would not hesitate to return to this apartment.
Great place for a stopover or weekend in Santiago. The loft is neat, the views speak for itself and the location is good as well.
Having this well located spot made it easy to visit Santiago for the first time!  Sunny and dark bedroom sides of the unit. Great little kitchen and backyard area!
Great location, very clean,  great check-in and great communication. Only con is having to pay the VAT outside the app.
It was amazing! And close to the city center, you can see all the sights! The street is also full of stores and restaurants

Stayed here for 3 nights, and had a wonderful time! Neighbourhood was very charming and had cute cafes and restaurants right outside, the space was super cute and had everything we needed, and the host was super responsive. AC was a bit less powerful than we expected. Would stay again!

Felipe is a great host and responded quick. We were able to check in 15 minutes after booking.
Quiet and great neighborhood with lots of accomodations near by.
highly recommended! 👍🏻
Great apartment in a fantastic location. Po Wen is very kind and helpful. Rooftop pool and deck was a big plus!
Paz was a lovely host and the apartment was great. We had everything we could have needed and the staff in the building were super nice too. Great location.
We thoroughly enjoyed our 3 nights' stay at Marcia's airbnb. Great location and comfortable place in Santiago. Marcia is a great host, friendly and helpful. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

We loved José’s apartment. It was pristine, comfortable and had a fantastic view. The concierge was friendly and very helpful. We also loved using the pool.
José responded quickly to our questions and even came to the apartment to help us with a query. We really enjoyed our stay, thank you José.
I had a wonderful stay here with Natalia and Silvia, both were great at communicating and everything was how it should be.  The bed was super comfy, I will definitely stay again!  Thanks guys
What a great place to stay ;) So clean, liveable and quiet. The location was amazing and the host was always quick to respond. 100% recommend!!

The place is quite compact, but it is well designed, so it comes across as cozy rather than cramped.
It is a nice place for a single person, or for a couple (if they don't intend to spend too much time there during the day).
My main problem is with the shower, it is very small but this expected and understandable.
However, since the shower is so small it is very easy to bump into the faucet and change the water temperature.
This means you inadvertently can get very hot water and this can be a safety risk if you don't ask fast enough.
I would recommend Maritza to change the faucet for a more compact one and that doesn't move as easily.

A great place to stay in Providencia, a lovely area in Santiago. The apartment is comfortable, well-equipped and has everything you need. The rooftop pool was a fantastic place to cool off.  Clara was really helpful with check in which was much appreciated after a long flight and also flexible at check out.  Totally recommend!!

I absolutely loved my stay at this wonderful unit.
Location is prime and it’s close to everything you need while still being quiet and peaceful.
The staff are very friendly.
The apartment itself is cozy, clean and has everything the listing mentions!
Lastly, some of the very best hosts one can ask for as they are friendly, helpful, attentive, kind and very accommodative!
Thank you! Will definitely return
Very nice central location. Safe, walkable.  We have decided to return there at the end of our trip to Chile.

My wife and I had a great stay at Gabriel’s place. It was extremely clean, and I loved the location. It was very easy to walk to many excellent bars and restaurants.
Gabrielle responded very quickly and clearly to any questions I had, he was extremely helpful.
This is a great place to stay in Santiago.

Exactly as described with a comfy bed and fast wifi. A great space to explore the city from.
There is a well stocked kitchen and the apartment is above a large supermarket which made it very easy to cook dinners!
Check-in is by keypad which was perfect as our flight arrived late at night. The host was very responsive to questions and even stayed awake late to make sure we were able to access the property
Would recommend, thanks!
Great space in the heart of providencia. Felt very safe and had a lot to in the area!

We LOVE Javier’s place!!! This was our third time returning. I don’t think there is a better place to stay in Las Condes. We love the park across the street, and the big shopping mall is just a quick walk down the street. Can’t wait to be back!

We had a great stay over the weekend, would highly recommend the place. Well located next to the mall and has nice rooftop view of the mountains. Host is extremely quick with responses for anything you may need!

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment  has great views and beds and sofa were comfortable. It’s within walking distance from barrio Italia which is a very cool stew with great bards and restaurants.  Felipe gave clear instructions from start to finish and was always responsive to our questions.   We would recommend Felipe’s place to anyone coming to visit Santiago

Our stay was amazing! The apartment was clean and comfy, and Jorge was always responsive and very helpful. I would absolutely recommend their place and if we are back in Santiago we would stay again in their apartment.
we had a great stay here. It was close to shops and easy to get the 411 bus which we used to get on the hop on hop off bus.

Great location for cute bars and restaurants! The pool was perfect for cooling off on the hot days and very glad for the fans in each of the rooms. the mountains look amazing for sunset!
would definitely stay again
Beautiful place to stay, ideal in everyway for the 3 of us! Will most certainly be booking again when we come back!
Nice spot in a good area here in Santiago. Easy to move around by public transport or on foot.

good place, good location, good host.
i wouldnt say it was "superb" but good enough for me to gladly book again in the future. thsnk you Boris.
Alejandro’s units is as described. The area is very busy with small business all around. Alejandro was quick in communicating and accommodating me. I enjoyed my stay overall.

We enjoyed our stay, it felt comfortable like we were at home. We liked the nearness to the metro and Italia neighborhood too. Lobby attendants were friendly and we felt safe. A great base to explore!

Carlos is very helpful when you need some help.
he gave some local recommendations also without me asking.
Really enjoyed staying at the apartment, it had a nice view.
It may be a struggle if you want to bring your luggage up to the bedroom, so I chose to keep it downstairs.
Utilities was readily available.
Would definitely recommend this place, it's also not far from local attractions by uber or bus, as they all stop just outside.
Micaela is a great host - lovely and very responsive to messages. Place was clean, easy to access, and in a great location. Kitchen well supplied, everything you can ask for.
A simple and Nice apartment for 2 people and a very Nice location! And with a Nice pool and rooftop aswell🙌🏻🤩

Spacious, comfortable apartment. Air conditioning unit in main bedroom was a life saver in the summer, but wish it would have been available for rest of apartment. The balcony was great to enjoy during evening and nighttime hours. very safe neighborhood close to public transportation.

Had a wonderful stay at Héctor Daniel’s place ! His place - space is like a gallery
He really has wonderful artefacts, paintings and just the style and taste
I loved spending time in the common space and I also loved my room! Thank you for making me feel comfortable Héctor and for helping me if I had question.
10/10 ! :)

Matías's place is nice and comfy for a couple to stay. We especially liked how responsive he was to any request and was always able to provide some assistance.
Only one small thing is that it does not have a/c which made it a little warm as we went during summer.

Great apartment in Barrio Italia. Our favorite neighbourhood in Santiago.
Jonathan was super friendly and helpful regarding our late arrival and the flat was exactly what we needed!

It’s an okay spot for what you pay. The balcony views are very nice however the lack of air conditioning in the midst of a heat wave was not ideal. Fortunately at night the windows circulate the air better. Check in is straight forward, but, Host response times are very slow. The space needs updating, a lot of broken furniture, closet doors kept banging into overhead lighting, it’s a hazard. I don’t want to deter other bookers, I just want the host to provide a better place and experience if they’re choosing to host on the site

This is my second visit here. It was a positive experience as I mentioned in my previous review. I did use the laundry facilities this time and everything was good. The building has two washers and two dryers in the basement accessible via a card key from the front desk. The building is half managed apartments and half hotel rooms. I found the price for an apartment on AirBNB to be very attractive during both says. Quiet, comfortable, place to stay with a good desk for working.
We had a great stay! The apartment was perfectly located to all the great restaurants and museums in the area.

We loved staying at Emelina and Miguel's. Amazing central location to everything within walking distance. The room was perfect for our needs and allowed us to cook, with a supermarket just down the road too. would recommend and would stay again if I am back in Santiago. They were great hosts with great communication :)
The place was just what we wanted, perfectly spaced for two people to have a comfortable stay. It’s well located, very close to the metro.

Well decorated apartment in a lively neighborhood as mentioned, be ready for people and street vendors right outside the door and balcony, and lots of restaurants to walk to.
We stayed at this apartment for 2 nights in February and it was hot. The only AC unit is in the master bedroom and otherwise the fans are ineffective with the rest of the house.
Kitchen lacked basic items like cooking oil, etc that you expect from an Airbnb, it basically only has dishes - there was even no ice tray for us to make ice.
We had 3 adults and two kids and were only provided with 3 bath towels and 2 hand towels. Also felt rationed for toilet paper LOL as there were half rolls and no extra supply! Overall a nice apartment in a lively location but lacks basics to make for a comfortable stay for anything longer than a day or two.

Nancy’s place is highly recommended, the unit has everything you need for a short or long stay. We stayed for a whole month and we felt right at home. Location is excellent and the neighbourhood is safe and there are so many restaurants around. I would definitely go back if we ever visit Santiago again.

Daniela was a very responsive and helpful host when we had questions about parking and laundry. The apartment is in a nice neighbourhood close to the metro and only around 15 mins by Uber to most sights. The building and flat were very safe, clean and comfortable. The only two small drawbacks were that there is only AC in the sitting room and not in the bedrooms (only 1 fan) so we found sleeping a bit hot, and there is not a lot of space to unpack clothes. However the fantastic value for money compensated for this.
Pablo’s apartment was fantastic and exactly as described. It’s a very modern building with a great view of the city. Thanks Pablo!

We loved our stay in this apartment! The place was spacious and clean with a nice balcony to enjoy meals outside. We also had access to the pool, which was an added bonus! Great location in Barrio Italia, with easy access to the metro to get into the centre of town. Maria Paz was a great host, she greeted us when we arrived and was always responsive when we had questions.

The apartment was well located with everything nearby. The sunset every night was beautiful and we loved the balcony!
It was a little bit dirty, but otherwise everything was perfect!

This is a beautiful place on the 10th floor of a modern building. There are porches, a nice living room, a modern kitchen. It is light and spacious and in a safe and vibrant part of the city. There isn’t air conditioning but there are fans and the air flow keeps it cool during typical summer days. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

If you’re in Santiago, this is the place you want to stay. It’s in a beautiful location in the Providencia district and is extremely walkable. The building had a luggage cart so I could easily transport my bags to my room. Concierge was extremely friendly and helpful, as was Eduardo himself. The views from the apartment are incredible- it was like a little private piece of paradise in the city. I highly recommend staying here and hope to be back soon.
Everything was perfect, the location, the flat was modern and clean. Very happy with my stay!

Fantastic value for money. We’ve stayed in a lot of places around Chile and Arturo’s is certainly the best. Kitchen was fully equipped with everything we need. Lovely extra touches such as beauty face masks and coffee pods to sweeten the deal.
Gracias Arturo!

We stayed here for 4 nights and would definitely recommend! The location is great, the room is bright and clean, bathroom and kitchen are clean. We were able to sit on the balcony which was lovely as well. Sebastian was a great host and gave great recommendations. Thank you so much!
Great communication with a super friendly, flexible host. Place is exactly as described and Andrea is an absolute delight. Book this place if it's available!
Javier was very pleasant and had the apartment very clean. The check in process was flawless. Staying  there was a very pleasant experience and I would stay at his place again. Thanks Javier.  A++

The apartment does not look as fresh and clean as in the pictures. Not all pictures were from that apartment. There might be another apartment in the building, and the pictures were combined. The building is outdated. The lobby on the floor I stayed on smelled unclean. The pool and barbecue area needs maintenance. The building, in general, is not well-kept.
Wonderful apartment. Exactly as advertized.  Great central location in Santiago.  Was very comfortable here and had everything I needed.  Would stay here again for sure.  Thank you.

We loved the apartment and felt very at home on the 27th floor. We enjoyed spending time there on the balcony especially in the afternoon/evening. During the summer months the bedroom gets hot from the sun in the late morning (around 9:30-11am), but there is a good air conditioner for this. The area is very central: walking distance from many sights in downtown Santiago. We especially appreciated the grocery store ‘Los Paises’ which was right outside. The security personnel were also super friendly and you can tell they care about their job. Would recommend 👍🏼

It’s a very good building and everything you need is nearby. The metro station is just outside the door. The view toward the mountains is magnificent and really made this day exceptional. Carlos is extremely helpful and super nice. He checks in to make sure everything is going as planned. An excellent host for sure. We plan to return.
Staying at his spot was part of what made our short stay in Santiago so great.  The location was amazing and the accommodations were just what we needed.
Great small, newish apartment in a big apartment complex in a quiet neighbourhood. We enjoyed our stay, the pool is a nice plus to the overall experience.
A comfortable apartment close to good food, artisan shopping and historical sites. Our host, Daniel was very helpful and friendly, great communication.
Maria's place is in a safe and central location, with with everything that a traveler needs in easy walking distance. She is a good host, both communicative and attentive.

One of the best airbnbs I’ve had the pleasure of staying at. Great locale with a quaint balcony to unwind on after a busy, fun day. Felt like it was great value and Felipe as well as the building staff were top notch. This will be part of my recommendations for friends visiting Santiago.

Nice place to stay. Relatively quiet neighborhood that’s in between many of the places visitors to the city are likely to visit. Close to transit options and walkable. Markets and places to eat are within very short walking distances.
Very flexible and responsive hosts. The studio is small but comfortable. Nice bed, TV, AC, good shower and all the basics in the kitchen area. Fast internet. Checking in and checking out with the front desk is swift and simple.
The apartment is in a great location Lastarria. It has everything one might need for a short stay.

Compact, well-appointed apartment right in the middle of Lastarria. Two showers make things much easier when getting ready to go out for the day. We had no issues with safety or security in the neighborhood. Washing clothes in the common laundry room was easy to figure out.

My friends and I had a great stay at Maria Paz's place. The apartment was comfortable and clean and we appreciated the convenience of being within close walking distance to good restaurants and bars in Barrio Italia.

I have been many times in SCL. This place is quite unique. It’s peaceful, beautiful and close (10-15 min) walk or a short ride from great restaurants. The bathroom products were very nice.
We were greeted by Doña Carina and she made us feel right at home.
Please be aware that you get to the mansard via a set of stairs and the driveway has gravel (not optimal for luggage with wheels).

hosts were very responsive and informative. the location is impressive with many bars and restaurants up and down the street, museum and park short walking distance. the location is safe for center Santiago.

Great apartment! Excellent location close to all major tourist attractions. The apartment itself is clean, comfortable and has all the amenities we need for our stay. Host responded quickly and was very helpful with her tips of the neighborhood too. Highly recommended!
Great location to walk to park or restaurants and bars; close to take Uber anywhere else. Lovely views. Definitely recommend staying here.

Exceptional quality place - one of those airbnbs you breathe a sigh of happiness because it is very comfortable. Natural lighting is great with good air flow. It is well stocked with everything you could possibly need (all high quality). There is a balcony to enjoy. Bed was extremely comfortable. I highly recommend.
Beautiful apartment and very responsive host. Perfect spot for home-base to explore Santiago. More beautiful in person.

The apartment and the building are wonderful and clean, the people at the reception are kind and I felt safe always int he building. The view is awesome. The bed and the sofa bed have great pillows although the mattresses are not the most comfortable. The pool area has only four lounge chairs and one of them is broken. We were told by the people in the reception that the area is not safe to walk when it gets dark, but there are some restaurants right downstairs. All the other attractions are not walking distance. There is a park in front of the building, although some of it is under construction. Ubers are easy to get. Avoid taxis, they overcharged me. There are pharmacies and a really modern clinic with an emergency room nearby.

We enjoyed our month long stay in Santiago. The apartment is small but comfortable for two. A fan and portable ac unit was provided and kept the apartment cool. It’s close to markets, restaurants and coffee shops. The metro and bus are very close by and make it easy to get around. Also close to San Cristobal hill. Gondola is walkable in 15 mins. Nice view from the balcony. Friendly front door desk attendants. Andrea was very responsive and friendly and gave clear check in / out instructions.
Amazing location and great for the price. It's a brand new apartment complex so the street views on Google are inaccurate. Everything is in walking distance from grocery stores to restaurants.

We have a great stay at Felipe’s place. From the start he was friendly, responsive and extremely helpful. The place is exactly like the photos and close to the metro so very accessible. Love all the plants 😍
Great place with a lot of space, super clean, beautifully designed, in a great neighbourhood. What’s not to like!

Eduardo was a gracious host. The apartment room was clean and peaceful, if a bit on the smaller side. The apartment building is centrally located and about a 10 minute walk to the Santa Lucia metro train station (subway). There are some interesting neighborhoods close by with a large variety of restaurants including many Chinese and Peruvian eateries. Overall the place is a good value for the price.

had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly friendly and responsive, making the check-in process seamless and ensuring I had everything I needed for a great stay. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a cozy and welcoming experience!

Amazing location with lots of great restaurants nearby.
Easy walking (if you line to walk) to most attractions, a d the
Metro is very close by.
Apartment is a bit worn, but has a well-equipped kitchen and comfy beds, though one room does not have AC. A fan is provided.
One of the few places in the area with parking, and it was welcome - just be aware large cars may have trouble getting into the spot (lots of narrow turns)
Great stay overall for the price, would have been nice to have more towels and shampoo provided, but overall a good stay in a great area.

Hector's place is close to great restaurants and bars but you don't hear any noise in his house so great for a good night's rest as well.
Hector was a great host and even walked me to the bus stop to make sure I found the place. He was also flexible with my check in since I arrived a bit earlier and could leave my luggage at his place.

Pamela is a great host and the apartment was exactly as the pictures. Having a safe indoor parking was huge and made parking easy.
There is a hair dryer that the ladies used and there are adapter plugs throughout the place that work for US electronics. Very easy to stay here if you are from the US. Can easily recommend Pamela as a host!
Great apartment in a nice district in Santiago with an awesome view. The host was also responsive and helpful.
Gustavo was an excellent host, helpful, friendly and Informative. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. We would definitely reccomend his place.

I arrived in Santiago at night to catch a flight the next day, so my stay was brief. However I knew the area from a previous visit to the city. Apartment is located in a very nice, safe area, right beside the metro so everything is convenient. I wish I had more time to enjoy the massage chair (which is a nice touch). Overall it was a great place to stay for my very brief visit back to the city.

Fabulous stay at this apartment. It is really nicely furnished and lots of thought has gone into making it homely. Loved the balcony and swimming pool too.
Great area really interesting with lovely cafes and restaurants.
Karen was amazing to communicate with and a great host.
We have booked to come back..we love it.
I went here to relax and it was very nice. I loved the scenery from the room and the roof!

Very convenient spot for walking to El Pueblito or the Metro. A lot of direct sunlight in the late afternoon and evening makes the apartment super hot in summer. The fans helped but the shades were not dark enough to keep things cool at all.
The space is nice and the kitchen is a good space.

The apartment is as described and is clean. The apartment is well located in the heart of Lastarria. Bed is comfortable. Cristian is attentive and responds quickly to any questions. Very reasonably priced and I had a pleasant stay. Thank you.
Great stay at Adrian's place - they were great hosts and provided everything needed, great value for the flat! Easy check-in process and good communication from the host.

Excellent place. Excellent communication. Exactly what I needed for 3 days in Santiago, close to Barrio Italia.
The communication with Miguel and his team was very profesional and helpful.
Great apartment. Stylish and cozy. Has everything you need. Francisco is a great host and tried to do everything for a comfortable stay. I definitely recommend it.
pablo was a excellent host. apartment was a 10. great views and very peaceful. will come back again and i totally recommend this place. thank you pablo

The apartment was perfect and had everything you needed and was also centrally located to everything.
Consuelo as a host is what makes everything even better. Her communication was incredible and she was so accommodating and helpful even during a nation wide power outage!
5 stars across the board, would recommend anyone to stay here.

Thank you so much Gustavo fir a great stay
10/10 fir everything it was a fabulous stay

A hop skip away from the MUT and costanera center. Absolutely spotless place very cozy fresh linens and Ignacio was very accommodating with an early check in and late check out definitely recommend this place if you want to be in a great area close to everything.

This is the best location in Santiago. The Airbnb was exactly as described and was incredibly charming and comfortable. The hosts were very proactive and responsive and made us feel at home. Cannot recommend this place enough!

I absolutely loved Hector's place! The location is pristine, the house is comfortable, beautiful and decorated with so much taste! And you get all the amenities you need. Thank you for being such a great host Hector!

Comfortable space in the center of Lastarria, great central location. Very responsive host, really appreciated flexibility with checkout, very kind. Unit is great for about 4-5 people, would feel a little cramped with more than that. Thank you!!

Gonzalo was a very good host. We asked him if we could check in earlier because of the flight, and he was there in the middle of the night to meet us. He switched to English because we weren't very fluent in Spanish. After our check-in, he was always responsive and helped us with some items that we needed.
The apartment is very cozy and has everything you need, even for a lengthy stay.
The location is great—it's about five minutes from the metro station and right near the bus stop. Because of that, it's easy to travel around Santiago.
The place looked exactly same as in the pictures, apartment view is amazing. Host is responsive. There are so many places to walk around. We highly recommend this option.

Very nice, clean and comfortable apartment in very safe and walkable area of Santiago. Great restaurants and shopping nearby. Check-in was very easy. Washer/dryer in unit was a plus, as is the great view of the city and mountains from the balcony. Host provided very clear and helpful instructions. Would definitely stay here again.

We loved Francisco’s place! We stayed for 3 weeks and it felt like home! The home is exactly as described and pictured, with very comfortable beds and a fully stocked kitchen. The neighborhood could not be better, very close to great cafes and restaurants. A supermarket and many bakeries within 5 mins. Pancho is an exceptional host - he greeted us with delicious breakfast, which we appreciated after a very long flight. He was always responsive to any question. Would highly recommend and would love to stay again.

The neighbourhood is located amongst restaurants, coffee shops, food stores, and a street market. With only a 15 minute way to the Centro this is a perfect location for a stay in Santiago. Communication was easy with David and Elena and they will do their best to accommodate your requests.
Clean, comfortable spot in the middle of the financial district of the city. Many restaurants nearby and safe, walkable area surrounding.
I’m so glad to have met in Chile. They kindness and warmth. Meeting them has been a wonderful experience.

Bernabe is an extraordinary host. His apartment is beautiful and well stocked with everything from breakfast to very good wine. But his hospitality and care are really outstanding.  We didn’t just stay at his apartment - we gained a great friend.  Belles Artes is a fabulous area and easily walkable to great restaurants, museums and sights. Bernabe’s trip to the ocean was unforgettable. Muchos gracias querido amigo!

I would definitely recommend staying here for your time in Santiago!
We arrived at the central bus station in Santiago which was super hectic, but after a quick taxi here we were so pleasantly surprised! It’s the perfect area and we were able to walk everywhere. The flat was nice and quiet and well designed with everything you need. Thanks!!
Great apartment in a great location. Everything was as per the advertisement. Paola was also very helpful and responsive to any queries that we had. Would definitely stay here again
Host was fast to respond to messages sent. It was a good place for us to rest. Staff were extremely helpful and courteous.

It was a cute apartment, cozy, well-located. Manuel was a great host. He connected me to local opportunities such as a language interchange program, and even arranged a free lesson before I left with a Spanish teacher! His English wasn't perfect, but probably good enough depending on what your level of Spanish is.
I would definitely recommend this Airbnb.
As described. Good home base with nice rooftop pool and area to relax in the sunshine. Very responsive and front desk were helpful. Would stay again.

Hector is a special person. Very helpful communicative, and understanding but also just generally amiable and happy. I really enjoyed talking to him.
The place is in an incredible location and feels very safe. Good access especially to bars and clubs.
The place is imaginative and artistic. Expect barebones in terms of appliances and functions. If you are good with that it’s an excellent place with a great host.
The place was very nice and modern. Very nice receptionist and very clean. I stayed for one month and highly recommend it!

second stay at this lovely apartment. loved watching life go by on the balcony.
Karen excellent host .
Thank you.
Susan

A great host with an excellent view and location.
I was nice and cozy in this apartment, and it is located to any and everything.
It could use a little TLC as others have stated, but ultimately a great stay.
Would stay again!

Antonio was a great host! He was very friendly and always tried to keep in touch with me. I had no worries about checking in.
The room was very clean and well equipped. The location was nice. It was easy to walk to the city center.
I really recommend you stay at this place!

We had an amazing stay at Mabel’s place! The loft was spotless and beautifully decorated. She has beautiful pieces of art that decórate the space beautifully. The location was perfect, walking distance to the beautiful Costanera Center Mall. Mabel was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our booking and stay, making everything smooth and easy. I have to mention as well that check out time was at 11pm making it so much easier and stress free for us as our flight back home was late. We 100% recommend Mabel’s beautiful loft.

Excellent budget option in Santiago - the place is clean and within close distance to many of the city’s attractions. It’s not located in the safest neighbourhood but I wouldn’t call it sketchy either.
Clean, cosy apartment with amazing view! Very helpful host who helped us a lot with storing our bags before check-in & after check-out
This was already our second stay at this place. Pablo was so nice to let us leave our luggage in the apartment after check-out for a few hours and we picked it up before the next check-in.

We arrived from Puerto Montt at around 2am and she was willing to stay up so we could get inside. The apartment is massive for the cost and it’s so nice. The surrounding area is also super walkable with tons of restaurants and lots to do. Definitely worth what we paid and I would go back here before even considering any of the other places we stayed during this trip. 11/10

Consuelo's place is cute with all the amenities my boyfriend and I could ask for including a metro card for public transportation! It was a great location, very walkable to a lot of great areas in Santiago!

Absolutely a fantastic location to explore a trendy, very cultural and just a great small neighborhood in Santiago. I am from Santiago but have been gone for 20 years and I would absolutely live in this area. It’s fantastic!
Great, fast communication and a lovely place in a great location. Loved having a pool which wasn’t busy at all due to it being a residential building :)
Comfortable apartment about 20 minutes walk from the main shopping mall and restaurants. Communication with Clara was excellent. The apartment is a bit small but has everything needed.
Great spot to stay at in Vitacura leading up to our wedding. Close to the best restaurants, hotels, and shopping.

Highly recommend this stunning
apartment with sweeping views, windows all around, large enclosed patio, lovely neighborhood. Much care and detail is evident with decorating and maintaining this classy home, including numerous amenities - fully equipped kitchen, filtered water, multiple TVs, luxury quality bedding, and more.
The building is VERY safe and secure, with excellent concierge.
We were able to securely drop off baggage early, without issue.
Very secure parking garage.
Our host Pamela was excellent, always quick to reply to any question. Pamela also provided helpful information about the surrounding area.
All was great, our group of five loved staying here, and would love to stay again.
I had a really comfortable and relaxed stay, and I’d recommend staying here to anybody! John was helpful and really welcoming. Also, everything was so clean, and John’s dog is super sweet!

The place didn't look as pleasant as the images suggested. One of the pillowcases had a stain on it which made me uncomfortable about what a blue light might highlight.
The location was fine. The host was responsive to messages.
Second time here, see my first review, all very good. Hope to be able to use the place again in the future.

We had a good stay here but be aware of the surroundings and the constant music and shouting throughout the entire night due to the nearby bars located on the main street in Bellavista. It can feel somewhat sketchy in the nearby area but the building has guards 24/7. The apartment smelled of smoke through the ventilation and the bed linen also smelled, the smell went away when we used the AC and opened the windows. The door to the main bedroom locked us on the inside and had to be open from the outside so we were lucky we were not alone in the apartment. The big bed had a quilt that was to small and didn't fit in the cover so we had to take it out. The host did not answer very fast, we asked for help with parking and then didn't receive any instructions when confirmed.

Was a nice place - we enjoyed the parque in the neighborhood.
And they were flexible with the check in.
Small things were not great: the communication is in another language and the sentences to short so the automated translation did not always work.

An awesome stay in an awesome city. The apartment had everything we needed and was super comfortable with an added bonus of beautiful sunshine on the balcony in the mornings with views of the mountains behind the city.
The apartment block also had a good gym and pool and we’d highly recommend going up to the top floor in the evenings for a sunset view of the city.
Really great stay, we’d love to come back in the future!

Amazing, Location!
Great parking on site and such a great host very responsive and helpful . Wonderful stay!
I strongly recommended you won’t be disappointed by the fantastic location

Francisco's place felt like the perfect place to experience the best of Santiago. The central location enabled us to easily explore the sights of central Santiago, the beautiful parks, the Barrio Italia and much more - all within 15-20 minutes walking distance. The house is decorated with beautiful antiques and artwork, we felt like kings and queens living here for the week! Francisco was very helpful with local recommendations and helping us arrange transport. We loved to hang out on the garden patio which overlooked a beautiful park and the dome of a nearby church in the evenings. It was very hard to leave this beautiful spot.

Host was responsive and easy to communicate with. The AC is only in the bedroom and is not able to properly cool down the apartment so it was very hot when we were there. It would be good to have up front information on how to access the laundry room and gym.

I had an amazing stay at Jose’s Airbnb! The place was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and all the amenities were in perfect condition. I especially loved the pool area with the stunning view. It’s located in a quiet neighborhood but still close to restaurants, and public transport.
Jose was very responsive and helpful and ensuring I had everything I needed. Check-in was seamless.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Santiago. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!
Greta location and apartment is cozy with everything needed. Would stay again my next time in Santiago.

Good Stay, very hot in March, AC would have been appreciated. Great View. Friendly staff. Brought us a French press that was missing. Small double beds were a bit tight, queen size prefered.
Good fit for 2 couples.
The apartment is in a great location with everything you need at a short distance walk. Host is excellent and very helpful. Highly recommended.
Conveniently located in Bells Artes neighborhood close to museums and restaurants. 24- doorman.

Francisca and her partner are so sweet and welcoming, I had a really nice stay here. The apartment is beautiful and it's in a great location. I was working remote here for a week and had a few issues with the internet while taking calls but other than that it was a great home base.  Would definitely recommend :)
It was exactly what we need, safe and everything close. Clara was really helpful and lovely, always available for any need. i

There not really anything negative that I can say about Carlas rental. The location itself with perfect for our family of 4 but could have easily accommodated another person or 2. The place had a full functional kitchen with everything you could need to cook your own meals. The balcony and all the windows made it very easy to keep a nice breeze blowing thru the unit and although the unit itself does not have AC, each room does have a fan and even with the daytime temps reaching well over 30 degrees during the day, it never got anywhere near that hot inside the unit itself.
The host was always quick to respond to any questions and the digital keypad entry made it easy for everyone to do their own thing without having to worry about rushing back to the unit to unlock the door!

I stayed in this apartment for 2 weeks, i have nothing but good things to say.
First, the location is great, close to the Parque Forestal, great restaurants and the subway.
The apartment was clean and equipped with all the essentials, Micaela was a great host, readily available for questions. 100 % recommended.
The apartment is very well located. It was very clean, and they are good restaurants nearby at a walking distance.

This was a wonderful experience. The location is great, with lots to do.
Check-in was smooth with even early check in.
Great location near the fish and vegetable markets. Walkable to the cathedral. Easy to get Uber to move around.
Felipe is a great and responsive host. He helped me a lot. The place is very cozy and clean!
It was a great place to stay for one night, but I wouldn’t recommend it for more than that. The bed needs to be changed, and the flat smells like cigarettes.
Amazing view of Santiago in a very convenient location by Terminal Sur and 20min uber from the airport. Easy check in and house exactly as advertised. Would stay again.
We enjoyed our time at Gabriel's place. The apartment was clean and well located with great views!. We would be happy to stay again.

Francisco was extremely accessible and quick to respond to any enquiries...
the place was as expected and published, and in a great location.
Marcia is very attentive and friendly which make our stay very comfortable. This apartment is also well located in a safe neighbourhood and easy accessible metro nearby.

Very much enjoyed Nancy's place.  Very clean and cozy.  The kitchen was well appointed and useful.  The washing machine worked well and was a great amenity, since I stayed several weeks.  Netflix and YouTube TV was a nice perk.  Internet was fast and consistent.  Nancy was responsive and the caretakers in the building were kind and helpful.  The location is perfect to explore the city.  Walking distance from many restaurants, Constanera Center, parks, and Cerro san Cristobal.  The metro station is less than 5 minutes away.  This place is good for long stays.  Highly recommend it.

The location of Fernando's apartment is incredible. It is literally in the middle of a village of incredible restaurants and within walking distance of many more! The only thing we only understood better when we got there was the issue of the building's parking being in a different place from where the apartments are. If you need to use the space, it is a good idea to ask Fernando for details.

We’ve had a very pleasant short stay at Felipe’s apartment. One can immediately tell that a host truly cares about his guests’ experience. The check-in was superbly organized,  with  immediate communication afterwards whenever needed.  Everything has a nice personal touch, including  a sweet welcome gesture upon arrival. The apartment is quite small but nicely designed and functional. Nice panoramic view of the city from the 13th floor corner unit. Central location, everything is within a short to a reasonably-distanced walk.  Very convenient for a brief stay in the city.

One of the most wonderful Airbnbs I have stayed in. Host is pleasant and responds very fast. The building is beautiful and safe with a rooftop with fantastic panoramic views of the city, tables to have dinner, and a pool. The apartment is charming and clean. The neighborhood surrounding the apartment is delightful and hip, close to many attractions, parks, and some of the best restaurants in the city. I would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone traveling to Santiago!

Gisela's courtyard oasis was the perfect place to refresh and plan excursions into the surrounding city neighborhoods. Although the cabin is compact the overall available space of the courtyard, kitchen, and the fantastically designed garden opened the actual space considerably.
The manager, Sumner was more than accommodating, offering suggestions for dining, laundry, and various neighborhoods worth visiting.
The neighborhood itself is leafy, quiet, and it felt extremely safe. An excellent bakery, laundry, and some small tidy markets are all located within a short block's walk. As well as a Chilean Walmart.
I highly recommend this home.

craftly described and pictured advertisement. it is really a single room with a bathroom. installed bookshelf between bed and sitting area does not make it two room apartment.
location is great in the bohemian part of town.
apartment is on the 4th floor with no lift in the building - this was not mentioned in the description.
inside of cupboards were either feeled with owners possessions or very dusty, could not use storage at all.

Christian’s place was a perfect spot in the heart of Santiago! We loved the location and it helped us to do everything we wanted to do. It was also a really nice place to come back to after a long day out.
A really beautiful flat with amazing views. Carlos was very communicative and quick to reply. The flat was very well equipped and the location is very central
Clean and pretty centrally located. Only complaint is how firm the bed is. Very responsive hosts. Would stay again.

5 stars!!! We have stayed in a lot of Airbnbs in many cities around the world and this was one of our favourites. We loved the style of the apartment and the location. Providencia is a beautiful suburb with lots to do, close to green spade and lots of restaurants. We were travelling with our two twin babies and really appreciated that they were able to provide two cots - it made our lives much easier 🙏🏼
We would love to stay here again next time we are in Santiago!

Good value, convenient flat, nice, clean, and tidy. The area isn’t great (and especially not safe at night as a tourist) but that is part of what makes the flat good value i guess.
Felipe is friendly and communicates well.

Staying at Cristian's place was great. The apartment is excellent, well-equipped, and just like the photos. The location is perfect — close to everything, with plenty of things to do nearby. I highly recommend it to everyone.

Pros:
Location near Lastaria. Subway station very close, newer smart tv, comfortable mattress, nice view from balcony.
Cons: falsely described as “new”, lacks character, plastic plants, entire place could use a paint job, closet doors stick difficult to open, need two hands to open side tables near bed otherwise drawers fall out, light next to couch won’t turn off button switch broke have to unplug instead. Kitchen had only the final dregs of salt, pepper and sugar…. Nothing else.
This place is essentially filled with cheap IKEA like furniture that has seen better days
There were no directions regarding garbage disposal or anything else for that matter only wifi login, No extra garbage bags.
In the end, I’d recommend choosing a different place. It didn’t meet my expectations for an airbnb. Not worth it really. You might as well check into a hotel.
The apartment is very easy to reach from the airport and just a short walk from the center. Great view, all equipment you'd want, just a bit more traffic noise than ideal.
Central location in the middle of all attractions and also very quiet. The room is not big but you have a private bathroom.

This lovely apartment in the heart of Santiago was perfect for a week long stay. It has excellent connectivity to the rest of the city and amazing views of Santiago by day and night.
Javier is an excellent host, able to help with just about any situation and available around the clock.
Please note, as the apartment is in the city centre, you can expect traffic during the day and some hustle and bustle at night, but well within the comfortable range.
Check in was a breeze, Don Cesar was outstanding at answering all our building related question and also had some good insight on the city and what to see.
Overall highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Santiago.

Nice apartment, matched the description and the photos. A bit older, but fully functional, and has everything you need. Top balcony and the view. Great host, let me check in a bit earlier, always responsive and friendly.
Really enjoyed Mirza's place. Easy to find, clean and had everything we needed. Loved small little touches like preparing a Bip! card for us so we can use the metro easily.
Gracias Germancitoooo! It was a beautiful time in your house :) cutie and very friendly host
It is comfortable apartment close to main activities in Santiago. Jesus is a great host, response in a quick timer manner and he is very helpful.

Came to Santiago for a wedding with my family and Olga’s place was great. It’s on a hill so if you dont have a car the exercise is awesome.
We had a little problem with the internet and it got resolved very quickly. Thank you Olga.
The house is spacious and the view of Santiago is amazing. Especially at night.
Excellent apartment,  very organized and clean. The host is also extremely attentive and helpful, great service with very clear instructions.

This is a great place, in a great location really close to the subway and my favorite park and a short walk to the Italian neighborhood which I like.
What I loved is the kitchen area with a real stove! And stocked with cooking essentials, which is a rare and underappreciated convenience. It shows the real empathy of the hosts, who were great help responding immediately and proactively checking in with me.
I'd definitely go back.

Nice, clean apartment, good location near metro, with two good bedrooms. Only downside was that it got hot during the day, no aircon but several fans available. Concierge downstairs was very helpful. Good communication.

Great location and comfortable loft apartment with a great view of the hill and its funicular. There is a bit of noise at night (past midnight, even on a weekday) both from outside and the building neighbors that you will want to be prepared for.  Alvaro is super communicative and helpful. Recommend!

Christian’s place was awesome - clean, comfortable and stylish with everything we needed. The location is amazing - literally steps away from Santa Lucia hill where you can take a nice stroll and convenient to many shops and restaurants. Highly recommended!

The apartment was simply delightful, and exactly as pictured. It also is well located to easily explore
Various neighborhoods and sights.

The place is EXCELLENT.
Great location in the city with the metro in easy walking distance.
Fabulous sitting out area with a comfy armchair and a table and more chairs. Panoramic view of the city.
The entire “ window wall” slides open for great flow.
The glazing has great soundproofing and being on the 9th floor the city noise can easily be shut out.
The place has a really nice vibe , it feels like a home from home.
The host is super friendly and responsive.

This apartment is very well positioned. You can walk to all central sites and any bar or restaurant you want. The streets are clean and safe. There is good security at the entrance to the tower block and everyone we met in the elevator was polite and friendly. Pablo was an excellent host and responded very quickly to any message we sent him. The apartment's photos are flattering, but it's a perfectly well equipped accommodation with a comfortable bed and is excellent value for the area. It is in a large tower block so you will hear the neighbours if you have the windows open.

The place is very modern and comfortable with great amenities. Beautiful view from the rooftop.  Large mall complex within 7-8 minutes of walking.  It's a very busy area so there's a lot of traffic noise during the day.  However, it's fairly quiet at night.

The apartment is in a fantastic location—safe, walkable, and convenient. However, the cleanliness needs improvement, as I had to re-clean upon arrival.
One major issue was the internet connection. The apartment relies on WiFi from a neighboring unit, which made troubleshooting impossible. As a result, I was without internet for four full days—a significant problem since I was working remotely. I had to spend extra money on mobile data to stay connected.
On the positive side, the laundry facilities were very convenient—affordable, easy to use, and a great added benefit.
Ignacia’s apartment was lovely and in a great location for our stay in Santiago. As a host, she was super helpful, responsive and kind. Would recommend staying here
Nice view of the city, but noise from the highway made sleeping diificult.   furnishings as pictured, but more worn, could use updating.
The location of the flat was very convenient, the check-in and check-out very smooth, but overall the place is in more need of maintenance than we expected from the pictures.
The apartment is cute and comfortable. It is located downtown, right in the heart of the neighborhood. There is music all the time that also enters the apartment. We loved it.

A really perfect Space in Santiago, with a high price/quality ratio
The place has all you need and is actually huge
Two separate bedrooms both with ensuites and a nice kitchen and leaving room

We had a great stay! Very close to the Salvador subway stop that made it so easy to zip around the city. The area felt safe, the apartment was very cozy and Andrea was really responsive to any questions we had. We would recommend for sure.
Bruno was very friendly & helpful and communicated well. Accommodation is well located and once you get the hang of the safe card app - easy to access. Would recommend it to anyone visiting Santiago.
I'm very pleased with the accommodations. The apartment was clean and had a spectacular balcony and view. It was in close proximity to malls and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again.

This airbnb is beautiful and Gabriela is an amazing host! Gabriela is super friendly and helpful and goes out of her way to make you feel at home!
This was my second time staying here and I was so happy to be back!
The view is beautiful, the apartment has everything you need, and the location is wonderful.
A wonderful stay... just as described and presented in photos. The host was extremely helpful and responsive to inquiries. A great neighbourhood!

All of the hosts at this property were exceptionally kind and responsive. The property is clean and the pictures are an accurate representation. It's a lovely apartment.
The location was a bit of a busy street and Providencia was a bit too hectic for us.
The place was perfect! It was in a wonderful location and Barrio Italia was so charming. We could walk or take public transportation to all things Santiago. Highly recommend!
We had an excellent time at Catalina’s location. It was right in the heart of Santiago and we had easy access to whatever we wanted to do and the amenities were perfect within the apartment itself.

Really great room and host. The fastest internet I’ve ever had — great for those that need to work like I did. Room is spacious and very close to many great places of interest. Security downstairs is friendly. Host very quick to reply to messages. No complaints from me about anything!
Great, peaceful spot for a longer stay. Beautiful neighborhood and the apartment has everything you will need. I hope to return.

Prime location, prime host that was attentive without being intrusive. Francisco was so kind, professional , and helpful. He was available when we had an unexpected car issue.
I’m very particular about cleanliness and Francisco gets a five out of five! The domestic help was delightful.
The area is amazing for walking, restaurants, and family time. The house is stunning, large, beautifully decorated and tranquil terraces.
The beds and furniture were very comfy. We felt very safe and secure. This is truly a gem and so is his artwork! Thank you, Francisco, I can’t imagine a a better place to say in Santiago.

I had a fantastic stay at Valentina’s Airbnb in Santiago! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location, making it easy to explore the city. Valentina was a friendly and attentive host, always ready to help with recommendations.
The apartment was fabulous! Close to many restaurants the heated pool was amazing. The sauna was top-tier and overall enjoyed our stay at her apartment. Thank you again!

Thank you Pancho! We loved our stay. It was very green and peaceful ands near great restaurants and other amenities and within walking
