distance to multiple parks and playgrounds.

My first time in Santiago and I felt quite comfortable alone in the apartment. The concierge was very helpful and the host always responsive. Terrific places to eat a short distance away in Lastaria and handy to a supermarket. Perhaps not as roomy as I imagined but certainly happy to recommend.

Alejandro was so helpful in many ways.  Always attentive to my needs even letting me know I could check in early.  Great host and Lastarria is a great, very safe neighborhood with a grocery store below and the metro station one block away!
Very nice apartment on a great location. The place has all the amenities you may need to feel at home. The host is helpful and kind. Highly recommendable.

Gabriela’s apartment is located in a great area of the city - it felt safe and was a few minutes’ walk to the nearest metro station. The apartment is spacious and felt very homely. Gabriela was very responsive, friendly and gave us plenty of recommendations for our time in Santiago. We loved our stay and would recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Santiago!
amazing place and amazing location. few minor details that could make it go from great to extraordinary, but repeating great overall

Was not able to visit santiago as I fell ill, but if it was not for Francisca's airbnb and her help I would have had a lot harder time. She helped replenish things when needed and get me medicine to my door the first day as I was very ill. Her place made it easy for food delivery and security in the building is really good. It was literally my home away from home as I was recovering there. If I come back when I am well, I would definitely book her place again.

I had a fantastic stay at Carmen's house.  The room is nice and sunny and the house is fully equipped.  I was very comfortable.  It's in a safe, leafy neighbourhood with dappled sunlight and many things to see and do within walking distance.  Such a good vibe.

This place is a hidden gem. 24/7 security , laundry and close to everything . You most experienced the rooftop pool at night and take an opportunity to see a panoramic view of the city, it’s beautiful. The host was very easy to deal with and always responded in a timely manner.
We found this place to be perfect for our stay. We enjoyed the neighborhood and the building staff were very friendly.  The unit was clean and well appointed.  We recommend it
Very nice stay. the view is  incredible and the hosts were very proactive and helpful. Will stay here again for sure next time.

Apartment has everything you need. Was a very comfortable stay for our last few days in Santiago and great value overall. In a great location and very central. Rodrigo is very responsive and helpful! Would totally recommend
you will not be disappointed staying in this penthouse. It's a little slice of heaven in Santiago
Very nice location, close to many shops and restaurants, both the host and staff in the building were responsive and friendly. Great experience.
While staying here, everywhere we needed to go was walkable. Thank you to Almarsur for the early check in for our first days in Chile!

Great apartment in a fantastic location — right across from St. Lucia Hill and close to lots of great cafes and restaurants. The apartment is spacious and comfortable, especially the living room, and it has everything you need for a longer stay. Cristian was a friendly and helpful host. Would definitely recommend!

Manuel was a great host - very friendly and helpful.  He sent me a lot of information before my stay. The location of the flat is perfect - it's right in the city centre.  It was really well equipped and the communal launderette was easy to use. The WiFi was fast and reliable. I'd definitely stay there again.

This is a lovely airbnb and Ivan is a wonderful host!
The views are beautiful and the neighborhood is amazing.
Second time staying here. If I have the opportunity, would stay here again. Couldn't pick a better location!

If I have my own studio apartment in future, this is how it might look like! Clean, cosy for one person, convenient, I have everything I need to work remotely for a week.
I like that the host is artistic to put books, decorations, art pieces that exemplifies the personality of the host.
I really enjoyed my 1 week of stay in this unit.
But, the neighborhood to the south and west might feel a bit sketchy, just be more careful.
Great place to stay, with an incredible view which was important for me. I'll be staying there again for sure

Cannot say enough good things about this place! My friends and I had a blast, it was so comfortable and the perfect space for our trip. Esteban and his team were very responsive and respectful, always.
Great location. Basics are all there and the wifi for working remotely was great. The host communication was awesome too, she helped us find a driver we used a couple times.
A really clean and well equipped apartment in Santiago - was nicer than the pictures! The concierge was very friendly at check-in and we had a great night’s sleep!

Wilmer Enrique was a great host, very clear and attentive. The studio flat was exactly what I needed, clean and with lovely sheets, in a great location, easy to get to everywhere by metro or bus, and walking distance from most of the places I needed to go to. Will return.

Very Very comfortable place. Was really happy I was able to return for a second time to stay. An apartment with everything you need to make you feel at home. I hope to return to stay here next time I am in Santiago. I highly recommend.

The location of the Airbnb is really good, next to nice restaurants, bars and stores.
Luis was very responsive at all times and allowed us to check in early.
The only thing that we would suggest is maybe to take the water pressure in the shower a bit up. Other than that everything went smooth and we enjoyed our stay with Luis.
Air b&b is very annoying.  After five 5 stars ratings, to force me to do more in order to proceed  is more than irritating.

Andrea’s apartment was a lovely place to stay in Santiago, walking distance to the historical centre and near to the metro to get further around the city. It was immaculately kept and nicely decorated. Shower was great with good water pressure and hot water.

We stayed for four nights in the apartment. Easy to find. Smooth check-in and check-out. Very careful and attentive host. Not too spacious, but cosy. There is everything for a short stay. Incredible view from a window (25th floor)! Recommended!

Great place, located close to the metro, restaurants, and in quiet neighborhood. Clean.
Would stay again.

Camilo’s place is an absolute gem in Santiago! Well located in Providencia, the apartment is an easy walk to local restaurants and shops… and a simple stroll to the metro. The apartment itself is charming, well appointed with thoughtful touches. Camilo is extraordinarily communicative and accommodating, with great instructions for those who arrive early with luggage and lots of wonderful tips. Would stay again! Gracias!

The flat is located in the metropolitan area. Its walkable distance to all the major things the city has to offer. the neighbourhood itself is not extravagant but a few mins walk and you find all the tourists. The best thing is the price as it’s totally worth it. The amenities in the house worked find. The internet works super fast and had no issues with my meetings. There is a 25th floor with very nice 360 views of the city and also a self laundry that you can use for 1300 chilean pesos each per cycle for both the dryer and washing machine). I managed to also make breakfasts at home as it came equipped with all the utilities. The building is safe with 24/7 security and quiet neighbours. Over all a great stay (you eventually get use to the blue colour :))

everything was great, secure, apartment was super clean . perfect shower. super cozy bad, nice tv, good kitchen equipment, perfect communication. we were tired from traveling and we stayed like 2 days only in the apartment and it was perfect for that.
recommended

I really enjoyed my stay here Magdalena is so kind and warm and I felt very welcomed into her home. The location is central and close to everything. The house is big enough that there's plenty of privacy and the outside area is a lovely place to relax with lots of plants. A very charming house, I highly recommend!

The apartment is clean & comfortable.
Sara Cecilia was very responsive in answering our questions & ensuring we had everything we needed. We used the fan in the bedroom to help drown some of the street & construction noise. We will consider staying again when we are in Santiago.

Exceptional stay ! Sebastian is really responsive and kind. You have the ability to do your laundry, which is a must when we travel. The apartment is very well located, there is everything you need and the vibe is very chill and great. I would recommend 100%!

Camilo makes the most beautiful spaces - felt like home staying at her apartment. And in the heart of vibey Santiago with lots of great restaurants - and she shared a great list of recommendations too :)
No problems; host is very kind and even arranged for late checkout due to my flight being delayed. Would book with again

Javiera is a great Host. She was very responsive and her appartment is beautiful, safe  & clean! It’s located close to a very cute district called “Barrio Italia” and we had a great time here. We definitely would book it again for our next stay in Santiago. Highly recommend :)

A small place but I was traveling alone so it was comfortable enough for me and it contained everything that I needed to prepare my own vegetarian meals.  Good location, safe, quiet, fast internet, and within walking distance to stores and restaurants. Recommended for the solo traveler or a couple that simply needs an inexpensive place to shower and sleep in-between day tours.  I will definitely check for the availability of Jose's place the next time I'm planning a stop in Santiago.
Evelyn was a great host, and made sure i had everything I needed. Super communicative

Great place and great deal!
Carolina was super responsive and an amazing host.
We would definitely come back!

The value for money is fair, the location is very good for reaching various points of interest in the city, and it is also situated in a safe area. There are many shops and restaurants nearby, which is a great advantage. The apartment itself is clean and matches the description. Communication with the host was also efficient.
The place was lovely and Barrio Italia is a sweet neighbourhood! A well equipped suite in a great building. Karen was an incredibly attentive and responsive host. Would absolutely stay here again!

Great place! Jeka was very help and great with communication. The place had many ammenities, which was fantastic! This is such good value for the price, thank you so much for having us Jeka, we look forward to staying again soon 😊
Amazing accomodation, must stay here if you are visiting! Near fabulous restaurants and a cute shopping area.

Beautiful modern apartment, extremely clean and well located. The bed is so comfortable! Close to the centre and museums. Area was busy and felt safe. Check in was very easy especially as we arrived late at night. Thank you for a wonderful stay

Safe, quiet apartment in the heart of one of Santiago's best neighborhoods. It was my first trip to Santiago and I did not know much about the different areas. I am so lucky I chose this apartment, after exploring various other neighborhoods there is no where else I would rather stay. A cozy home base for your trip. Cannot recommend enough!
We had a great stay at Mauricio's Airbnb. The area was very walkable, safe, and convenient, with access to the subway and a large mall. Mauricio was very responsive and easy to communicate with.

We had a blast staying at Clara’s place in Santiago. It’s located in the perfect place, minutes away from the metro station and central to all the popular attractions. The apartment was tidy, clean, and extremely comfortable. Clara was a fantastic host and was very accommodating to our check-in and out times. She made sure we had everything we needed (and more) to ensure we were comfortable. We cannot recommend Clara as a host and her place enough.

Andrea’s place is exactly as described! When we first walked into the apartment it smelled clean and the view from the balcony was breathtaking. The kitchen is equipped with everything you need to prep a quick meal. Bedroom has enough space to put away your clothes and bed is super comfortable. Also the water runs pretty good in all faucets and shower. Overall we really enjoyed our stay and will definitely recommend Andrea’s place you will not be disappointed. (One thing I do have to be honest for light sleepers, is that it’s a bit noisy, because the apartment is on a main street and close to a hospital so you can hear the traffic and ambulances, however for us it did not bother, we were able to sleep well)

The apartment was more spacious than thought. It was easy to find and had a great view over the surrounding blocks.
We had no difficulties and loved our stay. Would 100% recommend :)

Lovely place to stay in a good location, good transport and lots of things to do in the area. Maritza was very accommodating and helpful with her suggestions in and amongst the surrounding area. Would love to come back!
A really great place to stay when you're in Santiago. Loved the views at sunrise and sunset.
Cozy apartment near Santiago Center.Adrian was a friendly host, helpful and provided with insightful information when needed.

The neighborhood is fantastic with many places to eat and many pubs within walking range. Great vibes. It’s also easy to get around the city from there. Good location overall. The place itself was also great. It’s everything you’d need for a few days in Santiago.

Luis place is an excellent choice for your stay in Santiago. It is in a great location that felt very safe but is also a vibrant neighborhood. The apartment is situated on a side street just one block from a very popular area. It was very quiet in the apartment. They left us chocolate, water, fruit and a bottle of wine which we very much enjoyed. Highly recommend staying here!

I had long flight and arrived morning to Santiago,Nolfa texted me you are tried go n check in early . It was amazing and really appreciated thank you so much . Place is close to everywhere and definitely come back again

What an absolute delight! Such a unique space and the perfect oasis to unwind after a day of exploring. Cool period touches, a relaxing outdoor space, what more could you ask for? Gisela was an amazing host and we had a delightful stay. Definitely coming back when we come to Santiago again!
This is a great airb&b. I fully recommend it. The location is great and all the staff very kind and helpfull. I will come back, when possible !
We spend one night in the appartement, it is very well located and has a beautiful view of the mountains. Nice place to spend few days visiting Santiago.
Nice apartment, well located. I enjoyed my stay. The communication with the host was friendly and quick. I would certainly recommend this place. Thank you!

We were very happy with the apartment.  The location was very convenient!  Enjoyed the stay and the quick response when I had questions.  I worked remote a few days and the only downside was noise from a school nearby mid-day.

Amazing place!
Region super well located, easy to go to metro and walkable restaurants nearby.
good apartment and also good amenities

We loved everything about the apartment. It was very clean, looked just like the photos, and was in a great location - quiet yet close to so many great restaurants. Camilo was very easy to communicate with and he was incredibly accommodating. We would definitely stay here again if we have the opportunity to return to Santiago in the future!

Good compact Airbnb with everything you need. Reliable wifi and hot shower water. Good selection of SmartTV channels. It's also in a happening central and walkable area. Isabel is a responsive host in tune with guests' needs. Recommended!

Everything was great with the apartment, the location is excellent and we had a great communication during the stay. I decided to stay one more day in the city and they helped me a lot with that. Thanks again!

We had an excellent stay at Oliver's flat. The bed is very comfortable and cosy. The apartment is spacious and well kempt. Apartment block was secure and quiet.
Walking distance to cafes, restaurants and pubs.
Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Would recommend a clothes drying rack as the dryer on the washing machine takes too long.

Great apartment near Barrio Italia with many restaurants and place to walk. Metro station is 50 meters away from the building. The host even provided a card to use a metro. We had 0 issues with the equipment and building, used the gym. Beautiful view and safe area!
The apartment was great, and the host was very responsive. Any issues we had were quickly addressed. Overall, a very pleasant stay.

We had a great 3 nights at Cristian's apartment. Everything we needed was there. Clean, comfortable, convenient and funky. Great communication. Convenient location. Washer/Dryer a total bonus. Would highly recommend.

Lovely stay, amazing view. Safe neighborhood, extremely walkable but also close to a subway station. We missed some kitchen supplies as we chose to cook dinner on some nights. Everything else was great.
Quite, clean and very nice and responsive host! Excellent place to stay for a couple of nights!

This apartment satisfied all my priorities when I travel: the location couldn’t be faulted, character, light and bright, secure, clean. We had no issues at all. Walking distance to many places and close to transport, metro and many bus routes. It should be said that we only eat breakfast in the apartment, we never cook. The building is older but very clean.

Thank you so much for this amazing stay! I was allowed to check in a few hours earlier as well which was so nice, thank you! The area was lovely and there are lots of restaurants and things to do in the vicinity. The property was so nice and the host is so helpful
We enjoyed our stay, perfect for our needs. Apartment was clean and comfortable. Rene was accomodating and helpful.

This was my third time back at Gabriela’s Airbnb, I love it!
Gabriela is so kind, she’s very communicative, she’s an amazing host and she goes out of her way to make you feel at home!
The view is gorgeous. The location is wonderful. The apartment is always very clean and lovely and full of all you need for a short or long stay.
I highly recommend Gabriela’s Airbnb!
Thanks. The appartment is very  clean, well equiped and well located. Fran is helpful and kind

Thanks for that place. Was clean and comfortable.
It is a bit noisy because the road, but you can close the door to the balcony and use air conditioner.
Very good place. Highly recommended

This is an absolutely perfect place for a short or even medium-term stay in Santiago. I spent a week in Marcelo’s charming apartment, and I had an all-around great experience. The apartment is comfortable, the location is extremely convenient, and Marcelo was a super friendly, helpful, and responsive host. 5 stars across the board. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Daniella's place locates at the beautiful area in vitacura, and especially with a beautiful first-floor balcony. It is just feeling like home. Daniella is a very responsive and helpful guest, who helps me a lot during the stay, and provide very helpful recommendations as well. I would highly recommend this place!
Abolutely perfect - the apartment is exactly as in the photos, the kitchen has absolutely everything, the view from the balcony is fantastic and the area is great. Highly recommended!

This is the second time we've stayed at Antonio's. Its a wonderful place and location right on the park and it feels just like a home away from home. I was there for work with my family and it was central to the metro, cafes and shops.

Great place to stay! Really loved the apartment and area. It was peaceful and had everything close by. Paola was a great host and was very responsive. We have family in Santiago and definitely plan on staying here again.

Good location in Providencia - felt very safe, and walkable to other areas including the San Cristobal hill. Ubers were also very cheap to get around the city.
There are a couple of "corner shops" next door and a Starbucks round the corner. There is a Santa Isabel supermarket about 10 minutes walk and a huge shopping centre about 20 minutes walk.
The flat was clean and had all the essentials. Clara was very responsive
The apartment gym was quite spacious but only had a couple of old weight machines. We didn't try the pool.

Absolutely amazing hosts!!! We came to Chile unprepared and they offered us jackets to stay warm and showed us around the city. The apartment is so cute and clean filled with plants and a beautiful balcony. You feel very comfortable. So grateful for this experience! 🤍
The place is really nice and worth the money. There is plenty of space throughout the apartment, the appliances and furniture are nice and everything is clean.
Great location and place to stay in Las Condes! Everything you need is in walking distance! Would come again!

The apartament is lovely, very clean, well taken care of, tasteful decoration and super functional.
I did not miss anything, the staying was amazing. everything I needed Daniela was very helpful and proactive in her responses.
The building staff is nice and helpful.
I stayed there for a month and I highly recommend it.
thank you Daniela! <3
Quite place in a great bar and food area. Also easy to reach the metro by walking. A great place to stay.
Beautiful and functional apartment, fully equipped with everything we needed. Great service at the front desk. We didn’t have to worry about anything. Highly recommend!
Camilo’s place worked extremely well for myself, mom and sister traveling to Santiago. It is a very safe unit and beautifully decorated and cared for. Would stay again when back in Santiago!

Lovely apartment in a unbeatable location! The apartment is one block away from the metro station and is located in the heart of Providencia/Las Condes. Amazing communication with the hosts during my entire stay (~10 days), and the apartment was perfect for 1-2 people. It was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed. I'd definitely stay again :)

perfect place to spend the week in Santiago. The apartment is big for one or a couple. It is close to lots of shops and small restaurants. The place is close to several metro stations and places of interest. I highly recommend this place

The apartment was everything and above any expectations we had! Everything was extremely clean and laid out for us to have a comfortable stay. We felt very safe as well and the area surrounding was walkable and full of cafes and sights to see. The communication we had with the hosts was also perfect. Would stay at this fabulous apartment again!
Exelent place,safe and Rosario's hospitality is exelent,a grat place to be at.

David and Francisco’s place is amazing! Clean, great city view, secure, and it’s no need to share the bathroom!
They also teach me useful knowledge of Chile, like traditional foods, drink, cities, and Santiago attractions. And I even tried some Chilean food there.
Really recommend! 👍🏻
Cristóbal went above and beyond making sure we had a wonderful stay.  High recommend staying here!!! Amazing views, sunsets, and dining options to walk to.
Comfortable space in a lovely and peaceful neighborhood perfect for walking. Many nearby cafes and bakeries as well as local markets to pick up any needed essentials.

very nice apartment and very responsive host. Don't really have anything to complain except that the neighbours can be a bit noisy at times and turn up the music pretty loudly. But that is of course not the hosts fault. Other than that all perfect!

Great location. The apartment is exactly as described although there is a repetitive constant water flush from the floors above which can be heard throughout the day and night which is disturbing. Once this is fixed it would be a great space

Nicolas is excellent host, picked me up at the airport.. the apartment matches the pics & description of the apartment. Nicolas responds very quickly to questions and concerns. Great location, very walkable to supermarkets, pharmacies,  gyms and restaurants. Definitely recommend this apartment.
Great location, super clean, easy and really fast communication! Would always come back and highly recommend!

The apartment was excellent—beautifully designed with spectacular framing and equipped with absolutely everything you could need for a comfortable stay.
Its location couldn't be more central, making it easy to explore the city on foot. Communication with Gustavo was seamless and prompt throughout the entire process.
Highly recommended!
Lionel was a great host. Very responsive to any questions or issues I had. The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photos and situated in a great location.

I appreciated that the host is proactive, helpful and responsive. But the apartment is not well maintained, there are cracks on the floor and walls. In general it's a decent apartment but (for me) a bit too expensive for what it offers.
Amazing host , great location , near the restaurants , coffee stores , lots of thing to do around , the best place ever . The view of the apartment is breathtaking.

Comfy unit ,great location,all you need close at hand
We used the convenient heater as it was cold at night
Everything as described. It was just not that clear how to check-in, I had to wait a bit.
Great location to Barrio Italia.  Place was very comfortable and safe!  Would highly recommend to anyone visiting in Santiago.
Great appartment to explore the city. Nice paintings on the wall, pleasant atmosphere. The only problem was that the toilet was clogged the day that we left the appartment.

The apartment was well located, and had everything we needed for our stay! The building has great amenities and in a great location! Jessica went above and beyond as a host and we definitely recommend this apt and Jessica as a host at any of her properties!

This apartment was fabulous and had great  views of the city and the Andes. It had a small but perfectly formed balcony where you could sit and admire the views while enjoying a glass of Chilean wine. It was within walking distance of the historic sites and there were some good local bars and restaurants. It was just above the metro which we used frequently definitely a cheap and quick way to get around Santiago. Carlos was a great host,  extremely helpful responsive and a really nice guy who could not do enough for us. He recommended a good variety of restaurants for us to try in both Santiago & Valparaiso. Overall a great visit!

Friendly host, really easy to get from the airport. Just take the bus to Terminal Sur and it’s 5 -10 minutes walking, extremely convenient! The area is around 10-15 minutes by metro do downtown, supermarket near by. It can be noisy if you are sensitive but I didn’t have any issues. Highly recommended

I had a wonderful time at Carmen's house. Everything was nice and clean as pictured and the house (located in a quite and cute neighborhood) makes me feel very like home. Would definitely stay here again if I come back to Santiago :)

Brian is a wonderful host the apartment is beautiful clean is in a very nice area I give it a 5 star.
Thank you Brian for everything.

Carolina was always very quick to respond and help out if needed. Her place is convenient for people visiting the clinic like I was. It’s in a very safe upper level neighborhood. There are restaurants nearby and it’s pretty walkable. All of the amenities matched the description and overall I enjoyed the whole experience. I would recommend staying with Carolina.

Luis’s listing was exactly as expected and is a great location if you want somewhere that feels safe and in a good neighbourhood. Luis was very helpful and friendly with all the questions I asked and gave me very good recommendations.

An okey stay for one night. We had an unpleasant check in with their big dog jumped us after we told her that we are afraid of dogs. Otherwise the photos were a bit misleading compared to what we experienced in person.
One of the best airb&b I’ve ever stayed in! Super clean- new- modern! Walkable location and great apartment amenities. I really enjoyed using the sauna and the host was great at coordinating with me!
Clean, accurate listing. Host was responsive. Check-in was easy. Neighborhood was quiet. Would stay again.

The apartment is excellently located. Walking distance to everywhere around barrio Italia.
Very easy to get in and out.
Lots of natural light inside.
Appliances enough for all the basics.
Would totally recommend.
Perfect place to stay in a beautiful neighbourhood in Santiago, right next to Santa Lucia hill and walking distance to good restaurant, shops and parks!

The place was just perfect for us! We really enjoyed fully equipped and spacious flat. Neighbourhood is very safe with everything you need walking distance. Ignacia always were very helpful. Thank you!

The apartment is really perfect for a stay in Santiago. It's located in the best and safest part of the city, metro station and one of the biggest shopping centres in Santiago are just a few minutes by walk. Everything was very clean and modern.

Stayed two night, be warned that there’s no lift and it’s a spiral stairs.
Room was really clean and nice, space was nicely planned, not too cramped with the dining area around.
We had issues with tv connecting to the wifi in order to watch anything, but nobody did a thing about it, the guy via text nor the guy in the building didn’t bother coming up to take a look. The next day it just self recovered somehow.
Instructions to depart was not clear, tried looking for the building keeper to return the key, ended up only after texting the building owner and was told to leave the keys back in the room.

It’s a cozy place clean and well maintained .
It has everything I expected for my stay . I personally would have appreciated some more kitchen utensils but the apartment has it all for one to be comfortable .
Great value. Very clean, all the amenities I needed. And a washer/dryer in the unit is rare and convenient here. Very happy to recommend
Great apartment in a nice location. Very clean and comfortable. Host was great with communication! Definitely recommend for a stay in Santiago.

Josés place was wonderful! Super easy check in, felt very safe and awesome location. Easily walk to bars restaurants and attractions. José was very friendly and responsive, even going above and beyond for us to accommodate an early check in.

It was an excellent place for my stay. I traveled to Santiago with my wife to attend my mom's funeral, and this place was very convenient, great location (close to my mom's apartment), very safe (even late at night), and Jose went the extra mile trying to make my stay as comfortable as possible. I highly recommend his place and won't hesitate to book it again (if available) in my next visit to Santiago.
Absolutely amazing place, especially For the price. Super private and in one of the best areas. Place was spotless as was the neighborhood. I would definitely stay here again when I’m in Santiago.

Andrés and Luisa were grea and attentive hosts. The place is beautiful and in one of the most ideal locations in Santiago, walkable from everything. Very pet friendly and with a very nice park on site where our puppy could run and socialize with other dogs from the area. Would love to return!
Great place and location, very quiet and green, made it very special. Daniella is a great host

It has a good location for walking to the main places of Santiago and close to Barrio Italia, a place with good restaurants and a nice variety of activities. The hosts were available all the time and answered really quickly. The place was in good shape.

Great stay in a nice safe neighborhood. The apartment is spacious and sunny. The bed is comfortable. The kitchen has all you need for a long term stay. Rodolfo was very helpful and the communication was smooth. 100 % recommended

A great stay in a fantastic area of Santiago. Beautiful apartment that was very well equipped with an incredible view. Host’s instructions were so detailed, even with videos attached for extra help. I would highly recommend!
A lovely host who kept in touch with us. The apartment was spacious with very comfortable beds and a lovely balcony.  A really pleasant stay.
Wonderful apartment in the heart of the Providencia neighborhood with great access to the best restaurants.  Apartment was well furnished and our host Camilo was very welcoming and helpful.
Rodolfo was very helpful, and his place was a great stay. It's in a very walkable area, and I enjoyed walking to Cerro Santa Lucia!

What a wonderful home! Very comfortable and clean and quiet. Neighborhood is located in a residential area, near public transit and walkable. Plaza closeby has a small grocery store with all the essentials. Would highly recommend this place!
Gonzalo was very responsive and helpful. Space is in a good location, however, a bit rough around the edges compared to US standards,

This is not a newly remodeled apartment as stated in the listing. Maybe it was 10+ years ago, but it is not anymore. The pictures are MUCH nicer than reality. The apartment felt stale, unclean and dingy; especially the coffeemaker, utensils, dishes, cups, pots and pans that I had to wash myself before using. The oven worked nicely and I was able to bake a cake. Communication was decent (I mentioned all above) and Pablo provided great recommendations for the vibrant area. The metro card was very thoughtful. Location is excellent and mountain views are fabulous although, due to pollution, you cannot always see them. No direct sunlight. I appreciated the cleaning service mid-stay in my two week stay.

We enjoyed our stay in this Santiago apartment, Everything was clean and in order. Our host was responsive and while we paid for an extra day we were able to get into the apartment after our overnight flight at 7am.

Perfect spot in Santiago, quiet, safe, clean and friendly. I’ve stayed in some other places for more than a month and Jonathan has been the best by far. 👌
Recommended 🫡

The place was very clean, thoughtfully decorated, and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. The view of Santiago and the mountains was stunning, and communication with the host was excellent. Highly recommend!

Wonderful Stay in a Beautiful Apartment
We had a fantastic stay! The apartment is modern, spotless, and located in a safe, attractive neighborhood close to great restaurants. Each bedroom having its own bathroom was perfect for our needs. The host was incredibly responsive and friendly, making everything easy. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

The place itself is fine. It’s clean enough and in a decent location.
My review is just because of multiple small things that could be improved:
- We only got one key and you had to have it to leave, which was extremely inconvenient when one person of the group went out without the others.
- The check in is very late and the check out is very early. Early check in is very inflexible and you only get early check in if you pay for a whole extra night.
- The main gate was supposed to have keyless entry but it was not working as confirmed by the host.
- There wasn’t any soap or shampoo like the listing said.
- The TV in the main bedroom would not turn on.
- I received way too many automated messages from the host which made things kind of confusing at times. I received 4 different codes and only one of them worked.
Great stay in the heart of Providencia. The apartment was great for working remotely. I really liked how spacious and functional the space was. I’d love to stay again here in the future.

Anita’s warmth and affection made me feel instantly at home; she welcomed me not as a guest, but as a friend! Her husband was equally kind and thoughtful, always making sure I had everything I needed. Together, they have created a space that feels like a home away from home. I even went away for a few days to Isla Negra and Valparaíso and didn’t once feel the need to lock my room— that’s how comfortable and safe I felt. And with Pablo Neruda’s house just 400 meters away, the location couldn’t have been better. Highly recommended.
Pablo is a nice host and made my stay easy.  Nice place to stay near the heart of town!

The apartment is very comfortable, clean. Has everything you need. The balcony and view is amazing. Building is located in the nice area with lots of restaurants. Very safe and touristic. Gonzalo is very responsive, helpful and reliable. Thank you. Was very nice stay.

A cute place to stay in Santiago in one of my most favourite areas... beautifully quiet with a stunning view of Santa Lucia Hill.. Javier is superb at checking all is ok and nothing is too much trouble... thank you Javier!

Stayed at Lucia’s place for one night and had no issues at all. The apartment was clean and felt very comfortable.
It appears to have central air conditioning, which was a nice surprise since not many places in Chile have that. On a cold night, the apartment was warm and cozy, a big plus!
We had a few questions and contacted the host, who replied very quickly.
The apartment has a great view from the 20th floor, overlooking Cerro San Cristóbal and the city of Santiago. The night view was great.
They had already set up the bed for us in the living room, which we didn’t expect but really appreciated.
The only thing worth mentioning is that the couch/futon had many stains, which we noticed after waking up and tidying up the living room.
Other than that, it was a pleasant and convenient short stay.
Excellent place in Santiago, nice restaurants nearby. Quickly resolved an issue when we realised we didn't have a heater. The apartment is a little dark inside for hanging out

Our hosts were absolutely lovely – always helpful and friendly. They helped us whenever we needed. The location of the apartment was also great, making it easy to explore the area. We definitely recommend staying here!

The apartment was perfect with one of the best views of Santiago it's located in Barrio Italia, which has so many restaurants and cafés and everything is very close. José was very helpful and always responded quickly. Thank you

This is a beautiful apartment close to a number of coffee, shops and restaurants. The Neighbourhood feels very safe and welcoming. Our host welcomed us in person when we first arrived and gave us a great tour of the apartment, which is absolutely gorgeous. Their number of personal touches which shows how much attention was put into its design. I would not hesitate to stay here again on my next trip to Santiago.
Very comfortable apartment, good rooftop views (we took a glass of wine up there), lovely neighborhood.

Soledad was quite communicative and helpful throughout. The place is exactly as described. It is also situated close to a Metro, and walking distance to plenty of restaurants, bars, and a few museums.

I love it here 🙌! And I can’t stop extending my stay.
I’ve honestly lost track of how many times I’ve extended this stay.
That should tell you everything.
Fast WiFi, super comfortable, quiet building, and unbeatable location. Philip is a fantastic host. This place just makes life easy.
Great apartment for my stay in Ñuñoa, very well equipped with everything I needed. Nice modern building and well located.

We returned to stay at Francisco's beautiful, grand house and we were greeted with the same wonderful hospitality as the first time. We really enjoyed our stay in the best location in such a comfortable place to be. We walked to old and interesting places in the city and visited excellent restaurants. Francisco is a very good host. We hope to return again soon. Five stars plus. Highly recommend. Thank you Francisco.

Highly, highly recommend this apartment in the heart of Santiago.
Location is perfect, value for money is fantastic and, best of all, Sebastian is an amazing host. He’s friendly, well-travelled and informative, offering some great recommendations for enjoying Santiago in a less conventional way.
I loved this place and would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Rodolfo's beautiful house is located at the centre of a very popular district in Santiago. I highly recommend renting his property.

Hector is a great guy. I enjoyed my stay. His place is very quiet. The bed is very comfortable. I slept well. The weather was starting to get very cold and if i had stayed longer i would have needed a heater.  But very cozy and warm in bed. I liked my stay. A very unique place.

Absolutely the best airbnb I have stayed in. The views will take your breath away. Andres was so helpful and responsive. Apartment was immaculate and as described. perfect size for me. I was here for work and finally was able to step away and feel feel comfy and at home and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Thank you so much for everything. I hope is available when I return. I will not think twice to stay at any of your properties.
Thank you,
Mike D. from Virginia
Nice place, the parking is a pain to her in, i should be automatically but overall a good place. The ac wasn’t working tho

Karime’s place was our home for almost three months, and we truly enjoyed our time there — we felt at home from the very first moment.
The apartment is just perfect: it's fully equipped with everything you might need. The location is also very convenient, within walking distance of the Alto Las Condes mall.
The view of Manquehue Mountain is simply beautiful.
And last but not least, Karime is an amazing host. She was always kind, available, and attentive whenever we needed anything. Communication with her was smooth and fast.
If you're looking for a place to stay in Santiago, this is definitely it!
Thanks again, Karime, for having us!

Nancy was a great host, always made sure we had everything we needed and responded quickly to any questions we had. The apartment was in an amazing location, right by many restaurants, shopping areas and the metro. The apartment gets a lot of light during the day and has a great view of the mountains near the city. I would recommend staying here while on your trip to Santiago.

5 star ⭐️ review for 5 star ⭐️ property!!
I stayed here for 9 days and can’t say enough positive things about the area, my apartment and the communication and help from the property managers. I felt right at home and safe, being a solo female traveler that is important!! Easy to walk everywhere and great restaurants all around you:) Comfortable beds and pillows are an added plus ! Thank you again :) 🙏

Fantastic place.  Perfect location.  Breathtaking views, literally exactly like the photos... The host was ways accessible when we needed, prompt and probably the best communication I've ever experienced at an Airbnb.   Look forward to coming back here!!!

Would definitely recommend to stay at Mabel's loft! The home is beautifully decorated and well equipped. Restaurants, bars, groceries, shopping, and a Santiago Metropolitan Park are all within a short walk.
Amazing apartment, all the necessary things were in place (towels, soup, shampoo etc). Extremely friendly communication, easy check-in and check-out

Guille is amazing ! I had a great time ! The desk people were also super helpful .
FYI , there is a Peruvian restaurant two blocks away from the air bnb if you looking for great food

Great apartment in a very safe and well connected neighbourhood.
Very clear check in instructions and fast response times.
Excellent value for money.
Recommended and would happily stay here again on my next visit to Santiago

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is beautiful, very well connected, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The hosts were incredibly friendly, helpful, and proactive — especially when we had an issue with our previous stay. They kindly allowed us to check in early, which made a big difference. The windows block out almost all the city noise, making it a peaceful space to relax. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thank you!

Lovely apartment in a nice neighborhood. The place was very cozy and it had great views of the Andes. The Pedro de Valdivia subway stop was only a kilometer away. Many great restaurants are also close, as is the mall!

The apartment is in a central location, but it’s smaller than expected. The host was very kind and communicated clearly and quickly, which I really appreciated. Unfortunately, the surrounding area felt quite noisy and not very safe at times. The bathroom was very small and could have been cleaner. Overall, it was okay for a short stay, but not ideal for longer visits.

A must stay AirBnB in a must stay neighborhood!  We felt safe at all times with plenty of restaurants at our footsteps. We got in to Santiago on an early flight and by the time we landed they had the apt ready for a very early check in, that was perfect. Quick to respond for any issue and quick to help you with any questions or tips needed. The beds were VERY COMFORTABLE. Heaters available in each room. Traveled with my mom and aunt (the biggest critics of AirBnB hahaha) and they loved it as well.
Had an amazing stay! Camila let us check in early and was very helpful! The airbnb is perfect!
Safe area, nice apartment with a cool view, and Americo the host was super helpful and responsive.
Very nice, clean and spacious apartment. Very close to many major tourist areas. Hosts were very responsive, would recommend!

Very nice detailed apartment in a very nice area..Always felt safe. Walkable..No gym or Sauna in the building..WIFI was fast and reliable, many reboots each day..Very nice stay in Santiago..I recommend the apartment.
The apartment could not be in a better location, and Nestor was a great host! It was exactly what I was looking for

I stayed in this department for 3 months and I had a great time and a very good communication with Paulo. Paulo did really make me feel at home. A month into my stay during my wife’s stay for a couple of weeks he gave us more Independence. The apartment is in an excellent location with shops and restaurants nearby, and a metro station. For short and long stays in Santiago, there no hesitation, stay with Paulo.
Bruno was very responsive and helpful and allowed us to check in early which was great. Building felt very safe and secure.
We didn’t much assistance but the place is very cozy, close to public transit or plenty of places to eat. We had a great time at Cristian’s place.

A nice room in a very nice neighborhood. The bed was very comfortable and the Wi-Fi worked really well. The neighborhood is very colorful and artsy with lots of cafes, restaurants and little theaters. A nice place to stay.

Felipe’s apartment has a MILLION DOLLAR view! The Andes will captivate you! His communication was always super responsive and when we had an issue with the heater he had it resolved that same day. The door staff in the building were really friendly. The location was a few steps from the metro and walking distance to lots of great restaurants, bars and shops. We loved our stay. Thanks Filipe and thanks Chile!

The price was affordable, but we experienced several issues during our stay.
1. Our room had a lock, but no key was provided, so we couldn't secure it. Since there were other guests in the house, we didn't feel comfortable leaving our belongings unattended.
2. The towels placed on the bed were damp, and unfortunately, the host didn’t respond when we mentioned it. One of the other guests kindly showed us where to hang them to dry.
3. Cleanliness could be improved — the bathroom had hair in the bathtub, and the kitchen wasn't very clean either.

Francisco’s townhouse was a dream come true for our trip to Santiago. The location and space were phenomenal and Francisco made sure that we had everything we needed. On top of all of this, the space is packed with amazing art that we enjoyed taking in throughout our stay. Highly recommended!
Hector was an amazing host - responsive, kind, funny, and helpful. The location is great and his place was an enjoyable experience too.
The flat was comfortable, clean and well decorated. The views were amazing. Not often you wake in the middle of a city to see mountains on all sides.
Great place. Luis was super welcoming, they left some chocolates and wine. The place and location are super nice, the WiFi was great too. Really lovely place

Great location. Very comfortable and Cristian was very helpful with questions 🤗
Would definitely stay again

The apartment was exactly as described. It came with some complimentary food and snacks, which was a pleasant surprise. The host was very proactive and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend this place.
Great spot. Walking / short uber distance to tourist attractions, restaurants etc. I would stay here again for sure. Host was very responsive and accommodating.

Alexander's place was perfect for an efficiency stay in Santiago. The apartment is super convenient to everything, and he accommodated my checkin time due to my early flight arrival. I would definitely return!
An inclusive and inviting host. I’ll think of Paulo as a friend in Chile for years to come!
Perfect! Easy to find, perfect ABs clean place and everything worked out great! Definitely will come back If I come to Chile again

This property is just as gorgeous in-person as it appears in the photos! It is filled with art and beautiful furnishings. The rooms were all beautiful and beds very comfortable. The location is very convenient - within walking distance of downtown. We also appreciated how responsive and flexible Mabel was. Just a wonderful place - highly recommend!
Was a great place and everything was smoothly done . Thank you very much . I highly recommend this place .

The apartment is clean, very comfortable, and is as advertised. The building is safe. Jose is very responsive and helpful. Location-wise, you are close to the downtown. The Metro and the Bus are close. Good place to stay.

Great place, close to all the restaurants and bars in Lastarria and right next to Saint Lucia Hill.  Nice and spacious and host is always there to help with whatever you need!  Be sure to visit Bocanariz, Chipe Libre and Santiago Wine Club (Pamela is amazing at picking out bottles).
Thank you so much Margarita for sharing your home with us, we made amazing memories to last a life time and will definetly come back!
Rebeca was very helpful  and empathic with our struggles. we felt comfortable in the flat - thank you!

The place is beautiful and has an amazing view, especially at sunset , really something to enjoy.
Christian was very friendly and quick to answer any questions we had, which we appreciated a lot.
There were a couple of things to keep in mind: the internet connection didn’t work during our stay, even after restarting the router several times. Also, some personal care items mentioned in the listing (like shampoo or soap) were not available.
Overall, we still think it’s a great place and would recommend it!

Everything was great! The apartment was very clean, good WiFi, ample hot water, comfortable bed, great views and in the middle of a safe neighborhood with lots of restaurants, shops and supermarkets. Andrea was friendly and very responsive.

Extremely well equipped apartment, easy to keep clean and organised thanks to its superb modern design. Fantastic location for restaurants, supermarkets and metro. HOM are great hosts, extremely responsive and attentive. Also concierge is extremely friendly and also very helpful so you never feel alone!

We had a very nice stay here! When we arrived Paz was already outside waiting for us to make sure we can locate the house. The accommodation is located at the back of the house, so it’s actually quiet :) Everything was well prepared, drinking water, heater was on. The bed is also very big so we both had good sleep! The washing machine and dryer also worked well. Paz has also always asked us if everything is okay and made sure we tell her if we had any problem and she has always been responsive. On our last day after we left for the airport, we left something behind and Paz also offered to send it back to Germany 🥺 Thank you! ❤️

Absolutely loved - perfect location and the views are amazing. Brian was extremely helpful and even allowed me to update my reservation for an additional day at the last minute.
Highly recommend
Claudia was excellent. We had an issue with poor cleaning of the bathroom by the housekeeping staff and she had it cleaned quickly. Extremely responsive and wanted to make sure everything was right.

We had a good time at Jonathan’s place. The apartment was just as pictured with all the amenities we needed, the views of the mountains were spectacular.
Location was excellent with a grocery store across the street, and the subway entrance was also on the next block.
It was a nice walkable neighborhood with various shops and restaurants.
Would love to stay at this location again.

We felt very much at home here. It is secure, has quick access to public transit. The home is well furnished and we had everything we needed for our stay. Host was very responsive to our questions. Note: If you need to do laundry during your visit, you will need your own detergent.
Maria's place was spotless, and it was centrally located.  The views are beautiful.  Maria and Marley are wonderful, and I 100% recommend staying here.  It was perfect for a solo traveler.

I would recommend Camilo's  listing to all considering a visit to Santiago.   It is a beautiful and relaxing place to end a busy day of sightseeing, with wonderful artwork to enjoy throughout.  Great, safe location with lots of options for coffee and dining.
honestly the price is a little too high but I will say Carla was definitely a great host and the view wasn't that bad at all
Very easy to find place and no troubles checking in. Many thanks for entering the apartment early. Apartment was really clean and I liked the central location. Many thanks for hosting me :)

A few things at home should be improve, and make sure they are in good working condition.
like the dryer is a low efficiency, non vented and for that reason takes a long time to dry the clothes.
The door in the master bathroom needs to be fixed or replaced, does not close at all.
For the price paid, at least we should have access to extra toilet paper and Shampoo, and body soap available.
Please consider this, recommendations and it will make a good impact in the future guests.

Jonathan was flexible with check in times and spoke great English which was great for our lack of Spanish. He gave us the rundown on the surrounding area and great recommendations. Clean and nice place walkable to many places. 10/10 recommend.

This apartment was extremely conveniently located for our stay in Santiago, whether we were walking to things nearby or taking the metro that was just a quick walk away. Maria Jose went above and beyond as a host, allowing us to drop our luggage off before check in and taking time out of her day to help me sort out an issue with an airport transfer.

great stay for our entry point in Santiago. it is more centrally located to other barrios that you’ll want to explore, which is very nice. the place was warm (it’s winter and this hasn’t been the case at a few other airbnbs) and the hard wood floors are charming.
Cristobal was so responsive to our questions. He was also very helpful when we had something stolen.

Paz is an intelligent and attentive host. Ideal place to recharge your batteries.
Pros:
Peaceful and quiet
Great for a good nights sleep.
Decent sized room.
Clean.
Safe area.
Fast Fibre internet.
Secure environment.
Responsive, kind, attentive host.
Functional modern bathroom.
Located close to the Metro and major roads.
Surrounding area is walkable and pleasant.
Beautiful views of the mountains.
Intant hot drinking water.
Host provides knitted slippers.
Cons:
There are quite a lot of rules which helps keep an ordered and perfect, clean home but it might be overwhelming for some who are more free spirited.

The house is in a very beautiful neighborhood, and the house itself is very cute! Jacqueline is very helpful and attentive. Danielen wasn’t feeling well, and Jacqueline made a point of checking how she was doing and gave her some medicine. The house is super cozy, I recommend it to everyone!

Beautiful apartment with natural lighting, Friendly Benjamin met us on arrival and and showed us around the apartment. Carolina was quick to respond to us with any query.
The apartment is in a quiet location and it is easily walkable to Plaza de Armas.
Thank you for hosting us in Santiago 🫶
Loved our stay here! Hosts were super friendly and even let us extend our checkout, which we were super grateful for. Lovely apartment and location!
Great place and location. Very safe. Michael was very accomadating with early check-in and late check-out. Would recommend

Awesome location and HOST! He went above and beyond as I was visiting for my birthday. He had fresh fruit, fresh flowers and even snacks outside and inside the fridge to make breakfast and lunch. I arrived super early in the morning and he was gracious enough to allow me to check in the wee hours of the morning. Very responsive and helpful on recommendations on where to go, where its safe to go and checked on me daily to see if I was ok.  If you are looking for the best location to stay while visiting Santiago, THIS IS THE LOCATION. Will for sure be back and use this penthouse again. Oooh I forgot the views are stunning, but beware of the Winter, jaja its super cold, but he has plenty of heaters.

Francisco was a great host: friendly, proactive and also welcoming then giving us the home with all amenities and privacy. The place was exactly as advertised and as in photos.
Quiet, spacious, and with kind extras like fresh bread with jam and butter, fresh ground coffee with milk and sugar. Providencia is a safe and attractive inner city suburb - easy metro access and walkable - and with many bread shops, cafes, supermarkets; the perfect place from which to explore Santiago.

The lodging is fantastic, the skiing facilities excellent, but the administration of the ski tickets and classes a disaster.  We had to stand in line for over an hour every single day to get tickets for the ski lessons because they don’t sell them in advance.  Information about different options is inexistent. Also there is no signaling or piste maps once you are in the mountains

The apartment is clean, spacious and well equipped.
The balcony is perfect when having your morning coffee.
The neighbourhood is nice with many restaurants and shops nearby.
Karen and Carlos are caring hosts who will make you feel right at home.
Highly recommend if you are staying in Santiago!
Nice room and neighborhood. The host was very nice and waited for me to arrive even though it was late. Only the shower was hard to use, besides that a great place!

Javiera was an incredible host! She was so helpful and easy to reach. Her attentiveness really made a big impact on my trip! 10/10!!
The apartment has absolutely breathtaking views. Sunrise coffee on the patio in view of an enormous Andes mountain range is not something I will forget anytime soon.
I hope to visit again next winter, I loved every minute of it!

Great stay, our first nights in Chile and it made for a great home base. Across from a great park. Only annoying thing was the QR codes needed to get in and out of the building (quite a clunky process to get the code). Other than that minor grievance all was well
I traveled to Santiago with my family from Australia. The apartment was excellent, with stunning views, perfect location, and the hosts were very helpful and easily reachable.

We had a great time here. The place is cozy and very well located. Dominga, Nino and Flor are super friendly and helpful. The only thing is that most of the things in the apartment is old. Nothing serious or deal breaker but a replacement for new houseware and devices would be well appreciated, as well as a good deep cleaning in the whole apartment. Thank you!

Gian’s place was excellent for what I needed for a few days stay in Chile. The apartment is very well organized, quiet and cosy with all the necessary commodities. Gian himself was a really great host. Very pleasant and extremely easy to get into contact. I really look forward to staying here again the next time I visit Santiago
Everything matched the description was in a nice area very close to shopping centres and great restaurants! Host was very responsive and easy to deal with

The apartment was as described. Its biggest selling point is the location! Perfect for exploring the city on foot, metro or Uber. Stunning sunrise and sunset views. The building staff was very friendly and attentive. Showers were well-stocked. We didn’t really use the kitchen much, but enjoyed the complementary bottle of wine and used the toaster for breakfast.
We were on the go most of the time in Santiago, but it was a great price for 5 days and in the middle of everything!
Cynthia’s place and her helpful attitude were great. Unfortunately during our stay the internet was sporadic.
Quiet place, a lot of things nearby. Be careful, Wifi is not included. However, host provides credentials for a shared network, which is not neither stable nor fast
This cozy, modern, and clean apartment offers all the amenities you need. The very responsive host ensured my stay was as comfortable as possible. I highly recommend staying here.

Carolina was very nice since day one after we booked, supporting with more then just the apartment and going beyond to helping with snow related tips.
The space accommodated very well the 4 of us (2 kids, but could be adults as the beds were great). Small but cozy, exactly as described and seen.
The building itself was also great. The heat pool was deliciously hot, the kids had fun at the internal kids area, there was a fire at the chimney room, easy to park inside at designated spots and ski in an out helps tremendously. Would definitely come back here and recommend anyone to do so!

The apartment is comfortable, and we had a good stay. A couple of ubers told us the neighbourhood was dangerous, and although we didn't have any issues it doesn't feel very safe; many storefronts are shut with metal curtains, and it feels a bit abandoned. It's very central and everything you need is close by though.
The apartment has everything you need and Antonio is extremely helpful and communicative.

Great apartment. The place is actually better than the pictures posted. Very nice view to the snowy mountains. Premium location a couple hundred meters from skiing area and lifts. Spacious master bedroom and closet considering it’s a small apartment. Very compact kitchen and spotty internet but that might be a common issue across the board in the surroundings since it’s a remote location 3,000m above sea level.
Maintenance could be improved since the balcony lights were out and the heater/radiator in the master bedroom requires maintenance, rusty and paint chipped.

Such a cool little apartment in an awesome neighborhood! As described, you are right in the mix in this apartment. The front bedroom facing the street can be a little loud at night but it was worth it to be in the middle of such an amazing area!

Absolutely wonderful! Casa Araucaria is a true gem in Santiago, beautifully decorated with incredible taste and charm in every detail. The location couldn’t be better: just one block from Sky Costanera, with easy access to the Jumbo supermarket, various shops, and even the Hard Rock Café! The house is cozy and spacious, with heated floors, very comfortable beds, and everything you need to relax after exploring the city. Mabel was a thoughtful and welcoming host, and everything was spotless. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for comfort, style, and convenience in Santiago!

this place was really good. its not to far from a few bus stations and at an okay walking distance to the next underground station.
the view from the balcony is amazing and the apartment has everything you could need, including a washing machine with drying function.

Lidia's place is perfect if you plan to go to the mountains for some day hikes or to the ski resorts! We had a super lovely time and Lidia is one of the nicest hosts we have been to! Great place and super clean too!
All was good, I had to check-in at 6:30am and that was not a problem (paying a whole day for the remaining 3 hours of course), so it was very convenient for an early arrival to Santiago.

Great location to explore Santiago from and Carolina was very helpful and easy to deal with. Sadly utensils in the kitchen when we came to use them were dirty. Apartment could do with a little investment as aspects felt tired and worn out.

I stayed at this place multiple times. The location works well for me. The building is nice and secure. The location is close to Oxxo, cruz verde, The House, Lumier and La Virgen restaurants are all walking distance. The Internet is stable.

Clean, great value, close to metro, overall pleasant, comfortable space, perfect for exploring Santiago or catching Skitotal bus to Valle Nevado. The building was also very nice with concierge, and plenty of conveniences right in the neighborhood as well and restaurants within a stone's throw. Thanks Andrea!

I definitely recommend.
My husband and I had a long layover in Chile and decided to stay near our friend’s home, but terribly far from the airport. The bed was comfortable and the apartment is clean. It is definitely a pleasant stay for 2 people. Heads up- if you come in the winter time don’t forget to put the water heater on. It took about an hour and half for it warm up the water completely.

Camila and Andrés were so welcoming and friendly. What started out as a helping us out with a special request, ended up being a great evening of sharing and getting to know each other. They are so generous and make sure their guests are happy. As far as the apartment, it is so conveniently close to the airport but is quiet and very easy to sleep in. The bed was super comfortable, and everything was clean and organized. 100% recommended!

I stayed at Miguel’s airbnb for two weeks and I loved it, I didn’t want to leave! Miguel was a great host and he responded quickly whenever I had any questions. The building is a few steps from the red line metro, very convenient. The building is also close to the cutest cafe ever, Lover, which is woman-owned and yummy. The view of the city from the unit was beautiful, the bed was comfortable, and the neighborhood felt safe. Across the street is a well used path for walking/jogging/scootering. I wish I brought my rollerblades. As another reviewer mentioned, the place gets dusty quickly probably from the construction, so I brought a small air purifier to help with my asthma and I was fine. I would 100% stay here again!

Maria was very responsive and helpful. I definitely recommend her as a super host.
The apartment has a nice balcony that covers both bedrooms and the common space.

Great location, near subway and places to visit.
Paola is very atention.

Lovely apartment, centrally located, with free parking in a garage included. (Max 1,95cm tho..)
Cozy place, great shower, impeccably clean and lovely decorated. 10/10 would book again. :)

I would definitely recommend this apartment. It is updated and modern, has fabulous views of the mountains (sunset pictures will not disappoint), spotless and many extra touches!
Standouts to me: shower warmed quickly, plenty of available heaters, extra storage in the bathroom for toiletries, even an emergency light and first aid kit. And the washer/dryer combo was a huge bonus!
The apartment is in a very walkable area with much to do. The doormen are vigilant and we felt very safe. Because it is in a busy area, there is some city noise, but it did not keep us awake!
One of the best Airbnb apartments I’ve ever stayed in! Would definitely recommend.

A very warm and friendly host! The loft is absolutely stunning and flooded in natural light. Very comfortable stay. The loft is located right in the middle of the entertainment precinct - surrounded by restaurants and bars. Note that in the evenings and into the night you will hear the party sounds from around the neighbourhood. On the Saturday night it was very noisy, but on the other nights it was mostly a distant murmur and didn’t cause us an issue. The metro is a comfortable ten mins walk away and the entry to Cerro San Cristobal and the famous Neruda house, La Chascona, are only two blocks away. The 24-hour concierge was very helpful and friendly.
This was a great place for us. It was convenient and the house was very unique with colorful art and plenty of space. Would highly recommend!

Neighborhood vibe while a block from transit that is convenient to downtown. Beautiful apartment and the room/bathroom are detached so a lot of privacy. Great for my extended stay to work from home and to enjoy the city
Thanks to Carlos, Cecilia, and Vincente. They are very kind and helpful. Their responces are always very quickly. We have a good stay at their comfortable house.

Great view. Not sure why a cleaning fee is paid because I found plastic wrappers on the floor as soon as I stepped in. Had to clean the sediment stain in the toilet. Hair and residue on walls of shower. Had to clean some dishes before using them.
Had I not had a driver, negotiating parking lot security would have been a challenge. Was going only on Juana’s first name and the name of the building. Didn’t get an apartment number or anything. Fortunately the concierge staff was extremely nice and helpful.
Given the challenges in the disparity between check-in/check-out times and the road schedule up and down the mountain, some clearer communication about what to expect would have been very helpful. Nonetheless, I very much enjoyed my stay.

This place is perfect! From the views to the beautiful layout inside. The rooftop pool deck with even more views make it even better. Check in was super easy, All the property staff polite and helpful. The security makes it extremely safe. It’s with in walking distance to one of the largest shopping malls and lots of restaurants. The host was incredibly helpful and detailed. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Santiago area.

Consuelos place is very comfortable and has all the facilities we needed.  Consuelo was very helpful with direction s and we found the location to be with on walking distante to the centre of the city.

The location was excellent and apartment layout was convenient. Maria was a very responsive host which we appreciated.
An improvement we suggest is to update mattress or add a foam topper in the larger bedroom as it was not the most comfortable.
Overall, a good first stay in Santiago.

Beautiful and comfortable apartment on a great location. Claudia was super responsive.
We had a great time on our stay!
Hector was brilliant, very kind and helpful. Lovely house in a good location. I felt very safe

Great place to stay, the location is key and very easy to find. Check in and communications was really easy.
thank you.
Barbara was very friendly and responsive. We had a great experience staying at the apartment. Felt very safe in Vitacura.

I’ve stayed in many airbnbs over my years of travel but by far Gonzalo’s Airbnb was the best my friends and I have ever experienced.
Location and pricing was great and the house built by the owner himself was warm and cozy .
Gonzalo is also an incredibly nice and genuine man who only wishes for you to have a great stay and feel like you’re at home.
I’d highly recommend anyone who is visiting Santiago to look into Gonzalo’s house .

Carmen was an amazing host. She went above and beyond helping me with everything that I needed being new to the city. She was always happy to give me advice about the area and also managed to fix any issues that came up with the airbnb while I was staying there. Would definitely recommend staying at Carmen’s if you’re looking for a place in Santiago!

We loved the place, easy to get to slopes. Great location! Giancarlo made the whole process very easy, he was very accommodating with all requests and information about the property. Communication was A+. Thank you so much, we truly enjoyed the stay can't wait to come back next year. Arthur
So close to restaurants, easy to find, lots of food and very walkable!  The surrounding coffee spots were amazing!

I had a wonderful stay in Santiago! The Nunoa region truly offers a delightful mix of great restaurants and markets. It's such a lovely option for anyone wanting to explore and get to know the city better. I can understand why someone would find it an excellent choice!

I felt right at home at Veronica’s place! Her and her son were very welcoming. On the first day, she stayed home to make sure I got checked in okay and showed me around the neighborhood. Right next door are two amazing parks that I spent a lot of time in and there are lots of little corner shops where you can buy a prepaid sim if you need one. There is also a farmer’s market twice a week in the neighborhood.  As for the room, the bed is soft and there is a heater. Veronica also provided me with lots of blankets and even got me a hot water bottle to sleep with since I’m not used to cold climates anymore. During the weekdays it is fairly quiet and her cute dog Zendaya doesn’t bark much when no one is home, the weekends get a bit busier but that’s to be expected as it is a homestay.

When we return to Santiago, we will definitely want to stay at Madeleine’s apartment again. Everything was just as we expected. Great location, very close to the metro, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, and supermarkets. You can even walk to the Costanera Center. The bed is very comfortable, the shower is great, and everything was clean and well-organized. The building’s doormen are very friendly, and the facilities are excellent. The apartment suited us perfectly, and communication with the host was easy and smooth.
Susan was so sweet, the place was safe, clean and charming. The bed was comfy and the location was fantastic. Definitely recommended. Susan was a wonderful host

Great stay! Anita Maria and her husband made me feel so welcome! The place was walking distance to great restaurants and easy to get to other parts of town. Next time I’m in Santiago, I’ll reach out to them again!
Excellent place to stay, very close to the Manuel Montt station and near everything in Providência. Andrea was very friendly and helpful.
that was absolutely perfect - the bed is super comfortable, John is super friendly, I wish I could have stayed longer !!
Really enjoyed my stay. The place is flooded with light, was clean and the instructions were super helpful.
Sebastian is a good person, always answers my question. The apartament very close to Santa Lucia subway. Walk in Santigo and look de Andes cordilheira is beaultiful.

I loved my stay and enjoyed the jacuzzi and pool! The space felt so cozy and welcoming, and it was spotless when I arrived. The location couldn’t have been better, with plenty to do just a short walk away. The host was so kind and easy to communicate with, which made everything stress-free. I’m already looking forward to coming back next time I’m in the area!

Valentina was very accommodating with check in and check out, and answered all our questions about how things worked immediately when we emailed her.  The place was comfortable for our group of 5 and the views of the Andes were outstanding from almost every room!  The condo is very convenient to the ski lifts (sky in/out) and a short walk to the hot tub, restaurants, and shops.  We loved it here!

My stay with Lorena was amazing. I had a really good and comfortable experience here. Lorena was very flexible and easy to communicate with and her mother was super friendly as well. I’d definitely come back and stay again in Santiago

Incredible place, good taste in everything, felt very much like a home and super cozy.
Near restaurants and small stores, the local was excellent. I have only the greatest things to say. Would definitely come back. Thanks for everything:)
Sebastian is a great host and his home is so conveniently located. I look forward to staying here in my next visit!
I had a wonderful Stay at Oliver's place. Many attractions were at walking distance or close by. Photos matched advertisement
Very nice, simple apartment in the Bellavista barrio. Ximena was very communicative and we were even able to check out a bit later.

Everything was just fine with this modern apartment. Nice upscale area of Santiago so no worries there. Only stayed for a few nights but cooked breakfast & they had everything available in the unit. I would recommend!

Loved staying at Matias place.  The apartment was exactly as described, it had everything we needed and it was comfortable and in an excellent location right next to the slopes.  Matias was a great host and very helpful and responsive. Would recommend it!

Very centrally located, great food around the area. Public parks near by for working out or just a quick jog. Walkable to trendy areas (if you enjoy walking around exploring). I had plenty of storage space for my snowboarding equipment. Awesome patio to enjoy a smoke or a great view of the Andes or the city.
Evelyn was extremely helpful and accommodating, I was able to book parking if you are getting a rental car. I would definitely book here again in the future.
The apartment is super comfortable and they've clearly invested in a wide variety of amenities to anticipate guest needs. I had an excellent stay, and Rosita was very kind.

Perfect for several reasons. Close to the metro and MUT, close to offices and restaurants , close to the ski resorts, and overall centralized to the things to do in Santiago. Very safe neighborhood and security staff are always friendly. The cleaning lady is always friendly and helpful. I basically used the home as my base of operations to work remotely as well as proximity to the shuttle station to go to valle nevado for snowboarding. At one point I got sick of valle nevado and rented a car to go to other resorts which was convenient as parking is included. The hot tub was solid for me after skiing on the weekends. Can’t say it’s the quiet neighborhood however some challenges trying to sleep with an opera singing neighbor who throws parties. Personally I’m young enough to not care but I would not recommend it if you’re looking for a quiet spot. Overall I would recommend and definitely plan on returning.
We had a great stay at Marita, the location and views are amazing! She was also a great host. The place had everything we needed.  Would happily stay there again, and recommend it.
Great place close to the slopes! If you plan to cook, be prepared for a rudimentary kitchen setup, but the place is a good find in an expensive town.
