Very nice and confortable apartment. It’s very close to the metro station and it even has a mini super market in front just crossing the street.
If you're looking to explore the historical center, you can't beat the location! Oh, and 24h reception, which is great. Apartment is cozy and has everything you need.

We liked the apartment, it was as described and the host was very responsive and helped with checking-in and give us instructions to enter the building. We like the location because it is close to restaurants, market, and also to move around with Uber. Recommended.

It was a pleasure - i don’t speak spanish but I felt right at home with Sonia who helped me checkin. I found the accommodation a welcome change for me (being always preferring hotels with all facilities). The 3 separate keys for car park, main gate and the front door were a cherry on top :-)
Jose’s place was a great stay during the time in Santiago. The view is amazing overlooking the city. Not far from the center and surrounding areas. Also very peaceful area.

Four friends and me stayed at Leticia's apartment. It is a nice, well located and clean apartment. Leticia answered promptly all the doubts we had regarding the apartment.
Highly recommend it!

The apartment is in an excellent location: very walkable, with plenty of great restaurants nearby.
The main room is spacious, and having 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms makes it ideal for comfort and convenience. The apartment itself is very cozy, and the kitchen is both well-sized and well-equipped, perfect for cooking at home. The Nespresso machine for coffee and the milk frothing machine was a nice touch.
The balcony is huge and a fantastic spot to relax or spend time with friends. Having a designated parking spot was also extremely convenient.
Overall, a wonderful stay - definitely 5/5.

Highly recommend staying at Claudia’s!  Her house is very convenient to the slopes…you can walk or take the shuttle to ski and to restaurants.  Plenty of space, well stocked, and with a beautiful view.  Claudia is also super helpful and very proactive with information and directions.  Five stars!!!!
Beautiful and very comfortable apartment. Everything went perfectly, and I’ll definitely stay with Pablo again the next time I visit Chile.

Wow can I just say this was an INCREDIBLE stay!! Truly the definition of hospitality. I’m a solo skier and booked this place locally to be a 5 min walk to my transportation (provided by Skitotal) to and from Valle Nevado and so I could stay locally and enjoy restaurants in the evening. From an incredible seamless stay, I truly could have not asked for a better experience. I felt so at home, from the cafe connected to the building, to the helpful hosts and their accommodations, to the open spaces to work remotely; as a solo traveler I never felt alone in any way, I felt so safe! I wish I could rate this place higher. Best Airbnb experience I’ve had. I would solely return just to stay here again. Thank you to all who made this stay so memorable!! Muchas gracias!!

It was wonderful! Everything is perfect on this place. Principally the location.
Thanks Andrea and AIRBNB for moving me from the other place and refund me to be able to confirme the Andreas Airbnb.
Fernando’s place was just as described.  Clean and comfortable, it’s also in a great area to go out in the evening. It was worth the price we paid.
Perfect place to stay. Shower was great, bed extremely comfortable, all the appliances worked perfectly. Will definitely seek this place out for my next stay in Santiago. Thanks for hosting, Arturo!
The apartment was beautiful, spotless, exactly as pictured, and the host was very communicative and responsive. Highly recommended.

If you are needing a home base to explore Santiago, look no further! Right in the middle of the city center with endless cafes, restaurants and sights to see all within walking distance. Brian & Pablo are great hosts and wonderful communicators as well. Will gladly stay again next time I’m in the city. Muchas gracias!

everything is super, the apartment is definitely worth the money. good neighborhood, 24-hour metro store nearby and a nice area. the apartment itself is clean and well-maintained like new. I don't know if they prepare it for every season or if they manage to maintain such cleanliness, but everything was great, even the dishes and pots were absolutely new.

This condominium has a magnificent view of the mountains from a wrap-around balcony, is comfortable and looks exactly as pictured, and has a well-stocked kitchen. There were just two of us, and we had access to 3 bedrooms and only 1 of 2 bathrooms - do bring your own soap, shampoo, conditioner. Sound carries in the hallways, so it makes sense that the TV volume is locked at a moderate level. The thermostat is also locked at a comfortable level - we likely could have negotiated with Francisco if we needed a cooler sleeping temperature. The storage room for skis and boots is easy to access and locks are provided. You can ski out in good snow conditions. Francisco was super responsive. The staff members in the lobby, particularly Flavio, were also extremely welcoming. We enjoyed our stay!
Amazing location and cute apartment!! Definitely would recommend. Fernando was very communicative and Alejandra was lovely — we loved our visit here!

Micaela’s place is right next to the museo Bellas Artes, and walking distance to Lastarria. Very convenient location, but it is very quite because it face interior. Micaela is a great host, she is very responsive, easy to communicate with. I arrived at the apartment after 2am in the morning, there was no problem with the check-in, and she let me check out late.

Eduardo's accommodation was perfect. Its central location, close to shopping center and highways, and underground parking were very convenient for exploring the region by car for 5 days. The high floor and elevated views of the Costanera tower and the city is magnificent. I was able to check in very early after my international flight early flight. Finally, the apartment is extremely quiet.
A huge thank you to you Eduardo.
Philip’s was great! He was a wonderful host and always super responsive to any questions we had. Great location and perfect amount of space. Can’t wait to go back!
she was the best house I had treated me like family and was literally the best Airbnb I'd stay at this place when I come back most definitely . thank you Lidia for the amazing experience
Great place. Parking garage saved us. Need to talk to doorman to get in but was very easy. Safe neighborhood and easy to get around. Recommend!

It was my first time renting a room. Check-in and check-out were super easy. The accommodation has everything you need and a very nice little heater. It has a private bathroom and a shared kitchen. Marley the dog is super sweet, friendly, I loved Marley. The apartment is located in the center of Santiago. It's very easy to walk everywhere.
Sofía was the best snd kept us updated with road closures to make our ski trip as easy as possible.

We loved our stay here. Ana was so friendly and helpful, from allowing us to check in early to looking after our bags before we left for the airport. The apartment was beautifully equipped and the kitchen had new, clean implements. The bedroom was very comfortable (a huge bed and high quality linen), and the wardrobe space was useful. Next time we are in Santiago we will certainly come back. Great value for money and a lovely apartment.

Gabriel is super helpful and friendly! The apartment location is incredible! There are so many local restaurants and shops in the area. The view from the apartment is breathtaking. Snow-capped mountains that feel within reach above a bustling yet friendly city. I highly recommend Gabriel and this apartment!
The location is ok. You can walk to the city centre in 20-30 minutes. The streets are good and peaceful. The kitchen is fully equipped. The internet is fast.

This place was perfect! Right by the rentals, lodge and mini market, also ski in ski out.
Juana and team was so responsive, polite and helpful, we felt totally at home knowing we were staying at a safe and high quality establishment. Highly recommended!!
We had a fantastic five nights at Matias' place. He was incredibly responsive and everything was perfect. We will be coming back!

The apartment is 50m from Valle Nevado. Easy to walk and perfect for a time of skiing. Guillermo and family are very responsive and helpful. Response time was minutes. The house is spacious and clean. Just like the pictures. Kitchen had full appliances.
Perfect place for a solo traveler or a couple. I was using it as home base while skiing in Valle Nevado for a few days so it’s location was ideal. The building itself is very nice and very safe.

Daniela-Fernando are great hosts. Very responsive  The apartment is  within walking distance of the significant tourist areas. They allowed us to leave our baggage before checking in, which was appreciated.

We stayed here for a couple nights and loved it. The building was nice, the views were awesome, even despite it being winter, and the space was very clean with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We hope to return again soon!
We had a wonderful stay near Santiago and at the bottom of the hill to Farellones. Great stay for a family and could easily make meals there. Very comfortable and the house heats up well.
I like this location it was walking distance to shopping area ..The apartment was very nice and Aline was kind and helpful. I would stay here again!
Amazing place to stay. Beautiful view and Coke is amazing host. I recommend a million times. Would love to stay here again. Thanks for everything :)
Nice place. I'm coming back in the future for more activities. The surroundings is great and the apartment is not only nice, but well located.

Antonio is responsive and friendly host. Walkable to local mini market and restaurant. We wish we stay a little longer. Apartment is convenient located. We're really enjoying the place, have no complaint and highly recommend.

Nice apartment in a hotel that is in the center of Providencia. Safe neighborhood, lots of dining options nearby, and walking distance to the metro. The hosts were very accommodating and helpful -- especially Ivan and Ana -- even with our limited Spanish. We appreciated being able to do laundry and store our luggage for the day after check out.
Giancarlo was a great host and so responsive and friendly whenever I needed anything or had an issue. You can’t expect a better host than Giancarlo
Would stay here again! Christian was a great host, he made sure we had everything we needed to be comfortable! Great spot in the city, right by St Lucia Hill.

Apartment had everything that I needed. Very comfortable.
Easy 4 minute/300 yard walk to ski ticket counter and slopes
For a ski area, restaurant prices were a normal high.
I enjoyed my brief stay at the apartment. Walking distance to downtown and I felt safe in the neighbourhood. The thing I liked about the place was the very comfortable bed. I would stay again

It’s a convenient location close to banks, mini marts and restaurants, metro station.
It’s very clean and spacious and super easy to check in and Gabriela is very responsive and provide local recos.
You can get to restaurants near the park and also historic center easily by Uber.
One thing to call out is that the laundry is done by coins or by QR code. Couldn’t get the QR code working and it was hard to get coins. But I also stayed for 2 weeks with travels to other places and needed to do more laundry than normal folks.

Our stay at the Airbnb at Philips Place was fantastic! The highlight was the stunning terrace with a relaxing jacuzzi perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring. The space was clean, stylish, and well-equipped with everything we needed, from comfy beds to a modern kitchen. The hosts were super responsive and thoughtful, making check-in a breeze and providing great local tips. The location is ideal, with shops and restaurants just steps away. Highly recommend this gem for a luxurious and memorable stay!
Great stay! Perfect location, easy check-in, super clean, and just like the listing. The host was really helpful and quick to reply.
Fantastic location with plenty to do nearby and a great selection of restaurants within walking distance. Cristobal was extremely responsive and always happy to help. Highly recommend!
Great area, felt secure, always monitored, close to the subway and many bus stations. Close to lots of supermarkets, many things to do. Excellent place for a short stay.

Great clean apartment
Very good value for a stay on the snow
Bring provisions as dining options are limited.

It’s definitely the great place to stay. The location is perfect where is near a lot of attractions and museums in Santiago. There’s a bit of trouble to check in, because we arrived at the apartment very early in the morning, but all things ended up well. The place is clean and comfortable to stay, which definitely worth the prices we paid.
Quiet environment, friendly host, great location. Perfect for a short stay. The apartment is a bit old and tired but feels safe and comfortable.

Great host, beautiful spot. Great for a Solo Traveler or a couple. Pretty close to all the Major Tourists attractions, Landmarks,most of which you could walk to if you're up to it and a short taxi ride if you're not. Good selection of food close by, in addition to public transportation and anything else you might need. Apartment provides great views, Reception downstairs so not just anybody Can enter the building without you, they were coo too.

I confirm that this apartment is in exact best location in Lastarria.  Right in center but private and secure with 24/7 concierge.  It is very nice to have two bathrooms with bathtubs.   The apartment is significantly less expensive than the other apartments and hotels.  It provides value.  Last, the hosts are very responsive and KIND.

We felt very comfortable staying with Carlos and Karen. Everything was clean and there were lots of restaurants and bars around the corner. All kinds of transportation options were nearby and we never felt unsafe. Karen is very friendly and always responded quickly to my messages. We were even able to check in early.
Overall great experience. The host was so friendly and helpful with me. The communication was great and that’s the main thing I look for. The place was also great and the bed comfortable!

If you are a skier, this is the place! So convenient and just a few steps back-and-forth to the mountain. A true ski-in/ski-out experience. Great communication with Matias. The place is small, but we already know that. Completely equipped with everything you need. All the right touches. Location, location, location! Communication was by far, a great additional benefit. A wonderful experience all around. I would love to come back.
Excellent place to stay in Chile. Super nice apartment with great views of the city. It’s well located just minutes away from many historical landmarks and stores.

I highly recommend Javiera’s place to anyone coming to visit Santiago. I stayed for about 5 weeks and really felt like the place became my home. The concierges are all extremely friendly and the building has high security, so it feels very safe. The laundry in the building was really convenient. I loved the view from the room, and I recommend going up to the roof on the 23rd floor to see the sunset. The place felt pristinely clean and had everything I needed. The bed was also amazingly comfortable. I truly did not want to leave!

I had a wonderful stay here! The apartment is in an ideal location, with lots of shops and restaurants around. It was very clean and cozy. Ana María was friendly and responsive to any questions. I definitely recommend it!
This stay had the best bed, linens, and pillows of anywhere I’ve ever stayed.  The host was friendly and always responsive.  I will definitely stay here again in the future.

If you want a place that makes you feel at home in Santiago, that has unique charm, close to "it" all, with the sweetest host you could ever imagine, stay here!
Bernebe was incredibly responsive and attentive, gave great advice and will make you want to come back and stay there again!
This was our second time staying at The Place. Never disappoints. Great accommodations, amazing service and staff.
AMAZING location, the host always answered very quickly and super efficient, super easy check in would absolutely come back!

I was so pleased with this place and it’s location. Next to the metro and downtown. Many places to eat, visit and walk to. The unit is well designed and maintained. Javier was so hopeful with recommendations and attentive to any of my needs. I will be back and the wonderful views at night are amazing. Thank you again!

I have to say usually I wouldn't take a chance on a place with zero reviews but I was astounded by the quality, especially for the price. Location was great, apartment was everything and beyond that was described. Both Nicki and Sam were incredibly helpful in regards to check in and that insider knowledge for recommendations. If I ever come back to Santiago I know where I'll be staying.

We had a perfect experience. Francisca arranged for us to check in early as we had come straight from London and arrived at 8:30am - we were so grateful for access to a bed after a long journey! The apartment was spotlessly clean, the bed super comfy, and everything we needed was right there. Whenever we asked for anything or had a question, they helped right away, and also very kindly allowed us a later checkout. The apartment is walking distance to activities and restaurants, a short walk to the metro, but also very quiet for rest and sleep. I would definitely stay again.

Great place! The apartment has a view of the Andes. It is also about one block away from a large underground mall that has plenty of food. Close to the metro too. Perfect location really. And the host was very friendly and communicative.
We had a great stay in Santiago, and Gabriel was very flexible and accommodating. The views of the Andes Mountains were absolutely breathtaking! Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at Ivan's place. the location is perfect very central and easy to move around, we rented a car and having free parking was a huge help. We felt safe and comfortable at the building and apartment, it's equiped with everything one needs to make yourself comfortable. I would definitely come back!

this was our first visit to Santiago and because of the attentiveness of the host Juan and the location of the apartment, it will not be our last. Juan was really helpful, providing us with great tips and recommendations for everything from shopping, to trips, to restaurants, to sights. His apartment could not have been more equipped and secure with great access to pretty much everything we needed in the city. We are regular travellers and would thoroughly recommend your consideration of Juan and his home.
